title: Tu Hi Re Dil Mein
summary: Tu Hi Re Dil Mein (transl. You Are In My Heart) is an Indian Hindi-language television family drama series which premiered on Zee TV on 15 June 2026 and stream digitally on ZEE5.  Produced by Films and Shots Production, the series stars Priyanshi Yadav, Abrar Qazi and Simran Rawal. It is an official remake of the Malayalam TV series  Mizhi Randilum of Zee Keralam.
plot: Believed to bring luck, Vrinda marries her dream man, Sanjay, who loves Swati. Living in his home as a caretaker, Vrinda faces silent sacrifices and soul ties, uncertain if fate will ever choose her.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Priyanshi Yadav as Vrinda * Abrar Qazi as Sanjay * Simran Rawal as Swati

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Abrar Qazi was confirmed to play the male lead, Sanjay. Priyanshi Yadav was selected to portray Vrindha. Simran Rawal was cast to play Swati, making her television debut as a lead actor.

articleSections.title: Premiere
articleSections.text: The show was put on hold for some time from March dut to the lukewarm response from the audience for the first teaser and title dispute with Ekta Kapoor. Makers spend time in developing the love triangle and Sanjay's dilemma tracks. After the delay, the show premiered on 15 June 2026, replacing Saru.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text: The show opened with a low BARC TRP of 0.7 in week 24 of 2026.

articleSections.title: Title dispute
articleSections.text:
When Zee TV announced the title as "Pavitra Rishta" in December 2025, the creator of the 2009 iconic TV series by the same name, Ekta Kapoor slammed the makers for using the same title. She shared a sharp, critical note on her Instagram stating:
After the intense backlash from fans and producer Ekta, the channel changed the title to "Tu Hi Re Dil Mein" in April 2026.

articleSections.title: Director opted out
articleSections.text: In June 2026, director Ameet Guptha went public with social media evidence. He shared screenshots proving his name had been entirely chopped from the first episode’s on-screen credits despite he dedicated six months to pre-production and filming the initial episodes. Broadcaster ZEE Network officially withdrew its internal "rotational credit" policy in July after intense pressure from the Screenwriters Association.

title: Taarkata
summary: Taarkata is a 2026 Indian Bengali-language action crime web series directed by Samik Roy Chowdhury and produced by Avinaba Ghosh, and Vikram Chatterjee under his production banner Vikram Chatterjee Films. It stars Chatterjee alongside Priyanka Sarkar, Satyam Bhattacharya, Meiyang Chang, and Debesh Roychoudhury.
plot: Agni is a former police officer who returns to his hometown after years away. A mysterious death pulls him into an investigation tied to a past he had tried to leave behind. As the case develops, the lives of the other characters prove connected to the same history. Chhanda works in a field where death is routine but finds the emotional reality of it harder to manage. Dodo passes for modern and open-minded while hiding a violent streak.

articleSections.title: Background
articleSections.text:
Vikram Chatterjee had worked as an actor in Bengali cinema since his debut in 2012. He told t2online that producing was something he had planned for later: "Getting into production was something I would have done eventually, maybe a couple of years down the line. Bangla ZEE5 asked if I wanted to produce the show. Since they showed faith in me, I decided to take it up and execute it now."
Chatterjee had wanted to work with director Samik Roy Chowdhury for some time. "I've seen his work and really like the way he thinks and executes ideas," he said.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Meiyang Chang, a singer and television host, had not previously appeared in a Bengali-language production. His casting in Taarkata was one of the aspects Chatterjee highlighted when discussing the series' mix of talent.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first look was released in April 2026. The official trailer followed on 30 May 2026. "Bheshe Jai" was released at a promotional event on 8 June 2026.

title: The Pyramid Scheme
summary: The Pyramid Scheme is a 2026 Amazon Prime Video original Hindi-language television series written by Akshendra Mishra and directed by Ashish R Shukla and Shreyansh Pandey. The series stars Paramvir Cheema, Ranvir Shorey, Aanjjan Srivastav, Shekhar Suman, Ashish Raghav, Alfiya Jafri, Akhilendra Mishra, Smita Bansal, Indresh Malik, Sushant Singh.
reception:
The Times of India reviewer Dhaval Roy stated "The characterisations across the board are convincing," India Today reviewer Pritinanda Behera opined that the series "does slow down a bit around the middle."
Deepa Gahlot of Scroll.in writes that "The eight-part show swings wildly between farce and family melodrama, reaching the kernel of the plot rather late – how get-rich-quick swindles work, and how the perpetrators get away." Prathyush Parasuraman writing for The Hollywood Reporter India stated that "This pyramid scheme flatlines quickly, and A Silly and Soulless Stab At Scam Culture."
Abhishek Srivastava of Moneycontrol gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "There is a good series hidden somewhere inside ‘The Pyramid Scheme.’ What appears on screen is watchable enough, but it never becomes as compelling or insightful as its premise promises. Jaya Dwivedie of India TV also rated it 3/5 stars and writes that "The Pyramid Scheme may not become a cult series like TVF's Panchayat or Gullak, but it is definitely worth watching once." Sumit Rajguru of Times Now also gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that "The Pyramid Scheme is a worthy watch for those looking for something unique and light-hearted. The series has its standout moments that are not to be missed."

title: Thai Maaman
summary:
Thai Maaman or Thai Maaman - Thaikku Nigaranavan (transl. Maternal uncle) is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language Melodrama romantic television series that airs on Star Vijay starring Ranjith, Devipriya, Raj Kapoor, Seema G. Nair, Sastik and Shiyara Shalini
. Directed by Manoj Kumar, written and Screenplay by Chandru Dhuraiyappan, the serial revolves around the journey of a touching sentimental story between a brother and a sister.
The show was produced by Jagan Baskaran under the Box Office Studio banner. It premiered on Star Vijay on 27 April 2026, and airs from Monday to Friday at 19:00 and streams digitally on JioHotstar.
plot:
The series focuses on the relationship between Mayandi, a respected landlord in the village of Rasingapuram in Theni district of Tamil Nadu, and his younger sister Pechi, who is married to Manjamalai of the neighbouring village Nagalapuram.
Mayandi and Pechi have a strong bond and always look out for each other. While the two families were initially close, circumstances lead to a fight between Mayandi and Manjamalai during the ear piercing ceremony of Manjamalai and Pechi's third daughter Ilavarasi, leading to the death of Manjamalai's father at the hands of Sudalai, Manjamalai's wastrel and drunkard brother-in-law, who then puts the blame on Mayandi. This, along with Mayandi accidentally cutting off Manjamalai's hand during their fight, leads to Mayandi getting sentenced to fourteen years of imprisonment, shattering his family and beginning the life-long enmity between the two families, with Pechi, who is aware of her brother's innocence and refuses to condemn him, caught in between the feud. Mayandi's wife Meenatchi distances the family from Pechi's family and focuses on tending her husband's land while he is in prison, eventually becoming rich due to her hard work. On the other hand, Manjamalai becomes more influenced by Sudalai and, distraught due to losing his hand, becomes an unemployed drunkard and his family begins to face the hard times.
Ten years later, Mayandi is released from prison earlier than expected due to good conduct and returns home to witness the feud personally. The feud has extended to the next generation, with Mayandi and Meenatchi's son Azhagar and Manjamalai and Pechi's eldest daughter Poongodi (who were both close in their childhood) hating each other and blaming each other's fathers as the cause of their conflict and engage in practical jokes and verbal banter most of the time. Azhagar is in love with Nandhini, who is the daughter of Deivanai, Meenatchi's sister-in-law. The conflict takes a drastic turn during Poongodi's puberty ceremony, which is held later than usual due to her poor health when she is menstruating. Manjamalai, who reluctantly, on Sudalai's request, invites Mayandi and his family to the ceremony only to seize Mayandi's properties, becomes infuriated when Mayandi asks for Poongodi to marry Azhagar in exchange for the properties. Manjamalai insults Azhagar's parentage and challenges Mayandi and Azhagar that he would get Poongodi married to another person within a week. Poongodi's marriage is arranged with a middle-aged bar owner named Pandi. On the night before the wedding, Azhagar, to get back at Manjamalai for his cruel words on his parentage that shattered Meenatchi and vowing to stop the marriage at any cost, kidnaps Poongodi and keeps her safely in an abandoned cinema theatre until the Muhurtham (auspicious time for marriage) is over. Once he has won in his challenge i.e. ensuring that the wedding does not take place, he personally takes Poongodi back home. At this juncture, Poongodi and Manjamalai hatch a plan to humiliate Azhagar and his family due to the humiliation faced by Manjamalai on the marriage not taking place. As part of this plan, Poongodi forces Azhagar to marry her in front of the Rasingapuram panchayat and then enter his home to expose and humiliate Azhagar, Mayandi and their family members and show that they are not good people as they claim to be.
The rest of the story revolves on whether Poongodi and Manjamalai succeed in their mission, whether Poongodi and Azhagar accept each other despite the circumstances, whether the brother-sister bond of Mayandi and Pechi can continue to hold and whether the two families would ever reconcile.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Thai Maaman was produced by Jagan Baskaran under the banner of Box Office Studio, known for his series like Thendral Vandhu Ennai Thodum (2021-2023), Kaatrukkenna Veli (2021-2023) and Chellamma (2022-2024). The series is directed by Manoj Kumar, known for his series like Mouna Raagam (2017-2023) and Chinna Marumagal and written by Chandru Dhuraiyappan.
The concept of the show was originally based on Bharathiraja's 1993 film Kizhakku Cheemayile.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Tamil film actor, Ranjith was cast as Mayandi, marking his return after Bigg Boss 8. Actress Devipriya plays the role of Mayandi's sister Pechi. Raj Kapoor played the role of Pechi's husband, Seema G. Nair played the role of Mayandi's wife.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
Star Vijay released the series' first promo on 5 April 2026 featuring all the main cast. The second and third promos were released on 13 April and 17 April 2026. On 22 April, revealing the upcoming release date.
The show debuted on Star Vijay on 27 April 2026 from Monday to Friday at 19:00, taking Sindhu Bairavi Kacheri Arambam 's time slot.

title: Thadayam
summary: Thadayam is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language crime thriller streaming television series written and directed by Navinkumar Palanivel for ZEE5. Produced by Ajey Krishna under the banner Cocktail Cinemas, the series stars P. Samuthirakani and Sshivada in lead roles. The narrative is inspired by events reported in 1999 along the Tamil Nadu–Andhra Pradesh border. The series premiered on 27 February 2026.
plot: Set in 1999, the series follows a series of ritualistic midnight murders in rural villages along the Tamil Nadu–Andhra Pradesh border. The perpetrator's pattern involves stealing the mangalsutra (thali) from victims, contributing to local fear and speculation. Sub-Inspector Adhiyaman investigates the case alongside Inspector Lakshmi, as they navigate the social and psychological tensions surrounding the crimes.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The official trailer was released on 19 February 2026. The series. streamed on ZEE5 from 27 February 2026 in Tamil.

episodesList.title: The First Case
episodesList.summary: Adhiyaman, a police officer on the waitlist for VRS, investigates a case of theft. Later, when a different village reports a similar incident, SI Adhiyaman observes a startling pattern.

episodesList.title: The Border
episodesList.summary: Unable to find leads in the investigation, Adhiyaman meets the victims of the theft case. Just as he is about to update the inspector about the case, he finds a clue about the culprit’s whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Truth Meets Devil
episodesList.summary: Adhiyaman and his team reach Andhra Pradesh and are shocked to discover a series of murders that follow the same pattern. As they visit the murder locations, more shocking twists await them.

episodesList.title: The Warning
episodesList.summary: The officers receive news about another murder while investigating in Andhra Pradesh. While the team splits up to follow different leads and includes villagers in the search, another life is lost.

episodesList.title: Find The Devil
episodesList.summary: Statements from the survivors confirm Adhiyaman’s theory about the culprit. Meanwhile, the police finds crucial evidence in the last crime scene that helps in their search across the states.

episodesList.title: The Conclusion
episodesList.summary: The evidence leads them to the criminal's last location. As they find more clues of multiple offenders, the police devise a plan to separate the culprits and arrest them. Will Adhiyaman’s plan succeed?

plotHtml: Set in 1999, the series follows a series of ritualistic midnight murders in rural villages along the Tamil Nadu–Andhra Pradesh border. The perpetrator's pattern involves stealing the mangalsutra (thali) from victims, contributing to local fear and speculation. Sub-Inspector Adhiyaman investigates the case alongside Inspector Lakshmi, as they navigate the social and psychological tensions surrounding the crimes.
tagline: In the shadowy corners of rural Tamil Nadu, a sub-inspector unravels a chilling mystery of midnight murders tied to stolen mangalsutras.

title: Tod Kar Dil Mera
summary: Tod Kar Dil Mera (transl. After Breaking My Heart) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series which premiered on 19 January 2026 to 31 May 2026 on StarPlus and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced under Bombay Shows Studio, it starred Anurima Chakraborty and Ashish Raghav.
plot:
Set in Lucknow, the series follows Raj S. Ranjan, a middle-class clerk who marries Advocate Raushni Srivastava in an arranged marriage. Despite the circumstances, the two quickly fall in love. Raj lives with his conservative family, which includes his mother Sumitra, his sister Ritika, and his younger brother Mayank. After marriage, Raushni chooses to prioritize her married life and becomes a homemaker.
Raushni learns about Raj's unfulfilled dream of becoming an IAS officer, a wish once held by his late father. Raj had been an IAS aspirant but was forced to abandon his plans after his father died of a heart attack, after which he took up his father's job to support the family. When Mayank is framed in a violent case, Raushni represents him as an advocate with Sumitra's permission but is threatened into deliberately losing the case to prevent him from being falsely accused of a more serious crime involving a woman named Keerti. Unaware of the truth, Mayank begins to resent Raushni. Around the same time, Sumitra is diagnosed with lung carcinoma but hides her illness. Impressed by Raushni's dedication, Sumitra allows Raj to leave his job and prepare for the UPSC examination.
While Raj studies, Raushni manages the household and helps Ritika gain confidence. Raushni and Sumitra develop a close bond before Sumitra eventually passes away. On the same day, Raj receives the news that he has cleared the UPSC examination and is appointed as an IAS officer. Raj then leaves for a three-year training program, where he meets fellow trainee Meghna Gupta. Over time, Raj grows close to Meghna. Meanwhile, Raushni becomes pregnant with Raj's child, but Raj tells her to abort the child. His reaction causes her severe stress, resulting in a miscarriage and the inability to ever conceive again. During Raj's training, the couple's relationship gradually weakens.
Upon completing his training, Raj sends Raushni divorce papers. After initially refusing to respond, she eventually learns about his affair with Meghna and agrees to the divorce. Following several counselling sessions and court proceedings, Raj and Raushni separate, and Raj later marries Meghna. Meanwhile, Mayank receives political backing from a businessman named Vikrant Rathore, who is supported by Meghna's father K.K. Gupta. Mayank becomes a corporator after murdering his political opponent. Raushni purchases the Ranjan house from its owner despite opposition from Raj and Mayank. Mayank marries Keerti, who is later revealed to be involved in criminal activities such as honey-trapping and money extortion. Ritika supports Raushni and eventually becomes a lawyer like her. Honoring the promise she made to Sumitra, Raushni accepts Meghna as the new daughter-in-law of the Ranjan family and performs the rituals welcoming her into the household. Over time, Raushni and Meghna develop a friendship.
Raushni's law firm is later assigned to handle pending cases under Raj's jurisdiction. Along with her friend Isha, she investigates a bridge collapse that caused multiple deaths. The investigation reveals that Mayank, Vikrant, Rammoorthy, the contractor, and Raj were involved in corruption. During the investigation, Isha is murdered, leaving Raushni devastated. Determined to seek justice for her friend, she resolves to uncover the truth and hold those responsible accountable. With the help of Ritika and police officer Kartik Tyagi, and with Meghna’s support, Raushni begins investigating Isha’s murder. Following the clues Isha left behind, she uncovers that Isha had gathered strong evidence in the bridge collapse case, which ultimately led to her being killed by Mayank. Ujjwal, once Mayank’s trusted aide but now Raushni’s confidant, steps forward and testifies against Mayank, exposing his crimes. Additionally, a recording of Rammoorthy’s final words implicates Mayank, Raj, and Vikrant, further strengthening the case. As a result, Mayank is convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment. Raj is dismissed from his position and faces a departmental investigation for his involvement. Meanwhile, Raushni is promoted to the position of a judge and is appointed to the District Court. In a twist of fate, Raj’s case is reassigned, with Raushni presiding as the main judge. Ritika, deeply shaken by Mayank’s arrest and Raj’s downfall, struggles emotionally but still hopes for Raj’s redemption. Around the same time, Meghna is revealed to be pregnant. However, she chooses to leave Raj and moves into the Ranjan house, where she begins living with Raushni and her family. Over time, Raushni and Meghna develop a deep bond and become best friends. Meghna gives birth to a daughter, Jr. Sumitra, but tragically passes away a few minutes after childbirth. Before her death, she entrusts all parental rights of her daughter to Raushni and asks Raj to stay away from her daughter. Raushni honors Meghna’s final wish. Weeks later, Raj files for custody of Jr. Sumitra. Due to Ritika refusing to testify in Raushni’s favor, Raj ultimately wins custody of the child. Meanwhile, as investigations into corruption deepen, Vikrant Rathore and K.K. Gupta shift the blame onto Raj, framing him for their own crimes as well. Raj is subsequently sentenced to two years in prison as punishment for his actions. During this time, Sid, who had been held captive by sea pirates for several months, is finally rescued and reunites with Ritika. In the prison, Mayank, who had a change of heart, apologises to Raushni and stays with Raj as an inmate after Raj's aged inmate dies. Raj has a change of heart in the prison.
Two years later, Raj is released from prison after completing his sentence and returns to the Ranjan house. With Raushni and Raj’s approval, Ritika and Sid decide to get married. Having changed as a person, Raj once again asks Raushni for her companionship and a chance to rebuild their relationship. However, Raushni refuses, choosing instead to stand firm in her own path. Over Ritika's wedding preparations, Raj tries to persuade Raushni with the seven vows given to her. Raushni, before the wedding night, firmly refuses. A heartbroken Raj leaves the house. Over the night, Raushni realises Raj's changed behaviour and decides to reconcile but he has already left. Ritika's wedding gets postponed and Raj is presumed to be dead and his final rites are performed. Raushni is persuaded by Ritika and Mayank to punish K.K. Gupta and Vikrant Rathore for their crimes and provides evidence against them with Ritika as the lawyer.
Seven years later, life has moved on. Ritika and Sid are married and live in the Ranjan house. Jr. Sumitra yearns for her father. Keerti returns to the Ranjan house with her and Mayank's son Vishesh. Mayank is released from jail for his good behavior. Raj is revealed to be alive near Kanpur who has given up his leisurely life and teaches UPSC aspirants for free. Jr. Sumitra's teacher, Sameer, comes as a tenant to the house of Raushni's neighbour Jagrani. He develops a deep bond with Jr. Sumitra. Meanwhile, a man named Bhagwant protests against Raushni's decisions in court, due to which the court panel removes her. It is revealed that Keerti is also working with Bhagwant to conspire against Raushni. They are working under an unknown leader. As Jr. Sumitra keeps demanding Raushni for a father, Raushni's family tries to convince her to marry Sameer. Raushni eventually agrees to marry Sameer. Raj's student Bittu clears UPSC. On Raushni's engagement day with Sameer, Bittu goes to tell this good news to Raushni, having known her when he was a child. Raushni sees a video of Raj in Bittu's phone, and realises that Raj is still alive. Along with Mayank, Ritika, and Jr. Sumitra, she goes to Raj's village and convinces Raj to return to the Ranjan house. Raj agrees and returns along with them. As Raj is revealed to be alive, Sameer cancels his engagement to Raushni and promises to always be her good friend. Jr. Sumitra refuses to accept Raj and wants Sameer to be her father, but Raushni wants to marry Raj. Later, Raj tries to win Jr. Sumitra's trust by playing with her and Vishesh, and travelling with her, but she still wants Sameer as her father. Meanwhile, Bhagwant convinces Rammoorthy's son Angad to join him in conspiring against Raushni. Raj asks Sameer to marry Raushni, but Sameer refuses. Eventually, Raj and Raushni get married, and Jr. Sumitra accepts Raj as her father on Sameer's request. After their marriage, it is revealed that Raj is still evil, and is the leader of the conspiracy against Raushni to get her impeached from the position of judge, with Bhagwant, Keerti, Angad, and K.K. Gupta as members of his team. Raj takes Raushni outside using the excuse of eating Biryani to get her stabbed by a disguised Angad. One week later, Kartik gives her a gun for self-defense. Meanwhile, Raushni is given ten days to justify her decisions that she gave as a judge, which might stop her impeachment. But Raj tampers with her files, which makes Raushni's opportunity fail. Raushni's health deteriorates and she falls into depression. The doctor advises her not to take stress. Mayank starts suspecting that Raj is involved in the conspiracy against Raushni after seeing Raj talk to Keerti. Raushni gets impeached and is labelled as mentally ill, which shatters her. Later, Mayank talks to Raushni and both have suspicion on Keerti. They plan to do a fake fight so that Mayank talks to Keerti and she tells Mayank about her leader, but their plan fails as Raj overhears them and tells Keerti not to tell anything to Mayank. Their fake fight makes the family think that Raushni's mental health has deteriorated, and they think of sending her to asylum. Later, Sameer joins Raushni and Mayank, and follows Keerti as part of the plan. He records Keerti talking to Bhagwant, Angad, and K.K., and sends it to Raushni, hence confirming their involvement in the conspiracy against Raushni. Raj meets his team members and expresses his wish to kill Raushni and make it look like suicide, which even K.K. finds to be too cruel. Later, Raushni tells Raj that K.K. Gupta is involved in her impeachment, and goes to confront K.K. He tells Raushni that there is a mastermind who is leading all this. Just as he is about to say Raj's name, Raj secretly shoots him dead using Raushni's gun. The next morning, Raushni realises that Raj is the mastermind after thinking for a while. She tells Ritika about this, but Ritika refuses to believe her. Then Raushni confronts Raj, who reveals that he planned this all to destroy her and take revenge from her. He tells her to prepare for Karva Chauth, pray for his long life and die. Raushni is left completely broken. She sees a vision of her deceased mother-in-law Sumitra motivating her. Later that day, Raushni shoots Raj dead and sees a vision of Sumitra nodding in approval.
A few years later, Keerti rides off somewhere on her motorcycle. Raushni is released from asylum. Sameer and an adolescent Jr. Sumitra come to pick Raushni up from asylum and they have a reunion.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was announced by Bombay Shows Studio on StarPlus. It was initially titled Tod Kar Dil Mera... Hua Sab Tera. Principal photography of the series commenced in October 2025 The filming took place in Lucknow.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The series is set against the backdrop of Lucknow. The promo featuring the leads was released on 8 January 2026. The cast promoted the series Mohanlalganj and Lucknow.
The series was made available for streaming on JioHotstar and received mixed reviews from critics.

episodesList.title: Pagphera
episodesList.summary: Newlyweds Raj and Raushni embark on their journey of love and married life. Raushni steps back from her profession to be with Raj. How will their bond and future unfold?

episodesList.title: Pehla Din
episodesList.summary: Raj faces humiliation at his workplace due to his job position. Later, Raj asks Raushni to meet him, while she contemplates how to step out during her Muh Dikhai ceremony.

episodesList.title: Saza Ya Inaam?
episodesList.summary: Raushni defends Mayank when Sunil reports his violence to the police. Later, Mr. Maathur advises Sunil not to go against Mrs. Raushni in court.

episodesList.title: Waapsi
episodesList.summary: Sumitra questions Mayank about the case for which he chose Raushni as his advocate. Later, Raushni eagerly looks forward to returning to her in-laws' house.

episodesList.title: Aakhir Kab Tak?
episodesList.summary: Joy fills Raushni's heart as she receives a letter from Raj. Later, she confronts Raj about their family's hidden conflicts, asking how long misunderstandings will keep them apart.

episodesList.title: Ek Nayi Shuruaat
episodesList.summary: Raj thanks Raushni for being his life partner and urges Mayank to change his life. Later, Raushni is left speechless on seeing Raj's UPSC hall ticket and subject books.

episodesList.title: Puraane Zakhm, Naye Vaade
episodesList.summary: Raushni learns how Raj gave up his IAS dream after his father's death and took a job. Moved by his pain, she comforts him and promises to stand by him as he dares to dream again.

episodesList.title: Ahoi Ashtami Ka Din
episodesList.summary: Raj gives Ram seven days to correct the tender. Later, Raushni promises Raj she will convince his mother to let him take a study break.

episodesList.title: Adhure Sapne
episodesList.summary: Raushni tells Isha she wants to fulfill Raj's unfulfilled dream of becoming an IAS officer. Later, Raushni reveals that the letter invites Sumitra as a guest on FM radio.

episodesList.title: Izzat Pe Daag!
episodesList.summary: Income tax officers raid Raj's house and suspend him pending an enquiry. Later, Sumitra urges Raushni to cleanse the Ranjan family name and prove Raj's innocence.

episodesList.title: Teer Ya Tukka?
episodesList.summary: Raushni presents video evidence to the income tax officer, saving Raj from a bribery case. Later, Sumitra agrees with Raushni's decision to support Raj's UPSC dream.

episodesList.title: Iss Mod Se Jaate Hai
episodesList.summary: Raushni surprises Raj by setting up a study room for his UPSC preparation, while Roshni meets Ashish seeking a job. Later, Raj assures Raushni he can balance work and studies.

episodesList.title: Parivaar Ki Naukari
episodesList.summary: Raj struggles to balance his entrance exam preparation along with his job. Later, noticing his stress, Raushni urges him to talk to Sumitra about quitting his job.

episodesList.title: Aur Phir Yun Hua...
episodesList.summary: A disappointed Raj tears his admit card, admitting he can't manage work and studies. Later, Sumitra recalls her late husband's dream of seeing Raj as an IAS officer.

episodesList.title: Badlaav Ki Bayaar
episodesList.summary: Raushni envisions Raj as a successful IAS officer. Later, she reads the letter about his resignation, while Raj faces ridicule from colleagues over his dream.

episodesList.title: Toote Pankh
episodesList.summary: The court finds Mayank guilty after strong evidence is presented and sentences him to jail. Later, Sumitra confronts Raushni for losing the case and collapses, vomiting blood.

episodesList.title: Kismat Ke Khel
episodesList.summary: Ritika shines at the party while Raj is devastated by Sumitra's diagnosis, as she prepares to reunite with her late husband, leaving the family broken.

episodesList.title: Jeena Yahan, Marna Yahan!
episodesList.summary: Sumitra refuses hospital care, insisting she wants to take her last breath at home. Later, on the day of the results, Raj rejoices after clearing the Civil Services Mains exam.

episodesList.title: Ummeedein Aur Aansoo
episodesList.summary: Sumitra plays cricket with the colony women, and Raushni wins the match for her. Later, she emotionally hands over the house duties to Raushni and urges Raj to never leave her.

episodesList.title: Maa
episodesList.summary: Sumitra passes away while singing on the radio, leaving everyone heartbroken. Later, Raj receives news of becoming an IAS officer and yearns to share it with Sumitra.

episodesList.title: Piya Se Judaai
episodesList.summary: Raj surprises Raushni with a terrace glowing with lights and flowers, promising eternal love. Later, an emotional Raushni bids Raj farewell as he leaves for IAS training.

episodesList.title: Khushkhabri
episodesList.summary: Raj calls Raushni to update her on his IAS training. Later, Raushni tries to inform Raj about her pregnancy, but he remains occupied with Meghana's family friends.

episodesList.title: Badalte Rishte
episodesList.summary: Raj is overjoyed to learn Raushni is pregnant. Later, Meghana advises him to focus on his career, and Raj urges Raushni to consider abortion, leaving her heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Khushiyon Ke Dukh
episodesList.summary: Raushni, devastated, confronts Raj over aborting their child. Later, the doctor informs Ritika that Raushni miscarried due to stress and cannot conceive again in the future.

episodesList.title: Rishte Ki Daraar
episodesList.summary: Mayank bravely rescues Keerti from the men relentlessly stalking her. Later, a distressed Raushni desperately tries to reach Raj, while he steadily grows closer to Meghana.

episodesList.title: Milne Ki Aasha
episodesList.summary: As Raj assures his love, Meghana urges him to prove it by talking to her father. Later, Raushni's hopes shatter when Raj denies visiting Lucknow despite Ritika's claim.

episodesList.title: Dil Par Chali Chhuriyan
episodesList.summary: Raj reflects on his journey and the future he envisions with Meghana. Later, Raushni is left stunned as Raj's divorce papers arrive in chilling silence.

episodesList.title: Do Kinaare
episodesList.summary: Raushni drifts into memories of Raj's promises of forever. Later, her heart shatters when she spots him, but he coldly ignores her and walks away.

episodesList.title: Yaadein
episodesList.summary: Raj feels proud as he becomes an IAS officer and remembers his father's words. Later, Praveen grows concerned about Raushni's relationship, while Harita reassures him.

episodesList.title: Koshish
episodesList.summary: Ritika tells Raushni that Raj has changed a lot since becoming an IAS officer. Later, Raushni confronts Raj for breaking her heart by sending divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Beti Ka Baap
episodesList.summary: Praveen goes to meet Raj and convince him to stay with Raushni despite the divorce decision. Later, Praveen's sudden death in an accident leaves the family heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Antim Vidai
episodesList.summary: Raushni decides to perform Praveen's final rites and asks Harita to stay with her. Later, Raushni confronts Raj about the day Praveen tried to meet him before the accident.

episodesList.title: Nayi Shuruaat
episodesList.summary: Raushni meets Raj to get his signature on the case documents. Later, at Raj's office, Raushni demands an explanation for the divorce and refuses to sign without it.

episodesList.title: Aamna-Saamna Aur Faisla
episodesList.summary: Seeing Raj with Meghana at their favourite spot, Raushni breaks down in heartbreak. Later, she signs the divorce papers, choosing to start her life anew.

episodesList.title: Naye Vaade
episodesList.summary: Raushni decides to start a new chapter in her life without Raj. Later, the judge accepts their divorce, but the final decision depends on the marriage council's report.

episodesList.title: Dard Ki Lakeerein
episodesList.summary: Raushni visits Chhaya, the marriage counsellor, for guidance. Later, Raj agrees to Meghana's decision to follow KK Gupta's orders to secure a divorce from Raushni.

episodesList.title: Dil Ki Baatein
episodesList.summary: Raj gifts Meghana a necklace as she urges him to attend the court hearing. Later, Raj and Meghana arrive together at Ritika's birthday, redefining their changing equations.

episodesList.title: Teri Meri Kahani
episodesList.summary: Raushni stands up for Ritika when Mayank tries to control her. Later, after Raj and Mayank warn Sid to stay away, Ritika cuts all ties with Raj.

episodesList.title: Haar Ya Jeet
episodesList.summary: Heeralal, the owner of Ranjan Niwas, gives Raushni a notice to vacate the house, but she decides to fight back to protect it. Later, with Raj's support, Mayank wins the election.

episodesList.title: Samjhaute Ki Shuruaat
episodesList.summary: Keerti celebrates Mayank's election victory as Raushni conveys to Raj that she chooses to walk her path alone. Later, Ritika rejoices after clearing her UGC Law exam.

episodesList.title: Maa Toh Maa Hai
episodesList.summary: Raushni sells her jewellery to secure Ranjan Niwas for Ritika's birthday. Later, an elderly aunt entrusts her Sumitra's legacy along with a heartfelt letter.

episodesList.title: Shaadi Ka Tohfa
episodesList.summary: Post-divorce, Raushni warns Raj to stay away and vows revenge for his betrayal. Meanwhile, Ritika stands firm against Mayank to defend Raushni.

episodesList.title: Dusra Vivaah
episodesList.summary: Meghana invites Raushni to her and Raj's wedding, leaving Ritika angry. Later, Raj and Meghana marry at the registrar's office, leaving Raushni heartbroken.

episodesList.title: Farz
episodesList.summary: Ritika credits Raushni for her victory and reveals the Power of Attorney transfer, placing duty on her shoulders. Later, Raushni performs rituals to welcome Raj and Meghana home.

episodesList.title: Dil Ke Bojh
episodesList.summary: Meghana thanks Raushni for making her Karwa Chauth special. Later, Isha's demise shatters Raushni, leaving her broken and guilty for failing to save her.

episodesList.title: Dosti Imtihaan Leti Hai!
episodesList.summary: Raushni vows to avenge Isha's death and takes charge of her case despite her grief. Later, Raj frantically pressures Mayank to scrub his name from the investigation.

episodesList.title: Jaal Ke Qaidi
episodesList.summary: Raushni confronts Raj for granting Ram Murthy a license despite corruption charges. Later, Raj and his team cooperate with Raushni to gain her trust.

episodesList.title: Yaado Ke Nishaan
episodesList.summary: Raj and Raushni recall Isha and her pranks. Later, while investigating Isha's death case, Raushni loses the pendrive containing Isha's details given by Kartik.

episodesList.title: Nayi Umeed Nayi Raushni
episodesList.summary: Raushni thanks Meghana for her support and decides to reopen Isha's case. Later, a wave of Isha's memories guides Raushni to a hopeful new clue.

episodesList.title: Adhure Chhootein Nishaan
episodesList.summary: Raushni and Ritika hunt for clues and finally crack Isha's email. Later, the digital trail reveals dangerous secrets as Raj begins to fear Raushni's next move.

episodesList.title: Aakhri Chaalen
episodesList.summary: Raushni clashes with Raj over the destroyed evidence while pushing the investigation ahead. Later, she traces Ayesha's address and sets out to chase the next crucial lead.

episodesList.title: Pehle Shikaar
episodesList.summary: On his deathbed, Ram Murthy tells Raushni that Mayank is behind all the crimes. Later, the police arrest Mayank for Ram Murthy's death and his role in the false tender budgets.

episodesList.title: Shaah Aur Maat
episodesList.summary: Raj scrambles to protect Mayank as suspicions rise around him. Later, Raushni uncovers a shocking truth about Mayank's second murder, leaving her shaken.

episodesList.title: Badi Ladaai Ke Chhote Kadam
episodesList.summary: Raushni remembers her cherished moments with Isha and takes up her case. As Raj vows to shield Mayank using his influence, she boldly promises to expose him.

episodesList.title: Vaadon Ke Bojh
episodesList.summary: As Ritika falls sick, Raj rushes her to the hospital, reminding Raushni of the late Sumitra. Raj blames Raushni for the rift in his family and for Ritika turning against him.

episodesList.title: Dhundhlaate Rishtey
episodesList.summary: Ritika demands Raj apologise to Raushni to prove his redemption. Raushni comforts a guilt-ridden Ritika and vows in court to expose Mayank's crimes.

episodesList.title: Khushi, Dukh Aur Sach
episodesList.summary: Raushni shocks the courtroom with a bold revelation, forcing the judge to adjourn the hearing. The move exposes a deeper game being played behind the case.

episodesList.title: Ummeedein Toot Na Jaayein
episodesList.summary: Raj bribes a man to give a fake statement in Isha's murder case. Soon after, doctors reveal Meghana is pregnant, but she wishes to have an abortion.

episodesList.title: Aarop-Pratyarop
episodesList.summary: Meghana reminisces about her childhood with Raushni and apologises for her mistake. Meanwhile, Raushni presents Ujjwal in court to prove that Mayank is behind Isha's murder case.

episodesList.title: Haar? Jeet? Nyay?
episodesList.summary: Advocate Mehra battles to acquit Mayank. Soon after, Raushni summons Ujjwal to testify against Mayank's crimes in court. Will the truth triumph and justice be served?

episodesList.title: Naya Aadhyay
episodesList.summary: Raushni presents strong evidence and tears apart false claims in court. The verdict shocks all as Mayank is sentenced, while her courtroom brilliance captures public attention.

episodesList.title: Uthal Puthal
episodesList.summary: Ritika celebrates Raushni's role in Raj's downfall as Meghana leaves him and seeks refuge. Raushni protects her, while Raj desperately searches and tries to reach her.

episodesList.title: Ek Adhuri Si Kahani
episodesList.summary: Drunk Raj vows revenge on Raushni for ruining his life and creates a scene at Ranjan's house. But real trouble hits him when officials confront him over signing illegal documents.

episodesList.title: Zindagi Ke Imtehaan
episodesList.summary: Raj faces police restrictions as Meghana refuses to return. Raushni's double game is exposed in a confrontation, while she leaves Gupta to face the consequences alone.

episodesList.title: Godh Bharai
episodesList.summary: Three months later, preparations begin at the Ranjan Nivas for Meghana's Godh Bharai. Excitement fills the air as Ritika announces that Raushni has been appointed as a judge.

episodesList.title: Ulte Padte Daav
episodesList.summary: Celebrations turn tense as Meghana avoids Raj during her Godh Bharai. The next day, Vikrant's clever ploy to rope Raj into his scheme fails miserably when Raj refuses.

episodesList.title: Nayi Shuruaat
episodesList.summary: Raushni embarks on her new journey as a judge, celebrated with a cake-cutting ceremony at the court. Raj is arrested with a warrant as he tries to escape the house with money.

episodesList.title: Sumitra
episodesList.summary: After giving birth to a baby girl, Meghana passes away, entrusting Raushni with her child. She also declares that Raj has no rights over the child.

episodesList.title: Nyayadheesh
episodesList.summary: Raushni heads to court where she and Raj are stunned to see each other, and he recalls dreaming of her as a judge. She urges Shashwat to confess and expose Raj and Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Mere Ghar Aayi Ek Nanhi Pari
episodesList.summary: Hearts melt as Raushni bonds with Sumitra and invites Raj to the naming ceremony. A tearful Raj is overwhelmed as he finally performs the sacred ritual he's dreamed of.

episodesList.title: Vakt Ki Karvatein
episodesList.summary: Ritika remembers Raj's concern for Sumitra and confronts Raushni about her motives to ruin his life. Ritika takes on Raj's case, and Raushni respects her decision.

episodesList.title: Asamanjas
episodesList.summary: Raj directs his lawyer to allege Meghana's mental instability to gain Sumitra's custody and sends a legal notice to Raushni. Shocked, she faces a dilemma but resolves to fight.

episodesList.title: Alagaav
episodesList.summary: Mayank is guilty and asks Ritika to catch Keerti with money. In the court, the verdict goes against Raushni, and Sumitra's custody is handed over to Raj with police protection.

episodesList.title: Papa Ki Pari
episodesList.summary: Raj struggles with solo parenting as he fumbles caring for Sumitra and reflects on his limits. His world collapses when police arrest him for bribery with solid proof.

episodesList.title: Faisla Ya Nyay?
episodesList.summary: As Raj gets arrested, Raushni gladly takes responsibility for Sumitra. Once the hearing date is set, Ritika questions Raushni's decision in Raj's case.

episodesList.title: Nyay Ki Goonj
episodesList.summary: The court opens with Mr. Gupta testifying against Raj's corruption. After examining the evidence, Raushni delivers the verdict, punishing Raj and upholding justice.

episodesList.title: Dilon Ke Andhere
episodesList.summary: Raushni struggles with isolation despite her success. Ritika marks a big career leap, while Raj faces a harsh reality check behind bars.

episodesList.title: Gunaah Aur Gunahgaar
episodesList.summary: Mayank's plea for a secret call is denied as tensions rise in jail. Raushni confronts Ritika, then coldly refuses Mayank, while Ritika's anxiety grows over Sid's silence.

episodesList.title: Sawaal Aur Jawaab
episodesList.summary: Raj mocks Mayank's plea while he defends Raushni. Ritika reunites with Sid and later seeks forgiveness, leaving Raushni emotionally shattered.

episodesList.title: Ae Kaash
episodesList.summary: Raj wakes up from his dream of living a happy life with Raushni and his daughter, Sumitra. He sees Raushni as a judge and himself as an IAS officer.

episodesList.title: Khaali Haath
episodesList.summary: Raj feels hollow from within. As Ritika struggles with Raj's case, Raushni guides her in the right direction, but Raj's emptiness leaves Ritika saddened.

episodesList.title: Aadhe Sach, Poori Baatein
episodesList.summary: Raushni grows emotional as her mother, Ritika, and the neighbours care for her after work. Elsewhere, Raj refuses bail and serves two years in prison as atonement.

episodesList.title: Rihaai
episodesList.summary: Raj is released from jail on Sumitra's birthday but goes missing, leaving Ritika worried. She finally brings him home, where Raushni coldly allows him to join the celebration.

episodesList.title: Pehla Vachan: Prem Aur Samaan Ka
episodesList.summary: Raushni reminisces about Raj's surprise on their first wedding anniversary. Raj agrees to Sid and Ritika's marriage, making Sid swear to uphold every ritual vow.

episodesList.title: Dusra Vachan: Raksha Ka
episodesList.summary: Joy spreads as Ritika and Sid exchange engagement rings in the Ranjan family. As Raj insists on rebuilding their relationship, Raushni confronts him over his broken vows.

episodesList.title: Teesra Vachan: Jeene Ka Saath
episodesList.summary: Raj tries to make amends with Raushni, asking for another chance to rebuild their relationship. Raushni feels both excited and pained about Ritika's upcoming marriage.

episodesList.title: Chautha Vachan: Imaandari Ka Vaada
episodesList.summary: Raj explains to Raushni that the money he gave for Ritika's wedding is legitimately earned. Raj feels like a burden due to his mistakes, yet remains determined to win Raushni back.

episodesList.title: Panchva Vachan: Sukh Dukh Bantne Ka
episodesList.summary: As Ritika's Bhaat ceremony begins, Anand arrives carrying memories of Sumitra. Amid the celebrations, Anand confronts Raj and requests Raushni give him another chance.

episodesList.title: Chhatha Vachan: Parvarish Ka Vaada
episodesList.summary: Raj feels guilty for failing to fulfil the sixth vow he made to Raushni as Sumitra gets annoyed being around him. Mayank returns home after serving his jail term.

episodesList.title: Saatwan Vachan: Moksh Tak Yatra
episodesList.summary: Raj recalls Raushni's seventh vow to love him till salvation, while Ritika's Haldi celebrations begin. Soon, Raushni forgives Raj but removes him from her life, leaving him broken.

episodesList.title: Kuch Zakhm Puraani Yaadon Ke
episodesList.summary: Raushni decides to give Raj a second chance, but he suddenly disappears, leaving a letter behind. With no clues, Raushni turns to Kartik for help gaining a hint from Pandit Ji.

episodesList.title: Do Kinaare, Do Sach, Do Zindagi
episodesList.summary: As Raushni searches for Raj, Ritika breaks down in worry. Caught between emotions, Raushni hopes for Raj's return and chooses to start their life anew.

episodesList.title: Kuch Aadhe, Kuch Adhure Se
episodesList.summary: Raushni is haunted by Raj's absence, while Ritika refuses to marry without Raj. She is called to the police station for identification, where she finds Raj's belongings.

episodesList.title: Kuch Khwaab Adhure Vaadon Ke
episodesList.summary: Raushni receives a courier from Raj containing evidence against KK Gupta and Vikrant. Mayank reveals Naushad's connection to the conspiracy, pushing Raushni closer to the truth.

episodesList.title: Kuch Bojh Adhuri Yaadon Ka
episodesList.summary: Sid leaves his home for Ritika while Raushni is shocked at Raj's death. Flooded with memories of Raj, she urges Sid to forgive his father, hoping to heal broken bonds.

episodesList.title: Ek Insaaf, Ek Bechani
episodesList.summary: Ritika regains consciousness as Kartik takes Mayank away, but Raushni shifts focus to revenge before bidding Raj a final goodbye. Sid finally secures a meeting with Naushad.

episodesList.title: Antim Vida Ke Baad
episodesList.summary: Raushni turns down Shashwat's proposal. Soon, her plan with Ritika compels Naushad to confess to his crimes and name Vikrant and K.K. Gupta, leading to their arrest.

episodesList.title: Waqt Ki Dhool
episodesList.summary: Seven years later, Sumitra turns Sunday into a fun-filled day, spreading laughter in the house with her riddles. Raushni and the family go on a picnic and spends quality time.

episodesList.title: Bhule-Bisre Dard
episodesList.summary: Raushni agrees to give shelter to Keerti after hearing about her struggles. She later urges Ritika to give Keerti a chance, reminding her she is Mayank's wife.

episodesList.title: Uski Yaadein, Uske Vaade, Uske Zakhm
episodesList.summary: Raushni helps Mayank realise his harsh behaviour toward his son while Keerti secretly plots against them. Sumitra cheers up Vishesh, making Raushni happy to see their sibling bond.

episodesList.title: Nazar Ke Dhoke
episodesList.summary: An old lady, Raj's neighbour, spots him, while Raushni reminds her about Raj's demise. Vishesh shares his pain with Sumitra as Mayank ignores him.

episodesList.title: Shaant Aur Klaant
episodesList.summary: Raushni urges Mayank to take responsibility for Vishesh and enroll him in school. Ritika urges her to expose Keerti, but Raushni vows not to ruin Vishesh's future.

episodesList.title: Kuch Khushiyaan Kuch Gham
episodesList.summary: Joy spreads as Raushni and the family reopen her father's general store. Memories flood Raj's mind as he cuts the cake for Sumitra's birthday, while Raushni recalls Meghana.

episodesList.title: Toofan Ke Baad Ki Tabaahi
episodesList.summary: Sumitra asks Raushni about her father, while Keerti begs Mayank for a second chance. Meanwhile, Bhagwant plots to humiliate Raushni as she mourns over Raj's photo.

episodesList.title: Ichchhaayein Aur Majbooriyan
episodesList.summary: Sameer requests that Raushni be gentle and caring with Sumitra. Raj is overjoyed by Bittu's UPSC success, while Mayank is shaken by a threatening call from an unknown number.

episodesList.title: Naye Mausam, Nayi Khushbuyein
episodesList.summary: Raushni promises Keerti that Mayank will marry her. Raj accompanies the villagers to file a FIR against Brijesh, then hides from Raushni at court, leaving her suspicious.

episodesList.title: Udte Khwaabon Ke Parinde
episodesList.summary: Ritika reveals to Raushni what she uncovered about Keerti's past, while Mayank accepts that Vishesh is his son. Raushni's mother plans to match her with Sameer.

episodesList.title: Ek Faisla, Ek Antardwand
episodesList.summary: Sumitra remains upset with Raushni, while Ritika advises Raushni to move on from Raj. Raushni puts forth certain conditions before agreeing to remarry.

episodesList.title: Vaadon Se Pehle
episodesList.summary: The family urges Sameer to get married to Raushni as he shares his emotional past with her. The two slowly understand each other's pain and agree to marry for Sumitra.

plotHtml:
Set in Lucknow, the series follows Raj S. Ranjan, a middle-class clerk who marries Advocate Raushni Srivastava in an arranged marriage. Despite the circumstances, the two quickly fall in love. Raj lives with his conservative family, which includes his mother Sumitra, his sister Ritika, and his younger brother Mayank. After marriage, Raushni chooses to prioritize her married life and becomes a homemaker.
Raushni learns about Raj's unfulfilled dream of becoming an IAS officer, a wish once held by his late father. Raj had been an IAS aspirant but was forced to abandon his plans after his father died of a heart attack, after which he took up his father's job to support the family. When Mayank is framed in a violent case, Raushni represents him as an advocate with Sumitra's permission but is threatened into deliberately losing the case to prevent him from being falsely accused of a more serious crime involving a woman named Keerti. Unaware of the truth, Mayank begins to resent Raushni. Around the same time, Sumitra is diagnosed with lung carcinoma but hides her illness. Impressed by Raushni's dedication, Sumitra allows Raj to leave his job and prepare for the UPSC examination.
While Raj studies, Raushni manages the household and helps Ritika gain confidence. Raushni and Sumitra develop a close bond before Sumitra eventually passes away. On the same day, Raj receives the news that he has cleared the UPSC examination and is appointed as an IAS officer. Raj then leaves for a three-year training program, where he meets fellow trainee Meghna Gupta. Over time, Raj grows close to Meghna. Meanwhile, Raushni becomes pregnant with Raj's child, but Raj tells her to abort the child. His reaction causes her severe stress, resulting in a miscarriage and the inability to ever conceive again. During Raj's training, the couple's relationship gradually weakens.
Upon completing his training, Raj sends Raushni divorce papers. After initially refusing to respond, she eventually learns about his affair with Meghna and agrees to the divorce. Following several counselling sessions and court proceedings, Raj and Raushni separate, and Raj later marries Meghna. Meanwhile, Mayank receives political backing from a businessman named Vikrant Rathore, who is supported by Meghna's father K.K. Gupta. Mayank becomes a corporator after murdering his political opponent. Raushni purchases the Ranjan house from its owner despite opposition from Raj and Mayank. Mayank marries Keerti, who is later revealed to be involved in criminal activities such as honey-trapping and money extortion. Ritika supports Raushni and eventually becomes a lawyer like her. Honoring the promise she made to Sumitra, Raushni accepts Meghna as the new daughter-in-law of the Ranjan family and performs the rituals welcoming her into the household. Over time, Raushni and Meghna develop a friendship.
Raushni's law firm is later assigned to handle pending cases under Raj's jurisdiction. Along with her friend Isha, she investigates a bridge collapse that caused multiple deaths. The investigation reveals that Mayank, Vikrant, Rammoorthy, the contractor, and Raj were involved in corruption. During the investigation, Isha is murdered, leaving Raushni devastated. Determined to seek justice for her friend, she resolves to uncover the truth and hold those responsible accountable. With the help of Ritika and police officer Kartik Tyagi, and with Meghna’s support, Raushni begins investigating Isha’s murder. Following the clues Isha left behind, she uncovers that Isha had gathered strong evidence in the bridge collapse case, which ultimately led to her being killed by Mayank. Ujjwal, once Mayank’s trusted aide but now Raushni’s confidant, steps forward and testifies against Mayank, exposing his crimes. Additionally, a recording of Rammoorthy’s final words implicates Mayank, Raj, and Vikrant, further strengthening the case. As a result, Mayank is convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment. Raj is dismissed from his position and faces a departmental investigation for his involvement. Meanwhile, Raushni is promoted to the position of a judge and is appointed to the District Court. In a twist of fate, Raj’s case is reassigned, with Raushni presiding as the main judge. Ritika, deeply shaken by Mayank’s arrest and Raj’s downfall, struggles emotionally but still hopes for Raj’s redemption. Around the same time, Meghna is revealed to be pregnant. However, she chooses to leave Raj and moves into the Ranjan house, where she begins living with Raushni and her family. Over time, Raushni and Meghna develop a deep bond and become best friends. Meghna gives birth to a daughter, Jr. Sumitra, but tragically passes away a few minutes after childbirth. Before her death, she entrusts all parental rights of her daughter to Raushni and asks Raj to stay away from her daughter. Raushni honors Meghna’s final wish. Weeks later, Raj files for custody of Jr. Sumitra. Due to Ritika refusing to testify in Raushni’s favor, Raj ultimately wins custody of the child. Meanwhile, as investigations into corruption deepen, Vikrant Rathore and K.K. Gupta shift the blame onto Raj, framing him for their own crimes as well. Raj is subsequently sentenced to two years in prison as punishment for his actions. During this time, Sid, who had been held captive by sea pirates for several months, is finally rescued and reunites with Ritika. In the prison, Mayank, who had a change of heart, apologises to Raushni and stays with Raj as an inmate after Raj's aged inmate dies. Raj has a change of heart in the prison.
Two years later, Raj is released from prison after completing his sentence and returns to the Ranjan house. With Raushni and Raj’s approval, Ritika and Sid decide to get married. Having changed as a person, Raj once again asks Raushni for her companionship and a chance to rebuild their relationship. However, Raushni refuses, choosing instead to stand firm in her own path. Over Ritika's wedding preparations, Raj tries to persuade Raushni with the seven vows given to her. Raushni, before the wedding night, firmly refuses. A heartbroken Raj leaves the house. Over the night, Raushni realises Raj's changed behaviour and decides to reconcile but he has already left. Ritika's wedding gets postponed and Raj is presumed to be dead and his final rites are performed. Raushni is persuaded by Ritika and Mayank to punish K.K. Gupta and Vikrant Rathore for their crimes and provides evidence against them with Ritika as the lawyer.
Seven years later, life has moved on. Ritika and Sid are married and live in the Ranjan house. Jr. Sumitra yearns for her father. Keerti returns to the Ranjan house with her and Mayank's son Vishesh. Mayank is released from jail for his good behavior. Raj is revealed to be alive near Kanpur who has given up his leisurely life and teaches UPSC aspirants for free. Jr. Sumitra's teacher, Sameer, comes as a tenant to the house of Raushni's neighbour Jagrani. He develops a deep bond with Jr. Sumitra. Meanwhile, a man named Bhagwant protests against Raushni's decisions in court, due to which the court panel removes her. It is revealed that Keerti is also working with Bhagwant to conspire against Raushni. They are working under an unknown leader. As Jr. Sumitra keeps demanding Raushni for a father, Raushni's family tries to convince her to marry Sameer. Raushni eventually agrees to marry Sameer. Raj's student Bittu clears UPSC. On Raushni's engagement day with Sameer, Bittu goes to tell this good news to Raushni, having known her when he was a child. Raushni sees a video of Raj in Bittu's phone, and realises that Raj is still alive. Along with Mayank, Ritika, and Jr. Sumitra, she goes to Raj's village and convinces Raj to return to the Ranjan house. Raj agrees and returns along with them. As Raj is revealed to be alive, Sameer cancels his engagement to Raushni and promises to always be her good friend. Jr. Sumitra refuses to accept Raj and wants Sameer to be her father, but Raushni wants to marry Raj. Later, Raj tries to win Jr. Sumitra's trust by playing with her and Vishesh, and travelling with her, but she still wants Sameer as her father. Meanwhile, Bhagwant convinces Rammoorthy's son Angad to join him in conspiring against Raushni. Raj asks Sameer to marry Raushni, but Sameer refuses. Eventually, Raj and Raushni get married, and Jr. Sumitra accepts Raj as her father on Sameer's request. After their marriage, it is revealed that Raj is still evil, and is the leader of the conspiracy against Raushni to get her impeached from the position of judge, with Bhagwant, Keerti, Angad, and K.K. Gupta as members of his team. Raj takes Raushni outside using the excuse of eating Biryani to get her stabbed by a disguised Angad. One week later, Kartik gives her a gun for self-defense. Meanwhile, Raushni is given ten days to justify her decisions that she gave as a judge, which might stop her impeachment. But Raj tampers with her files, which makes Raushni's opportunity fail. Raushni's health deteriorates and she falls into depression. The doctor advises her not to take stress. Mayank starts suspecting that Raj is involved in the conspiracy against Raushni after seeing Raj talk to Keerti. Raushni gets impeached and is labelled as mentally ill, which shatters her. Later, Mayank talks to Raushni and both have suspicion on Keerti. They plan to do a fake fight so that Mayank talks to Keerti and she tells Mayank about her leader, but their plan fails as Raj overhears them and tells Keerti not to tell anything to Mayank. Their fake fight makes the family think that Raushni's mental health has deteriorated, and they think of sending her to asylum. Later, Sameer joins Raushni and Mayank, and follows Keerti as part of the plan. He records Keerti talking to Bhagwant, Angad, and K.K., and sends it to Raushni, hence confirming their involvement in the conspiracy against Raushni. Raj meets his team members and expresses his wish to kill Raushni and make it look like suicide, which even K.K. finds to be too cruel. Later, Raushni tells Raj that K.K. Gupta is involved in her impeachment, and goes to confront K.K. He tells Raushni that there is a mastermind who is leading all this. Just as he is about to say Raj's name, Raj secretly shoots him dead using Raushni's gun. The next morning, Raushni realises that Raj is the mastermind after thinking for a while. She tells Ritika about this, but Ritika refuses to believe her. Then Raushni confronts Raj, who reveals that he planned this all to destroy her and take revenge from her. He tells her to prepare for Karva Chauth, pray for his long life and die. Raushni is left completely broken. She sees a vision of her deceased mother-in-law Sumitra motivating her. Later that day, Raushni shoots Raj dead and sees a vision of Sumitra nodding in approval.
A few years later, Keerti rides off somewhere on her motorcycle. Raushni is released from asylum. Sameer and an adolescent Jr. Sumitra come to pick Raushni up from asylum and they have a reunion.
tagline: In a poignant tale of love and sacrifice, Raj and Raushni navigate family pressures and unfulfilled dreams in the heart of Lucknow.

title: Taskaree
summary:
Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web (lit. 'Smuggling: The Smuggler's Web') is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller television series created by Neeraj Pandey and written by Vipul K Rawal along with Neeraj Pandey for Netflix, produced under the banner of Friday Storytellers. The series follows an Indian Customs Service team stationed at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport as they combat an international smuggling syndicate. The series stars Emraan Hashmi, Sharad Kelkar, Amruta Khanvilkar, Zoya Afroz, Nandish Sandhu and Anurag Sinha.
The series premiered on Netflix on 14 January 2026. Upon release, Taskaree received mixed reviews from critics, with praise directed at its performances and grounded treatment of smuggling operations but criticism towards writing. Taskaree achieved significant global viewership, becoming the first Indian series to top Netflix's global non-English television list.
plot:
Set at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport in Mumbai, the story follows a suspended but principled customs officer, Superintendent Arjun Meena (Emraan Hashmi), who is reinstated to lead a special task force against an international smuggling syndicate. The team is appointed by Assistant Commissioner Prakash Kumar (Anurag Sinha) of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs and consists of officers who were previously sidelined for refusing to engage in corruption, including fearless field officer Ravi Gujjar (Nandish Sandhu) and detail-oriented officer Mitali Kamath (Amruta Khanvilkar).
As the task force begins dismantling smuggling operations, they confront deep-rooted corruption, political interference, and the criminal network of smuggler Bada Choudhary (Sharad Kelkar). Their mission becomes increasingly perilous following targeted violence and the deaths of officers, revealing that the threat extends beyond smugglers to compromised officials within the system.
The narrative builds toward a high-stakes operation involving a large gold-smuggling attempt disguised under diplomatic cover. While the task force succeeds in exposing the plot and bringing down the syndicate, the victory comes at a personal cost, underscoring the ongoing and relentless battle against corruption.
reception: It became the first Indian series to reach number one on Netflix's global non-English TV list. According to Tudum’s weekly chart, Taskaree recorded 5.4 million views and 29.4 million hours of watch time in its debut week, securing the top position worldwide and finishing ahead of the Korean romantic comedy Can This Love Be Translated? The show continued its strong momentum in the second week, adding another 3.9 million views and 21.2 million hours of watch time, and retained a place in Netflix’s global Top 10 non-English shows, ranking third overall. In just 12 days following its release, the series crossed an impressive 9.3 million views, while accumulating more than 50.6 million total hours watched in its first two weeks. In comparison, Netflix’s earlier 2025 release Black Warrant achieved 9.8 million views over its entire run. Following its release, Zoya Afroz, Amruta Khanvilkar, Anurag Sinha, and Emraan Hashmi ranked first, second, third, and sixth respectively on IMDb’s Popular Indian Celebrities list for the week, while director Neeraj Pandey ranked tenth.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Taskaree is based on real-life incidents and required extensive research. Writers Neeraj Pandey and Vipul K. Rawal were introduced to both retired and active smugglers by the series’ consultant, who is a customs officer. The series marks the fourth collaboration produced under Neeraj Pandey's Friday Filmworks.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Director Raghav M Jairath described Sharad Kelkar as an easy choice for the role of the antagonist, citing his strong screen presence. Amruta Khanvilkar was initially approached for a brief role, which was later played by Anuja Sathe; however, the makers subsequently asked her to audition for the role of Mitali. Nitin Rao, who had previously worked with the production on Kaun Pravin Tambe?, compared his role in Taskaree with his earlier work, stating that the contrast allowed him to explore a completely different side of himself as an actor. Mohammed Al Fahad, who portrays a police officer in the series, became the first Bahraini actor to appear in a major Bollywood production.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: Following a plot centred on an Indian Customs Service team at the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport in Mumbai tackling an international criminal syndicate, the series was shot on location in Mumbai, Goa, Delhi, Milan, Bangkok, Abu Dhabi, Al-Dera'a, Addis Ababa as well as in Bahrain. During the shoot, Emraan Hashmi, Amruta Khanvilkar, and Nandish Sandhu were collectively referred to as the “Trimurti” by the crew, owing to their chemistry. Cyril Raffaelli was one of the stunt coordinators for the show.

articleSections.title: Marketing and release
articleSections.text: The trailer of the series was released on 7 January 2026. The series premiered on Netflix on 14 January 2026 in Hindi and dubbed versions of Tamil, Telugu, and English languages.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: It became the first Indian series to reach number one on Netflix's global non-English TV list. According to Tudum’s weekly chart, Taskaree recorded 5.4 million views and 29.4 million hours of watch time in its debut week, securing the top position worldwide and finishing ahead of the Korean romantic comedy Can This Love Be Translated? The show continued its strong momentum in the second week, adding another 3.9 million views and 21.2 million hours of watch time, and retained a place in Netflix’s global Top 10 non-English shows, ranking third overall. In just 12 days following its release, the series crossed an impressive 9.3 million views, while accumulating more than 50.6 million total hours watched in its first two weeks. In comparison, Netflix’s earlier 2025 release Black Warrant achieved 9.8 million views over its entire run. Following its release, Zoya Afroz, Amruta Khanvilkar, Anurag Sinha, and Emraan Hashmi ranked first, second, third, and sixth respectively on IMDb’s Popular Indian Celebrities list for the week, while director Neeraj Pandey ranked tenth.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text:
Risha Ganguly of Times Now rated the series 3.5 out of 5 stars and wrote that "Taskaree: The Smuggler’s Web is a competently crafted crime series that prioritises realism over spectacle. While it lacks narrative surprises and occasionally struggles with momentum, strong performances, especially by Emraan Hashmi and Sharad Kelkar, keep it engaging." Titas Chowdhury of News 18 also gave it 3.5 stars out of 5 and stated that "Emraan Hashmi's performance relies less on bravado and more on contained intensity. Alternatively, Sharad Kelkar, meant to project menace and moral rot, remains curiously bland."
Bollywood Hungama rated the series 3 out of 5 stars and remarked that "On the whole, TASKAREE: THE SMUGGLER’S WEB is a unique one-of-a-kind show on customs and smuggling and impresses with its light-hearted narrative, comic and dramatic moments, a few twists and performances by the lead cast." Lachmi Deb Roy of Firstpost also gave the series 3 stars out of 5, writing that "You can binge-watch the show, but you can watch it at one go too, just the way I did, because once you start watching, you won’t feel like giving it up. Wait till the very end because that is the real twist of the show. Not for a minute are you going to get bored." Srishti Walia of Outlook rated the series 3 out of 5 stars and observed that "Pandey paces the series well, with characters grounded in their workplace and navigating the nitty-gritty of concealing illegal goods." Anuj Kumar of The Hindu noted that "Emraan Hashmi leads Neeraj Pandey’s thriller that trades explosive momentum for nuanced depictions of smuggling and the personal cost of integrity." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in wrote in her review that "There isn’t a trace of guilty pleasure over the 1970s movie-like scenes of smugglers operating somewhere in the foreign to push gold bars, drugs and expensive watches into India. There is no dearth of ideas in Taskaree for how to bring contraband into the country."
Kabir Singh Bhandari of Free Press Journal rated the series 2.5 out of 5 stars and said, "The series is like a tutorial on how smuggling is carried out at airports and what the role of the customs officers entail." In The Tribune, Nonika Singh, who also rated the series 2.5 out of 5 stars, noted, “The drama turns too filmy and has the trademark strengths and weaknesses of a signature Pandey series.” Reviewing for NDTV, Saibal Chatterjee rated the series 2.5 out of 5 stars and remarked that “if only the sheen of novelty wasn't dulled by facile plot twists, it would have been a far more captivating show.” Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India stated that it has "a bingeable world, a skippable storyline, and the Neeraj Pandey-helmed series falls into old habits despite exploring uncharted territory." Aishwarya Vasudevan of OTT Play rated it 2 out of 5 stars and commented that "Emraan Hashmi shines, but Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web sinks. Despite the global scale, the plot is predictable, and tropes are heavy. A hollow, abrupt thriller that lacks real substance and punch." Cinema Express critic Kartik Bhardwaj observed that "The series begins well but then plot churnings take over and everything is rushed."

episodesList.title: Customs vs Popat
episodesList.summary: The Indian Government appoints honest officers at strategic airports to curb smuggling. Prakash Kumar is assigned as Assistant Commissioner of Customs to Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Mumbai International Airport (coloquically Mumbai International Airport). He brings in three Custom Officers―currently suspended, but known for their honesty―Arjun Meena, Mitali Kamath and Ravinder Gujjar. The trio then forms their own team. The modus operandi of narcotics smuggling through popats (couriers) is explained.

episodesList.title: Bada Choudhary
episodesList.summary: The smuggling syndicate is headed by Ranjeet 'Bada' Chaudhary. Bada Chaudhary chose the life of crime after his brother's murder by a rival. The smuggling syndicate operates via Milan, Al Dera (fictional city previously mentioned in Neeraj Pandey's 2015 film Baby) and Ethiopia. Gujjar notices a pattern in Priya's travel history and discusses his suspicion with Arjun.

episodesList.title: The Priya Story
episodesList.summary: Priya Khubchandani is an air hostess who smuggles gold on the behest of her fiancé and Captain Shubham Kapoor. Arjun arrests her red-handed but offers her release provided that she help him catch Captain Kapoor instead. Priya agrees and soon infiltrates the Chaudhary gold smuggling syndicate in Ethiopia. She informs Arjun that the syndicate has devised a method to turn gold into powdery substance and pass customs check undetected. Arjun mulls over a way to give Chaudhary syndicate a big blow.

episodesList.title: Operation Longshot
episodesList.summary: Prakash and Arjun assign their team to an International Conference and delude Chaudhary syndicate into believing that Mumbai International Airport will be free of honest officers for one whole day. The syndicate plans to smuggle big load of gold, narcotics and luxury goods. Prakash changes the duty roster at the last moment and Operation Longshot is unveiled. The Custom Officers seize all smuggled goods. Priya is rescued from Al Dera and sent to a safe house in Mumbai. The team celebrates.

episodesList.title: Hum Coin Hain
episodesList.summary: The team extracts information from Aslam and Mukim, two of the syndicate couriers. Mukim names Ramesh Bhai as the Indian head of operations. The team leaves to arrest Ramesh Bhai. Aslam is ordered to kill Mukim in custody. The Customs Chief Commissioner sends Prakash on an urgent conference to Bangkok where he is ambushed by Bada Chaudhary. Ramesh Bhai dies in a skirmish with Kulvir.

episodesList.title: Darr Ka Dhandha
episodesList.summary: All team members are threatened in various ways by the Chaudhary syndicate. Bada Chaudhary warns Arjun against seizing the smuggled gold soon landing in Mumbai. Gujjar arrests the popats anyway, incurring Chaudhary's wrath. Gujjar is killed by Chaudhary's henchmen and framed in fake corruption charges post death. Arjun suspects Kulvir, Kulvir admits to killing Ramesh Bhai in exchange of a bribe worth INR 1 crore. Bada Chaudhary threatens to kill Priya.

episodesList.title: Kahani Khatam
episodesList.summary: Prakash asks Arjun about the identity of Ravinder's informer. Bada Chaudhary faces pressure from Omar and Arbab. It is revealed that Prakash too, is working for Bada Chaudhary. Bada Chaudhary decides to smuggle 2 tonnes worth of gold. Arjun and Bada Chaudhary realise that Ravinder's informer is Suresh Kaka. Priya returns to Al Dera to presumably rejoin the Chaudhary syndicate. Arjun looks for smuggled gold in coffins but finds none. He realises the gold is being smuggled via Diplomatic Cargo and seizes the gold while unveiling Prakash's corruption. COIN officers arrest Chaudhary syndicate in Al Dera. Priya and Suresh Kaka are rescued.

plotHtml: Set at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport in Mumbai, the story follows a suspended but principled customs officer, Superintendent Arjun Meena (Emraan Hashmi), who is reinstated to lead a special task force against an international smuggling syndicate. The team is appointed by Assistant Commissioner Prakash Kumar (Anurag Sinha) of the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs and consists of officers who were previously sidelined for refusing to engage in corruption, including fearless field officer Ravi Gujjar (Nandish Sandhu) and detail-oriented officer Mitali Kamath (Amruta Khanvilkar). As the task force begins dismantling smuggling operations, they confront deep-rooted corruption, political interference, and the criminal network of smuggler Bada Choudhary (Sharad Kelkar). Their mission becomes increasingly perilous following targeted violence and the deaths of officers, revealing that the threat extends beyond smugglers to compromised officials within the system. The narrative builds toward a high-stakes operation involving a large gold-smuggling attempt disguised under diplomatic cover. While the task force succeeds in exposing the plot and bringing down the syndicate, the victory comes at a personal cost, underscoring the ongoing and relentless battle against corruption.
tagline: In a high-stakes battle against corruption, a principled customs officer leads a task force to dismantle an international smuggling syndicate at Mumbai's airport.

title: Tu Juliet Jatt Di
summary: Tu Juliet Jatt Di (transl. You’re the Jatt’s Juliet) is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that premiered on 17 November 2025 on Colors TV and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by Ravi Dubey and Sargun Mehta, the college drama series stars Jasmeet Kaur, Syed Raza Ahmed, and Sangita Ghosh in pivotal roles.
plot:
Nineteen-year-old Heer Sandhu is sharp, ambitious, and determined to carve out a future on her own terms. Growing up with an alcoholic and physically abusive father, she dreams of studying at Chandigarh Prime University, securing a stable career, and rescuing her mother and sister from the life they are trapped in. In stark contrast stands twenty-one-year-old Nawab Brar, a wealthy and spoiled heir who has lived a life untouched by consequences. Pampered and carefree, Nawab aspires to become a cricketer, chasing passion without ever having faced real hardship.
Their contrasting worlds collide when Heer and Nawab hatch a fake dating scheme to help him escape a forced arranged marriage. What begins as a calculated plan to outsmart their families spirals out of control, and in a twist of fate, the charade traps them in a marriage neither of them wanted.
Determined to keep their impulsive marriage a secret, Heer and Nawab agree to live as strangers at Chandigarh Prime University. But proximity breeds tension. As Heer and Nawab navigate campus life, unspoken emotions surface—jealousy, possessiveness, wounded pride, and lingering resentment.
What began as a forced alliance slowly turns into a complicated emotional battleground, where ambition, ego, and unexpected feelings threaten to expose the truth they are trying so hard to hide.
reception: The show became the slot leader from December 2025 to January 2026 with a 1.4 TRP and household reach of 2.4 TVR. In April, it trend at no 1 spot on its streaming platform JioHotstar.
