title: Thode Door Thode Paas
summary: Thode Door Thode Paas is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language family drama web series. Created by Shiirshak S. Anand and directed by Ajay Bhuyan, the series stars Pankaj Kapur, Mona Singh, and Kunaal Roy Kapur in lead roles. It premiered on 7 November 2025 on ZEE5. The story follows the Mehta family, whose patriarch challenges his family to undertake a six-month digital detox in exchange for a reward of ₹1 crore.
plot: The story follows Ashwin Mehta, a retired naval officer who realizes that his family's growing dependence on digital devices has weakened their personal relationships. To restore balance, he challenges the entire family to give up their phones, laptops, and social media for six months. If they succeed, they will receive a monetary reward of ₹1 crore. The series explores how this "digital detox" affects the family's communication, emotions, and togetherness.
reception:
Sreeparna Sengupta of The Times of India rated the series 3.5/5, describing it as "a heart-warming, feel-good story buoyed by a delightful Pankaj Kapur." She appreciated its optimism and humour but felt that some of its resolutions were a little too neat. Writing for India Today, Sana Farzeen also awarded 3.5 stars, calling the show "warm and refreshing." She noted that the premise might have worked even better as a shorter film but commended its gentle tone and the chemistry among the cast. Udita Jhunjhunwala of Scroll.in observed that the series "digital-detox experiment leads to analogue joy," and admired its restrained storytelling and thoughtful performances.
Aishwarya Vasudevan of OTTplay gave it 3 out of 5, calling it "a quick, charming watch" that delivers its "disconnect-to-reconnect" message without becoming preachy. In Rediff.com, Deepa Gahlot described the show as "a pleasant watch" held together by Kapur's effortless screen presence, though she found the setup of the digital challenge slightly contrived. Firstpost rated it 2.5 stars, acknowledging the sincerity of its cast but observing that the show's conflicts resolve too quickly and that the narrative "feels hushed and hurried."
According to Times Now News, the show's "digital fasting funda" gently reminds viewers to "disconnect to reconnect." Troy Ribeiro of The Free Press Journal rated it 3.5 out of 5, calling it "a wholesome, witty and warm reminder that connection begins where Wi-Fi ends." Rediff TV described it as "a pleasant watch," echoing the praise for its warmth and sincerity.

episodesList.summary: Kunal and Simran struggle to juggle work and family life while their children, Avni and Vivaan, remain absorbed in their devices. When family patriarch Ashwin returns from a trip, he announces a drastic change for the household.

episodesList.title: Zindagi Offline

title: The Game: You Never Play Alone
wikiTitle: The Game: You Never Play Alone
summary:
The Game: You Never Play Alone is a Tamil-language thriller television series created by 	Amalga Creations Medias INC and directed by Rajesh M. Selva. The series was written by Deepthi Govindarajan for Netflix.
It stars Shraddha Srinath, Santhosh Prathap and Chandini Tamilarasan.
The series was released on 2 October 2025.
plot: A passionate game developer determined to build her career must confront and defy misogynistic pressures when she becomes the victim of vicious online and real-world harassment.
reception:
Harshini SV of The Times of India gave 2.5 stars and observed that "Kavya’s games are described (again, never shown) to be the best because of the intricate details in their gaming world, and this detail and depth are what’s missing in the promising yet unconvincing The Game: You Never Play Alone." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in stated that "The seven-episode series is a passable thriller, with enough developments to keep all its characters busy, most of all Kavya. The show’s interest in the unseemly aspects of gaming culture or generalised misogyny itself is ultimately shallow, a contrivance to increase Kavya’s workload." Janani K of India Today gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "The Netflix show has promising ideas, but fails to explore them fully."
Shilajit Mitra of The Hollywood Reporter India observed that "The Game nevertheless amuses as a send-up of India's digital economy. "The download is all that matters," says a thin-lipped foreign investor in Kavya's company. Mobile is both present and future (the only character we see gaming on a console is poor Anoop). Misogyny runs rampant when data is cheap, and, as with fake news and political radicalisation, you never play alone." Lachmi Deb Roy of Firstpost rated it 3/5 stars and said that "The Game: You Never Play Alone’ is not just a thriller, but an eye-opener too for both youngsters and parents of teenagers and young adults." Anusha Sundar of OTT Play rated it 2.5/5 stars and commented that "With sharp moments but weak world-building, it’s a middling yet thought-provoking watch."
Rashmi Vasudeva of Deccan Herald gave it 3 stars out of 5 and said that "However, as the series progresses, the glitches show. The mystery becomes predictable, the gaming world remains a glossy backdrop rather than an immersive universe, and the villains arrive straight from cliché land. Subplots fizzle before finding shape." Sumit Rajguru of Times Now rated it 2.5/5 stars and said that "Overall, The Game – You Never Play Alone is an engaging show but marred by a predictable twist. Shraddha Srinath’s performance makes the web show worth watching. It has some flaws, but if you are a fan of crime thrillers, it is a treat for you."

title: The Ba***ds of Bollywood
summary:
The Ba***ds of Bollywood is an Indian Hindi-language satirical action comedy drama series created, co-written, and directed by Aryan Khan in his directorial debut for Netflix. Produced by Gauri Khan under Red Chillies Entertainment, it features Bobby Deol, Lakshya, Raghav Juyal, Sahher Bambba, Anya Singh, Manoj Pahwa, Manish Chaudhari, Rajat Bedi, Meherzan Mazda, Divik Sharma, Mona Singh, Gautami Kapoor, Vijayant Kohli, Neville Bharucha, and Armaan Khera.
The series follows Aasmaan Singh, an actor from Delhi, whose successful debut under producer Freddy Sodawallah leads to a role opposite Karishma Talvar in a film by Karan Johar. He faces challenges including Freddy’s multi-film contract, interference from Karishma’s father Ajay Talvar, a developing romance, and unforeseen complications. The series premiered on 18 September 2025 with seven episodes and received positive reviews, with critics highlighting Khan's direction, the story, screenplay, and performances.
plot: Aasmaan Singh is a young actor whose debut film, produced by the domineering Freddy Sodawallah, becomes a hit, earning him a role opposite Karishma Talvar in a new project directed by Karan Johar. Freddy’s insistence on an exclusive three-film contract threatens Aasmaan’s opportunity, pushing him, his manager Sanya, and friend Parvaiz to navigate Bollywood’s competitive landscape. As Aasmaan’s bond with Karishma grows, her father, veteran actor Ajay Talvar, disapproves and attempts to sabotage Aasmaan’s career, while personal and professional challenges, including public scandals and family pressures, test their ambitions in the unpredictable world of Bollywood.
reception:
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "Aryan Khan's debut as a director is a mixed bag -- while it entertains in parts, it deflates into seen-before ordinariness when it segues into showing us ‘the other side’ of the film industry." Simran Khan Times Now rated it 3.5/5 stars and said that "With his debut show, Shah Rukh Khan's son Aryan takes viewers on a witty, thrilling, and hilarious ride into Bollywood’s chaotic world." Sana Farzeen of India Today gave it 3.5 stars out of 5 and stated that "‘The Ba***ds of Bollywood’ is not perfect, but it’s honest, funny, and absolutely dramatic, something that we all love, isn't it? The next time this debutant director steps out, people will be queuing up for an autograph. But Aryan, pen kidhar hai? (Where is the pen)?"
Yatamanyu Narain of News 18 rated it 3.5/5 stars and observed that "Aryan Khan’s Netflix debut is a daring satire filled with nepotism digs, celebrity cameos, and a sharp take on Bollywood hypocrisy." Abhimanyu Mathur of Hindustan Times gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that " Aryan Khan's directorial debut never takes itself seriously, which helps it be entertaining, but leaves it a little shallow." Hardika Gupta of NDTV observed that "By the time the final episode wraps, you realise this isn't meant to be dissected like high art. It's meant to be consumed like Bollywood itself: loud, colourful, problematic, indulgent, but great fun if you let it be."
Sakshi Verma of India TV gave 3 stars out 5 and commented that "The Ba**ds Of Bollywood is a classic masala entertainer that is full of surprises, fun, drama and thrills. The show is not boring at any point and tries to make a glittery remark amid all the chaos and distress. The show is bouncy and should be taken as a fun watch. Renuka Vyavahare of The Times of India rated it 3.5/5 stars and said that "Daringly self-aware, the seven part series finds its footing in quieter moments—when it isn't busy showcasing star cameos or industry jabs. This is less of a scathing satire and more of an edgy, meta love letter to the film industry." Aashna Nadkarni of Mashable commented that "It is a complete treat for every Bollywood enthusiast!"
Sahir Avik D’souza of The Quint rated it 3.5/5 stars and writes in his review that "If Luck by Chance and Om Shanti Om had a foul-mouthed lovechild—that child would be Aryan Khan’s The Ba***ds of Bollywood." Bollywood Hungama gave it 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "THE BA***DS OF BOLLYWOOD is a hilarious and entertaining take on Bollywood and works because of Aryan Khan’s expert direction, crazy-n-entertaining moments, performances, shocking climax and starry cameos." Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com rated it 3/5 stars and stated that "Aryan Khan has made The Ba***ds of Bollywood entertaining and wicked."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The Ba***ds of Bollywood marks the directorial and writing debut of Aryan Khan, who also serves as the showrunner. Produced by Gauri Khan under Red Chillies Entertainment, the series was co-written by Khan with Bilal Siddiqi and Manav Chauhan. Khan, a graduate of the USC School of Cinematic Arts with a Bachelor of Fine Arts in Film and Television Production, drew on his industry experience to craft a satirical take on Bollywood’s inner workings. The series features a large ensemble cast, including Bobby Deol, Lakshya, Sahher Bambba and cameos from Bollywood figures such as Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, Aamir Khan, Ranbir Kapoor, Ranveer Singh and Karan Johar. Filming took place primarily in Mumbai, capturing the city’s film industry setting, with cinematography by Jay Pinak Oza and editing by Nitin Baid.
A music video, "Ghafoor", featuring Tamannaah Bhatia, Shakti Kapoor, Gulshan Grover and Ranjeet, directed by Farah Khan, was created to promote the series but used only as a background score in the series. To engage fans, Aryan Khan and Shah Rukh Khan collaborated with Meta in mid-October 2025 to launch India's first "secret reel", a BTS video from the series. Unlike standard reels, this video requires a password to unlock, which can be deduced from a clue in Episode 6.

articleSections.title: Controversies
articleSections.text: Following the release of The Ba***ds of Bollywood, the National Human Rights Commission filed a complaint with the Mumbai Police against the show for depicting Ranbir Kapoor using a banned electronic cigarette on screen without a statutory warning or disclaimer. Similarly, Sameer Wankhede, a former Narcotics Control Bureau zonal director who led the 2021 Cordelia cruise drug bust resulting in Aryan Khan's arrest (from which Khan was later cleared), but who faces a pending CBI probe in Mumbai courts for alleged bribery in connection with the case, filed a defamation suit against the show's makers at the Delhi High Court. He alleged the apparent parody of him was "false, malicious and defamatory". The defamation case was scheduled for a hearing on 30 October 2025. However, the court dismissed the defamation case and ruled that the complaint must be returned as it lacked jurisdiction to entertain the plea.

episodesList.title: Meet the Ba***ds
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan Singh lives in Mumbai with his friend Parvaiz and uncle Avtaar Singh, a former playback singer. His debut film, produced by Freddy Sodawallah’s company, becomes a hit. Aasmaan’s parents, Rajat and Neeta Singh, visit from Delhi to celebrate. At a party, Aasmaan meets actor Ajay Talvar. His manager, Sanya Ahmed, pitches him to Karan Johar for a film role, but Freddy pressures Aasmaan into signing a three-film deal. At a roundtable conference hosted by Sanjeev, Aasmaan insults Karishma Talvar, Ajay’s daughter, for her industry connections, causing tension with Ajay. Impressed by Aasmaan’s boldness, Karan offers him the role.

episodesList.title: Movie Mafia
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan, Sanya, and Parvaiz meet Freddy and encounter Jaraj Saxena, who has been sidelined for 15 years after signing with another producer. Freddy initially supports Aasmaan’s work with Karan but later urges him to cancel. At Dharma Productions, Aasmaan learns Karishma is the female lead and apologises for his earlier remarks, but a reporter’s comment sparks a scene. Aasmaan signs a commercial to fund his father Rajat’s liver transplant. Rajat advises him to stay resilient. Ajay disapproves of Aasmaan’s casting opposite Karishma. When Freddy pressures Aasmaan to abandon Karan’s project, Aasmaan cancels the three-film deal and leaves.

episodesList.title: Barbaad Mohabbat
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan, Parvaiz, Sanya, Karishma, and her bodyguard Sukhi travel to Goa to rehearse intimate scenes. The intimacy coach is replaced by Emraan Hashmi, who struggles to train them. Ajay monitors Karishma through Sukhi. After failing to perform, Aasmaan and Karishma are locked on a balcony, where they bond and improve their acting, impressing Hashmi. The next day, Aasmaan performs a Heimlich manoeuvre when Karishma chokes on a fishbone, and the incident goes viral, causing a scandal. Karishma’s brother Shaumik embarrasses the family by publicising the news. Karishma explains the situation to her parents. Freddy assigns lawyers against Aasmaan, but Parvaiz’s friends force Freddy to sign a new deal. Ajay refuses Freddy’s request for help, unwilling to work with him if Aasmaan joins Karan’s film.

episodesList.title: Bullshit Party
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan and his friends celebrate when Parvaiz secures a new deal from Freddy, though they overlook his coercive methods. Freddy faces challenges as Ajay refuses to work with him due to Aasmaan’s involvement in Karan’s film, threatening Sodawallah Productions. Karan approaches Aasmaan and Avtaar for his movie. Ajay grows concerned about Karishma’s friendship with Aasmaan and invites him home to rehearse but becomes uneasy with the script’s intimate scenes. At Karishma’s birthday party, her boyfriend Sameer proposes under pressure from Ajay, and she reluctantly accepts. Aasmaan leaves the party upset. Karishma, learning Ajay orchestrated the proposal, questions Aasmaan about his feelings, but he is kidnapped by goons before responding.

episodesList.title: My Hero
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan is taken to meet Ghafoor Ismail, an underworld don. Jaraj Saxena obtains a video of the meeting and uses it to strike a deal with Freddy to ruin Aasmaan’s career. Freddy leverages the video to convince Ajay to sign a film with him in exchange for removing Aasmaan from Karan’s project. The video leads to Aasmaan’s removal from the film. Karishma suspects Ajay’s involvement but he denies it. She visits Aasmaan but misinterprets seeing him with another woman as him moving on. Meanwhile, Rajat undergoes a liver transplant, but his body rejects it, and he passes away.

episodesList.title: The Filmfirst Awards
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan attends the Filmfirst Awards with his family, where he is nominated for Best Actor. Karishma discovers Ajay’s role in removing Aasmaan from Karan’s film. Aasmaan wins the award and delivers a speech. Backstage, Karishma reveals Ajay’s actions, leading Aasmaan to confront and punch Ajay, sparking a public scandal. Karishma challenges Ajay over his interference and expresses her desire to be with Aasmaan. Ajay locks her in a study, but she contacts Aasmaan, confessing her feelings. Aasmaan and Parvaiz rescue Karishma from Ajay’s house.

episodesList.title: Picture ka title hoga...
episodesList.summary: Aasmaan and Karishma plan to marry, but Ajay intercepts them before they can sign the marriage papers, leading to a confrontation. Neeta reveals that Aasmaan and Karishma are half-siblings from her past affair with Ajay, halting their plans. Aasmaan and Karishma agree to remain friends and part ways. Aasmaan and his team partner with Ghafoor Ismail to produce more films. Meanwhile, Jaraj, Freddy and Jeejeebhoy orchestrate a meeting between Neeta and Ajay, blackmailing them to star in a new Sodawallah Productions family drama series titled The Bastards of Bollywood, including Aasmaan and Karishma.

soundtrack.composer: The soundtrack features an original score by Shashwat Sachdev and songs composed by Sachdev, Anirudh Ravichander and Ujwal Gupta. The music rights were acquired by T-Series. The album, released on 16 September 2025, includes 13 tracks. The first single, "Badli Si Hawa Hai", written by Kumaar and sung by Arijit Singh and Amira Gill, was released on 23 August 2025. "Tenu Ki Pata", featuring vocals by Diljit Dosanjh, Aryan Khan and Ujwal Gupta, was released on 11 September 2025. "Ghafoor", with vocals by Shilpa Rao and Ujwal Gupta, was released as a music video on 19 September 2025.

plotHtml: Aasmaan Singh is a young actor whose debut film, produced by the domineering Freddy Sodawallah, becomes a hit, earning him a role opposite Karishma Talvar in a new project directed by Karan Johar. Freddy’s insistence on an exclusive three-film contract threatens Aasmaan’s opportunity, pushing him, his manager Sanya, and friend Parvaiz to navigate Bollywood’s competitive landscape. As Aasmaan’s bond with Karishma grows, her father, veteran actor Ajay Talvar, disapproves and attempts to sabotage Aasmaan’s career, while personal and professional challenges, including public scandals and family pressures, test their ambitions in the unpredictable world of Bollywood.
tagline: Aasmaan Singh is a young actor whose debut film, produced by the domineering Freddy Sodawallah, becomes a hit, earning him a role opposite Karishma Talvar in a new project directed by Karan Johar.

title: The Chronicles of the 4.5 Gang
summary: The Chronicles of the 4.5 Gang (stylised as 4.5 Gang, also known as Sambhava Vivaranam Nalara Sangham) is a 2025 Indian Malayalam-language crime comedy streaming television series created and directed by Krishand. It stars Sanju Sivram, Darshana Rajendran, Jagadish in lead roles. The series premiered on SonyLIV on 29 August 2025.
plot: Set in Thiruvanchipuram (a fictional version of Thiruvananthapuram), the series follows a group of five slum boys who dream of making it big amidst the chaotic world of crime, comedy, and survival.
reception:
The Chronicles of the 4.5 Gang opened to widespread critical acclaim upon its release.
The Indian Express hailed it as "the best Malayalam series yet," praising Krishand’s inventive storytelling and the way he redefined the gangster genre on streaming platforms.
The Hindu described the series as "clever and entertaining," highlighting its sharp writing and the director’s unique ability to balance crime and satire.
The New Indian Express called it "an audacious gangster epic told with mischief and bite," commending the ensemble cast and its daring narrative choices.
The News Minute echoed this sentiment, writing that the show is "crooked, funny, and oddly endearing," applauding its quirky tone.
According to The Times of India, the series successfully "gets its formula right," offering a refreshing take on the gangster saga format in Malayalam web content.
The Week compared it to Gangs of Wasseypur, labeling it "Malayalam cinema’s answer" to the cult Hindi franchise, particularly admiring its scale and ambition.
OTTplay praised the series as "wacky" and "stamped with Krishand’s signature style."
Times Now described it as "an amusing series that gets its formula right."

title: Tumm Se Tumm Tak
summary: Tumm Se Tumm Tak (transl. From You to You) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series that premiered on 7 July 2025 on Zee TV.  Produced by Prateek Sharma under the banner of Studio LSD Private Limited, the series stars Niharika Chouksey and Sharad Kelkar in the lead roles. The show is an official remake of the popular Zee Marathi television series Tula Pahate Re.
plot:
Tumm Se Tumm Tak follows Anu Sharma, a 20-year-old middle-class girl from Chandni Chowk, Delhi, and Aryavardhan "Arya", a 46-year-old successful industrialist heading the Vardhan Group of Industries. Anu's father works at a local store that sells Rajnandini Sarees, a brand owned by Arya's company.
Their lives intersect, when Arya's bicycle breaks down on the way to the Annual Function of K.C. College, where he is the chief guest and Anu is invited to give a speech. Sharing an auto-rickshaw unknowingly, Anu is initially unaware of Arya's identity. Despite an awkward first meeting and a public mishap, during her speech, Arya is impressed, by Anu's sincerity and offers her a job at his company.
As their relationship develops, Anu is pushed toward an arranged marriage with Bipin, orchestrated by the manipulative Raghu, who seeks personal gain. Arya quietly works behind the scenes to stop the marriage, by uncovering Raghu's hidden motives and exposing him using a new company policy that, reveals Raghu's conflict of interest.
Anu and Arya navigate challenges posed, by their differing social backgrounds and the opposition they face from Arya's confidant Jhende and Arya's assistant, Meera.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Niharika Chouksey as Anu Aryavardhan (née Sharma): Gopal and Pushpa's daughter; Aryavardhan's second wife (2025–present) *Sharad Kelkar as Aryavardhan (née Rajeev Bhatia): Gayatri's step son; Rajnandini's widower; Anu's husband (2025–present)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Helly Shah and Karan Singh Grover was first approached for the lead role but was replaced by Niharika Chouksey and Sharad Kelkar. The series marks Kelkar's television comeback after eight years. Vandana Pathak joined the cast, marking her television comeback after 5 year. In August 2025, Dolly Chawla was selected to play Meera. In January 2025, Ravjeet Singh was cast as Dr. Mohit. In February 2025, Nikhil Raaj Khera join as Dr. Mohit's father. In May 2026, Anita Hassanandani was cast as Rajnandini. In the same month, Angad Hasija Joins the cast play Yashvardhan

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series is primarily shot in Delhi, particularly in and around Chandni Chowk, to authentically depict Anu Sharma’s middle-class background. Iconic Delhi landmarks such as India Gate and Qutub Minar also feature in the show’s outdoor scenes. Corporate and mansion scenes are filmed in studios in Mumbai to represent Aryavardhan’s affluent world.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: The series was reported to the Bombay High Court due to the huge age difference between the lead actors, and the Bombay High Court replied "If you don't like it, don't watch it."

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan and Anu's First Meet
episodesList.summary: Raised in a middle-class family, Anu lives with her parents, Gopal and Pushpa. Aryavardhan, a noted businessman known for being extremely punctual, meets Anu for the first time on his way to an event.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Boosts Anu’S Confidence In College
episodesList.summary: College students mock Anu, who comes on stage to give a speech, but Aryavardhan encourages her. At the suggestion of some students, Aryavardhan gives Anu a blank cheque, showing his trust in her.

episodesList.title: The Blank Cheque Fuels Pushpa’S Greed
episodesList.summary: Anu tells Gopal and Pushpa about the blank cheque, sparking greed in Pushpa. The next morning, Anu visits Aryavardhan’s office to return it, only to be shocked by an empty envelope.

episodesList.title: Can Anu Stop Pushpa From Depositing The Cheque?
episodesList.summary: Meera ousts Anu from the office. Aryavardhan learns of it and makes Meera apologise. Anu, worried about the lost cheque, rushes to the bank with Gopal after learning that Pushpa went to deposit it.

episodesList.title: Anu Returns The Cheque To Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Meera gives Anu a written apology. Anu returns Aryavardhan’s cheque, prompting him to set a condition in exchange. She calms an infuriated Pushpa, but the neighbourhood women mock Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Family Arrives At Aryavardhan’S Party
episodesList.summary: Anu, Pushpa and Gopal face humiliation at Aryavardhan’s party entrance until he arrives and takes them in. During the event, Aryavardhan asks Anu to launch the new product herself.

episodesList.title: Meera Insults Gopal At The Party
episodesList.summary: At the party, Meera gets Gopal drunk and has him humiliated. Aryavardhan scolds Meera for her behaviour and apologises to Gopal. Later, he makes a promise to Anu.

episodesList.title: A Special Party For Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Anu collects money to host a party for Aryavardhan. Meanwhile, he cancels a meeting to spend time with her, upsetting Meera. Jhende keeps an eye on them but soon loses track.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Experiences A Simple Life With Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan experiences a simple life with Anu. Later, he saves her from an accident, but Raghu, the father of a suitor coming to see Anu, sees them on the street.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Gives Anu A Job
episodesList.summary: Raghu visits Anu’s house and refuses to get his son Vipin married to her. Aryavardhan arrives, scolds Raghu, and offers Anu a job. The next day, Raghu returns to her house with a secret motive.

episodesList.title: Anu’S First Day At Work
episodesList.summary: Raghu explains to Rajni the motive behind marrying Vipin to Anu. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan promotes Meera and makes Anu her assistant. However, Anu makes a mistake on her first day.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Changes The Office Rule For Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan surprises Meera and others by changing an office rule for Anu. She tries to put Anu down during introductions, but Aryavardhan defends her by revealing her strengths.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Lashes Out At Anu
episodesList.summary: Anu pays off Gopal's debt and protects him from humiliation. While Meera plots to get Anu fired, Aryavardhan lashes out at Anu for bringing champa flowers in the office.

episodesList.title: Meera Fails To Get Anu Fired
episodesList.summary: Meera believes that her plan to get Anu fired will succeed. However, Anu exposes worker exploitation at Aryavardhan’s factory, prompting him to assign her a new responsibility, leaving Meera stunned.

episodesList.title: Has Aryavardhan Fallen In Love With Anu?
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan is shocked to learn that Anu is engaged to Vipin. Jhende makes him realise that he’s fallen for Anu, but also discourages him from pursuing the relationship.

episodesList.title: Meera Grows Jealous Of Anu's Relationship With Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Gopal opposes Anu’s marriage to Vipin and returns Raghupati’s gifted fridge. Meanwhile, Jhende shares news with Aryavardhan. Meera grows jealous seeing Aryavardhan dine with Anu.

episodesList.title: Harshvardhan Fires Anu From Her Job
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan's brother Harshvardhan comes to the office, but Anu stops him from meeting Aryavardhan. In anger, Harshvardhan orders Anu to be fired and informs Aryavardhan about it.

episodesList.title: Anu Keeps Her Job Loss A Secret At Home
episodesList.summary: Relying on Anu’s job, Pushpa buys an expensive saree for her on installments. Anu hides the fact that she has lost her job. The next day, she calls Aryavardhan, but Meera disconnects the call.

episodesList.title: Anu Realises She Is Falling For Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Anu realises she is falling for Aryavardhan and prays to the Goddess for clarity. Soon, Aryavardhan arrives at the temple, finds Anu, and asks her to come to the office the next day.

episodesList.title: Anu Is Reinstated At Work
episodesList.summary: Bholi’s husband gifts her a scooter, but Pushpa accidentally damages it. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan convinces Harshvardhan to rehire Anu, who invites him to a religious gathering.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Visits Anu For 'Mata Ki Chowki'
episodesList.summary: Anu decorates a doll resembling Aryavardhan for 'Mata ki Chowki'. When he visits her home, he invites his foreign delegates to join him. Seeing the doll, Aryavardhan questions Anu’s feelings for him.

episodesList.title: Meera Fumes At Aryavardhan's Praise For Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan praises Anu for her saree, sparking Meera’s jealousy. Determined to win his attention, Meera sets a plan in motion. Meanwhile, Raghupati schemes to marry Anu off to Vipin.

episodesList.title: Anu Shares Her Feelings With Simran
episodesList.summary: Gopal refuses to take help from Raghupati. Anu tells Simran that she has fallen in love with Aryavardhan. Meanwhile, Pushpa plans Anu’s marriage with Bipin and then visits Aryavardhan’s office.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Invites Aryavadhan For Dinner
episodesList.summary: At Pushpa's invitation, Aryavardhan visits Anu's house for dinner. Pushpa sends Anu and Gopal out of the house on some pretext and talks to Aryavardhan about Anu's marriage.

episodesList.title: Siddhi Mata Predicts Anu's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Pushpa requests Aryavardhan to persuade Anu to marry Bipin. The fortune-teller Siddhi Mata predicts Anu's marriage, and later, Anu decides to find out Aryavardhan's marital status.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Asks Anu Her View On Marriage
episodesList.summary: Meera scolds Anu for trying to find out about Aryavardhan’s personal life. Aryavardhan asks Anu for her opinion about marriage. Later, FM, a peon, tells Anu something, which shatters her.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Comes Home For A Puja
episodesList.summary: Anu prays for a way to resolve her dilemma, and Siddhi Mata comes to her doorstep. Aryavardhan's mother organises a puja, and he arrives at home to attend it. Simran asks Anu to look into Mrs Vardhan.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Finds Out About Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan gives a gift to his mother. Pushpa calls Aryavardhan to talk about Anu's marriage, and Aryavardhan's mother misunderstands the situation. Later, she asks Jhende about Anu.

episodesList.title: Anu Is Shocked To Hear Aryavardhan's Words
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan calls Anu to meet him, but when Gopal learns that it’s part of Pushpa’s plan, he gets angry. In her dreams, Anu confesses love to Aryavardhan, but in reality, she is shocked by his words.

episodesList.title: Gopal Makes A Promise To Anu
episodesList.summary: Pushpa adds to Anu's pain by flaunting the wedding preparations. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan's mother urges him to understand what's in Anu's heart. Gopal makes a promise to Anu upon learning her decision.

episodesList.title: Raghupati Gives Pushpa Some Time
episodesList.summary: Raghupati gives Pushpa eight days to convince Gopal for Anu and Bipin's marriage. When the gas cylinder runs out at home, Anu goes to the office hungry. Meanwhile, Gopal is fired from his job.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Keeps A Secret From Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan sends food for Anu, but she declines, asking him not to worry about her. Gopal conceals his loss of job from the family, while Pushpa hides a secret from Anu, who eventually uncovers it.

episodesList.title: Gopal In Search Of A Job
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan convinces Anu to let go of her feelings and marry Bipin. Meanwhile, Gopal wanders in search of a job. Anu leaves important office work and sets out with Pushpa to find Gopal.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Is Pained By Anu’S Decision
episodesList.summary: Anu agrees to marry Bipin in front of Aryavardhan, leaving him pained. Later, a distressed Gopal faints after losing his shop, and Anu and Pushpa rush to his aid.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’S Lonely Journey
episodesList.summary: Mrs Vardhan advises Aryavardhan to help him overcome his loneliness. Gopal reluctantly talks to Raghupati about Anu and Bipin’s alliance, while Anu approaches Meera for help.

episodesList.title: Anu Accepts Meera's Condition
episodesList.summary: Meera offers Anu financial help on a condition, which Anu accepts. As Aryavardhan longs for Anu, he unexpectedly shows up at the family gathering where her wedding date is being set.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Arrives To Help With Anu’S Wedding
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan visits Raghupati’s house as Anu and Bipin’s wedding date is set. He later asks Anu’s family to let him assist with the preparations and opens up about his past.

episodesList.title: Anu Allows Aryavardhan To Stay At Her Home
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan requests to stay at Anu’s home until her wedding, but she agrees with a condition. When the moment is right, Anu questions him, and Aryavardhan discovers Raghupati’s ploy.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Decides To Stop Anu's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Pushpa avenges Gopal's insult by confronting Subhash. Aryavardhan discovers Raghupati's real motive and decides to stop Anu and Bipin's wedding. The next morning, he takes everyone jogging.

episodesList.title: Harshvardhan Refuses To Grant Leave To Anu
episodesList.summary: Mansi complains to Aryavardhan's mother about his absence from the office for the past three days. At Meera's behest, Anu arrives at the office to apply for leave but Harshvardhan refuses to grant it.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Helps Anu Choose A Mangalsutra
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan comes along with Pushpa and Gopal to the jewellery store, while Anu convinces Harshvardhan to grant her leave. She arrives at the store, where Aryavardhan helps her choose a mangalsutra.

episodesList.title: The Neighbours Speak Ill About Anu
episodesList.summary: While Aryavardhan returns from shopping with Anu's family, a beggar recognises him, and he assigns a task to Jhende. Seeing Aryavardhan with Anu, the neighbours start gossiping about them.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Defends Gopal
episodesList.summary: The neighbours falsely accuse Gopal. Aryavardhan teaches them a lesson, and everyone celebrates Independence Day. Preparations begin for Janmashtami at Aryavardhan’s home, and he tells a lie to Meera.

episodesList.title: Meera Visits Anu’S House
episodesList.summary: Anu decides to care for her parents even after her marriage, while Aryavardhan overhears Raghupati sharing a plan with Rajni. When Meera visits Anu’s home to learn about Aryavardhan, Anu grows uneasy.

episodesList.title: Raghupati's Truth Is Exposed To Anu's Family
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan alters one of his company's policies, leading Raghupati to break Anu and Bipin’s alliance. Pushpa pleads with him, but after discovering his true motive, she lashes out.

episodesList.title: Thoughts About Anu Trouble Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Pushpa breaks Anu and Bipin’s alliance, earning Gopal’s praise, and everybody then celebrates Janmashtami. Later, Anu writes her feelings in a diary, while thoughts about her trouble Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: Subhash Gives Gopal His Job Back
episodesList.summary: Anu’s family decides to throw a party to thank Aryavardhan. Out of fear of Aryavardhan, Subhash gives Gopal his job back. Later, Anu tries to give Aryavardhan a love letter.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Fails To Meet Anu’S Family
episodesList.summary: Anu, Gopal and Pushpa wait for Aryavardhan at the restaurant, but Jhende keeps him from going there. Soon after, the manager insults them and throws them out.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Wait Ends In Heartbreak
episodesList.summary: Anu gets sad as Aryavardhan doesn't show up at the restaurant. Meanwhile, he locks himself in a room, and Manasi vows to uncover the secret of that room. Meera stirs up trouble for Anu at the office.

episodesList.title: Anu's Proposal For The Investors
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Rajni get into an argument. Meanwhile, Anu seeks Gopal's help for a presentation at office and puts forth a proposal for increasing sales for Rajnandini Sarees before the investors.

episodesList.title: Siddhi Mata Predicts Aryavardhan’S Future
episodesList.summary: Siddhi Mata tells Mrs. Vardhan about Aryavardhan’s future. Hearing Aryavardhan praise Anu, Mrs. Vardhan expresses a desire to meet her. Later, Aryavardhan finds a way to pacify Anu’s anger.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Is Saddened To See Anu With Bipin
episodesList.summary: At office, Aryavardhan praises Anu and then asks her to type an apology letter to the Sharma family on his behalf. Later, he sees Anu with Bipin and feels disheartened.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Fumes At Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan yells at Anu at the office. When she asks him to take his medicine, he gets furious. But after Anu gets hurt, he gently bandages her wound. Later, he regrets his behaviour.

episodesList.title: Anu Arrives At Gopal's Shop For A Survey
episodesList.summary: Anu visits Gopal’s shop with the investors for a survey. Gopal surprises Pushpa with a thoughtful gift. Aryavardhan tracks Anu’s location and meets her there, while Raghupati sees them together.

episodesList.title: Pushpa's Suspicion About Anu And Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Gopal see Anu with Aryavardhan, and Pushpa gets suspicious. The investors praise Anu, leaving Meera annoyed. While returning home, an FM program reminds Aryavardhan of Anu.

episodesList.title: Ravi Complains To Meera About Anu
episodesList.summary: Raghupati shows Rajni a video of Aryavardhan and Anu, revealing his plan. Meanwhile, Anu firmly responds to investor Ravi for speaking against Meera. Upset, Ravi calls Meera to complain about Anu.

episodesList.title: Meera Scolds Ravi After Learning The Truth
episodesList.summary: Meera complains to Aryavardhan about Anu, and he authorises her to fire her. But after learning the truth, Meera scolds Ravi instead. Meanwhile, Mansi lashes out at Harshvardhan and insults him.

episodesList.title: Siddhi Mata Gives Pushpa A Solution
episodesList.summary: Jhende urges Aryavardhan to stay away from Anu and make a decision. Meanwhile, Siddhi Mata offers Pushpa a remedy for Anu’s marriage worries.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Tells Anu To Join Another Branch
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan promotes Anu and asks her to join another branch, but she gets upset and leaves the matter to Goddess Durga. Siddhi Mata then urges both Anu and Mrs Vardhan to visit a temple.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Family Decides To Visit The Temple
episodesList.summary: Worried about Harshvardhan, Mrs Vardhan urges Aryavardhan to accompany her to the ancestral temple. Anu’s family decides to go there too. Bipin tells Simran a plan to reunite Anu and Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Family Sets Out For The Jivdani Temple
episodesList.summary: Simran and Bipin’s plan to unite Anu and Aryavardhan gets foiled. Anu’s family leaves for the Jivdani temple, while Aryavardhan’s hope of meeting her begins to fade.

episodesList.title: Bheem Kaka Advises Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Mansi stops Aryavardhan from going to the temple with Mrs Vardhan. Meanwhile, Anu’s family arrives there. Hoping for a miracle in a bid to meet Anu, Aryavardhan receives advice from Bheem Kaka.

episodesList.title: Will Anu's Wish Be Fulfilled?
episodesList.summary: Anu’s family performs a puja at the temple, where Mansi clashes with Pushpa. Mrs Vardhan feels a sense of connection with Anu. Just as Anu makes a heartfelt wish to the Goddess, Aryavardhan arrives.

episodesList.title: The Goddess Unites Anu And Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan hides his face upon seeing Anu at the temple, but Anu senses his presence. Later, he seeks answers to his dilemma from Mrs Vardhan, while Anu prepares to leave for Jaipur.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’S Betrayal Hurts Anu
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Gopal plan to stop Anu’s transfer. Hurt by Aryavardhan’s betrayal, Anu arrives at the office, where Meera surprises her. Anu recalls her first meeting with Aryavardhan and his advice.

episodesList.title: Anu Leaves For Jaipur After A Promise To Gopal
episodesList.summary: Jhende advises Aryavardhan to forget Anu. Meanwhile, Anu reveals Aryavardhan's betrayal to Simran. She makes a promise to Gopal and leaves for Jaipur after bidding everyone adieu.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Tries To Stop Anu From Going To Jaipur
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan chases Anu’s bus to stop her from going to Jaipur, but Anu stands firm and questions him. Meanwhile, Jhende uncovers something troubling and grows anxious.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Rescues Anu From Trouble
episodesList.summary: Upset with Aryavardhan, Anu gets off the bus midway and lands in trouble, but Aryavardhan rescues her. Later that night, they stay at a hotel, where Anu gives him a gift.

episodesList.title: Anu Learns About Aryavardhan's Feelings
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan pours his heart out before a sleeping Anu, who is delighted to hear his words. Jhende finally tracks them down and sends Anu home. However, Gopal gets furious on seeing her.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Slaps Jhende
episodesList.summary: Meera pours her heart out to Jhende. Gopal suspects Aryavardhan’s intentions. Jhende and Aryavardhan argue over Anu. In a fit of anger, Aryavardhan slaps Jhende, and the latter makes a firm decision.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Tries To Placate An Upset Jhende
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan tries to appease Jhende, stressing on Jhende's importance in his life. Meanwhile, Gopal asks Pushpa to stop Anu from working, but Anu convinces him to let her keep the job.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Announces A Casual Day At The Office
episodesList.summary: Mrs Vardhan mentions a girl, and Aryavardhan assumes it’s Anu. He announces a casual day at the office and waits for Anu. Later, Mansi’s relative Neel joins the office.

episodesList.title: A Conspiracy Against Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan welcomes Anu at the office. In her neighbourhood, gossip about their relationship angers Gopal. Later, Anu is shocked to find her presentation data missing.

episodesList.title: Meera Gives Anu A Deadline To Find The Data
episodesList.summary: Meera gives Anu 24 hours to recover the data, but with one condition. Anu tries to recover it with Neel’s help. Meanwhile, Jhende grows suspicious of Meera and confronts her.

episodesList.title: Neel Tries To Befriend Anu
episodesList.summary: Mrs Vardhan urges Aryavardhan to marry. Neel tries to befriend Anu, while Meera sees her plan working. Later, Anu and Aryavardhan fondly recall each other while having kadhi chawal.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Presentation Inspires Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Anu impresses investors with her presentation and earns Aryavardhan’s praise. Later, she delightedly thanks him for wearing the tie she gave him.

episodesList.title: Meera's Ploy To Separate Aryavardhan From Anu
episodesList.summary: Anu misses lunch with Aryavardhan, upsetting him. Jhende grows suspicious of Neel and warns him. Meanwhile, Meera plots to poison Aryavardhan's mind against Anu.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Invites Neel Over For Tea
episodesList.summary: Neel helps Pushpa tackle an insolent municipality officer, and she invites him over for tea. Jhende confronts Meera about her scheme to unite Neel and Anu. That night, Aryavardhan pays Anu a visit.

episodesList.title: Mrs Vardhan Becomes Suspicious Of Mansi
episodesList.summary: Gopal overhears women maligning Anu over Aryavardhan's visit. Mansi’s praise of Neel rouses Mrs Vardhan’s doubts over her intentions. Later, Mrs Vardhan insists on meeting Anu at Aryavardhan's office.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan's Demand Shocks Meera
episodesList.summary: Meera lies to Mrs Vardhan to keep her from meeting Anu. Aryavardhan shocks Meera by insisting Anu join him in London for a conference. He then makes an announcement, and Anu reveals a secret to Neel.

episodesList.title: Gopal Forbids Aryavardhan From Taking Anu To London
episodesList.summary: Jhende visits Anu’s house to collect her passport documents. Learning of the London conference, Gopal confronts Aryavardhan and forbids him from taking her along. Anu then runs into Siddhi Mata.

episodesList.title: Neel Secretly Informs Mansi And Meera
episodesList.summary: Raghupati and Rajni push Pushpa into protesting and plot to stop the municipal workers from clearing the garbage. Meanwhile, Anu visits Aryavardhan, and Neel quietly tips off Mansi and Meera.

episodesList.title: Meera Sends Neel With Anu For Pushpa's Bail
episodesList.summary: Framed by Raghupati and Rajni, Pushpa is arrested for protesting against a municipal officer. Meera informs Anu and sends Neel to help Pushpa. Meanwhile, Mrs Vardhan offers advice to Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: A Nightmare Grips Anu And Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan learns of Pushpa’s arrest and scrambles to the prison. Neel is put behind bars, while Mansi justifies her actions to Mrs Vardhan. Later that night, a nightmare grips Aryavardhan and Anu.

episodesList.title: An Old Foe Plans An Attack On Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan and Anu perform Kanjak Puja at their homes. An old foe vows to kill Aryavardhan. Later, Siddhi Mata gives Anu an amulet and asks her to tie it on Aryavardhan’s wrist.

episodesList.title: Jhende Confronts A Dark Realisation
episodesList.summary: Meera prevents Anu from visiting the office on Dussehra, leaving her crushed. Jhende is shaken by a dark realisation, and a bad omen ensues. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan’s foe walks free from prison.

episodesList.title: Jhende Sneakily Films Anu And Neel
episodesList.summary: Meera sends Anu to a godown, but Neel comes to Anu’s aid. Anu follows Aryavardhan's car yet fails to meet him. Jhende then films her with Neel. Soon, an unexpected visitor arrives to meet Anu.

episodesList.title: A Threat To Aryavardhan’S Life
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan tells Anu that he wants her to share the office duties with Harshvardhan. Later, Jhende tells Aryavardhan about Jalandar’s plan to take his life and stops him from going to London.

episodesList.title: Jalandar Threatens Jhende
episodesList.summary: Jhende forces Aryavardhan to make him comply with his demand. He also confiscates Aryavardhan’s phone to save him from Jalandar. Later, Jalandar threatens Jhende.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’S Mistake Gives Jalandhar An Edge
episodesList.summary: Jhende is stunned when Meera says that Aryavardhan isn’t in London. Neel swaps phones with Anu to trace him, and Aryavardhan’s slip-up unexpectedly helps Jalandhar.

episodesList.title: Jalandhar Visits The Vardhan Residence
episodesList.summary: Jhende discards Aryavardhan’s SIM card and warns him of Jalandhar tracking him. Neel visits the Sharmas as Jalandhar heads to the Vardhan residence. Jhende then alerts Aryavardhan about this.

episodesList.title: Anu Learns About Aryavardhan's Whereabouts
episodesList.summary: Jhende keeps Aryavardhan confined while Anu learns he is still in Delhi and pleads to meet him. Meanwhile, Mansi argues with Meera over Harshvardhan, and Jalandhar’s aide watches Anu closely.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Plans To Meet Anu
episodesList.summary: Gopal and Pushpa appreciate each other’s efforts after swapping roles. Aryavardhan learns of Anu’s Karvachauth fast and agrees to meet her, unaware that Jalandhar’s aide is snooping on her.

episodesList.title: Anu Seeks Simran's Help To Hide Her Fast
episodesList.summary: Anu picks a gift for Aryavardhan and seeks Simran’s help to hide her fast from Gopal. Rajni finds an unexpected friend while, Aryavardhan plans to disguise himself as a delivery boy to meet Anu.

episodesList.title: A Sniper Aims His Gun At Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: As the moon rises, Anu suspects that Aryavardhan might not arrive to meet her. However, Aryavardhan shows up, and they both end their fast. Meanwhile, a sniper aims his gun at Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Challenges Jalandhar
episodesList.summary: Jhende learns of Aryavardhan’s escape as Anu ties Siddhi Mata's amulet on his wrist. The sniper's shot at Aryavardhan is interrupted. Soon, Aryavardhan boldly challenges Jalandhar in defiance.

episodesList.title: Jalandhar Poses As An Autorickshaw Driver To Trick Anu
episodesList.summary: Jalandhar, disguised as an autorickshaw driver, takes Anu to her exam. Aryavardhan arrives at the college to wish her luck and learns of Jalandhar’s misadventure. Elsewhere, Raghupati badmouths Anu.

episodesList.title: A Disguised Jalandhar Visits The Sharmas
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan lies to Pushpa about the guards and hires a bodyguard for Anu. Disguised as a hermit, Jalandhar visits the Sharmas later that day and urges them to get Anu married.

episodesList.title: The Sharmas Plan To Get Anu Married To Neel
episodesList.summary: Jalandhar, posing as a hermit, hints at Neel while discussing an alliance for Anu. The Sharmas then shock Neel with their proposal. Anu then visits a temple with Aryavardhan and runs into Siddhi Mata.

episodesList.title: Siddhi Mata Cautions The Sharmas
episodesList.summary: Siddhi Mata meets the Sharmas and cautions them about Anu’s prospective groom. Neel backs out of the marriage and upsets Jalandhar. Later, a deranged old man delivers a chilling warning to Anu.

episodesList.title: Meera Ruins Aryavardhan’S Dream To Marry Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan buys a ring to profess his love to Anu, but his hopes are crushed when he overhears Gopal and Meera discussing Anu’s upcoming marriage to Neel, who’s being forced into it by Meera.

episodesList.title: Jhende Deceives Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Gopal informs Aryavardhan about Anu and Neel’s impending wedding. Jhende deceives Aryavardhan with a video, urging him to suppress his feelings, and later issues a warning to Anu.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Feels Hurt To See Anu With Neel
episodesList.summary: Mrs Vardhan visits Anu’s locality, but Jhende misleads her into thinking Anu doesn’t live there, and Simran sees it all. Later, Aryavardhan arrives but leaves after spotting Anu with Neel.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Disclosure Shocks Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: While Gopal and Pushpa are caught up in Diwali prep, Anu arrives at the office to resign. Aryavardhan is stunned when she mentions her talk with Jalandhar and poses a pointed question before leaving.

episodesList.title: Neel Reveals Jalandhar's Plan To Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan rejects Anu's resignation and sends everyone home except Neel. Tricked by Aryavardhan and Jhende, Neel reveals Jalandhar's plan to give Anu a file about Aryavardhan's past.

episodesList.title: Jalandhar’S Plan Fails As Aryavardhan Acts Swiftly
episodesList.summary: Anu’s Diwali rituals stop as Aryavardhan rushes to stop Jalandhar from exposing his past. A smoke bomb helps Jalandhar flee, but Neel’s link stuns everyone, and Aryavardhan makes Anu a promise.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’S Diwali Promise
episodesList.summary: As Anu knits a sweater for Aryavardhan, he prepares to fulfil his promise to her. Amid Diwali prep everywhere, Meera gets a hint of Aryavardhan and Jhende’s plan to use Neel against Jalandhar.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Confronts Jalandhar On Diwali
episodesList.summary: On Diwali, Anu hides a surprise for Aryavardhan, who skips his family puja to attend Anu's. Earlier, he confronts Jalandhar with Neel's help, but Jhende's unexpected move changes everything.

episodesList.title: Gopal Gives A Responsibility To Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Gopal give a gift meant for Anu’s future-husband to Aryavardhan. Later, Aryavardhan is disheartened when Gopal asks him to find a match for Anu.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan And Anu Wear Matching Outfits
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan wishes Harshvardhan and Mansi on their anniversary and wears clothes that match Anu’s outfit. He then invites Anu to the party in front of Meera. Later, Anu collapses on seeing a file.

episodesList.title: Truths Unfold As Anu Battles For Life
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan rushes Anu to the hospital in his arms, shocking all. At home, Mansi creates a scene to uncover his room’s secret. Meanwhile, Jhende and Aryavardhan stumble upon shocking truths.

episodesList.title: Anu Sleepwalks Out Of The Hospital
episodesList.summary: Jhende tells Aryavardhan that Anu saw the file revealing his past. After regaining consciousness, Anu begins sleepwalking, while Aryavardhan misses her during Mansi and Harshvardhan’s party.

episodesList.title: Anu Faces Danger Over Aryavardhan’S Secret
episodesList.summary: Anu sleepwalks to Vardhan Mansion, while Mansi demands the key to Aryavardhan’s secret room. A man warns Anu he’ll cheat her and threatens to kill her when she refuses to believe him.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’S Search For Hidden Secrets
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan hands over his business to Mansi but scolds her for sending Anu home. Before meeting Anu, he goes to check the file that made her faint. Jhende assures him it’s safely hidden.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Uncovers The Shawl's Secret
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan visits Anu to return her shawl, but Anu imagines him proposing her. A CCTV footage later reveals the shawl’s true owner, shocking him, while the eerie events outside his room scare Mansi.

episodesList.title: Harshvardhan Faints Near The Secret Room
episodesList.summary: Mansi forces Harshvardhan to open Aryavardhan’s secret room, causing him to faint. Jhende talks to Aryavardhan about Meera’s feelings, while she thinks of plotting to make him break ties with Anu.

episodesList.title: Gopal's Saree Store Catches Fire
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan scolds Mansi for making Harshvardhan open his secret room. She regrets it and returns the key. Simran explains Meera’s coldness to Anu. Gopal is stunned as his saree store catches fire.

episodesList.title: Gopal Is Tricked Into Signing An Agreement
episodesList.summary: Subhash fails to get Gopal arrested for negligence, so he tricks him into signing an INR 5 lakh repayment deal. Aryavardhan calls Anu, but Gopal stops her and Pushpa from seeking his help.

episodesList.title: Anu Plans To Ask Meera For A Loan
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan calls Anu but senses she’s hiding something. Anu plans to borrow money from Meera to help Gopal repay Subhash. Meanwhile, Gopal’s neighbours suspect foul play in the fire at his store.

episodesList.title: Anu Stands Tall As Pushpa Faces Humiliation
episodesList.summary: Bipin tries to warn Simran about Raghupati’s misdeeds. Later, Anu sees Pushpa being humiliated and takes a bold stand. At home, Mansi’s outburst forces Gayatri to call Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Is Torn Between His Family And Anu
episodesList.summary: Tired of Mansi’s constant demands, Aryavardhan asks Harshvardhan to take charge, but he refuses. Later, Aryavardhan tells Gayatri about Gopal’s store and wonders why Anu kept it from him.

episodesList.title: Meera’S Shocking Claim Puts Anu At Risk
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan goes to console Gopal, while Harshvardhan and Mansi take charge at the office. Meera stuns everyone, blaming Anu for a lost tender. Bipin uncovers Raghupati’s secret and alerts Anu.

episodesList.title: Anu Confronts Raghupati For Setting The Fire
episodesList.summary: Anu confronts Raghupati for setting Gopal’s shop on fire and resolves to find proof against him. Later, Meera alleges that Anu had leaked the company’s bid and begins an enquiry into the matter.

episodesList.title: Anu Resigns After Being Accused Of Fraud
episodesList.summary: Two employees from the office find a bag of money at Anu's house and accuse her of defrauding the company. Hurt by Aryavardhan’s silence, Anu resigns and leaves him deeply saddened.

episodesList.title: Gopal Learns About Anu’S Dismissal
episodesList.summary: Meera is shaken when Aryavardhan scolds her and Harshvardhan, vowing to expose whoever framed Anu. After Raghupati reveals Anu’s dismissal, Gopal locks himself in, alarming Pushpa and others.

episodesList.title: Mansi’S Party Plan And Meera’S Bold Challenge
episodesList.summary: Mansi throws a party to mark her first day at work. Meanwhile, Kalyani takes Anu to an event management firm for a job interview. Aryavardhan confronts Meera, who demands proof that she framed Anu.

episodesList.title: Siddhi Mata’S Prophecy For Gayatri
episodesList.summary: Anu visits Jagdish’s firm with Kalyani, but a surprise event call changes everything. As Gopal mourns his burnt store, Gayatri collapses after meeting Siddhi Mata and urges Aryavardhan to marry.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Discovery Sparks A Storm
episodesList.summary: Anu learns Subhash moved sarees before the fire and confronts him with Gopal and Pushpa. Subhash alerts Raghupati, hinting at the mastermind. Meanwhile, Mansi asks Meera to follow up with Jagdish.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Big Break And Meera’S Silent Move
episodesList.summary: Anu and Simran face a catering crisis until neighbours rally to help. Meera secretly alters the menu to sabotage Anu. Unaware of this ploy, Aryavardhan steps in, offering Anu hope to succeed.

episodesList.title: Raghupati’S Goons Outnumber Gopal And Pushpa
episodesList.summary: During the catering arrangements, Anu’s hostility towards Aryavardhan softens. Meanwhile, Bipin alerts Gopal and Pushpa, who confront Raghupati over stolen sarees. However, his goons outnumber them.

episodesList.title: Pushpa’S Fierce Battle To Save Gopal
episodesList.summary: Pushpa battles Raghupati and his goons to save Gopal, while Bipin rushes for help. As police close in on Raghupati, Rajni fears for her family. Aryavardhan plans to skip his party to support Anu.

episodesList.title: Jhende Alerts Aryavardhan About Anu’S Order
episodesList.summary: Jhende tells Aryavardhan Anu’s catering is for Mansi’s party, with Meera in charge. Meera shares a key detail with Mansi, while Simran spots Anu with Aryavardhan and fears being seen.

episodesList.title: Secrets And Chaos Before Mansi’S Big Day
episodesList.summary: Ganga helps Pushpa prepare for Mansi’s party and notices Anu and Aryavardhan’s bond. Aryavardhan’s revelation and a setback in delivery turn the day into a rollercoaster of emotions.

episodesList.title: Anu And Aryavardhan Against Mansi’S Rage
episodesList.summary: Mansi fumes at Gopal, Pushpa and Anu, demanding a public apology for the wrong food. Aryavardhan defends them, and Gayatri realises Anu must be special for him to help despite being an industrialist.

episodesList.title: Meera Faces Accusations And Fear
episodesList.summary: Mansi shocks Harshvardhan with claims of Aryavardhan and Anu’s affair. Jhende blames Meera for the party chaos, leaving her shaken. Later, she steps into Aryavardhan’s cabin, dreading confrontation.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Exposes Meera
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan exposes Meera’s scheme to frame Anu with bribery and leaks. Meanwhile, Gopal rejoices as Anu and Pushpa confront Subhash, compelling him to accept terms that restore his store.

episodesList.title: Gopal’S Decision Saddens Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan exposes Meera’s ploy to frame Anu but conceals her name. Gopal’s decision leaves him saddened, while Siddhi Mata urges Gayatri and Pushpa to visit Appe Pashan Murthy for Bhoota Kola.

episodesList.title: Anu Calls Aryavardhan To Meet Her
episodesList.summary: At Simran and Bipin’s urging, Anu calls Aryavardhan to meet her while he prepares to profess his love. Meanwhile, Appe Pashan Murthy signals to their parents that they are destined to marry.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’S Confession Halted
episodesList.summary: Anu’s words halt Aryavardhan’s love confession. She scolds Simran and Bipin for arranging the meet. The next day, ignoring Meera’s resignation news, Aryavardhan visits Anu preparing for an interview.

episodesList.title: Appe’S Words Change Gopal’S Decision
episodesList.summary: Gopal rejects Aryavardhan’s offer to Anu as Business Head at Rajnandini Sarees, but Appe’s words sway him. Rajni’s joy fades with Raghupati’s return, and Anu is hurt when Aryavardhan calls her Meera.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Visits Meera's House
episodesList.summary: Anu waits to sign an agreement in front of Aryavardhan, but Jhende pressures her through Harshvardhan. While Raghupati warns Gopal and Pushpa, Aryavardhan sees something unexpected at Meera’s house.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Comes To Gopal And Pushpa's Rescue
episodesList.summary: The corporation seizes Gopal and Pushpa’s goods for unlicensed street trading, but Gayatri intervenes. Later, Aryavardhan shares Meera’s troubles with Anu, while Jhende asks Meera to reform her ways.

episodesList.title: Meera Tells Bholi To Spy On Anu
episodesList.summary: Bholi helps Anu get the idea of running an online saree shop. Later, Bholi visits Meera for a job, and Meera tells her to spy on Anu. Elsewhere, Mansi suspects Aryavardhan’s feelings for Anu.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Promotes Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan organises a welcome party for someone, and Meera assumes that it is for her. However, Aryavardhan declares that the party is for Rajnandini Sarees’ new business head, Anu.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Hosts A Welcome Party
episodesList.summary: Jhende tells Meera that Aryavardhan’s has planned a welcome party for her. Simran enlists Bipin's help to boost Gopal’s sales. Aryavardhan makes an announcement at the party that leaves Meera stunned.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Asks Aryavardhan About Anu
episodesList.summary: Gayatri questions Aryavardhan about his fallout with Anu while Mansi eavesdrops. Anu tells Simran about Meera confessing her love to Aryavardhan and later asks him about his feelings.

episodesList.title: Gayatri’S Bold Decision Shocks Mansi
episodesList.summary: Anu questions Aryavardhan’s love for Meera, and his reply leads to a tender moment. Pushpa and Gopal get a surprise offer, while Gayatri shocks Mansi with her bold decision!

episodesList.title: Jhende Discovers Meera’S Plot Against Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan assigns Anu to host Gayatri’s birthday and office anniversary before flying to London. Meanwhile, Jhende discovers Meera’s plot and warns her to retreat to avoid fresh trouble.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Call Triggers Mysterious Disturbance
episodesList.summary: At Aryavardhan’s urging, Anu calls Gayatri for the first time, triggering strange sounds in his secret room. Jhende tells Meera how Anu impressed Aryavardhan’s family with Gayatri’s birthday plans.

episodesList.title: Meera Plots To Ruin Anu's Gift For Gayatri
episodesList.summary: After Bholi’s update, Meera drives Raghupati to ruin Anu’s hand‑painted saree for Gayatri. Yet, destiny delivers it to Gayatri, while an unaware Anu anxiously searches, troubled by its loss.

episodesList.title: Meera Plots To Stop Anu From Meeting Gayatri
episodesList.summary: Mansi steals from Anu’s home to convince Gayatri of her affair with Aryavardhan. Meera ropes in Raghupati for a ploy to stop Anu from meeting Gayatri, while Aryavardhan plans a surprise for Anu.

episodesList.title: Anu Faces Meera’S Wrath
episodesList.summary: Mansi brings Aryavardhan’s sweater as proof of his affair. An emotionally hurt Pushpa leaves with money, worrying Gopal. Later, Anu faces Meera and Raghupati’s wrath on her way to Gayatri’s house.

episodesList.title: Anu Faces A Tough Question
episodesList.summary: Gopal is shocked to hear Bholi say that Anu was brought home unconscious. Pushpa arrives just then. Anu hides her pain from Gayatri and confides in Aryavardhan before facing a tough question.

episodesList.title: Anu's Attire Upsets Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Pushpa asks Anu to wear a specific outfit, and Anu confides in Meera, who fumes at the praise Anu receives. At the party, Gayatri meets Anu, and Aryavardhan is upset that she ignored his gift.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Dances With Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan remains aloof from Anu during Gayatri’s birthday celebration. Meanwhile, Meera plots to dance with Aryavardhan during a game, but he ends up dancing with Anu.

episodesList.title: Anu Saves Aryavardhan From Meera’S Attack
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan inadvertently becomes the target of Meera’s attack at the party, but Anu saves him. Gayatri praises Anu in front of everyone, while Jhende instigates Aryavardhan against her.

episodesList.title: Meera Plots A Scandal To Humiliate Anu
episodesList.summary: Meera plots a photo scandal to humiliate Anu, but Pushpa defends her. Aryavardhan struggles with his feelings for Anu. Later, Meera lures Anu to her house and shocks her with a display of photos.

episodesList.title: Meera Plants A Doubt In Anu’S Mind
episodesList.summary: Meera plants a doubt about her and Aryavardhan’s relationship in Anu’s mind. Tearful, Anu spills out her dilemma before Aryavardhan. Gayatri decides to visit Anu’s home after a chat with Siddhi Mata.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Meets With An Accident
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan confronts Meera for switching Anu’s dress. Later, Meera learns about Gayatri’s plan to visit Anu’s house and gives Raghupati the task to stop her. Gayatri meets with an accident.

episodesList.title: Anu Offers To Donate Blood To Gayatri
episodesList.summary: Anu takes Gayatri to the hospital. Raghupati tells Meera that he had inadvertently caused Gayatri’s accident. Though Mansi blames Anu for the accident, Anu decides to donate blood to Gayatri.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Sacrifice And Meera’S Dark Secret
episodesList.summary: Anu bravely risks her life and donates blood to save Gayatri, while Meera secretly pays Raghupati for the accident. Later, Anu’s stern words shock Aryavardhan, leaving him speechless.

episodesList.title: Siddhi Mata Warns Anu Of Pushpa’S Trouble
episodesList.summary: Gopal grows wary of Pushpa’s behaviour after the car damage, while Meera and Raghupati dread exposure. The next day, Siddhi Mata warns Anu that Pushpa may soon face serious trouble.

episodesList.title: Pushpa’S Car Is Linked To Gayatri’S Accident
episodesList.summary: Gopal panics as Jhende’s men reveal that Pushpa’s car was involved in Gayatri’s accident. Mansi turns Harshvardhan against Anu, while Aryavardhan’s words at the office leave Anu conflicted.

episodesList.title: Gopal’S Surrender Sparks Chaos
episodesList.summary: Gopal suspects Pushpa ran over Gayatri and surrenders at the police station. Meera uses Mansi to provoke Harshvardhan, but Jhende steps in to save Gopal.

episodesList.title: Mansi’S Cutting Question Silences Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Harshvardhan cancels Gopal’s bail as Mansi humiliates Anu’s family. Aryavardhan arrives to help, but Mansi’s question silences him, while Raghupati and Meera savour the triumph of their ploy.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’S Anguish, Meera’S Deception
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan feels torn after lashing out at Harshvardhan while defending Gopal’s innocence. Meanwhile, Anu’s family discovers a crucial clue, as Meera and Raghupati plot their next cunning move.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’S Apology And Bold Revelation
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan makes peace with Harshvardhan, revealing his vow to clear Gopal’s name. As society and the press torment Anu’s family, he stuns everyone with a bold statement that silences their attacks.

episodesList.title: Anu’S Truth Sparks Shock, Fear And Rage
episodesList.summary: Meera reels in shock, Raghupati trembles as Anu clears Gopal and Pushpa before the press and police. Later, Mansi fumes when Harshvardhan tells Aryavardhan that his doubts about Anu’s family are gone!

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan And Jhende Confront Meera
episodesList.summary: Shattered after losing his job due to a tarnished image, Gopal confides in Pushpa and Anu. Bipin reveals a shocking secret to Anu on the way. Later, Aryavardhan and Jhende confront Meera.

episodesList.title: Anu And Raghupati's Clash Of Fate
episodesList.summary: Anu exposes Raghupati, leading to his arrest, but Aryavardhan’s old enemy frees him with a trick. Later, Mansi grows upset as Harshavardhan plans to visit Anu’s home to apologise to her family.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’s Secret Santa Gift to Anu
episodesList.summary: Anu is delighted with Aryavardhan’s gift during a game of Secret Santa. Later, Anu falls unconscious, stressing about her exam result. Aryavardhan scolds Meera for Anu’s state.

episodesList.title: Meera Tampers With Anu’s Exam Result
episodesList.summary: Harshvardhan apologises to Anu’s parents. Anu is devastated upon failing in her exam. Aryavardhan exposes Meera and Mr Mishra’s plot, and Anu’s real pass result is reinstated.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Result Sparks Tension Between Aryavardhan and Meera
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan surprises Anu over her graduation, but she feigns failure at home before delighting Pushpa with the truth. Later, Aryavardhan confronts Meera for conspiring with Anu’s faculty.

episodesList.title: Anu Comes Across a Familiar Name
episodesList.summary: The madman warns Anu again about her future with Aryavardhan. Gayatri unsettles Aryavardhan with strange claims, while Anu and Simran receive a surprise. At work, Anu comes across a familiar name.

episodesList.title: Anu Uncovers Rajnandini’s Hidden Truths
episodesList.summary: Anu questions Mr Bharadwaj about Rajnandini, but Jhende insists she’s hallucinating. Later, she finds Rajnandini Women’s Shelter while seeking the answer to why Aryavardhan hides his love for her.

episodesList.title: Jhende Foils Anu’s Quest For Rajnandini
episodesList.summary: Jhende blocks Anu’s search for Rajnandini at the women’s shelter. Meanwhile, Meera deceives Gopal into seeking Anu’s help to halt her transfer, leaving Pushpa doubtful of Meera’s sudden change.

episodesList.title: Anu Confronts Aryavardhan Over Rajnandini
episodesList.summary: Anu reaches Aryavardhan’s old mansion with Simran, seeking truths about Rajnandini, but Jhende foils her plan again. The next day, Anu makes an accusation against Aryavardhan and demands answers.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Suspicion and Aryavardhan’s Silence
episodesList.summary: Anu takes Jhende to Aryavardhan’s old mansion, but her suspicion rises when a photo frame vanishes. Later, Aryavardhan is left stunned as Anu’s family unite on New Year’s Eve to halt her transfer.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Love Confession On New Year’s Eve
episodesList.summary: At the New Year party, Aryavardhan helps Anu win Tambola, but she reveals his sacrifice. Later, Raghupati spikes her drink, and a semi-conscious Anu goes on stage to profess her love for Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’s Struggle and Anu’s Misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: Gayatri reveals Raghupati’s plot against Anu, leading Gopal to punish him. The next day, Aryavardhan, troubled and distant, resolves to confess the truth, while Anu blames herself for his silence.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Guilt After Aryavardhan’s Big Revelation
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan shocks Anu by revealing that Rajnandini is not just his saree brand, but also his wife's name. As Anu faints, he takes her home. The next day, guilt consumes Anu as she confides in Simran.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Coldness Towards Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Anu plans to apologise to Rajnandini for falling for Aryavardhan, while Pushpa grows tense with a diabetes diagnosis. Later, Anu’s cold behaviour towards Aryavardhan prompts Meera to question her.

episodesList.title: Anu Plans to Ask Gayatri About Rajnandini
episodesList.summary: Jhende visits Aryavardhan to get Anu’s transfer application signed, but Gayatri vows to stop her. At home, Anu learns Pushpa has diabetes and later plans to talk to Gayatri about Rajnandini.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Helps Anu Enter His Mansion
episodesList.summary: Pushpa prays for strength against her sweet cravings. Anu faints at Gayatri’s Mata Ki Chowki, but Aryavardhan helps her into the mansion, where she grows uneasy over Rajnandini’s strange absence.

episodesList.title: Anu Learns About Rajnandini’s Death
episodesList.summary: During the Mata Ki Chowki, Anu faints after following a shadowy figure and getting eerie flashbacks. Aryavardhan rescues her and shocks her by revealing that Rajnandini is no more.

episodesList.title: Meera’s Schemes Threaten Anu’s True Love
episodesList.summary: Anu embraces Aryavardhan after his revelation, but a jealous Meera records them to drive a wedge. As Aryavardhan prepares to profess his love, Meera plots to shatter the moment.

episodesList.title: Meera’s Video Plot Against Anu and Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Mansi calls Meera to ask if Aryavardhan and Anu are having an affair. Later, Aryavardhan tells Jhende his plan to profess his love, but a jealous Meera schemes to release a video to ruin their moment.

episodesList.title: Meera Exposes a Hidden Love Affair
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan asks Jhende to make some arrangements near India Gate for his love confession to Anu. Meanwhile, Meera reveals the truth to Gopal, who clutches his chest in pain and faints in shock.

episodesList.title: Gopal’s Condition Halts Aryavardhan’s Love Confession
episodesList.summary: Pushpa finds Gopal unconscious and neighbours rush him to hospital. Meera lies to Jhende at work about her absence. Anu hurries to the hospital, while Aryavardhan fears she left because of his past.

episodesList.title: Dr Mohit Declares Gopal’s Surgery Urgent
episodesList.summary: Dr Mohit tells Anu a minor heart surgery is needed for Gopal. As Anu calls Meera for mediclaim, Harshvardhan asks Aryavardhan if he loves Anu. Later, Aryavardhan is shocked by Gopal’s condition!

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Saves Gopal, Unaware Of a Danger
episodesList.summary: Anu visits Meera’s house for insurance approval, but Meera shuts her out in distress. Later, Aryavardhan helps Anu with Gopal’s angioplasty expenses, unaware that a sniper has him in sight.

episodesList.title: Gopal Ignores Anu At The Hospital
episodesList.summary: Meera fears that her video caused Gopal’s heart attack. At the hospital, Gopal ignores Anu. Later, Anu and Pushpa thank Aryavardhan, while Gopal stresses over Aryavardhan paying for his treatment.

episodesList.title: Gopal Asks Anu to Stay Away From Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: At Dr Mohit’s suggestion, Anu talks to Gopal about his stress. Gopal asks her to stay away from Aryavardhan, leaving her shaken. Later, Gopal’s behaviour around Gayatri worries Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Stumbles Upon a Shocking Video
episodesList.summary: Gopal is upset on learning of Aryavardhan’s role in his treatment. Meera’s behaviour makes Mansi’s suspicious and Gayatri shares her concerns with Jhende. Later, Pushpa stumbles upon a shocking video.

episodesList.title: Gopal’s Hostility Shakes Aryavardhan’s Family
episodesList.summary: Pushpa scolds Simran for supporting Anu and Aryavardhan’s affair. Meera deflects the blame and provokes Gopal once more, while Gayatri, Jhende and Aryavardhan grow uneasy about his sudden hostility.

episodesList.title: Meera Trembles As Jhende Exposes Her Ploy
episodesList.summary: Gopal returns home with Anu and Pushpa but remains upset with Anu. Jhende exposes Meera’s plot after Gayatri’s call. Later, Anu opens Aryavardhan’s gift, bringing them brief relief.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Marriage Plans and Aryavardhan’s Abduction
episodesList.summary: Dr Mohit’s visit prompts Gopal and Pushpa to plan Anu’s marriage to him. Aryavardhan’s attempt to meet Anu ends in his abduction to Kashmir, leaving Anu torn and his family anxious over his absence.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’s Abduction News Shocks The Nation
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan’s video exposes his abduction by terrorists in Kashmir. As he defies their plot against the nation, Anu vows to track him down using the device he once gifted her.

episodesList.title: Meera Slaps Anu
episodesList.summary: Meera slaps Anu when she expresses her desire to join the rescue mission for Aryavardhan. Later, the kidnappers make their demands in exchange for Aryavardhan’s release.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Plea to Join Jhende’s Risky Mission
episodesList.summary: Jhende visits Anu for her bracelet to rescue Aryavardhan, while terrorists find the other one with him. As Gayatri and Mansi look after Harshvardhan, Anu seeks her parents' consent to join Jhende.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Search and Aryavardhan’s Struggle
episodesList.summary: Anu, Meera and Jhende head to Kashmir with a search party to rescue Aryavardhan. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan is thrashed while escaping the terrorists as both families grow anxious for Anu and Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: Anu Reaches Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Anu’s bracelet guides her to a little Amal. At her request, Amal and her father take her to Aryavardhan, but terrorists hold them captive. Meanwhile, Gayatri visits Gopal and Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Efforts Help Jhende Rescue Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Jhende and the search party rescue Anu and Aryavardhan from the terrorists. Once safe, Anu insists on returning to Delhi, recalling her promise to Gopal and Pushpa to stay away from Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’s Heartfelt Confession to Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan feels strange when Anu remains distant and insists on leaving for Delhi, while Jhende consoles a jealous Meera. Yet love prevails as Aryavardhan unexpectedly professes his feelings to Anu.

episodesList.title: Anu Chooses Family Honour Over Love
episodesList.summary: Anu confesses her love to Aryavardhan, who silences her doubts. Meera grows curious about their trip to Kashmir. Later, Anu confides in Gopal about the proposal, choosing family honour over love.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Closure Shatters Aryavardhan’s Hopes
episodesList.summary: Gopal trusts Anu when she says she is going to the office to seek closure with Aryavardhan. Dr Mohit’s arrival sparks new possibilities, while Aryavardhan is left shattered as Anu ends their ties.

episodesList.title: Is It Over Between Anu and Aryavardhan?
episodesList.summary: Heartbroken after parting from Aryavardhan, Anu puts on a brave face for Gopal and Pushpa. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan breaks down in front of Jhende.

episodesList.title: Dr Mohit Expresses His Interest In Anu
