episodesList.summary: Anu’s concern for Gopal impresses Dr Mohit, who expresses his interest in her. Jhende angrily confronts Anu about pressuring Aryavardhan into proposing to her in front of the Sharmas.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Meets Dr Mohit Near Anu's House
episodesList.summary: Gopal and Pushpa cheer Anu, while Siddhi Mata urges Gayatri to visit her to find out what is bothering Aryavardhan. Later, Aryavardhan arrives there and finds Dr Mohit there with his mother.

episodesList.title: Dr Mohit's Mother Chooses Anu For Him
episodesList.summary: Anu is stunned by Aryavardhan’s visit, though her parents welcome him inside. Jhende warns Meera never to hurt Aryavardhan again, while Dr Mohit’s mother shocks all by choosing Anu as her son’s bride.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’s Injury and Anu’s Destiny
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan injures himself at work and tells Jhende that Anu will marry Dr Mohit. Siddhi Mata’s words unsettle Gopal and Pushpa, yet they agree to visit Dr Mohit’s home at his mother’s request.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Nightmare Troubles Gopal and Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Mansi spots Gayatri outside Aryavardhan's secret room and questions Harshvardhan about Rajnandini. Gopal and Pushpa are pleased by Anu's call with Dr Mohit, until her nightmare leaves them worried.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Tasks Jhende With a Probe
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan explains Anu’s decision to Jhende and asks him to trace who showed the video to Gopal. Despite learning about Anu’s nightmares, Dr Mohit’s parents plan his marriage with Anu within a week.

episodesList.title: Anu and Aryavardhan At Crossroads
episodesList.summary: Anu reaches office late due to her wedding talks and faces Meera’s taunts. Gopal confronts Aryavardhan, who apologises and vows to stay away. As roka plans begin, Pushpa collapses, leaving Gopal torn.

episodesList.title: Jhende and Aryavardhan Secretly Help Gopal
episodesList.summary: Subhash humiliates Gopal when he asks for a loan, but Jhende secretly steps in with police support for Aryavardhan’s sake. The next day, Aryavardhan is shattered to learn of Anu and Dr Mohit’s roka.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Turns to Alcohol to Forget Anu
episodesList.summary: Unable to stay away, Aryavardhan goes to Anu’s locality and she senses his presence during her roka with Dr Mohit. At night, he returns home drunk, murmuring of lost love, leaving his family shaken.

episodesList.title: Anu Expresses Her True Feelings to Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Anu opens up to Simran but their talk turns into a clash. The next day, Jhende urges Aryavardhan to pull himself together. At work, Anu apologises to Aryavardhan and shares her feelings and struggles.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Faces a Shocking Moment
episodesList.summary: Dr Mohit visits Aryavardhan’s office, urging him to attend his marriage with Anu. Gayatri meets Gopal and Pushpa to discuss Anu and Aryavardhan’s bond, while Aryavardhan faces a shocking moment.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’s Darkest Hour
episodesList.summary: After seeing Anu with Dr Mohit, Aryavardhan spirals into despair, drinking until Meera's car hits him. Meanwhile, Anu hides her turmoil after Dr Mohit’s family comes home to try the mangalsutra.

episodesList.title: Jhende’s Plan to Reunite Aryavardhan and Anu
episodesList.summary: Pushpa confronts Anu about her love for Aryavardhan, but Simran’s words silence her. After seeing Aryavardhan broken, Jhende devises a plan, while Gayatri asks him to get an important paper home.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Summons Gopal to His Office
episodesList.summary: Jhende assures Gayatri that he will reunite Anu and Aryavardhan. At a meeting, a remark about Aryavardhan’s age sparks a push‑up challenge. Soon after, he summons Gopal to his office.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Overhears Anu and Gayatri
episodesList.summary: As Gayatri confronts Anu about her feelings for Aryavardhan, Pushpa overhears and learns the truth. Meanwhile, Aryavardhan shares his dilemma and asks Gopal whether he should attend Anu’s wedding.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Mehndi and a Sign Of Destiny
episodesList.summary: Anu and Dr Mohit’s families unite for a pre‑wedding ritual, but Siddhi Mata reveals a sign hinting Anu and Aryavardhan’s destiny. Later, Jhende arrives at her mehndi with a gift that terrifies Gopal.

episodesList.title: Jhende and Simran Step Up For Their Friends
episodesList.summary: Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 45-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

episodesList.title: Jhende and Simran Set Their Bold Plan
episodesList.summary: Jhende plans Anu and Aryavardhan’s elopement with Simran and Bipin. On the day of Anu’s haldi, both are tricked into meeting each other, unaware that Meera has already revealed the truth to Gayatri.

episodesList.title: Pushpa’s Hope and Raghupati’s Claim
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan brings Anu home, delighting Pushpa, who urges them to elope and marry. Meanwhile, Dr Mohit’s mother Sudha is shocked when Raghupati claims Anu has eloped on the day of their haldi.

episodesList.title: Anu Meets Aryavardhan Before Her Wedding Rituals
episodesList.summary: Anu reassures Pushpa as she feels guilty for forcing Anu into an unwanted marriage. Aryavardhan attends Dr Mohit and Anu’s wedding. Anu meets Aryavardhan before the rituals and apologises to him.

episodesList.title: Dr Mohit’s Decision Puts Aryavardhan on Edge
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan and Anu share emotional goodbyes and promises, unaware that Dr Mohit has overheard them. During the wedding rituals, Mohit walks away, but Aryavardhan brings him back for Gopal’s sake.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Fights Gopal for Anu’s Future
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan brings Dr Mohit back, but he still refuses to marry Anu. Rajni slaps Raghupati for mocking Anu’s family. The next day, Pushpa urges Gopal to wed Anu to Aryavardhan and firmly supports her.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Stands by Anu and Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Mansi and Harshvardhan question Aryavardhan over Anu’s cancelled wedding, but Gayatri stands by him. The next day, Pushpa reveals Gopal is fine and pledges her support to Aryavardhan and Anu.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Vows to Win Gopal Over in Seven Days
episodesList.summary: With Pushpa’s support, Aryavardhan begins his plan to win Gopal’s approval. Meera fumes, but Jhende stays hopeful. Hearing Gopal’s four conditions, Aryavardhan vows to win him over in seven days.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Brings Roses for Gopal
episodesList.summary: Gopal frets over stopping Aryavardhan, while Pushpa believes he’ll win him over. Wearing his twenty‑year‑old clothes, Aryavardhan tries to charm Gopal with roses as Mansi and Meera plot against him.

episodesList.title: Rajni Learns of Anu and Aryavardhan's Affair
episodesList.summary: Gopal grows annoyed by Aryavardhan’s constant attempts to win him over and finds him at an unexpected place again. Rajni learns of Anu and Aryavardhan's affair, and another truth soon hurts her.

episodesList.title: Gopal Struggles to Escape Arya
episodesList.summary: Gopal tries to hide from Aryavardhan by taking Anu and Pushpa to a temple, but he still finds them. A viral video gives Mansi and Meera a reason to question it, while Pushpa tries to pacify Rajni.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan's Dinner Date With Gopal
episodesList.summary: Gopal visits Anu’s office to observe Aryavardhan’s behaviour with her, but with Anu and Pushpa’s help, Aryavardhan tricks him into a dinner date. Meanwhile, Pushpa notices Rajni being rude to Anu.

episodesList.title: Meera's Sudden Visit Shifts Gopal’s Perspective
episodesList.summary: When Pushpa reveals the cause of Rajni’s anger, Anu vows to win her back. While Meera’s unexpected visit intrigues Gopal, Jhende secretly meets Simran and Bipin to set Aryavardhan’s plan in motion.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Backs Gopal With Sports Day
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan sets up a Sports Day in Chandni Chowk, framing it as Gopal’s initiative and hinting at a surprise reward. But Meera and Mansi quickly dismiss the plan, stirring fresh criticism.

episodesList.title: Meera's Plan to Spoil Aryavardhan's Sports Day
episodesList.summary: Gayatri learns of Meera’s love for Aryavardhan only after Mansi hints at a better match than Anu. Meanwhile, Meera brings a pro wrestler and Raghupati uses him against Aryavardhan at the sports day.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’s Fight Wins Him Gopal’s Trust
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan agrees to fight the wrestler brought by Raghupati and Meera, earning Gopal’s love and trust. Meanwhile, Jhende lies to Gayatri about Meera’s feelings but later scolds Meera for her plots.

episodesList.title: Gopal Faces Questions on Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Gopal realises that Pushpa and Anu had helped Aryavardhan, even as gossip spreads that he is in love with Anu. A few women question Gopal, and Raghupati later vows to separate them on Holi.

episodesList.title: Holi Brings a Secret for Anu
episodesList.summary: Gayatri joins Anu's family for Holika Dahan, and Gopal welcomes her and introduces her to Vishwanath Kaka. The next day, Anu visits Aryavardhan for Holi and discovers something unexpected.

episodesList.title: Anu's Vow on Holi Worries Gopal
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan stuns all by agreeing to celebrate Holi after 20 years but insists on winning Gopal over first. Later, in Chandni Chowk, Anu vows to stop celebrating if he fails, leaving Gopal anxious.

episodesList.title: Gopal's Decision Stuns Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Gopal flees to avoid Holi, only to be trapped by Raghupati's goons. Aryavardhan risks all to save him, but Gopal's decision regarding Anu’s marriage later leaves him reeling.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Plans a Surprise for Anu
episodesList.summary: Gayatri and Jhende rejoice over Aryavardhan convincing Gopal for his marriage with Anu. But Raghupati calls Meera to hatch a plan to stop the wedding, as Aryavardhan hints at a surprise for Anu.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Marriage Plans Upsets Mansi and Meera
episodesList.summary: Swayed by Raghupati, Rajni warns Pushpa of disgrace, but she stays firm. Mansi mistreats Gayatri, angering Aryavardhan. Later, Anu and Aryavardhan share a warm moment despite Meera’s jealousy.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan and Anu’s Relationship Under Threat
episodesList.summary: Anu and Aryavardhan rejoice as their relationship is accepted, while Meera, Mansi and Raghupati plot to ruin their happiness. Unaware of their schemes, Gayatri works to finalise the wedding date.

episodesList.title: Rumours Spread About Anu and Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Anu and Aryavardhan’s photo goes viral, and rumours begin to spread about them. The news perturbs Gopal, and he states that Anu and Aryavardhan must get married soon.

episodesList.title: Raghupati Tries to Turn Chandni Chowk Against Anu
episodesList.summary: Gopal urges Aryavardhan to agree to a quick wedding to save Anu from the viral scandal. Later, Mansi’s blame triggers Harshvardhan’s panic, while in Chandni Chowk, Raghupati riles the neighbours.

episodesList.title: Anu Vows to Persuade Harshvardhan
episodesList.summary: After Raghupati insults Anu, Pushpa lashes out and Gopal stands by the match. Harshvardhan then forces Aryavardhan to refuse. Anu learns of a promise to Rajnandini and vows to win Harshvardhan over.

episodesList.title: Tumm Se Tumm Tak - March 14, 2026
episodesList.summary: Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 45-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Chance to Win Harshvardhan Over
episodesList.summary: Pushpa takes Gopal’s help to placate Rajni, but she stays firm. Meanwhile, Harshvardhan hears Anu after long waiting and gives her a chance to convince him about marrying Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: Harshvardhan’s Ultimatum for Anu
episodesList.summary: Guided by Meera, Harshvardhan lays down a stern condition to accept Anu for Aryavardhan. Jhende challenges Meera's move, but in vain. Later, Pushpa and Gopal figure out how Anu can meet it.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Hires Happy Singh to Train Anu
episodesList.summary: Anu tries to talk to Simran about Harshvardhan’s test. Later, Pushpa hires trainer Happy Singh to help Anu pass the test, as Aryavardhan secretly supports her.

episodesList.title: Anu’s High‑Society Hurdle
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Gopal struggle to teach Anu high‑society etiquette as neighbours taunt her. Rajni begins doubting her decision to stay away, while Aryavardhan is kept from reaching Anu.

episodesList.title: Rajni Joins Anu’s Battle
episodesList.summary: Pushpa grows emotional when Rajni offers to help Anu learn high‑society etiquette. But when Meera calls Anu a liar and dishonest, Aryavardhan snaps back and reveals the truth about his offer to Anu.

episodesList.title: Will Anu Pass the Test?
episodesList.summary: On Anu’s test day, Meera manipulates Mansi to join the judges' panel but grows uneasy when Gayatri and Jhende join too. Later, Anu answers confidently, but a tricky bouncer leaves her baffled.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Struggle and Harshvardhan’s Fall
episodesList.summary: Anu struggles through etiquette tests and disappoints Harshvardhan, leaving her family worried. Later, she finds him collapsing in the street after an emotional breakdown and rushes to help him.

episodesList.title: Harshvardhan Finds Shelter in Anu’s Care
episodesList.summary: Anu brings Harshvardhan home when he refuses to contact his family after being cheated again. She secretly alerts Aryavardhan to calm him and then devises a way to help Harshvardhan.

episodesList.title: Anu and Pushpa Shape Harshvardhan’s New Path
episodesList.summary: Pushpa trains Harshvardhan in negotiation, and Anu sharpens his decisions, helping him launch a quilt project with the sarees collected after the scam, angering Mansi. Later, Anu spots a quilt theft.

episodesList.title: Meera and Raghupati’s Rising Threat
episodesList.summary: Anu chases a quilt thief and discovers Aryavardhan, who has come with good news. As Harshvardhan grows closer to her family, Meera plots against them, and Raghupati vows to crush the Sharmas’ efforts.

episodesList.title: Raghupati Tries to Burn the Quilts
episodesList.summary: Raghupati schemes with Meera and burns the quilt boxes to sabotage Harshvardhan and the Sharmas, but Anu outwits them, leading Harshvardhan to understand the value of money.

episodesList.title: Harshvardhan Approves the Match
episodesList.summary: On his way to Anu’s home, Aryavardhan is happy when Harshvardhan says she’s the match for him. The next day, both families meet to fix the wedding date as Pushpa plans to visit the ancestral temple.

episodesList.title: An Old Enemy Watches Anu Alone
episodesList.summary: Meera and Mansi are upset with the marriage talks, while Anu’s neighbours taunt Gopal and Pushpa. When both leave for the ancestral temple, Anu is left alone, unaware an old enemy is watching her.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Keeps Anu and Aryavardhan Apart
episodesList.summary: Anu reflects on her ring before meeting Aryavardhan, but Gayatri orders Jhende to keep them apart until Gopal and Pushpa return. Meanwhile, a stranger helps Gopal and Pushpa at the temple.

episodesList.title: Raghupati Begins His New Plot Against Anu
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan tries to meet Anu with Jhende’s help, while Mansi’s resistance leaves Harshvardhan worried. Later, Raghupati plots against Anu and Aryavardhan as Gopal and Pushpa search for the stranger.

episodesList.title: The Stranger Who Cautions Anu’s Parents
episodesList.summary: The stranger’s warning that Aryavardhan isn’t who he appears to be leaves Gopal and Pushpa shaken. Later, Anu faces Raghupati’s ploys, and Aryavardhan reluctantly hands the wedding planning to Meera.

episodesList.title: Jalandhar Returns to Separate Anu and Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Meera takes charge of Anu and Aryavardhan’s wedding. Gopal and Pushpa warn Jhende about a stranger, who is soon revealed as Jalandhar, bent on ruining Aryavardhan’s life.

episodesList.title: Jalandhar’s Plot After the Night of Fear
episodesList.summary: Late at night, Aryavardhan hears a scream and rushes to his secret room. At her house, Anu wakes from a nightmare. The next day, Jalandhar plots against them using Raghupati.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Announces Marriage and a Key Decision
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan gathers both families for a press conference to announce his marriage to Anu and a key decision. Meanwhile, provoked by Raghupati, her neighbours plot to stop the wedding.

episodesList.title: Jhende Finds Proof Jalandhar Is Alive
episodesList.summary: Mansi and Meera wait for Anu to fail, but her neighbours support her new business. Elsewhere, Jhende gets a video of Jalandhar punishing Raghupati and is shaken by the thought that Jalandhar is alive.

episodesList.title: Mansi Begins Her Probe Into Jalandhar
episodesList.summary: Jhende shows Aryavardhan a video hinting Jalandhar is alive, a truth Mansi overhears and vows to probe. As Anu faces mixed reactions pitching her bridal venture before Pushpa calls with 'roka' news.

episodesList.title: Mansi Probes Aryavardhan’s Past
episodesList.summary: Meera plans Anu and Aryavardhan’s pre-wedding ritual, concealing her desire to sabotage it. Mansi’s curiosity about Aryavardhan’s past sparks conflict. Meanwhile, Jalandhar’s plot deepens.

episodesList.title: Secret Plots Threaten Anu’s 'Roka'
episodesList.summary: Anu and Aryavardhan’s 'roka' begins warmly, but a secret message on Raghupati’s phone alarms Jhende and Simran. Meanwhile, Mansi confides in Meera about her plan to derail the special day.

episodesList.title: The Hidden Truth About Rajiv
episodesList.summary: After Anu and Aryavardhan’s 'roka', Mansi mocks Gopal, doubting how he will handle a huge guest list. Jhende falls into Raghupati and Jalandhar’s trap as Jalandhar urges Anu to uncover who Rajiv is.

episodesList.title: Anu Finds a Letter From Rajnandini’s Past
episodesList.summary: At Jalandhar’s behest, Anu visits Aryavardhan’s bungalow and gets an old letter related to Rajnandini. Gopal loses savings to fraud, while Mansi talks to Harshvardhan about the wedding.

episodesList.title: The Letter Linked to Rajnandini Disturbs Anu
episodesList.summary: The letter linked to Rajnandini’s past unsettles Anu. Pushpa, Meera and Jhende discuss the wedding menu with the planners. Later, Mansi purposely mentions Jalandhar to observe Anu’s reaction.

episodesList.title: Meera’s Wedding Ploy Backfires
episodesList.summary: Meera’s ploy backfires as Pushpa rejects her lavish wedding plan. Hiding fraud losses, Gopal seeks a loan from another bank. As Anu probes Rajiv’s past, Aryavardhan invites her to lunch.

episodesList.title: Rajni Steps in to Help Gopal and Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Gopal and Pushpa hide their financial troubles as Rajni steps in to help with the wedding. At work, Meera snaps at Anu over Pushpa’s behaviour, while Aryavardhan ignores his health for lunch with Anu.

episodesList.title: Jalandhar Rekindles the Secret About Rajiv
episodesList.summary: Amid a tyre burst, Jalandhar meets Anu and urges her to ask Aryavardhan about Rajiv. Meanwhile, Gopal and Pushpa struggle for wedding funds. Gayatri warns Anu that Aryavardhan skipped his medicines.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan’s Chest Pain Shakes Everyone
episodesList.summary: Anu rushes Aryavardhan to hospital after his sudden chest pain. As Siddhi Mata’s warning leaves Gopal unsettled, Meera sets aside her enmity and embraces Anu, while the news shocks both families.

episodesList.title: Anu’s Vow to Save Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: News of Aryavardhan’s heart attack sparks doubts about Anu marrying an older man. At the hospital, Anu and her family stand by Aryavardhan’s loved ones, as she vows to fast after meeting Siddhi Mata.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Undergoes a Successful Surgery
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan’s surgery succeeds, and he is declared out of danger. Elsewhere, Anu consoles a distraught Meera. Later, Jhende questions Anu about the man driving the suspicious car.

episodesList.title: A Promise to Protect Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Shocked to learn that Jalandhar urged Anu to ask Aryavardhan about Rajiv, Jhende makes her promise never to do so. The neighbours’ comments about Aryavardhan’s health leave Pushpa worried for Anu.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan's Condition Raises Wedding Doubts
episodesList.summary: At a press meet, Meera announces Aryavardhan’s recovery, but Jalandhar plots his next move. Jhende confronts Raghupati to uncover the ploy, while Pushpa worries about Anu’s marriage to Aryavardhan.

episodesList.title: Pushpa’s Doubts Deepen Over Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Anu senses Pushpa’s silence stems from fears around Aryavardhan. As Rajni deepens her doubts, Pushpa visits Gayatri. Soon, Jalandhar meets Raghupati, and Jhende plots to outsmart them.

episodesList.title: Pushpa’s Doubts Shake the Marriage Plans
episodesList.summary: Mansi is happy to hear Gayatri and Pushpa discuss cancelling Anu and Aryavardhan’s marriage. Jhende learns of Pushpa’s doubts while Anu and Meera prepare for Aryavardhan’s discharge.

episodesList.title: Anu Goes Against Pushpa's Decision
episodesList.summary: Anu cares for Aryavardhan despite objections, but Pushpa reveals her plan to cancel the alliance, fearing for Anu’s future. Anu refuses to leave Aryavardhan as he calls her, unaware of the truth.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan's Plan to Convince Pushpa
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan learns Pushpa wants to end his alliance with Anu. Determined to win her over, he joins Anu to convince her, while Rajni continues to fuel Pushpa’s doubts.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Consents for Aryavandhan and Anu's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Aryavardhan wins Pushpa’s approval by proving that his health won’t affect his and Anu’s married life. The celebration fades when Anu receives a cryptic message about his link to Rajeev Bhatia.

episodesList.title: Anu Confronts Simran About Neel
episodesList.summary: Anu spots Simran secretly meeting Neel and later confronts her. Meanwhile, fearing that Anu may uncover the truth, Aryavardhan subtly tries to probe her worries.

episodesList.title: Tumm Se Tumm Tak - April 26, 2026
episodesList.summary: Anu, a kind 20-year-old, and Aryavardhan, a resolute 45-year-old businessman, defy societal norms and family resistance, overcoming struggles to demonstrate that love transcends age or boundaries.

episodesList.title: Rajni Blames Anu for Simran and Neel's Affair
episodesList.summary: A beggar’s words about Rajiv disturbs Anu. Simran reconciles with Neel, but Rajni lashes out and blames Anu. Meanwhile, Pushpa and her neighbours attempt to expose an LPG scam.

episodesList.title: Anu Goes to Meet the Cryptic Caller
episodesList.summary: Rajni forbids Simran and Neel from meeting and blames Anu. Aryavardhan battles his secret as Anu is summoned by a cryptic caller to talk about Rajiv, while Rajni insults Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Will Aryavardhan Confess the Truth About Rajiv?
episodesList.summary: Rajni blames Anu for Simran’s affair, while Anu seeks the truth about Rajiv. Aryavardhan meets Anu at the temple to tell her about Rajiv, making her feel guilty for going behind his back.

episodesList.title: The Secret of Rajiv Bhatia
episodesList.summary: Anu grows anxious seeing Aryavardhan’s condition and begs him not to reveal anything. Still, he tells her the truth about Rajiv Bhatia. Soon, Gayatri arrives with Jhende to add to his revelation.

episodesList.title: Anu Is Shaken by Aryavardhan's Truth
episodesList.summary: Gayatri reveals a truth about Aryavardhan and Rajnandini that leaves Anu shaken. Meera confronts Jhende for answers the next day. Meanwhile, Bholi helps Gopal and Pushpa dodge the gas delivery agent.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Backs Simran and Neel
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Gopal escape arrest for stealing gas cylinders, only to expose the scam and earn praise. Soon after, Aryavardhan boldly supports Simran and Neel’s marriage, despite Rajni’s firm opposition.

episodesList.title: Aryavardhan Exposes Rajni’s Past
episodesList.summary: Neel breaks down when Rajni refuses to accept his and Simran’s relationship. Later, Meera asks Jhende about Jalandhar, while Aryavardhan stops Neel and Simran from eloping and exposes Rajni’s past.

episodesList.title: Rajni Consents for Simran and Neel’s Wedding
episodesList.summary: Rajni apologises for hiding her past and agrees for Simran and Neel’s wedding. Aryavardhan promises to organise the wedding the next day, but his decision doesn’t go down well with Mansi.

episodesList.title: Jalandhar and Raghupati’s Plot Against Aryavardhan
episodesList.summary: Jalandhar and Raghupati plot to destroy Aryavardhan’s life. Unaware of the conspiracy, Anu and Aryavardhan engage in a fun challenge, while Meera reproaches Aryavardhan for organising Neel’s wedding.

soundtrack.composer: The show's title track is called "Tumm Se Tumm Tak". The lyrics are penned by Amit Deep Sharma, and the original composition is by Sunaad Gowtham. The track is primarily sung by vocalists Javed Ali and Palak Muchhal, with additional vocals by Nishant Pandey and Senjuti Das.

plotHtml:
Tumm Se Tumm Tak follows Anu Sharma, a 20-year-old middle-class girl from Chandni Chowk, Delhi, and Aryavardhan "Arya", a 46-year-old successful industrialist heading the Vardhan Group of Industries. Anu's father works at a local store that sells Rajnandini Sarees, a brand owned by Arya's company.
Their lives intersect, when Arya's bicycle breaks down on the way to the Annual Function of K.C. College, where he is the chief guest and Anu is invited to give a speech. Sharing an auto-rickshaw unknowingly, Anu is initially unaware of Arya's identity. Despite an awkward first meeting and a public mishap, during her speech, Arya is impressed, by Anu's sincerity and offers her a job at his company.
As their relationship develops, Anu is pushed toward an arranged marriage with Bipin, orchestrated by the manipulative Raghu, who seeks personal gain. Arya quietly works behind the scenes to stop the marriage, by uncovering Raghu's hidden motives and exposing him using a new company policy that, reveals Raghu's conflict of interest.
Anu and Arya navigate challenges posed, by their differing social backgrounds and the opposition they face from Arya's confidant Jhende and Arya's assistant, Meera.

title: The Hunt: The Rajiv Gandhi Assassination Case
wikiTitle: The Hunt: The Rajiv Gandhi Assassination Case
summary:
The Hunt: The Rajiv Gandhi Assassination Case is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language crime thriller web series streaming on SonyLIV. It is directed by Nagesh Kukunoor and produced by Applause Entertainment and
Kukunoor Movies .
It stars 	Amit Sial, Sahil Vaid, Bagavathi Perumal and  Girish Sharma and the was released on 4 July 2025.
It's based on the book "Ninety Days: The True Story of the Hunt for Rajiv Gandhi's Assassins" by Anirudhya Mitra.
plot: The show explores the events surrounding the assassination of former Indian Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi, who was killed on 21 May 1991 in a suicide bombing carried out by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) during an election rally in Tamil Nadu. The series follows the subsequent high-profile investigation led by a Special Investigation Team of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI). Through archival footage and firsthand interviews, the show delves into the planning of the attack, focusing on key figures like LTTE operative Sivarasan, while shedding light on the complex political dynamics between India and the LTTE. It provides a detailed and dramatic account of one of India's most significant and controversial assassination cases.
reception:
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "Amit Sial-Sahil Vaid show is a welcome addition to shows looking back at recent times, which attempt to pin-point historical and political flashpoints in India with archival documentary footage." Dhaval Roy of The Times of India also gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "The series proves that a gripping narrative doesn’t require non-stop action to deliver edge-of-the-seat thrills." Anurag Singh Bohra of India Today gave 4 stars out of 5 and commented that "The show is meant for all media professionals, academicians and those inquisitive about politically sensitive events. It also needs to be on the binge-watch list of individuals seeking the truth about India as concerned citizens."
Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in observed that "The overall feeling is of a job well done, despite the hiccups and the meddling. The motives behind the political double-dealing and Indian links to the storied separatist movement are left to other, more ambitious creators." Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost rated 3/5 stars and writes in his review that "It’s also fitting that Kukunoor and his writers Sriram Rajan and Rohit Banawlikar opt for a streaming format to tell this bone-chilling story of a dark chapter in Indian history. But they don’t treat the subject as a documentary. It unfolds like a whodunnit. We have been told how it happened." Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India praise the series and said that "It’s never easy to tell a story that doesn't have the luxury of twists and revelations. Most of us know how it ended, but The Hunt does a solid job of jogging through the timeline with the rigour of a seasoned journalist. The film-making replicates the no-nonsense spirit of its source material: more a true-crime procedural than a fiery op-ed. To understand what the show does right, it’s important to recognise the pitfalls it avoids."
Syes Firdaus Ashraf of rediff.com gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "You are hooked from the first episode." Lakshmi Subramanian of The Week rated 3.5/5 stars and said that "Almost 35 years after the death of former PM Rajiv Gandhi, the seven-episode SonyLiv series based on Anirudhya Mitra’s book and directed by Nagesh Kukunoor makes a gripping watch." Subhash K Jha of News 24 gave 4 stars out of 5 and commented that "The Hunt knows which side it is on, but gives us the room to decide where we want to be, not only while watching the series but in the larger picture." Shreyas Pande of Cinema Express rated 3.5/5 stars and said that "The Hunt is at once a textbook investigative thriller and a rarity. It embraces a style that is deeply humbling, returning to the bare necessities of storytelling, and adopts a gaze that is both revelatory and inquisitive."

episodesList.title: Where Do We Begin?
episodesList.summary: The Indian High Commission in Colombo receives a mysterious phone call, followed by the meticulous assembly of a suicide bomb. As the news of the tragic bombing at Sriperumbudur shakes the nation, Prime Minister Chandrashekhar appoints D.R. Kaarthikeyan to lead a multi-agency Special Investigation Team. Parallelly, forensic expert Prof. Chandrashekar uncovers vital clues, while a leaked press photo accelerates the case but compromises the investigation, leading to a chilling revelation.

episodesList.title: If You Prick Us, You Will Bleed Too
episodesList.summary: As the Special Investigation Team uncovers propaganda operations and hidden printing presses, they confirm Haribabu was a key operative. Meanwhile, surveillance intensifies on some suspects, who narrowly escape arrest. The team captures Koneshwaran, a low-level operative part of a nine-member team smuggled in from Jaffna. With mounting evidence and shocking confessions, the investigation uncovers how dangerously close a second assassination attempt came.

episodesList.title: In Moments Of Pain, You Seek Revenge
episodesList.summary: Sivarasan, a close aide of LTTE chief Prabhakaran, narrowly escapes the coast guard, confirming he is still in India. As the Special Investigation Team scrambles to find him, they face a flood of misleading tips. Surveillance intensifies, and Ravi Shankar is finally caught and interrogated, revealing key links to the assassination plot. Meanwhile, Sivarasan plots a daring second attack. With his team spreading out in disguise and scouting the location, the threat escalates.

episodesList.title: The Noose Tightens
episodesList.summary: As the investigation intensifies, interrogations reveal how Nalini and Murugan became central to the conspiracy, and the SIT orchestrates a nationwide manhunt for them. Meanwhile, Sivarasan, defying LTTE orders, attempts a failed bomb attack on the SIT headquarters. The SIT gains vital intel from Murugan, including safe house locations and operational details. As the net tightens, the investigators move closer to dismantling the LTTE network on Indian soil.

episodesList.title: He Must Go!
episodesList.summary: The SIT learns how Dhanu, Shubha, and Haribabu conducted dry runs to prove they could breach high-level security-setting the stage for Rajiv Gandhi's murder. Meanwhile, the SIT arrests key LTTE sympathizers who expose the elaborate smuggling and safehouse networks along the Tamil Nadu coast. However, when one of them, who is the key to finding the mastermind, escapes custody, it reignites a desperate chase.

episodesList.title: No One Is A True Friend
episodesList.summary: The SIT intensifies its hunt for Sivarasan, believing he may have fled Tamil Nadu. However, a lucky arrest in Coimbatore reveals that Sivarasan was smuggled into Bangalore in an oil tanker. As surveillance sweeps the city, a near-raid on one safe house in Indiranagar misses Sivarasan by mere metres, and a tragic misstep by local police in Biroota and Muthati results in the deaths of 17 LTTE operatives, prompting political backlash and urgent pressure on the SIT to capture Sivarasan alive.

episodesList.title: The Trail Ends?
episodesList.summary: The net tightens around Sivarasan as a local tip leads the police and SIT to his last known hideout in Konanakunte, Bangalore. Despite internal conflicts, media frenzy, and repeated delays, the NSG prepares for a final assault. Tension mounts as Sivarasan, hiding with Shubha, Nero, and others, grows paranoid and desperate. The SIT finally receives clearance to act, but will it be too late?

plotHtml: The show explores the events surrounding the assassination of former Indian Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi, who was killed on 21 May 1991 in a suicide bombing carried out by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) during an election rally in Tamil Nadu. The series follows the subsequent high-profile investigation led by a Special Investigation Team of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI). Through archival footage and firsthand interviews, the show delves into the planning of the attack, focusing on key figures like LTTE operative Sivarasan, while shedding light on the complex political dynamics between India and the LTTE. It provides a detailed and dramatic account of one of India's most significant and controversial assassination cases.

title: The Traitors
summary:
The Traitors (known as The Traitors India outside India) is an Indian reality competition series, streaming on Prime Video, based on the Dutch series De Verraders.
Hosted by filmmaker Karan Johar, the first season premiered on 12 June 2025. The series was renewed for a second season in June 2025. The second season premiered on 13 August 2026.
Following the premise of De Verraders, the show features a group of contestants participating in a game similar to Mafia or Werewolf, where an informed minority (known as the "Traitors") must eliminate an uninformed majority (known as the "Innocents") to win. Meanwhile, the "Innocents" are tasked to discover the "Traitors" and vote them out of the game in order to win. The series is filmed in and around Suryagarh Palace.

articleSections.title: Format
articleSections.text:
A group of contestants arrive at the palace in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan with hopes of winning a large cash prize of ₹1 crore that is built up through missions. The players are referred to as the "Innocents", but among them are the "Traitors" — a group of contestants secretly selected by the host. If the Innocents eliminate all the Traitors, they will share the prize fund. However, if any Traitors manage to make it to the end, eliminating the Innocents, they win the entire prize money.
The contestants participate in missions to build up their cash prize. In some missions, any contestant may also win a ‘shield’ that grants them immunity from the subsequent murder.
On most nights, The Traitors meet in a secret tower to decide on an Innocent contestant to ‘murder,’ who is then immediately eliminated from the game. The remaining Innocents are unaware of who has been eliminated until the following morning, when that person fails to appear at the breakfast table in the castle.
At the end of each day, the players gather at the ‘Circle of Shaq,’ where they discuss whom to vote out before individually casting their votes. Players vote privately, then reveal their choices one by one, often giving a brief rationale for their decision. The player who receives the most votes is banished from the game and reveals their affiliation. If during the game the number of ‘Traitors’ drops to two, they are given the choice to recruit an Innocent to join them instead of murdering.
After the final Circle of Shaq, the remaining players participate in the End Game. The group are given an opportunity to end the game by unanimous vote. Any vote to continue will lead to another immediate banishment vote. When a unanimous decision is reached to end the game — or when there are only two players left — the remaining players reveal their affiliation. If all remaining players are Innocents, then the prize money is divided evenly among them. However, if any Traitors remain, they win the entire prize money.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The first official teaser was posted on Prime Video's social media on 17 September 2024, announcing that filming had begun. Later on 30 May 2025, the official trailer of season 1 was released with the premiere date of 12 June 2025.
On 25 June 2026, the show was renewed for a second season. The first teaser was released on 27 July 2026, which revealed the premiere date of 13 August 2026, and the first two contestants joining the show, comedian Munawar Faruqui and actress Mallika Sherawat.

articleSections.title: Expansion
articleSections.text: The success of the first season of led to the development of a Telugu-language adaptation, The Traitors Telugu. The series was announced by Amazon Prime Video in March 2026 as part of its 2026 Indian programming slate. It is produced by SOL Productions and features actor Teja Sajja as the host. The series is scheduled to premiere on Amazon Prime Video in late 2026 and will feature 20 celebrity contestants.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text: A review in India Today praised the show’s glamorous setting and Karan Johar’s hosting style.

articleSections.title: International broadcast
articleSections.text:
In Australia, the series became available to stream on 10 Play in October 2025, as a companion to the Australian version broadcast by the network. The series was presented with English subtitles.
In the United Kingdom, the series began broadcasting on BBC Three and became available to stream on BBC iPlayer on 30 April 2026. It was broadcast by the BBC, which also airs the British version.

title: The Royals
summary:
The Royals is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language romantic comedy drama television series directed by Priyanka Ghose and Nupur Asthana and written by Neha Veena Sharma. Produced by Pritish Nandy Communications, the series stars an ensemble cast including Bhumi Pednekar, Ishaan Khatter, Zeenat Aman, Sakshi Tanwar, Nora Fatehi, Vihaan Samat, Dino Morea, and Milind Soman. The narrative follows a financially struggling royal family in modern-day India whose fortunes take an unexpected turn when the heir teams up with a hospitality entrepreneur to revive their ancestral palace as a luxury resort.
The series premiered on Netflix on May 9, 2025, and received mixed reviews from critics. While the performances of Khatter, Samat, and Tanwar, and its costumes and production design was widely praised, Pednekar's chemistry with Khatter was panned, the direction was considered underwhelming and the storyline drew criticism for lacking emotional depth. The series was renewed for a second season on May 28, 2025.
reception:
Sukanya Verma of Rediff.com rated the series 2 out of 5 stars. In her review, she criticized the show's emphasis on surface-level aesthetics, remarking that "everything is seen through the prism of sex and good looks." She argued that the narrative—centered on a financially strained royal family launching a hospitality venture—lacked narrative depth and relied excessively on visual appeal.
Shubhra Gupta from The Indian Express also awarded the series 2 out of 5 stars, describing it as "all show." She observed that the production "struggles for air under all that costumery," suggesting that elaborate visuals could not compensate for its lack of narrative substance. Gupta also found the central romantic arc underwhelming, stating that "all that coupling... doesn’t really get as steamy as it should have."
Abhimanyu Mathur of Hindustan Times offered a more favorable view, rating the series 3 out of 5 stars. He described it as a "fun rom-com" that balances frivolity with occasional emotional weight. Mathur praised the chemistry between the lead actors and drew comparisons to Bridgerton, writing that the series effectively combines Bollywood elements with a period-drama sensibility. While noting its imperfections, he concluded that it was a "much-needed clutter-breaker" in the Indian streaming landscape.
Pallavi Keswani of The Hindu was more critical of the series, stating that it "finds itself creatively lacking despite possessing a long list of talented names." She argued that the show failed to leverage its ensemble cast into compelling drama, citing an absence of innovation or originality in its storytelling.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The series was officially commissioned by Netflix, with Priyanka Ghose and Nupur Asthana attached to direct. Production was handled by Pritish Nandy Communications.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Bhumi Pednekar and Ishaan Khatter were cast in the lead roles. Sakshi Tanwar joined the ensemble following the departure of Mallika Sherawat, who exited the project due to creative differences.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: Principal photography began in February 2024 and concluded in May 2024. The series was filmed primarily on location in Jaipur and Mumbai.

plot:
Saraswathi, a dedicated primary school teacher in her early 50s, is respected in her professional life but faces neglect and emotional pain at home.
She has two daughters and a son, but only her youngest daughter, Veena, remains unmarried and close to her. Radha (the eldest daughter) and Mahesh (the son) treat Saraswathi as a caretaker, cook, and facilitator—using her for their benefit while giving her nothing in return.

title: The Waking of a Nation
summary:
The Waking of a Nation is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language historical drama web series streaming on SonyLIV based on the events leading to the Jallianwala Bagh massacre in 1919. It was directed by Ram Madhvani and produced by Amita Madhvani and Ram Madhvani, under banner of Ram Madhvani Films.
It starred Taaruk Raina, Sahil Mehta, Bhawsheel Singh Sahni and Nikita Dutta in main roles. The series was released on SonyLIV on 7 March 2025. Various critics rated the show with 2 to 3 stars out of 5.
plot:
On 13 April 1919, a British army officer, Brigadier-General Reginald Dyer, ordered his troops to shoot at a crowd of unarmed and peaceful Indians that had assembled at Jallianwala Bagh in Amritsar to protest against the Rowlatt Act. The firing lasted for roughly five minutes, during which 1,650 rounds were fired. The number of casualties is still debated, but the British Government later accepted that nearly 400 Indians had been killed in the shooting.
A textbook example of the tyranny of the British Raj, the Amritsar Massacre – later known as the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre – became a watershed moment in India’s freedom movement, galvanizing the entire nation to rise against its colonial master and setting India’s struggle for independence in motion.
The massacre at Jallianwala Bagh caused such public outrage that the British Government was compelled to set up the Disorders Inquiry Committee to investigate the incident. The findings of the inquiry divided the Commission along racial lines, with its British members refusing to view the massacre as a symptom of systemic racialism, while its Indian members insisted that race relations and white supremacy lay at the core of the violence. The Hunter Commission’s report singularly blamed Brigadier-General Dyer for the massacre, and as a consequence, the general was stripped of his rank and asked to resign.
But what led General Dyer to march into Jallianwala Bagh and execute such a heinous crime? What did the riots that had torn through Amritsar three days earlier on 10 April have to do with the massacre? What did this have to do with the arrest and deportation of Dr. Satyapal and Dr. Kitchlew, two prominent and well-respected Gandhian leaders in Amritsar? And what role did Punjab’s Lieutenant-Governor Michael O’Dwyer play all through this tragic episode?
Most importantly, was Brigadier-General Dyer singularly responsible for the massacre, or was he acting on specific orders?
Waking of a Nation: Jallianwala Bagh is a web series that explores the frictions and triggers behind the Jallianwala Bagh massacre through the eyes of Kantilal Sahni, a fictitious member of the Hunter Commission. Putting the events surrounding the massacre under a microscope, the series uncovers a deep conspiracy rooted in the colonial notion of white superiority. The show reimagines history based on the Hunter Commission’s inquiry, and deals with issues like racism, prejudice, whitewashing, half-truths and the redaction of history. Waking of a Nation: Jallianwala Bagh also looks at how India became India.

articleSections.title: Release and reception
articleSections.text:
The Waking of a Nation premiered on 7 March 2025, on OTT Platform SonyLIV.
Hardika Gupta of NDTV gave 2 stars out of 5 and said that "Unlike other portrayals of this historical event - such as Sardar Udham or Rang De Basanti - director Ram Madhvani does not dwell on the bloodshed itself." Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com gave 2.5 stars and writes that "Ram Madhvani's series is all over the place and also boring to watch". Rahul Desai The Hollywood Reporter India said that "Ram Madhvani period drama lacks the technical finesse to explore the Jallianwala Bagh massacre." Alaka Sahani of The Indian Express rated 2/5 stars and said "The Ram Madhvani-directed middling historical drama based on the events leading to Jallianwala Bagh massacre is too verbose and lacks dramatic tension". Nandini Ramnath of scroll.in said about the weries that "In its effort to slap viewers out of their perceived stupor, The Waking of a Nation does itself a huge disservice. The desired impact could have been achieved without jumbling the timeline or working overtime to prove a conspiracy that isn’t exactly one – history rather than hysteria."
Sana Farzeen of India Today gave 3 stars out of 5 and writes in her review that " For history buffs, the six-episode show is going to be a decent weekend watch. But if you’re expecting a stirring dose of patriotism or an emotionally gripping tale, you may walk away disappointed." Devesh Sharma of Filmfare rated 2.5/5 stars and said that "It takes us to the aftermath of the Jallianwala Bagh massacre but sluggish pace and inconsistent writing mar the impact". Aishwarya Vasudevan of OTT Play gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and observed that "The Waking of a Nation explores the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre through a courtroom drama but falters with repetitive flashbacks. Taaruk Raina shines, yet the series struggles to stay engaging." Abhinav Singh of Mashable India said "The Waking of a Nation is a show that’s skippable only because it spends more time pandering to emotions rather than hooking the viewers." Archika Khurana of The Times of India gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and writes that "The Waking of a Nation is an ambitious but inconsistent historical drama that struggles to balance its engaging premise with effective storytelling."

episodesList.title: Kaala Qanoon: A Dastardly Act
episodesList.summary: In April 1919, as protests against the Rowlatt Act sweep through Amritsar, Punjab’s British administration decides to exploit the people’s anger to its advantage. Childhood friends Kantilal, Hari, and Allahbaksh meet after years. In December 1919, Kantilal Sahni decides to lay the truth bare at the Hunter Commission despite a threat to his life.

episodesList.title: Danga: Anatomy of a Riot
episodesList.summary: Following the arrest of popular leaders Dr. Satyapal and Dr. Kitchlew, and a British firing on Indian protestors, Amritsar spirals out of control. Riots engulf the city and tear into the friendship between Kantilal and Allahbaksh, while innocent British civilians are placed at the mercy of the mob.

episodesList.title: Marham: A Healing
episodesList.summary: In April 1919, British officer Major Macdonald’s sensitive handling of the situation restores peace in Amritsar. His approach annoys Punjab’s administrators, who want to use force against the native population. In December 1919, Kantilal receives an unwelcome visitor with a subtle agenda, and he is made an offer that he might find hard to refuse.

episodesList.title: Qahar: The Massacre
episodesList.summary: Even as General Reginald Dyer threatens Amritsar with a promise of violence, a devious plan is hatched to draw the unsuspecting public to Jallianwala Bagh. The general leads his troops into the Bagh to unleash terror on the city’s innocent. As casualties mount, Kantilal and Allahbaksh set aside their differences to mourn the loss of a friend.

episodesList.title: Saazish: The Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: In April 1919, Amritsar reels under the effect of General Dyer’s brutal repression of civilian rights. In December 1919, a murder and a shocking revelation stir Kantilal’s conscience. At the inquiry, Kantilal finds holes in General Dyer’s testimony and proves that the general lied before the Commission.

episodesList.title: Shaatir Khiladi: The Ringmaster
episodesList.summary: As Kantilal draws a noose around General Dyer, the actual perpetrators of the massacre risk being exposed. But in a masterstroke, the tables are turned on Kantilal as a damning secret surfaces. Shamed and shunned by his own people, Kantilal resolves to fight back and unmask the mastermind.

title: The Roshans
summary:
The Roshans is a 2025 Indian Hindi-language documentary series that premiered on Netflix on 17 January 2025. The four-part biographical series examines the life, work, and legacy of the Roshan family, a multigenerational household that has been part of the Hindi film industry for over seven decades.
The series traces the artistic lineage from composer Roshan Lal Nagrath to his sons Rakesh Roshan and Rajesh Roshan, and to actor Hrithik Roshan, reflecting on how the family’s creative output helped shape mainstream Bollywood music and cinema.
plot:
The Roshans chronicles four generations of one of India's most recognizable film families. The narrative begins with Roshan Lal Nagrath, who rose to prominence as a composer in the 1950s and 1960s. It then explores the parallel careers of his sons—filmmaker Rakesh Roshan and composer Rajesh Roshan—before culminating in the global stardom of Hrithik Roshan.
The docu-series intertwines personal anecdotes with professional milestones, using extensive archival footage, rare home videos, and intimate family interviews. It presents the Roshan family as both public figures and private individuals grappling with fame, legacy, and loss. Themes of artistic pressure, reinvention, and intergenerational influence recur throughout the episodes, reflecting how the family navigated changes in the Indian film industry.

articleSections.title: Family background and legacy
articleSections.text: (second from left), Rakesh Roshan (centre), Eshaan Roshan (second from right), and Rajesh Roshan (extreme right) in 2001

articleSections.title: Roshan
articleSections.text: The docu-series opens with the life and career of the family patriarch, composer Roshan (Lal Nagrath), tracing his move to Bombay via Gujranwala, Lucknow and Delhi, and his marriage to singer Ira Nagrath (later Ira Roshan). It recounts his first big opportunity from filmmaker Kidar Sharma in Neki Aur Badi (1949) and uses archival audio to illustrate his process and impact on Hindi film music of the 1950s–60s. Critics note that the show positions Roshan’s oeuvre—frequently referenced through celebrated songs and interviews with peers—as the creative springboard for subsequent generations.

articleSections.title: Rakesh Roshan
articleSections.text:
Acting career The second strand focuses on Rakesh Roshan’s early years in front of the camera, acknowledging a prolonged period of struggle and near-misses. Rakesh recalls being replaced by Jeetendra in Basu Chatterjee’s Priyatama (1977), an incident he says was driven by distributor scepticism and co-star preferences; the episode is explicitly cited in the series and subsequent coverage. He accepted character and negative roles in order to remain visible, before eventually re-orienting his career.
Transition to Director The series then charts Rakesh’s pivot to filmmaking, marking commercial breakthroughs with Khudgarz (1987) and Karan Arjun (1995). Shah Rukh Khan, among other collaborators, weighs in on Rakesh’s directorial method and his partnership with brother Rajesh, recalling how he advised launching Hrithik owing to his screen presence. Coverage around the show also noted Rakesh indicating that an announcement on Krrish 4 would come “very soon.”

articleSections.title: Rajesh Roshan
articleSections.text: The programme’s third track examines Rajesh Roshan’s apprenticeship with the composer duo Laxmikant–Pyarelal and his emergence as a music director with films like Kunwara Baap (1974) and Julie (1975). It comments on his longevity across changing musical tastes while retaining a relatively low public profile, with family and colleagues reflecting on his creative temperament and collaborations with Rakesh on multiple soundtracks.

articleSections.title: Hrithik Roshan
articleSections.text: The final arc centres on Hrithik Roshan’s career, beginning with the unprecedented debut of Kaho Naa… Pyaar Hai (2000) and the mass hysteria that followed, juxtaposed against personal doubts and physical setbacks he discusses on camera.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The series was announced by Netflix in late 2024 as part of its slate of Indian original documentaries.
According to reports, the Roshan family provided filmmakers unprecedented access to personal archives, including photographs and home videos dating back several decades. Production sources suggested that the interviews were conducted over several months in 2024, with Hrithik Roshan initially expressing hesitation about sharing deeply personal experiences on camera before agreeing to participate.
The project was filmed primarily in Mumbai and includes footage from the family’s homes and film sets. It was edited to combine archival elements with contemporary reflections..

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: , Rajesh Roshan, Kanchan Roshan, Sunaina Roshan, Pinkie Roshan, Anu Ranjan, Hrithik Roshan and Shashi Ranjan in 2025 The Roshans was released globally on 17 January 2025 on Netflix. All four episodes were made available for streaming simultaneously. Promotional materials, including the trailer and key art, were unveiled in early January 2025. Netflix promoted the series as an "emotional exploration of one of India's most beloved film families."

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text:
Writing for Medium, Sucharita Tyagi described The Roshans as “a masterclass in storytelling about a famous family,” commending its emotional core and sincerity.
The Hindu characterized the documentary as “an expected trip down memory lane,” stating that while engaging, it offered “little new insight” into the family’s history. The Times of India echoed this view, calling it “engaging in parts” but ultimately a “glossy, polished tribute.” The Hollywood Reporter India commented that it was an example of “nonfiction behaving like fiction,” arguing that it prioritized image control over authentic exploration.

plotHtml:
The Roshans chronicles four generations of one of India's most recognizable film families. The narrative begins with Roshan Lal Nagrath, who rose to prominence as a composer in the 1950s and 1960s. It then explores the parallel careers of his sons—filmmaker Rakesh Roshan and composer Rajesh Roshan—before culminating in the global stardom of Hrithik Roshan.
The docu-series intertwines personal anecdotes with professional milestones, using extensive archival footage, rare home videos, and intimate family interviews. It presents the Roshan family as both public figures and private individuals grappling with fame, legacy, and loss. Themes of artistic pressure, reinvention, and intergenerational influence recur throughout the episodes, reflecting how the family navigated changes in the Indian film industry.

title: Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar
summary: Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar is a Hindi drama series that premiered on JioHotstar on 22 November 2024. The series stars newcomers Dhaval Thakur and Sanchita Basu. The story revolves around two young lovers from different backgrounds and societal standards, whose love story is marred by family feuds rooted in caste and class differences. The series is directed by Shraddha Pasi Jairath and produced by Bombay Show Studios. It emerged as the most-watched show of the year on JioHotstar.
plot:
Season 1
Set in Uttar Pradesh, the series explores the love story of Kuldeep, a young man from a poor background, and Shanvika, a girl from an influential and wealthy family. Their relationship is tested by societal expectations and deeply rooted issues of caste and class. As their romance develops, they face fierce opposition, particularly from Shanvika's powerful family, who are determined to keep them apart.
Season 2
reception:
Grace Cyril of Times Now rated the film 2 stars, stating, "While the storyline might have failed to impress us, the actors are the ones who save Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar from being a total dud."
Archika Khurana of Times of India also rated the series 2.0 stars, commenting, "In conclusion, Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar fails to live up to its potential. The predictable plot and underdeveloped themes hold it back, despite decent performances from the lead actors."
Amit Bhatia of ABP News criticized the series, saying, "The story is so stale that it becomes useless to talk about other things. Overall, this series is revenge on you, do not take it from anyone."

episodesList.title: Chauhano Ki Shaan
episodesList.summary: Shanvika, the arrogant daughter of the elite Chauhan family. Kuldeep, a poor but brilliant young man. A broken bicycle leads to a meaningful exchange between the two.

episodesList.title: Humse Dosti Karoge?
episodesList.summary: Nakul and his cronies try to snatch Kuldeep's new bicycle from him, leading to a fight. Shanvika interferes, and she poses a question to Kuldeep.

episodesList.title: Aapki Pehchan Hai Kya?
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep's disinterest in her proposal makes Shanvika angry. She vows to outscore him academically, setting the stage for competition.

episodesList.title: Namak Harami Mat Karna
episodesList.summary:
Shanvika misbehaves with Inspector Dushyant Singh when she declares

she'll rank first in her class. Her "hard work" bears fruit, and Kuldeep goes missing. Where did he go?

episodesList.title: Ishq Hua Hai!
episodesList.summary: Shanvika and Kuldeep's romance blossoms. However, one day, Pushkar and his men bust their blissful moment, leading to tension between the families.

episodesList.title: Galti Hamari Nahi Thi
episodesList.summary: Shanvika's declaration leads to Kuldeep's family being humiliated in public. They flee for life after Pushkar sets fire to their house, but Simmi's tragic step shatters them.

episodesList.title: Saaye Mai Dhoop
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep starts driving a rickshaw for a living. Prerna, a passenger preparing for the UPSC exams, inspires him to reflect on his dreams and look forward to a bright future.

episodesList.title: Namak Haram
episodesList.summary: Family pressures Shanvika into marrying Dushyant reluctantly. Kuldeep focuses on studies but faces devastation after a fateful call.

episodesList.title: Tu Hoga Kamyaab
episodesList.summary: Shanvika's rejection of Dushyant on their wedding night sparks turmoil. Kuldeep grapples with inner conflicts as Prerna guides him to harness his anger constructively.

episodesList.title: Chaman Mein Deedawar
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep's life hangs in the balance as he faces his UPSC final interview and his mother's coma. The UPSC results bring a shocking revelation, especially those in Sitaarpur.

episodesList.title: Mera Lakshya Kuch Aur Hai
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep's political return sparks chaos when he proposes building a bridge in a Chauhan area. Daddu proposes an easy way for him to do it.

episodesList.title: Astitwa ki Ladai
episodesList.summary: Under Kuldeep's orders, all boating operations are sealed, paving the way for the bridge project. During his and Mala's wedding, tensions escalate with the arrival of the Chauhans.

episodesList.title: Bhoot, Bhavishya, Vartaman
episodesList.summary: The Chauhans are infuriated seeing Dushyant guarding Kuldeep. Mala speaks to her new husband about their future. The Chauhan's face losses when their businesses are raided.

episodesList.title: Woh Badla Lene Hi Aaya Hai
episodesList.summary: Dushyant warns Shanvika of Kuldeep's desire for revenge but she refuses to engage. Fed up with Kuldeep's high handed behaviour, the Chauhans hire Gauri to kill him.

episodesList.title: Kuch Bachna Nahi Chahiye
episodesList.summary: Gauri, on the run from the police, is abducted by unknown men. He urgently contacts Angad to meet the Chauhans at their hideout. Meanwhile, Kuldeep raids the Chauhan's house

episodesList.title: Ghar Ka Malik Bhag Chala
episodesList.summary: The Chauhan brothers surrender, which creates a sensation. In prison, Manohar wonders about his past actions. Meanwhile, Kuldeep throws a party and invites Dushyant and Shanvika

episodesList.title: Ab Apna Rasta Badal Lo
episodesList.summary: Dushyant decides to resign, but Kuldeep refuses and makes an offer. Gendalal warns Kuldeep about Daddu, who has a different plan for Chauhan's son in law.

episodesList.title: Sab Kuch Khatam Ho Gaya
episodesList.summary: Daddu instructs SP Mishra to apprehend Pushkar, but he flees. Shanvika consoles a troubled Dushyant. Kuldeep meets his childhood friend Pintu, who advises him.

episodesList.title: Ab Humari Baari
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep finally learns why Shanvika lied about their relationship. Tragedy strikes yet again, and Shanvika has no choice but to pick up the pieces of her shattered life.

episodesList.title: Naye Dushman ya Naye Dost?
episodesList.summary: Shanvika performs her husband Dushyant's last rites as Sitaarpur watches. On her journey home, she is ambushed, forcing her into a gun fight. Who is her new enemy?

episodesList.title: Kunwar ki Ummid, Shanvika ki Chaal
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep spirals into guilt over Shanvika despite Mala and Daddu's efforts to help him. Tensions rise as a looming threat pushes Shanvika to make a strategic move.

episodesList.title: Bas Ek Mulakaat
episodesList.summary: Multiple attacks on Shanvika heighten tensions across Sitaarpur. As she prepares herself for the battles ahead, a shocking revelation shakes her trust.

episodesList.title: Kuldeep ka Prayashchit
episodesList.summary: Angad finds himself trapped in Shanvika's scheme, while Kuldeep's guilt drives him toward a risky move. As political conspiracies deepen, Shanvika finally agrees to meet Kuldeep.

episodesList.title: Pyaar ka Nostalgia
episodesList.summary: Shanvika confronts Kuldeep, gun in hand, yet her pain overpowers her anger. They exchange their losses, leading Kuldeep to agree to join her dangerous quest for justice.

episodesList.title: Pushkar ki Jaan ko Khatra hai
episodesList.summary: Chaos erupts as Pushkar faces danger in the hospital, but Shanvika intervenes to rescue him. Angad shoots a corrupt doctor unaware that he is under surveillance.

episodesList.title: Raajneeti par Pyaar Bhaari
episodesList.summary: Kunwar assures Shanvika of his support but grows furious over Pushkar's disappearance, suspecting Daddu. Shanvika and Kuldeep clash when she admits ordering Dr Vinay's murder.

episodesList.title: Shanvika ka Naya Rakshak
episodesList.summary: Shanvika is ambushed but saved by a masked shooter, leaving Daddu shaken. Suspicious, Daddu asks Singh to bring Mala home and keep a close watch on Kuldeep.

episodesList.title: Transfer yaa Saazish?
episodesList.summary: Obsessed with Kuldeep, Mala opposes Daddu's plan to kill him and pledges to ruin Shanvika. Subsequently, Daddu discloses Kuldeep's unexpected transfer order, shocking Kuldeep.

episodesList.title: Nani ki Seekh, Pyaar ki Jeet
episodesList.summary: Daddu celebrates his political move and plots Shanvika's death after Kuldeep's transfer. A powerful flashback inspires Kuldeep to move in a way that leaves Daddu stunned.

episodesList.title: Imaandari ka Sabut
episodesList.summary: Saadhu and Kundan commit a crime, triggering a chain reaction that shakes Sitaarpur. Shanvika quietly turns the fallout to her advantage by letting Kunwar take the credit.

episodesList.title: Varchasva ki Ladai!
episodesList.summary: Poornima's death sparks an all-out war as Daddu Prasad commands the annihilation of Kunwar's family. Amid the turmoil, Shanvika and Pushkar secretly scheme for their rise.

episodesList.title: Deewaron Ke Bhi Aakhein Hoti Hain
episodesList.summary: Prerna and Pushkar grow closer, unaware of the danger ahead. As panic spreads over the police murders, Daddu uses Angad to trap Shanvika, but Kuldeep foils the plan.

episodesList.title: Kaptaan Mara Gaya!
episodesList.summary: As Angad is hidden away for safety, Kuldeep manipulates Daddu's suspicions. Daddu then orders Saadhu and Kundan to kill Shanvika or pay with their lives.

episodesList.title: 2 Prime Suspects!
episodesList.summary: Public outrage over SP Mishra's murder prompts the Chief Minister to transfer the case to the Intelligence Agency. Shockingly, Shanvika and Kuldeep emerge as key suspects.

episodesList.title: Gheera!
episodesList.summary: Constable Divya's interrogation exposes SP Mishra's corruption. Suspicion grows around Kuldeep as Pradeep disappears, only to resurface under arrest for his covert role.

episodesList.title: Baazi Palat Gayi!
episodesList.summary: During Intelligence Agency’s probing, Angad reveals how Daddu Prasad planned murders to protect his power. Shanvika emerges as a formidable force in Sitaarpur’s political field.

episodesList.title: Alert!
episodesList.summary: The Intelligence Agency exposes Daddu Prasad’s political scheme and arrests him amid public outrage. While love and victory bring Kuldeep and Shanvika closer, Pintu is abducted.

episodesList.title: Uttaradhikari Mil Gaya!
episodesList.summary: As Pintu’s kidnapping haunts Kuldeep, Sitaarpur is sealed, criminals rounded up, and pressure mounts. While Daddu plots his comeback, Mala’s vengeance is finally exposed.

episodesList.title: Satta Ka Safar!
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep learns Pintu’s murder was meant to break him. He urges Shanvika to get into politics. She asserts control by striking a business deal. Kunwar assures her a minister’s post.

episodesList.title: Siyasi Zameen
episodesList.summary: Kunwar proposes Shanvika's candidature to the Chief Minister, shifting political equations. Meanwhile, Kuldeep mentors Shanvika, stirring old feelings and Mala's insecurity.

episodesList.title: Ticket Mil Gaya
episodesList.summary: Shanvika's political rise rattles Daddu and Kunwar. Celebrations begin at the Chauhan Mansion as Shanvika's ticket is announced, while masked men abduct Kuldeep's family.

episodesList.title: Maut ka Badla Maut!
episodesList.summary: Ranjan's death drives Chatki to seek revenge against Kunwar. Meanwhile, Daddu Prasad returns to politics after securing bail, raising the stakes for all.

episodesList.title: Shaam 5:00 Baje
episodesList.summary: A coded call helps Kuldeep escape captivity, exposing a conspiracy linked to Ramlal's camp. Shanvika's campaign sweeps the polls, defeating Daddu by a huge margin.

episodesList.title: Result!
episodesList.summary: Shanvika celebrates her political success, but Kuldeep loses his father, Gendalal, to a brutal murder. Seeking revenge, Kuldeep attacks Daddu and ends up in jail.

episodesList.title: Badalte Raste!
episodesList.summary: Mala confesses to her father of plotting Kuldeep's father’s murder. After Daddu Prasad’s statement, Kuldeep is reinstated as the DM. Shanvika assumes her new role as a minister.

episodesList.title: Samuhik Vivah!
episodesList.summary: Bansal runs a human trafficking racket under a mass marriage scheme. Kuldeep learns of Pushkar's release. Returning to Sitaarpur, Pushkar ruthlessly reclaims his control.

episodesList.title: Sangathan!
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep orders strict action against illegal arms after Pushkar's return. He asks Daddu and Rantej to unite with Bansal and Rathod. The battle for Sitaarpur grows deadly than ever.

episodesList.title: Aslaah
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep intensifies his crackdown on Pushkar by ordering strict legal action against illegal arms. At Bansal's office, Pushkar reviews the progress of their criminal network.

episodesList.title: Pyaar Nahi toh Dosti hi Sahi
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep is cleared by the court and is determined to take on the Chauhan family. As Pushkar and Prerna grow closer, Kuldeep and Mala choose to begin their bond as friends.

episodesList.title: Tender
episodesList.summary: A ₹1,000 crore tender fuels a political power struggle in Sitaarpur. Pushkar's unexpected marriage alters the dynamics amidst secret alliances and concealed conspiracies.

episodesList.title: Humein Chinta hai Tumhari
episodesList.summary: A cancelled government tender deepens the rift between Shanvika and Kuldeep. Pushkar stirs up a public spectacle, pushing Sitaarpur toward deeper political conflict.

episodesList.title: Samuhik Vivah ka Sach
episodesList.summary: A mass marriage scheme exposes a shocking trafficking racket. As Kuldeep closes in on the culprits, his investigation puts influential leaders and Shanvika in the spotlight.

episodesList.title: Sach ki Talaash aur Satta ki Jung
episodesList.summary: Set on uncovering the mass marriage scandal, Kuldeep gets attacked. Shanvika focuses on strengthening her public image. Kuldeep faces a tense confrontation with MLA Trilochan.

episodesList.title: Badla ya Usool!
episodesList.summary: Shanvika's political empire is at stake. Bansal and Rathore worry about getting exposed. Kuldeep begins the hunt for the truth and shakes the foundations of Sitaarpur's politics.

episodesList.title: Saboot Nikalo
episodesList.summary: Shanvika and her family worry about their political image after Kuldeep shows proof of the conspiracy. While Bansal and Rathore try to erase it, Kuldeep vows to expose the guilty.

episodesList.title: Mala aur Do Kaand!
episodesList.summary: Preeti uncovers a major secret involving Mala and Sadhu, but this puts her life in danger. While Daddu begins to suspect Kuldeep, Shanvika's enemies continue to plot against her.

episodesList.title: Mastermind!
episodesList.summary: Sitaarpur's mass wedding racket is exposed, implicating Home Minister Vishal Tikariya. As Mala is suspected of Pintu's and Kuldeep's dad's murders, Preeti's life is threatened.

episodesList.title: Personal Ambition
episodesList.summary: Prerna joins hands with Rantej to undermine Shanvika's political rise. As Pushkar suspects a traitor within, a hidden informant threatens to expose their conspiracy.

episodesList.title: Bohot Hua Natak!
episodesList.summary: Kuldeep refuses to frame Shanvika despite his hatred, choosing to fight her on his own terms. As he ends his fake marriage with Mala, Shanvika fears for his safety.

episodesList.title: Guest Room
episodesList.summary: Mala confronts Kuldeep, refusing to let go of him or their marriage. As her possessiveness grows, Kuldeep moves to the guest room while Preeti urges him to resolve the situation.

episodesList.title: Charitra Hanan
episodesList.summary: Rumours about Kuldeep and Shanvika threaten her reputation and family honour. Suspecting Daddu's involvement, she fights back while Kuldeep tries to evade Mala's traps.

episodesList.title: Confession
episodesList.summary: Sadhu's confession reveals Mala's role in Pintu's and Gendalal's murders. As power, revenge and betrayal collide, the evidence takes on a mysterious purpose.

episodesList.title: Divorce
episodesList.summary: Sitaarpur inaugurates its first cancer hospital as Mala signs the divorce papers. Kuldeep doubts her intentions, but a deadly confrontation changes everything.

episodesList.title: Naya Daavedaar
episodesList.summary: Tushar faces brutal interrogation over Sadhu's disappearance as Rantej suspects him of betrayal. Criminal Vishal Tikariya escapes and returns to Sitaarpur seeking revenge.

episodesList.summary: Kuldeep risks his life for Shanvika after Vishal Tikariya abducts her. Daddu Prasad decides to launch Mala into politics. Sadhu and Kundan’s secrets become increasingly dangerous.

episodesList.title: Faraar
episodesList.summary: Shanvika finally chooses to fight for her love and publicly announces her decision, creating a storm within her family. Daddu, Mala, and their allies begin plotting against them.

episodesList.title: Purane Pyaar ki Nayi Taseer!
episodesList.summary: Shattered by her family’s denial, Shanvika leaves her home and goes to Kuldeep. Pushkar warns Kuldeep. Shanvika and Kuldeep announce their engagement, triggering furious reactions.

episodesList.summary: Kuldeep and Shanvika head to the temple. As Pushkar is lured into a trap, Rantej's men cover the area. Pushkar gets shot and a desperate Shanvika urges Kuldeep to save her uncle.

episodesList.summary: After surviving the ambush, Pushkar urges Kuldeep and Shanvika to get married. Kuldeep visits his old home to seek blessings while Shanvika goes to her mother before the wedding.
