plotHtml:
Tantra is the story of a family who have fallen prey to the clutches of an evil incantation. The Khannas are an affluent family who move into their dream home Jalsa but become unfortunate victims of the gruesome practice of tantra. The antagonist is the House itself whose haunting effects make the place unliveable and a nightmare for its inhabitants. Niyati, the brave daughter of the Khanna family emerges as the one who can fight against the evil and protect her family from the witchcraft.
Jalsa is Prithvi Khanna's dream home and he gave the responsibility of constructing it to his heir, Nirvaan. It is shown that the house is alive under black magic and the only one who knows of this is the old lady who lives in the house in front of Jalsa. Saudamini, the tantric, gets the old lady to commit suicide under her tantra's influence as the old lady would have told Niyati the truth about the house. Niyati and her family move in to Jalsa and on their first night in the house, Niyati's brother Nirvaan is attacked by the tantra and almost killed, only to be saved by Niyati. Niyati notices that the wires which were choking Nirvaan were moving on their own leading to her suspicion that something is wrong. Her mother, Sumati, refuses to believe her and instead blames her for not paying attention to Nirvaan. Niyati and her childhood friend, Akshat, take it upon themselves to figure out who the mysterious lady they saw was. Later on at the Jasla's housewarming party, Kanchan is introduced as a member of the catering service. Kanchan recalls having seen Saudamini at the same party, so she tries testifying against Saudamini, but she and Akshat are abducted by Saudamini and saved in the nick of time by Niyati and inspector Bharat. The goons who kidnapped them mysteriously commit suicide without revealing who was giving them orders.
Niyati witnesses the house maid, Geeta, being dragged by supernatural forces into a wall. Terrified by the sight, Niyati tries to convince her parents about the mysterious occurrences in the house. On the other hand, Nirvaan is in love with a girl named Nisha, who is later revealed to be Saudamini's daughter. Saudamini casts a spell upon all the family members except Niyati which makes them believe that Nirvaan and Nisha are getting married in a couple of days. In a baffling plot twist, it is revealed that Kanchan is actually working with Saudamini and helping her in her evil plans and that Nisha, who is also in love with Nirvaan, is helpless and letting Saudamini pose as her mom because her real mom is being held captive. During a party at Jalsa, Nirvaan is put under a spell by Saudamini and Kanchan which causes him to misbehave with Nisha following which she reveals to Prithvi and the family that Nirvaan tried to harass her. While Prithvi questions Nirvaan's actions, Niyati supports her brother and lashes out at Nisha and Saudamini, accusing Nisha of falsely framing Nirvaan.
Nisha breaks up with Nirvaan on Saudamini's orders. Nirvaan, who is still under the spell, behaves violently, blames Niyati for the break-up and commits suicide under the spell's influence. Niyati, who was following Saudamini and Nisha to uncover their secret, loses track of them in a forest and comes across a priest who tells her that her house is controlled by evil forces. She rushes home to inform her parents only to find Nirvaan has committed suicide. Grief-stricken Niyati tries to convince the devastated family of the rituals going on in her house only to be rejected by inconsolable Sumati who blames Niyati and reveals to everyone that Niyati is Prithvi's illegitimate child. That same night, Saudamini gets Nisha killed so there is no evidence left to use against her. It is later revealed that Kanchan is Prithvi's niece. Prithvi had ousted his younger brother, Pratap, for betraying him. Afterwards, Pratap was homeless and couldn't even find a job. Due to his unfortunate conditions, he committed suicide and left his pregnant wife Sunaina as a widow. Saudamini is Sunaina's sister and she is seeking justice for her brother-in-law's death. Saudamini wanted to avenge her sister becoming a widow and Kanchan being fatherless by ruining the Khannas.
While everyone is away for Nirvaan's last rites in Haridwar, Niyati is attacked by the house and trapped inside. She is told by the Aghori that she will find the cure to the tantra in Tantra Nagri. Niyati manages to escape from Jalsa and finds a book that tells her where that village used to be. However, before she could find the cure, Niyati gets sent to the mental asylum after everyone is led to believe that she is mentally unstable. After Nirvaan's last rites, Saudamini revealed that she is the tantric that has done tantra on Jalsa. Niyati tries to expose her but Saudamini possesses Niyati with her tantric and gets her to admit that she killed Nirvaan and she is the one who is doing tantra. Seeing all this, Prithvi and Akshat are led to believe that Niyati is under a shock and needs medical treatment. But Niyati manages to escape from the asylum. On the other hand, inspector Bharat has figured out Kanchan's truth and tries to make her confess. He finds out Kanchan and Saudamini are related to one another and they are in cahoots to destroy the Khannas while. Before he can tell Prithvi anything, Kanchan pushes him off a cliff and calls Saudamini for help.
Niyati ends up hiding in Saudamini's trunk after escaping from the asylum and finds out that Kanchan is Saudamini's niece and confronts them. Saudamini and Kanchan reveal to Niyati that Prithvi isn't her real dad, and at the same time Prithvi ends up revealing to the entire family that Niyati isn't his illegitimate child, but his younger brother, Pratap's daughter. Niyati finds out that Kanchan is her twin sister. In the Khanna household, Pratap's real truth is exposed. Pratap had deceived his brother and stolen from him. Pratap was a selfish alcoholic man who only cared about money and not his family. Under the influence of alcohol, he harms Sumati and causes her to miscarry. It is also revealed that Pratap was the one who asked Saudamini to bind the Jalsa with tantra after he committed suicide there.
20 years ago, Niyati was born weaker than Kanchan, so she was shifted to a different hospital for intensive care. The hospital Sunaina and Kanchan were in caught fire but Saudamini saved her sister and niece. Prithvi was under the impression that Sunaina is dead, so he decides to adopt Niyati as he and Sumati had also lost their child. Prithvi tells Sumati that Niyati is his illegitimate child instead of Pratap's daughter because Sumati would not have accepted her baby's killer's child. After learning the truth, the Khanna family is split with people who refuse to accept Niyati (mama, mami, Kartik, Mansi and Sumati) and people who do (dadi, nani and Prithvi).
While Prithvi raised Niyati with love and support, Saudamini led Kanchan down the path of revenge, which Sunaina did not agree with. Once Kanchan is older, she joins an architecture company who is building Jalsa so she could get Saudamini to perform tantra on the house. After revealing everything, Saudamini and Kanchan try to instigate Niyati against the Khanna's, but Niyati refuses to join hands with them. Saudamini tries to kill Niyati so she won't be a hindrance to their plan, but inspector Bharat saves Niyati. However, he gets fatally shot by Saudamini. Kanchan ends up shooting Niyati twice and runs away with Saudamini when Akshat comes to her rescue. Unfortunately, Niyati falls off a cliff, into the lake below, and Akshat jumps after her to save her, but he is unable to find her. Niyati is rescued by a tantric instead and taken to a tantra temple.
Niyati chooses to support Prithvi and along with Akshat, who she later marries, they vow to stand up against the evil forces and protect them from the looming dangers of black magic. Kanchan also captures Akshat's soul in order to ruin Niyati's married life. But at the end, Niyati saves Akshat by releasing his soul from soul world. Kanchan also controls Khanna family against her by performing black magic on them with the help of an actress in the form of sage. But she fails and dies at the end. Niyati, Akshat and her family lives happily ever after.
tagline: Tantra is the story of a family who have fallen prey to the clutches of an evil incantation.

title: The Great Indian Dysfunctional Family
summary:
The Great Indian Dysfunctional Family is a 2018 Hindi web series created by Dipika Bajpai for video on demand platform ALTBalaji. The series stars Kay Kay Menon and Barun Sobtiband revolves around the relationships between the brothers and their families, heartbreaks and breakdowns.
The series is available for streaming on the ALT Balaji App and its associated websites since its release date.
plot: The series revolves around a Ranaut family and explores the estranged relationships between two brothers Samar Ranaut (Barun Sobti) and Vikram Ranaut (Kay Kay Menon). The story begins when Samar, Vikram's estranged brother returns home with his wife after having fled both from home and the army 8 years ago. After his return begins an unusual family reunion that escalates into a series of heartbreaks, betrayals, and emotional breakdowns, questioning the trust in every relationship.
reception: Nicole of The Quint writes "Beyond its contemporary packaging, TGIDF doesn’t reinvent the wheel. But it’s entertaining nonetheless much in a way that watching a mindless Bollywood flick is."

title: Top Singer
summary:
Top Singer is an Indian Malayalam-language reality television singing competition show broadcast on Flowers, created and directed by Sindhu Sreedhar. The show features 22 contestants, all under the age of 15. Esther Anil hosted the show for the first 49 episodes. After co-hosting the 50th episode with Meenakshi Anoop, Meenakshi took over as the sole host. Top Band is the orchestra of the show. It is currently the longest running Malayalam reality show.
The first season aired from 1 November 2018 to 1 September 2020.  
The second season of the show aired from September 2020 to September 9, 2022.
The third season aired from 4 October 2022 to 29 August 2023.
The fourth season aired from 13 September 2023 to 15 September 2024.
The fifth season aired from 24 September 2024 to 14 September 2025.
The sixth season aired from 22 September 2025 to on 26 August 2026.
The seventh season will launch soon.

title: Tujhse Hai Raabta
summary:
Tujhse Hai Raabta (transl. My Heart Knows) is an Indian Hindi-language television series that airs on Zee TV and is digitally available on ZEE5. It replaced Piyaa Albela. It premiered on 3 September 2018 and focuses on the unspoken connections and bonds between people. It stars Reem Shaikh, Sehban Azim, Poorva Gokhale, Arzaan Shaikh and Rajat Dahiya.
It was replaced by Bhagya Lakshmi in its timeslot.
plot:
Kalyani Deshmukh lives in Pune with her parents. Her mother Madhuri slips on the balcony and dies, and her father Atul is jailed and gives her custody to his caring ex-wife, Anupriya who is dominated by her family. Kalyani's cousin, Sampada loves Atharv but was forced to marry ACP Malhar Rane. She delivers a son, named Moksh and elopes with Atharv. Malhar marries and troubles Kalyani, believing she was behind Sampada and Atharv's elopement.
Kalyani raises Moksh. Atharv and Sampada live poorly. He marries the landlady, Mugdha, proclaiming she is mentally unstable and takes over her property. Atharv and Sampada try to create problems for Kalyani but fail. Anupriya's brother, Keshav takes revenge on her by kidnapping Moksh, but Malhar finds him. After learning his mother Kavita died due to an accident by Atul's father Sayajirao, Malhar is angry. Sayajirao kills himself. Atul returns from jail.
Malhar and Kalyani reacquire Moksh's custody from Sampada. Atharv turns mentally unstable due to an accident. He befriends a man, in fact Malhar's father, Madhav. Kalyani introduces him to Malhar. A dead body is found. Madhav's brother, Sarthak reveals he killed the man. Malhar's sister, Swara tells the man was Radheshyam, a transgender man whom she fell in love with and married him. Kalyani realizes Sarthak isn't responsible for Radheshyam's death.
Soon, it turns out Malhar's half-brother, Aahir killed Radhe Shyam. He kidnaps Moksh but is jailed after Malhar and Kalyani save Moksh. Her friend Rachit enters. In a taxi, Malhar realises the driver is Aahir and saves Kalyani. Aahir escapes. Kalyani meets Madhuri's twin sister Mamta, who lost her right hand and works for the Naxals who disguises herself as Madhuri, Kalyani's mom. Rachit reveals he loves Kalyani after their fake marriage and blackmails her to agree with him if she wants to save Moksh who is diagnosed with cancer and needs an urgent bone marrow transplant.
Rachit tries to molest and later kill Kalyani, but Malhar saves her. Kalyani gets pregnant through IVF to save Moksh with Sampada and Malhar's child. Atharv, disguised, kidnaps Atul's mother Ahilya and tries to kill the child. Kalyani faints. Malhar learns her health is deteriorating, and abortion is necessary.
Trilok is a donor match for Moksh's bone marrow. Trilok has a wife, Divya, who looks exactly like Kalyani whose photo Kalyani sees on visiting his house. He says his wife is dead and he wants Kalyani to accompany his daughter, Suhana if they want him to donate bone marrow for Moksh. Kalyani and Malhar fight a lot and try to settle their different opinions. After the operation Trilok kidnaps Moksh and blackmails Kalyani.
Kalyani sends Divya in the car which according to Trilok has Moksh. The car explodes, and she dies. Kalyani and Malhar realise Moksh was also in it and assume him dead. Kalyani blames Malhar who shoots her in agitation unable to hear her say Moksh is dead. Kalyani is presumed dead as she falls off the cliff.
reception: In April 2019, the series and the channel was sent notice by Election Commission for promoting the then Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government scheme of Mudra Loan which violated the code of conduct for which the channel replied, "As a responsible national television network, ZEE has always created content basis its stringent content guidelines. The mention of certain government schemes and initiatives in some of the episodes of the television shows was a creative call taken purely in the interest of the public."

articleSections.title: 5 years later
articleSections.text:
Malhar is now Sub-Inspector and lives in guilt for having lost Kalyani. Kalyani is now District Magistrate of the area. Swara is married to Vivek. Anupriya no longer considers Kalyani as her daughter. During her engagement to Minister Damini Deshpande's son, Vikram, Kalyani is caught in a fire, and Malhar saves her. Vikram rejects Kalyani after seeing her face. But Kalyani removes her bandages, thus revealing that she has only minor burns. But Kalyani refuses to marry Vikram due to his attitude.
On Avni's baby shower, it is revealed that Avni is not Malhar's wife. Ahir had left Avni when she became pregnant with his child. Madhav's dying wish was that Malhar would take care of Avni and her child in his name. Meanwhile, Kalyani finds out that Mukku is none other than Moksh. Moksh accidentally kills Ahir. Kalyani hides Moksh from Malhar, fearing that if Malhar finds Moksh, he will send him to the correction home. Meanwhile, Vivek accidentally burns Swara and is arrested.
To save Vivek from Sarthak's wrath, Anupriya tells him that Mukku is her and Sarthak's daughter. Avni tries to separate the family and turn them against each other fortunately Malhar discovers that Mukku is his son Moksh and is elated but Sarthak becomes depressed and the case of Ahir's death is opened and Malhar, Kalyani and Anupriya try to save Moksh but Malhar is shot by Avni and Anupriya is blamed and Moksh becomes mute as he is the witness to the incident of Malhar's death. Malhar returns and Moksh reveals that Anupriya is innocent and Avni had shot Malhar so Anupriya is proved innocent. Anupriya and Sarthak reunite with their lost daughter, Gungun and get remarried. Finally, Malhar, Kalyani, Moksh, Anupriya, Sarthak, AauSaheeb, Godavari, and kalyani’s unborn baby reunite to live happily.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The production and airing of the show was halted indefinitely in late March 2020 due to the COVID-19 outbreak in India. Because of the outbreak, the filming of television series and films was halted on 19 March 2020 and expected to resume on 1 April 2020 but could not and the series was last broadcast on 24 March 2020 when the remaining episodes were aired. The filming resumed on 28 June 2020 and with airing to resume on 13 July 2020.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: In April 2019, the series and the channel was sent notice by Election Commission for promoting the then Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government scheme of Mudra Loan which violated the code of conduct for which the channel replied, "As a responsible national television network, ZEE has always created content basis its stringent content guidelines. The mention of certain government schemes and initiatives in some of the episodes of the television shows was a creative call taken purely in the interest of the public."

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: Kalyani decides to get her parents, Madhuri and Atul, remarried on their 18th wedding anniversary. She surprises them by showing her tattoo of their names, and explains that the pain of getting the tattoo done was nowhere close to the pains they took for her upbringing. To make the day more special, she tricks an old lady into buying her champagne as she is underaged. Later, she catches a man trying to run away with the temple’s jewellery. After reaching home, she gets the shock of her life.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Madhuri hangs from the balcony while Atul tries to save her. Madhuri falls from the balcony and is rushed to the hospital. Coincidentally, Atharv is brought to the same hospital. Kalyani requests Atharv to take his curse back. The nurse informs Atul that Madhuri's health is deteriorating. When Kalyani asks Madhuri who was responsible for the accident, she takes Anupriya's name and breathes her last. The police take Atul in custody in spite of Kalyani vouching for his innocence.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Ahilya reaches the hospital to meet Atharv and finds out that Kalyani had filed a complaint against him for theft. Later, at the police station, when Kalyani pleads for Atul's innocence, the inspector informs her that Madhuri had filed a complaint against him for abuse. The inspector interrogates Atul about the accident. When Kalyani checks Atul's phone, she sees a message from Madhuri about Anupriya. The hospital authority denies giving Kalyani the custody of her mother's body.

plotHtml:
Kalyani Deshmukh lives in Pune with her parents. Her mother Madhuri slips on the balcony and dies, and her father Atul is jailed and gives her custody to his caring ex-wife, Anupriya who is dominated by her family. Kalyani's cousin, Sampada loves Atharv but was forced to marry ACP Malhar Rane. She delivers a son, named Moksh and elopes with Atharv. Malhar marries and troubles Kalyani, believing she was behind Sampada and Atharv's elopement.
Kalyani raises Moksh. Atharv and Sampada live poorly. He marries the landlady, Mugdha, proclaiming she is mentally unstable and takes over her property. Atharv and Sampada try to create problems for Kalyani but fail. Anupriya's brother, Keshav takes revenge on her by kidnapping Moksh, but Malhar finds him. After learning his mother Kavita died due to an accident by Atul's father Sayajirao, Malhar is angry. Sayajirao kills himself. Atul returns from jail.
Malhar and Kalyani reacquire Moksh's custody from Sampada. Atharv turns mentally unstable due to an accident. He befriends a man, in fact Malhar's father, Madhav. Kalyani introduces him to Malhar. A dead body is found. Madhav's brother, Sarthak reveals he killed the man. Malhar's sister, Swara tells the man was Radheshyam, a transgender man whom she fell in love with and married him. Kalyani realizes Sarthak isn't responsible for Radheshyam's death.
Soon, it turns out Malhar's half-brother, Aahir killed Radhe Shyam. He kidnaps Moksh but is jailed after Malhar and Kalyani save Moksh. Her friend Rachit enters. In a taxi, Malhar realises the driver is Aahir and saves Kalyani. Aahir escapes. Kalyani meets Madhuri's twin sister Mamta, who lost her right hand and works for the Naxals who disguises herself as Madhuri, Kalyani's mom. Rachit reveals he loves Kalyani after their fake marriage and blackmails her to agree with him if she wants to save Moksh who is diagnosed with cancer and needs an urgent bone marrow transplant.
Rachit tries to molest and later kill Kalyani, but Malhar saves her. Kalyani gets pregnant through IVF to save Moksh with Sampada and Malhar's child. Atharv, disguised, kidnaps Atul's mother Ahilya and tries to kill the child. Kalyani faints. Malhar learns her health is deteriorating, and abortion is necessary.
Trilok is a donor match for Moksh's bone marrow. Trilok has a wife, Divya, who looks exactly like Kalyani whose photo Kalyani sees on visiting his house. He says his wife is dead and he wants Kalyani to accompany his daughter, Suhana if they want him to donate bone marrow for Moksh. Kalyani and Malhar fight a lot and try to settle their different opinions. After the operation Trilok kidnaps Moksh and blackmails Kalyani.
Kalyani sends Divya in the car which according to Trilok has Moksh. The car explodes, and she dies. Kalyani and Malhar realise Moksh was also in it and assume him dead. Kalyani blames Malhar who shoots her in agitation unable to hear her say Moksh is dead. Kalyani is presumed dead as she falls off the cliff.
tagline: Kalyani Deshmukh lives in Pune with her parents.

title: Tula Pahate Re
summary: Tula Pahate Re (transl. I Look At You) is an Indian Marathi language television series which aired on Zee Marathi. It is directed by Girish Mohite and Chandrakant Gaikwad and produced by Aparna Ketkar and Atul Ketkar under the banner of Right Click Media Solutions. It starred Subodh Bhave and Gayatri Datar in lead roles. It premiered from 13 August 2018 by replacing Tuza Maza Breakup.
plot:
Isha Nimkar is a sober middle-class girl living in a chawl with her parents. One day, she has to deliver a speech at the "K.T. College" honouring the chief guest Vikrant Saranjame, a wealthy industrialist of the "Saranjame Group of Industries" who lives with his widowed mother Snehalata a.k.a. Aaisaheb, younger brother Jaydeep and arrogant sister-in-law Soniya in a large mansion in Karjat, Maharashtra. Due to his fame and greatness, Vikrant has become a dear public figure surrounded by many people, including his close friend Vilas Zende, who is also his personal assistant.
Also, Isha's father Arun Nimkar works in one of the shops of "Rajnandini Sarees", the department of sarees, which is owned by Vikrant. On his way to the college, Vikrant's bicycle breaks down and thus he shares an auto-rickshaw with Isha when he meets her for the first time. Isha does not recognize Vikrant in the auto-rickshaw and speaks rudely to him for having money to pay, although she pays the fare of him too. Later at the college, Isha is shocked to see Vikrant entering as the chief guest and bursts into tears. Due to this commotion, she forgets her speech that lists many accomplishments of Vikrant, which leads to all her college friends teasing her.
However, Vikrant defends Isha by advising her and her college friends to always have trust in themselves and each other in any situation, and also gains Isha's trust by handing her over a blank cheque. Despite this, Isha and Mr. Nimkar modestly decide to return the blank cheque to Vikrant against the wishes of Isha's mother Pushpa. The next day, Isha takes the envelope containing Vikrant's cheque to his office and hands it over to his secretary Myra Karkhanis. However, Myra is shocked to discover that the envelope is empty and humiliates Isha for being after a rich personality under some pretext.
Meanwhile, Vikrant reaches Isha's house to return her money from the auto-rickshaw fare, but Pushpa misunderstands him for the fridge repairer and tries to make him repair the fridge. Later, Isha meets Mr. Nimkar and they learn that Pushpa has gone to deposit Vikrant's cheque in the bank. Just as Pushpa is about to fill in the amount on the cheque, Isha and Mr. Nimkar intervene and refuse to let her do so. Pushpa then apologises to Vikrant after learning about his true identity from Isha. Also, Isha and Mr. Nimkar return the cheque to Vikrant and request him to keep it.
Further, Vikrant falls in love with Isha and offers her a job in his company. As time passes, Isha begins to develop feelings for Vikrant too, while Myra and Zende try to separate the lovebirds due to the fact that she also loves Vikrant. However, Myra and Zende's each plan backfires and Vikrant invites Isha to his mansion. While there, he reveals her the truth about his deceased wife named "Rajnandini", whom he loved a lot and whose sudden demise had left him much disturbed. Therefore, he named the department of "Rajnandini Sarees" in the memory of his late wife.
Upon learning this, Isha despises Vikrant for hiding this from her and storms off, but it turns out to be just a prank. Actually, Isha has forgiven Vikrant for respecting her while telling her all this. Later, Vikrant takes Isha for a helicopter ride and proposes marriage to her mid-air. Speechless on seeing his unique way of proposing marriage, Isha agrees to marry Vikrant but the couple faces opposition from Mr. Nimkar due to their age difference, although Pushpa agrees for their relationship. With support from Zende, Aaisaheb and Pushpa, Vikrant and Isha eventually manage to convince Mr. Nimkar and have a grand marriage ceremony under Myra and Zende's organisation.
After their marriage, things unexpectedly start changing when the audience sees a dark side of Vikrant and Zende. It is suddenly revealed that Vikrant's late father Dadasaheb has stated in his will that he can never inherit the Saranjame property and that Rajnandini is the real owner of it. Therefore, Vikrant married Isha to use her as a pawn to obtain the Saranjame property. Following his plan, Vikrant tries to pretend that Isha is "reincarnation" of Rajnandini, so that Aaisaheb and Jaydeep (who are the current owners of the Saranjame property) can easily transfer the Saranjame property to Isha.
After a couple of months, Isha discovers an ongoing fraud in the Saranjame company and the name of the fraudster is revealed to be "Gajendra Patil". Upon learning this, Vikrant and Zende mysteriously make an actor take the blame of being the fraudster and have him arrested by the police. However, Isha goes on to visit the election commission office to enrol Vikrant's name in the voting list, where she is stunned to see the name "Gajendra Patil" with Vikrant's photograph. At the same time, she shockingly learns from Jaydeep and Soniya that Rajnandini was actually Aaisaheb's stepdaughter and Jaydeep's stepsister, and that Vikrant was the son-in-law of Dadasaheb who made him change his last name to Saranjame.
Also, Jalindar Mane, an archenemy of Vikrant, confesses about his true identity and colours to Isha soon after he is released from prison. Having become sure of Vikrant's deception, a devastated Isha meets the Jogtin, a woman asking for alms, and wishes to find the purpose of her life from the Goddess Ambabai. At this point, the beautiful face of a mysterious woman is reflected back upon Isha from the divine plate of water. Eventually, a confused and heartbroken Isha confronts Vikrant over his true identity and Rajnandini's relationship with Aaisaheb and Jaydeep. However, Vikrant regains Isha's trust by narrating her a fake story of the past involving him and Rajnandini.
Further, Vikrant takes Isha to a private room of him in the Saranjame mansion, where all of Rajnandini's belongings are kept safely by him as souvenirs along with Dadasaheb's photograph. He goes on to uncover the large photograph of Rajnandini in the room before Isha. Isha is horrified to recognize Rajnandini as the mysterious woman whose beautiful face was reflected upon her from the divine plate of water. Due to the shock, Isha falls unconscious in the room itself and all of Rajnandini's life events miraculously flash past her eyes in her unconsciousness.
A flashback shows that the middle-aged Rajnandini lived happily in the mansion with Aaisaheb, a young Jaydeep and Dadasaheb. One day, her car breaks down on her way to an important meeting with Jalindar at his office. Thus, Rajnandini shares an auto-rickshaw with Gajendra Patil (Vikrant), an orphan who lives in a chawl with his childhood friend Zende. Gajendra is educated but unemployed while Zende is a street-smart boy who can easily fool people. Gajendra is revealed to be going to the same destination for an interview with Jalindar and falls in love with Rajnandini due to her richness.
After the two reach their destination, Gajendra intervenes during Rajnandini and Jalindar's meeting and gives his interview to Jalindar before Rajnandini. An unimpressed Jalindar initially rejects Gajendra due to his low percentage of marks. However, Gajendra is ultimately selected in Jalindar's company on the recommendation of Rajnandini, who was impressed with his attitude during the interview. As time passes, Rajnandini falls in love with Gajendra too and he eventually proposes marriage to her.
Despite Dadasaheb's hesitance to approval, Rajnandini marries Gajendra in a temple and rechristens him as "Vikrant" after the name of the male protagonist in the book titled Tula Pahate Re that Aaisaheb had gifted to her on her birthday. Rajnandini even recruits "Vikrant" as the heir to the Saranjame company, much to everyone's puzzlement. However, Jalindar hands over all the evidences against Vikrant and Zende to Dadasaheb, who disowns Vikrant through an intense insult in private and secretly changes his will. An offended Vikrant immediately retaliates by arranging Dadasaheb to be killed in the consumption of wrong medicine.
Further, Vikrant also changes Dadasaheb's postmortem reports and secretly holds Aaisaheb responsible for his sudden demise. Meanwhile, Jalindar tries to tell Rajnandini the truth by meeting her in private but she refuses to believe him. Now, Vikrant has Zende kill Jalindar's own employee named Shivpurkar and frames Jalindar for the murder, causing Jalindar to be arrested by the police. Also, Vikrant and Zende prohibit the late Dadasaheb's photograph from the office. However, things change when Rajnandini visits the office and learns about Vikrant's new rule about Dadasaheb's photograph.
On this development, Rajnandini goes to meet Jalindar in prison where he confesses about Vikrant's true colours to her. Moreover, Rajnandini has a microphone fixed in Vikrant's office cabin to expose his truth. As a result, all the conspiracies of Vikrant and Zende are recorded in the microphone. Upon receiving this proof, Rajnandini regrets her blind faith in Vikrant before meeting him in private on the mansion terrace, where she threatens to hand over all the evidences against him to the police. However, a miserable Vikrant mercilessly forced Rajnandini off the terrace to her unfortunate end on the fateful night.
The story catches up to the present where a horrified Isha wakes up to have a gut feeling that she is indeed the "reincarnation" of Rajnandini who has descended back to the Earth to seek revenge from Vikrant. The next day, while wandering aimlessly, Isha ends up at her maternal home where she does not hesitate to inform her parents about this development. Mr. Nimkar believes her to have some sort of mental illness and consults her a psychiatrist. However, Isha stands firm by citing her undying commitment to the purpose of her life.
That evening, Isha returns to the Saranjame mansion where she hallucinates the image of Rajnandini, who confides in Isha that she is her reincarnation. On this ground, Isha vows to punish Vikrant and Zende for the injustice they have served to the society. Isha goes on to confess about her true identity with Vikrant and Zende's conspiracies to Jaydeep and Aaisaheb, who both fall into an emotional trap and instantly accept her as Rajnandini. The three plan to avenge both Dadasaheb and Rajnandini's deaths along with Jalindar and Myra by making Vikrant and Zende realise their mistakes.
As part of her mission, Isha cleverly creates a rift between Vikrant and Zende due to the fact that Zende has grown suspicious of her true identity and tries to inform Vikrant about it multiple times. However, Vikrant refuses to believe Zende despite his numerous attempts to convince him. Eventually, Zende conspires to have Isha killed by his henchmen, but Vikrant intervenes and has himself accidentally shot in his arm by one of Zende's henchmen. In these circumstances, Isha considers calling off the mission due to the fact that she is also pregnant with Vikrant's child. Meanwhile, Zende has his henchmen abduct an unconscious Vikrant from the Saranjame mansion and bring him to his own house to settle the issue.
While there, Vikrant regains consciousness and Zende desperately tries to explain him the situation once again but in vain. In a last attempt to take Vikrant into confidence, Zende summons Jalindar to his house where he confronts Jalindar before Vikrant over being the accomplice of Isha in her conspiracy to seek revenge from them both. However, Jalindar silently commits suicide by consuming poison and confesses to Vikrant that Isha loves him a lot before he dies. At last, a furious Vikrant believes that Zende has betrayed him and their friendship and returns home after he shockingly shoots down Zende fatally with his gun.
Despite this, Vikrant eventually discovers the truth with the help of the confession about Isha being the reincarnation of Rajnandini that Mr. Nimkar had unconsciously made to him during a private conversation between them in the office. A regretful Vikrant laments his mistake of killing his true friend Zende and vows to teach a lesson to all the avengers who are plotting against him. In the meantime, Isha realises that Vikrant can blow her cover on benefit of doubt and decides to fight back with a strong heart, much to Aaisaheb and Jaydeep's gratitude.
The next morning, Isha appears before Vikrant in Rajnandini's clothes and recounts all her life events. She demands an explanation from Vikrant on why he served this injustice to the innocent Rajnandini when she had given him all that he wanted. Seeing no other way out, a brainwashed Vikrant finally admits before Isha, her parents, Aaisaheb, Jaydeep, Soniya and Myra that he did all this only to get rid of the sufferings from poverty which had caused his mother's desert. However, he carelessly taunts everyone that they cannot convict him for his crimes for not having any evidence for doing so.
Later that night, Vikrant contacts Isha and mysteriously asks her to come to the terrace. As Isha heads off, Aaisaheb is tremendously worried that Vikrant might do the same thing with Isha that he did with Rajnandini. On the terrace, Vikrant asks Isha what love means to her, to which, Isha replies that she understood the meaning of love only from him. At the same time, Vikrant also confesses that he still truly loves her despite the fact that she betrayed him and went against him, and that he killed his close friend Zende only out of his immortal love for her.
Despite this, the series has a shocking and tragic climax when out of a sudden, Vikrant unexpectedly jumps off the terrace and meets his death as he is unable to deal with his guilt, causing a lot of devastation to Isha. In the end, Isha bids farewell to Aaisaheb, Jaydeep and Soniya and leaves the Saranjame mansion with her parents for wanting to live her true-self, "Isha Nimkar", stating that the soul of Rajnandini has finally attained peace due to the death of her killer, Vikrant. The series ends with Isha and her parents having started a catering business from their chawl few months later.

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: Isha Practises The Speech Which She Needs To Deliver In Her College. Isha Sees Nimkar Getting Reprimanded By His Boss And Feels Dejected. Myra Rebukes Zende For Giving His Views.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Vikrant's Employees Get Surprised As He Reaches The Office By Helicopter And Then Rides A Cycle To Reach College For An Event. He Shares An Auto With Isha As His Cycle Breaks Down.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Isha Gets Petrified After Seeing Vikrant As The Chief Guest. The Students Mock Her As She Starts Crying. However, Vikrant Defends Her And Offers A Blank Cheque As A Sign Of Trust.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: Pushpa Gets Furious At Nimkar For Refusing To Encash The Cheque And Humiliates Him. Isha Takes The Cheque To Return It To Vikrant. Later, Myra Insists Isha Give The Cheque To Her.

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: Myra Humiliates Isha After Finding An Envelope Empty. Rupali Identifies Vikrant But Doesn't Disclose His Identity To Pushpa At His Request. Isha Tells Nimkar Of The Missing Cheque.

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: Isha And Nimkar Stop Pushpa From Filling In The Details On The Cheque. Pushpa Says Sorry To Vikrant After Knowing His Identity. Later, Vikrant Invites The Nimkars To His Party.

episodesList.title: Episode 7
episodesList.summary: Pushpa Boasts To Her Neighbours About Going To A Party. Vikrant Tells Isha That He Got Influenced By Her Money-saving Attitude. The Investors Later Get Shocked By His Announcement.

episodesList.title: Episode 8
episodesList.summary: While Isha Shares Her Ambitions With Vikrant, Nimkar Drapes A Saree In A Drunken State. A Furious Vikrant Rebukes Myra And Holds Her Responsible For The Nimkars' Humiliation.

episodesList.title: Episode 9
episodesList.summary: Myra Seeks Vikrant's Forgiveness Over The Party Incident. Nimkar Helps Isha To Arrange Money For A Party. Later, Myra And Zende Get Shocked To See Isha Taking Vikrant Out With Her.

episodesList.title: Episode 10
episodesList.summary: Vikrant Gets Mesmerised By Isha's Patience, Simplicity And Honesty. Pushpa Gets Worried Over Isha's Whereabouts. Myra And Zende Later Get Disappointed Over Vikrant's Conduct.

episodesList.title: Episode 11
episodesList.summary: Zende Informs Vikrant Of Their Company's Profit. Tillu Criticises Isha And Blames Her For Being Spotted With Vikrant. Shortly, Vikrant Comes And Gives A Befitting Reply To Tillu.

episodesList.title: Episode 12
episodesList.summary: Tillu Informs The Nimkars That Bipin Will Only Marry Isha. Myra Believes That She Has Been Fired, But Vikrant Gives Her A Surprise. Isha's Parents Suggest To Her To Work Smartly.

episodesList.title: Episode 13
episodesList.summary: Myra Gets Shocked As Zende Informs Her That Isha Has Got A Job In The Organisation. Vikrant Shows Isha Her Desk. The Employees Panic Due To Isha's Mistake, And She Gets Tensed.

episodesList.title: Episode 14
episodesList.summary: Myra Introduces Isha To Her Colleagues In A Way To Humiliate Her. Vikrant Gets Impressed By Isha's Approach To A Problem. Later, He Orders Zende To Give A Joining Bonus To Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 15
episodesList.summary: Vikrant Scolds Isha For Keeping Flowers At The Wrong Place. Isha Forgets The Place They Were Supposed To Go For An Industrial Visit. Vikrant Tries To Analyse The Workers' Problems.

episodesList.title: Episode 16
episodesList.summary: Vikrant Reprimands The Managers For Behaving Ruthlessly With The Workers. He Apologises To Isha For Speaking Rudely. He Later Questions Myra For Taking Some Wrong Decisions.

episodesList.title: Episode 17
episodesList.summary: Bipin Tells Vikrant That He Is Going To Marry Isha. Vikrant Asks Zende To Investigate The Tillus. Isha Finds Vikrant's Behaviour Strange. Myra Asks Isha About Her Marital Status.

episodesList.title: Episode 18
episodesList.summary: Myra Feels Jealous After Seeing Vikrant And Isha Eating Food Together. She Tells Zende That Isha Has Become Vikrant's Secretary. A Businessman Wants To Sell His Property To Jaydip.

episodesList.title: Episode 19
episodesList.summary: Jaydeep is eager to share the news of Gateway of India with Vikrant. When Jaydeep arrives at Vikrant’s office, Isha stops him from meeting Vikrant as he is in a conference. An offended Jaydeep fires Isha immediately. When Jaydeep informs everyone about the deal, Vikrant realises that it’s a blunder and tries to rectify it. A heartbroken Isha doesn’t share the news of her being fired at home. Rupali suggests Isha look for another job, but the fact that she can’t see Vikrant anymore hurts Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 20
episodesList.summary: Nimkar’s boss taunts him when he expresses his desire of buying an expensive saree for Isha one day. Vikrant calls Isha’s parents to learn about Isha’s whereabouts. An upset Isha goes to the temple and questions god whether Vikrant feels the same for her. Just then, Vikrant comes to meet Isha at the temple and asks her to rejoin his company the next day since he trusts her. An elated Isha gets sweets for her parents and shares her happiness with Rupali.

episodesList.title: Episode 21
episodesList.summary: Isha and her mother argue over Isha wearing an expensive dress to office. At office, Mayra is furious for seeing Isha again. Vikrant gives Isha an opportunity to apologise to Jaydeep. A fuming Jaydeep gives only six minutes to Isha to express herself. Isha explains her innocence by drawing reference to Lord Ganesh’s birth story and apologises to Jaydeep. Eventually, Jaydeep forgives Isha. Later, a grateful Isha asks Vikrant to write something in her slam book.

episodesList.title: Episode 22
episodesList.summary: Aware that Vikrant is watching her, Isha pretends she cannot find a rickshaw. Her plan works, and Vikrant offers to drop her home. Isha is delighted and daydreams about Vikrant throughout the drive. Nimkar’s boss arrives home and threatens to sell off the shop if Nimkar does not repay the loan. Nimkar and Pushpa are dumbstruck. Later, their neighbour comes to talk about his son’s and Isha’s wedding. He offers them financial help, but Nimkar refuses. Later, Isha reaches home and praises Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Episode 23
episodesList.summary: While Isha shares her feelings for Vikrant with Rupali, Vikrant answers all the questions in Isha’s slam book. Rupali cautions Isha about Vikrant being a middle-aged man and asks her to confirm his marital status. However, Isha feels love doesn’t have any age. After Nimkar and Isha leave for work, Pushpa tells Ranjana her wish to get Isha married to Bipin and plans to convince Nimkar and Isha for the same. Later, Pushpa arrives at Vikrant’s office to invite him for dinner at their place.

episodesList.title: Episode 24
episodesList.summary: Pushpa invites Vikrant and Zhende for dinner at her home. Maira gets furious after learning about it and expresses her anger at Zhende, who assures her that her dinner with Vikrant will not be cancelled. Zhende tries to convince Vikrant to go with Maira. Pushpa, Nimkar, and Isha make preparations for the impending dinner. Meanwhile, a man warns Vikrant about his changing fate. Pushpa assures Ranjana about Bipin and Isha's marriage. Isha thanks Vikrant for coming for dinner.

episodesList.title: Episode 25
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Jhende arrive at Isha’s house and Pushpa welcomes them. Before Isha and Nimkar arrive, she pleads with Vikrant to convince them for Isha’s wedding with Bipin. While Nimkar and Vikrant exchange gifts, a ‘Jogtin’, a woman asking for alms, arrives and predicts that Isha’s wedding will take place within a month. The next morning, Pushpa tries to convince Nimkar for Isha and Bipin’s wedding, but he walks off. Later, Rupali reminds Isha to confirm whether Vikrant is married or not.

episodesList.title: Episode 26
episodesList.summary: Unsure of Isha’s reaction, Vikrant practises with Jhende on how to convince Isha for her wedding. Just then, Mayra arrives, and on seeing her upset, Vikrant apologises for not turning up for their planned dinner. Later, Jhende informs Mayra about Isha’s wedding, and she rejoices, assuming that Isha will leave her job after her wedding. Mayra reprimands Isha for asking Vikrant’s personal details. After Pushpa’s reminder, Vikrant decides to talk to Isha and calls her to his office.

episodesList.title: Episode 27
episodesList.summary: Iisha shares her opinion regarding marriage with Vikrant, and tells him about her expectations from her groom. Jhende interrupts the conversation and informs Vikrant that they need to urgently leave for Karjat. After Vikrant leaves, Iisha finds out from her slam book that Vikrant is unmarried. However, a peon informs Iisha that Vikrant has left due to Mrs Saranjame’s ill-health, which upsets Iisha. At Vikrant’s house, Aaisaheb holds a puja for Vikrant’s wedding, much to Sonya’s irritation.

episodesList.title: Episode 28
episodesList.summary: Sonya and Aaisaheb have a war of words when Sonya maligns Vikrant in front of her. Vikrant learns that the news of Aaisaheb’s ill-health was just a ploy. On reaching home, Vikrant seeks Aaisaheb’s blessings before having the cake, which upsets Sonya. Influenced by a fake video, Jaydeep decides to undertake a project of turning copper into gold. Vikrant gifts Aaisaheb the saree that was gifted to him by Nimkar, leaving her surprised. Aaisaheb is hopeful of Vikrant’s marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 29
episodesList.summary: A bank personnel calls and informs Pushpa about a loan offer. Isha shares her confusion regarding Vikrant’s marital status with Rupali, but Rupali asks her to be hopeful. Pushpa calls Vikrant to remind him to convince Isha for the wedding. However, Aaisaheb picks up the call. A curious Aaisaheb questions Jhende about Isha. Puzzled, Jhende tells Vikrant to talk to Isha at the earliest. At midnight, Isha has a nightmare which wakes her. Later, Vikrant calls and asks her to meet him the next day.

episodesList.title: Episode 30
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 33
episodesList.summary: Mr Tillu threatens to cancel the wedding, but Pushpa asks him for a couple of days to convince Nimkar. At home, the Nimkars fail to gather money for a new gas cylinder. Elsewhere, Vikrant prefers normal home food over continental cuisines, which angers Sonya. Nimkar’s boss brutally insults Nimkar when he asks for money. At office, Vikrant calls Isha to his cabin when he learns that she didn’t go for lunch with her colleagues. Isha hesitates to open her lunchbox in front of Vikrant as it’s empty.

episodesList.title: Episode 34
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 36
episodesList.summary: Isha and Pushpa appease an upset Nimkar. Elsewhere, Aaisaheb makes Vikrant realise again the need to have a partner in life to get rid of his loneliness. Mr Tillu speaks to Nimkar about fixing the wedding date the next day and says he will take care of all the finances. Deciding to share the finances, Isha approaches Mayra for help and asks her to keep it a secret from Vikrant. Mayra gives Isha a cheque worth INR five lakh and puts forth a condition that she should stay away from Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Episode 37
episodesList.summary: Isha sets out to encash the cheque given by Mayra and lies to her parents when asked about it. Meanwhile, Vikrant recollects the time spent with Isha. Pushpa informs Vikrant that the wedding date will be fixed today. Later, a casual chat with Jaydeep makes Vikrant realize that one must learn from the past and move on. At Bipin’s house, when Isha and her parents visit to fix the date, Mr. Tillu asks why there aren’t any relatives from their side. Just then, Vikrant walks in, surprising everyone!

episodesList.title: Episode 38
episodesList.summary: When the Nimkars and the Tillus meet to fix the wedding date, Vikrant walks in, surprising everyone and making Isha uncomfortable. Vikrant offers to help, but Isha declines it by saying, errands like carrying heavy oil containers are not his cup of tea. Vikrant leaves quietly and reaches home to see Aai Saheb praying for his marriage. He misses Isha but is happy for her. The next day, Vikrant tells Mayra he will be away from office for a week, and lands up at Isha’s house with an oil container!

episodesList.title: Episode 39
episodesList.summary: Jhende instructs Vikrant’s bodyguards to stay undercover and watch over him. Mayra overhears his conversation and probes, but Jhende deludes her. Vikrant decides to help the Nimkar family with the wedding preparations. The Nimkars are stunned when Vikrant reveals that, once upon a time, he too lived in a chawl. Isha is confused about Vikrant’s intentions and decides to confront him. She sends her parents off for shopping to get some alone time with Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Episode 40
episodesList.summary: Mayra notices Isha’s absence at work and suspects that Vikrant and she are together. Meanwhile, Isha confronts Vikrant about his feelings for her but is left speechless when he plays with words and walks away. Just then, Mr. Tillu walks up to Vikrant with business ideas, which makes Vikrant rethink Isha’s marriage. He then instructs Jhende to verify Mr. Tillu’s background.

episodesList.title: Episode 41
episodesList.summary: Jhende obtains information about Mr. Tillu's real motive and relays it to Vikrant. Pushpa and Nimkar are glad to have Vikrant helping them for Isha's wedding, but Isha feels otherwise. The next morning, Vikrant arrives and takes Isha's family, Bipin, and Mr. Tillu out for jogging. Soon, everyone is exhausted except Isha and Vikrant. Isha slips, but Vikrant catches her, much to her delight! In the office, Mayra gets suspicious after learning that Vikrant and Isha haven't arrived yet.

episodesList.title: Episode 42
episodesList.summary: Mayra entrusts the responsibility of running the office to Jaydeep. She then calls Isha and reprimands her for taking two days of leave without notice. Isha tells her she needs four days of additional leave for her wedding. Mayra tells Isha to submit her application to Jaydeep. Isha does so, but an ill-mannered Jaydeep tears up her application. Jhende asks Isha about her leave when Mayra informs him about Jaydeep taking over the responsibilities. Further, Jhende warns Mayra against her anger.

episodesList.title: Episode 43
episodesList.summary: Jhende informs Vikrant that Jaydeep has rejected Isha’s leave application. Gathering some courage, Isha manages to convince Jaydeep to accept her leave application by narrating the story of ‘Hirkani’. At the jewellery shop, Vikrant and Isha end up liking a ‘mangalsutra’ worth INR 3 lakh. Mr Tillu agrees to buy it in order to save his image. Isha is elated when Vikrant helps her wear the ‘mangalsutra’ while she struggles. Later, Vikrant hides the ‘mangalsutra’ and Mr Tillu insults Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 44
episodesList.summary: While going home, Pushpa gets irritated by a stranger staring at her. Later, Pushpa makes a dish out of leftover rotis and Isha wishes to stitch a dress for herself using Pushpa’s old sarees which impresses Vikrant. While Vikrant and Isha go to fetch the ‘Mangalsutra’, the fellow residents wonder whether Vikrant wants to take over their locality for redevelopment. Further, Isha and Vikrant have a hearty talk. Later, Ranjana and the fellow residents threaten the Nimkars to stay away from Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Episode 45
episodesList.summary: Vikrant overhears the fellow residents conversing and reprimands them for threatening Nimkar. He clarifies that he is not eying their locality for redevelopment and urges them to be united. While Vikrant goes to call the Tillus to have a look at the necklaces, he overhears Mr Tillu lamenting about the increased expenses. Mayra calls Vikrant to ask his whereabouts and hears Isha’s voice. Vikrant tries to feed Isha, but she shies away. Mayra smartly makes Jhende reveal Vikrant’s whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Episode 46
episodesList.summary: Bipin gets ten gold necklaces for Isha. While the Nimkars worry about the expenses, Isha gets a message on her phone about her first salary being deposited. Pushpa shares her happiness with the neighbouring ladies, but they retort, saying Isha’s salary will be enjoyed by her in-laws. Jhende tells Mayra that Vikrant wants her to make changes in the Employee Manual. When Isha receives a copy of the manual, Vikrant tells her to check with the Tillus whether they approve of all the rules.

episodesList.title: Episode 47
episodesList.summary: Isha shows Raghuveer the Employee Manual, and he learns that relatives of an employee are not allowed to associate with Vikrant’s company for business. Furious, he calls off the marriage. Pushpa wants to reason with Raghuveer, but Vikrant volunteers to amend the rule. Raghuveer excitedly agrees to the marriage. However, Pushpa realises the Tillus’ intentions and calls off the wedding. Raghuveer makes threats to seize the Nimkars’ shop. Nimkar’s boss, who was made to tag along, apologises.

episodesList.title: Episode 48
episodesList.summary: Pushpa and Mr Nimkar insist Vikrant spend one last day with them, and he obliges. Jhende reminds Vikrant about Jaydeep’s birthday and takes him to the office, where everyone is waiting to cut the cake. Jaydeep introduces everyone to the “money printing machine” that he has bought. He is furious when the machine doesn’t work. Mayra pressurises Jhende to get Vikrant to the office the next day. Isha writes a love letter to Vikrant, and Rupali assures her of Vikrant having similar feelings.

episodesList.title: Episode 49
episodesList.summary: Mr Nimkar and Pushpa decide to take Vikrant for lunch to Bollywood Café owing to the discounted prices. In the office, Jhende and Mayra hold Vikrant back for the general body meeting. After a long wait at the restaurant, Isha calls Vikrant, but he doesn’t answer. After Isha’s repeated calls and texts, Vikrant ends the meeting in haste and leaves to go meet the Nimkars. Jhende tries to stop Vikrant from going by emotionally blackmailing him and telling him it is against Peer Baba’s discretion.

episodesList.title: Episode 50
episodesList.summary: Vikrant is angry with Jhende for blackmailing him to break the promise he made to the Nimkars. Vikrant explains his state of mind to Jhende by narrating a story. Isha tells Rupali she will wait for Vikrant to approach her. Mr Nimkar is welcomed by his boss to the shop. At office, Mayra asks Isha to make a presentation on Rajnandini sarees. Isha hesitates initially, but, after recalling Vikrant’s words, she suggests recycling sarees into dresses, and everyone is impressed with her proposal.

episodesList.title: Episode 51
episodesList.summary: Impressed by Isha’s presentation, the clients tell Vikrant that they want Isha to lead the project. Vikrant apologises to Isha for not turning up for lunch, but she cuts him off saying she has to submit a report to Mayra. Rupali is upset with Ranjana when she insults Isha and Pushpa. Vikrant plans a surprise celebration for Isha’s successful presentation. Mayra is furious as she failed to tarnish Isha’s image. Later, Vikrant asks Isha to write an apology letter to the Nimkars.

episodesList.title: Episode 52
episodesList.summary: Bipin, who wants to be friends with Isha, reveals that he knows Vikrant and she are in love with each other. Isha gives Vikrant’s apology letter to Pushpa. In the morning, Bipin gives Isha a ride to office, which Vikrant sees. A fuming Vikrant scolds Isha for being insincere, much to Mayra’s delight. Vikrant calls Isha to his cabin and angrily expresses his feelings. When Isha repeatedly offers him his medicine, he breaks the glass in anger. However, seeing Isha hurt, he tends to her injury.

episodesList.title: Episode 53
episodesList.summary: Isha refuses to take an extra lunch box for Vikrant. Mr Nagarkar calls Mayra and tells her he will confirm the meeting only if Isha is available, which irks Mayra. Mayra reprimands Isha for not doing the research about the Raj Nandini sarees. Isha impresses the dealers with her idea of magnifying the demand for Raj Nandini sarees, and asks them to join her in the survey.

episodesList.title: Episode 54
episodesList.summary: Jhende asks Vikrant why his behaviour has changed since Isha has come into his life, but Vikrant is unable to answer. The next day, Mayra and Jhende get angry with Vikrant when he questions them about Isha’s whereabouts. Vikrant tells Jhende Isha being a new employee is his responsibility. Pushpa calls Vikrant to ask whether Isha fought with him, but he lies. Later, the dealers and Isha visit Mr Nimkar’s shop for the survey, but Isha refuses to reveal her identity in front of the dealers.

episodesList.title: Episode 55
episodesList.summary: The dealers are happy with the survey's outcome. Isha reveals to them that her father works at the shop. Vikrant follows Isha, and during their fight, learns that Vikrant hasn't eaten all day. She takes him to a road-side stall, where Vikrant insists on eating spicy food despite Isha's request. Nimkar informs Pushpa about Isha's visit, and they decide to eat outside. Later, Vikrant is surprised to run into Isha's parents. Isha advises Vikrant to accept the truth to ease his worries.

episodesList.title: Episode 56
episodesList.summary: In the car, Vikrant listens to the ‘Love Guru’ radio show, wherein a professor falls in love with his student. Although Vikrant relates to the situation, he hides his feelings from Jhende. During the survey, Mr Shinde badmouths Mayra and Vikrant, and Isha reprimands him. An insulted Mr Shinde complains to Mayra about Isha’s rude behaviour. Vikrant instructs Mayra to take any action she pleases. Later, at office, when Mayra is about to fire Isha, Mr Nagarkar tells the truth and saves Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 57
episodesList.summary: Jhende takes Vikrant to a nostalgic place where they relive their memories. Jhende makes Vikrant realise he is in love with Isha and he is hiding the same from himself. Elsewhere, Bipin gives Isha a red rose and asks her to count its petals to know whether Vikrant will marry her. The ‘Jogtin’ assures Pushpa of Isha’s marriage. Later, Vikrant offers Isha a promotion which requires her to move to Bangalore. Isha tells Vikrant that he cannot stop loving her even if he distances himself from her.

episodesList.title: Episode 58
episodesList.summary: Isha gives Vikrant a challenge, wherein they shouldn’t attempt to meet each other in the next 24 hours. However, if they happen to meet each other accidentally, then Vikrant has to accept his feelings for Isha. While Rupali and Bipin plan to make them meet each other, Jhende and Mayra plan otherwise. When Rupali asks Jhende about Vikrant’s whereabouts, he suspects it to be Isha’s plan. While Vikrant gets angry with Jhende for trying to downgrade Isha, Isha foils Rupali and Bipin’s plan.

episodesList.title: Episode 59
episodesList.summary: At night, Isha is unable to sleep due to the thoughts of not being able to meet Vikrant. Vikrant goes to his Karjat house and decides to be alone for the next 24 hours. In the morning, Sonya argues with Aaisaheb for being partial towards Vikrant. Falling prey to another fraud, Jaydeep buys so-called ‘Biochemical Petrol Sesame’ that turns mineral water into petrol for INR five crore. A disgusted Sonya locks Jaydeep in a room. Worried, Aaisaheb informs Vikrant about it and he consoles Jaydeep.

episodesList.title: Episode 60
episodesList.summary: Isha’s parents wonder what could be the reason behind Isha’s indifferent behaviour. On Aaisaheb’s request, Vikrant tries to give his piece of mind to Sonya, but she doesn’t budge. Later, Sonya appeases Jaydeep and tells him that she wants to see him take all the responsibilities and be successful with his own efforts. The ‘Jogtin’ reminds Isha to go to Amba Devi’s temple in Karjat. Pushpa is unable to ask Vikrant about the temple’s address, but Isha tells her that she has found it.

episodesList.title: Episode 61
episodesList.summary: Isha insists on going to the Karjat temple immediately and the Nimkars leave in a cab instead of taking a train. Aaisaheb requests Vikrant to accompany her to the temple, but he refuses and lets Sonya go instead. On seeing only half an hour left in the completion of 24 hours, Isha prays to the goddess. Later, Sarjerao convinces Vikrant to go to the temple. Vikrant spots Isha at the temple, and hides behind a pillar when Isha comes to give Prasad. However, Isha recognises him.

episodesList.title: Episode 62
episodesList.summary: Aaisaheb explains to Vikrant that god turns one’s desires into reality, and one should accept it when god does so. Isha concludes that Vikrant doesn’t want to accept the truth. She tells her parents that she will be going to Bangalore the next day as she has been granted a promotion, leaving them shocked. Pushpa decides to call Vikrant to stop Isha’s transfer. A delighted Mayra gives Isha a send-off. In her speech, Isha says she won’t deny her fate, and agrees to go to Bangalore.

episodesList.title: Episode 63
episodesList.summary: An emotional Vikrant tells Jhende that he and Isha had come together within 24 hours, but he is guilty of hiding from her. Jhende consoles Vikrant saying they both will get over each other once she goes to Bangalore. Isha confides in Rupali and Bipin that she had met Vikrant in the temple, but he refused to accept her. Isha leaves for Bangalore. On learning that the Bangalore bus has left, Vikrant chases the bus with his car and stops it. Vikrant enters the bus and tries to stop Isha from going.

episodesList.title: Episode 64
episodesList.summary: An emotional Isha asks Vikrant why he wants to stop her from going to Bangalore when she has accepted her fate. Mayra and Jhende are worried for not knowing about Vikrant’s whereabouts, and Jhende leaves in search of him. Vikrant compels Isha to get off the bus. Isha confronts Vikrant and tells him that she won’t talk to him until he accepts his feelings. Later, Vikrant shouts at her for asking unknown people for a lift. On seeing her breaking down, he apologises to her and consoles her.

episodesList.title: Episode 65
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Isha go to a nearby hotel and learn that the next bus to Mumbai is in the morning. They decide on spending the night at the hotel, and the receptionist gives them the last vacant room. Isha’s parents get more worried when Jhende visits their house and asks Isha’s whereabouts and whether Vikrant had visited them. Isha again tries to make Vikrant confess his feelings for her but fails. Later, an awkward Vikrant asks Isha to sleep on the bed while he watches over her.

episodesList.title: Episode 66
episodesList.summary: Vikrant speaks his heart out while Isha is asleep. Isha pretends to be asleep and hears Vikrant confess his love for her. In the morning, Jhende and Mayra come to pick them up from the hotel. On reaching home, Isha is shocked to see the neighbours at her house and consoles a crying Pushpa. Isha says that her transfer has been cancelled. Later, Mayra breaks down when Jhende tells her about Vikrant and Isha’s love. Mayra grumbles about Vikrant’s behaviour and insults Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 67
episodesList.summary: Mayra tells Jhende that she cannot stand Vikrant falling in love with a middle class girl. When Isha tells her parents that Vikrant had come to pick her up at night, Mr Nimkar gets suspicious and tells Isha to focus on her studies. Vikrant slaps Jhende when he insults Isha in front of him. An excited Isha informs Rupali that Vikrant confessed his feelings to her.

episodesList.title: Episode 68
episodesList.summary: An emotional Vikrant apologises to Jhende for raising a hand at him. Jhende warns Mayra against going to London for five days as he fears Vikrant and Isha might come closer. Isha packs an extra lunchbox for Vikrant. At office, Vikrant announces that one of the days of the week will be an open office day, wherein he will sit among the employees and work, and everyone will be allowed to wear casual clothes. Mayra taunts Vikrant over it. Later, everyone is surprised to see Isha in the office.

episodesList.title: Episode 69
episodesList.summary: Mayra puts up an act to convince Vikrant to go to London for the ‘World Trade Conference’. Vikrant decides to take Isha along. Mayra tells Jhende to instigate Isha’s parents against the trip. While Isha excitedly informs Mr Nimkar about it, a few colleagues raise their eyebrows at Isha’s selection. Vikrant tells Isha that she deserves to go to London. Later, Jhende visits Isha’s parents to collect documents for Isha’s passport, and indirectly tries to create suspicions in their mind.

episodesList.title: Episode 70
episodesList.summary: An elated Isha shares her excitement with Rupali regarding her London trip. Mr Nimkar does not allow Isha to go to London. He refuses to tell the reason to Isha. Later, Mr Nimkar goes to Isha’s office with her to meet Vikrant. Mr Nimkar tells Vikrant that he would not allow Isha to go to London with him as he fears Isha will be badmouthed by everyone. Vikrant empathises with his worries and refuses to take Isha to London. Later, Mr Nimkar reveals to Vikrant that Jhende had cautioned him.

episodesList.title: Episode 71
episodesList.summary: Pushpa asks the neighbours what they want from London and collects money from them. However, when Rupali suspects Mr Nimkar cancelling Isha’s trip, Pushpa returns the money. At office, Vikrant tells Mayra and Jhende that Jaydeep will be taking the entire charge of the office in his absence and Isha will be assisting him. Vikrant also taunts Mayra and Jhende for their deeds. Later, Vikrant pacifies Isha and gifts her a necklace, which she refuses to accept. An upset Pushpa admonishes Mr Nimkar.

episodesList.title: Episode 72
episodesList.summary: Jaydeep gets Mr Bhokare, a ‘Vastu’ expert, to the office. Mr Bhokare advises changing the direction in which the employees face, to boost the company’s success, and Jaydeep obliges. Vikrant gives Isha a digital watch, through which they can be in touch with each other. Isha tells about it to Rupali. At night, Isha is elated on receiving ‘I miss you’ text from Vikrant on her watch. The next day, while Isha distributes snacks in the office, Mayra reprimands her and complains to Jaydeep.

episodesList.title: Episode 73
episodesList.summary: When Isha narrates how the tradition of ‘Faral’, snacks, began during Diwali, Jaydeep tastes the Chaklis and praises them. Jaydeep informs Mayra and Jhende that they will give Chaklis made by Isha’s mother as a corporate gift instead of the diaries, which irks Mayra. Mayra visits Pushpa to place the order for Chaklis and Pushpa is elated to get the advance money. Later, Jaydeep asks the employees for their opinion on his calendar design. Isha tries to oppose the design, but Mayra cuts her off.

episodesList.title: Episode 74
episodesList.summary: Isha goes to Jaydeep’s office and voices her disapproval regarding the calendar's design. Mayra gets frustrated debating with Isha over the ideas for the design and leaves. Later, Isha convinces Jaydeep that the demand for the calendar will rise if they make the middle class people connect with it. Mr Nimkar almost sells off the entire ‘Faral’ made for Isha’s office. Isha and Pushpa stop him and explain the issue. Mr Nimkar tells Isha to tell the truth in the office and apologise.

episodesList.title: Episode 75
episodesList.summary: Isha tells Mayra on the call that the order cannot be ready by the next morning, but Mayra demands that the order should be delivered in the morning itself. The Nimkars, along with Rupali and Bipin. toil all night to prepare the Chaklis. Isha hurts herself in the process and imagines Vikrant tending to her wound. In the morning, Mayra tries to instigate Jaydeep against Isha, but Isha arrives just in time with the order and foils her plan. Later, Vikrant calls Isha and congratulates her.

episodesList.title: Episode 76
episodesList.summary: Isha comes home with the money and hands it over to Mr Nimkar. He decides to buy gifts for everyone who helped them in finishing the order, much to Pushpa’s disappointment. Sonya is irked when Aaisaheb misses Vikrant and refuses to eat the ‘Faral’. A lady comes to buy Chaklis from Pushpa to send them to her sister in Canada, and Isha decides to send them to Vikrant in London. As Isha wants it to be a surprise, Rupali suggests Isha to get Vikrant’s London’s address from office.

episodesList.title: Episode 77
episodesList.summary: Sonya orders Bobby to throw away her old sarees. When Jaydeep shows her the new calendar design suggested by Isha, she asks Bobby to throw away that as well. However, Aaisaheb appreciates the calendar design. At office, Isha goes to Jaydeep’s cabin to ask for Vikrant’s London address. Mayra rebukes her and Jaydeep insults Isha’s idea. Just then, Jaydeep learns about the success of the new calendar. An elated Jaydeep announces bonus for all and gives Vikrant’s London address to Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 78
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 79
episodesList.summary: Aaisaheb is stunned when the ‘Jogtin’ tells her that she had foreseen her visit to the Nimkars. At office, Jaydeep hands over an important file to Isha. Mayra is shocked to learn about Aaisaheb’s visit to Isha. Mayra calls Pushpa and places a huge order of Chaklis worth INR two lakhs. Sonya is furious when Jaydeep gifts her a Rajnandini saree. Pushpa is elated to receive a surprise gift from Mr Nimkar. Later, Isha video-calls Vikrant with the help of Rupali and Bipin and they have a hearty talk.

episodesList.title: Episode 80
episodesList.summary: While Vikrant assumes that Isha is wearing the necklace given by him, Isha tells him that Aaisaheb gifted her a similar necklace. Vikrant is about to express his feelings, but the call gets disconnected. Uddhav visits Pushpa to talk about the order and smartly takes a picture of the tender’s copy. At office, Mr Sabnis informs Jaydeep about the tender’s amount being leaked. When Mayra suspects Isha, Jaydeep appoints Mr Paranjpe and Mrs Wadkar for the inquiry, while Mayra confiscates Isha’s phone.

episodesList.title: Episode 81
episodesList.summary: Mr Paranjpe and Mrs Wadkar arrive at Isha’s house and inform Isha’s parents that Isha is accused of leaking the company’s tender. During the inspection, they find a bundle of cash under the mattress, but Pushpa and Mr Nimkar deny being aware of it. Seeing the proof, Jaydeep rebukes Isha and calls for legal action against her, much to Mayra’s delight. Vikrant calls Isha, but she is unable to tell him her problem. Mr Nimkar suspects that Pushpa had kept the cash and locks himself in the room.

episodesList.title: Episode 82
episodesList.summary: Isha learns that after being given the termination letter, she won’t be allowed any other job. Jaydeep decides to talk to Vikrant before signing Isha’s termination letter, but Mayra and Jhende stop him. When Isha informs Mr Nimkar about the termination letter, he decides to come to her office with Pushpa. While Jaydeep is about to give the letter to Isha, her parents come there and Mr Nimkar begs for forgiveness. Just then, Vikrant shows up and decides to talk to Isha before convicting her.

episodesList.title: Episode 83
episodesList.summary: Vikrant summons Isha’s parents to his cabin to interrogate them. Vikrant asks them if any stranger had visited their house. After much insistence, Pushpa reveals that Mayra had placed a big order of Chaklis and had sent a person to confirm the order. Vikrant confronts Mayra and gets out the truth from her. Later, a furious Vikrant asks Mayra the reason behind targeting Isha always. Mayra blurts out that she became insecure since Isha’s joining and admits to loving Vikrant in front of Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 84
episodesList.summary: When Vikrant assumes that Isha has misunderstood him, she reveals that she had heard him express his feelings for her in the hotel. She urges Vikrant to give a clear answer to Mayra. Mr Nimkar wants to meet Vikrant before leaving. Vikrant tells Mayra that he doesn’t have any feelings for her and requests her not to leave the company. Mr Nimkar tells Vikrant that he doesn’t want Isha to work in his company anymore, and Vikrant agrees.

episodesList.title: Episode 85
episodesList.summary: Jhende is shocked to learn that Isha has left the job. Vikrant decides to not hide his feelings for Isha from anyone. Just then, Jhende informs Vikrant that Jalindar, who tried to kill Vikrant 15 years ago, has come out of the jail. Jhende decides to tighten Vikrant’s security by seeking police protection. Upset about not being able to meet Vikrant, Isha calls Vikrant and asks him to meet at a café.

episodesList.title: Episode 86
episodesList.summary: Frustrated for not being allowed to step out of the office, Vikrant thinks of a plan and orders a pizza. Isha and Rupali make an excuse and go to the café. When the pizza delivery boy arrives, Vikrant takes his uniform and goes to meet Isha. Isha is surprised to see Vikrant in a delivery boy’s uniform. Jhende is irked on learning about it. Isha tells Vikrant that she loves him for his simplicity and not his position. Later, Vikrant is disturbed to spot a person hiding his face with a newspaper.

episodesList.title: Episode 87
episodesList.summary: A worried Mr Nimkar looks around for Isha and Rupali. He spots Rupali hiding after seeing him. After getting a call from Rupali, Isha decides to leave. Vikrant notices a person following him and locks him in the washroom. Vikrant and Isha spend romantic moments before bidding goodbye to each other. While Vikrant tells Jhende about Jalindar’s men following him, Isha and Rupali cook up a story at home. Jalindar learns about Vikrant being in love with Isha. Isha tells Rupali about the date.

episodesList.title: Episode 88
episodesList.summary: Vikrant realises that Isha could be in danger and orders Jhende to provide security to her. Jalindar calls Isha and tells her that Vikrant is a fraud, and she shouldn’t trust him. Jalindar doesn’t reveal his identity to Isha. The Nimkars feel uncomfortable due to the security outside their house. At night, Isha receives ‘I miss you’ text from Vikrant on her digital watch. The guards get suspicious, but Isha handles the situation. The next morning, Mayra decides to accompany Vikrant for a jog.

episodesList.title: Episode 89
episodesList.summary: While cycling, Vikrant talks to Isha on the call, but Mayra assumes that he is talking to her. Isha confides in Rupali about the unknown caller badmouthing Vikrant. Rupali advises Isha to inform Vikrant about it, but Isha doesn’t agree. Jalindar calls Isha again and tries to instigate her against Vikrant by quoting his words. Isha receives a text from an anonymous number while going for the exam. Vikrant meets Isha at the examination venue and brings ‘Prasad’ for her from her favourite temple.

episodesList.title: Episode 90
episodesList.summary: Isha shows a chit given by a rickshaw driver to Rupali, who raises doubts over Vikrant. Isha scolds her, saying that she completely trusts Vikrant. Rupali suggests Isha talk to Vikrant and calls him, but later scolds Isha when she doesn’t inform Vikrant about the anonymous call. Vikrant tells Jhende he is sure that Jalindar would try to reach Isha and threaten her. He asks Jhende to find Jalindar at any cost. Vikrant visits Isha and slyly notes down the numbers from her mobile’s call log.

episodesList.title: Episode 91
episodesList.summary: Jalindar calls Isha to give her another proof to prove Vikrant a fraud, but she refuses to trust him. She gets shocked when Jalindar sends her a picture of the weird stranger she had come across once. Later, Isha has a nightmare wherein the stranger tries to attack her. Isha wakes up to fever and decides to meet Vikrant to tell him about everything. Later, Isha meets the stranger again. Vikrant throws a party to celebrate the world-wide success of the ‘Chhota Recharge Pack’, and misses Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 92
episodesList.summary: Vikrant comes out of his cabin when he learns of Isha’s visit. Vikrant dances with Isha which amuses everyone. Later, Vikrant takes Isha to his cabin and asks her the reason behind her visit. Meanwhile, an irked Mr Nimkar calls Isha and reprimands her for going to office when she is sick. Isha reveals everything to Vikrant and shows him the picture of the stranger. In the car, Vikrant gives his jacket to Isha and comforts her when she feels cold.

episodesList.title: Episode 93
episodesList.summary: Vikrant takes Isha to the stranger and asks her to confront him. The stranger reveals that he was given money for threatening Isha. However, on learning that he was insulting Vikrant, he slaps himself and apologises to her, narrating how Vikrant had helped him. Isha confesses her love for Vikrant. Mr Nimkar voices his suspicions regarding Vikrant’s office. Vikrant confides in the Nimkars about how Jalindar became his enemy. Jhende tells Vikrant that Isha being his weak point is helping Jalindar.

episodesList.title: Episode 94
episodesList.summary: Nimkar conveys to Pushpa that he suspected that Isha was in a relationship with someone at her office. Jhende approaches Isha and makes her realise that Jalindar could take ill-advatage of the fact that she is Vikrant's weakness and asks for her promise to break all relations with Vikrant for his safety, to which Isha agreees. Jalindar calls Isha, and she informs him that she had broken all ties with Vikrant but is aghast to learn that Jalindar intended to destroy Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Episode 95
episodesList.summary: Jhende arrives at an under-construction building looking for Jalindar but finds a note which reads that it’s not easy to catch him. Isha’s parents discuss love marriage to cheer her up, but Isha says she doesn’t love anyone. Vikrant decides to propose marriage to Isha and shares it with Jhende.
