Pushpa decides to take up a part-time job, while Isha prepares for a job interview. Elsewhere, Vikrant too rehearses his lines to propose Isha for marriage and goes to her place, surprising her.

episodesList.title: Episode 96
episodesList.summary: Isha is glad to see Vikrant pay her a surprise visit and asks him the reason behind it. Vikrant repeatedly fumbles while trying to propose marriage to her. Isha asks him to help her prepare for her job interview and they end up having a fun banter. Just then, Nimkar and Pushpa arrive, and Vikrant asks Isha to rejoin his office, leaving her delighted. Nimkar allows Isha to rejoin Vikrant’s office but lays a few conditions and tries making her realise the class difference between them and Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Episode 97
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tells Jhende that he failed to propose marriage to Isha. Isha gets ready to go to work, but decides against going when Rupali reminds her of the promise made to Jhende. However, Rupali convinces Isha to confide in Vikrant about her conversation with Jhende. When Isha reaches office, Jhende tries to stop her from meeting Vikrant, but in vain. Vikrant assures Isha that she can meet him. Later, Isha tells Vikrant about the conditions Mr Nimkar laid down for Isha re-joining the office.

episodesList.title: Episode 98
episodesList.summary: Mr Nimkar calls Isha to remind her of the conditions. Jhende tells Vikrant that Isha loves him for his wealth, but Vikrant laughs it off. Jhende bets on proving Isha avaricious and Mayra an appropriate partner for Vikrant. Vikrant summons Isha to his cabin and asks about her expectations from life. Isha wishes to lead a simple life with a small family, irrespective of the size of the house. Later, Jhende slyly tells Isha that Vikrant wants her to shift to a new flat and gives her the address.

episodesList.title: Episode 99
episodesList.summary: Jhende claims to have won the bet and tells Vikrant that Isha loves him for his money. However, Jhende is stunned when Vikrant tells him that Isha had returned the flat keys to him. Vikrant gives Jhende another chance. Vikrant tells Mayra about appointing Isha as the head of the new department which will be working on Rajnandini saree’s fabric. Mayra pretends to agree with Vikrant’s decision and mocks Isha. Later, Vikrant announces the news in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Episode 100
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tells Isha that she deserves everything she has. When Jhende expresses his disappointment for not being able to put Isha down, Mayra says that she loves challenges. Isha’s parents throw a small party to celebrate her promotion. During the party, Vikrant calls Isha and the guests raise their eyebrows at it. At night, Mr Nimkar is unable to sleep as he recalls people’s statements about Isha. He asks Isha if she is hiding anything from him, but later tells her that he trusts her.

episodesList.title: Episode 101
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tells Aaisaheb that he will be announcing the name of the department head for Rajnandini saree in the board meeting. Mayra tells Isha that her attire is too simple for the occasion and buys her a modern dress. Vikrant turns furious on seeing Isha wear uncomfortable clothes and later reprimands her. Jhende claims to have won the bet and gives Vikrant another chance. Mayra takes Isha to her house and shows off Vikrant’s gifts to her. Vikrant is surprised to not find Isha in the office.

episodesList.title: Episode 102
episodesList.summary: Isha makes an excuse and takes the necklace gifted by Vikrant from Pushpa. Next, Isha tells Rupali that she wants to break all ties with Vikrant and asks her to return all the gifts to Vikrant after three days. At the office, Isha learns that Vikrant has a hectic schedule lined up. She purposely sends a lot of texts to Vikrant while he is in the meeting. Further, Isha decides to go for a movie with Bipin to annoy Vikrant. A disturbed Vikrant leaves the meeting and is hurt to see Isha with Bipin.

episodesList.title: Episode 103
episodesList.summary: Isha doesn’t go to work and lies to her parents about going to her friend’s engagement. To appease an angry Vikrant, Jaydeep asks Isha to narrate a story to Vikrant over the phone. When Vikrant scolds Isha for not coming to work, she lies about being sick. Later, Vikrant visits Isha’s house and learns about Isha’s lie. On Rupali’s insistence, Isha confides in Vikrant the reason behind her unusual behaviour. Vikrant confronts Jhende and Mayra and decides to propose marriage to Isha the next day.

episodesList.title: Episode 104
episodesList.summary: As the Nimkars are about to go to watch a play, Vikrant’s driver arrives and gives an invitation letter to Isha. After leaving, Isha learns that Vikrant has invited her to his house. On entering Vikrant’s house, Isha is amazed by the grandeur. Vikrant reveals his past to Isha, making her emotional. Mr Tillu apprises Isha’s parents of Isha and Vikrant’s affair and asks them to visit Vikrant’s house to see what their daughter is up to. Later, Vikrant gives the ring to Isha on the helicopter.

episodesList.title: Episode 105
episodesList.summary: Vikrant takes Isha for a chopper ride and proposes marriage to her mid-air. Isha is speechless on seeing Vikrant’s unique way of proposing marriage to her and accepts his proposal. Mr Nimkar is stunned to see Isha in Vikrant’s arms. Vikrant takes Isha to his house, where they share some wonderful moments amidst a hearty chat. Isha tells Vikrant that she will convince her parents for their marriage. A shattered Mr Nimkar returns home and apprises Pushpa of everything, leaving her devastated.

episodesList.title: Episode 106
episodesList.summary: A visibly flummoxed Nimkar tells Pushpa that he trusts Isha and his upbringing. Isha shares her dilemma about their parents’ disapproval with Vikrant owing to their age difference. A disturbed Nimkar blabbers about the consequences of Isha and Vikrant’s relationship. Isha arrives home with a pastry as a mark of celebrating her happiness, but her father’s behaviour leaves her baffled. Jhende is also stunned to learn about Vikrant proposing marriage to Isha and congratulates him.

episodesList.title: Episode 107
episodesList.summary: Nimkar takes to reading a religious book and Isha realises that he is disturbed. Later, Jhende apprises Mayra of Vikrant’s marriage proposal to Isha, leaving Mayra stunned. Mayra silently vows to turn the situation in her favour. When Isha leaves for office, Nimkar blesses her. Pushpa learns from Guruji that Isha will marry into a royal family. Rupali visits Vikrant and gives him a parcel, saying Isha has returned his gifts. Vikrant realises it to be a prank but pretends to have fallen for it.

episodesList.title: Episode 108
episodesList.summary: Vikrant summons Isha to his cabin and strongly expresses his displeasure to her for sending all her memorable gifts to him. On seeing Isha cry, Vikrant reveals it was a prank. Mayra arrives and tries taunting them about Isha getting additional powers and authority, but Vikrant silences her. He later takes Isha to the cafeteria and instils confidence in her to speak to Mr Nimkar about his marriage proposal. On Vikrant’s advice, Isha behaves sternly with Mayra and takes medicines for Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Episode 109
episodesList.summary: Tillu informs Mayra that Mr Nimkar has complete trust on Isha. They vow to break that trust and spoil Isha’s image and reputation. Isha and Vikrant spend a wonderful time, and Vikrant instils confidence in her to talk to her parents about their marriage. Mr Nimkar talks to Isha about registering her name in a marriage bureau, leaving her baffled. Tillu badmouths about Isha to the neighbours. Jhende and Mayra embarrass Isha in office.

episodesList.title: Episode 110
episodesList.summary: Mr Nimkar lashes out at Mr Sawant when he badmouths Isha. Mr Nimkar’s boss insults him for venting out his frustration on the customers. A hesitant Isha calls Mr Nimkar and tells him that Vikrant wants to speak to him regarding her future, but his reply stuns Isha and Vikrant. Pushpa asks Isha whether she is hiding something from her father. Ranjana influences Pushpa to sell off their house. Taking Jhende’s advice, Vikrant decides to send Aaisaheb to Isha’s house to talk about the marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 111
episodesList.summary: Mr Nimkar is shocked to see a young girl walk into his shop with her husband, who is of her father’s age. Jhende captures Mr Nimkar and forcefully takes him to Vikrant’s office. Jhende threatens Mr Nimkar to say yes to Vikrant’s questions. On learning about it, Vikrant apologises to Mr Nimkar and orders the driver to drop him home safely. Vikrant rebukes Jhende for his behaviour and warns him against coming between Isha and him. Later, Vikrant tries to comfort a frightened Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 112
episodesList.summary: Jhende gives an apology letter to Vikrant and asks him to give it to Mr Nimkar. But, Vikrant tears up the letter and asks to be left alone. After Isha reaches home, Mr Nimkar questions her about her relationship with Vikrant. When Isha remains mute, he tells her that Vikrant is misusing her and everyone is badmouthing them. Isha is shocked to learn that Mr Nimkar had seen her with Vikrant on the chopper. Mr Nimkar is devastated when Isha owns up to her deeds. Later, Vikrant visits Isha’s house.

episodesList.title: Episode 113
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tries to apologise to Mr Nimkar, but he shuts the door on Vikrant’s face. Vikrant decides to stand right there until he opens the door. Isha pleads with her parents to listen to Vikrant, but in vain, which makes Isha cry. The neighbours badmouth Vikrant on seeing him standing at the Nimkars’ door for long. The next morning, Mr Nimkar sees Vikrant standing at the same place. Vikrant admits to loving Isha and vows to answer all the questions of Mr Nimkar before getting married to Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 114
episodesList.summary: Isha and Pushpa celebrate Mr Nimkar’s birthday. Mr Nimkar receives a bouquet and a gift from Vikrant which makes him angry. Mr Nimkar doesn’t accept the gift and leaves for work without the lunchbox. Pushpa tells Isha that she will always support Mr Nimkar in any stand he takes. Jhende justifies his actions to Vikrant and later, apologises to Isha for misbehaving with Mr Nimkar. Pushpa is keen on seeing Mr Nimkar’s gift. Vikrant permits Isha to leave office early for the birthday dinner.

episodesList.title: Episode 115
episodesList.summary: The Nimkars go out for dinner and are surprised to find the restaurant empty. The waiter tells them that a special chef has joined on the occasion of Mr Nimkar’s birthday. Impressed by the food, Pushpa wishes to compliment the chef. Mr Nimkar is annoyed to learn that Vikrant was the chef, but Vikrant makes him cut the cake and subtly proposes to become a part of Nimkar family through the gift. The next day, Isha’s picture is published in the newspaper, but Mr Nimkar feels it’s Vikrant’s favour.

episodesList.title: Episode 116
episodesList.summary: Mr Nimkar’s boss pesters him to ask Isha to give a massive discount on the Rajnandini sarees' and sells them at 50% discount. At the office, Mihir and Mrs Wadkar taunt Isha while Mr Paranjpe and Sapna congratulate her. Mr Nimkar decides to mortgage his house to make up for his boss’s losses. Later, Mr Nimkar lambasts Vikrant for cancelling the Rajnandini sarees’ dealership with his shop, but Isha gives an explanation. Mr Nimkar decides to meet the prospective grooms for Isha's marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 117
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tries to talk to Mr Nimkar about Vikrant, but he evades the topic. At office, Vikrant asks Mr Paranjpe, Mrs Wadkar and FM for their views on love marriage. Mihir is irked to see Vikrant giving importance to FM. Mr Nimkar dislikes the four suitors owing to their selfish and exploitative motives. Later, Vikrant arrives as the fifth suitor. Further, Vikrant answers all the questions that Mr Nimkar had put forth and asks him to consider his proposal to marry Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 118
episodesList.summary: Pushpa tells Isha that it’s her responsibility to get Isha and Vikrant married. Vikrant invites Isha to celebrate the good news and Christmas with him. The next morning, Mr Nimkar allows Isha to go out with Vikrant. Mr Nimkar leaves with Pushpa to follow Isha and Vikrant. Mr Nimkar’s suspicions are proved wrong when he sees Vikrant take Isha to an old age home, where they happily feed cake to the old people. Later, Isha’s parents secretly watch Isha and Vikrant feeding cake to each other.

episodesList.title: Episode 119
episodesList.summary: Isha feels lucky to have found Vikrant owing to his loving and caring nature. Pushpa praises Vikrant for being down-to-earth, but Mr Nimkar disregards it. Pushpa gets angry and tells Mr Nimkar that he hasn’t done anything for Isha as a father which hurts him. Vikrant drops Isha home and gives her a cake to celebrate Christmas with her family. Pushpa tells Isha that Mr Nimkar left the house in anger. Later, Mr Nimkar returns home drunk and criticises himself, hurting Pushpa and Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 120
episodesList.summary: Isha sends a letter to Vikrant, who is shocked to read that Isha wants to put an end to their relationship as it’s hurting her close ones. Isha confides in Rupali about her decision, but Rupali disapproves of it. Just then, Vikrant drives Isha away and rebukes her for taking the decisions regarding their relationship alone. The Jogtin visits Pushpa and asks for alms, assuring that everything will be fine. On Vikrant’s insistence, Isha tries to talk to her father, but he avoids her.

episodesList.title: Episode 121
episodesList.summary: Pushpa packs Isha’s bag and tells Isha that she is taking her to Pinky’s house in Pune. However, Pushpa takes Isha to meet Vikrant and asks Vikrant to take Isha away and marry her. Vikrant refuses saying he will wait until Mr Nimkar consents to it. Mr Nimkar calls Pinky and realises that Pushpa lied. After Isha and Pushpa return home, Mr Nimkar confronts them regarding their whereabouts and Pushpa divulges everything. Later, Mr Nimkar reveals to Pushpa about Vikrant’s first marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 122
episodesList.summary: Mr Nimkar thinks that Vikrant has cheated on them by not telling them about his ex-wife, but Isha says that Vikrant never wanted to hide it, and hence, he mentioned the same in the file. Mr Nimkar asks Isha whether Vikrant’s family would accept her the way Vikrant does. Just then, Aaisaheb arrives with Vikrant and tells Mr Nimkar that Vikrant never thought of a second marriage until he met Isha and he is highly eligible. After everyone’s reassurance, Mr Nimkar finally agrees for the marriage.

episodesList.title: Episode 123
episodesList.summary: Aaisaheb informs all the Saranjame family members about Vikrant’s marriage. Sonya is disappointed due to Isha’s low status, but Aaisaheb and Vikrant convince her to accompany them to the Nimkars’ house to talk about the particulars of the marriage. Vikrant apprises Mayra and Jhende about the marriage proceedings and asks Mayra to plan a simple wedding. The Nimkars are busy with the preparations of welcoming the Saranjames. After reaching the Nimkars’ house, Vikrant introduces his family members.

episodesList.title: Episode 124
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 125
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 126
episodesList.summary: Vikrant’s family members give suggestions for the design of the Mangalsutra, but Vikrant asks them to talk to Mayra. Pinky arrives at the Nimkars’ house and announces that she’ll be staying until Isha’s wedding. On Vikrant’s instructions, Mayra comes to Isha’s house to show the shortlisted Mangalsutra to Isha. On Jhende’s insistence, Vikrant himself decides to finalise the Mangalsutra with Isha and calls her to the office. Vikrant is irked to learn that Pushpa and Pinky have accompanied Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 127
episodesList.summary: After calling Isha to his cabin, Vikrant escapes with her from the fire exit and takes her to buy the Mangalsutra. Isha makes Vikrant choose her Mangalsutra while she buys a bracelet for him with her own money. Pinky gets annoyed as she and Pushpa had to wait and couldn’t even select the Mangalsutra. She warns Isha against meeting Vikrant before marriage. Rupali and Isha share a friendly banter. The next day, the Nimkars, along with Pinky, go to Vikrant’s office to see the invitation card.

episodesList.title: Episode 128
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 129
episodesList.summary: Pinky says she will come for the ‘Vyahi Bhojan’ only if she gets an invitation. Isha’s parents distribute Isha’s wedding invites in their locality and their neighbours are overawed by the grandeur of the invitation. Aaisaheb calls Mr Nimkar to give them a special invitation for the ‘Vyahi Bhojan’. Pinky is upset as Aaisaheb didn’t call her, but Isha and Mr Nimkar trick her into accompanying them. The Nimkars are mesmerised to see the Saranjame house. Sonya prepares street food for the Nimkars.

episodesList.title: Episode 130
episodesList.summary: Everyone picks the clothes of their choice. Pinky doesn’t like the sarees individually and demands to have the designs of five different sarees in one. The designer refuses, but Vikrant buys their company and orders the designer to make customisation possible. When Vikrant shows Isha her wedding saree, she tells him that she wants to wear the Rajnandini saree gifted by her father instead. Later, the Nimkars are troubled by the paparazzi and Vikrant orders Mayra and Jhende to look after the same.

episodesList.title: Episode 131
episodesList.summary: Ranjana badmouths Isha in front of the paparazzi. Vikrant encourages Isha to face the paparazzi by giving them their answers. People threaten to blacken Isha’s face when she comes out of the house and bombard her with questions. Isha patiently answers all the questions and explains how her and Vikrant’s relationship is pure. She reiterates that love knows no boundaries. Everyone applauds Isha. The next day, the family members and neighbours gift Isha her favourite things, making her emotional.

episodesList.title: Episode 132
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 133
episodesList.summary: The 'Mehendi' ceremony of Vikrant and Isha starts with a trivia of their love story which builds excitement amongst all. Myra makes each person enact a situation from the couple's love story. Vikrant volunteers for his turn and takes the opportunity to draw 'Mehendi', henna tattoo on Isha's hands after a romantic performance. At the end of the day, the men enjoy a bonfire and drinks while Jhende helps them. Amidst this, Vikrant and Isha share a sweet moment under the sky.

episodesList.title: Episode 134
episodesList.summary: Vikrant asks Isha to call him by his name. She tells Vikrant that she wishes to have their home at the wedding venue. Vikrant declares that he’s won the 'mehendi' bet and romances Isha. Late at night, Isha wakes up in a shock after having a nightmare and encounters Aaisaheb outside her room. Pushpa panics after not finding any pestle to prepare the turmeric, but Mayra calms her down by showing the imported samples of turmeric. Rupali makes Vikrant jealous by raving about Isha’s beauty.

episodesList.title: Episode 135
episodesList.summary: Jaydeep announces that he wants to make a museum of the Saranjame family members, which will have their wax statues. Mayra engages Isha and Vikrant in an interesting ring-finding game. The Nimkars and Saranjames have a dance competition during the 'sangeet'. The next day, Rupali and Bipin manage to hide Vikrant’s shoes, much to Sonya’s disappointment. Vikrant faints during the wedding proceedings as he forgets to take his medicine. Later, Vikrant amends a few customs of the wedding.

episodesList.title: Episode 136
episodesList.summary: At the post event press conference, Vikrant and Isha arrive for the very first time as a married couple. Jhende consoles Myra and appreciates her courage as she weeps profusely at the wedding event. Amidst weeping family members, a teary-eyed Isha bids farewell to the Nimkars while Vikrant assures them that the Saranjame family would always keep her happy. Later, Aaisaheb and the rest of the Saranjame family members welcome Isha to their residence with great enthusiasm.

episodesList.title: Episode 137
episodesList.summary: Isha serves a dish to all the friends, relatives and colleagues. Rupali calls her to ask about her whereabouts while the others retire to their rooms. Isha knocks at the door of a room but Vikrant asks her to wait for some time. Vikrant's servant escorts her to a room where she relaxes and recalls some sweet memories. Vikrant walks in and tries to talk but finds Isha fast asleep. Later, Vikrant calls Jhende as he gets disturbed after finding a gift from Jalinder in his room.

episodesList.title: Episode 138
episodesList.summary: Vikrant gets ready for office and Isha wakes up to realise that she's late. She waves him goodbye, and then, accidentally enters Sonya's room. Aaisaheb meets her and tells her that she is happy with Isha's arrival in Vikrant's life. Mayra gets upset with Vikrant for shouting at her during a call. Mr. Nimkar is shocked and tensed on learning about the marriage expenses from Mayra. Jaydeep and Isha discover a new relationship between them. An infuriated Vikrant orders Jhende to find Jalindar.

episodesList.title: Episode 139
episodesList.summary: Jaydeep makes Isha sit on a chair next to Vikrant's, which makes Aaisaheb happy and Sonya bored. Isha readies the dinner with Manda and Bobby while Sonya makes fun of her. Sitting in the office, Vikrant constantly calls Jhende for updates on finding Jalindar. He then reaches home late and feels sorry seeing Isha waiting for him. The next day starts with the Saranjames offering prayers. Elsewhere, Mr Nimkar collects money for selling their house and this makes Pushpa break into tears.

episodesList.title: Episode 140
episodesList.summary: Isha seeks Aaisaheb’s permission to make sesame laddus for everyone and calls Pushpa for the recipe. Isha surprises Vikrant, who later gets upset when Isha enquires about the closed room. Mr Nimkar pleads with Pushpa, Rupali and Bipin to not tell Isha about selling the house. Isha stuns the Saranjame ladies by finding the old moulds to make the sweets. Isha gets emotional reminiscing about the Sankranti memories and Jaydeep plans a surprise for her.

episodesList.title: Episode 141
episodesList.summary: Mayra disapproves of Vikrant’s attire. Vikrant reprimands Mayra for under-estimating Isha. Jaydeep calls Vikrant and invites him for the kite festival. Mayra is proven wrong when Isha calls Vikrant to remind him to take his medicine. Isha distributes ‘Tilguds’ to everyone, but Sonya doesn’t accept it. Later, Isha challenges Vikrant to identify the special ‘Tilgud’ that she made for him, and he wins the challenge. After welcoming everyone to the kite festival, Jaydeep gifts a gold kite to Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 142
episodesList.summary: Isha cuts her finger by mistake during the kite-flying competition. She encounters Jalindar while chasing the kite and gets shocked. Vikrant fails to catch Jalindar. Later, Jalindar calls on Isha’s phone and threatens Vikrant. Vikrant fires his security and calls for police protection. Isha invites her parents for her ‘Haldi Kumkum’. The next day, Aaisaheb asks Isha to wear a 'Rajnandini' saree for the ‘Haldi Kumkum’ and Vikrant compliments Isha’s looks.

episodesList.title: Episode 143
episodesList.summary: Mr Nimkar and Pushpa bid adieu to their neighbours. Everyone becomes emotional and tries in vain to convince them to stay. The ‘Jogtin’ visits the Saranjame house and asks Isha to visit Goddess Amba’s temple before the problems take a toll on her. Vikrant calls Isha and reprimands her for stepping out of the house and not keeping her phone with her. Isha’s parents reach for the ‘Haldi Kumkum’ and keep their luggage away to avoid Isha’s questions. Pushpa brings ‘Poliche Ladu’ for Isha's in-laws.

episodesList.title: Episode 144
episodesList.summary: Isha’s parents leave after the ‘Haldi Kumkum’. Despite Mr Nimkar’s refusal, Vikrant asks the driver to drop them home. However, they get off the car midway but ask the driver to lie that he has dropped them home. A stranger offers food to them. They decide to spend the night at Goddess Amba’s temple. When a worried Isha calls them, Mr Nimkar switches the phone off. The next morning, when Isha and Vikrant visit the temple, Pushpa spots Isha, but Mr Nimkar warns her against talking to Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 145
episodesList.summary: Pushpa sends Mr Nimkar away and calls Isha. However, Mr Nimkar catches her calling and switches the phone off. Mr Nimkar hides behind the beggars while Isha and Vikrant distribute clothes to them. Isha feels her parents’ presence in the temple, but Vikrant tells her that it’s because she is missing them. Mayra shows Isha’s cabin to Vikrant, who later puts his and Isha’s picture frame in the meeting room. Will Isha learn about her parents’ truth after visiting her maternal house?

episodesList.title: Episode 146
episodesList.summary: Mayra expresses her disapproval about Vikrant not maintaining uniformity in the rules and favouring Isha. Vikrant says that he is doing so as he loves Isha. Isha searches for her father, but cannot find him anywhere. When Isha doesn’t answer Vikrant’s calls, Mayra says that Isha doesn’t value him. Vikrant lashes out at Isha for making everyone wait for her. The picture frame in the meeting room falls and breaks, leaving Vikrant disturbed. Later, Isha tells Vikrant about her parents.

episodesList.title: Episode 147
episodesList.summary: Vikrant suspects Jalindar to be behind the sudden disappearance of Isha’s parents, and orders Jhende to find him at any cost. Jaydeep informs Vikrant that an unidentified bag has been found in the house. After reaching home, Vikrant finds cash in the bag. After interrogating the guards, Vikrant learns that the bag was left by Isha’s parents. Isha cries the whole night while Vikrant tries to comfort her. When Jaydeep suggests buying a satellite to locate Isha’s parents, Vikrant reprimands him.

episodesList.title: Episode 148
episodesList.summary: Jhende’s men find Isha’s parents. An emotional Isha expresses her disappointment to her parents for keeping her in the dark about everything. Vikrant returns the house to Isha’s parents without hurting their sentiments and gives them a piece of his mind, and they apologise to Isha. Isha thanks Vikrant and kisses him. At the office, everyone notices the lipstick mark on Vikrant’s cheek. At home, Isha decides to prepare ‘Poliche Ladu’ for Vikrant, despite the servants’ refusal.

episodesList.title: Episode 149
episodesList.summary: Isha offers ‘Poliche Ladu’ to Vikrant, who tells her that he doesn’t like them much, much to Isha’s surprise. Sarjerao gets the rice cooker for Isha, who then learns that Mayra takes care of the expenses of the entire house and the overall diet for all. Isha sends the ‘Poliche Ladu’ to her parents and makes them happy. Pushpa decides to send Kheer for Vikrant in return. Sonya cribs about Mayra and Isha to Vikrant. Isha prepares Indian breakfast for Vikrant, keeping his calorie count in mind.

episodesList.title: Episode 150
episodesList.summary: Sonya is surprised to see Isha bring tea for her. Isha suggests Sonya to take the house’s responsibility, and she obliges, thinking it will create a rift between Mayra and Isha. Isha’s parents visit the Saranjame house and get ‘kheer’ for Vikrant. Vikrant calls Isha’s parents to his room and asks Mr Nimkar to not call him sir and make him feel like an outsider. Sonya surprises everyone by taking charge of the kitchen. Mayra learns that Isha has rejected the exotic vegetables ordered by her

episodesList.title: Episode 151
episodesList.summary: The local vegetable vender comes to the Saranjame house. While buying the vegetables, Isha calls Pushpa and asks her to bargain with the vender. Later, the guards throw the vender out of the house on Mayra’s orders. At the dining table, Isha suggests Vikrant to give the house’s responsibility to Sonya and he obliges. Mr Nimkar thinks about taking up a part-time job. At office, Vikrant hands over the Khandelwal project to Mayra and tells her about giving the house’s responsibility to Sonya.

episodesList.title: Episode 152
episodesList.summary: Vikrant calls for a meeting and hands over the chequebook used for the house’s expenses to Sonya. A delighted Sonya celebrates her happiness with Jaydeep and Bobby by cutting a cake. Later, Sonya calls for a meeting and asks everyone if they trust her. Further, as the leader of the house, she asks Vikrant to open the closed room for everyone. When Vikrant refuses, she asks him to open it for Isha as it’s her right. Vikrant gets furious at Isha and angrily gives her the keys of the room.

episodesList.title: Episode 153
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 154
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 155
episodesList.summary: Mr Nimkar and Pushpa worry about making Vikrant comfortable. The men in the neighbourhood try to hear Isha and Vikrant’s conversation, and they purposely talk about their honeymoon. Jaydeep misses Isha, who informs Aaisaheb about their stay at her maternal house. Isha gets surprised to see Vikrant wear a ‘lungi’. Rupali and Bipin take the couple to eat a special ‘paan’. Isha’s parents sleep outside the house and insist the couple to sleep inside. Later, the couple shares a candid conversation.

episodesList.title: Episode 156
episodesList.summary: After spending a few romantic moments with each other, Isha takes Vikrant to the terrace, where they reminisce about some candid moments from the past. In the morning, Vikrant and Isha leave to go to the Saranjame house. Pushpa calls Aaisaheb and praises Vikrant. Aaisaheb asks Mr Paranjpe to come home in the evening with the lawyer and some important papers. She informs all the family members about the meeting through a text. Later, Isha gets some strange feelings regarding the meeting.

episodesList.title: Episode 157
episodesList.summary: In the meeting, Aaisaheb announces that she wishes to transfer the Saranjame property to Vikrant. However, the lawyer says that according to the legal papers, she can transfer the property to anyone except Vikrant. This angers Aaisaheb. Vikrant says that he himself had asked Dadasaheb to include this clause to win his trust. Jhende leaves the meeting in anger and Vikrant chases him. When Vikrant asks Jhende the reason for being upset, he slaps Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Episode 158
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tells Jhende that he is lucky to have Isha in his life. He adds that he married Isha and won her and her family’s trust in order to use Isha to acquire the Saranjame property. The next morning, Isha gets scared listening to the gunshots and Aaisaheb tells her that Vikrant does shooting when in stress. Isha goes out and stops Vikrant, who apologises to her for breaking her trust. However, Isha says that she loves him even more after learning that he doesn’t own the property.

episodesList.title: Episode 159
episodesList.summary: When Jhende calls an apple a banana and a banana an apple, Mayra considers him ill. Jaydeep tells Vikrant that he doesn’t deserve the property. Vikrant concludes saying that the title of the property is not a concern. Jaydeep doesn’t take the pen drive loaded with property details. Jhende asks Vikrant how he will prove that Isha is Rajnandini’s reincarnation. Vikrant anticipates Isha's each move when she comes to return the pen drive. He tells Jhende that he could mould Isha the way he wants.

episodesList.title: Episode 160
episodesList.summary: Vikrant gets angry when the employees discuss about apples and bananas, while Mayra plans for Jhende’s psychological tests. Later, Vikrant narrates to Jhende how he won Dadasaheb’s trust and was planning to acquire the property through Rajnandini. However, her sudden demise left him disturbed, until he met Isha and confirmed that he can prove her Rajnandini’s reincarnation. He shows Jhende the newspaper article that gave him hope. He reveals his evil intentions behind winning the Nimkars’ trust.

episodesList.title: Episode 161
episodesList.summary: Pushpa asks her neighbours for solutions on reducing stress and gets surprised with Mahimkar’s suggestion. Elsewhere, Jhende tries to make Vikrant understand that he can get the property without proving Isha Rajnandini’s reincarnation, but Vikrant says that he has waited long enough. Vikrant further decides to make Isha join office again. On Jhende’s request, Aaisaheb asks Isha to join office. However, Vikrant says that he doesn’t have stress and disapproves of Isha helping him out.

episodesList.title: Episode 162
episodesList.summary: Jhende questions Vikrant for opposing Isha’s decision when he actually wants her to come to the office. While Vikrant is confident that Isha will come to the office, she decides otherwise. Vikrant fixes a meeting with Khandelwal the next morning and pretends to have forgotten it in order to prove that he is in stress. At the office, while Vikrant awaits Isha, Jaydeep shows up and tells Vikrant that he has come to share his workload on Isha’s suggestion. Vikrant asks Jaydeep to hold the meetings.

episodesList.title: Episode 163
episodesList.summary: To Vikrant and Jhende's utter disbelief, Jaydeep handles the meeting exceptionally well. However, upon Mr. Milind's insistence, when Jaydeep agrees to meet him for a few minutes, Milind manages to lure him into coming for the demo of one of his products and Jaydeep ends up postponing a meeting due to it. Meanwhile, Isha informs Aaisaheb about Jaydeep's progress in the office. Upon Vikrant's instruction, Milind finally manages to cajole Jaydeep into buying the product at an exorbitant price.

episodesList.title: Episode 164
episodesList.summary: Milind isn’t satisfied with the deal, but Jhende threatens him with a gun. Jaydeep gets a time-machine and asks Vikrant to try it in order to relieve his stress. However, Jaydeep feels dejected as the machine doesn’t work. Vikrant blames himself for the loss of INR 3.5 crore. Aaisaheb chides Isha for sending Jaydeep to help out Vikrant instead of going herself. Later, Isha apologises to Vikrant. The next day, much to Jhende’s surprise, Isha shows up at office.

episodesList.title: Episode 165
episodesList.summary: Vikrant announces to the office staff about Isha re-joining the office. Isha is overwhelmed to see her new cabin. She calls Mr Nimkar and informs him about having a cabin of her own. A dejected Mihir tells Mayra that he cannot accept Isha as her boss and gives his resignation. After learning about it from Mayra, Vikrant apprises Isha of the same. Later, Isha asks Mihir to take his resignation back and tells him that she will only sit in the cabin after proving herself.

episodesList.title: Episode 166
episodesList.summary: Jhende worries about Isha gaining popularity, but Vikrant relaxes him. Isha tells Mayra that she would like to be called Mrs. Saranjame. Later, Mayra, Mrs. Wadkar and Mr. Paranjpe inform Isha that the Rajnandini factory in Borivali is incurring losses, hence they will have to reduce the workers. They ask Isha to take the action soon. Isha confides in her father about the workload. Mayra feels Isha isn’t capable of taking quick action. Vikrant asks Isha to take a break and meet him.

episodesList.title: Episode 167
episodesList.summary: Vikrant makes coffee for Isha. She tries to seek his help to take the factory’s decision, but he asks her to take a decision on her own. Just then, she gets inspired reading a message in the ‘Fortune Cookies’. She decides to study the company’s records of the past 25 years, which surprises everyone. Jaydeep looks for something interesting to gift Isha. Later, Isha takes the files home and decides to study them all night. Vikrant tries to get intimate with her, but she asks him to sleep.

episodesList.title: Episode 168
episodesList.summary: Isha is happy to see Vikrant sleeping in peace and doesn’t wake him up on time. She instructs Aaisaheb not to disturb him until he wakes up on his own and hands his phone to her. Everyone in the office is surprised at Vikrant being late. Jhende pleads with Aaisaheb to wake Vikrant up. Later at the office, Paranjpe praises Isha’s work in front of Vikrant, who finds it ordinary. When Isha calls Vikrant to apologise, he makes her say 'I love you' loudly, after which, Mayra summons her to her cabin.

episodesList.title: Episode 169
episodesList.summary: Mayra fusses about Isha making a lot of errors in her work. Jhende suggests Vikrant to insult Isha in front of everyone. An excited Rupali shares Isha’s result with the Nimkars, making them feel proud. At the office, Vikrant declares Isha as the best employee of the month and praises her work. Isha rebukes Vikrant for being partial towards her. Ganya tells Mr Nimkar that his job is at risk since their shop doesn’t have the dealership of Rajnandini sarees. Vikrant badmouths Isha and her parents.

episodesList.title: Episode 170
episodesList.summary: Isha’s parents visit her office with sweets and share the news of her being a graduate with everyone. Everyone congratulates Isha. Mr Nimkar tells Isha and Mayra that he wants the dealership of the Rajnandini sarees back, but they ask him to speak to Vikrant. Mr Nimkar tells Vikrant that he wants to sell the shop to his boss in order to get the dealership back and Vikrant supports his decision. At home, Jaydeep suggests celebrating Isha’s result. Aaisaheb is disturbed after reading something.

episodesList.title: Episode 171
episodesList.summary: Jhende asks Aaisaheb why she is disturbed. A shocked Aaisaheb tells him that Isha has got the exact same percentage as Rajnandini. Vikrant gives a surprise to Isha. He also gifts her a slam book. In the office, Mayra asks Isha to sign some legal documents, but she refuses to sign it before reading it. When Jhende complains to Vikrant about it, he says that it’s a part of his plan. Mr Nimkar sells his shop to his boss. Later, Isha gets an idea from Vikrant while talking to him about her parents.

episodesList.title: Episode 172
episodesList.summary: Mihir reminds Isha to sign the documents, but she says that she is thinking of a solution. While shopping, Jaydeep tells Sonya that he wants to assist Isha since he has a lot to learn from her and Sonya supports him. Isha calls for a meeting and puts forth a solution for the factory problem. She says that they can sell off the loss-making unit and shift its employees to the other unit instead of removing them. Vikrant approves the idea. Isha plans a Sunday surprise for the family with Jaydeep.

episodesList.title: Episode 173
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the Saranjame house finds a note saying they need to come to a room without telling anyone about it. However, everyone lands up gathering in the same room. Isha and Jaydeep reveal that the note was written by them and share their plan of doing a collective activity every Sunday. All of them decide to play cricket. Isha sprains her leg while fielding and Vikrant calls out Rajnandini’s name, shocking everyone. Later, Vikrant carries Isha to the room and tends to her injury.

episodesList.title: Episode 174
episodesList.summary: Vikrant asks Isha to punish him with a hunter for calling her Rajnandini. When she refuses, Vikrant punishes himself. Aaisaheb tells Jhende that she sees traits of Rajnandini in Isha. Vikrant tells Isha that he had pledged not to think about Rajnandini. Jaydeep tells Sonya that he feels a certain warmth in Isha. Vikrant decides to be unreachable throughout the day to make Isha feel alone at the office. Mihir informs Mayra about the labour contractor being livid with Isha’s decision.

episodesList.title: Episode 175
episodesList.summary: Isha learns that Vikrant has gone to meet her parents. The contract labourers arrive at office and criticise Isha’s decision. Isha asks them to give their problems in writing, but they don’t budge and threaten to go on a strike if their demands are not met in a day. Vikrant orders a pizza for Mr Nimkar instead of taking his tiffin to him. He sarcastically compliments Pushpa’s culinary skills. Vikrant learns about Isha having a nightmare every ‘Ashtami’, which proves to be a coincidence.

episodesList.title: Episode 176
episodesList.summary: Mr Paranjpe explains to Isha why the contract labourers have a problem with shutting the unit down. Isha reaches home and learns that Vikrant isn’t home yet. However, Isha is surprised to find Vikrant in the room. Vikrant warns Isha against talking about work at home. Isha has a nightmare and behaves strangely. When Aaisaheb and Jaydeep come to her room, she tells them that it’s a usual occurrence at the night of ‘Ashtami’. A shocked Aaisaheb confirms the same with Mr Nimkar.

episodesList.title: Episode 177
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 178
episodesList.summary: Vikrant rebukes the entire staff for being unaware of the ongoing fraud despite working with the company for several years. Mihir raises a doubt at Isha’s stand, but she says that she’s done the research. Jaydeep gets Isha’s parents to the office and asks Isha to enter the cabin since she has proven her worth. Aaisaheb is upset as Isha didn’t solve the matter the way she was expecting. Even Vikrant is surprised at Isha’s intelligence. Rajesh and Sudhir visit the person responsible for the fraud.

episodesList.title: Episode 179
episodesList.summary: Rajesh and Sudhir consult Vikrant for their future plan of action. Vikrant gets irked to find Isha studying the files at home. He tells Jhende that Isha will pay the price for delving deep into the matter. The next day, everyone treats Isha with respect at the office. Vikrant comforts Isha when she gets worried at not being able to find the name of the fraudster. When Vikrant fires the labour contractors, Isha tells him that they should keep them on their jobs in order to reach the fraudster.

episodesList.title: Episode 180
episodesList.summary: Vikrant thanks Isha for reminding him of his values. At night, Vikrant calls Mayra and says that he misses her. The next day, Mayra comes to office decked up and eagerly waits for Vikrant. Vikrant gets frustrated on learning about a get-together from Aaisaheb. Sonya congratulates Isha and thanks her for bringing a change in Jaydeep. The Nimkars, Bipin and Rupali come to the Saranjame house and Aaisaheb tells them that she will be gifting Rajnandini’s ‘Tanmani’, a Maharashtrian ornament, to Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 181
episodesList.summary: Vikrant asks Mayra to schedule the monthly meeting the same day. He ignores Isha’s calls throughout the meeting. Isha gives a tour around the Saranjame bungalow to Rupali and Bipin. Later, Isha takes them to her room, where they have a hearty conversation. Elsewhere, Vikrant praises Mayra and asks her to not lose her hold on the company. Isha’s parents tell Aaisaheb that Isha is lucky to have such caring in-laws. Sonya tries to teach the right pronunciation of her name to Isha’s parents.

episodesList.title: Episode 182
episodesList.summary: On everyone’s insistence, Isha agrees to have dinner in Vikrant’s absence. Late at night, Vikrant arrives and rebukes Isha for eating without him. On seeing Isha wearing Rajnandini’s ‘Tanmani’, he takes it away from her. An emotional Vikrant returns the ‘Tanmani’ to Aaisaheb and warns her against seeing Rajnandini in Isha. Later, Vikrant angrily leaves the house. The next day, Aaisaheb asks Isha to go to her parents' for a few days. At office, FM helps Isha retrieve a file she forgets to save.

episodesList.title: Episode 183
episodesList.summary: After welcoming Isha, Mr Nimkar surprises her with her favourite snack. The next morning, Isha offers to prepare breakfast. Pushpa repeatedly asks Isha whether her in-laws talk about Rajnandini, which irks Isha. After a hearty chat, Rupali too asks Isha about the same, but she evades the topic. At the office, when Isha says that she is unaware of Vikrant’s whereabouts, Mayra feels that she is hiding it owing to her jealousy while Jhende suspects Jalindar behind it. Later, Isha misses Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Episode 184
episodesList.summary: On learning about FM’s interest in doing a computer course, Isha announces that the company will sponsor the fees of the course. Isha tells Mayra and Jhende that she wants to go for lunch with them. When Aaisaheb chides Jaydeep for not being bothered for Vikrant, Sonya chastises her for entertaining Vikrant’s selfish behaviour and never asking him for an explanation. Isha lies about Vikrant’s whereabouts to her parents. During the lunch, Isha asks Jhende and Mayra about their past.

episodesList.title: Episode 185
episodesList.summary: Sonya takes Jaydeep to the Nimkars’ house. On learning about Sonya and Jaydeep’s visit from Pushpa, Isha leaves for home in a hurry. Meanwhile, Sonya reveals to Isha’s parents about Vikrant leaving the house in anger. After Isha arrives, Pushpa confronts her for hiding it from them. Isha promises to handle the situation wisely the next time onwards. Elsewhere, Aaisaheb worries for Isha. Jaydeep expresses his disapproval at Sonya telling everything to the Nimkars in front of Aaisaheb.

episodesList.title: Episode 186
episodesList.summary: Isha’s parents try to cheer her up. Later, Isha speaks her heart out to Rupali, who suggests her to resort to her old remedy and asks her to go to the Ganesh Temple. While Isha goes to pray to god, Rupali calls Vikrant and informs that Isha is in the temple. Vikrant comes there, but to his surprise, Isha doesn’t talk to him. She taunts him for disappearing without informing her. Afterwards, Vikrant calls Mr Nimkar, but Isha refuses to talk to him. Vikrant informs Jhende that he had gone to Pune.

episodesList.title: Episode 187
episodesList.summary: While Mr Nimkar worries about Isha and Vikrant’s dispute, Pushpa tries to comfort him. When Vikrant calls Rupali to know Isha’s whereabouts, Isha makes her lie to him and leaves. In the morning, Vikrant visits the Nimkars and learns that Isha’s gone to Karjat. On being confronted, Rupali reveals the truth to him. On reaching home, Aaisaheb rebukes Vikrant for hurting Isha, leaving Sonya and Jaydeep stunned. Vikrant orders Jhende to search for Isha. But, Isha hides in the Saranjame house itself.

episodesList.title: Episode 188
episodesList.summary: Sonya and Jaydeep are surprised to learn that Isha was in the house itself. Isha reveals that she deliberately hid in order to teach Vikrant a lesson. Vikrant becomes livid as Jhende is unable to find Isha, and his blood pressure shoots up. On learning about Vikrant being unwell, Isha rushes to office. Mayra blames Isha for Vikrant’s condition and gives her a warning. Later, Jhende is amazed at finding Vikrant faking his sickness. At home, Vikrant apologises to everyone for his behaviour.

episodesList.title: Episode 189
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Episode 190
episodesList.summary: Vikrant rebukes Isha for going to Rajesh’s house without informing him. Rajesh has a war of words with his wife for letting Isha in the house. The Nimkars visits the Saranjame house with gifts for everyone. Mr Nimkar tells Aaisaheb about the profitable business of Rajnandini sarees. When an infuriated Vikrant refuses to come out of the secret room, Isha lies to her parents that he is busy with work. Before the Nimkars leave, Sonya tells them about Vikrant’s habit of going to the secret room.

episodesList.title: Episode 191
episodesList.summary: After comparing Isha’s birthdate with Rajnandini’s death anniversary, Aaisaheb tells Jaydeep that she sees Rajnandini in Isha, but Jaydeep laughs it off. Pushpa is disturbed as her neighbours co-incidentally talk about strange things about closed rooms. Later, seeing Isha wearing Rajnandini’s saree, Vikrant lashes out at her. Pushpa calls Sonya to know more about the closed room, and Sonya tells her to confront Vikrant with it. Afterwards, Vikrant apologises to Isha.

episodesList.title: Episode 192
episodesList.summary: The Saranjames are stunned when Sonya gets ready to go to the Nimkars’ house with them. After reaching there, the Saranjames are warmly welcomed by Isha’s parents. Rupali gets ‘pakoras’ for the guests, while Bipin applies colour to everyone. Sonya encourages a nervous Pushpa to ask Vikrant about the closed room. After a failed attempt, Pushpa gathers her courage and asks him about it, but Vikrant remains silent. Later, Vikrant puts colour on Isha’s face, which shocks everyone.

episodesList.title: Episode 193
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Isha go outside to join others in the Holi celebrations and everyone is shocked to see that Isha, who is scared of colours, has come to join them to play Holi. Aaisaheb and Jaydeep discuss the similarities between Rajnandini and Isha. Meanwhile, Sonya and Pushpa discuss as to why Vikrant is not telling them what is hidden behind the closed door. At night, Vikrant calls up Jhende to devise a plan to use Isha's fear of colours against her.

episodesList.title: Episode 194
episodesList.summary: Jhende arrives at Vikrant's house with a bag full of colourful masks, but Vikrant announces that he has decided to cancel the plan as he believes that the masks won't scare Isha. Elsewhere, Rajesh is packing up to leave the city when Isha arrives at his place and requests him to share the culprit's name. But, Rajesh does not pay heed to her request. Later, Isha receives an SMS with the culprit's name. Isha goes to the office and shares the name with Vikrant and Jhende, further shocking them.

episodesList.title: Episode 195
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Jhende get a schock of their life when Isha reveals the culprit's name. Isha states that they should go to the police and file a complaint, but Vikrant assures her that he will personally look into the matter. Jhende worries about Isha revealing the name to Aaisaheb as it will unveil Vikrant's secret. At home, when Isha is about to reveal the name, Vikrant calls her and asks her to meet him. Later, Vikrant and Jhende come up with a plan to safeguard Vikrant's secret.

episodesList.title: Episode 196
episodesList.summary: Along with Sonya, a curious Pushpa devise a plan to find out the secret hidden inside the closed room. After Vikrant emotionally blackmails Isha and assures her that he will protect the person providing her the information, Isha reveals Rajesh's name. After a while, Vikrant goes into the closed room, but a few moments later, Sonya sees Vikrant sneaking out of the house. When Sonya informs Isha about the same, Isha does not believe her. Elsewhere, Vikrant and Jhende pay a visit to Rajesh.

episodesList.title: Episode 197
episodesList.summary: Isha notices Vikrant limping and questions him about it. The next morning, Pushpa arrives at Isha's home stating that she was invited by Sonya, as the latter wants to learn how to prepare 'Papad' and 'Chakli'. At the office, Vikrant questions Jhende if he has been able to find anybody who will readily take the blame of being the culprit. Meanwhile, at home, Manda Tai overhears Pushpa and Sonya plotting to find the secret behind the closed door.

episodesList.title: Episode 198
episodesList.summary: Vikrant berates Isha for questioning him about the office matters in front of the family. Isha informs Vikrant that she won't give up until the culprit is caught. A frustrated Vikrant calls Jhende to check if he was successful in locating somebody who will readily take the blame, but Jhende informs him that no one is ready to do so. On family's insistence, Pushpa agrees to stay back at Isha's home. The next morning, Isha decides to go to the office.

episodesList.title: Episode 199
episodesList.summary: Jhende informs Vikrant that he was successful in finding someone to take the blame of being the culprit. On getting to know that Isha is in the office talking to Paranjpe, Vikrant calls her up and informs that he has found the culprit and asks her to meet him. Isha arrives at the given location, where Jhende and Vikrant show her the culprit. At the office, Vikrant praises Isha for her efforts. When Isha puts in her resignation, Vikrant acts like he is not happy with this decision of hers.

episodesList.title: Episode 200
episodesList.summary: Jhende voices his concern to Vikrant about Isha still being able to find out the real identity of the culprit. At home, Aaisaheb praises Isha for her efforts. However, when Pushpa addresses the culprit by the name Gaja Patil, Aaisaheb faints. After regaining consciousness, Aaisaheb is about to reveal the connection between Gaja Patil and Vikrant but fails to do so due to Vikrant's intervention. Later, Vikrant urges Isha to stop discussing about Gaja Patil with anyone.

episodesList.title: Episode 201
episodesList.summary: Aaisaheb warns everyone against uttering Gaja Patil’s name. Isha is intrigued after learning about the same. Meanwhile, Jhende warns Sarjerao and Mr Paranjpe to remain quiet in Gaja Patil’s matter. Aaisaheb tells Isha that Vikrant loves her a lot, and she shouldn’t doubt the family members. Sonya makes Pushpa search for the key of the closed room in Isha and Vikrant’s room. After finding the key, Sonya takes its impression on a soap bar. Later, Vikrant spots them coming out of his room.

episodesList.title: Episode 202
episodesList.summary: Isha tries to retrieve information about Gaja Patil from Sarjerao and Mr Paranjpe, but they deny knowing anything. While Sonya and Pushpa are about to make a duplicate key of the closed room, Pushpa drops the plan as Mr Nimkar predicts the consequences of doing so. Vikrant rebukes Isha for trying to enter the room, but Pushpa confides the truth to him. Later, although Vikrant gives them the key, they decide against going inside. Afterwards, Mr Nimkar learns of Pushpa’s actions.

episodesList.title: Sonya plays a recording of Rajnandini to pacify an upset Jaydeep
episodesList.summary: Rupali opens up about her parents’ separation and asks Isha to trust Vikrant. An upset Jaydeep locks himself in a room. Sonya plays a story recorded by Rajnandini to appease him.

episodesList.title: Isha returns the key of Rajnandini’s room to Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Isha returns the key of the closed room to Vikrant. Aaisaheb’s belief about Isha being Rajnandini’s reincarnation grows stronger as Jaydeep shares Isha’s habit of telling stories.

episodesList.title: Isha receives shocking information
episodesList.summary: Isha goes to enrol Vikrant's name in the voting list. But it worries Vikrant, as it might reveal his secret. Later, the enrolment officer shares an information that shocks Isha.

episodesList.title: Sonya argues with Jaydeep and Aaisaheb for thinking that Isha is Rajnandin
episodesList.summary: Sonya argues with Jaydeep and Aaisaheb about their belief of Isha being Rajnandini. Elsewhere, Isha comes across Rajesh's neighbour and asks him about Rajesh's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Rajnandini's truth shocks Isha
episodesList.summary: Mr Paranjpe's revelation about Gaja Patil puzzles Isha. Aaisaheb apprises Isha and Vikrant of her decision to transfer her property to Isha. The truth about Rajnandini shocks Isha.

episodesList.title: Isha asks Vikrant's real name to Jaydeep
episodesList.summary: After learning about Rajnandini's truth, a shocked Isha asks Jaydeep about the real name of Vikrant. Later, Isha receives a call from Rajesh's neighbour, Shette.

episodesList.title: Sonya shares her suspicions about Vikrant with Isha
episodesList.summary: Sonya feels suspicious about Vikrant's intentions. Meanwhile, Aaisaheb invites Isha's parents for a special occasion. Later, Sonya's compassionate advice increases Isha's dilemma.

episodesList.title: Isha's condition for signing the papers shocks Vikrant and Jhende
episodesList.summary: Isha's refusal to sign the property papers shocks everyone. After Vikrant's persuasion, Isha agrees to sign the papers but her surprising condition appalls Vikrant and Jhende.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's attempt to make Isha accept Aaisaheb's decision
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tries to manipulate Isha into accepting the property. Later, Isha confides in Rupali that Vikrant's real name is Gaja Patil. A shocked Rupali then comes up with a plan.

episodesList.title: Isha discovers the real identity of disguised Gaja Patil
episodesList.summary: An Imam alerts Jhende about a woman who will wreak havoc in Vikrant's life. Isha discovers the real name of the disguised Gaja Patil. Later, an inquisitive Isha calls Jalinder.

episodesList.title: Jalindar's shocking revelations about Vikrant appalls Isha
episodesList.summary: Jalindar asks Isha to meet him in private. The news of Vikrant receiving an award delights everyone. When Isha meets Jalindar, he makes some shocking revelations about Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Isha's persistent efforts to find out Vikrant's truth
episodesList.summary: Isha refuses to go home with Vikrant. Later, Jhende warns Vikrant against protecting Isha. The next day, Isha goes in search of 'Devghare Chawl' to unravel Vikrant's truth.

episodesList.title: Isha learns about Vikrant's deceit
episodesList.summary: Pondering over Bipin's words, Isha searches the home for the clues. Later, Isha breaks down upon realising that each and every word of Vikrant about his past was a blatant lie.

episodesList.title: ‘Jogtin' advises Isha to seek help from goddess Ambabai
episodesList.summary: While everyone worries about Isha at home, 'Jogtin' saves her from an accident. Isha seeks answers from Goddess Ambabai. Later, the 'Jogtin' brings a devastated Isha home.

episodesList.title: The woman's face seen in the dream disturbs Isha
episodesList.summary: At night, the sound of anklets perturbs Vikrant. The next day, Vikrant warns Jhende against harming Isha. Later, Isha's revelation of seeing a woman's face startles Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's confession shocks Jhende
episodesList.summary: Pushpa reveals a secret that stuns Isha. A disturbed Vikrant confronts Isha about her changed behaviour. Later, Vikrant's shocking confession leaves Jhende speechless.

episodesList.title: Isha gets Rajnandini’s sketch made
episodesList.summary: Bipin’s friend, Akshay, makes a sketch of the woman Isha saw. Isha concludes that it’s Rajnandini. Mayra tries to cheer up Vikrant, who worries about Isha learning about his truth.

episodesList.title: Isha decides to meet Jalindar
episodesList.summary: Vikrant spends the night at Mayra's home. The next day, Jhende's spy tells him of Isha meeting Jalindar to enquire about the unknown face. But,, Vikrant refuses to believe Jhende.

episodesList.title: Vikrant learns about Isha's secretive liaison
episodesList.summary: Jalindar alerts Isha about Jhende spying on her. While Isha returns home, Jhende proves his point to Vikrant by producing the proof. Later, a furious Vikrant confronts Isha.

episodesList.title: Jalindar gets shot by Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Jalindar's quick-witted thinking saves Isha from Vikrant's wrath. Falling prey to Jalindar's ploy, when Vikrant and Jhende confront him, he ends up getting shot by Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Isha faces a shocking reality
episodesList.summary: Vikrant lies to Isha about his encounter with Jalindar. As Isha and Rupali visit the site of the incident to investigate the matter, they face a shocking reality which stuns them.

episodesList.title: Isha learns about Jalindar being alive
episodesList.summary: Jalindar's recount of his dangerous encounter with Vikrant leaves Isha speechless. The queer foresight of 'Jogtin' perturbs Isha. Vikrant's volatile behaviour infuriates Mayra.

episodesList.title: Isha confronts Vikrant
episodesList.summary: a distressed Isha confronts Vikrant about hiding his real identity from her. Later, Vikrant tries to manipulate Isha to gain her trust and assures her to reveal the truth. But, Vikrant's recount of the past events shocks Isha.

episodesList.title: The Closed Room
episodesList.summary: Vikrant's twisted version of truth increases Isha's dilemma. Later, Vikrant takes Isha to the closed room to make her believe him. However, appalled with the reality unfolding before her eyes, she falls unconscious.

episodesList.title: Calm Before The Storm
episodesList.summary: when Jaydeep refuses to eat, Rajnandini tells him a story to pacify him. Dadasaheb’s health deteriorates as he forgets to take his medicine. Later, Aaisaheb shows Rajnandini’s horoscope to the priest, who predicts an impending danger in her life.

episodesList.title: A Serendipitous Tragedy
episodesList.summary: Jalindar rejects Gajendra's candidature after he barges into Rajnandini and Jalindar's private meeting. An exasperated Gajendra returns home to his flatmate Jhende. Impressed by his charm and confidence, Rajnandini recommends him to Jalindar.

episodesList.title: Episode 229
episodesList.summary: Sherpulkar insinuates Gajendra, who gets into an altercation with Jalindar at work. Aaisaheb wishes to see her daughter settled while Dadasaheb is about to launch something special. Sherpulkar's revelation changes Gajendra's life forever!

episodesList.title: Episode 230
episodesList.summary: Gajendra meets Rajnandini in a temple and invites her to his home. While Rajnandini mulls over her feelings for Gajendra after visiting his house, Isha wakes up in her room with a start as the events of Rajnandini's life flashes past her eyes.

episodesList.title: Episode 231
episodesList.summary: Gajendra comes across one important document in office while going through some old files. Siezing the opportunity, he calls Rajnandini and passes on some confidential business information to create a rift between Jalindar and Rajnandini.

episodesList.title: Episode 232
episodesList.summary: Gajendra's cunning plan works successfully. Later, Rajnandini urges Dadasaheb to recruit him in their company. The next day, Dadasaheb and Aaisaheb worry about Rajnandini's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Gajendra professes his love to her.

episodesList.title: Episode 233
episodesList.summary: Rajnandini's confession shocks Dadasaheb and Aaisaheb. Soon enough, Rajnandini marries Gajendra and rechristens him as Vikrant. The next day, Jalindar proves his innocence to Dadasaheb and reveals Gajendra's involvement in the fraud.

episodesList.title: Episode 234
episodesList.summary: Dadasaheb condemns Gajendra's behaviour and insults him. At night, Gajendra manipulates Rajnandini against Dadasaheb. The next day, Rajnandini introduces Gajendra as Vikrant to everyone in office and reveals her shocking decision.

episodesList.title: Episode 235
episodesList.summary: Vikrant appoints Jhende in office. A 'Jogtin' alerts Rajnandini about an impending danger. Dadasaheb decides to use the workers' strike to his advantage. The next day, Paranjape's revelation of Vikrant's failure shocks Rajnandini.

episodesList.title: Episode 236
episodesList.summary: Rajnandini manages to end the workers' strike after Vikrant fails. Infuriated due to Vikrant's audacity, Dadasaheb insults him and later, he secretly changes his will. Thereafter, Dadasaheb falls unconscious due to an asthma attack.

episodesList.title: Dadasaheb's sudden demise
episodesList.summary: Dadasaheb's sudden demise anguishes Rajnandini and she seeks solace in Vikrant's arms. Vikrant's revelation on seeing the post-mortem report agonises Aaisaheb. Meanwhile, Sarajerao decides to reveal the truth to the police but Jhende threatens him.

episodesList.title: Episode 238
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Jhende attend the Dadasaheb's condolence meet. Advocate Dagde briefs Rajnandini about Dadasaheb's will and the changes he made. She informs about the changed will to Aaisaheb and Vikrant. Vikrant tries to pacify a shattered Aaisaheb.

episodesList.title: Episode 239
episodesList.summary: the lawyer's revelation about a special clause in Dadasaheb's will shocks Vikrant. Meanwhile, a mysterious message sent with a bouquet perturbs Rajnandini. Later, Rajnandini meets Jalindar who reveals Vikrant's truth, but Jhende spies on them.

episodesList.title: Episode 240
episodesList.summary: Jhende apprises Vikrant of Rajnandini and Jalindar's secret meeting. Vikrant regains Rajnandini's trust. He asks Jhende to kill Shirpurkar and plans to frame Jalindar. Dubious about her own judgements, Rajnandini mulls over the recent developments.

episodesList.title: Episode 241
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Rajnandini collects proofs against Vikrant
episodesList.summary: as per the plan, Paranjape provokes Jhende into confessing the truth in front of Vikrant in his cabin. Upon receiving the proof, Rajnandini regrets her blind faith in Vikrant. Later, she threatens to inform the police along with the proofs.

episodesList.title: Vikrant kills Rajnandini
episodesList.summary: As Rajnandini meets an unfortunate end at the hands of Vikrant, Isha who gets the flashes of it, wakes up in her room with a start. The next morning, Isha meets the 'Jogtin' to seek answers. Meanwhile, Vikrant and Aaisaheb worry about Isha's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Isha feels that she is Rajnandini's reincarnation
episodesList.summary: Isha feels confident about her being Rajnandini's reincarnation. Later, her recount of Rajnandini's life events shocks her parents. Meanwhile, Mayra informs Vikrant that Isha is at her parents' house. Isha's shocking revelation puts her parents in a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Vikrant sends a letter to Isha
episodesList.summary: Vikrant's sudden business trip to London pleases Jhende. Aaisaheb visits Isha and gives Vikrant's letter to her. Sonya and Jaydeep decide to find out the reason behind Isha's changed behaviour. Later, a stressed Isha shares her concerns with Bipin and Rupali.

episodesList.title: Everyone guess Isha to be Unhealthy
episodesList.summary: looking at Isha's disturbed state of mind, Bipin and Rupali decide to check whether she is suffering from any mental illness. Mr Nimkar also supports their idea. Pushpa thinks that Isha is possessed. Jhende appoints a man to keep an eye on Isha and her family.

episodesList.title: Sonya finds a book in Isha's room
episodesList.summary: Bipin and Mr Nimkar consult a psychiatrist regarding Isha's condition. Mr Nimkar repeatedly quizzes Isha about the books that she has read, the stories that she has heard, etc. While searching Isha's room, Sonya comes across a book which intrigues her.

episodesList.title: Mr Nimkar takes Isha to a psychiatrist
episodesList.summary: Rupali and Bipin's suggestion to consult a psychiatrist infuriates Isha. However, Mr. Nimkar pacifies her and takes her to the psychiatrist. Isha spots an unknown man there, whom she had seen in her dreams. Meanwhile, Jhende's spy follows them around.

episodesList.title: Isha decides to collect proof
episodesList.summary: Jhende is surprised on hearing about Isha's visit to a psychiatrist. Isha decides to collect proof to support her theory. The psychiatrist is left stunned on the confession of his receptionist.

episodesList.title: Isha finds the purpose of her life
episodesList.summary: Isha's return to the Saranjame house delights Aaisaheb and Jaydeep. Convinced that she is indeed Rajnandini's reincarnation, Isha finds the purpose of her life. Later, she decides to seek revenge for the injustice faced by Rajnandini and others.

episodesList.title: Isha's recount of the events
episodesList.summary: Mane admits that Isha's recount of the events might be true. The whole chain of events recounted by Isha stuns the psychiatrist as well. Jaydeep and Sonya worry about Isha's behaviour. Sarjerao's panicked reaction upon being asked about Sumit confuses Isha.

episodesList.title: The Next In The Line of Succession
episodesList.summary: Jhende learns about Isha being Rajnandini's reincarnation from Mane. Isha confides the truth in Sarjerao. Mane tells Mr Nimkar about Isha's life being in danger. Later, Isha declares in a meeting that the Saranjame business will now be handled by Jaydeep.

episodesList.title: Metamorphosis
episodesList.summary: Isha's decision to hand over the official responsibilities to Jaydeep startles everyone. Isha's changed behaviour becomes the topic of gossip in the office. Mr Nimkar and Pushpa come to stay at the Saranjame house. The overall situation at work bothers Jhende.

episodesList.title: A Drama Within Glass Offices
episodesList.summary: Jhende once again tries to prove that Jaydeep is incompetent to handle the business, but in vain. Sonya overhears Isha's conversation with her parents and Sarjerao. Jhende's conversation with the salesman makes Paranjape suspect that they have joined forces.

episodesList.title: Spiked!
episodesList.summary: Jhende mixes something in Jaydeep's tea, which negatively affects his sensibility. Isha's prudent advice eventually helps Aaisaheb recollect the past. Revealing her real identity to Paranjape, Isha secretly hides a microphone under Jaydeep's table.

episodesList.title: Chess Players With No Eyes
episodesList.summary: Isha and Paranjape intervene and expose the salesman. Upon being confronted, the salesman reveals the mastermind behind the plan. Expecting Jaydeep to be ousted, Mayra and Jhende rejoice.

episodesList.title: Revelation
episodesList.summary: Vikrant's true intentions shock Jaydeep. Isha tells Jaydeep that she is indeed Rajnandini. Sonya shows a movie to Isha's parents. Jaydeep's changed demeanour at work stuns Jhende and Mayra.

episodesList.title: Metamorphosis, pt. II
episodesList.summary: In Rajnandini's style, Isha intimates Jhende about his mistake and warns him against repeating it. Isha's overall demeanour reminds Jhende of Rajnandini and he starts panicking. Meanwhile, Isha's changed behaviour continues to worry her parents.

episodesList.title: A Brother's Grave In A Woman's Room
episodesList.summary: Isha takes Jaydeep to the locked room of Rajnandini. She devises a plan to reveal the truth to Aaisaheb. The next day, Jaydeep and Isha send Sonya out of the house along with Isha's parents. FM gives the microphone found in Vikrant's cabin to Mayra.

episodesList.title: Mother, It is I, In Another Skin
episodesList.summary: Mayra eavesdrops when Paranjape tells Isha over a phone call that FM has found the microphone. On learning that Jaydeep fell unconscious due to the wrong medicines, Aaisaheb recollects the past and feels dejected. Isha reveals to her that she is Rajnandini.

episodesList.title: A Reservoir Dog
episodesList.summary: Isha takes Aaisaheb to Rajnandini's room and reveals the truth to her. In that room, Isha comes across Rajesh's son's playball. On learning from Mayra that Paranjape has allied with Isha, Jhende takes a few goons along with him and goes to confront Paranjape.

episodesList.title: Everyone Knows
episodesList.summary: Paranjape informs Isha that Jhende is after his life. Sonya changes Isha's birth certificate. Jaydeep tells Sonya that Isha is, in fact, Rajnandini. Jaydeep learns about Paranjape's mishap from Isha. Meanwhile, Jhende and Mayra decide to call Vikrant back.

episodesList.title: My Dinner With Myra
episodesList.summary: Sonya tricks Aaisaheb into seeing Isha's fake birth certificate. After verifying all the details of the company, Isha invites Mayra to dine-out with a secret purpose in her mind. Later, Isha's parents apologise to Aaisaheb for lying to her.

episodesList.title: A Room Full of Surprises
episodesList.summary: Isha takes Mayra to the Saranjame house. Jaydeep keeps Jhende busy at work. In Rajnandini's room, Isha reveals the truth to Mayra and tells her that she is Rajnandini. However, Mayra refuses to believe it. Jhende calls Mayra but Sonya receives that call.

episodesList.title: Dekho, Dekho Woh Aa Gaya!
episodesList.summary: Mayra refuses to believe Isha despite Isha's numerous attempts to convince her. Eavesdropping on Mayra and Jhende's conversation, Sarjerao passes on the information to Isha and Jaydeep. Later, Vikrant's unexpected return worries Isha and Jaydeep.

episodesList.title: A Hard Truth, A Soft Convince
episodesList.summary: Vikrant goes to office despite Isha's numerous attempts to make him stay at home. Upon overhearing Jhende and Vikrant's conversation, Mayra realises the truth. Meanwhile, Sonya strives hard to convince Isha's parents that Isha is mentally unstable.

episodesList.title: From Two Witches To An Angel And A Witch
episodesList.summary: Mayra appreciates Jaydeep's decision in front of Vikrant, which puzzles Jhende. Later, pouring her heart out to Isha, a repentant Mayra apologises to her. Aaisaheb reassures Isha's parents, who worry about Isha and Vikrant.

episodesList.title: A Divorce of Want
episodesList.summary: Jhende rebukes Mayra for supporting Isha, to which she gives him a befitting reply. Vikrant is elated on hearing Isha's latest decision. Jhende is stunned when Isha answers Vikrant's phone. Vikrant praises Isha for being understanding about Aaisaheb's wishes.

episodesList.title: A Questionnaire Forced To Answer
episodesList.summary: Sonya overhears Aaisaheb and Jaydeep's conversation. Jhende taunts Mayra for being overconfident in her belief in Isha. Elsewhere, Jhende's goons kidnap Sarjerao. Vikrant berates Jhende for badmouthing Isha. Jhende questions Sarjerao about Isha.

episodesList.title: A Wild, Wild Consequence
episodesList.summary: The goons hired by Jhende make Sarjerao confess everything against Isha. Jhende threatens Isha that he will reveal the truth to Vikrant. Elsewhere, Jaydeep frees Sarjerao from the goons. In the office, Isha and Mayra try to thwart Jhende's plan.

episodesList.title: Jhende is proven wrong
episodesList.summary: Mayra and Isha give some instructions to the security guards. The security guards scan Jhende's man and send his bag to Mayra, who deletes the video from the pen drive in the bag. Later, the failure of the plan infuriates Jhende. Jaydeep brings Sarjerao home.

episodesList.title: Episode 272
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Jalindar hands over all the proofs
episodesList.summary: a smart Mayra doesn't let Vikrant see the property documents. Jhende sights Jalindar and tries to alert Vikrant. Elsewhere, Jalindar hands over all the proofs against Vikrant and Jhende to Isha. Meanwhile, Jhende sets a spy on Isha and Jalindar's trail.

episodesList.title: Episode 274
episodesList.summary: Tula Pahate Re is a Marathi romantic drama television show starring Subodh Bhave and Gaytri Datar. They belong to different worlds, they are from different backgrounds and two different decades. This couple will prove that when two souls are meant for each other, they will find their way to meet, even if the two belong to two eras!

episodesList.title: Isha, Jaydeep, Jalindar and Mayra
episodesList.summary: Isha's parents try to talk sense into her. As Vikrant learns the truth, Isha, Jaydeep, Jalindar and Mayra devise a new plan. Later, Vikrant confesses to Jhende that he loves Isha. Afterwards, Jalindar takes a picture with Jhende and sends it to Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Vikrant feels suspicious about Jhende
episodesList.summary: Jalindar's photos with Isha as well as Jhende perplexes Vikrant. Isha and her mates put their plan into action. They finally manage to plant a seed of doubt in Vikrant's mind against Jhende. Jhende remembers a 'fakir's' forecast. Isha's parents get worried.

episodesList.title: Vikrant gets a good news
episodesList.summary: Vikrant tends to an ill Isha and takes her to a doctor. Meanwhile, Jhende threatens Manda to apprise him of all the developments at the Saranjame house. Later, she informs him that Isha is going to visit the temple with Aaisaheb. Vikrant gets a good news.

episodesList.title: Vikrant is stunned
