episodesList.summary: Manda fails to stop Vikrant from going to the temple. Jhende, along with his goons, arrives at the temple, to hurt Isha. Isha is left speechless when Vikrant shares a piece of good news with her. Later, Vikrant is stunned by Isha's sudden disappearance.

episodesList.title: Vikrant saves Isha
episodesList.summary: Vikrant saves Isha from the goons and takes the bullet for her. During his treatment, the police visit his house for an enquiry. Sonya eavesdrops on Isha.

episodesList.title: Isha Collects Her Pregnancy Report
episodesList.summary: Isha wonders why Vikrant saved her. Pushpa thinks about Vikrant and Isha. Later, Isha visits the doctor to collect her pregnancy report.

episodesList.title: Jaydeep Confronts Jhende
episodesList.summary: Jaydeep reminds Jhende about the skeletons in his closet. Isha shares her internal dilemma with Rupali. Sonya once again confuses Isha’s parents.

episodesList.title: Pushpa Finds out about Isha's Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: Jaydeep and Sonya get into an argument. Pushpa is stunned about Isha's pregnancy. Rupali rebukes Ranjana for giving Isha's pregnancy report to Pushpa.

episodesList.title: Isha's Parents Refuse to Talk to Her
episodesList.summary: Rupali informs Isha that Pushpa knows about her pregnancy. Jhende has a plan to see Vikrant. At her maternal home, Isha's parents refuse to talk to her.

episodesList.title: Jhende's Goons Kidnap Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Nimkar asks Isha for proof. Pushpa tries to reason with her. Nimkar reminds Isha of something about Vikrant. Elsewhere, Jhende's goons kidnap an unconscious Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Isha Reveals the News to Jaydeep
episodesList.summary: Jaydeep and Aaisaheb suspect Jhende for the kidnapping. Isha is shocked to hear about Vikrant's kidnapping from his house. Later, she tells Jaydeep that she is pregnant.

episodesList.title: Isha and Jaydeep Seek Jalindar's Help
episodesList.summary: To expose Isha, Jhende decides to capture Jalindar. Meanwhile, Isha and Jaydeep decide to seek Jalindar's help. Jhende tries to present his side to Vikrant.

episodesList.title: Jalindar Promises to Find Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Jalindar promises Jaydeep that he will find Vikrant. Jhende learns about Isha and Jaydeep's meeting with Jalindar. Jhende finally concludes that Isha is indeed Rajnandini.

episodesList.title: Vikrant and Jalindar Come Face to Face
episodesList.summary: Jhende tries to win back Vikrant's trust. Isha, Jaydeep, and Mayra get worried when Jalindar goes to meet Jhende alone. Later, Vikrant and Jalindar come face to face.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Jalindar assures Vikrant about Isha's honesty. Vikrant returns home. On his return, Isha comes back home and enquires about Jalindar and Jhende.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Reveals Isha's Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: Vikrant shares the news of Isha's pregnancy with the family. Aaisaheb gets worried about avenging Rajnandini and Dadasaheb's death, but Isha tries to talk to her.

episodesList.title: Isha's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Vikrant and Isha discuss baby names. The thoughts of Rajnandini's past and her own future mess with Isha's mind. Meanwhile, something bothers Jaydeep.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Stumbles upon a Clue
episodesList.summary: Vikrant stumbles upon Rajnandini's book and Dadasaheb's pen. Isha tries to find a way out of the situation by sharing her turmoil with her parents.

episodesList.title: Vikrant Gets Restless
episodesList.summary: Vikrant's suspicion of Isha makes him restless. Mayra conveys this information to Isha. Vikrant learns that Jhende's doubts regarding Isha were true.

episodesList.title: Vikrant's Attempt to Find the Truth
episodesList.summary: Vikrant pours his heart out to Rajnandini's photo. Isha feels that Vikrant suspects her. Later, Vikrant tries to extract the truth from Isha's father.

episodesList.title: Isha Makes a Plan
episodesList.summary: Isha fears getting exposed. She tries to find out the details about her father's conversation with Vikrant. Later, Isha decides to make Vikrant realise his mistakes.

episodesList.title: Aaisaheb is Doubtful of Isha's Plan
episodesList.summary: Nimkar tells Pushpa that he has revealed the truth to Vikrant. Aaisaheb is doubtful that Isha can extract a confession out of Vikrant. Sarjerao informs Vikrant that he has been called downstairs.

episodesList.title: Isha Exposes Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Isha exposes Vikrant. Vikrant believes that Isha is indeed Rajnandini. Sonya is shocked on learning the truth. Aaisaheb asks Isha to call the police.

episodesList.title: Tula Pahate Re
episodesList.summary: When Vikrant reveals his feelings for Isha, she remembers all the moments she had shared with him. Later, Vikrant's sudden decision shocks everyone.

plotHtml:
Isha Nimkar is a sober middle-class girl living in a chawl with her parents. One day, she has to deliver a speech at the "K.T. College" honouring the chief guest Vikrant Saranjame, a wealthy industrialist of the "Saranjame Group of Industries" who lives with his widowed mother Snehalata a.k.a. Aaisaheb, younger brother Jaydeep and arrogant sister-in-law Soniya in a large mansion in Karjat, Maharashtra. Due to his fame and greatness, Vikrant has become a dear public figure surrounded by many people, including his close friend Vilas Zende, who is also his personal assistant.
Also, Isha's father Arun Nimkar works in one of the shops of "Rajnandini Sarees", the department of sarees, which is owned by Vikrant. On his way to the college, Vikrant's bicycle breaks down and thus he shares an auto-rickshaw with Isha when he meets her for the first time. Isha does not recognize Vikrant in the auto-rickshaw and speaks rudely to him for having money to pay, although she pays the fare of him too. Later at the college, Isha is shocked to see Vikrant entering as the chief guest and bursts into tears. Due to this commotion, she forgets her speech that lists many accomplishments of Vikrant, which leads to all her college friends teasing her.
However, Vikrant defends Isha by advising her and her college friends to always have trust in themselves and each other in any situation, and also gains Isha's trust by handing her over a blank cheque. Despite this, Isha and Mr. Nimkar modestly decide to return the blank cheque to Vikrant against the wishes of Isha's mother Pushpa. The next day, Isha takes the envelope containing Vikrant's cheque to his office and hands it over to his secretary Myra Karkhanis. However, Myra is shocked to discover that the envelope is empty and humiliates Isha for being after a rich personality under some pretext.
Meanwhile, Vikrant reaches Isha's house to return her money from the auto-rickshaw fare, but Pushpa misunderstands him for the fridge repairer and tries to make him repair the fridge. Later, Isha meets Mr. Nimkar and they learn that Pushpa has gone to deposit Vikrant's cheque in the bank. Just as Pushpa is about to fill in the amount on the cheque, Isha and Mr. Nimkar intervene and refuse to let her do so. Pushpa then apologises to Vikrant after learning about his true identity from Isha. Also, Isha and Mr. Nimkar return the cheque to Vikrant and request him to keep it.
Further, Vikrant falls in love with Isha and offers her a job in his company. As time passes, Isha begins to develop feelings for Vikrant too, while Myra and Zende try to separate the lovebirds due to the fact that she also loves Vikrant. However, Myra and Zende's each plan backfires and Vikrant invites Isha to his mansion. While there, he reveals her the truth about his deceased wife named "Rajnandini", whom he loved a lot and whose sudden demise had left him much disturbed. Therefore, he named the department of "Rajnandini Sarees" in the memory of his late wife.
Upon learning this, Isha despises Vikrant for hiding this from her and storms off, but it turns out to be just a prank. Actually, Isha has forgiven Vikrant for respecting her while telling her all this. Later, Vikrant takes Isha for a helicopter ride and proposes marriage to her mid-air. Speechless on seeing his unique way of proposing marriage, Isha agrees to marry Vikrant but the couple faces opposition from Mr. Nimkar due to their age difference, although Pushpa agrees for their relationship. With support from Zende, Aaisaheb and Pushpa, Vikrant and Isha eventually manage to convince Mr. Nimkar and have a grand marriage ceremony under Myra and Zende's organisation.
After their marriage, things unexpectedly start changing when the audience sees a dark side of Vikrant and Zende. It is suddenly revealed that Vikrant's late father Dadasaheb has stated in his will that he can never inherit the Saranjame property and that Rajnandini is the real owner of it. Therefore, Vikrant married Isha to use her as a pawn to obtain the Saranjame property. Following his plan, Vikrant tries to pretend that Isha is "reincarnation" of Rajnandini, so that Aaisaheb and Jaydeep (who are the current owners of the Saranjame property) can easily transfer the Saranjame property to Isha.
After a couple of months, Isha discovers an ongoing fraud in the Saranjame company and the name of the fraudster is revealed to be "Gajendra Patil". Upon learning this, Vikrant and Zende mysteriously make an actor take the blame of being the fraudster and have him arrested by the police. However, Isha goes on to visit the election commission office to enrol Vikrant's name in the voting list, where she is stunned to see the name "Gajendra Patil" with Vikrant's photograph. At the same time, she shockingly learns from Jaydeep and Soniya that Rajnandini was actually Aaisaheb's stepdaughter and Jaydeep's stepsister, and that Vikrant was the son-in-law of Dadasaheb who made him change his last name to Saranjame.
Also, Jalindar Mane, an archenemy of Vikrant, confesses about his true identity and colours to Isha soon after he is released from prison. Having become sure of Vikrant's deception, a devastated Isha meets the Jogtin, a woman asking for alms, and wishes to find the purpose of her life from the Goddess Ambabai. At this point, the beautiful face of a mysterious woman is reflected back upon Isha from the divine plate of water. Eventually, a confused and heartbroken Isha confronts Vikrant over his true identity and Rajnandini's relationship with Aaisaheb and Jaydeep. However, Vikrant regains Isha's trust by narrating her a fake story of the past involving him and Rajnandini.
Further, Vikrant takes Isha to a private room of him in the Saranjame mansion, where all of Rajnandini's belongings are kept safely by him as souvenirs along with Dadasaheb's photograph. He goes on to uncover the large photograph of Rajnandini in the room before Isha. Isha is horrified to recognize Rajnandini as the mysterious woman whose beautiful face was reflected upon her from the divine plate of water. Due to the shock, Isha falls unconscious in the room itself and all of Rajnandini's life events miraculously flash past her eyes in her unconsciousness.
A flashback shows that the middle-aged Rajnandini lived happily in the mansion with Aaisaheb, a young Jaydeep and Dadasaheb. One day, her car breaks down on her way to an important meeting with Jalindar at his office. Thus, Rajnandini shares an auto-rickshaw with Gajendra Patil (Vikrant), an orphan who lives in a chawl with his childhood friend Zende. Gajendra is educated but unemployed while Zende is a street-smart boy who can easily fool people. Gajendra is revealed to be going to the same destination for an interview with Jalindar and falls in love with Rajnandini due to her richness.
After the two reach their destination, Gajendra intervenes during Rajnandini and Jalindar's meeting and gives his interview to Jalindar before Rajnandini. An unimpressed Jalindar initially rejects Gajendra due to his low percentage of marks. However, Gajendra is ultimately selected in Jalindar's company on the recommendation of Rajnandini, who was impressed with his attitude during the interview. As time passes, Rajnandini falls in love with Gajendra too and he eventually proposes marriage to her.
Despite Dadasaheb's hesitance to approval, Rajnandini marries Gajendra in a temple and rechristens him as "Vikrant" after the name of the male protagonist in the book titled Tula Pahate Re that Aaisaheb had gifted to her on her birthday. Rajnandini even recruits "Vikrant" as the heir to the Saranjame company, much to everyone's puzzlement. However, Jalindar hands over all the evidences against Vikrant and Zende to Dadasaheb, who disowns Vikrant through an intense insult in private and secretly changes his will. An offended Vikrant immediately retaliates by arranging Dadasaheb to be killed in the consumption of wrong medicine.
Further, Vikrant also changes Dadasaheb's postmortem reports and secretly holds Aaisaheb responsible for his sudden demise. Meanwhile, Jalindar tries to tell Rajnandini the truth by meeting her in private but she refuses to believe him. Now, Vikrant has Zende kill Jalindar's own employee named Shivpurkar and frames Jalindar for the murder, causing Jalindar to be arrested by the police. Also, Vikrant and Zende prohibit the late Dadasaheb's photograph from the office. However, things change when Rajnandini visits the office and learns about Vikrant's new rule about Dadasaheb's photograph.
On this development, Rajnandini goes to meet Jalindar in prison where he confesses about Vikrant's true colours to her. Moreover, Rajnandini has a microphone fixed in Vikrant's office cabin to expose his truth. As a result, all the conspiracies of Vikrant and Zende are recorded in the microphone. Upon receiving this proof, Rajnandini regrets her blind faith in Vikrant before meeting him in private on the mansion terrace, where she threatens to hand over all the evidences against him to the police. However, a miserable Vikrant mercilessly forced Rajnandini off the terrace to her unfortunate end on the fateful night.
The story catches up to the present where a horrified Isha wakes up to have a gut feeling that she is indeed the "reincarnation" of Rajnandini who has descended back to the Earth to seek revenge from Vikrant. The next day, while wandering aimlessly, Isha ends up at her maternal home where she does not hesitate to inform her parents about this development. Mr. Nimkar believes her to have some sort of mental illness and consults her a psychiatrist. However, Isha stands firm by citing her undying commitment to the purpose of her life.
That evening, Isha returns to the Saranjame mansion where she hallucinates the image of Rajnandini, who confides in Isha that she is her reincarnation. On this ground, Isha vows to punish Vikrant and Zende for the injustice they have served to the society. Isha goes on to confess about her true identity with Vikrant and Zende's conspiracies to Jaydeep and Aaisaheb, who both fall into an emotional trap and instantly accept her as Rajnandini. The three plan to avenge both Dadasaheb and Rajnandini's deaths along with Jalindar and Myra by making Vikrant and Zende realise their mistakes.
As part of her mission, Isha cleverly creates a rift between Vikrant and Zende due to the fact that Zende has grown suspicious of her true identity and tries to inform Vikrant about it multiple times. However, Vikrant refuses to believe Zende despite his numerous attempts to convince him. Eventually, Zende conspires to have Isha killed by his henchmen, but Vikrant intervenes and has himself accidentally shot in his arm by one of Zende's henchmen. In these circumstances, Isha considers calling off the mission due to the fact that she is also pregnant with Vikrant's child. Meanwhile, Zende has his henchmen abduct an unconscious Vikrant from the Saranjame mansion and bring him to his own house to settle the issue.
While there, Vikrant regains consciousness and Zende desperately tries to explain him the situation once again but in vain. In a last attempt to take Vikrant into confidence, Zende summons Jalindar to his house where he confronts Jalindar before Vikrant over being the accomplice of Isha in her conspiracy to seek revenge from them both. However, Jalindar silently commits suicide by consuming poison and confesses to Vikrant that Isha loves him a lot before he dies. At last, a furious Vikrant believes that Zende has betrayed him and their friendship and returns home after he shockingly shoots down Zende fatally with his gun.
Despite this, Vikrant eventually discovers the truth with the help of the confession about Isha being the reincarnation of Rajnandini that Mr. Nimkar had unconsciously made to him during a private conversation between them in the office. A regretful Vikrant laments his mistake of killing his true friend Zende and vows to teach a lesson to all the avengers who are plotting against him. In the meantime, Isha realises that Vikrant can blow her cover on benefit of doubt and decides to fight back with a strong heart, much to Aaisaheb and Jaydeep's gratitude.
The next morning, Isha appears before Vikrant in Rajnandini's clothes and recounts all her life events. She demands an explanation from Vikrant on why he served this injustice to the innocent Rajnandini when she had given him all that he wanted. Seeing no other way out, a brainwashed Vikrant finally admits before Isha, her parents, Aaisaheb, Jaydeep, Soniya and Myra that he did all this only to get rid of the sufferings from poverty which had caused his mother's desert. However, he carelessly taunts everyone that they cannot convict him for his crimes for not having any evidence for doing so.
Later that night, Vikrant contacts Isha and mysteriously asks her to come to the terrace. As Isha heads off, Aaisaheb is tremendously worried that Vikrant might do the same thing with Isha that he did with Rajnandini. On the terrace, Vikrant asks Isha what love means to her, to which, Isha replies that she understood the meaning of love only from him. At the same time, Vikrant also confesses that he still truly loves her despite the fact that she betrayed him and went against him, and that he killed his close friend Zende only out of his immortal love for her.
Despite this, the series has a shocking and tragic climax when out of a sudden, Vikrant unexpectedly jumps off the terrace and meets his death as he is unable to deal with his guilt, causing a lot of devastation to Isha. In the end, Isha bids farewell to Aaisaheb, Jaydeep and Soniya and leaves the Saranjame mansion with her parents for wanting to live her true-self, "Isha Nimkar", stating that the soul of Rajnandini has finally attained peace due to the death of her killer, Vikrant. The series ends with Isha and her parents having started a catering business from their chawl few months later.

title: Top Model India
summary:
Top Model India is an Indian English-language reality television series, which  premiered on 4 February 2018 and broadcast on Colors Infinity. The series is an Indian version of Tyra Banks-created 2003 American reality television series America's Next Top Model. The viewers see several men and women compete for the title of Top Model India, providing them with an opportunity to begin their career in the modeling industry.
This is the reboot of MTV India's India's Next Top Model.
Mahir Pandhi is the winner of the first cycle of the show.

title: TED Talks India
summary: TED Talks India (originally known as TED Talks India Nayi Soch (season 1) and also known as TED Talks India Nayi Baat (season 2)) is an Indian talk show hosted by Shah Rukh Khan, that premiered on StarPlus. The slogan of the show is "Don't kill ideas".

episodesList.title: Power of Words
episodesList.summary: In the second episode, 'Power of Words' is the underlying theme. Speakers: Javed Akhtar, life skills educator Deepak Ramola, child and adolescent psychologist Shelja Sen, college student and social media campaigner Gurmehar Kaur (daughter of Kashmir martyr Captain Mandeep Singh) and founder-CEO, Uniphore, Umesh Sachdev. Performers: Clinton Cerejo

episodesList.title: Badalte Rishte
episodesList.summary: This episode talks about our relationships with each other, the society, with machines, with the world and most importantly, with ourselves. Speakers: Disruptive artist Jasmeen Patheja, artist and photographer Samar Singh Jodha, filmmaker Karan Johar, innovator-social entrepreneur Trisha Prabhu and environmental activist-writer Bittu Sahgal. Performers: Sivamani

episodesList.title: Dekho Aanewala Kal
episodesList.summary: One always lives with the hope of a, and for a better 'Tomorrow' – and that is the theme for this episode. Speakers: CEO, Google Inc. Sundar Pichai, designer and inventor Anab Jain, Senior Manager, AI Science for Alexa, Ashwin Ram, Co-founder of SocialCops, Data Intelligence Company, Prukalpa Sankar, Sciences and Aerospace Engineer and Deputy Director, Mars Orbiter Mission, Ritu Karidhal. Performers: Piano star Lydian Nadhaswaram and singer Shalmali Kholgade

episodesList.title: Power to Women
episodesList.summary: The underlying theme is "Meri Marzi #PowerToWomen". Speakers: Film and TV producer Ekta Kapoor, co-founder of the #100sareepact Anju Kadam, medical officer Dr Ramindar Dhillon, engineer, innovator, and entrepreneur Mihir Shah, and the captain of the Indian women's cricket team Mithali Raj. Performers: Nritarutya Dance Company, featuring Chandana Bala

episodesList.title: Wonder of Learning
episodesList.summary: In this episode, we have a mix of speakers sharing their thoughts on learning. Speakers: Neuroscientist Dr Shubha Tole; astrophysicist Dr Karan Jani; founder and CEO of Blippar Ambarish Mitra; cyber security expert Jagdish Mahapatra, and education scientist Sugata Mitra. Performers: Prahlad Tipanya

episodesList.title: What Are You Learning?
episodesList.summary: If we are indeed a product of our environment, how are we using the challenges posed by it to innovatively solve for science and humanity? SRK finds out with the speakers.

episodesList.title: Investing in Yourself
episodesList.summary: In a country of 1.32 billion people, if each one of us were to realise the best version of ourselves, imagine what our lives would be like? It's time to join SRK on an introspective journey.

episodesList.title: Your Attention Please
episodesList.summary: Innovations have transformed our world for the better, but they've come at a price. Here's a look at the problems, and the solutions that'll empower us, for generations to come.

episodesList.title: We Shall Overcome
episodesList.summary: True success means taking everyone along. In this episode, speakers offer unique scalable solutions to some of the issues India is struggling with as a nation.

episodesList.title: Young and Shaping the World
episodesList.summary: SRK takes us on an inspiring ride with the next generation of Indians, who use their energy and forge forward by addressing some of the most fundamental issues of our time.

episodesList.title: Power of Half a Billion Women
episodesList.summary: As SRK pledges his unconditional support for women, we talk about the challenges that still linger upon women and innovative ways to fight them.

episodesList.title: You in the Future
episodesList.summary: SRK dives into a futuristic space, of scientific breakthroughs only imagined in sci-fi films. It's time to reimagine our present while shaping our future.

title: Tu Aashiqui
summary: Tu Aashiqui (transl. You are my love) is a 2017 Indian musical drama romance television show based on two lovers' efforts to unite. Series aired on Colors TV on 20 September 2017 to 12 October 2018. It is produced by Mahesh Bhatt under Gurudev Bhalla production house. It stars Jannat Zubair Rahmani, Ritvik Arora, Rahil Azam and Gauri Pradhan
plot:
Pankti Sharma is a beautiful young girl. Kind-hearted and charming, Ahaan Dhanrajgir is a musician. He meets and falls for Pankti, who also feels an attraction to him. Her mother Anita, being a failed actress and almost completely bankrupt, sells Pankti for money to Ahaan's rich, cruel and manipulative uncle, the middle-aged JD.
Ahaan wants to save Pankti and fulfill her dream of becoming successful singer. Eventually, he frees Pankti whose sister, Poorva falls in love with her boss, Monty after Anita sells her to him.
Eventually, the truth about JD is exposed to the entire family. JD's wife, Sheetal (Himanshi Choudhry), asks for a divorce but JD makes her sign over all her property to him. JD tries to kill Sheetal but she ends up in a coma. Pankti now pursues her singing career with Ahaan's support. JD posts indecent photos of Pankti but Ahaan supports her and they run away to live a new life where no one knows them. JD threatens to kill Poorva unless Anita files a complaint against Ahaan for abducting Pankti. Ahaan and Pankti are given shelter in a village but have to escape from JD again and go to the house of Uday Mathur (Rushal Parekh), Ahaan's best friend and manager. Ahaan tries to clear Pankti's name by lying about the photos being fake but Pankti appears on the talk show and clears her own name by telling the truth. Sheetal wakes up from the coma and shoots JD but unbeknownst to her, it is a fake bullet. Sheetal is arrested and JD is presumed dead.
JD returns under the persona of a man named Reyansh Diwan (Raqesh Bapat) and befriends Ahaan and Pankti organizing a concert in London where Ahaan is attacked by a hooded goon. Sheetal is released on bail and discovers Reyansh is actually JD. She tries to warn Ahaan and Pankti but JD blackmails her to stay silent and kidnaps her. Pankti and Ahaan argue and Reyansh makes matters worse by creating more misunderstandings between them. Pankti sets up a trap for Reyansh and decodes Sheetal's last message as "JD is Reyansh". Pankti and Uday defeat JD along with Sheetal's son, Vikram (Buneet Kapoor), and free Ahaan and Sheetal. JD is arrested, and the family celebrate.
Ahaan and Pankti meet a famous singer named Rangoli Rai (Krissann Barretto). In public, Rangoli pretends to be nice but behind closed doors she is obsessed with herself and her fame. Vikram becomes jealous of the attention Ahaan gets and instead of launching Ahaan as JMD's new face, he launches Rangoli. Rangoli tries to get close to Ahaan. Pankti struggles as people in the music industry remind her of her past as a mistress and try to take advantage of her. Ahaan becomes friends with Rangoli.
Rangoli comes to sing the final recording of a song but can't hit any notes right. The music director wants to replace her with Pankti angering Rangoli. Vikram does not want Pankti to sing as she is not a member of the JMD Company. Ahaan instead organises a concert for Pankti, but Rangoli has the concert cancelled. Ahaan, Pankti and Rangoli are scheduled to sing at a charity concert organized by KK. Fans praise Pankti's voice over Rangoli's and Vikram decides to sign Ahaan and Pankti for the benefit of his company. Rangoli plans to separate Ahaan and Pankti. Pankti discovers Rangoli's intentions but Ahaan doesn't believe her. Pankti gets upset, gathers evidence against Rangoli, and finally exposes her.
Ahaan and Pankti are set to be married on the same day as Monty and Poorva. Before Ahaan and Pankti can complete their vows, the police arrive and arrest Ahaan as Rangoli has accused him of rape. Ahaan is taken into custody while Rangoli tells Ahaan that she would take her complaint back if he marries her but he refuses. Ahaan's trial begins and Rangoli hires Dinesh Khandelwal (Ashwin Kaushal), a cunning lawyer. Eventually, Ahaan's mother, Aparna Dhanrajgir (Dolphin Dwivedi) becomes Ahaan's lawyer and wins the court case in Ahaan's favour.
Pankti and Ahaan overcome all their problems, and marry. The show ends with Ahaan and Pankti living happily with their family.

JD posts indecent photos of Pankti but Ahaan supports her and they run away to live a new life where no one knows them. JD threatens to kill Poorva unless Anita files a complaint against Ahaan for abducting Pankti. Ahaan and Pankti are given shelter in a village but have to escape from JD again and go to the house of Uday Mathur (Rushal Parekh), Ahaan's best friend and manager. title: The Drama Company
summary: The Drama Company or The Drama Company: Super Nights is an Indian comedy show on Sony Entertainment Television. It premiered on 16 July 2017. It features comedians Krushna Abhishek, Ali Asgar, Sugandha Mishra, Sudesh Lehri, Sanket Bhosale and actor Mithun Chakraborty as permanent guest.

episodesList.title: Team Munna Michael Meets Badshah Akbar
episodesList.summary: In the inaugural episode of The Drama Company Show, Krushna Abhishek, playing the role of Akbar, produces a hilarious performance in association with the stars of Munna Michael.

episodesList.title: Team Mubarakan In Nilu Ki Shaadi
episodesList.summary: The stars of the upcoming movie Mubarakan, Anil Kapoor, Arjun Kapoor, Ileana DCruz, and Athiya Shetty, make an appearance in the Drama Company as Krushna Abhishek, who plays a down to earth farmer, and company, bring to you Nilu Ki Shaadi.

episodesList.title: Babita Phogat, Pawan Kumar
episodesList.summary: Indian wrestlers Babita Phogat and Pawan Kumar witness the ambitions of Krushna Abhishek, as Pillu Pehlwan, who wants to make his daughters, Sita and Papita, Olympic Gold medallists in wrestling.

episodesList.title: Terence Lewis And Gauhar Khan In Chudail Ka Inteqaam
episodesList.summary: A deserted mansion is haunted by a Chudail, Sugandha Mishra. After the death of the mansion's owner, Thakur Puran Singh, Hariram, played by Krushna Abhishek, guards the mansion. Now, Puran Singh's grandson, Sanket Bhosale and his friends Riddhima Pandit and Ali Asgar, arrive at the mansion to meet the Chudail. The horror plot takes a comical twist with the arrival of Terence Lewis and Gauhar Khan, the guests on tonight's episode of The Drama Company.

episodesList.title: Baccha Party's Jungle Safari With Krushna And Pinkudi
episodesList.summary: Krushna and Pinkudi are on a quest to find a hidden treasure. They, along with celebrity child artists like Akshat, Matin Rey Tangu, Dishita Sehgal, and Ditya Bhande amongst others, go on a jungle safari to find the treasure.

episodesList.title: Devdas's Love Story
episodesList.summary: Krushna Abhishek plays Devdas, who has just returned from London. When he goes to meet his childhood love, Paro, he is shocked to find that she is in love with Vivek Oberoi. He becomes an alcoholic and befriends Chandramukhi and Chunni Babu. Chunni Babu tells him his love story with Richa Chadda. Will Devdas finally unite with Paro?

episodesList.title: Rajkummar Rao, Ayushmann Khurrana, Kriti Sanon, Pankaj Tripathi, Seema Pahwa
episodesList.summary: The Drama Company has guests from the film Bareily Ki Barfi, comprising Ayushmann Khurrana, Kriti Sanon, Rajkummar Rao, Seema Pahwa and Pankaj Tripathi. Krushna Abhishek plays Raju Katri, who is seeking an alliance for his daughter, Barfi.

episodesList.title: Haseena Parkar, A Love Story
episodesList.summary: Shraddha Kapoor, her brother Siddhant Kapoor and the cast of Haseena Parkar grace the stage of The Drama Company. Sanskar is smitten by Haseena Parkar aka Shraddha Kapoor and goes to ask for her hand in marriage. But, her brother Siddhant, a don, promises to get them married only if Sanskar is willing to shed his sanskari image. He seeks help from a local don in order to become a gangster. Will he manage to woo Haseena?

episodesList.title: Hum Naach Kar Chuke Sanam
episodesList.summary: In this episode of The Drama Company, choreographers Geeta Kapoor, Ahmed Khan, and Marzi Pestonji make an appearance. Krushna Abhishek plays Sameer, an NRI, who comes from Italy to learn dance from Guruji, played by Sudesh Lehri, but ends up falling in love with his daughter Nandini. After Guruji discovers their love story, will he still be willing to teach Sameer? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Sidharth Malhotra, Jacqueline Fernandez
episodesList.summary: In today's episode of 'The Drama Company', Sidharth Malhotra and Jacqueline Fernandez promote their film 'A Gentleman'. Krushna Abhishek plays a news anchor, who runs his channel Gentleman Ki Khabar. He is on the hunt for a big news story.

episodesList.title: Independence Day Special With Huma Qureshi and Gurinder Chadha
episodesList.summary: In this Independence Day special, Huma Qureshi, who will be seen in Viceroy's House, directed by Gurinder Chadha, witnesses the romantic tale between Krushna Abhishek and Sugandha Mishra.

episodesList.title: Ganesh Chaturthi Special
episodesList.summary: In this Ganesh Chaturthi special, singers Shalmali Kholgade, Amit Mishra, Guru Randhawa, and Gurdeep Mehndi witness the amusement rising out of a singing reality show.

episodesList.title: Fun With Babumoshai Bandookbaaz
episodesList.summary: The star cast of Babumoshai Bandookbaaz: Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Bidita Bag, and Divya Dutta, are the guests on tonight's episode of The Drama Company. Today's act begins with Krushna Abhishek rushing Ali Asgar, who plays a Don, to the hospital. The condition of the Don becomes worse as the doctor is none other than Sudesh Lehri.

episodesList.title: Fun With The Cast Of Lucknow Central
episodesList.summary: The cast of Lucknow Central grace the sets of The Drama Company. Witness an entertaining and a fun-filled episode, wherein the cast try to get jailor Ali Asgar married to Farhan Akhtar. Krushna Abhishek and Sudesh Lehri plan to escape from the jail but are caught by the jailor.

episodesList.title: Entertainment Guaranteed With The Poster Boys
episodesList.summary: In this episode of The Drama Company, the cast of Poster Boys, Sunny Deol, Bobby Deol, and Shreyas Talpade, make an appearance. Experience nostalgia as Krushna Abhishek, Sudesh Lehri, and Saket Bhosale relive Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol's most successful films.

episodesList.title: An Evening With Sanjay Dutt
episodesList.summary: In this episode of The Drama Company, the cast of Bhoomi make an appearance. Bollywood superstar Sanjay Dutt is accompanied by his co-stars Aditi Rao Hydari, Sharad Kelkar, and the film's director, Omung Kumar.

episodesList.title: Ravishing Raveena
episodesList.summary: Bollywood actress Raveena Tandon makes an appearance on this episode of The Drama Company. Krushna Abhishek plays a hockey coach and is training them for an upcoming tournament. A hilarious train journey is in store when Krushna meets Raveena.

episodesList.title: The Sound Of Music

tagline: The Drama Company or The Drama Company: Super Nights is an Indian comedy show on Sony Entertainment Television.

title: Tenali Rama
summary:
Tenali Rama is an Indian Hindi-language historical fiction comedy drama based on the life of the legendary Telugu poet Tenali Ramakrishna, one of the Ashtadiggajas at the court of Vijayanagara emperor Krishnadevaraya (C.E. 1509–1529).
The series premiered on Sony SAB on 11 July 2017 and concluded on 13 November 2020.
The second season aired from 16 December 2024 to 19 July 2025.
reception: Shweta Keshri of India Today gave the series a positive review, praising Krishna Bharadwaj's portrayal of Tenali Rama, the VFX and special effects of the series, the colourful sets and comic content which "can easily lure viewers to the show and takes you back to the 16th century."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Regarding the series Tenali Rama, Neeraj Vyas, Senior EVP & Head, Channel SAB and MAX cluster of channels, said, "India has a compelling tradition of both written and oral folklore. Our epics are treasures that teach life lessons via stories. Tenali Rama was a legendary poet of the 15th century. He is immortal, his wit being admired even in today's times. With Tenali Rama's adaptation on SAB, we intend to offer a restored and renewed version of this classic chronicle."

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Krishna Bharadwaj was chosen to play the titular role of Tenali Rama and went bald for it. Speaking on how he got the role, he said,
It was reported in June 2017 that Manav Gohil had been cast to play the pivotal role of Krishnadevaraya. Gohil, who worked with SAB TV on Yam Hain Hum, where he played the titular role, said, "This time it's Krishnadevaraya, a very powerful king that I am portraying. It's a comedy show and I am looking forward to working with a new set of people. The show is "Tenali Rama" and I am so ready to get rolling with this one."
Veteran actor Pankaj Berry was cast to play the series' antagonist and Tenali Rama's foe frenemy, Tathacharya, who is the royal priest in the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya, and always creates trouble for Tenali Rama with the help of his fellow disciples, Dhani and Mani. Berry said, "I am very excited to play Tathacharya. It is a very different kind of challenging role, there are different layers to the character even though it's a negative character." It was reported in July 2017 that Sonia Sharma and Priyanka Singh had been cast to play the roles of Krishnadevaraya's wives, Chinna Devi and Tirumalamba, respectively.

articleSections.title: Revival
articleSections.text: In October 2024, It was announced that a sequel to Tenali Rama was in development. On 30 October 2024, first promo was released of Tenali Rama's sequel on the occasion of Diwali. It confirmed that Pankaj Berry, Sohit Soni and Sanjay Mangani would reprise their roles as Tattacharya, Mani and Dhani respectively. It premiered on Sony Sab on 16 December 2024.

articleSections.title: Historical inaccuracies
articleSections.text: The series portrays Chinna Devi as Krishnadevaraya's senior wife and chief queen and Tirumalamba as his junior wife. She was the princess of Srirangapattana and Krishnadevaraya had married her most probably in 1498, long before his accession to the throne in 1509. Chinna Devi was actually a Royal Dancer whom Krishnadevaraya had married immediately after birth of his first daughter in 1502.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Shweta Keshri of India Today gave the series a positive review, praising Krishna Bharadwaj's portrayal of Tenali Rama, the VFX and special effects of the series, the colourful sets and comic content which "can easily lure viewers to the show and takes you back to the 16th century."

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text: Tenali Rama was dubbed and aired in Tamil on Zee Tamil under the title Thenali Raaman. Later, it was dubbed and aired in Telugu on Zee Telugu as Vikata Kavi Thenali Ramakrishna. It was also dubbed in Malayalam and aired on Zee Keralam as Thenaali Raman.It was also dubbed in Kannada and aired on Dangal Kannada as Tenali Rama.

episodesList.title: The Missing Bridegroom
episodesList.summary: The villagers of Tenali are flocking to Lakshmiamma's house to attend the wedding of her son, Rama. Meanwhile at Lakshiamma's house, preparations are in full swing for the wedding when Gunjappa, Rama's friend, notices that Rama is missing. Sharda, Rama's bride and his lover, falls unconscious upon knowing the harsh truth. Soon, the villagers begin their search for the eloped bridegroom.

episodesList.title: Tenali Saves Gundappa's Family
episodesList.summary: Sharda is annoyed at seeing Rama continue his merry ways and living a carefree life when everyone around him is in trouble. Sharda informs Rama that Gundappa's family will go homeless if they don't repay money to a notorious loan shark. Rama assures Sharda that he will devise a way to save Gundappa and his family.

episodesList.title: Tenali Meets The Goddess
episodesList.summary: Goddess Kali appears before Tenali Rama and asks him for his wish. Tenali Rama impresses Kali with his wit and walks away with his wishes fulfilled. Then, Tenali Rama arrives in the village and ties the knot with his lady love.

episodesList.title: Tenali Arrives At Vijayanagara
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama travels to Vijayanagara with his family. Meanwhile, the king asks his Nagar Kotwal to catch the thief who has been troubling the people in the empire or he will lose his position. Tathacharya is furious to see Tenali Rama in the town, and he comes up with a plan to teach Rama a lesson. Will Rama be able to escape from the conspiracy against him?

episodesList.title: Escape From Tathacharya's Curse
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya buries Tenali Rama neck-deep in mud and curses him . He manages to trick a passerby and escape. When Tathacharya discovers that Tenali Rama has escaped, he devices a plan to capture him.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Hunt To Find Tenali
episodesList.summary: After Tenali Rama manages to escape, Tathacharya organises a hunt for him and declares him a thief. He puts Rama's posters all over the village. But when Tenali sees the pictures, he replaces them with Tathacharya's photo.

episodesList.title: Prisonbreak
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama tells Tathacharya that he will soon escape from the prison. He manipulates the kotwal and gathers the things he needs to escape from captivity. As Tathacharya visits the prison to check out on Tenali Rama, he finds out that a fire has broken out and Rama is missing.

episodesList.title: A Chance To Prove His Innocence
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama traps Tathacharya and the kotwal in the prison and escapes. Furious by this act, Tathacharya demands a death sentence for Rama from the king. As the King asks to find Rama and present him before him, Rama appears in the court himself and pleads his innocence. What will the fate hole for Rama? Will the king punish him with death this time?

episodesList.title: Tenali Starts His Investigation
episodesList.summary: Tenali starts his investigation to find the real thief, and he starts by revisiting all the places of crime in order to look for clues. Tenali stumbles upon a few lines written by the thief and comes up with a plan. Although his mother urges him to run away from the kingdom, Tenali insists he will stay and see this through. What is his plan?

episodesList.title: Tenali Reveals The Thief
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama visits Sudhamini's house and is surprised to find Tathacharya. Sudhamini is shocked when she finds her jewels missing. At Krishnadevraya's court, Tenali appears and reveals that he has found out the real thief.

episodesList.title: Tenali Proves His Innocence
episodesList.summary: Tenali manages to prove his innocence and reveals that Kotwal is the thief responsible for stealing Sudhamini's jewels. He tricks Tathacharya and forces him to confess to Krishnadevraya that he saw Kotwal stealing from Sudhamini's house.

episodesList.title: Mallu Deva or Gopanna?
episodesList.summary: Tenali addresses Kotwal as Mallu Deva in front of Krishnadevaraya and claims that he is the thief. Tenali gets abducted by a few men. He is shocked to find that Gopanna, Kotwal's aide, is in fact Mallu Deva.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya Tricked
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama partners with Gopanna aka Mallu Deva and visits Tathacharya's house to steal. His foolish assistants reveal where the jewels are kept. When Tathacharya arrives, he is angry to see his precious things stolen, and finds a clue left behind.

episodesList.title: The Death Sentence
episodesList.summary: While Krishnadevaraya gets ready for Kotwal's hanging, Tenali arrives and reveals that Kotwal is innocent. But Krishnadevaraya accuses him of lying and awards him death sentence.

episodesList.title: Mallu Deva Is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama tries to buy time from Krishnadevaraya in order to wait for Mallu Deva and his men to arrive. After a while, when Tenali is about to get hanged, Mallu Deva sneaks out from a secret chamber and is forced to confess to his crimes.

episodesList.title: Tenali Appointed As Official Jester
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya is impressed with Tenali Rama's wit and humour and officially appoints him as Vijaynagara's jester. However, Tathacharya is unhappy with the decision but is forced to abide by the king's order.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Insult
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama is excited for his first day as the jester in Krishnadevaraya's court. While he looks for a seat, Tathacharya humiliates him and drags him to the entrance. But Rama uses his wit and manages to win against Tathacharya.

episodesList.title: The Invisible Game
episodesList.summary: A lady comes to Krisnadevaraya's court and tries to con everyone by telling that she has a magical saree that is invisible. However, Tenali understands her ploy and decides to use her own trick against her.

episodesList.title: Tenali Decides To Leave The Court
episodesList.summary: After being mocked by Tathacharya at Krishnadevaraya's court, Tenali Rama feels humiliated and decides to resign from his position as a jester. But he decides not to give up when he miraculously advises a little girl.

episodesList.title: Krishnadevaraya's Test
episodesList.summary: When Krishnadevaraya hears everyone gossiping about his soft corner for Tenali Rama, he decides to take his test. He disguises as a saint and visits Rama's house with his assistant.

episodesList.title: Tenali Rama is Banished
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama queues up to collect a golden mango being donated by Krishnadevaraya. Alleging that he is greedy, Krishnadevaraya orders Tenali Rama to leave the court and asks him to never show his face again.

episodesList.title: Timmarusu's Surprise Visit
episodesList.summary: Timmarusu secretly visits Tenali and seeks his favour in protecting Krishnadevaraya and the Vijayanagar empire from the unfavorable demands being made by Tathacharya. At a feast, Tathacharya is insulted by Tenali Rama, and he vows to seek revenge.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Unusual Appearance
episodesList.summary: The council members are stunned when Tenali arrives in the council with his face covered inside an earthen pot. When asked about the earthen pot, Tenali replies that he does not want the King to see his face as it will infuriate him.

episodesList.title: Devyani's Gift
episodesList.summary: Queen Devyani from Sundergadh sends an exquisite piece of jewellery to Krishnadevaraya as a gift. But Krishnadevaraya is caught in a dilemma when both his wives crave for the jewellery. He assigns Tenali Rama to bail him out of the situation.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Evil Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya speaks to Chinna Devi and Tirumalamba and poisons their mind against each other. Meanwhile, Tenali is caught in a dilemma about the 'Sindurpatta'. His wife suggests that he gets another 'Sindurpatta' made to make both queens happy.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Plans To Expose Tenali
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya finds out that Tenali has replicated two fake pieces of the 'Sindurpatta'. He decides to expose Tenali Rama and asks Krishnadevaraya to get his two wives for a grand celebration. Tenali must find a way to fight back.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya Meets Sudhamini
episodesList.summary: Tahtacharya meets Sudhamini and gifts her the 'Sindurpatta'. At the court, Tenali Rama, Krishnadevaraya and Tathacharya are shocked when they see the two queens, Chinna Devi and Tirumalamba, wearing the 'Sindurpatta'.

episodesList.title: The Sindurpatta Secret
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya's queens are shocked when they see Sudhamini coming to the court to perform with the 'Sindurpatta' on her head. When Krishnadevaraya asks Tenali, he reveals a stunning secret.

episodesList.title: Tenali Rama is Promoted
episodesList.summary: After Tenali Rama exposes the messenger from Sundergad and the motive behind his intentions to share the 'Sindurpatta', Krishnadevaraya gets impressed with him. He announces that Tenali will be promoted as his special consultant.

episodesList.title: Rama's New Challenge
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya is furious when he learns that the people of Vijayanagar aren't intelligent. In order to make his empire strong, Tathacharya suggests that Tenali Rama presents eight fools in Krishnadevaraya's court.

episodesList.title: The First Fool
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama is caught in a dilemma when Krishnadevaraya asks him to present eight fools in his court. While is family members try to tell him that it is a trick, he is determined to find them. After much hunting, he manages to find his first fool.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Advice To Tathacharya
episodesList.summary: Tenali continues his quest to present eight fools in Krishnadevaraya's court, and ends up visiting Tathacharya's home. However, when he sees him mocking and insulting his wife, he is forced to advice him and asks him to respect women.

episodesList.title: The Eighth Fool
episodesList.summary: After pronouncing Tathacharya and himself as the sixth and seventh fool, apart from the five he presents in court, Tenali Rama calls Krishnadevaraya as the eighth fool. Everyone is stunned. But Krishnadevaraya is enlightened by Tenali's talks.

episodesList.title: Tenali and the Diamond
episodesList.summary: Tenali teaches his son the meaning of Ganesh shlok. Later, another trouble comes in the way of Tenali Rama in the form of the diamond, which is supposed to be guarded by the royal guards.

episodesList.title: Security For The Chandramani
episodesList.summary: After Tenali is assigned the responsibility of protecting the Chandramani, he requests Krishnadevaraya to give him a chance for organizing the entire function. Tathacharya is extremely upset when Tenali is chosen over him and plots his revenge.

episodesList.title: Sneeze Fest
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama, who is down with a cold, welcomes all the guests for the grand occasion in Vijayanagar empire. Looking at Tenali sneezing continuously, Tathacharya asks Krishnadevaraya to hand him the responsibilities of taking care of the Chandramani.

episodesList.title: Krishnadevaraya's Warning
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya warns Tenali Rama of the importance of Chandramani and asks of him to take care of singers of his court who are still suffering from cold.

episodesList.title: Rama's Midnight Adventure
episodesList.summary: Tenali suspects that one amongst the five singers is the thief who is capable of stealing the Chandramani. In a bid to find out about them, Tenali visits each of them and gives them medicine.

episodesList.title: Rama Overhears Tathacharya's Plan
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama is shocked when he overhears Tathacharya's conversation and learns about his plan to steal the Chandramani. Krishnadevaraya performs pooja in front of the Ganesh idol.

episodesList.title: The Chandramani Bloom
episodesList.summary: On the tenth day of the Ganesh pooja, a special flower that blooms once in thousand years is brought to Krishnadevaraya's kingdom. During the pooja, everyone is surprised to see the Chandramani bloom inside the flower.

episodesList.title: The Chandramani Is Stolen
episodesList.summary: After the Ganesh pooja, a monkey enters Krishnadevaraya's kingdom and takes the Chandramani. A furious Krishnadevaraya yells at Tenali Rama for not paying attention to the security arrangements.

episodesList.title: The Ultimatum
episodesList.summary: Tenali gets an ultimatum by Krishnadevaraya to find the Chandramani within two days and is in a dilemma. He seeks help and prays to Ganesha to provide him a solution.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya Defames Tenali
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya and his disciples tell Krishnadevaraya about the consequences that will befall on those who disrespect Lord Ganesh's wishes. A worried Krishnadevaraya asks his guards to summon Tenali to the palace.

episodesList.title: The Chilli Trick
episodesList.summary: In order to expose the real thief of the Chandramani, Tenali Rama hands a pouch to everyone at Krishnadevaraya's court. He calls a monkey trainer and gets the monkey who stole the Chandramani.

episodesList.title: The Talking Parrot
episodesList.summary: Mithu, a new parrot, makes its way to the Vijayanagar empire, and Krishnadevaraya is astonished to see it talking like humans. The parrot reveals the fortunes of Krishnadevaraya, Tathacharya and Tenali Rama.

episodesList.title: Mithu's Word Haunts Tenali
episodesList.summary: After Tenali Rama comes back from Krishnadevaraya's court, he finds himself constantly haunted by the parrot's words. He tries to arrive at the parrot's motive behind speaking ill of him.

episodesList.title: Tenali The Ventriloquist
episodesList.summary: When Tenali sees a ventriloquist performing, he discovers the secret to the parrot talking at Krishnadevaraya's court. He insists on learning the art form and pleads to the ventriloquist.

episodesList.title: Rama exposes Samsher Khan
episodesList.summary: When Samsher Khan is unable to get the parrot to speak, Tenali uses his skills and speaks like the parrot. Sasher Khan is surprised and is forced to reveal his crimes.

episodesList.title: The Sleepwalking Ghost
episodesList.summary: Tenali is frightened when he hears various ghost tales from his mother and wife. At night, a mysterious beast disguised as an animal makes its way to Tenali's house. When Tenali sees it, he is scared.

episodesList.title: New Task For Tathacharya
episodesList.summary: A man enters Tathacharya's house wearing Bearskin. He tells Tathacharya about his habit of sleepwalking. Tathacharya presents this problem in front of Krishnadevaraya to seek a solution. Tathacharya asks Krishnadevaraya to appoint Tenali for the work. But, Tenali skillfully asks Krishnadevaraya to assign this work to Tathacharya as he is the senior person. Whom will Krishnadevaraya assign work to?

episodesList.title: The Haunted House
episodesList.summary: Scared Tathacharya and Dhani Mani enter the haunted house. They experience paranormal activity in the house. Dhani Mani leaves Tathacharya in the house and runs away.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Thrilling Encounter
episodesList.summary: Tenali and his family members enter the haunted house. Everyone runs away leaving Tenali when they encounter the ghost.

episodesList.title: Uncovering A Mystery
episodesList.summary: Tenali and Krishnadevaraya enter the haunted house but find nothing. Krishnadevaraya assigns Tenali to find Tathacharya with the help of Dhani Mani.

episodesList.title: Who Is Venkataramanna?
episodesList.summary: After coming from the mysterious and haunted palace, Tenali Rama reveals that it belongs to Venktaramanna. However, Tathacharya tries to reason with him. Tenali requests Krishnadevaraya to allow him to bring Venkataramanna's sons to share evidence. Will the mystery behind the haunted house finally be revealed?

episodesList.title: Ghost Exposed
episodesList.summary: Tenali presents Vishnu in the form of a Ghost before the Durbar. Vishnu tells those in attendance that anyone in the Ghost outfit will look similar.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Fast
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Dussehra, Queen Chinna Devi and Queen Tirumalamba keep a fast for Krishnadevaraya's long life.

episodesList.title: Ramleela in Vijayanagara
episodesList.summary: Tenali tells Krishnadevaraya that if the Ramleela performers are unable to come to Vijayanagara then esteemed members of this Darbar will perform Ramleela instead.

episodesList.title: Devaraya's armory
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevarayas is looking to renovate his ammunition for his army and he calls upon an "expert" to show off his inventions. King and his court are impressed by these inventions but when Krishnadevaraya puts his own life at risk to test a weapon, Tenali decides to act and put an end to this.

episodesList.title: The New Director
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya asks Tenali to solve his dilemma: to keep mustache or not to keep one for Ram's character in Ramleela. Tathacharya gets shocked after knowing that he is no longer the director of Ramleela. Tathacharya gets scared and worried after meeting Guruprasad, the new director for Ramleela. How will Tathacharya's experience with Guruprasad?

episodesList.title: Navatri Special
episodesList.summary: SYNOPSIS Tathacharya annoys Guruprasad for giving him a fair opportunity to show his skills. After a long argument, Guruprasad assigns Tathacharya to play Ravan's role. Tenali is assigned to select other characters for Ramleela. During the rehearsal, Tenali notices a change in the colour of the wild berries. He prevents Krishnadevaraya from consuming it and consumes it himself. Will Tenali have any effects after consuming poisonous wild berries?

episodesList.title: Attack On Krishnadevaraya
episodesList.summary: During the Ramleela rehearsal, Mantrivar and Tenali keep an eye on Krishnadevaraya's security. Tenali finds a suspicious Achyutadevaraya changing a wooden sword into a metal sword.

episodesList.title: Raavan Dahan
episodesList.summary: While the Ramlila is on at Krishnadevaraya's kingdom in full swing, Ghungroo plans to attack him during the Raavan Dahan. Tenali Rama watches everyone carefully to protect him.

episodesList.title: Vastu Danger
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya and Tenali get irritated by Vamacharya for spreading Vastu fad across Vijayanagara. Meanwhile, after reaching Durbar, they notice Krishnadevaraya's throne being turned to the opposite side. But, Krishnadevaraya decides to keep the throne in its orginial position to make people believe that Vastu has no proven evidence to be true. Will Tenali find a better solution for the growing Vastu craze?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya Plans To Continue Vamacharya Craze
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya beats Dhani Mani for supporting Vamacharya. Varunmala tells Tathacharya that she got the knowledge of Vastu from his books. Meanwhile, Varunmala tells that she suggested Chinna Devi about vastu.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Suggestion
episodesList.summary: Tenali and Tathacharya notice that their chairs are facing the opposite direction as per the instructions of Chinna Devi. Tathacharya tactfully expresses his worries about Varunmala losing her mental balance.

episodesList.title: Tenali Found A Solution
episodesList.summary: Tenali returns home and notices that all the wooden pillars in the house are in their position. He finds that Amma has nailed all the wooden items of the house after Vamacharya's statement to remove pure wooden items from the house.

episodesList.title: Vastu Conundrum
episodesList.summary: Upon King's request, Tenali takes the matter into his own hands and resolve the issue with 'Vasthu'. According to his plans, Chinna Devi calls upon Amma as she was convinced by Tenali that she could find the solution for any kind of problem.

episodesList.title: Vastu Conundrum 2
episodesList.summary: As Vamacharya continues her efforts to establish the powers of Vasthu, as gets Tenali to a state where he couldn't even control his own head. Will Tenali be able to prove Vamacharya wrong ?

episodesList.title: King's Wager
episodesList.summary: Tenali becomes the victim of his own success when King challenges him to do something impossible. Whereas Tattacharya continues to find ways to get Tenali into trouble.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Cunning Plan
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya plans to put Tenali in trouble in Darbar. He decides to call Atma Swami to prove that heaven exists. But, Atma Swami suddenly shouts on Tathacharya and tells him about his sins.

episodesList.title: Rama Plans To Leave
episodesList.summary: Rama gets worried after finding a note of his name in the basket. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya finds himself stuck in the situation where Tirumalamba serves him inedible food.

episodesList.title: Tenali On Funeral Pyre
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya asks Rama out of concern to leave the state to stay alive. But Rama refuses Tathacharya's advice and moves towards funeral pyre.

episodesList.title: Rama Is Alive
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya gets depressed for plotting the death of Rama. He decides to apologize to Rama's family for his mistake. Tathacharya and Dhani Mani enter Rama's house. They get shocked to see Rama alive.

episodesList.title: Rama's Witty Web
episodesList.summary: Timmarasu summons Rama to the court. But, he is not to be seen anywhere. When the King asks Shardha about the whereabouts of Rama, she replies wittily which traps the court members in the web of her witty words. What is Rama’s plan this time?

episodesList.title: Rama's Hiding Plan
episodesList.summary: Rama plans to take sadhu's attire to hide from Tathacharya and Dhani-Mani. He enters Rajmata's temple and dupes her by lying of being a Sadhu from heaven.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya tells darbar to wait for Rama till he comes. But after a while, Tathacharya gets worried as Rama does not come. Later, Krishnadevaraya asks Mantrivar to find a solution.

episodesList.title: Identical Twins
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya gets angry after everyone asks him the reason for wearing the turban. Meanwhile, Mantrivar tells that there are two brothers who claim their name as Suresham.

episodesList.title: Hair Removing Oil for Rama
episodesList.summary: Dhani Mani enter Rama's house to keep hair removing oil as per Tathacharya's instructions. Meanwhile, they notice Gundappa coming, they close their eyes thinking no one will see them. Seeing Dhani Mani in the house, Rama decides to irritate them. Will Rama know the reason behind Dhani Mani entering his house?

episodesList.title: Rama's hair in trouble
episodesList.summary: Rama notices Gundappa wandering in the house holding a snake in his hand. Meanwhile, Tayhacharya rubs mud over his body to repel snakes. Later, Tathacharya tells Krishnadevaraya that Lord Shiva told him to donate the hair of an intelligent person. How will Rama save his hair?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya excitedly arrives at Saudamini's house to meet her. Annoyed Saudamini chains Tathacharya and tells that she has a surprise for him.

episodesList.title: Rooster Crowing
episodesList.summary: Rama gets annoyed after listening to rooster's crowing in the early morning. Rama gets angry after Shubhalakshmi refuses to calm the crowing rooster.

episodesList.title: Missing Rooster
episodesList.summary: Dhani Mani enters Rajmahal to catch the rooster as per Tathacharya's order. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya listens to some sounds and arrives at Vasudev's room to find the reason behind rooster's crowing. Later, Vasudev gets on hunger-strike for not finding his rooster. Will Krishnadevaraya find Vasudev's rooster?

episodesList.title: Rama Took The Rooster
episodesList.summary: Rama tells Gundappa that he brought rooster to keep it safe from the people who want to kill the rooster. He also tells that he tried to hide the rooster in the forest but, it followed him home.

episodesList.title: Rooster In Tathacharya's House
episodesList.summary: Gundappa tells Rama that Dhani Mani took Vasudev's rooster. Meanwhile, Dhani Mani surprises Tathacharya by showing him Vasudev's rooster.

episodesList.title: Lazy Rama
episodesList.summary: Sharda tells Amma that Rama is sleeping even after having a bath. Amma decides to wake up Rama and scold him for not helping anyone. Meanwhile, Amma tells that while returning from the temple, she saw Devaiya Kaka asking everyone to help him with farm work. Will Amma tell Rama to help Devaiya Kaka on the farm?

episodesList.title: Rama's Forgetfulness
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya presents Rama's forgetfulness in the court. Tathacharya tries to convince the court by telling everyone Dhani Mani's experience with Rama. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya decides to take Rama's test by asking a few questions. Will Rama be able to prove his innocence?

episodesList.title: Rama's Memory Loss
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya bribes a physician to medicate Rama to erase his memory. The physician gives the medicine to Sharda lying that it is for Rama's good health. After consuming the medicine, Rama loses his memory and forgets his own house. Will Rama get his memory back?

episodesList.title: Clever Rama
episodesList.summary: Rama forgets everything because of Tathacharya's medicine. Rama unknown to the fact that he is working in Darbar, asks Krishnadevaraya to give him work in the Darbar. Will Rama be able to get his memory back?

episodesList.title: Rama's Revenge On Tathacharya
episodesList.summary: Rama plans to take revenge on Tathacharya with the help of the doctor's medicine. The Doctor agrees to give Tathacharya a medicine that will make him behave senselessly.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya Becomes Doorkeeper
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya asks Rama to find a solution for making Tathacharya normal. Rama tells Krishnadevaraya that Tathacharya should be treated with multiple-personality inducing medicine. Will the medicine be useful for Tathacharya or have side effects?

episodesList.title: Intelligence
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya brings a pot full of almonds as present to the Sultan's answer. But, Mantrivar rejects his idea of presenting almonds. Meanwhile, Rama arrives in the Darbar with a pot of intellect.

episodesList.title: Trip To Sultan's Empire
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya decides to send Rama and Tathacharya to meet Sultan. Krishnadevaraya tells Mantrivar to showcase Rama's jar of intelligence and gold jar in the empire to praise Rama's intelligence. Will Rama enjoy his trip to Sultan's empire or face challenges?

episodesList.title: Rama Meets Sultan
episodesList.summary: Ghungru makes Tathacharya and Dhani Mani unconscious and changes the identity letter of Krishnadevaraya. Dhani Mani and Tathacharya notices Ghungru missing next morning. Meanwhile, everyone reaches to the Sultan's empire. How will be Rama's experience in Sultan's empire?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya Asks Rama For Help
episodesList.summary: Dhani Mani request Sultan to cancel their punishment, but Sultan rejects their request. Meanwhile, Tathacharya asks Rama to use his intelligence for saving them.

episodesList.title: Rama Fools Fakir Baba
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya asks Rama to find a solution to escape death. Meanwhile, Sultan's Fakir Baba listens to the conversation between them. Rama tells Tathacharya and Dhani to fake happiness for the death sentence. Will Sultan cancel Rama and Tathacharya's death sentence?

episodesList.title: Urgent Meeting
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya wakes up from a nightmare, and immediately calls a meeting in Darbar. Tathacharya, Rama, and Mantrivar get eager to know the reason behind calling a meeting in the middle of the night. Why Krishnadevaraya called everyone to meet him?

episodesList.title: War of Intelligence
episodesList.summary: Mohini tells Krishnadevaraya that she is the most intelligent person in the world. Krishnadevaraya tells her that she has some misunderstanding as there are more intelligent people. Mohini challenges Krishnadevaraya that if someone defeats her, she will do whatever the winner tells. Krishnadevaraya selects Rama for the challenge. Will Rama defeat Mohini?

episodesList.title: Competition Day
episodesList.summary: Mohini arrives at Tathacharya's house to convince him to help her win over Rama. Pandit Rama Krishna arrives in the darbar for the competition. Meanwhile, Tathacharya tells the rules of the competition to Mohini and Rama. Will Rama win the competition?

episodesList.title: Rama Loses the Competition
episodesList.summary: Rama successfully answers the question Mohini asks him. Meanwhile, Tathacharya continuously tries to help Mohini win the competition. Later, Tathacharya shuts the timer before its end and announces Rama's defeat. How will Krishnadevaraya react to Rama's defeat?

episodesList.title: Krishnadevaraya Stands For Rama
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya rejects Rama's defeat and tells Mohinidevi that each contestant should get an equal chance. Krishnadevaraya tells Mohinidevi that Rama will ask her questions. Krishnadevaraya also adds that if Rama loses, Krishnadevaraya will keep his crown on Mohinidevi's feet. Will Rama win the challenge?

episodesList.title: Third Chance For Mohinidevi
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya decides to take the second chance where Rama asks questions and Mohinidevi answers. But Mohinidevi fails to answer Rama's two questions. Rama decides to give Mohinidevi second third chance in the competition. Will Mohinidevi win her third chance?

episodesList.title: Weird Issues
episodesList.summary: Mantrivar tells Krishnadevaraya that Prasanna from Belamkundagram wants to meet him. Prasanna tells that his daughter wants Krishnadevaraya to choose a suitable husband among two people Prasanna came within darbar. How will Krishnadevaraya solve Prasanna's issue?

episodesList.title: Boxing Match
episodesList.summary: Amma, Sharda, and Gundappa tell Rama that they want to attain Boxing. Rama refuses as he finds it offensive. But, Amma manages to make agree Rama fulfill her wish to watch boxing.

episodesList.title: Rama Participates in Wrestling
episodesList.summary: Rama gets worried after participating in the wrestling match. Sharda and Amma give sympathy to Rama and offers him almonds for energy. Rama tells that he asked for two days before the match to think about the match.

episodesList.title: Knowledge is Power
episodesList.summary: Rama arrives at the wrestling ground to pray for god for his fight. Rama cleverly puts jaggary around the wooden rod which as per the competition has to be pulled out of the mud. Next day Rama arrives on the ground for the match. Will Rama win the match?

episodesList.title: Final Wrestling Match
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya forces Rama to participate in wrestling against Durjan. Rama gets worried after looking at Durjan's physical fitness and experience in wrestling. He decides to confuse Durjan by asking him vague questions till Mantrivar returns. Will Rama win the match?

episodesList.title: Traitor in Vijayanagara
episodesList.summary: Mantrivar and Rama get worried to see Krishnadevaraya coming late in the darbar. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya arrives in the darbar and starts the work of the darbar. Mantrivar tells Krishnadevaraya that they have to give punishment to the detective of enemy empire. How will Krishnadevaraya decide the punishment to the traitor?

episodesList.title: Krishnadevaraya's Identical Twin
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya's identical arrives in the darbar and tells that he is the real king Krishnadevaraya. To prove the truth, the identical reminds Rama and Tathacharya of visiting the jungle for hunting a few days back. How will Rama solve this issue?

episodesList.title: Rama Confused
episodesList.summary: Mantrivar and Rama plans to present a neckless to one of the Krishnadevaraya's identical to identify them easily. Rama and Mantrivar follow both of them to find out who takes the wrong turn to the guest room. But Rama and Mantrivar get confused after seeing both taking the right path. How will Rama solve the issue of real Krishnadevaraya?

episodesList.title: Rapidfire Questions
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the darbar gets worried to see both of the Krishnadevaraya give all the answers perfectly. Rama decides to ask a question both Krishnadevaraya's about his first meet with him. Both end up saying that they remember what happened on Rama's first visit, but cannot remember what Rama said to Krishnadevaraya. How will Rama solve the issue?

episodesList.title: Queen Tirumalamba's Food Test
episodesList.summary: Queen Tirumalamba prepares tomato gulab jamun for one of Krishnadevaraya to find the real King. Krishnadevaraya tells Rama to announce him as fake king, but save him from Queen Tirumalamba's food. How will Rama distinguish between identical King?

episodesList.title: Two Krishnadevaraya On Battlefield
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya finds out that Sultan Shamsuddin has betrayed him and has attacked Vijayanagara. Both of the Krishnadevaraya ahead on the battlefield to warn Sultan Shamsuddin. Sultan and Fakir get shocked to see two Krishnadevaraya. Will Rama be able to find Real King Krishnadevaraya before the war?

episodesList.title: The Real Krishnadevaraya
episodesList.summary: Rama tells everyone that the person who had a fight with Sultan Shamsuddin is the real king. But, everyone gets confused as Rama changes his statement saying another person who stayed back in the fight is the real king because of his calm attitude towards understanding the situation first before reacting. Will Rama be able to tell who is the real King?

episodesList.title: Appreciation
episodesList.summary: Vijayanagara Empire celebrates Krishnadevaraya's Rajya Abhishek. Krishnadevaraya decides to give presents to Mantrivar, Tathacharya, and Rama for being the special person in the darbar. Rama tells Krishnadevaraya that he has no hair on his hand because of his always lending attitude. Due to Rama's clever answers, Krishnadevaraya gives him more presents. Will Tathacharya feel jealous?

episodesList.title: Krishnadevaraya's Crown
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya invites Marquis De Pompadour to his house with a plan to suborn him against Rama. But, Tathacharya stays unknown to the fact that Marquis De Pompadour accepts his invitation to hypnotize him and steal Krishnadevraya's crown. Will Rama find Marquis De Pompadour real reason to visit Vijayanagara?

episodesList.title: Krishnadevaraya's Pagdi
episodesList.summary: Rama and Mantrivar notice Tathacharya and Mani in the market. Rama asks Tathacharya out of curiosity about being worried about something. Meanwhile, Mantrivar removes his Pagdi and while leaves wrongly wears Krishnadevraya's pagdi. How will Rama solve the Pagdi issue?

episodesList.title: Pagdi Missing
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevraya gets furious to see his ancestral pagdi missing. He orders Rama to find his pagdi before sunset and warns that if he fails, everyone in the room will be hanged to death. Krishnadevraya also tells Rama that he will be the first person to be hanged. How will Rama solve the Pagdi missing problem?

episodesList.title: Rama Got Hypnotised
episodesList.summary: Marquis De Pompadour decides to hypnotize anyone from Rama's house to get the Pagdi. Rama comes out of his house and Marquis De Pompadour hypnotizes him and tells him to bring the Pagdi in the mid-night for him. Meanwhile, Tathacharya gets excited to see Rama getting into the problem. Will Rama save Krishnadevaraya's Pagdi from Marquis De Pompadour?

episodesList.title: Latecomer Rama
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevarya tells Mantrivar to wait for all the members to arrive in the Darbar. Mantrivar corrects Krishnadevaraya and tells him that everyone is present in the Darbar except Rama. Krishnadevaraya tells that he is an important part of our Darbar so we have to wait for him. Meanwhile, Tathacharya plans to deceive Krishnadevaraya against Rama. Will Krishnadevaraya take action against Rama for arriving late in the Darbar?

episodesList.title: Silly Challenge
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevarya gets angry to see Rama coming late to Darbar. Meanwhile, Tathacharya tells both Maharani about Rama's late coming habit. Both the Maharani decide to keep a challenge for Rama to see his timing. Will Rama surpass his new challenge?

episodesList.title: Misunderstanding Between King & Queen
episodesList.summary: Rama lies to Chinna Devi about a beautiful woman meeting Krishnadevraya in the park. Krishnadevraya gets angry after listening to Chinna Devi's accusation. Krishnadevraya punishes Chinna Devi and asks her to stay at her mother's house for six weeks. How will Rama solve the misunderstanding?

episodesList.title: Rama Dismissed from Darbar
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya grabs the moment and tells Krishnadevraya that Rama should be punished for his mistake. Krishnadevraya agrees to Tathacharya's statement and dismisses Rama from Darbar's work and position. How will Rama regain his position in Darbar?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya Misses Rama
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevraya fires everyone from the darbar as everyone suggests a wrong person for the punishment. He asks Tathacharya to find the perfect person who can be punished. Tathacharya requests Krishnadevraya to spare him one-day time span to find the answer. How will Tathacharya find the answer without Rama?

episodesList.title: Rama's Demands
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya requests Rama to come with them to solve the question Krishnadevraya put forward. Rama tells that he will come to the darbar only if his demands are fulfilled. Tathacharya agrees to Rama's conditions and tells to come with him. Will Rama answer Krishnadevraya's question?

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Old Man
episodesList.summary: The King's challenge of standing in the river overnight is accepted by an old man. Tenali Rama accompanies the man as he spends the night in the river. He survives and everyone is shocked. When asked how he survived, the old man replies that he took his warmth from a small lamp in the temple.

episodesList.title: Cooking Food
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama invites the King and his court home for supper. Everyone waits and waits but the food doesn't arrive. The extremely hungry guests get impatient and ask Tenal why the food is taking so long to prepare. To which Tenali shows them how he is cooking the food in vessels and barely letting the flames of the hearth touch the vessels.

episodesList.title: King Tathacharya
episodesList.summary: Varunmala brings a Baba to make him meet Tathacharya. The Baba tells Tathacharya that he can see that Tathacharya has a chance to live a kings life in the near future. Tathacharya gets happy and wishes that Baba's statement proves true. Meanwhile, Mantrivar arrives at Tathacharya's house and tells him that Krishnadevraya has called him.

episodesList.title: Sitting on the Throne
episodesList.summary: Thathacharya asks Tenali Rama whether he should sit on the throne or not? Thathacharya asks whether he should sit on the floor and Tenal Rama agrees. Will Thathacharya agree?

episodesList.title: Living Like the King
episodesList.summary: Thathacharya demands to be treated like the king. He says he wants to live the kings life and have his lifestyle. Tenali Rama meets this demand and putting Thathathcharya through the paces. Will Thathacharya be able to handle it?

episodesList.title: The Baba's Secret
episodesList.summary: The Baba is an agent of the Sultan. It is revealed that he has been fooling Thathacharya. Will Tenali Rama be able to uncover this treachery?

episodesList.title: Tenali In Prison
episodesList.summary: The Prime Minister and Tenali are conspiring in prison. The Prime Minister informs Tenali that his enquiries on the Baba yielded suspicious information.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Ghost
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama haunts Thathacharya. Tenali tells him about the attempt on Thathacharya's life.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Secret Potion
episodesList.summary: Thathacharya is tired from fighting the Baba. Tenali Rama tells him that if he loses, it will be the Kingdom's loss as well. Tenal gives Thathacharya a potion that he says will give Thathacharya all of Tenali's strength. Will Thathacharya win the fight?

episodesList.title: The Pirate's Riddle
episodesList.summary: The pirates who kidnapped Tenali need him for his wits. They present him with a riddle and task him to solve it. The pirate implies that if Tenali isn't able to solve the riddle, there would be consequences.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya Offers to Solve
