episodesList.summary: Tenali is forced to return to the pirate after he realises he is on a ship. The pirate tells him to solve the riddle again. Thatahacharya offers to do it. Will he able to?

episodesList.title: The Riddle Solved
episodesList.summary: Tenali solves the riddle and gives the pirate a location. The pirate orders the ship towards the location Tenali provided. Tathacharya and the other prisoners too want to step on land but the pirate forbids it.

episodesList.title: The Island Challenge
episodesList.summary: After the conch has been blown. The challenge has been thrown down. Tenali tries to convince the Jeera trader that they need to talk to him. Meanwhile the minister is concerned.

episodesList.title: The Game Starts
episodesList.summary: After the conch has been blown. The challenge has been thrown down. Tenali tries to convince the Jeera trader that they need to talk to him. Meanwhile the minister is concerned.

episodesList.title: The Treasure
episodesList.summary: While on board the ship, Tattacharya slips and falls into the ocean. Rama refuses to solve the puzzle until the pirates find Tattacharya. But, the real question is will Rama solve the puzzle and open the treasure box?

episodesList.title: A Tiger On The Loose
episodesList.summary: With the dawn of a new day, Tenali Rama’s family members demand their lives see a change for the good. Rama is asked to take his family members on a tour. Meanwhile, Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is faced with a new threat: a tiger prowling and terrorising his kingdom.

episodesList.title: A Trip To The Woods
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is petrified of the man eating tiger, that according to rumours can shape shift. The king and his aides, including Tenali, decides to pay a visit to the forest. Accompanying Tenali are his family members. Will they catch the tiger?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Tattacharya finds himself in trouble when he comes face to face with the supposed shape-shifting tiger. At midnight, Tattacharya goes missing. In order to find him, Tenali and Krishnadevaraya have to come up with a plan. Will they be able to rescue him?

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Tiger
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya decides to hunt the tiger which has become a mythical shape-shifting tiger in the town. Tattacharya cleverly escapes being caught in the middle of the act. Meanwhile, the Krishnadevaraya’s wives escape in what is presumed to be a tiger attack. How will Tenali solve this mystery?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya, The Bait
episodesList.summary: Tenali has to come up with a plan to catch the elusive tiger. He devises a strategy and asks Tattacharya to become a bait. At midnight, Tattacharya is tied up to a tree in order to lure the tiger.

episodesList.title: The man-eater
episodesList.summary: The man-eater, who has terrorized Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is captured. Tattacharya is relieved that he is safe. At the darbar, Tenali explains whether the man-eater can actually shape-shift into a tiger.

episodesList.title: Tenali Finds the Culprit
episodesList.summary: Tenali proves that it was Lakhanna who created the myth of the man-eating tiger. Lakhanna explains the reason behind his act, which led to fear among the villagers. His sole intention was to safeguard the forests and bring an end to rampant deforestation. Will Krishnadevaraya forgive him?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Challenge
episodesList.summary: A man walks into the darbar and puts a challenge before Krishnadevaraya’s court members. He asks the intellectual members of the kingdom to identify his mother tongue. If they win, he will shower them with gold. Tathacharya comes forth and accepts the challenge. Will he win?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Penalty
episodesList.summary: The guest who has put forth the task of finding his mother tongue before Tenali and Tattacharya is enraged when Tattacharya slaps him in order to find his mother tongue. Krishnadevaraya orders death sentence on Tattacharya. Will Tenali save Tattacharya?

episodesList.title: The Mother Tongue
episodesList.summary: The task to find the mother tongue of Krishnadevaraya’s guest continues as Tenali and Tattacharya come up with different plans. Tenali manages to find the mother tongue and proves that the guest’s mother tongue is Telugu.

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Visitor
episodesList.summary: Tenali is hungry but his wife has not prepared a meal for him. This irritates Tenali and he leaves for the darbar without eating. At the King’s court, a mysterious man, who appears to be intelligent, arrives. Who is this man?

episodesList.title: Tenali's New Nemesis
episodesList.summary: Kalluri Dinkar’s wit impresses everyone at the King’s court including Krishnadevaraya. No one knows for sure what Kalluri Dinkar’s intentions are. They are unaware that Kalluri wants to humiliate Tenali and take his position.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Wisdom
episodesList.summary: Tenali and Kalluri Dinkar are pitted against each other in a battle of wisdom to determine who is better. Shardha arrives in the darbar and mocks Kalluri, who feels humiliated and decides to exact revenge on Tenali.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Wisdom
episodesList.summary: Tenali and Kalluri Dinkar are faced with a tough proposition. They have to decide the fate of a child and help Krishnadevaraya deliver a sound judgement. Heeding Kalluri’s advice, Krishnadevaraya delivers a verdict that saddens Tenali and he decides to quit from his advisory position at the darbar.

episodesList.title: The Necklace Thief
episodesList.summary: At midnight, a thief sneaks into Tenali Rama’s house and steals Shardha’s gold necklace. Gundappa tries to catch a glimpse of the thief. While trying to escape the thief bumps into the Queen’s convey. Shardha approaches the Krishnadevaraya and asks for justice. Krishnadevaraya summons the Queen and asks her to revel the identiy of the thief.

episodesList.title: Tenali Leaves the Kingdom
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama is directed to leave the kingdom and head to his village. As per the order, Tenali and his family members leave their house. But, the Queen, who has seen the thief is still keeping it a secret. Why is the Queen keeping it a secret?

episodesList.title: Tenali Is Victorious
episodesList.summary: Tenali is proved right and Kalluri Dinkar’s decision are proved wrong by none other than Krishnadevaraya. Tenali’s advice was the right one and even Kalluri Dinkar acknowledges that Tenali is more intelligent than him.

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Child
episodesList.summary: Shardha approaches a saint, who asks her to plant a pineapple in order to bear a child. She forces Tenali Rama to get out at midnight and plant a pineapple. The next day, mysteriously a child appears.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Son
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya is in trouble as his supposed son has arrived home. Tathacharya is unsure from where this boy has arrived. Tathacharya’s wife too claims that the boy is his son after seeing his mannerisms, which are similar to Tathacharya’s. Who will solve the mystery of the pedigree?

episodesList.title: Meet Tenali's Son
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya’s son, Chotacharya, comes to the darbar and Tenali, seeing Chotacharya’s mannerisms, claims that he is indeed Tathacharya’s son. But, as the event unfolds, Tathacharya turns the situation around and claims that Chotacharya is Tenali’s son.

episodesList.title: Mystery of Tenali's Son
episodesList.summary: Sameer enters the wedding house with the Baraat dancing in the front. Naina's father and her brother are furious to see him but can't do anything as he came in by the groom's side. Naina is happy to see him but gets jealous when another girl starts dancing with him.

episodesList.title: Mystery of Tenali's Son Continues
episodesList.summary: Tenali proves in the darbar that Choturama is neither his son nor Tathacharya’s. Then, to everyone's surprise it is believed that Chotu is Krishnadevaraya’s son. Hearing this the King is puzzled and refuses to acknowledge him as his son.

episodesList.title: The Theft
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is excited to be part of the sobhayatra. While on the way to the temple, the valuables begin carried by Tattacharya are stolen. Who has committed the robbery and how?

episodesList.title: The Grand Theft
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevarya is furious about the robbery that has taken place before the festival. Tenali concludes that Sommaya, who had directed Tattacharya to take a different route, is part of the robbery. But, who is the mastermind behind the grand theft?

episodesList.title: The Culprit Revealed
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom is in a state of despair. Tenali is looking to find evidence that will reveal the culprit behind the robbery. Then, Krishnadevaraya receives a letter in which a neighboring King has called Krishnadevaraya to bend the knee before him.

episodesList.title: Tenali Rama's Letter
episodesList.summary: Shradha finds a letter written by Tenali. In the letter, Tenali states that he is going to meet Dhananjay. A similar letter is sent to Krishnadevaraya and he learns that Tenali has risked his life to resolve the differences between the two states. While on the way to the neighbouring kingdom, Tenali meets Tathacharya. How will Tenali and Tathacharya prevent the war from happening?

episodesList.title: Rama's Daring Act
episodesList.summary: cannot speak. Tenali takes the task to reviving the child's speech. He does so by pushing Dhananjay off the terrace. What will be the consequences of this act?

episodesList.title: Tenali's Goodwill
episodesList.summary: Dhananjay is furious at Tenali as he was pushed by him from the terrace. When Tenali informs that his intention was to treat the lost voice of Dhananjay’s son, Dhananjay realises Tenali’s goodwill. But, will Dhananjay give back the stolen ornaments to Tenali?

episodesList.title: Dhananjay Surrenders
episodesList.summary: Dhananjay fails to fulfill Tenali’s demand and realizes that all the wealth in the world is not sufficient to meet the demand of Tenali. Before the war can commence, Dhananjay runs to the battlefield and hands over the ornaments to Krishnadevaraya.

episodesList.title: Threat to Krishnadevaraya
episodesList.summary: Tenali meets the Goddess, who informs him about the looming threat on Krishnadevaraya and his kingdom. Tenali and Krishnadevaraya are unaware that Chandrakala has been sent by the rival Kings to harm Krishnadevaraya.

episodesList.title: The Trap
episodesList.summary: Two craftsmen arrive in Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom. They meet Sharadha and inform her that they will make old gold ornaments as shiny as new. Falling for this trap, Sharadha hands over the gold ornaments to them.

episodesList.title: Tenali Is Conned
episodesList.summary: Tenali and Shardha realise that the two craftsmen have duped them and made away with their jewellery. The two craftsmen arrive at Tattacharya’s house and con his wife. Then, Tenali sees Chandrakala and realises that she has arrived in the kingdom with a malicious intent.

episodesList.title: Jewellery Thieves
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya is informed that Charulata and her husband have duped people in his kingdom. The King orders that the thiefs have to be arrested soon. Chandrakala is in the darbar and upon seeing the King she follows him.

episodesList.title: Chandrakala's Weakness
episodesList.summary: Chandrakala faces hostility when she arrives in Tenali’s house. After learning that it is not Tattacharya’s house, she leaves. Meanwhile, Tenali and the king’s guard are searching for the jewellery thieves. Will Tenali be able to nab the thieves?

episodesList.title: Revenge of the Thug
episodesList.summary: Bala is determined to exact revenge on Tenali. But, he intends to con Krishnadevaraya in front of the darbar, which will startle Tenali. Meanwhile, Chandralakha has arrived in Tattacharya's house. What is the reason behind her visit?

episodesList.title: Bala's Revenge Plan
episodesList.summary: Bala plans to get revenge on Tenali for what he did to him. intends to con Krishnadevaraya in front of the darbar, which will startle Tenali.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Plan
episodesList.summary: Bala and his wife move into the palace and find themselves caught in the intricate web of Tenali’s wit. Tenali wants to make sure Bala leaves the palace voluntarily. How will Tenali achieve this plan and will Bala leave the palace?

episodesList.title: Poison For A Lie
episodesList.summary: The king taunts Bala with offerings of palace and gold while being suspicious of them in turning the gold to iron. Tenali steps in to unravel Bala and his wife’s plot.

episodesList.title: It's Holi
episodesList.summary: Chandrakala arrives in the palace and watches Krishnadevaraya without his awareness. Then, Krishnadevaraya arrives the darbar and is greeted by his council on the occasion of Holi. Tenali does not want to play Holi but Sharadha insists that he let her apply color on him.

episodesList.title: Holi Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Chandrakala during the Holi celebrations decides to execute her plan and kill Krishnadevaraya. She mixes her blood in a dessert prepared for the king. While on her way to give the dessert to Krishnadevaraya, she meets Tattacharya, who takes the desserts to give it to Krishnadevaraya. Chandrakala breathes a sigh of relief as Tattacharya will be held responsible for Krishnadevaraya’s death.

episodesList.title: Holi Aftermath
episodesList.summary: Tattacharya is plotting a plan to get back to Tenali for ridiculing him in public by pouring colour over him. He gets intoxicated and employs a snake charmer.

episodesList.title: Kalavathi's Warning
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya assures Kalavathi that she will receive justice. Kalavathi warns Krishnadevaraya that the kingdom will be cursed and attacked by shape-shifting snakes if justice is not served. Then, seeing Chandrakala, Kalavathi gets astonished.

episodesList.title: Snake Catcher
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya’s council is terrified after numerous snakes entered each of their residence Kalavathi is called to the darbar and she informs that the kingdom will be cursed by the snakes. Tenali Rama arrives in the darbar and reveals his plan to call the snakes to the darbar. Will Tenali’s plan work?

episodesList.title: Chandrakala's Identity
episodesList.summary: Tenali sees Chandrakala drinking milk. Chandrakala reveals that she is a shape-shifting snake and plans to kill Krishnadevaraya. When Tenali decides to inform Krishnadevaraya about Chandrakala, she threatens to kill Sharada. What will Tenali do to save Krishnadevaraya?

episodesList.title: The Just Punishment
episodesList.summary: Chandrakala poisons the laddo from Tenali and SharadaDevi for the King. She gives Tenali an antidote for her poison and makes him take the poisoned laddo to the King.

episodesList.title: The Silver Lining
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya gets his finger cut from a mock duel with his queen. Tattacharya uses this instance to entrap Tenali against the words he used in wishing the king. The king asks him to prove his statement, threatening to cut his finger else wise.

episodesList.title: The Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: Tenali, Tattacharya, and Krishnadevaraya are all tied up by the tribal men. They are brought before the priestess, who selects Krishnadevaraya as the one to be sacrificed before their deity. Krishnadevaraya pulls out the sword and battles the tribal leader. But, in the end, Krishnadevaraya loses and finds that his neck is about to be chopped off. Will this be Krishnadevaraya’s end?

episodesList.title: Recipe for Disaster
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya, Tenali, and Tattacharya safely return to their kingdom. Later, Queen Tirumalamba is worried that Krishnadevaraya might go bald. She decides to make him a special drink which will keep his hair firmly fixed to their roots. But, the special drink creates chaos in the kingdom.

episodesList.title: Bearded Beauties
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya dumps his medicine for facial hair since it tastes funny. But, it falls into a plate of laddoos that all the women in the court eat. The next morning opens up to a bizarre scene all over the capital with women growing facial hair. How will the women get out of this predicament?

episodesList.title: The Odd One In
episodesList.summary: The women of the court are thinking for a way to remove the moustaches they grew due to the hair potion. Hopeless, a gathering of all the men in Vijayanagara is called for to discuss in finding a solution to this problem. But the discussion turns to a mockery which the Queen made them resent.

episodesList.title: The Facial Hair Conundrum
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama goes in search of a solution to the facial hair on women in Vijaynagar and announces in court that all the women need to chant a hymn for 21 days and the men need to cook while fasting.

episodesList.title: A Cow for A Brahmin
episodesList.summary: There is a scarcity of milk everywhere. Tenali's mother is complaining of the unavailability of good quality milk and so is Rajguru's wife. with pressure from their home, both of them are looking forward to getting a cow. Meanwhile, the King calls them over for presenting them with a gift.

episodesList.title: A Cow and A Cat
episodesList.summary: Tenali and Rajguru bring home a cow after the milk scarcity and both of their families complaint to them about it. Tenali and others witness the milkman mixing water with the milk to sell more. The milkman apologizes to them and asks them for mercy. What will Tenali do now?

episodesList.title: Cat In The Box
episodesList.summary: The day of the competition comes and everyone presents their cats in front of Maharaj for him to decide who wins but Pandit Rama Krishna's cat is nowhere to be seen. Tenali tells Maharaj that his cat doesn't drink any milk and he'll prove it to anyone.

episodesList.title: The Artist
episodesList.summary: Maharaj paints a painting and presents it in front of Guruji and Tenali and tells them to explain what they see in the painting. Obviously, the painting is too horrible for them to explain or describe it.

episodesList.title: Three Dolls
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya and Tenali Rama are faced with a tough task. They have to find three differences between three strikingly similar dolls. If they fail, Krishnadevaraya has to oblige to the demands of Jhilli.

episodesList.title: Krishnadevaraya's Anger
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama successfully finds out differences between three dolls, which satisfies Jhilli and upholds Krishnadevaraya’s prestige. Later, Tenali Rama happens to be at the receiving end of Krishnadevaraya’s wrath. What made Krishnadevaraya angry?

episodesList.title: Greed for Gold
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya is of the suspicion that Tenali possess a special gem stone that can turn an ordinary metal into gold. He informs this to Krishnadevaraya, who is intrigued about it. Later that night, Tathacharya decides to sneak into Teanli’s house to find out about the gem stone.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Speech
episodesList.summary: Tenali is startled to see Tathacharya inside his house. Tathacharya reveals that he is searching for the gem stone. A search is conducted at Tenali’s house for the gem stone. Will Tathacharya get his hands on the gem stone?

episodesList.title: Mysterious Disappearance
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama’s proves that he does not possess any gem stone that can turn ordinary metal into gold. Later, Krishnadevaraya’s son, Vasudev, goes missing right under Tathacharya’s nose. Where has Vasudev disappeared?

episodesList.title: The Secret Chamber
episodesList.summary: Either Tenali or Tattacharya has to step inside the secret chamber. But, neither want to take that risk. Tenali presumes that Tattacharya has gone inside the chamber. Later, Krishnadevaraya assigns the task to Tenali and asks him to risk his life and go inside the chamber.

episodesList.title: Vasudev Returns
episodesList.summary: Tenali has gone inside the secret chamber to find Kumar Vasudev. Krishnadevaraya assures the Queen that he will find Vasudev. Right then, Kumar Vasudev meets the Queen. Now that Vasudev is safe, how will Tenali escape the chamber?

episodesList.title: Tenali Is Lost
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya is worried as Tenali Rama has still not returned from the secret chamber. Tattacharya learns about Tenali and meets Krishnadevaraya. Now, Tattacharya too has to venture inside the chamber, where Tenali has lost contact with Shardha.

episodesList.title: Tiger On The Loose
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya himself takes on the responsibility of rescuing Tenali. Meanwhile, Tenali, who is trapped inside the secret chamber, comes face to face with a tiger. How will Tenali escape from the jaws of death?

episodesList.title: End of The Tunnel
episodesList.summary: Just when Krishnadevaraya is about to enter the cave, Tattacharya, along with Tenali Rama, comes out of the cave. As Krishnadevaraya rejoices, a tiger too runs out of the cave. Krishnadevaraya is relived that not just Tenali but the tiger too has found freedom from the cave.

episodesList.title: The Visitors
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama has a new plan. He and Shardha disguise themselves as Punjabis and pretend to be visiting Krishnadevaraya’s kingdom. In disguise, Tenali meets Krishnadevaraya to execute his plan. What is Tenali’s plan about?

episodesList.title: The Mirror
episodesList.summary: Tenali and Shardha put up a mirror in the darbar. Tenali invites everyone to look into the mirror. The ones who are righteous will see a glimpse of the Goddess. From Tattacharya to Chinnadevi, everyone lies that they have seen a glimpse of the Goddess. Next, Tenali invites Krishnadevaraya to look into the mirror.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Lesson
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama explains to Krishnadevaraya the reason behind his disguise. This greatly impresses Krishnadevaraya. Later, in Krishnadevaraya’s darbar, a dancer enthralls Krishnadevaraya’s council. The dancer, who is close to Tattacharya, impresses Krishnadevaraya with her dance. Who is this special guest?

episodesList.title: Caught From A Different Angle
episodesList.summary: Saudamini Devi has got something stuck in her eye and King Krishnadevaraya helps her out with it. Queen Chinna Devi and Tenali catch them from an angle that is just too suspicious to be true. They figure that King Krishnadevaraya might be settling for a new queen. Sad and confused Queen Chinnadevi opens up to queen Tirumalamba and both of them confronts King Krishnadevaraya.

episodesList.title: Spreads Like Fire
episodesList.summary: Maha Mantri confronts King Krishnadevaraya about the rumour about him and Saudamini Devi. King Krishnadevaraya gets furious on Tenali thinking that he was the start to the rumour. Tenali confides the truth in his wife.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Truth
episodesList.summary: Queen Chinnadevi is determined to expose Saudamini. Then, Tattacharya is seen talking to Saudamini and the council members learn about Tattacharya and Saudamini’s relationship. When confronted by Tenali Rama, Tattacharya claims innocence. Will Tattacharya confess the truth?

episodesList.title: The Reacting Truth
episodesList.summary: It’s the poetry reciting day at Emperor Krishnadevaraya’s court and all the ministers are preparing for it. While Tenali saves Tathacharya poem from falling in the mud, what else will happen in the Royal court of Vijayanagara?

episodesList.title: The Trickster
episodesList.summary: A stranger heads into Vijaynagara and tricks Acharya into thinking he wants a shelter for a night, finally he dupes Acharya and makes him look like a fool. Tenali is all set to catch this man.

episodesList.title: Tenali Knows Best
episodesList.summary: The trickster, who recently cheated Acharya Chakra Pani, is now at Tenali’s home pretending to be Tenali’s childhood friend Gopal Krishna. Watch how Tenali teaches the cheat a lesson and makes him admit his frauds.

episodesList.title: Lesson Learnt
episodesList.summary: It’s Tenali’s turn to trick Rajguru Acharya Tathacharya. Tenali dresses up as a visitor and gives Tathacharya the duty to protect a sack of gold coins, but what Tathacharya doesn’t know is that it’s a sack of stones. A foreign explorer from Portugal Domingo Paes is on his way to the kingdom of Vijayanagara.

episodesList.title: Good Food or Good Wife
episodesList.summary: King Krishnadevraya's has a case of a bad stomach ache and he thinks that Queen Tirumalamba’s cooking might be the cause. While queen Tirumalamba brings more dishes for the King, the King is fed up with it. Tenali is called, watch how he brings a witty solution.

episodesList.title: Visitor From Portugal
episodesList.summary: Vijayanagar has a guest from Portugal and he wishes to write about the prosperous kingdom in his book. This text would help the upcoming generations, to learn and respect the great empire. The courtiers are excited about the development and are all keen to have their story in the book. How would Vijayanagar react to welcome their guest?

episodesList.title: Put Your Name In History
episodesList.summary: Domingo Paes have come all the way from Portuguese to write his novel about Vijayanagara empire. Tathacharya is all set and excited about his visit and wants to put his name down in Paes’s novel.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Plan
episodesList.summary: Domingo is touring Vijayanagar and documenting the everyday happenings. Krishnadevaraya's council wants to prove their superiority over others. Tattacharya suggests to Krishnadevaraya that Domingo's documents will prove that Vijayanagar is one of the greatest kingdoms to the western world. Tattacharya has a plan up his sleeve to put his name in Domingo's documents.

episodesList.title: The Winds of War
episodesList.summary: Domingo is touring Vijayanagar and documenting the everyday happenings. Krishnadevaraya's council wants to prove their superiority over others. Tattacharya suggests to Krishnadevaraya that Domingo's documents will prove that Vijayanagar is one of the greatest kingdoms to the western world. Tattacharya has a plan up his sleeve to put his name in Domingo's documents.

episodesList.title: Women of Vijayanagara
episodesList.summary: Domingo Paes is writing his book about Vijaynagara. Emperor Krishnadevaraya is all set for a war with Narsingh Vardhan. All the women of Vijaynagara surprisingly get to the battle field to represent the women and get their names down in history.

episodesList.title: The Peacekeeper
episodesList.summary: Anand find the envolpe with money inside Naina’s washroom, although disappointed with Naina, he forgives her. Naina sneaks her way to Sameer’s place to catch a glimpse of him after a year, but Sameer is still angry with Naina.

episodesList.title: Friend From Afar
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya is worried about his ally and friend Dharampal. To Krishnadevaraya's surprise, Dharampal pays a surprise visit to Vijayanagar with his wife. What is the purpose of Dharampal's visit?

episodesList.title: Split Personality
episodesList.summary: Munmun has a drastic change in personality after drinking a special juice made by Tirumalamba. Munmun picks up a sword and starts attacking the ones surrounding her. Krishnadevaraya is furious after learning that Tirumalamba's special drink made Munmun angry.

episodesList.title: The Queen Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Munmun sneaks out of the palace in the guise of a servant. Tenali and Shardha do not find Munmun and inform Krishnadevaraya. Before Munmun can be found, Dharampal arrives at the palace. Will Dharampal find out that his beloved Queen has disappeared?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Punishment
episodesList.summary: Munmun appears at Tattacharya's house but not as herself. Munmun thinks she is Amma and starts punishing Tattacharya. Later, Munmun is Jwala, a bandit. Will Tenali find a solution to Munmun's split personality?

episodesList.title: Queen Becomes Bandit
episodesList.summary: Munmun thinks she is a bandit, Jwala and terrorizes the citizens of Vijayanagar. Krishnadevaraya tries to halt Munmun's bandit way of life. Seeing Dharampal approaching, Tenali diverts the attention of Munmun so that Dharampal doesn't see her as a bandit. Will Munmun regain her senses?

episodesList.title: Sharda's Father Pays A Visit
episodesList.summary: Munmun now thinks she is Shardha's father and arrives at Tenali Rama's house. Gundappa, after searching for Tenali, informs him that his father-in-law has arrived. Meanwhile, Dharampal is eager to meet his wife, but Krishnadevaraya keeps him busy until the queen comes to her senses.

episodesList.title: Trapped In Love
episodesList.summary: Tenali solves the mystery behind Munmun's various disguises. When Dharampal arrives in the darbar, Tenali explains to the king that Munmun is trapped in his obsessive love and this is affecting her psychologically, which explains her various disguises.

episodesList.title: A New Problem
episodesList.summary: Dharampal learns his lesson and decides to return to his kingdom. Then, another complicated case comes to Krishnadevaraya's darbar. Tenali has to solve the case of the Kotwal and his wife who are arguing about an issue.

episodesList.title: Seeds Of War
episodesList.summary: Mughal Emperor Babar has sent a spy in Vijayanagar. Meanwhile, Tenali has a nightmare in which he has been captured by Babar's army. Tenali fears that the Mughal forces will march towards Vijayanagar. Before Babar plans his attack, he has planned to beat Tenali at his own game.

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Dhani and Mani inform Tathacharya about the visitor. Based on Dhani and Mani's description, Tathacharya suspects that the visitor has been sent by Mughal emperor Babar, probably to spy on Vijayanagar. Will Tenali Rama find out that he is the target for Babar?

episodesList.title: The Traitor
episodesList.summary: Babar's spy sneaks into Tenali Rama's house at midnight. Following the spy is Tathacharya, who also enters Tenali's house. The spy makes Tathacharya believe that Tenali is planning to dethrone Krishnadevaraya and become the king. Tathacharya believes the spy's word and informs Tenali that he will alert Krishnadevaraya.

episodesList.title: Treason
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya accuses Tenali Rama of treason and informs Krishnadevaraya about it. Krishnadevaraya immediately summons the guards and asks them to arrest Tenali and hang him. How will Tenali get out of this mess and prove his innocence?

episodesList.title: Rama's Plan
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya surprises Tenali by assuring him of his trust in Tenali Rama's loyalty. Tenali asks Krishnadevaraya to let him meet Babur and convince him to abandon the idea of war. Will Tenali Rama's plan work?

episodesList.title: Tenali's Journey Begins
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama convinces his mother and packs his bags to head towards Agra to meet Babar. Tattacharya is displeased with Tenali’s visit to Agra. He decides to follow Tenali Rama and find out if he is Babar’s spy.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Solution
episodesList.summary: While on the way to Agra, Tenali sees Tattacharya following him. Tenali manages to deceive Tattacharya and arrives at Agra. While at Agra, Tenali comes across a man who has been separated from his wife for a minor issue. Tenali decides to take matters into his own hands and solve the man’s problem.

episodesList.title: Tenali Meets Babar
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama notices Tattacharya’s arrival in Agra and gets him beaten up by a crowd. Later, Tenali and Tattacharya join hands to save Vijayanagar. Then, Tenali arrives in Babar’s court and dares to look him in the eye and deliver his message.

episodesList.title: Laughter Challenge
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama notices Tattacharya’s arrival in Agra and gets him beaten up by a crowd. Later, Tenali and Tattacharya join hands to save Vijayanagar. Then, Tenali arrives in Babar’s court and dares to look him in the eye and deliver his message.

episodesList.title: The Battle Begins
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama notices Tattacharya’s arrival in Agra and gets him beaten up by a crowd. Later, Tenali and Tattacharya join hands to save Vijayanagar. Then, Tenali arrives in Babar’s court and dares to look him in the eye and deliver his message.

episodesList.title: Rama's Last Wish
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama asks for his last wish to be fulfilled before the sentence is implemented. Tenali asks for the guard to be summoned. Tenali proves to Babar that anyone can enter his kingdom without guards supervision. Babar is shocked to hear this. How will Tenali escape Babar's wrath?

episodesList.title: Tathacharya's Trick
episodesList.summary: In order to help Tenali Rama win the poetry battle, Tattacharya steals all the betel quids under Babban Miya's possession. Without the betel quids, Babban Miya loses concentration and Tenali Rama gains an upper hand. Will Babar find out Tattacharya's trick?

episodesList.title: Rama's New Competitor
episodesList.summary: Tenali reveals to Babar that Babban Miya's betel quids were stolen by Tattacharya. An infuriated Babar announces that Tenali Rama will face Maya Devi in a battle to be the wittiest. Will Tenali Rama emerge the winner?

episodesList.title: The Three Doors
episodesList.summary: Tenali reveals to Babar that Babban Miya's betel quids were stolen by Tattacharya. An infuriated Babar announces that Tenali Rama will face Maya Devi in a battle to be the wittiest. Will Tenali Rama emerge the winner?

episodesList.title: Tenali's Disguise
episodesList.summary: As the Sehansha disperses money to the poor, Tenali disguises him self as an old poor man, to trick the Emperor. But things turn out not how he had expected it.

episodesList.title: The Bow and Arrow
episodesList.summary: Tenali’s wife has taken up a new skill of archery but she isn’t quite good at it. On the royal court, the king questions Tathacharya about his whereabouts. There is good news as Mughal Raj Babar leaves and declares that there is no more a war between the two kingdoms.

episodesList.title: The Ritual
episodesList.summary: Krishnadevaraya dispises Prataprudradev, the neighboring king. He learns that Pratap is coming to perform the Rudrabhishek. But, Krishnadevaraya too wants to perform the ritual. This creates a conflict and the two kings refuse to budge. Does Tenali Rama have a solution to this problem?

episodesList.title: First In Line
episodesList.summary: As it’s a special occasion and Emperor Krishnadevaraya has reached the Shiva temple, in this purpose, there he meets Emperor Pratap who is also there for the same. Now both the Emperors fight it out that who will be the first one. Tenali saves the day with his idea.

episodesList.title: Tenali's Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya's manages to save his head from getting decapitated as Krishnadevaraya and Prataprudradev realize their mistake and spare Tathacharya's life. Later, Tenali wakes up in the middle of the night following a nightmare and decides to take Krishnadevaraya back to his kingdom before things get worse.

episodesList.title: Brewing Love
episodesList.summary: Tathacharya uses his disciples to teach Prataprudradev's advisor a lesson. Tenali Rama sees Prataprudradev's daughter trying to befriend Krishnadevaraya. Prataprudradev gets into an argument with Krishnadevaraya after seeing his daughter with the Vijayanagar king. Will this be the reason for war?

episodesList.title: Rama's Predicament
episodesList.summary: Shardha and Amma are on their way to warn the two queens about Jaganmohini when Tenali Rama stops them. Tenali Rama pleads with Shardha and Amma to stay away from the queens. Nevertheless, Shardha and Amma watch Jaganmohini and her mother closely. As Tenali Rama tries to avoid one troublesome situation another comes knocking.

episodesList.title: The Rightful Judgement
episodesList.summary: Shardha and Amma cajole Gundappa to instigate Chinnadevi and Tirumalammba against Jaganmohini. Meanwhile, Tenali Rama helps Krishnadevaraya deliver rightful judgment, which impresses Prataprudradev. Things get complicated when Prataprudradev asks Krishnadevaraya to let him take Tenali Rama as his council member.

episodesList.title: Tenali In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Tenali Rama gets into a dispute with Emperor Krishnadevaraya, and finally the decision is taken that he will be sent off to another Empire. Gundappa gets the queens in trouble by telling them what not.

episodesList.title: The Solution
episodesList.summary: Chinnadevi and Tirumalamba discover the real side of Prataprudradev's wife and daughter. Later, Shardha claims that she has been duped by Amma and produces a necklace as proof to Krishnadevaraya. Tattacharya opines that Tenali Rama should settle his family dispute inside the confines of his house. Will Krishnadevaraya offer a solution?

episodesList.title: Tit For Tat
episodesList.summary: Prataprudradev is impressed by Tattacharya's wisdom and wants to take him to his kingdom. Tattacharya realizes that the dispute he settled between Amma and Shardha was a ploy of Tenali Rama. As Tattacharya bids adieu, Tenali Rama informs him that he played a trick used by Tattacharya himself to get rid of the grand old master.

title: Teri Raza
summary: Teri Raza (Urdu: تیری رضا, lit. 'Your Pleasure') is a Pakistani television series that first aired on ARY Digital on 8 July 2017 and ended on 2 February 2018. It was produced by Fahad Mustafa and Dr. Ali Kazmi under their banner Big Bang Entertainment.
plot: Teri Raza centers on Suhana, a young college student in love with her chauvinist classmate Rameez. Her parents arrange a marriage for her with her older, well-settled relative, Imtiaz, after an Istikhara is performed by her grandmother. Suhana initially resists but eventually agrees to the marriage when Rameez's careless attitude leads her to believe he is not serious about their relationship. After marrying Imtiaz, Suhana cannot adjust to her new life and remains in love with Rameez. Imtiaz, realizing her feelings, divorces her, and she returns to Rameez. Due to his grandmother mother's pressure, Imtiaz marries her colleague Seema, leading Suhana to move on. Thus, she marries Rameez despite the opposition of her family who cut the ties with her after her decision. Her marriage suufers due to chauvinism of Rameez and his ture nature. At this turbulent stage, Suhana then learns that Imtiaz still loves her.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text:
The series was received mixed reviews, with critics panning characterisation of the female lead. The character received the highest votes in the "most annoying TV character" category by critics and readers of the DAWN Images.
The series was panned in the year-ender articles of several publications, with Sadaf Haider of DAWN Images criticised characterisation of Suhana's character, Buraq Shabbir of The News International noted the inconsistent treatment of the characters, and Mahwash Badar of The Express Tribune opined that the "story seems very clichéd but the dialogues are beautiful and the story keeps shifting in and out of intrigue to keep the audience hooked".

title: TV Biwi Aur Main
summary: TV, Biwi aur Main (transl. TV, wife and I)  is an Indian sitcom series on SAB TV. It premiered on 13 June 2017 and went off air on the 10 of October 2017.
plot:
Rajeev, a television daily-soap producer, is a workaholic, much to his wife's dismay. Hilarity ensues when he tries to strike a balance between his personal and professional life.
Show covers the comic timings created between Priya (Rajeev's wife) and Rajeev's mom who is not satisfied with her son's choice and wanted a daughter-in-law just like Bindiya (Rajeev's show's heroine). She thinks Bindiya is a perfect daughter-in-law as she portrays in the show and compares Priya with Bindiya, though in reality Bindiya is a self-centered arrogant attention seeker. As the time passes Rajeev's mom is shown to have a soft corner for Priya. The show ended with Rajeev receiving a chance to produce one more show in the same channel and he thanks everyone including his team and family for supporting him in his journey.

episodesList.title: Priya Yells At Bindiya
episodesList.summary: Priyanka and her friends are observing a religious fast for the long lives of their husbands. Meanwhile, Rajeev ponders over different ways to borrow the nuptial necklace from Priyanka. Then, Priyanka's friends show her Bindiya's interview in which she praises her chemistry with Rajeev. Suddenly, Rajeev enters the room and demands Priyanka's nuptial necklace which shocks Priyanka as well as her friends.

episodesList.title: Bindiya Refuses To Work In Rajeev's Soap Opera
episodesList.summary: Rajeev's troubles escalate as Priyanka refuses to give him the nuptial necklace while Bindiya threatens to leave the shooting location. Meanwhile, Priyanka learns the truth and offers Rajeev her nuptial necklace. However, Bindiya is still stubborn about leaving the location. Rajeev travels to the location to convince Bindiya and resume shooting.

episodesList.title: Rajeev's Affair
episodesList.summary: Priya finds Rajeev in a compromising position with Bindu. She vents out her anger on Rajeev. In defence, Rajeev claims that she is doubting her loyalty. Priya refuses to forgive Rajeev and walks out of the room. Rajeev decides to visit the set in order to escape Priya's wrath. Will Rajeev manage to win over Priya? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Priya's Singing Skills
episodesList.summary: Priya and Rajeev wake up to the sound of bhajan. Rajeev's mother-in-law is impressed by Bindu's devotion to God. She ridicules Priya as she does not know any bhajan. Priya is enraged and decides to sing a bhajan to prove that she can sing. But, Rajeev stops her before things go out of hand.

episodesList.title: Bindu's True Motive
episodesList.summary: Bindu brings a ring for Rajeev and puts the ring in his engagement ring finger. This enrages Priya, who insults Bindu and questions her motive. Bindu breaks down into tears and leaves. Rajeev goes to Bindu's room to console her but finds out that Bindu's true motive to come to his house is to marry him. Rajeev somehow manages to escape her room and tries to convey this to Priya. However, Priya feels guilty for how she had behaved with Bindu and thinks that Rajeev is taunting her for her actions.

episodesList.title: Priya's Marriage In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Priya's friends inform her that she has done a grave mistake by sending Bindu with Rajeev to the set. During the shoot, Kaushal fails to put Sindoor on Bindiya's forehead, leading to retakes. Guest: Sudeepa Singh - Bindu (Rajeev's Ex-girlfriend)

episodesList.title: Happy Ending
episodesList.summary: Priya and Bauji with the help of people on the set decide to change Rajeev's habit. Everyone plans to do their task slowly and let Rajeev believe that shooting will be delayed. But, Priya could not keep the secret and tells Rajeev that it was her plan to teach him a lesson. Meanwhile, Amma Ji and Rajeev's mother-in-law arrive at the set to watch the live telecast of Bindiya's show. Later, Rajeev thanks everyone for making Bindiya Sringar Ek Suhagan Ka successful.

title: The Test Case
summary: The Test Case is a 2017 Indian web series, directed by Vinay Waikul and Nagesh Kukunoor and produced by Endemol Shine India for the ALTBalaji. It stars Nimrat Kaur, Akshay Oberoi, Atul Kulkarni, Rahul Dev and Anup Soni in lead roles along with Juhi Chawla in a guest appearance. The web series is about the main character training to be the first woman test case in a combat role, within the Indian Army. The basic story of this web series is inspired from the 1997 American film G.I. Jane and former Canadian Army officer Sandra Perron's memoir Outstanding in the Field.
plot:
Captain Shikha Sharma is the only woman in a group of Indian Army officers training to join the Special forces. She is also the first woman to be undertaking the course making her a "test case" for inducting women into combat oriented roles in the Indian army. The storyline revolves around her journey of overcoming challenges at home to biases by her colleagues despite being an intelligent and a highly motivated individual.
Shikha initially faces physical challenges when completing a demanding obstacle course. But she perseveres and overcomes them with grit. This results in making both friends and enemies among her colleagues. She manages to not only remain in the course but also moves up to the top-half of the team's leaderboard. During the final phase of training, which is in the form of a simulated sortie into harsh enemy territory spanning multiple days, Shikha is placed in command of one of the two competing squads in an effort to test her leadership skills. The exercise ends in disaster with the squad losing contact with the course instructors for a prolonged period of time. The squad eventually makes it back with Shikha and Captain Bilal suffering severe injuries and unconscious. A medical examination reveals that Shikha's injuries were not as a result of combat injuries. But a follow-up interrogation by the lead course instructor Naib Subedar Kirpal Bhatti and the course commanding officer Colonel Ajinkya Sathe has Shikha and the members of her squad insisting that nothing untoward happened and the injuries were as a result of an accident.
In the meanwhile, an anonymous letter is sent to the Army command alleging that Shikha was sexually assaulted during the exercise. Lieutenant Colonel Imtiaz Hussain, a poker aficionado, is dispatched to investigate quickly and quietly. Using a series of unconventional tactics Colonel Hussain ultimately manages to piece together the sequence of events and identify the culprit. But Shikha refuses to press charges saying she wants to solve this problem without anyone else helping her. She explains to Hussain that she wants to set a clear example that women are not only just capable of joining combat units but also equally capable of defending themselves without help. She ultimately manages to get Captain Manit Varma to confess while covertly recording his confession; And also manages to defeat him in one on one close quarter combat. He is ultimately arrested and led away by the Army police.
The story ends on a happy note with Shikha graduating top of the training course.
reception: Bollywood actor Aamir Khan liked the series and appreciated the entire cast of the series for their efforts.

articleSections.title: Delay in episode availability
articleSections.text:
The first episode of the series was made available on the launch date over the ALT Balaji App. The future of the series appeared uncertain after successive episodes did not follow for a prolonged period. Reports of creative differences emerged between the director and the producer as a possible reason for the delay. Eventually it was announced that from the second episode onwards, Kukunoor had been replaced by Vinay Waikul as the director. Waikul had previously served as first assistant director for films like Dangal, 3 idiots, Bhaag Milkha Bhaag and Ghajini. This web series was Waikul's directorial debut.
In December 2017, an announcement from the show's producer confirmed the shooting having been completed for the remaining 9 episodes. These were made available for viewing on 26 January 2018 - to coincide with the Indian Republic Day.

articleSections.text: Bollywood actor Aamir Khan liked the series and appreciated the entire cast of the series for their efforts.

episodesList.title: The Beginning
episodesList.summary: It's merit vs. bias for Captain Shikha Sharma. How long before she's recognized for her strength rather than her gender?

episodesList.title: The Outsider
episodesList.summary: At the obstacles training ground, under Naik Subedar Bhatti’s watch, the officers sweat it out to finish the obstacles task in the given time. Almost everyone expects Capt. Sharma to fail but she is determined to prove otherwise. Meanwhile, in the first week someone is forced to exit the course.

episodesList.title: The Player
episodesList.summary: Though accounts of Capt. Sharma’s endurance reaches the Defense Ministry, only ‘Dozakh’ will be the ultimate test. Tensions between Capt. Rathore and Capt. Sharma increase when he is punished for reporting late next morning. But the commando training is not just hard work, the officers get an evening to relax and enjoy. Capt. Sharma gives everyone the slip to go away for a while.

episodesList.title: Heart of Darkness - Part I
episodesList.summary: With a past heavily looming over her psyche, Capt. Shikha Sharma endures it all in the Dozakh task. Capt. Siddiqui gets upset when Sharma refuses to discuss her personal life with him. Meanwhile, Col. Ajinkya Sathe pulls a surprise by suddenly changing a decision. Who will be Shikha Sharma’s allies in the final task of Dozakh? One more will bite the dust.

episodesList.title: Heart of Darkness - Part II
episodesList.summary: How far can a human body push its limits to prove a statement? Can you really keep quite while going through hell? Now, Dozakh is not just a task to be completed but a real mission to be accomplished. Due to puzzling circumstances, team leader Capt. Shikha Sharma’s leadership skills are questioned by her team member. This is a ticking time bomb.

episodesList.title: Down But Not Out
episodesList.summary: The final task may be officially over, but it is the beginning of new struggles for Capt. Shikha Sharma. Leaving SFTC seems like the only option. The officers submit debrief reports about everything that happened during the operation. What will the reports of Team Alpha reveal? Gen. Ramani appoints a trusted officer to investigate.

episodesList.title: Mind Games
episodesList.summary: What happened that day? Why did Capt. Siddiqui go home and why is Capt. Shikha Sharma in the hospital? Col. Imtiaz Hussain is here to find some answers, and members of Team Alpha are concerned. He begins by interrogating RMO Capt. Aparna Rao. Is she hiding the truth? Meanwhile, Shikha Sharma submits her debrief report.

episodesList.title: Prisoners of Conscience
episodesList.summary: Lt. Col. Imtiaz Hussain approaches Shikha Sharma to find out her version of the events. Shikha Sharma learns a few things that bring some clarity. How long before she finds out the ultimate truth? Meanwhile Capt. Bilal Siddiqui talks to Lt. Col. Imtiaz Hussain.

episodesList.title: The Confession
episodesList.summary: Lt. Col Imtiaz Hussain figures out the actual sequence of events of that fateful day. Col. Ajinkya Sathe is outraged after learning the findings of the investigation. Moreover, he finds Shikha Sharma’s decision more shocking. The final two exercises of the course begin. Find out why Shikha Sharma eyes for the 3rd spot and not the 1st.

episodesList.title: What Goes Around... Comes Around
episodesList.summary: The remaining officers successfully complete the course and pass out wearing the Maroon Beret. They are now part of the elite of the elite forces. Along with the rescue operation Capt. Shikha Sharma also finishes another very important operation. Will Capt. Shika Sharma create history?

title: Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh, Piyaji
summary:
Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh, Piyaji (transl. You Are the Sun, I Am the Twilight, Beloved) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series that premiered on 3 April 2017 on Star Plus. The series is also digitally available on Disney+Hotstar. Produced under the banner of Shashi Sumeet Productions, it is the sequel to Diya Aur Baati Hum. The series starred Rhea Sharma and Avinesh Rekhi. It ended on 1 June 2018.
It was originally broadcast in the afternoon during the network's Star Dopaher (afternoon) programming block. On 24 July 2017, the series was moved to prime time replacing Saath Nibhaana Saathiya.
plot:
The series takes place 20 years after the events in Diya Aur Baati Hum and it revolves around the children of Sooraj and Sandhya, mainly focusing on their daughter, Kanak.
Kanak's grandmother, Santosh initially hates her to the core, blaming her to be the reason behind her parents, Sooraj and Sandhya's death. She fixes her alliance with Mayank who lives abroad in London. Kanak's life takes a new turn when Uma Shankar Toshniwal, a rich, kind-hearted and devotional, spiritual man of fath and an Ayurveda doctor by profession, marries her, believing that as a sign from Lord. Uma is a strong faithful believer in morals and ways from his own spirit but also sometimes wrongly guided by his greedy and hypocritical maternal aunt, Nanda. Kanak sets off on a journey with Uma to teach him the greatest moral of life – humanity. In the process, Kanak falls in love with Uma after establishing herself as the perfect wife for him. Uma's sister Saras and Kanak's brother Vansh elope, enabling Nanda to instigate Uma in hating Kanak. Kanak soon divorces Uma and demands 50% of his property which is named on Nanda. When Uma and Palomi are getting married, Uma feels that Kanak is in danger so he leaves his marriage and searches Kanak. He finds Kanak in a forest where Nanda's son Aditya hangs Kanak on a tree. He saves her life and sends Aditya to jail.
Uma and Kanak confess their love and decide to get married in ten days. Kanak exposes Nanda and Aditya in front of Uma when she gives poison to Laddus. Nanda then falsely accuses Uma for killing Palomi and gets him sentenced jailed for ten years. They both escape and go to Bangkok. They change their identity and expose Nanda and Aditya.
After returning to India, they soon decide to get married but Uma, for some unknown reason, marries Meera Mittal, the deranged daughter of a rich businessman, ditching Kanak.

articleSections.title: 2 years later
articleSections.text:
Kanak, now self-sufficient and possessing bitter hatred towards Uma, eventually reappears in his life, who has become a successful business tycoon running the 'K & U' company in the meantime. It is revealed later on that Uma still loves Kanak and was actually blackmailed and forced into marrying Meera to save his younger cousin Suman from receiving punishment for a murder she had inadvertently committed. Meera upon knowing Kanak's identity, along with Aditya, tries many heinous ways to separate the duo, including an unsuccessful attempt to marry off Kanak to Akshay also was hell-bent on ruining her. Suman is now full of guilt and decides to sacrifice her life so that Uma and Kanak can re-unite. They save her and the truth is finally unveiled before Kanak. She gets rid of her ill-feelings towards Uma and gets Meera arrested with the help of others by hatching a crafty plan.
They remarry after settling their differences and restore their relationship. Aditya realises his mistake and becomes loyal to his brother and sister-in-law. It is then that Nanda comes out of jail.
After Saras suffering an unfortunate miscarriage on account of failing to reach the medical facility on time, and seeing Uma's grief over the matter, Kanak and Aditya launch a bike ambulance service for Uma. This creates a number of enemies for Uma and Kanak from the very outset, and Dr. Parag, the corrupt Dean of Pratistha Medical College, joins hands with Nanda to cancel Uma's license so that he can use the idea to promote his own medical college and take the credit totally upon himself. Kanak decides to study paramedics and become a doctor herself to save the license from being cancelled and so that no one can label her as an amateur when she treats patients.
After facing numerous hurdles and hindrances set by the Dean himself at Dr. Parag's college, in an attempt to crush her dream, she finally succeeds in exposing Dr. Parag's true nature to the public. As a result, he is arrested and sentenced to imprisonment. It is revealed that during his time in jail, Nanda was subjected to ill-treatment by Dr. Parag, which fuels her desire for revenge upon her release. However, upon her release, she decides to abandon her plots against Uma and Kanak, choosing a different path.
Uma at this time receives a fake call and is attacked by goons, who also trash his bike ambulance. He recovers 6 months later, but loses his memory. To everyone's surprise, he turns into the same superstitious person he was before. He force Kanak to either choose him or pursue her paramedics course. Kanak ultimately chooses to continue her dream of becoming a doctor. Uma supports her decision, and Aditya then reveal that it was their plan all along to infuse some confidence and passion into Kanak, which she was lacking and also that he had never lost his memory. With this, the story finally ends on a happy note as Kanak sets off for her new career with the blessings of all the elders.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
This sequel of Diya Aur Baati Hum was planned before it going off air itself. Actress Neelu Vaghela playing Santosh revealed the title of the series in February 2017 as Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh, Piyaji. The title of the series was taken from the title track of Diya Aur Baati Hum.
The series began with a leap of 20 years in its storyline from Diya Aur Baati Hum focusing on Sandhya (Deepika Singh) and Sooraj's (Anas Rashid) children, mainly Kanak (Rhea Sharma) after their death.
This series was launched originally during Star Plus afternoon slot named Star Plus Dopahar Block along with three other series, aiming at retrieving the afternoon programming of the channel. Soon, in June 2017, this series among the others was moved to the prime time replacing Saath Nibhana Saathiya as the makers and the channel felt that it could reach a larger audience and also it being a sequel to one of the popular show Diya Aur Baati Hum.
Playback singer Palak Muchhal was roped to sing for the title track of the series. Singers Amit Trivedi and Shreya Ghoshal collaborated for the title track of the series.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: Based on the backdrop of Rajasthan, the series was mainly filmed at sets in Mumbai. Some of the initial scenes were shot in Kerala and Jaipur, Rajasthan. In January 2018, the sequence of Kanak and Uma searching for Palomi was shot in Thailand.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Neelu Vaghela, Ashok Lokhande, Kanika Maheshwari, Urmila Sharma and Rishina Kandhari reprised their roles from Diya Aur Baati Hum. Rajeev Singh was roped for the role of Vikram Rathi which was played by Karan Goddwani and Gautam Gulati in the former series.
Avinesh Rekhi was roped for the role of Uma Shankar. Rhea Sharma was roped for the lead role of Kanak. Besides Mayank Arora, Kabeer Kumar, Uday Nene, Sheetal Pandey, Sheefali Singh Soni, Sadiya Siddiqui, Madhura Naik, Mazel Vyas and Swathi Kapoor were cast then.
In November 2017, Kanika Maheshwari playing Meenakshi quit the series as she stated nothing yet to explore in her character. In February 2018, Kangana Sharma was roped for the role of Meera Mittal, making her television debut. Soon, in March 2018, Ankit Bhatla was cast as Akshay.

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: With the time slot shift from afternoon to prime time, the ratings of the series had an increase but as it could not garner expected ratings in the slot, it was sent a notice by the channel in May 2018 and was taken off air on 1 June 2018.

plotHtml: The series takes place 20 years after the events in Diya Aur Baati Hum and it revolves around the children of Sooraj and Sandhya, mainly focusing on their daughter, Kanak. Kanak's grandmother, Santosh initially hates her to the core, blaming her to be the reason behind her parents, Sooraj and Sandhya's death. She fixes her alliance with Mayank who lives abroad in London. Kanak's life takes a new turn when Uma Shankar Toshniwal, a rich, kind-hearted and devotional, spiritual man of fath and an Ayurveda doctor by profession, marries her, believing that as a sign from Lord. Uma is a strong faithful believer in morals and ways from his own spirit but also sometimes wrongly guided by his greedy and hypocritical maternal aunt, Nanda. Kanak sets off on a journey with Uma to teach him the greatest moral of life – humanity. In the process, Kanak falls in love with Uma after establishing herself as the perfect wife for him. Uma's sister Saras and Kanak's brother Vansh elope, enabling Nanda to instigate Uma in hating Kanak. Kanak soon divorces Uma and demands 50% of his property which is named on Nanda. When Uma and Palomi are getting married, Uma feels that Kanak is in danger so he leaves his marriage and searches Kanak. He finds Kanak in a forest where Nanda's son Aditya hangs Kanak on a tree. He saves her life and sends Aditya to jail. Uma and Kanak confess their love and decide to get married in ten days. Kanak exposes Nanda and Aditya in front of Uma when she gives poison to Laddus. Nanda then falsely accuses Uma for killing Palomi and gets him sentenced jailed for ten years. They both escape and go to Bangkok. They change their identity and expose Nanda and Aditya. After returning to India, they soon decide to get married but Uma, for some unknown reason, marries Meera Mittal, the deranged daughter of a rich businessman, ditching Kanak.
tagline: The series takes place 20 years after the events in Diya Aur Baati Hum and it revolves around the children of Sooraj and Sandhya, mainly focusing on their daughter, Kanak.

title: Tanhaiyan
summary: Tanhaiyan (transl. Solitude) is a Hotstar original romantic drama television series. It stars Barun Sobti and Surbhi Jyoti in lead roles. The series included 10 episodes of about 20 minutes each. It was produced by 4 Lions Films and distributed by Star India.
plot:
Set against a wedding backdrop, the show focuses on two individuals, Meera and Haider, who meet at the wedding of their friends Avantika and Sid. Haider is a rich and carefree casanova, while Meera is a bubbly and cheerful fashion designer. Haider holds himself and his absence responsible for his friend Raza's suicide, after Haider had left for London. Meera feels lonely after her parents died in a car accident. Both bottle their pasts, repressing their pain under their new personalities.
The two constantly bicker, playfully flirt with each other and decide to go for a one-night stand, which Meera drunkenly calls "sleepex". They grow closer after a failed attempt, finally do it and soon realize that they developed feelings for each other. Haider feels affected by Meera and pushes her away, scared that his feelings will make him vulnerable, and break his 'casanova' coping mechanism to escape his past.
Meanwhile, Avantika struggles with a secret of her own. When Sid and Avantika were briefly broken up at some point, Avantika had a brief one-night stand with their common friend, Sameer. Avantika reveals her long-buried secret to Sid, and he breaks off the marriage.
Haider visits Raza's grave, which he had avoided since he died, and finally breaks down, mourning his best friend. Meanwhile, heartbroken by Haider's dismissive and absent behaviour towards her. Meera decides to leave for a job in New York. Slowly waking up and smelling the coffee, Haider visits Raza's mother, where he has the epiphany that he cannot let Meera go. He rushes back and stops her from leaving, confessing his love to her, and they embrace. Later, he proposes marriage to her, which she accepts.
Meanwhile, Sid and Avantika reunite after sorting out their problems. On the engagement day of Haider and Meera, Haider notices Meera's earrings and recognizes them as his mother's, which were owned by Raza. Haider unlocks Raza's laptop, which was in his possession, by typing Meera's birthdate, and the laptop opens with a picture of Meera as the wallpaper. Shattered, he leaves the venue for London without any explanation, leaving Meera heartbroken.
Months later, Meera and Haider are still not over each other. Meera decides to go abroad for work and visits Avantika, who tells her about Raza. Meera remembers how she knows Raza whom she had worked with but never knew that he was silently in love with her. He proposed to her once but, because they had barely even spoken, Meera took it as a practical joke and jokingly said yes. She concludes that he might have committed suicide since he was lonely after she stopped working after her parents' death, realizing Meera was not serious. She received the earrings as a gift from Raza during her parents' funeral, but she never knew who sent them.
Meanwhile, Raza's mother, now aware of the situation, explains to Haider that Meera has no part in Raza's death. On the night before Meera's flight to New York, she visits Haider's house where they first met and reminisces all their moments when he finds an emotional Haider standing there who apologizes to her and they confess their love to each other. They reunite and hug passionately.

Peppered with folklores, legends and Sakshi's personal anecdotes.

title: Trideviyaan
summary: Trideviyaan is an  Indian Hindi Thriller, Comedy television series,  which was broadcast on SAB TV. The series was produced by Full House Media of Amir and Sonali Jaffar.
plot:
The plot follows the story of two girls - Dhanushree "Dhannu" and Tanuja "Tannu" who are caring housewives and also, work as secret agents for their father-in-law, Dinanath Chauhan alias Agent Himalaya. Dhannu alias Agent Laal Kila is married to Dinanath's elder son Shaurya Chauhan who is an honest and brave police inspector and Tannu alias Agent Hawa Mahal marries Dinanath's younger son, Garv Chauhan who is a crime news reporter. On their wedding day, when the time comes to leave the maternal home, Tannu locks the door of her room and refuses to leave. When asked, she confesses to Dinanath that she likes Garv but doesn't wish to go to her marital home and sacrifice her profession, which is a secret. But Dinanath reveals that he is aware of her secret, that she is UCA (Under Cover Army)'s secret agent and then he mentions that he is also a UCA agent, Agent Himalaya and henceforth she would continue in her profession by joining his secret army with another agent. Tannu then gladly accepts to leave for her new home and also thinks that the agent who would be joining her is her brother-in-law, Shaurya. On their way, they stop at a temple to complete Dhannu's manner regarding this marriage. But, as they were about to leave the temple after completing the "Mannat", a group of thieves threatens the entire Chauhan family, and they are taken to a distant place. There it is revealed to us that the second agent is Dhannu! The duo then beat up the goons and all the family members manage to escape. But Garv and Tannu are unable to spend time together on their wedding night as Tannu is called to Dinanath's secret lab where she is introduced to many new gadgets. But one day, Dinanath's younger daughter Manya Chauhan a.k.a. Mannu discovers that Tannu, Dhannu, and Dinanath are secret agents and wants to join their team as "Agent Qutub Minar" or else she will tell everyone, especially her mother, the secret.
On a fake mission, which coincidentally turns real, Mannu saves her co-agents and is permitted to receive training and become an agent and then the agents become known as "Trideviyaan". They successfully conceal their secret identities from Dinanath's wife Suhasini Chauhan, his mother Damyanti Chauhan who is a kleptomaniac, Fatteh Mama - the servant, the paying guests, and even from Shaurya and Garv. With Dhannu's strength, Tannu's speed, and Mannu's power of voice, they are a formidable team.
