episodesList.summary: Garv tells Tanu that he wishes to spend some time with her. Dhanu instructs Manu to force Garv to walk out of his room.

episodesList.title: Tanu Completes Her Mission
episodesList.summary: Tanu informs Dinanath that she has successfully completed her mission. Dinanath learns that Tanu is sitting inside Shaurya's jeep.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Attack the Goons in the Party
episodesList.summary: Manu's mother advises her to not follow Dhanu and Tanu's orders. Dinanath instructs his three secret agents to punish the goons who have entered into the party.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Resolve to Stay United
episodesList.summary: Suhasini asks Tanu to prepare food for her friend Mandakini Mehra. Trideviyaan assures Dinanath that they will remain united in the future.

episodesList.title: Tolaram Ka Godown
episodesList.summary: Diwakar tells his agents that the jeweler might know Ghamosha in person. He instructs Agent Lal Kila to check Tolaram's godown.

episodesList.title: Manu Plans to Arrest Tolaram
episodesList.summary: Dhanu tells Tanu that she should not have interfered in her in the secret mission. Manu assures Dhanu and Tanu that she will find and arrest Tolaram.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Hunt Tolaram
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan plan to hunt Tolaram in the city. Tanu learns that Dhanu's husband Shaurya is involved in various crimes.

episodesList.title: Tanu Plans to Seize the Smuggler
episodesList.summary: Tanu assures Dinanath that she will find out the policeman who is involved in the smuggling of gold. Shaurya tells Garv that the police commissioner wishes to meet him and Tanu.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Plans to Detain Shaurya
episodesList.summary: Tanu tells Dhanu and Manu that an international dance group would perform in the annual function of the police department. Trideviyaan plan to visit the function in the guise of the dance performers.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Fail to Arrest Shaurya
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan plan to secretly arrest Shaurya from the annual function of the police department. They enter Shaurya's room but fail to catch him.

episodesList.title: Police Arrest Shaurya
episodesList.summary: Shaurya reaches the seashore to seize Kitu and his goons. He requests the police to arrest him. Dhanu gets shocked to see Shaurya in jail.

episodesList.title: Episode 28
episodesList.summary: Shaurya tells Dhanu that he has deliberately put himself behind bars. Dhanu informs her family that she is looking forward to celebrate her wedding anniversary.

episodesList.title: Titu Befriends Shaurya
episodesList.summary: Fatte comes to Dinanath's house. Titu praises Shaurya for not revealing his secret to the police. Dhanu's family comes up with various ways to make her cry.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Stops Kitu From Escaping Jail
episodesList.summary: Dhanu's family plans to put her on sleep. Later, Shaurya stops Kitu from escaping the jail.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Beats Kitu
episodesList.summary: Shaurya beats Kitu and his goons in the police station. Shaurya tells his family that he will throw a party when he will find Gamosha.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Ka Locket
episodesList.summary: Dhanu tells Dinanath that she had given his locket to Shaurya. Shaurya's boss tells him that Gamosha may harm him in the future.

episodesList.title: Gamosha Threatens Shaurya
episodesList.summary: Gamosha plans to blow up Dinanath's house with a bomb. Gamosha makes a call to Shaurya. He asks Shaurya to release Kitu from jail.

episodesList.title: Bomb in Shaurya's House
episodesList.summary: Gamosha informs Shaurya's brother that soon his house will be blown up with a bomb. Shaurya brings bomb disposal squad to his house.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Finds the Watermelon Bomb
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan arrange an outdoor game for their guests. Shaurya finds the bomb kept in a watermelon. He ties to watermelon to Kitu's hands.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Arrests Kitu
episodesList.summary: Shaurya tells Gamosha that he has arrested Kitu. Gamosha assumes that Kitu has passed away. An astrologer assures Gamosha that Kitu is alive.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Receives a Mysterious Courier
episodesList.summary: Dinanath's wife tells her family that Parmindar Chaddha has made marriage proposal for Manu. Shaurya receives a courier from an anonymous person.

episodesList.title: Manu Refuses to Marry Nikhil
episodesList.summary: Manu clears it to Dhanu and Tanu that she doesn't wish to get married. Gamosha decides to take revenge against Shaurya once returning from a retreat.

episodesList.title: Chanda Meets Dhanu and Tanu
episodesList.summary: Chanda Chadhha meets Dhanu and Tanu in the restaurant. On the other hand, Nikhil comes to Dinanath's house to meet Manu.

episodesList.title: Chanda Chaddha Comes to Dinanath's House
Chanda Finds Out Shaurya and Dhanu's Relationship
episodesList.summary: Nikhil requests Chanda Chaddha to forgive Manu's family for their mistake. Chanda Chaddha finds out Shaurya's relationship with Dhanu.

episodesList.title: Manu Steals Nikhil's Mobile Phone
episodesList.summary: Chanda Chaddha questions Trideviyaan about Shaurya and Dhanu's relationship with each other. Manu appears before Nikhil in the guise of a security guard.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Appear Before Gamosha
episodesList.summary: Manu informs Dhanu and Tanu that she has stolen Nikhil's mobile phone. Trideviyaan appear before Gamosha in a dark room.

episodesList.title: Manu Secretly Enters Nikhil's Room
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan cracks the password of Nikhil's mobile phone. Dinanath assures Nikhil that he would soon find out his mobile phone. Manu secretly enters into Nikhil's room.

episodesList.title: Episode 45
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan plan to search Nikhil's secret box. They soon learn that Nikhil has kept Manu's childhood photos in the box. Nikhil tells Dinanath's family that he had a secret crush on Manu since his childhood.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Brings Gamosha to His House
episodesList.summary: Chanda Chaddha's car hits Gamosha in front of Dinanath's house. Dinanath tells his family that they must look after Gamosha's health. Dinanath's family bring Gamosha in their house.

episodesList.title: Gamosha Ka Game Plan
episodesList.summary: Dinanath's family assumes that Gamosha has lost his memory. Gamosha deliberately tells Dinanath that his name is Gajodhar. Dinanath asks Trideviyaan to find out Gajodhar's contact details.

episodesList.title: Manu Plans to Restore Gamosha's Lost Memory
episodesList.summary: Gamosha, in the guise of Gajodhar, plans to perform puja in the house. Manu hits a ball to Gamosha. She tells Dinanath that she wishes to restore Gamosha's lost memory.

episodesList.title: Titu Escapes From the Jail
episodesList.summary: Titu escapes from the jail. Shaurya informs his colleagues that he has kept a tracker in Titu's pocket. Trideviyaan finds out that Gamosha has been kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Arrests Titu
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan will come to a temple to rescue Gamosha. Shaurya arrests Titu from the temple. Gamosha regains his memory.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan and Dinanath learn that Chanda Chaddha is trying to enter into the basement. Trideviyaan convince Chanda Chaddha that she is not keeping well.

episodesList.title: Gamosha Invites Dinanath's Family for Party
episodesList.summary: Gamosha comes to Dinanath's house. He invites all the family members for dinner party. Dhanu finds Gamosha's photograph in her house.

episodesList.title: Gamosha Kidnaps Dinanaths Family
episodesList.summary: Gamosha invites Dhanu and her family for a party. Dhanu informs Dinanath that their family has been kidnapped by Gamosha.

episodesList.title: Episode 55
episodesList.summary: Gamosha reveals his true identity before Dinanath and his family. He decides to take revenge against Shaurya for hitting Titu.

episodesList.title: Diamond Ki Raksha
episodesList.summary: Dinanath informs Trideviyaan about an expensive Diamond kept in an exhibition. He tells them that they must protect the Diamond from theft.

episodesList.title: Episode 57
episodesList.summary: Dinanath tells Trideviyaan that they must save the Pink Diamond from thieves. Dhanu and Tanu come to the Diamond exhibition in the guise of sculptors.

episodesList.title: Thief Steals the Pink Diamond
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan comes to a museum to safeguard Pink Diamond. A thief secretly intrudes into the museum and steals the the Diamond.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Bring Pink Diamond to Their House
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan bring Pink Diamond to their house. The soon learn that Shaurya may arrest them for stealing the the diamond.

episodesList.title: Episode 60
episodesList.summary: Shaurya suggests Garv to let Manu keep Hiralal in their house. Dhanu tells Tanu and Manu that Shaurya may find out that Trideviyaan had stolen the Pink Diamond from the museum.

episodesList.title: Episode 61
episodesList.summary: Manu tells Dinanath that Shaurya is determined to arrest the thief who has stolen the Pink Diamond. A goon steals Manu’s dog Hiralal in front of her eyes.

episodesList.title: Episode 62
episodesList.summary: Chanda Chaddha tells Trideviyaan that she is aware that they had stolen Pink Diamond. Shaurya informs Trideviyaan that Mr. Patel will come to their house in the guise of an animal to take his pink diamond back.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Prepares Truth Serum
episodesList.summary: Shaurya arrests the thief who has stolen Pink Diamond. Trideviyaan gets shocked to see Dinanath dancing in their secret chamber. Dinanath tells Trideviyaan that he has prepared a 'truth serum' to arrest Satyawan.

episodesList.title: Manu Drinks the Truth Serum
episodesList.summary: Dinanath welcomes Muthuswamy to his house. Dhanu and Tanu find out that Manu has drunk the truth serum. Manu starts revealing Dinanath’s secrets before Muthuswamy.

episodesList.title: Episode 65
episodesList.summary: Dhanu tells Tanu that Manu should not reveal their secrets to Muthuswamy. Manu meets Shaurya in a market and tells him that she is a secret agent.

episodesList.title: Episode 66
episodesList.summary: Muthuswamy finds out that Dinanath is a secret agent. He points a gun towards Dinanath. However, Dinanath retaliates and beats Muthuswamy.

episodesList.title: Shauryas Family Return Home
episodesList.summary: Shaurya and his family secretly come into their house. Tanu and Garv plan to order food for them from a restaurant. Garv gets shocked to see a stranger in his house.

episodesList.title: Manu Ka Ghost
episodesList.summary: Garv and Shaurya find out that their family members have intruded into the house to watch a cricket match. Shaurya and his family get shocked to see Manu in the guise of a ghost.

episodesList.title: Dipika Comes to Shaurya's House
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan get shocked to see Dipika Patnewali flirting with Shaurya and Garv in the police station. Shaurya welcomes Dipika Patnewali in his house.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Teach Dipika a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Dipika comes to Shaurya’s room for rehearsing her dialogues for her upcoming film. Dhanu and Tanu plan to teach Dipika a lesson for intruding into Shaurya’s room.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Spots Two Detectives
episodesList.summary: Dipika tells Manu that she wishes to meet Shaurya and Garv in the guise of a detective. Shaurya spots Dhanu and Tanu in their detective avatar in front of his house.

episodesList.title: Sam Cooper Comes to Dinanath's House
episodesList.summary: Sam Cooper comes to Dinanath’s house. He offers various roles to Shaurya and his family members in his alleged new film. While shooting, Shaurya finds out that Sam Cooper is a robber.

episodesList.title: Missile Chor
episodesList.summary: Manu and her family plan to go for a picnic. Dinanath learns that a missile has been stolen from a space agency. Dinanath plans to find out the missing missile.

episodesList.title: Episode 76
episodesList.summary: Dinanath orders Trideviyaan to find a thief who has stolen a missile from space agency. Trideviyaan successfully nab the thief.

episodesList.title: Tanus Secret Video
episodesList.summary: Tanu tells Dinanath that Garv has forwarded their secret video to Shaurya’s mobile phone. Trideviyaan plan to delete the video from Shaurya’s phone.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Nab the Missile Thief
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan promise Dinanath that soon they will nab the thief who had stolen the missile from the space agency. Two thieves plan to secretly smuggle the missile out of the country.

episodesList.title: Ghost in Dinanaths House
episodesList.summary: Shaurya brings a planchet to his house to invoke ghosts. Dinanath’s family members get frightened to paranormal activities in the house.

episodesList.title: Ghost Appears in Dhanus House
episodesList.summary: A ghost appears before Dhanu. She tells Dhanu that she will stay in her house until she finds out her murderer. Dhanu’s family get shocked to see her dressed as a south Indian woman.

episodesList.title: Ghost Enters Dinanath's House
episodesList.summary: Shaurya and his family learn that a ghost has entered their house. Garv brings a doctor to his house to check Dhanu’s health.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Plans to Attack a Ghost
Episode 84
episodesList.summary: Mohini’s ghost asks Manu to reveal the name of her murder. Manu’s family urge her to reveal the name of the murderer.

episodesList.title: Episode 85
episodesList.summary: Manu informs her family that Mohini was hit by Rahul’s speeding car. Dhanu tells Dinanath that Mohini wanted to punish Rahul for his mistake.

episodesList.title: Manohar Meets Dinanath
episodesList.summary: Dhanu’s mother-in-law advises Trideviyaan to observe death anniversary of her father-in-law. A little boy enters Dinanath’s house in the guise of Manohar.

episodesList.title: Dhanu Forces Garv to Wear Saree
episodesList.summary: Manohar instructs Trideviyaan to prepare food for him. Tanu goes to a shop to buy sweets. Dhanu and Manu force Garv to wear a saree. Garv stands before Manohar in the guise of Tanu.

episodesList.title: Manohar Yells at Garv
episodesList.summary: Manohar yells at Garv for wearing saree and standing before him in the guise of Tanu. Later, Manohar advises Dinanath and his sons to not be afraid of their wives.

episodesList.title: Manohar Finds Out Shaurya's Secret
episodesList.summary: Dinanath, Shaurya and Garv apologize to their wives for hurting their feelings. Manohar gets shocked to see Shaurya’s fake moustache lying in his food.

episodesList.title: Goons Kidnap Manu
episodesList.summary: Dinanath observes transmitter in Manohar’s walking stick. Dhanu and Tanu find out that a few goons have kidnaped Manu.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Rescues Manu
episodesList.summary: Dinanath learns that his father has hidden a hazardous chemical in his house. Trideviyaan plan to rescue Manu from her kidnappers.

episodesList.title: Police Arrest Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Trideviyaan for looting a bank. Magician Kilmish comes to Dinanath’s house and hypnotizes Shaurya and his family.

episodesList.title: Kilmish Hypnotizes Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: Kilmish hypnotizes Trideviyaan with his magical powers. Trideviyaan call Garv and request him to release them from jail.

episodesList.title: Kilmish Comes to Dinanath's House
episodesList.summary: Kilmish comes to Dinanath’s house in the guise of a postman. Trideviyaan plans to attack Kilmish in their house.

episodesList.title: Kilmish Hypnotizes Dhanu's Family
episodesList.summary: Kilmish hypnotizes Dhanu’s family. He instructs them to attack Trideviyaan. Garv requests Kilmish to not cause any harm to his family members.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Hypnotize Kilmish
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan inform their family that Kilmish had tried to hypnotize them on the earlier day. Garv invites Kilmish to a magic show. Trideviyaan hypnotize Kilmish in front of his audience.

episodesList.title: Tribals Attack Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: Dhanu tells Shaurya that he should not have gone to Nasik for training. A few tribals enter Dinanath’s house and attack Trideviyaan.

episodesList.title: Katappi Demands a Key From Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: Manu asks Katappi as to what he wants from Tanu. Katappi demands a key from Trideviyaan. Manu tells Katappi that she has lost the key.

episodesList.title: Katappi Attacks Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: Dhanu tells Manu and Tanu that they must now allow Katappi to cause them any harm. Katappi and his aides attack Trideviyaan.

episodesList.title: Guddu Plans to Kill Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: Guddu finds a trunk full of jewellery in a jungle. Guddu and his goons tie Trideviyaan to a rope and plan to kill them.

episodesList.title: Guddu Brings Trideviyaan to Jungle
episodesList.summary: Guddu and his goons bring Trideviyaan to a jungle to kill them all. Trideviyaan tells Guddu that they are aware about his evil intention.

episodesList.title: Charlie Trouble Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan learn that Charlie parrot is aware of their secret names. Manu tells Dhanu and Tanu that they should keep Charlie in birds rescue center.

episodesList.title: Musa Ka Secret Plan
episodesList.summary: Musa tells his parrot that he will force Trideviyaan to shake Mumbai city with bombs. Dinanath tells Trideviyaan that they must find out the bombs created by Musa.

episodesList.title: Ghost Party
episodesList.summary: Police commissioner and his wife come to Shaurya’s house on their marriage anniversary. They get terrified to see Trideviyaan and Dinanath in the costume of ghosts

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Defuse Musa's Bombs
episodesList.summary: Musa’s parrot suggests Trideviyaan to find Musa’s bombs in a rickshaw. Trideviyaan find and defuse the bombs kept by Musa.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Expect a New Guest in Their House
episodesList.summary: Dinanath’s wife tells him that she is eagerly waiting to see her grandchildren. Garv assumes that his parents are planning for a baby.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Reveals the Secret of His Wife's Pregnancy
Children Create Havoc in Dinanath's House
episodesList.summary: Dinanath’s wife invites a few children from an NGO to her house. Trideviyaan inform Dinanath that a few men were trying to kidnap Vinay in a garden.

episodesList.title: Hide and Seek
episodesList.summary: Children force Trideviyaan and their family to play hide and-seek with them. Two goons secretly enter Dinanath’s house.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Rescue Vinay
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan rescue Vinay from his kidnappers. While returning home, Dinanath’s wife buys a lottery ticket.

episodesList.title: Dinanath's Wife Wins Lottery
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan congratulate Dinanath’s wife as she wins a lottery. They soon learn that the lottery ticket is missing.

episodesList.title: Shaurya and Garv Plan to Search Lottery Ticket
episodesList.summary: Shaurya and Garv plan to find out their lottery ticket. Few pedestrian beat Garv as he tries to find his lottery ticket.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Plans to Rent Out His Guesthouse
Amar and Prem Come to Dinanath's House
episodesList.summary: Amar and Prem’s landlord throw them out of his house. Later, Amar and Prem come to Dinanath’s house in the guise of a married couple.

episodesList.title: Prem Plans to Meet Manu
episodesList.summary: Prem calls Manu and asks her to meet him in person. Amar advises Prem to stay away from Manu and her family.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Find Out Prem's Past
episodesList.summary: Fatte tells Dinanath that they must do background check of their tenants. Trideviyaan plan to find out the secret of Amar and Promila’s love affair.

episodesList.title: Dhanu Decides to Verify Amar and Prem's Past
episodesList.summary: Prem tells Manu that she would find her life partner by the evening. Dinanath asks Amar as to where he met his wife for the first time. On the other hand, Trideviyaan ask the same question to Prem to verify his past.

episodesList.title: Amar Displays Hair Wigs to Dinanath
episodesList.summary: Amar tells Dinanath and his family that he has several hair wigs. He displays some of them to Dinanath. Dhanu asks Amar to bring Promila out of her room.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Plans to Arrest Ustara Man
episodesList.summary: Shaurya tells his team that they must arrest Ustara Man at the earliest. Dinanath assumes that his tenant Amar is a goon.

episodesList.title: Mission Ustara Man
episodesList.summary: Dhanu tells Tanu and Manu that they must find out 'ustara man'. Trideviyaan plan to find out the relationship between 'ustara man' and Dinanath.

episodesList.title: Shaurya Plans to Arrest Ustara Man
Shaurya Decides to Arrest Ustara Man
Dinanath Plans Amar and Promila's Wedding
episodesList.summary: A couple demand 5 lakh rupees from Prem. Dinanath’s family plan to organize Amar and Promila’s wedding.

episodesList.title: Dhanu Plans to Give Jewellery to Promila
episodesList.summary: The show explores two Sankaari Bahu's , Dhanshree and Tanuja along with their nanad Manya. Both the bahu's are well trained secret special agents. They have been chosen by their Boss who is none other than their Sasurji. This fact is hidden from the rest of the family. So these three will have to play two roles of managing their household chores as well as solving national conflicts and their biggest challenge will be to fight with the might and dangerous DON GAMASHA

episodesList.title: Mission Amar
episodesList.summary: Prem tells Trideviyaan that Vinayak and Alka would kill Amar if he fails to give them money. Trideviyaan plan to rescue Amar from his kidnappers.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Plans to Go to Delhi
episodesList.summary: Dinanath informs his family that he is going to Delhi on the next day. Dinanath arranges a competition between Trideviyaan to select the captain of their team.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Instructs Trideviyaan to Catch Thief
episodesList.summary: Dinanath instructs Trideviyaan to catch a thief. Manu tells Amar and Prem that she is aware of their secret.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Appoints Manu as Captain
episodesList.summary: Dinanath appoints Manu as the captain of his team. He instructs Dhanu and Tanu to follow Manu’s orders.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Meet Dummy Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: A few thieves steal donation money from a charitable event. Trideviyaan plan to catch the thieves. Trideviyaan get shocked to see dummy Trideviyaan in television.

episodesList.title: Dummy Trideviyaan in Dinanath's House
episodesList.summary: Dummy Trideviyaan come to Dinanath’s house. They tell the real Trideviyaan that they are secret agents.

episodesList.title: Prem Plans to Reveal His Secret to Dinanath
episodesList.summary: Prem tells Amar that he is going to inform Dinanath that he loves Manu. On the other hand, Manu tells Dhanu and Tanu that they must expose the real identity of Fake Trideviyaan.

episodesList.title: Manu Plans to Expose Fake Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: Kamlesh tells her colleagues that they must stay away from Trideviyaan. Later. Manu tells Dhanu and Tanu that Fake Trideviyaan are contract killers.

episodesList.title: Fake Trideviyyan Land in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Few terrorists attack a school and take the school children as hostages. Garv asks fake Trideviyyan to save the children from the terrorists. Fake Trideviyyan reveal their true identities to Trideviyyan.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan on Hit List of Terrorists
episodesList.summary: Dhanu tells Manu that a few terrorists might attack them in near future. Trideviyaan plan to keep themselves away from strangers.

episodesList.title: Baba Satyavan Comes to Dinanath's House
episodesList.summary: Baba Satyavan comes to Dinanath’s house. Dhanu tells Manu that they should stay away from Baba Satyavan.

episodesList.title: Baba Satyavan Finds Out Prem's Secret
episodesList.summary: Amar tells Suhasini’s family that his wife Promila is not keeping well. Trideviyaan assume that Promila is pregnant. Baba Satyavan finds out that Prem is staying in Dinanath’s house in the guise of a woman.

episodesList.title: Baba Satyavan Plans to Kill Amar and Prem
episodesList.summary: Baba Satyavan plans to kill Amar and Prem. Manu finds a gun in Baba Satyavan’s room. Trideviyaan find out that Baba Satyavan is a thug.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Plan to Punish Baba Satyavan
episodesList.summary: Manu informs Dhanu that she had found a gun in Baba Satyavan’s room. Trideviyaan learn that Baba Satyavan is planning to kill Amar and Prem.

episodesList.title: Manu and Dhanu Attack Baba Satyavan
episodesList.summary: Manu and Dhanu attack Baba Satyavan and save Amar, Prem and Suhasini from their kidnapper. Suhasini assumes that Dinanath is involved in an extramarital affair.

episodesList.title: Dinanath in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Suhasini yells at Dinanath for having extramarital affair with Bharati. Dinanath clears it to Suhasini that he is not involved in extramarital relationship.

episodesList.title: Bharti Enters Dinanath's House
episodesList.summary: Titu’s girlfriend enters Dinanath’s house in the guise of Bharti. She tells Shaurya’s family that she is Dinanath’s wife.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Ka Secret Plan
episodesList.summary: Dinanath tells Bharti that he would soon divorce his wife. Manu tells Suhasini that Dinanath wants to find out Bharti’s secret plan.

episodesList.title: Suhasini Wins Against Bharti
episodesList.summary: Dinanath’s family arrange a competition between Bharti and Suhasini to perform household chores. Suhasini stands out as winner at the end of the competition. Dhanu finds a tattoo on Bharti’s back.

episodesList.title: Bharti Holds Shaurya's Family Hostage
episodesList.summary: Bharti informs Dinanath that she has tied Promila and Suhasini to a bomb. Shaurya learns that Bharti has hold his family hostage.

episodesList.title: Garv Ki First Date Anniversary
episodesList.summary: Garv and Tanu plan to celebrate their ‘first date’ anniversary. However, Garv’s family prevents him from spending the day with Tanu.

episodesList.title: Champak Enters Dinanath's House
episodesList.summary: Champak and his aides stand before Dinanath’s house. They plan to intrude into the house to recover their money. Champak tells Dinanath and his family that he  is a chef.

episodesList.title: Champak Ka Secret Plan
episodesList.summary: The Chauhan housheold is visited by a notorious Bank Chor, played by Riteish Deshmukh, who wants to retrieve his cash-filled bag from the house. Despite his failed the attempts, the Bank Chor finally achieves his target by sedating the family members at night. Will Dhanu, Tanu and Manu be able to nab the culprit?

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Trideviyaan break into a laboratory where an evil scientist has developed a chemical weapon which impairs the sensory organs. The daring women successfully sabotage the scientists plan. However, the chemical weapon suddenly explodes and Trideviyaan accidentally inhale the toxic fumes. Soon, the ladies discover that their sensory perceptions have been impaired.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Become Deaf, Dumb and Blind
episodesList.summary: Following the explosion in the lab, Dhanu has lost her vision, Manu her hearing and Tanu her voice. After returning home, they find it hard to carry out simple tasks. When Shaurya arrives, Dhanu tries to conceal the fact that she is blind. She pretends to be unconsciousness in the presence of Shaurya.

episodesList.title: Tanu in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu are having a hard time concealing their sensory impairments. Meanwhile, Manu comes with an amazing plan to help out Dhanu. Manu asks Dhanu to measure her steps and identify the objects inside the house. Dinanath agrees to the plan and joins the ladies in realising the plan.

episodesList.title: Trideviyaan Hide Manu's Secret From Their Guests
episodesList.summary: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu are having a hard time concealing their sensory impairments. Tanu's tape recorder malfunctions and she nearly ends up getting caught. Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu learn that Shaurya is searching for the three women who stole the bomb.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Meets Professor Bhaskar
episodesList.summary: Agent Lalwani suspects that something is wrong with Dhanu, Tanu and Manu.  Dinanath Chohan calls them up and informs that he will be reaching their house. Meanwhile, Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu hide the fact that Lalwani is a secret agent from their respective husbands.

episodesList.title: Manu's Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Dinanath Chohan saves the day for Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu. The girls manage to fool Agent Lalwani and he leaves. Then, Dinanath brings an antitode, that will cure Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu's senses. Finally, the girls are back to the normal. Later, Dinanath shows the secret agents that Shaurya has apprehended the terrorist, who is responsible for the bomb blast.

episodesList.title: Manu's Dreams Turn Into Reality
episodesList.summary: Someone knocks on the door and Manu gets terrified. Manu suspects that someone has come to kill her. It turns out that Prem is the certain someone who has been knocking on the door. Dhanu and Tanu call up Manu to inquire. Manu hides the fact that Prem is in the house from Dhanu and Tanu.

episodesList.title: Manus Superpower
episodesList.summary: Dinanath Chohan is furious at Manu for forgetting about her mission. Dhanu convinces Tanu and her father in law that Manu's special power of seeing actual things while dreaming will help them to complete the mission. Watch the episode of Trideviyaan to find out what happens next!

episodesList.title: Abort Mission!
episodesList.summary: Manu has a dream in which she sees Dhanu and Tanu getting caught in their latest mission. When Manu learns that her sister-in-laws have already for the mission, she devises a plan to make them forfeit the mission. She decides to call up Shaurya and request him to take Dhanu for a movie. Will Manu be able to convince her brother? Find out!

episodesList.title: Kidnapped!
episodesList.summary: Manu's plan to make Prem kidnap her backfires as real kidnappers pick her up from her house. Although, initially Dhanu, took this disappearing act of Manu as a prank, they soon realized that Manu is in real trouble. Will they be able to rescue her in time? Watch to find out more.

episodesList.title: Manu Is Fired!
episodesList.summary: Dinanath Chohan fires Manu from duty. Dhanu and Tanu persuade Manu to request Dinanath Chohan to reinstate her. Dinanath agrees to reinstate Manu. Then, Shaurya calls up Dhanu and informs her that he will be out of town on work. Later. a mysterious woman is assigned to take the place of Dinanath's secret agent.

episodesList.title: Dhanu, Tanu, and Manus Night Out
episodesList.summary: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu hed out for an evening together. The terrorist gang, which has been trying to sabotage the mission of the Trideviyaan, follows them closely behind. Will Bijli, who has been hired to take the place of Tanu, succeed in her evil intentions? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Manu's Secret
episodesList.summary: Dhanu assures Dinanath that she is safe. Then, she informs him that she had locked Manu inside the car but they found her outside the car later. Dinanath suspects that something is wrong. Will his worst fears come true? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Tanu Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Dinanath learns that one of his secret agents has been kidnapped. Meanwhile, Tanu, who has been confined by her kidnappers, tries to find a way to contact Dinanath. Dhanu and Manu are still unaware that Tanu has been kidnapped.

episodesList.title: The Duplicate Agent Is Revealed
episodesList.summary: While Dhanu and Manu doubt each other to be the duplicate agent, Dinanath sets up a trap to catch the real intruder. He catches the duplicate Tanu, who was trying to steal the hard disk, red-handed in his office. However, Bijli, who imposter who was pretending to be Tanu, manages to escape with the hard disk. Can Dhanu and Manu catch her before it is too late? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Tanu Walks Free
episodesList.summary: Dhanu and Manu barge into the hideout, where Tanu has been kept in confinement. They manage to overpower Bijli and release Tanu. Seeing the kidnappers approaching, Tanu pretends to be Bijli, while Manu and Dhanu confine Bijli.

episodesList.title: A Knock on the Door
episodesList.summary: Dhanu, Manu, and Tanu head out of the house, leaving the boys all alone. The boys enjoy the game of cricket while the wives are out. Then, thanks to the rain God, rain drizzles in the city. Amidst the rain, two alluring women knock on the door. Who are these women and what is their intention? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Shaurya and Garv Blackmailed
episodesList.summary: Shaurya and Garv are unable to get rid of Angel and Pari, who are demanding a ransom from them in order to leave and threatens them with pictures of them being cuddled by these girls. They order pizza but are shocked to find out that their wives have returned early. Will Dhanu and Tanu find out about the girls, who have gone into hiding?

episodesList.title: Angel's Ominous Presence
episodesList.summary: Dhanu and Tanu's husbands try to hide the presence of Angel and Pari. Shaurya showers Dhanu with praises to distract her from Angel, who is hiding inside the wardrobe. Left without a choice, Shaurya also hides inside the wardrobe and locks it from inside. Will Dhanu find out about Angel and Pari's presence? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Gets Electrocuted
episodesList.summary: After cracking a complicated security code with a slight help from Fateh, Dinanath Chauhan hurries to the den to transfer the code to the chief. However, Dinanath is shocked to see that the den has been flooded with water during the rains. While trying to secure the equipments inside the den, Dinanath gets electrocuted and falls unconscious. Find out what happens next!

episodesList.title: Rashtrabhasha
episodesList.summary: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu take on a new avatar to help Dinanath get back to his old self. Dinanath, following the electric shock, has grown new fond affection for the Hindi language. Dhanu, Tanu and Manu follow suit in an attempt to cure Dinanath.

episodesList.title: Dinanath Pursuit of Truth
episodesList.summary: Dhanu, Tanu, and Manu take down the drug dealers, but they realize that their troubles have just begun when they come to know that Dinanath has once again suffered a memory loss and is following them along with his son to uncover their truth. Will they be able to salvage the situation? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Dinanath's Mysterious Secret Revealed
episodesList.summary: Dhanu, Tanu and Manu discover the secret behind Dinanath's memory loss. When Shaurya sees his father behaving odd, he calls up the doctor, unaware that Dhanu, Tanu and Manu have called him regarding Dinanath's problem. Will the doctor be able to solve their woes?

episodesList.title: Prems Secret
episodesList.summary: The family members discover that Dinanath has recovered completely. When Manu sees Promila, she senses that something is fishy. Later, when she goes to Garv's room she stumbles upon a huge secret involving Prem.

episodesList.title: Advocate Manu
episodesList.summary: Dhanu tries to protect his brother from the hands of her husband, who doubts that he has killed his wife. Shaurya tries to arrest him but Manu comes to his rescue by being his advocate. She also arranges a bail for him. However, Shaurya promises to come back with evidence against him. Is Raja guilty? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: A Letter for Raja
episodesList.summary: Dinanath learns from Tanu that Raja had an extramarital affair with a girl named Malini. Tanu tries to leave the house to investigate about Malini but she fails to escape the notice of Manu and Dhanu. Meanwhile, a postman arrives at their house to deliver a letter for Raja from Malini. What secret does the letter contain? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Dhanu's Injury
episodesList.summary: Dhanu falls down from a stool after a mysterious assassin shoots at the stool. Shaurya is worried when he learns about Dhanu's injury and rushes by her side. He receives a phone call from a gangster, who threatens to kill Dhanu.

episodesList.title: Bodyguard Hawa Singh
episodesList.summary: Shaurya appoints constable Hawa Singh as a bodyguard to take care of Dhanu, Manu and Tanu. However, Dinanath assumes that he is King D's henchman and attacks him. Later, Dinanath informs Dhanu, Tanu and Manu that King D is aware about Shaurya and their whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Decoding King d'S Call
episodesList.summary: Dinanath, Dhanu, Tanu and Manu decide to decode King D's call and discover that he is calling from the same police station where Shaurya is commissioned. They analyse and suspect that King D could be Firdaus Lala.

episodesList.title: Naagin Prank
episodesList.summary: Knowing that Garv is afraid of snakes, Tanu and other family members play a prank on him. He forgives them. However, he is horrified when two women appear as Naagin and ask him for a secret Nagmani.

episodesList.title: Missing Diamond
episodesList.summary: Dinanath assigns Dhanu, Tanu and Manu an assignment to find a missing diamond. However, he is unaware that the diamond has been hidden in his own garden. Will he be able to find the thief?

episodesList.title: Diamond Thief
episodesList.summary: Garv is continuously being blackmailed by an Icchapyaari Naagin, who is infact a thief, for a Nagmani, which happens to be a diamond. When Tanu discovers that Garv is in trouble, she decides to help him and hatches a plan to expose the Icchapyaari Naagin.

episodesList.title: Operation Vikrant
episodesList.summary: Shaurya informs Dhanu that he has been transferred to Nagpur after he was forced to release an influential politician's son, Vikrant, due to lack of evidence. Dhanu, along with Tanu and Manu, decides to launch 'Operation Vikrant' to help Shaurya.

episodesList.title: Shaurya's Hunt for Trideviyaan
episodesList.summary: When Shaurya is accused of being helped by Trideviyaan to solve his cases, he decides to track them down. While on his quest to find them, he and Garv find a red shoe, which belongs to one of the ladies. Will he be able to track the ladies?

episodesList.title: The Key Suspects
episodesList.summary: Garv and Shaurya suspect that someone from Dhanu, Tanu and Manu is one of the Trideviyaan, and have helped them crack several cases. When they devise a plan to find the truth from the ladies, the ladies deny any involvement.

episodesList.title: The Trap
episodesList.summary: Dhanu and Tanu realise that Shaurya and Garv have set a trap to catch the Trideviyaan. When Manu calls them and informs them that she has reached the location, they ask her to leave from there. Will she get caught by Shaurya and Garv?

episodesList.title: The Grand Reunion
episodesList.summary: Dhanu is elated when she discovers that Shaurya isn't transferred and that they will not have to leave the city. Dinanath gets extremely emotional when he sees the family together and remembers his wife Suhasini. The family is extremely happy when she returns from her family trip.

plotHtml:
The plot follows the story of two girls - Dhanushree "Dhannu" and Tanuja "Tannu" who are caring housewives and also, work as secret agents for their father-in-law, Dinanath Chauhan alias Agent Himalaya. Dhannu alias Agent Laal Kila is married to Dinanath's elder son Shaurya Chauhan who is an honest and brave police inspector and Tannu alias Agent Hawa Mahal marries Dinanath's younger son, Garv Chauhan who is a crime news reporter. On their wedding day, when the time comes to leave the maternal home, Tannu locks the door of her room and refuses to leave. When asked, she confesses to Dinanath that she likes Garv but doesn't wish to go to her marital home and sacrifice her profession, which is a secret. But Dinanath reveals that he is aware of her secret, that she is UCA (Under Cover Army)'s secret agent and then he mentions that he is also a UCA agent, Agent Himalaya and henceforth she would continue in her profession by joining his secret army with another agent. Tannu then gladly accepts to leave for her new home and also thinks that the agent who would be joining her is her brother-in-law, Shaurya. On their way, they stop at a temple to complete Dhannu's manner regarding this marriage. But, as they were about to leave the temple after completing the "Mannat", a group of thieves threatens the entire Chauhan family, and they are taken to a distant place. There it is revealed to us that the second agent is Dhannu! The duo then beat up the goons and all the family members manage to escape. But Garv and Tannu are unable to spend time together on their wedding night as Tannu is called to Dinanath's secret lab where she is introduced to many new gadgets. But one day, Dinanath's younger daughter Manya Chauhan a.k.a. Mannu discovers that Tannu, Dhannu, and Dinanath are secret agents and wants to join their team as "Agent Qutub Minar" or else she will tell everyone, especially her mother, the secret.
On a fake mission, which coincidentally turns real, Mannu saves her co-agents and is permitted to receive training and become an agent and then the agents become known as "Trideviyaan". They successfully conceal their secret identities from Dinanath's wife Suhasini Chauhan, his mother Damyanti Chauhan who is a kleptomaniac, Fatteh Mama - the servant, the paying guests, and even from Shaurya and Garv. With Dhannu's strength, Tannu's speed, and Mannu's power of voice, they are a formidable team.

title: The Aam Aadmi Family
summary:
The Aam Aadmi Family is an Indian comedy-drama series directed by Apoorv Singh Karki. The series debuted on a YouTube channel called The Timeliners, which garnered 10 million views. The first series featured Lubna Salim, Gunjan Malhotra, Chandan Anand, Kamlesh Gill, and Brijendra Kala. The Timeliners have released 3 seasons.
For the fourth season, the show moved to ZEE5. This was a part of the partnership between The Viral Fever and ZEE5 announced in June 2021 The premieres on 24 November 2023.
plot: Aam Aadmi Family is the story of a middle-class family, which features Sharma (Brijendra Kala) as the father, Madhu (Lubna Salim) as the mother, Bobby (Chandan Anand) as the naughty son, and Sonu (Gunjan Malhotra), their daughter being the sweetheart of the family. Daadi, played by Kamlesh Gill, is the notorious grandmother of the house.

episodesList.title: Deewar
episodesList.summary: The TV is finally delivered. But, there's one last decision to be made.

episodesList.title: Naya Daur
episodesList.summary: Will Sonu be able to convince her Mom to wear jeans?

episodesList.title: Badhaai Ho Badhaai
episodesList.summary: Sonu breaks up with her boyfriend and ends up accepting an arranged marriage proposal. But things do not go as planned.

episodesList.title: Jhooth Bole Kauwa Kaate
episodesList.summary: Mr Sharma arrives home early from the office on the pretext of being unwell, but is he really ill?

episodesList.title: Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai
episodesList.summary: After all, what does Mr Sharma want to say?

episodesList.title: Hulchul
episodesList.summary: Mr Sharma comes home to surprise his family but will he be able to?

episodesList.title: Mirch Masala
episodesList.summary: Mrs Sharma challenges Sonu and Bobby to run the house for a day. But will they be able to do so?

episodesList.title: Ram Leela
episodesList.summary: Bobby wants to go for a Goa trip. But Mr Sharma declines his request and humiliates him. Bobby's only chance at redemption is the Ram Leela function. What will he do?

episodesList.title: Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa
episodesList.summary: Sonu's boyfriend proposes to her, but she is in a dilemma. Will she marry him?

episodesList.title: Dulha Mil Gaya
episodesList.summary: Sonu's boyfriend comes home to meet her parents. But the Sharma family already have a prospective groom waiting for her. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Shaadi Ke Side Effects
episodesList.summary: The wedding preparations have begun. So join in the fun of Sonu's Mehendi and Sangeet ceremonies.

episodesList.title: Shaadi No.1
episodesList.summary: Sonu's big day is finally here. But her wedding does not go as planned. What's in store for her?

episodesList.title: Mera Damaad
episodesList.summary: Sonu and Sarthak come home. Mr Sharma has still not accepted Sarthak as his son-in-law. The electricity goes off when Sarthak tries to have a conversation with him. Will Mr Sharma ever like Sarthak?

episodesList.title: Chalti Ka Naam Gaadi
episodesList.summary: Mr Sharma is looking for his scooter keys. Mrs Sharma and Bobby are acting weird and do not want him to find the keys. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Aaj Ki Taaza Khabar
episodesList.summary: Sonu wants to pursue MBA from a college in another town. Will her in-laws object, or will Sonu be able to follow her dreams?

episodesList.title: Mother India
episodesList.summary: Sattu and his younger brother have a long-time feud. One day, the doorbell rings, and Sattu finds Jazzy Chachu at the doorstep. Will the brothers resolve their issues?

episodesList.title: Maa
episodesList.summary: It is Daadi's birthday, and the Sharma family is throwing a huge party for her. But will the celebrations go as planned?

episodesList.title: Jeevan Mrityu
episodesList.summary: The Sharmas try to cope with Daadi's death in their own ways. Mr Sharma is frustrated when the pandit backs out at the last minute, and Mrs Sharma worries that Daadi's soul is not at peace.

episodesList.title: Kaun Apna Kaun Paraya
episodesList.summary: Daadi's death leads to a property dispute in the Sharma family. While his brother is hell-bent on selling the ancestral house, Mr Sharma wants to hold on to it for the memories.

episodesList.title: Bechaini
episodesList.summary: Mr Sharma suffers from anxiety and insomnia after Daadi's death. He refuses to take therapy despite the doctor's recommendation. His family tries to help him, but he feels they are treating him like a mental patient.

episodesList.title: Udaan
episodesList.summary: Bobby asks Mr Sharma for a loan worth Rs 5 lakh for his food truck. Mr Sharma refuses and instead challenges Bobby to set up a stall at the Diwali fair and earn a substantial amount to prove his worth.

episodesList.title: Naya Kadam
episodesList.summary: Mrs Sharma wants to complete her education and gets all the support from Mr Sharma. However, it becomes difficult for her to balance her studies and the responsibilities of the household.

episodesList.title: Nok Jhok
episodesList.summary: Sonu and Sarthak are going through tough times. Mr Sharma is unable to figure out why Mrs Sharma is upset. The men watch the India-Pakistan match on Bobby's new TV while the women hang out.

episodesList.title: Yaadein
episodesList.summary: The Sharmas have a new dilemma. As they plan for a grand re-marriage party for Mr and Mrs Sharma's 30th anniversary, he hesitates, thinking about the recent death in the family.

episodesList.title: Tere Mere Sapne
episodesList.summary: There's more chaos in the Sharma household as Bobby lands himself in debt and the venue for Mr and Mrs Sharma's 30th anniversary gets double-booked. The Sharmas look for a new place, but will they succeed?

title: Tujhyat Jeev Rangala
summary: Tujhyat Jeev Rangala (transl. My heart is filled in you) is an Indian Marathi language television series which aired on Zee Marathi. The show is one of the top rated Marathi TV show from its inception and also Zee Marathi's third longest running soap opera. It starred Hardeek Joshi and Akshaya Deodhar in lead roles. It is produced by Smruti Shinde under the banner of Sobo Films. It premiered from 3 October 2016 by replacing Nanda Saukhya Bhare.
plot: The story revolves around the love story between Rana, a hardworking farmer from a rural area in Maharashtra and Anjali, an educated urban woman. Their relationship faces numerous challenges due to cultural differences, societal expectations and family opposition. Despite these obstacles, Rana and Anjali's love for each other continues to grow as they navigate the complexities of their relationship.

title: TVF Tripling
summary:
TVF Tripling is an Indian Hindi-language web series created by The Viral Fever. It was developed by Sameer Saxena and written by Akarsh Khurana and Sumeet Vyas. The series star Vyas, Maanvi Gagroo and Amol Parashar in lead roles, along with Kunaal Roy Kapur, Nidhi Bisht, Kumud Mishra, and Shernaz Patel. It traces the story of three siblings, who together start a hilarious journey to find themselves and their relations. The first season has music and background score composed by Amar Mangrulkar, with cinematography and editing done by G. Srinivas Reddy, Anand Subbaiya and Tamojit Das respectively.
TVF Tripling: Season 1 was premiered simultaneously in the company's media streaming platform TVF Play and in YouTube, from 28 August 2016 to 7 October, with five consecutive episodes were aired every week. The show received positive response from audience and along with some other contributions, the series has won several awards, including the Asian Television Award. It was recognised as one of the best web-series of 2016 and also a benchmark of success in Indian branded content and has since developed a cult status.
Following the success of TVF Tripling, the makers renewed for a second season with Sameer Saxena directing the series, and retaining the same technical crew, with the exception of music composer Mangrulkar, who worked in the first season, as he was replaced by Nilotpal Bora, whereas the cinematographer and editors were same. The series aired through Sony Liv on 5 April 2019, and unlike that of the first season, it received mixed reviews from critics.
The show was renewed for a third season in 2021 and moved to ZEE5 as the streaming platform. The third season premiered on October 21, 2022. The season is written by Sumeet Vyas and directed by Neeraj Udhwani. In this season the three siblings find out that their parents are getting a divorce. It received positive reviews from critics.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The Viral Fever released the first trailer of the series on 25 August 2016. As a part of the promotional purpose, TVF partnered with Tata Motors for the project to promote the newly launched Tata Tiago. respectively. The digital rights of the second season was sold to SonyLIV and the series was released on 5 April 2019.
For the third season, the series moved to ZEE5. The teaser for the season was released on 3 October 2022.

episodesList.title: Toh Chalein
episodesList.summary: Chandan, recently divorced, returns to Mumbai to meet his brother, Chitvan, a DJ. Chitvan, running from debt collectors, drags him to Jodhpur, to meet their sister, Chanchal, who is married into a royal family and pregnant.

episodesList.title: Ab Kidhar?
episodesList.summary: Chanchal reveals to her siblings that she is not actually pregnant. Following the fight between the siblings and Chanchal's husband, Pranav, they unceremoniously leave the palace.

episodesList.title: Right, Left Ya Seedha?
episodesList.summary: Chandan, Chanchal and Chitvan leave Jodhpur to hit the road. On their journey they find themselves lost in the desert. They meet a group of Israeli girls who steal their car.

episodesList.title: Aage Tiraaha Hai
episodesList.summary: On the road to find their stolen car, the siblings reach Bathinda, where they fight with the local car stealer and manage to reclaim their car with the help from Pranav.

episodesList.title: Pahunch Gaye Kya?
episodesList.summary: The siblings reach their parents’ home in Manali to find surprises.

episodesList.title: Mada Faka
episodesList.summary: Time flies! Chandan is now the author of the bestselling book Tripling. Chitvan is the star of the book & excited about the book being adapted into a movie. But seems like Chanchal doesn't feel the same way and being exasperated with Chandan, tortures them.

episodesList.title: Phir Se Tripling
episodesList.summary: The trio is back together and have hit the road. Chandan, being annoyed and Chitvan, unapologetic tries to help Chanchal find her husband Pranav who is missing and saving her from the police and media.

episodesList.title: Kabootar Ja Ja Ja
episodesList.summary: Chanchal, Chandan and Chitvan are now on a road trip with a purpose to find Pranav's whereabouts. They happen to meet Prince Alexander and his gorgeous Begum Zainab.

episodesList.title: Bandhu Re
episodesList.summary: The siblings have managed to thread the clues and connect some dots to reach Kolkata. They meet a Samaritan detective who sent them to Sikkim.

episodesList.title: Rasta Jahaan Le Chale
episodesList.summary: It's always about the journey. The destination only makes it sweeter.

episodesList.title: Back Home
episodesList.summary: The siblings find out that the parents are separating. The more they try to understand this, the more mysterious it gets. The parents are happy and yet separating. The last shock hits them when they get to know that their childhood home is being sold.

episodesList.title: Raaita Fail Gaya
episodesList.summary: The family organizes a brunch, but it is ruined when a young woman comes to house and announces her plans for changing the house in a hotel. It all turns to extreme chaos with arrival of Pranav.

episodesList.title: Ghar Hai Wahi
episodesList.summary: The family finds itself at a crazy party in the hills. drunk and confused they have to rush back home when they get to know that the cousin of Pranav has arrived and challenged him to duel till death.

episodesList.title: Happily Married
episodesList.summary: The siblings plan a trek as a last resort to solve the issue of parents’ separation. Everything goes wrong from the word Go.

episodesList.title: Jude Hai Hum
episodesList.summary: Heart broken, the siblings try to accept the inevitable separation of parents but they decided to save the home.

soundtrack.title: TVF Tripling: Season 1 (Music from the Original Series)
soundtrack.composer: For the soundtrack album of TVF Tripling: Season 1, Rajesh Krishnan chose Amar Mangrulkar, who earlier composed background music for the 2014 film Hasee Toh Phasee to work on the series. This marked Mangrulkar's maiden collaboration with The Viral Fever, as the company previously collaborated with Vaibhav Bundhoo for Permanent Roommates and TVF Pitchers. The soundtrack album consists of 13 songs which was composed, produced and programmed by Mangrulkar, who also wrote lyrics for the songs along with the series' director Krishnan, Kapil Sawant, Vaibhav Modi, Rajnigandha Shekhawat and Jaspreet Jasz. It also features a traditional folk song "Kesariya Balam" which is based on Rajasthani music and "Amma Puchchadi" which is originated from Himachali music.

title: The Voice India Kids
summary: The Voice India Kids is an Indian singing reality competition television series that airs on &TV or StarPlus. The series is produced by Endemol India.

articleSections.title: Format
articleSections.text: This show based on The Voice India. The show will allow young singers between the age group of 6–14 years to showcase their talent in front of a national audience. The show is part of The Voice franchise and is structured in three phases: Blind auditions, Battle rounds, and Live performance shows.

articleSections.title: Blind auditions
articleSections.text: The first stage is the blind auditions, where artists sing in front of the judges/coaches. In this round, each coach selects 15 singers for their team. Four coaches, all noteworthy recording artists, choose teams of contestants through a blind audition process. Each coach has the length of the auditioner's performance (about 90 seconds) to decide if they want the singer on their team. If one of the coaches is satisfied with the voice of an artist, and wants to mentor them for the next stage, they press the "I WANT YOU" button by their chair. This turns the chair around to face the stage, and allows the coach to see the artist for the first time after they have sung. This avoids any bias on the part of the judge/coach because of an artist's characteristics or personality. If two or more coaches want the same singer, the singer chooses their coach. The artist's journey on the show comes to an end if no coach selects them.

articleSections.title: Battle rounds
articleSections.text: Each team of singers is then mentored and developed by their coach in the second stage, called the Battle Round. The team coaches help to develop their artists by giving them advice, and sharing the secrets of their success in the music industry. The coaches have two of their own team members battle each other by singing the same song. The coach chooses which team member will advance to the next stage. The judges then have to choose from the individual "battles" which artists to take to the Live Round.[3]

articleSections.title: Live shows
articleSections.text:
The third stage, Live Shows, is where the remaining seven members of each team perform solo and try to entertain the audience and to impress the judges. After Round 1, each of the coaches can save three contestants to progress. After Rounds 2 and 3, each coach can save two contestants to progress. After Round 4, each coach can save one contestant to progress to the semi-final round. The remaining contestants progress, or not, based on a public vote conducted after each round.
In the semi-finals, the final two contestants from each team face off against each other. The judges then split 100 points between the two performers of their team. The winner is decided by the combination of public votes received and points given by their respective judges.

title: Tere Bin
summary: Tere Bin (Without You) is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series, which premiered 18 July 2016 on &TV at 8pm and ended its run on 25 November 2016. The series was produced by Shree Sidhivinayak Chitra. Gaurav Khanna, Shefali Sharma and Khushboo Tawde played lead roles in the series.
plot:
The show is about Dr. Akshay Sinha (Gaurav Khanna) who sacrificed his love to help his friend's fiance, Vijaya (Shefali Sharma) because she was pregnant when his friend died. Akshay and Vijaya have been married for 8 years but their marriage is a formal one where they care for each other and live as a family, but don't have the dynamic of a husband and wife.
Eight years later, his love, Dr. Nandini Bhatt (Khushboo Tawde) returns. He has a hard time explaining to her what happened and why he had to leave her, while Vijaya accepted her marriage with Akshay. She also wants a life as a normal husband and wife, unaware of the fact that Akshay and Nandini are having an affair. Meanwhile, the stress of the situation and keeping it from Vijaya causes him to behave strangely making Vijaya concerned. Akshay first wanted to end his and Vijaya's marriage by that he can be with Nandini. But whenever he tried to reveal his relationship with Nandini he stopped himself from doing that.
Vijaya finally finds the truth of Akshay and Nandini but she challenges Nandini that she will fix their marriage in one month otherwise she will go out from Akshay's life forever. Nandini tries to woo Akshay back into her life and away from Vijaya much to the dismay of her friend Dr. Irfaan Malik (Rohit Bhardwaj) who has been trying to convince her to move on and has a crush on Nandini that he already confessed to her.
Eventually, Akshay started to realise his priorities and his feelings for Vijaya and he confessed his past relationship with Nandini to Vijaya who told him that she knew the matter some days ago. Then couple confess their love and consummate their marriage. While Nandini realised the fact that now Akshay does not love her anymore and that she has to move on in her life. She decides to marry Irfaan who already loves her and cares for her.
The show ends with Akshay, Vijaya, Irfaan and Nandini starting their lives afresh...

title: Thalayanai Pookal
summary: Thalayanai Pookal is a 2016 Tamil family soap opera that airs on Zee Tamil. The show aired from 23 May 2016 to 29 June 2018 on Monday to Friday at 9:00 (IST). Later from 16 October 2017, the show shifted from Monday to Friday at 10:00 (IST). On 23 April 2018, the show shifted again to air Monday through Friday at 22:30 (IST) for 549 Episodes. The story is partially based on Balakumaran's novel Thalayanai Pookal. The show starred Anjali Rao, Nisha Krishnan, Sandra Amy, Delhi Ganesh Shrekar, Shreekumar, Neelima Rani and among others.
plot:
It is the story of Vedavalli, a brilliant and pragmatic middle class young girl who gets married into a wealthy joint family and fights to keep it united. The story is about family values, women empowerment and triumph of right thinking over evil intent.
Vedavalli and Sundar are engaged to get married. On the marriage day, Kalpana, a worker in Sundar's company, marries Sundar by using some dirty tactics. Nagarajan brings home Mallika and her mother to work in their home. Mallika wants to marry Nagarajan to settle in life.
Vedavalli's marriage is fixed with Vivek again but Vivek dies in an accident on the morning of the wedding. Nagarajan was forced to marry Vedavalli due to his father's request. The rest of the story is on how Vedavalli and Nagarajan overcome the differences between them and learn to love each other while fight against the obstacles arise in their life with the power of their love.

title: The Kapil Sharma Show
summary:
The Kapil Sharma Show (also known as TKSS) is an Indian Hindi language stand-up comedy and talk show that airs on Sony Entertainment Television. Hosted by comedian Kapil Sharma, the programme premiered on 23 April 2016.
The first season was set around Sharma and his neighbours living in the fictional Shantivan Non-Cooperative Housing Society. The show is filmed at Film City in Goregaon East, Mumbai. 
The initial season was produced by Sharma’s production company K9 Productions in association with Frames Productions. From the second and third seasons, production responsibilities were shared by Salman Khan Television and Banijay Asia, along with K9 Productions, while TEAM (Triyambh Entertainment and Media) served as the creative producer. 
The 5th season of the show premiered in September 2022, with Archana Puran Singh returning as the guest judge.
plot: The format is largely identical of Sharma's former show Comedy Nights with Kapil. The kapil sharma Show revolves around Kapil Sharma and his team of comedians, including Sumona Chakravarti, Kiku Sharda, Chandan Prabhakar, Krushna Abhishek, Bharti Singh and Rochelle Rao, who play residents of the Shantivan Non-cooperative Housing Society. Normally every episode unfolds in two parts with the first part being a comic skit enacted by the actors of the show and the second part being the celebrity interview where popular personalities from various fields indulge in a light-hearted interaction with karma. Navjot Singh Sidhu was the permanent guest of the show but was later replaced by Archana Puran Singh after 16 February 2019.
reception: The Kapil Sharma Show's first season received a mixed reception from critics and audiences. Namrata Thakker of Rediff.com gave it 2.5 stars out of 5 stars, liking the characters of Sunil Grover and Ali Asgar but saying that "the series has big shoes to fill considering how successful their earlier show Comedy Nights With Kapil was." Chaya Unnikrishnan of Daily News and Analysis gave the series two stars out of five but said, "Kapil Sharma's wit and funny one-liners bring a laugh". Although she praised part of the show ("In fact, the 10 minutes or so where [Sharma] has a monologue is the best part of the show"), Unnikrishnan called it "dull and disappointing". In her 1.5-star review, Letty Mariam Abraham of Mid-Day said: "The whole look and feel of the new set is interesting, even if the jokes are old". However, "Kapil brings nothing new to the plate and it seems like a waste of the prime time slot." The season 2 of the show got a favourable opening according Broadcast Audience Research Council ratings, with 8.1 million impressions.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text:
On 31 August 2017, the spokesperson of Sony Entertainment Television announced that Kapil Sharma and the channel have mutually agreed to give the show a short break as the shooting of several episodes had to be cancelled in the past few days due to Sharma's poor health. The show started losing TRP post Sharma's mid-air altercation with co-star Sunil Grover. After that, his health started deteriorating which made him skip the show for a couple of episodes. After the controversy, Grover left the show along with Chandan Prabhakar, Ali Asgar and some other cast members. Prabhakar returned to the show along with Bharti Singh appearing in recurring episodes. The show went off air in 2017. The second season took to the telecast in December 2018. Singh and Krushna Abhishek joined the show as new cast.
The show was also in controversy when film director Vivek Agnihotri said that the star cast of his movie The Kashmir Files was not invited to the show because the film does not have a commercial star cast. Later, film actor Anupam Kher, who starred in the film, denied allegations of Vivek Agnihotri.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: The Kapil Sharma Show's first season received a mixed reception from critics and audiences. Namrata Thakker of Rediff.com gave it 2.5 stars out of 5 stars, liking the characters of Sunil Grover and Ali Asgar but saying that "the series has big shoes to fill considering how successful their earlier show Comedy Nights With Kapil was." Chaya Unnikrishnan of Daily News and Analysis gave the series two stars out of five but said, "Kapil Sharma's wit and funny one-liners bring a laugh". Although she praised part of the show ("In fact, the 10 minutes or so where [Sharma] has a monologue is the best part of the show"), Unnikrishnan called it "dull and disappointing". In her 1.5-star review, Letty Mariam Abraham of Mid-Day said: "The whole look and feel of the new set is interesting, even if the jokes are old". However, "Kapil brings nothing new to the plate and it seems like a waste of the prime time slot." The season 2 of the show got a favourable opening according Broadcast Audience Research Council ratings, with 8.1 million impressions.

articleSections.title: Viewer response
articleSections.text: According to the reports published by the Broadcast Audience Research Council, the show's first episode of the show generated 8,943 responses. Although, some viewers were happy to see the same contestants back after watching Comedy Nights with Kapil, others were disappointed with the show's repetitive humour and chaos. The series' 16th episode, featuring the Sairat team and airing on 12 June 2016, had better ratings in the non-fiction category.
