episodesList.title: Welcome The Cast Of Saaho
episodesList.summary: In today's episode of The Kapil Sharma Show Season 2, we welcome the cast of Saaho, which includes Prabhas, Shradha Kapoor and Neil Nitin Mukesh. Stay tuned for a rib-tickling episode!

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Cast Of Pailwaan
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the cast of a new show on SET, Tara From Satara and talks about the plot of the show. And later Kapil invites the guests of tonight, lead stars of the movie Pailwaan, Sunil Shetty and Sudeepa Kichcha.

episodesList.title: Sushant And Shraddha Share Laughs With Kapil
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil calls upon the cast of the upcoming movie Chhichhore, Sushant Singh Rajput and Shraddha Kapoor. Along with them, the writer and director Mr. Nitesh Tiwari also come to the show. Varun Sharma, Saher Shukla, Naveen Polishetty and Tushar Pandey are also welcomed to the show. Shraddha's school friend, Fazaa also comes to the set and shares her experiences with the audience. Stay tuned to know more!

episodesList.title: The Deol Family Comes Together
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the lead cast of Pal Pal Dil Ke Paas. Sunny Deol is the director of this movie and shares his experience of working with his son. Karan Deol and Sahher Bamba are the debut lead in this movie. The Deol family comes together to share a wonderful time with Kapil on the show. Stay Tuned to have a humorous evening.

episodesList.title: Here Comes The Dream Girl
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the cast of an upcoming movie Dream Girl. Ayushmann Khurrana comes along with Nushrat Bharucha to start the show. Things get hilarious when Kammo Bua and other characters join in to share their time with the guests. Stay Tuned!

episodesList.title: Khalnayak Of Indian Cinema
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the true Khalnayak of Bollywood, Sanjay Dutt, and his wife, Maanyata. They have come here for the promotion of their upcoming movie Prasthanam. A while later the whole cast arrives on the stage. Sanjay Dutt and his wife share some exciting facts about each other. Stay Tuned for an entertaining evening.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Cast Of The Zoya Factor
episodesList.summary: In today's episode of The Kapil Sharma Show Season 2, Kapil welcomes the lead cast of the upcoming movie 'The Zoya Factor' i.e, Sonam Kapoor Ahuja and Dulquer Salmaan. They both share various childhood memories and have lots of fun in the show. Stay tuned to know more!

episodesList.title: A Night Full Of Desi Vibes
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes a famous Hindi Poet and an Emcee Dr. Kumar Vishwas. The night gets even more Desi when Manoj Bajpai and Pankaj Tripathi joins the stage. A fantastic duo, who made the cinematic universe go crazy for them to share some old but gold memories with Kapil.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Team Of Film Jhalki
episodesList.summary: Today's episode begins with a sketch premise, where Chandu gets married to Bhoori and is out celebrating his honeymoon. Everything seems to go hunky-dory until their soul nemesis Rajesh Arora arrives. After their hilarious act, Kapil invites the team of the film Jhalki on stage along with Sunidhi Chauhan.

episodesList.title: The Cast Of War
episodesList.summary: Today's episode Kapil begins with standup and makes the atmosphere gets quite amusing. After that, he welcomes the cast of an upcoming movie War. Hrithik Roshan and Vaani Kapoor take the stage and share a brief yet wonderful time.

episodesList.title: The War Continues
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, some Sheikh from Dubai is trying to buy Kapil's street. In protest Chandu, Bhoori and Bachcha Yadav call the police. After this hysterical sketch, Kapil begins the conversation with Tiger Shroff. The war between Tiger and Hrithik is still going on, and Kapil is somehow managing both the guests.

episodesList.title: The Sky Is Pink Today
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil receives a surprise as Bumper comes back in the show. Moments later, Kapil invites the lead cast of the movie The Sky Is Pink. Priyanka Chopra and Farhan Akhtar share a comical and hilarious night. Farhan Akhtar becomes a 'Gol Gappa' vendor today.

episodesList.title: Musical Night With Padmashri Udit Narayan
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the king of 90's music of Bollywood, Udit Narayan. Things get hysterical when his wife enters the stage and catches him flirting with Archana. A while later, Kapil welcomes Aditya Narayan and congratulates him on his new album.

episodesList.title: Reliving The Old Days With Govinda And Family
episodesList.summary: Today's show starts with Kapil welcoming versatile actor and one of the finest dancer of Bollywood Govinda, wife Sunita and his daughter Tina. Later singer Gajendra Verma joins the show and makes more fun. Also, Kapil congratulates them for their new song.

episodesList.title: The Show Gets Housefull Tonight
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the cast of an upcoming comedy movie, Housefull 4. Akshay Kumar, Riteish Deshmukh, Bobby Deol, and Chunky Pandey come on to the stage with some complaints about the lifestyle of Akshay and how everyone has to work accordingly.

episodesList.title: Housefull Party Continues
episodesList.summary: Today's episode continues with the star cast of Housefull 4 movie. But before them, Kapil shares a standup routine with the audience and asks them about the festivals of India. He welcomes Sajid Nadiadwala after his set to share a brief yet humorous evening with him. After a while, Kapil invites the glamorous lead actresses of the movie, and things get even more hilarious after that.

episodesList.title: Bull's Eye With Tapsee and Bhumi
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma starts the episode in his most celebrated avatar, that is Inspector Shamsher. Chandu and Bachha indulge in a hilarious one-on-one. Today's show is graced by Tapsee Pannu and Bhumi Pednekar to promote their upcoming film Saand Ki Aankh. Stay tuned for some rib-tickling one-liners and fantastic performances.

episodesList.title: The Cast Of Made In China
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma begins the episode with his stand-up comedy. Then he welcomes the six-pack band of Mumbai. After a stellar performance, we have the cast of Made in China, Rajkumar Rao and Mouni Roy.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Cast Of Bala
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the lead cast of an upcoming movie Bala. Ayushmann Khurrana comes back on the show with his back to back superhit performances, along with the very beautiful and talented actresses of Bollywood, Yami Gautam, and Bhumi Padnekar. Stay Tuned for an awesome evening with some humorous and rib-tickling moments.

episodesList.title: The Turbanator Of Cricket
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes Krushna's wife and a Debutant Rishaab Chauhan for their upcoming movie, Marrne Bhi Do Yaaron. After their brief interaction with Kapil, it's time to call on stage the Turbanator of Cricket, Harbhajan Singh. He comes with his wife and his cute little daughter and shares some rib-tickling moments with Kapil.

episodesList.title: The Cast Of Marjaavaan
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the cast of an upcoming movie Marjaavaan. He invites the gorgeous actresses on stage and forgets to invite the actors. Sidharth Malhotra and Riteish Deshmukh barge in angrily. The evening is full of laughter and rib-tickling moments.

episodesList.title: The Cast Of Motichoor Chaknachoor
episodesList.summary: Today's episode begins with Kapil performing a standup set for the audience about some funny names in India. Later, he invites the lead cast of an upcoming movie, Motichoor Chaknachoor. Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Athiya Shetty share an entertaining evening with Kapil and some rib-tickling moments from their movie.

episodesList.title: A Night Full Of Pagalpanti
episodesList.summary: Today's episode begins with a hilarious sketch premise, where Bachcha Yadav is expecting his son's English Teacher from school. He asks Samsher Singh to take his place and act as Kachha's father. A while later, the lead cast of Pagalpanti arrives Arshad Warsi, Anil Kapoor and John Abraham take over the show, and the evening gets hysterical after that.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Winter With Pagalpanti
episodesList.summary: Kapil speaks about the arrival of winter. He also shares a few jokes and experiences about winter. Later he welcomes Mrs Divya Khosla Kumar to the set and has a great round of fun. Thereafter, The star cast and director of the upcoming movie Pagalpanti join the frolic.

episodesList.title: Legendary Musicians Of This Era
episodesList.summary: A musical night in The Kapil Show today, inviting the Padmashri Shankar Mahadevan, Shaan, Harshadeep Kaur, and Salim Merchant. The night is full of soulful performances and some rib-tickling experiences. Also, Chandu is back on the show and has a hysterical interaction with the guests.

episodesList.title: Ustaad Wadali In The House
episodesList.summary: Today's episode begins with a magical performance by Ustaad Padmashri Puranchand Wadali and his son Lakhwinder Wadali. The atmosphere of the show gets soulful by their presence and their singing.

episodesList.title: The Cast Of Pati Patni Aur Woh
episodesList.summary: The show begins with a sketch premise where Chappu has finally got a job as a food delivery guy. The set turns into a hilarious comedic segment when Chappu forgets to bring Bachcha's order. After that Kapil invites the lead cast of an upcoming movie, 'Pati Patni Aur Woh' on the show.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Legend Jeetendra With Tusshar Kapoor
episodesList.summary: Kapil starts the show with the welcome of evergreen Bollywood star Jeetendra and his son Tushar Kapoor. Jeetendra shares many of his funny experiences and also answers to the rumors questioned by Kapil. Later Kapil creates a lot of entertainment with Tushar Kapoor as well.

episodesList.title: The Star Cast Of Panipat
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, the star cast of a newly released movie, Panipat, is invited to the show. Kapil welcomes the Khalnayak of Bollywood, Sanjay Dutt, to share a few interesting stories with him. Later on, Kriti Sanon and Ashutosh Gowariker join him for a humorous and entertaining evening.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Cast Of Dabangg 3
episodesList.summary: Kapil starts the show with many funny questions and answers with the audiences and even they are reciting their experiences. Later Kapil welcomes the cast of Dabangg 3 i.e, Chulbul Pandey urf Salman khan, Sonakshi Sinha, and Saiee Manjrekar. Kapil enquires different rumors from the guests on behalf of the spectators and having lots of fun with them.

episodesList.title: The Dabangg Stars Of Bollywood
episodesList.summary: The night continues with the glamorous cast of an upcoming movie Dabangg 3. Kapil invites the producer of the film Arbaaz Khan, the director Prabhudeva and a co-star Sudeep Kichha on stage. Together they share a wonderful and joyous time. After a while, they also play the famous 'Ke Bhail Crorepati', hosted by Bachcha Yadav. Stay Tuned for a rib-tickling evening and lots of humorous moments.

episodesList.title: Celebrating The 100th Episode With GOOD NEWWZ
episodesList.summary: An auspicious moment for the show, as we celebrate the 100th episode with the cast of an upcoming movie, Good Newwz. Akshay Kumar picks on everyone in Kapil's team including Kapil and mocks them. For the first time this season, Kareena Kapoor Khan comes on the show, followed by the entire cast. Together they share some extremely rib-tickling moments with Kapil, and the night touches the perfect mixture of fun and emotion.

episodesList.title: Colourful Night With Renowned Musicians
episodesList.summary: Today's episode starts with some glorious performances by some renowned artists in the music industry. Together they have produced the music album for an upcoming movie, Good Newwz. The night is full of special moments and experiences. Each one of them shares a lovely and hysterical evening on the show. Stay Tuned for a colourful and glamorous night!

episodesList.title: The Kakkar Family In The House
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Bachcha makes a new year resolution to find a suitable groom for his sister-in-law. Listening to which, Chandu presents himself as the most eligible bachelor for Bhoomi. A while later, Kapil invites the entire Kakkar family on stage. They share a wonderful and joyous evening and share some of their childhood memories with Kapil.

episodesList.title: A Night Full Of Bhojpuri Superstars
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil welcomes the superstars of Bhojpuri Cinematic Universe on the stage. The famous Bhojpuri Dance number, the Lollipop song was given by the very well known, Pawan Singh. Nirahua comes riding a rickshaw along with the glamorous ladies of Bhojpuri Cinema. Stay Tuned for a 'Desi Night' and a hilarious show.

episodesList.title: Welcoming The Lead Cast OF Tanhaji
episodesList.summary: The show begins with standup premise where Bachcha is not ready to let his sister-in-law stay with them. The entire family comes out with their personal opinion, and the set becomes hysterical. Later, Kapil invites the lead cast of an upcoming movie, a superstar couple of Bollywood, Ajay Devgan and Kajol. They share a humorous and entertaining evening with Kapil and some everyday life experiences.

episodesList.title: Special Celebrations With Deepika
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, Kapil invites the lead cast of an upcoming movie, Chhapaak, Deepika Padukone on stage. The night is special as Kapil is unable to contain his feelings and keeps on flirting with Deepika. Later, we celebrate Deepika's birthday with Laxmi Agarwal and the director of the movie, Meghna Gulzar.

episodesList.title: A Night With Jackie Dada
episodesList.summary: Kapil welcomes one of the most legendary and charming actors of Bollywood's previous era, Jackie Shroff, on stage. The entire cast of the show is called on stage to play some games with Jackie Dada, and the show gets hysterical with its pace. At the end of the show, they dedicate a dance performance to him, which makes him relive some of his golden days from Bollywood.

episodesList.title: The Googly Experts Of Indian Cricket Team
episodesList.summary: The show begins with a very funny sketch performed by the entire family. Kapil welcomes two tremendously talented and brilliant players of the Indian cricket team, Piyush Chawla and Yuzvendra Chahal. Both of them are effective leg-spinners and have always performed well. Yuzvendra also talks about the two NGO's which he is attached to that helps young girls who want to pursue their career in sports.

episodesList.title: A Night Full Of Panga
episodesList.summary: Kapil opens the show with welcoming the actors Kangana Ranaut, Richa Chadda, etc. along with the Director of the upcoming film Panga. The guests talk about the film which is based on women kabaddi and the hurdles about their personal and professional lives. From witty commentaries to sharing funny moments, the guests enjoy the show thoroughly with Kapil and Archana. Stay Tuned to know what happens in Top Ka Adalat.

episodesList.title: Swaying With The Street Dancers
episodesList.summary: In today's show, Kapil very heartily welcomes Remo D'Souza, Varun Dhawan and Prabhu Deva. Later followed by the whole team of Street Dancer 3D and Shraddha Kapoor. It's a joyous and entertaining evening with everyone present. As-usual the family members have a humorous interaction with the entire cast and Remo. The show ends with Sapna dancing with Varun and Shraddha and having a fun-filled time.

episodesList.title: Hungama On The Kapil Sharma Show
episodesList.summary: The whole cast of Hungama 2 comes to The Kapil Sharma Show to promote their upcoming movie. Shilpa Shetty, Paresh Rawal, Rajpal Jadav, Ashutosh Rana, eat. share funny incidents related to the film and their personal and professional life which is followed by the audience speaking about whether to get married early or late. Later, at "Baat Ki Khal", the guests discuss the necessity of judges in reality shows.

episodesList.title: Laughter Cruise Jaaneman
episodesList.summary: Take a trudge through these laughter-full meadows to ‘The Kapil Sharma Show’. It will tickle your funny bone till the end. Take this joyous ride, as our host makes sure that the stars of ‘Jawani Jaaneman’ have a hearty laugh throughout the entire episode, and also, we learn about Saif Ali Khan’s simple side.

episodesList.title: Sang Malang
episodesList.summary: Once again, take a turn to the lane of laughter and fun, where Kapil Sharma will meet today our stars of ‘Malang’ to tickle them with his humour till the end. Where, in a quiz, our beloved stars will affirm some truths about themselves and will clear the rumour, and in the end Dhwani Bhanushali will perform a song for us to savour.

episodesList.title: Thirty Years Of Aashiqui
episodesList.summary: In today’s exciting episode Kapil Sharma invites Rahul Roy, Anu Aggarwal, and Deepak Tijori to celebrate thirty years of Aashiqui’s release. They tell him how they got the roles, how their lives changed after the success, and how their characters name in ‘Aashiqui’ are the same as their real names. The Aashiqui’s cast makes the audience laugh with humorous incidents in the film. Kapil tells Rahul how everyone in India became a lover after watching Aashiqui. What impact it had on India’s moviegoers. The laughter becomes uncontrollable when Sapna and others arrive and crack their unique jokes. Also, Kapil Sharma shows his singing talents.

episodesList.title: Kartik’s Love Aaj Kal
episodesList.summary: In this episode Kapil welcomes the superstars of the Movie ‘Love Aaj Kal’ to the stage. Kapil challenges Kartik to lift Archana. He succeeds and then pretends to fall on the floor. Kartik and Sara then talk about the trending kartik hashtag on the twitter. They also discuss about their gym life. Kartik tells Kapil that he loves dancing. Kapil claims he can dance well too, just in his mind. Kartik then talks about his love life. He discusses how difficult it was for him to meet his girlfriend in school. Then Kapil asks Kartik and Sara whether they ever had lice in their hair. Sara admits to having lice once while Kartik tells he had lice many times. The laughter dose increases even more when Kammo Bua arrives and starts flirting with Kartik’s father. After that Kartik and Sara play a guess game and Kapil encourages the audience to share their valentine story.

episodesList.title: Is Kapil Ayushmann’s Lucky Charm?
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma welcomes the star cast of “Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan” on the show. Kapil asks Ayushmann if his show is lucky for him as his previous films were successful because Ayushmann promoted them on his show. On the other hand, Jitendra also confesses that he only signed the film to be on Kapil’s Show. After a while, Kiku Sarda dressed as a hip hopper compares Ayushmann to Shaktiman, he also asks Jitendra whether he got paid for the movie or he just had to make do with likes, shares, and subscribes as a form of payment. After a while, audiences interacts with the star cast. Kapil also dances with one of the audience members. Kapil later on, asks the stars to confirm some of the rumours. Whereas Krishna dressed as Sapna gives vermilion to Ayushmann and asks him to use it on Jitendra. The show ends with Ayushmann singing a song from his movie.

episodesList.title: Vicky And "Bhoot Part 1, The Haunted Ship"
episodesList.summary: This episode starts with a hilarious comedy sketch of Kapil and his team. After a while, Vicky Kaushal appears on the show to promote his film “Bhoot Part 1, The Haunted Ship”. Kapil interacts with Vicky about the film and his fears in general. Later on, Krushna appears on the stage and entertains Vicky with her goofiness and tries to flirt with him. Finally, the show ends with Sumona trying to scare Vicky.

episodesList.title: Kapil Is India’s Best Dancer
episodesList.summary: Today’s episode starts with the usual bang, where Kapil and Archana pull each other’s leg. Kapil then invites the judges of India’s Best Dancers on the stage; Geeta Kapoor, Malaika Arora, Terence Lewis. Kapil then asks them they already have a dance show, Super Dancers, why there’s a need for another. Geeta explains that was for kids and this is for teenagers. Archana makes fun of Kapil’s waistline. Kapil and the guest judges then crack few jokes and pull each other’s legs. Geeta also shares that how everyone starts addressing her as ‘Ma’. At that moment, Kapil jokes and asks Archana Puran Singh that how did she become a father. Then Kapil does a funny question and answers round. Then Sumona arrives and tries to become the India’s Best Dancers’ Show’s host, but Kapil can’t stop himself from teasing her. The laughter continues when the Dance Show’s host, Bharti arrives and tickles everyone’s funny bones. Kapil and Geeta Kapoor then do a funny imitation of airplane announcement.

episodesList.title: Kapil’s Sensational Thappad
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma starts the show with quirky and interesting take on history. He then takes a fun quiz on history with the audience. Later, he invites Taapsee Pannu on stage. Kapil asks Taapsee why her films’ titles are of single words, is it because she is single? He cracks a few more jokes with her and afterwards, invites another actror Diya Mirza and Thappad’s Director Anubhav Sinha. Kapil flirts with Diya by saying that she looks good in the black saree and jokingly calls Archana Bulgaria’s parrot. Kapil can’t stop flirting with Diya, to which Diya asks him whether he knows the film’s title or not? Kapil then does a Yes & No session with both the actors and the director. Then Chandu arrives unexpectedly with his own fashion show and the laughter doubles. Later, Chandu invites Bhoori, the fashion designer on the stage, hoping she will take his side, but they both end up pulling each other’s leg. Chandu leaves and Bhoori shows ‘Thappad’s’ star cast her fashion collection.

episodesList.title: Tiger Shroff’s Singing Skills
episodesList.summary: Kapil welcomes Tiger Shroff and Shraddha Kapoor for the promotion of “Baaghi 3”. He asks Tiger whether to reduce his intake of sugar or to reduce some romance in life to stay fit like him. Then, Kapil invites Ahmed Khan and Ritesh Deshmukh on the stage. Both of them enter on the stage with their awesome dance moves. Kapil tells Ritesh that he is his biggest fan. He also compliments Tiger for being an Indian action hero. Ritesh confesses that he wore Genelia’s shirt for a scene. Then, Kiku appears on the stage and entertains the guests with his unique promotion style. He asks Tiger if his body got tanned while shooting in the sun. Ahmed tells everybody that the film contains 85% real stunts and 15% VFX. Shraddha and Tiger showcase their dance performance on the stage. Ritesh compliments Ahmed for his various talents and both of them, entertain everyone with their mimicking skills as well. Everyone requests Tiger to sing a song.

episodesList.title: Ramayan’s 33 Years, Cast Celebrates
episodesList.summary: The cast of late Ramanand Sagar’s iconic serial Ramayana reunites to celebrate the 33 years of its airing. Kapil Sharma invites Arun Govil (Ram), Dipika (Sita) and Sunil Lahri (Lakman) with huge applause from the audience. Kapil goes nostalgic as he shares his first meeting with Arun Govil. Meanwhile, Arun reveals that his first audition was rejected by Sagar for the role of Shri Ram. Dipika and Sunil also share about how they were finalized to play their roles. Further, Arun narrates how he was abused by a man for smoking a cigarette, as they considered him God. Dipika shares how she realized after two-three months of Ramayan airing, that she and Arun were being revered by senior citizens too. Kiku Sharda and Bharti Singh’s humorous act leaves the cast in splits. Later, Prem Sagar, son of Ramanand Sagar arrives and launches the biography of his visionary father titled ‘An Epic Life: Ramanand Sagar, From Barsaat to Ramayan’ written by him.

episodesList.title: Women’s Day With The Devi’s
episodesList.summary: The occasion of Women’s Day just gets more special, as Kajol and Shruti Hassan arrive for the promotion of their short film Devi. Kapil wishes them a Happy Women’s Day, and congratulates Kajol on the blockbuster success of her last release Tanhaji. Kajol talks about Devi, which is based on a sensitive social cause, and feels that it should bring the required change and touch everyone from within. Meanwhile, Kapil invites the other cast members of the film, which includes Mukta Barve, Neena Kulkarni, Shivani Raghuvanshi and Yashaswini Dayama. Feeling that his show hasn’t looked so glamorous before, Kapil gets a photo session done with them. Further, Yashaswini croons Love You Zindagi, and Shruti also entertains with singing Alvida song beautifully. The cast even plays an extremely funny game. Later, Kajol reveals an interesting incident about misleading the media persons on the day of her wedding. The fun quotient adds up with Kajol shaking a leg with Bharti on Bole Chudiyaan.

episodesList.title: Akshay Kumar’s Early Morning Fun
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma wishes everyone a very Good Morning, as they’re shooting for this episode at 6 am in the morning. Kapil reveals the reason behind this early shooting is none other than their guest, superstar Akshay Kumar. He welcomes Akshay, who comes to promote his film Sooryavanshi. Akshay shares that there are many complaints against him of waking up so early for promotions. Then, Akshay recommends some artists to Kapil and shows everyone some funny morphed pictures of Chunky Pandey, Riteish Deshmukh, Saurabh Shukla, and Boman Irani. Meanwhile, Akshay tells something about award functions, which evokes laughter. They invite Sooryavanshi director Rohit Shetty, who arrives and says that he wishes to take over the judge’s chair from Archana Puran Singh. Rohit shares that Akshay didn’t wear the safety harness while shooting for the Helicopter scene in the film. Akshay shower praises on the Police, who sacrifice their lives for everyone. Later, Katrina Kaif is welcomed by Kapil.

episodesList.title: Double The Fun With Team Sooryavanshi
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma’s dose of entertainment continues with team Sooryavanshi. Kapil starts the show with a hilarious act, where he’s dressed up as a Police Inspector. Kapil then invites producer Karan Johar, and congratulates him for being awarded the prestigious Padma Shri. Karan compliments Kapil that he’s looking hot. Karan later shares about what makes him and Rohit Shetty come together for entertainers like Simmba and Sooryavanshi. Upon being asked whether he is more talented or flexible, Karan replies with a witty answer. Meanwhile, Karan says that he shouldn’t post any new ‘videos’ now. Rohit and Karan then share how Kareena Kapoor Khan gets to know about everything that is happening in Bollywood. Hearing about these incidents about Bebo, Akshay suggests that Mumbai Police should hire Kareena. Then, Kapil plays a game with Karan, where he has to recite some popular Police dialogues from Hindi films.

episodesList.title: Dream Girl Returns
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma invites Esha Deol on the show. He compliments her that she is looking very pretty and congratulates her on her debut book Amma Mia’s launch. Esha talks about the book and her two daughters, Radhya and Miraya, who inspired her to write the book. Continuing with the chat, Kapil then invites Esha’s mother and Bollywood’s Dream Girl, Hema Malini on stage. Hema then shares tips of being fit and reveals that as a kid, Esha was the naughtiest. Meanwhile, Hema narrates how she convinced Dharmendra to let Esha act in films. Later, Hema and Esha go on a nostalgic trip looking at some old pictures of Esha and Ahana along with their parents. Hema also shares how and when she got the title of ‘Dream Girl’ in films. Esha then Kapil to sing a song, and he beautifully croons Hema’s classic romantic number Humein Tumse Pyar Kitna. Sapna, Baccha Yadav and Titli Yadav entertain with their hilarious acts. Towards the end, Hema and Esha launch the book Amma Mia on the show.

episodesList.title: The Devdas Unfolds On Kapil’s Show
episodesList.summary: Bhoori rocks the stage with her dance performance but Shamsher Singh interrupts and interrogates her. Meanwhile, enters Baccha, who has decided to direct Devdas, the Bengali classic. Eventually, Shamsher, who’s playing Devdas gets bored and decides to portray a Punjabi Devdas. What will this Punjabi Devdas be like? Later, Sai Manjrekar and Ayush Sharma visit the show to promote their new single, Manjha. In a warm tete-a-tete with Kapil, they open up about their Bollywood journey so far.

episodesList.title: Kapil Becomes Yamraj
episodesList.summary: The episode starts on a musical note. Kapil beautifully croons classic songs, Inteha Ho Gayi Intezar Ki and Kisi Ki Muskurahaton Pe Ho Nisar. Kapil starts entertaining with his funny jokes about a new born baby. Meanwhile, a funny act on Yamlok brings the house down with laughter. Kapil becomes Yamraj and solves the confusion of a newly deceased on whether he should enter the Swarg Lok or Narak Lok. Kapil as Yamraj, tells everyone to use sanitizer, spreading awareness on Coronavirus.

episodesList.title: Kapil’s Wonderful Audience
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Kapil Sharma speaks with his audience and learns some interesting things about them. He entertains them with his quirky one liners. He also plays some funny games with the audience and makes them happy.

episodesList.title: Back And How!
episodesList.summary: Enjoy your favourite The Kapil Sharma Show once again. Kapil and his madhouse is back in action and you don’t want to miss it for anything. Watch Kapil connect with his fans distantly. And also get thoroughly entertained with a hilarious, yet realistic skit by the performers.

episodesList.title: Entertainment Unleashed!
episodesList.summary: Sonu Sood, has stolen millions of hearts with his acting, but more for his philanthropy. On The Kapil Sharma Show in this episode, Sonu talks to Kapil about his experience with the migrant workers. Also, enjoy the entertaining acts by our quirky host Kapil and the team.

episodesList.title: Life, Off-Screen!
episodesList.summary: Kapil and his team are working together for a long, and they all are like one big family. Let’s meet with the spouses of these family members. This weekend, Kapil interacts with Parmeet Sethi, Priyanka Sharda, and Kashmira Shah on their marriage and love life.

episodesList.title: Mission Laughter
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma welcomes Team Avrodh: The Siege Within actors - Amit Sadh, Neeraj Kabi, Madhurima Tuli, and Darshan Kumaar on the show. Kapil interacts with the stars about the web show. Later, they all play a funny game and enjoy some interesting revelations. Plus, adding to the fun are the hilarious acts by the gang.

episodesList.title: The Entertaining Brothers
episodesList.summary: The Independence Day celebration gets exciting on The Kapil Sharma Show as the music composer duo Salim–Sulaiman makes a rocking entry with the song Chak De India. They share some interesting facts while the hilarious acts of Sapna and Accha Yadav take the entertainment factor notches higher.

episodesList.title: The Laughter Loots
episodesList.summary: Hop on to a crazy laughter ride with Kapil Sharma as he engages in a conversation with the Lootcase actors, Ranveer Shorey, Kunal Khemu, and Rasika Duggal. Their quick comebacks to Kapil’s funny questions are sure to have you splitting into your sides. Catch this high-on-entertainment episode of The Kapil Sharma Show to know more about the movie Lootcase and much more.

episodesList.title: Mika, Shefali And Chahatt Raise The Hotness Bar!
episodesList.summary: The hotness bar reaches an all-new level on The Kapil Sharma Show, as the singing star, Mika Singh, and two sexy divas, Shefali and Chahatt, joins Kapil. Mika Paji not only entertains us with his all-time popular chartbusters but also gets chatty with Kapil on various topics like his song, Jumme Ki Raat. Hilarious acts by Mitti Mouse and Bua take the entertainment to an all-new level.

episodesList.title: Your Honor Haazir Ho!
episodesList.summary: The fun quotient on The Kapil Sharma Show increases in this episode as Kapil welcomes the Your Honor actors, Jimmy Sheirgill, Mita Vasisht, and Varun Badola. With Kapil’s tongue-in-cheek questions and witty replies by the celebs, this is a crazy laughter ride that you must not miss.

episodesList.title: Welcome, Covid-19 Warriors!
episodesList.summary: This weekend, our favourite host, Kapil Sharma has very special guests on the show. Let’s meet Dr. Muffazal Lakdawala and Dr. Gautam Bhansali, the doctors who have poured their sweat and blood to treat the Covid-19 patients despite the risk of getting infected. Watch their mind-blowing interactions with Kapil and the team in this wonderful episode. Check out their inspiring journey through the pandemic right now!

episodesList.title: The Zingaat Entertainment
episodesList.summary: Conquering millions of hearts with their melodious and foot-tapping music, composer duo, Ajay-Atul makes a Zingaat entry, as our host, Kapil Sharma welcomes them to celebrate Ganesh Mahotsav. Ajay-Atul talks about their love for music since childhood and shares many more interesting facts while treating us to a humorous conversation with our quirky host, Kapil and his laughter gang. Plus, the duo sings Deva Shree Ganesha adding much more fun to the Ganpati celebrations.

episodesList.title: Teen Geetkaar Bane Kapil Ke Yaar
episodesList.summary: The entertainment mode on The Kapil Sharma Show turns lyrical, as celebrated lyricists Swanand Kirkire, Amitabh Bhattacharya, and Manoj Muntashir, join our favourite host. Kapil starts asking them some funny questions which leave the guests in splits. Plus, the hilarious acts by Baccha Yadav and Mitti Mouse take the fun to a new level. Join the Kapil gang to have some musical fun and get to know some funny secrets and the hidden talent of our guests.

episodesList.title: Hansi Ki Bauchhar With Angad-Neha
episodesList.summary: Our host, Kapil Sharma, engages in a conversation with Bollywood’s power couple, Angad Bedi and Neha Dhupia. Kapil’s hilarious questions on marriage and lockdown secrets get the couple to be at their wittiest best, followed by a romantic moment between the two. Plus, Bachcha Yadav’s bank becomes a house of comedy, with each customer’s crazy quirks and antics.

episodesList.title: Comedy Ki Raat Sachin-Jigar Aur Diyva Ke Saath
episodesList.summary: Promising lots of music, fun, and entertainment, our host, Kapil Sharma welcomes the rocking music composer duo, Sachin-Jigar, and singer, Divya Kumar. From asking the guests some funny questions to giving an audition to Sachin-Jigar for playback singing, everything results in unlimited laughter. The guests even join in for an entertaining game of ‘Never Have I Ever’. Also, do not forget to catch Sapna’s punny act with Jigar, which will leave you in splits.

episodesList.title: Kadak Bhojpuri Entertainment With Manoj-Ravi
episodesList.summary: The entertainment bar reaches an all-new level as Bhojpuri superstars, Ravi Kishan and Manoj Tiwari join Kapil. The duo’s banter while giving witty answers to Kapil’s questions is unmissable. From Krushna’s ace act as Big B and Bachcha Yadav’s top-notch comical punches, this episode has it all. And what’s even more fun is the enactment of some cricketing moves by Manoj and Ravi.

episodesList.title: Richa-Harshdeep’s Unlimited Masti
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma invites two outstanding singers, Richa Sharma and Harshdeep Kaur, promising a high-on-entertainment ride. With some interesting revelations about Richa’s childhood mischiefs to Harshdeep getting a wedding proposal at Gurudwara, the guests get chatty with Kapil and enjoy their time on the show. Plus, the talented duo’s singing along with Kapil, and Sapna’s special massage makes it all the more necessary to watch this hilarious episode.

episodesList.title: Ashutosh-Renuka, Couple Goals Ki Paribhasha
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma welcomes one of Bollywood’s most ideal couples, Ashutosh Rana and Renuka Shahane. Kapil’s questions about Renuka falling in love with Ashutosh, Ashutosh’s writing, Renuka’s first visit to Ashutosh’s set, and much more, get the couple to be at their wittiest best. Renuka showcases her hidden talent and sings a romantic number for Ashutosh. Plus, Bachcha and Titli’s banter makes Renuka wish if she and Ashutosh were a couple like them.

episodesList.title: Annu Kappor, The Harfanmaula Kalakar
episodesList.summary: Mention Annu Kapoor, one instantly remembers the Antakshari days and Sapna brings back those memories during her chit chat with this legendary actor who made waves even as a show anchor. Annu ji, in his full swag and style, reveals a lot of his life’s secrets. Matching Kapil’s comedy moves he wows us with his soulful singing and infectious energy. Watch this episode to know a fine actor, a perfect stage anchor, and a lovely human being - Annu Kapoor.

episodesList.title: Mahabharat Ke Kamaal Kisse
episodesList.summary: The show tonight looks grand as some of the mega stars of the mega serial Mahabharat grace the show. The actors share funny and interesting stories, lesser-known facts come to light. Did you know casting director ‘Shakuni’ took 3500 auditions for over two years to finalise the cast? How did Nitish Bharadwaj learn the ‘Arjun’ dialogues? And not to forget the goofy, Punjabi-speaking ‘Hanuman’!

episodesList.title: Hasi Mazak ‘Hum Log’on Ke Saath
episodesList.summary: It’s a Hum Log cast reunion after 36 years and masti unlimited is guaranteed. Bachcha Yadav brings his infectious laughter dose and a Hum Log monologue of his childhood days. Divya Seth shares her birthday with Kapil and may replace Archana by her signature laughter. Rajesh Puri gets a chhole gift? Seema did real social work for 3 years based on her screen role. Did Manoj date Majhli on screen and Badki off screen? There’s Lallu’s dacoit photoshoot and many more Hum Log tales.

episodesList.title: Anubhav’s Blackmailing Tactics For Manoj
episodesList.summary: Great buddies Manoj Bajpai and Anubhav Sinha - have stories galore to share. Anubhav’s blackmail funda for Manoj or Manoj’s jibe at stingy Anubhav. While Manoj’s happy hour in a Paris bound flight was incredible, Anubhav confesses to having rejected many movies due to his average acting skills. What took 26 years for the buddy duo to collaborate for work? And when they did, something fabulous like ‘Bambai Mein Ka Ba’ came out. Stay tuned to Bachcha’s Raddi News. Is Sidhu back? But where is Kapil?

episodesList.title: Fun Overdose On Sony’s 25th Anniversary
episodesList.summary: As Sony TV turns 25, Kapil brings together a special episode to celebrate this silver jubilee. The entire cast share their best wishes for the channel and as usual, do not shy away from leg-pulling. Add to that, Indian Idol’s famed singer - Salman Ali’s melody, nakli Sidhu Paaji’s dhamaal, Bachchan sahab’s grandeur, Sunny’s dhai kilo ka haath, and much more. Enjoy this super funny episode to see the team’s antics.

episodesList.title: Beautiful Poonam,  Gorgeous Padmini
episodesList.summary: A huge shout out to the two beautiful Bollywood divas, who ruled hearts in the 80's era. They are none other than buddies, Poonam Dhillon and Padmini Kolhapure. When the duo catch up, fun, banter and meethi shararat go up by a notch. While Padmini is concerned about Kapil losing weight, Poonam complains that he isn't flirting enough with her. The best part is when Padmini says that Jackie Shroff used to flirt the most, and in walks Jaggu dada. Lastly, Padmini sings so well, wow!

episodesList.title: Siblings Shararat With Huma And Saqib
episodesList.summary: Fine actor Huma Qureshi is on the show with her younger brother, Saqib. Huma wanted to be an actress from her childhood, Saqib followed suit. Saqib was photographed as a child, dressed in Huma’s ghagra. Did you know Huma just completed a film with Akshay Kumar even amidst pandemic? Huma addresses Kapil as her brother, he forgets his lines in turn! Saqib was the greedy one. Huma once hit Saqib very hard and then panicked like crazy.

episodesList.title: Shatrughan Sinha, Beyond Khamosh
episodesList.summary: Better known for his action roles, Shotgun Sinha, today seems to be in his unplugged avatar, thanks to Kapil. From his marriage proposal story to being referred to as Shatur-murg, Mr. Sinha bares it all. His Khamosh still rings fresh after years. Did you know that Shatru ji used to deliver his scenes without retakes? What happened when he forgot his wife’s birthday? Son, Luv Sinha loves his action movies over romance.

episodesList.title: Divalicious Nora, Dapper Guru
episodesList.summary: Nora Fatehi and Guru Randhawa are an absolute delight to watch on The Kapil Sharma Show. Kapil gets all flirty with Nora and asks her to be a part of his web series. Guru Randhawa spins the magic of vocals and gets everyone swaying to his tunes. Meanwhile, Shona and Baabu approach Nora to do their homework, and shake a leg with Guru and Nora. Kapil’s band gets belly dancing lessons from Nora and Guru talks about how he taught Nora some cool Bhangra.

episodesList.title: Jodi Kamaal: Genelia And Riteish
episodesList.summary: After dating for ten long years, they wedded and today, Riteish and Genelia rock the show with their laughter tales. Watch out Riteish’s funda for pheras and shapaths for a wedding. Top it with Krushna’s Himalaya comedy, to complete the laughter scene. Answering a fan, Riteish confesses that he always says sorry to Genelia during their arguments. Genelia, in turn, gets to ask only ten questions to her hubby per day.

episodesList.title: Suresh Raina, Beyond Cricket
episodesList.summary: Suresh Raina, the skilled cricketer is in his fun avatar along with his wife, Priyanka. Suresh and Priyanka's child was born on the day lockdown started. Thus, Priyanka steps out of the house after ten months, thanks to Kapil's invitation. Suresh tried his hands at household chores during lockdown. Interestingly, Priyanka’s father was Suresh’s cricket coach. Was this a prelude to their wedding? Ever thought what do the cricketers’ wives do if their better halves don't score well? Keep watching.

episodesList.title: Laughter Crackers By Team Laxmii
episodesList.summary: The much awaited movie, Laxmii's star cast, Akshay Kumar and Kiara Advani, are here, and oh, what fun! From signature steps of ‘Burj Khalifa’ to holding an adalat, the duo does it all, with unfiltered fun and masti. Amid laughter bouts, team Kapil Sharma also has gifts for Akshay, to celebrate his silver jubilee. Watch out for the saree task and Kiara’s singing. The real life Laxmi joins the show and voices a strong message on behalf of the transgender community’s acceptance in society.

episodesList.title: Bulk Masti With Remo’s Gang
episodesList.summary: Remo brings his dance gang to the show and they talk about the making of the music video, Log Kya Kahenge, along with their other lockdown stories. Remo today is a trendsetter to those who thought dancing ain’t no good as a career. Amid Kapil’s non-stop humour, Punit gets a baraat wala rehearsal for his wedding, which is round the corner. While Sapna’s Garmi step is drool worthy, Bumper has found a match in Dharmesh!

episodesList.title: Chhalaang Stars In The House!
episodesList.summary: It’s Diwali with Rajkummar and Nushrratt, and their upcoming movie, Chhalaang. The actors give out movie’s little sneak peeks. When Rajkummar comes to ask for Titli’s rishta, there’s total madness around. Was Nushrratt Bhuri’s college mate? Rajkummar ran away to Mumbai for Boogie Woogie and used to sit outside Shah Rukh Khan’s house. Today he mimics SRK like a pro. Later, actor-director, Divya Khosla Kumar and Singer, Darshan Raval join in, to complete the fun scene.

episodesList.title: Back To School With Alisha-Jassi-Neeraj
episodesList.summary: On the auspicious occasion of Diwali, Kapil Sharma invites three talented pop singers, Alisha Chinai, Jassi Jasbir and Neeraj Shridhar on the show. While Alisha, Jassi and Neeraj take us back to the wonderful memories of the 90’s, Baccha and team make sure to entertain the guests with their epic performances. Later, Kapil surprises his audience with a Diwali bonus, as he welcomes Scam 1992 stars, Pratik Gandhi, Shreya Dhanwanthary and Hansal Mehta, on the show.

episodesList.title: Comedy Maahol With Govinda
episodesList.summary: It ought to be a bundle of laughs, when Kapil Sharma invites the king of comedy, Govinda, on his show. With his famous comic timing, Govinda gets super-candid with Kapil and spills some interesting beans about his co-workers. While Govinda creates a maahol with his unfiltered chit-chats, Bachcha brings his new friends to entertain the comedy king.

episodesList.title: Comedy Trip With Indian Idol Trio
episodesList.summary: The Indian Idol trio, Aditya, Himesh and Vishal, make a musical entry, with their super hit songs. The guests open up about the various quirky incidents that have happened during their stage shows. Aditya is all set to marry his childhood love and Himesh is enjoying his newly married life, Vishal being a lifetime bachelor. Few shortlisted singers of Indian Idol also show their talent. Know about Himesh’s first film song break, Bumper’s Aditya love and much more in this episode.

episodesList.title: Qisson Ki Mehfil With Shakti-Chunky
episodesList.summary: The legendary Bollywood superstars, Shakti Kapoor and Chunky Panday, grace The Kapil Sharma Show with their wonderful presence. Wasting no time, they both get pretty candid and start to spill some beans about each other. As Shakti and Chunky’s hilarious banter continues, Chandu and Bhuri, from BhuChand academy, perform a twisted tale of Devdas in front of them. Later, Sapna gets on the stage and makes sure to entertain Shakti and Chunky at the fullest.

episodesList.title: Anupam Kher, Satish Kuashik, Pankaj Tripathi On Kapil’s Show
episodesList.summary: The entertainment quotient is high on The Kapil Sharma Show, as our favourite host invites the seasoned actors, Anupam Kher, Satish Kaushik and Pankaj Tripathi, on the stage. Anupam and Satish speak about their friendship, and pull each other’s legs, while Pankaj Tripathi joins them to promote his upcoming film, Kaagaz. Later, Bachcha Yadav, with his Bhaisa, enters the stage to entertain our guests with hilarious one-liners.

episodesList.title: From Struggle To Stardom, Nawazuddin Siddiqui
episodesList.summary: The entertainment factor on The Kapil Sharma Show will reach a new level tonight, as our cherished host invites Nawazuddin Siddiqui on the stage. While Bumper and Sapna regale Nawazuddin with their quirky feats, Nawaz talks about his days of struggle and gives a glimpse into his personal life.

episodesList.title: Nehu-Preet, Shaadi Ke Baad Pehli Baar
episodesList.summary: Neha Kakkar Singh graces the show with her dearest hubby, Rohanpreet Singh. As non-stop laughter and romance is in the air, Nehu-Preet light up the stage like never before. Their subtle teasing and cute flirtations make the day. Kapil and Archana are awed by the lovebirds. Last but not the least, our comedy stars steal the show like every time. Watch the newly-weds relive some shaadi ki rasmein and have a total blast, followed by Tulsi Kumar’s stunning performance for the evening.

episodesList.title: Team Durgamati’s Savage Comedy Eve
episodesList.summary: What happens when the team of a horror thriller arrives on The Kapil Sharma Show? Tune in tonight as the amazing cast of Durgamati will grace the show and share some witty, hilarious and spooky stories with us. Arshad’s timeless comical puns, Bhumi’s relatable stories, Mahie and Karan’s sporting humour coupled with a rib-tickling QandA round and some funny gags with Kiku and Krushna, is bound to add loads of chuckles and laughter to your evening.

episodesList.title: Indian Cricket Team’s Rising Stars
episodesList.summary: Did you know that Nitish Rana is Krushna’s brother-in-law? Or the reason behind Axar’s unique name? Tonight’s show will be a box full of revelations, when IPL’s four shining stars, Nitish Rana, Ravi Bishnoi, Rahul Tewatia, and Axar Patel, will grace the stage to play an innings they have never played before. They won’t only relish the shenanigans of the hosts, but will also discuss their inspiring cricket journey.

episodesList.title: Frolic With The Singing Star, Sukhwinder
episodesList.summary: The man with a velvety voice, Sukhwinder Singh, is all set to wow Kapil and the audience with his super-hit songs, amidst non-stop laughter and frolic. The masti multiplies when Sukhwinder enjoys the funny antics of Kapil’s entertaining team. Kapil digs into many secrets of the singing superstar and is left speechless with Sukhi paa ji’s hilarious stories. Do not miss Sukhwinder Singh’s soul-touching performance, tonight on The Kapil Sharma Show.

episodesList.title: Unfiltered Masti With The Dance Masters
episodesList.summary: The masti multiplies when the acclaimed choreographers, Geeta Kapur, Ganesh Acharya and Terence Lewis grace The Kapil Sharma Show with their wonderful presence. There is Ganesh’s weight loss journey, Geeta-Kapil’s flirtatious conversation and Terence’s laughter peals. Add to that Accha’s boisterous gags and Nakli Jaggu Dada’s dancing feet, to get a perfect evening of fun and entertainment.

episodesList.title: Coolie No. 1 Ka Christmas Celebration
episodesList.summary: This Christmas season, Kapil Sharma invites Varun Dhawan and Sara Ali Khan on the show to promote their latest film, Coolie No. 1. While Varun and Alia get into a highly engrossing conversation with Kapil, Bhuri and Chandu from the famous BhuChand Academy showcase their extraordinary talent before the actors. Later, Kiku and Krushna as the mischievous school kids get on the stage to tickle Varun and Sara’s funny bones with their hilarious jokes.

episodesList.title: Comedy Mehfil With Team Coolie No. 1
episodesList.summary: The entertainment quotient intensifies on The Kapil Sharma Show, as the entire star cast of Coolie No. 1, joins Varun Dhawan and Sara Ali Khan for a magical evening. While Johnny Lever, Jaaved Jaaferi and Rajpal Yadav make the audience laugh with their chucklesome stories, Jackky Bhagnani, Shikha Talsania and Sahil Vaid share their bizarre experiences in the film industry.

episodesList.title: Kapil's Double Guestlist
episodesList.summary: Kapil has a special surprise for today's episode.Two set of incredibly talented guests. The cast of Ramprasad Ki Tehrvi and SonyLIV's show Sandwiched Forever. Watch as stars like Konkona Sen Sharma, Kunaal Roy Kapur, Manoj Pahwa and Seema Pahwa take the stage.

episodesList.title: New Year Celebration With Anil Kapoor
episodesList.summary: New Year celebration becomes more special as our loving host invites renowned star, Anil Kapoor as the special guest, who talks about his upcoming movie, AK vs AK. Tune in to learn Anil Kapoor's secrets behind looking young and dashing. The immensely entertaining Sarla, Titli, Chandu and Baccha Yadav make us laugh till we cry. Watch this super amusing episode of The Kapil Sharma Show only on SonyLIV.

episodesList.title: Punjabi Special With Badshah And Sukhbir
episodesList.summary: Kapil welcomes two of the biggest stars in the Hindi music industry, Badshah and Sukhbir to turn the show into an all-out dance party. Entertainment and laughter are guaranteed as the two musical giants meet and interact with all the other characters of the show.

episodesList.title: The Big Bull Stars Ki Raat
episodesList.summary: Abhishek Bachchan, Ajay Devgn, Sohum Shah and Nikita Dutta, the star cast of the movie, The Big Bull have graced the stage with their presence. The excitement level is at its peak on the set. Our charming host gets flirty with Nikita Dutta while Ajay and Abhishek pull his leg.

episodesList.title: The Cast Of Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahi
episodesList.summary: The cast of the popular T.V show from the mid 2000's, Jassi Jaisi Koi Nahi, grace Kapil's Stage. Mona Singh, Gaurav Gera, Virendra Saxena and Samir Soni tell us stories about their lives.

episodesList.title: The Evergreen Raj Babbar and Jaya Prada
episodesList.summary: Kapil hosts veteran actors Raj Babbar and Jaya Prada and other cast members, including Gurpreet Ghuggi and Ihana Dhillon, of the upcoming picture Bhoot Uncle: Tussi Great Ho. Join Kapil and family who interview their guests while entertaining everyone.

episodesList.title: Villain’s Day Out
episodesList.summary: Stars who have contributed immensely to Indian film industry with their negative roles over the years, come as guests on Kapil's Show. Legends Bindu, Ranjeet, and Gulshan Grover give us an insight into what it was like to be a loved and hated icon during their days of glory.

episodesList.title: Greatest Musicians Of All Time!
episodesList.summary: Three singing legends and winners of the Padmashree award, Pankaj Udhas, Anup Jhalota and Hariharan, arrive as guests at Kapil's show. They grace the stage with their mesmerizing voices and leave us awe-struck.

episodesList.title: Cast Of Wagle Ki Duniya and Mehendi Wale Haath
episodesList.summary: We have the cast of Wagle Ki Duniya which makes a comeback on all platforms after 33 years. The critically acclaimed sitcom from the late '80s, has a new take on modern problems. Originally written and created by legendary cartoonist R.K Laxman, the show uniquely captures every emotion of Indian middle-class life. In our next segment, we have Guru Randhawa and Sanjana Sanghi tell us about their new song 'Mehendi Waale Haath'.Also, will it be Shamsher's lucky day with Ridhima Pandit?

episodesList.title: Cast Of Bhuj On The Kapil Sharma Show
episodesList.summary: Kapil and his team is back with a bang along with Ajay Devgn, Nora Fatehi, Ammy Virk and Sharad Kelkar to promote their film, Bhuj: The Pride Of India.

episodesList.title: The Cast Of Bell Bottom With Kapil Sharma
episodesList.summary: Akshay Kumar reunites with Kapil Sharma, accompanied by the cast of Bell Bottom.

episodesList.title: Chak De India With Kapil Sharma And Team
episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma welcomes the Indian Women's and Men's Hockey Teams who showed their immense talent at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games.

episodesList.title: Kapil With Dharam And Shatru
episodesList.summary: Dharmendra and Shatrughan Sinha share the stage with Kapil Sharma and relive their glory days.

episodesList.title: Sid And Kiara On The Kapil Sharma Show
episodesList.summary: Bollywood's current favorite jodi, Siddharth Malhotra and Kiara Advani are here on The Kapil Sharma Show to promote their film 'Shershaah'.

episodesList.title: Neetu Kapoor With Kapil Sharma
episodesList.summary: Neetu Kapoor and Riddhima Kapoor Sahni arrive on The Kapil Sharma Show and share tales from their professional and personal lives.

episodesList.title: Laughter Riot With The Queen Of Bollywood
episodesList.summary: The fearless queen of Bollywood, Kangana Ranaut, is on The Kapil Sharma Show to promote her new film, Thalaivi.

episodesList.title: The Family Number 1
episodesList.summary: Bollywood’s Hero number 1 Govinda joins Kapil Sharma for a laughter riot with his wife, Sunita.

episodesList.title: The Bhoot Police Trio
episodesList.summary: The cast of 'Bhoot Police', Saif Ali Khan, Yami Gautam and Jacqueline Fernandez are in for a laughter ride with Kapil and the team.

episodesList.title: The '90s Musical Trio
episodesList.summary: The 90's music legends Kumar Sanu, Udit Narayan, and Anuradha Paudwal join Kapil Sharma to recreate that era's magic.

episodesList.title: Gales Of Laughter With Cricket Legends
episodesList.summary: Legendary cricketers, Virender Sehwag and Mohammad Kaif arrive at the stadium of entertainment and laughter that is The Kapil Sharma Show.

episodesList.title: Indian Idol Ki Shaan
episodesList.summary: The renowned musical duo, Neha Kakkar and Tony Kakkar, arrive on the show along with the finalists of Indian Idol Season 12 and join Kapil and his team for a fun-filled evening with a hint of music.

episodesList.title: Kapoor Family Ke Nayab Sitare
episodesList.summary: Karisma Kapoor and Randhir Kapoor spend an evening of fun and laughter with Kapil and his team.

episodesList.title: Talent Ke Asal Johari
episodesList.summary: The revered judges of India's Best Dancer Season 2- Geeta Kapur, Terence Lewis, and Malika Arora join Kapil Sharma for a night filled with entertainment and laughter.

episodesList.title: Vicky And Shoojit In The House
episodesList.summary: Bollywood heartthrob Vicky Kaushal and Shoojit Sircar, director of the film "Sardar Udham", arrive on The Kapil Sharma Show.

episodesList.title: Laugh Out Loud With The Team Of Rashmi Rocket
episodesList.summary: Taapsee Pannu and the team of 'Rashmi Rocket' arrive on The Kapil Sharma Show to fill the evening with laughter.

episodesList.title: Dussehra Celebration With The Stars
episodesList.summary: The biggest stars from the '90s, Juhi Chawla, Ayesha Jhulka, and Madhoo Shah celebrate Dussehra on The Kapil Sharma Show.

episodesList.title: Ek Surili Shaam
episodesList.summary: Legendary singers, Sonu Nigam, Hariharan, Sameer Khan, Ash King, Shaan and Talat Aziz grace The Kapil Sharma Show and create a musical atmosphere with a dose of laughter.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Success With Sonakshi Sinha

episodesList.summary: Kapil Sharma welcomes star cricketers Aakash Chopra, Suresh Raina and Deepak Chahar, along with their better halves, on his show, for a night of fun and a ton of gossip.

episodesList.title: Reminiscing The 90s With Manisha And Mahima
episodesList.summary: Manisha Koirala and Mahima Chaudhary, the superstar heroines of the 90s reminisce about their times and enjoy an evening full of love and laughter.

episodesList.title: Team Bhaijaan
episodesList.summary: Kapil welcomes the star cast of the upcoming film, 'Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan', Salman Khan and Pooja Hegde, to have an evening full of fun and celebration.

episodesList.title: The Pilgaonkar Special
episodesList.summary: Actor and director Sachin Pilgaonkar, along with his wife Supriya Pilgaonkar and daughter Shriya Pilgaonkar, grace the stage of Kapil's show and share some hearty laughs with the team.

episodesList.title: Parde Ke Piche Ke Sitare
episodesList.summary: Kapil welcomes well-known stars behind the curtains, Neeta Lulla, Dabboo Ratnani, Allan Amin, Aalim Hakim, Mickey Contractor and Ganesh Acharya, to grace the stage of The Kapil Sharma Show.

episodesList.title: NRI Wives Ki Team Ke Saath Mulakaat
episodesList.summary: The star cast of the upcoming film 'NRI Wives', Bhagyashree, Samir Soni, Raima Sen, Hiten Tejwani and Aditi Govitrikar grace their presence on the show and enjoy the evening with Kapil and team.

episodesList.title: Comedy Aur Garmi Ka Milan
episodesList.summary: The star cast of the 2003 classic 'Haasil' and the hit Sony LIV original series 'Garmi' along with director Tigmanshu Dhulia arrive on The Kapil Sharma Show to share laughs and some interesting stories from the set.

episodesList.title: Jogira Sara Ra Ra With Kapil And Team
episodesList.summary: Actors Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Neha Sharma, Zarina Wahab and Mahaakshay Chakraborty grace their presence on Kapil's show as they promote their upcoming film 'Jogira Sara Ra Ra'.

episodesList.title: The Queens Of TV
episodesList.summary: The four queens that rule the world of television, Urvashi Dholakia, Divyanka Tripathi, Anita Hassanandani, and Ankita Lokhande, arrive on the show to share some laughs with Kapil.

episodesList.title: Aazam Ki Team Ke Saath Gupshup
episodesList.summary: The star cast of the upcoming film Aazam, Raza Murad, Govind Namdev, Sayaji Shinde, Jimmy Sheirgill, Abhimanyu Singh and Indraneil Sengupta grace the stage of The Kapil Sharma Show and have a heartfelt conversation with the team.

episodesList.title: The Leading Ladies Of India
episodesList.summary: The leading ladies of the country, Raveena Tandon, Guneet Monga Kapoor, and Sudha Murty, arrive on the show as Kapil celebrates their extraordinary achievements.

episodesList.title: Chatrapathi Ki Team Ke Saath Mulaqat
episodesList.summary: Bellamkonda Sai Sreenivas, Nushrratt Bharuccha and Bhagyashree grace their presence on Kapil's show to promote their film 'Chatrapathi' and laugh out loud with the team.

episodesList.title: Stars Se Bhari Shyaam
episodesList.summary: The evergreen, talented and beautiful stars from the '80s and '90s era, Sangeeta Bijlani, Varsha Usgaonkar, and Mandakini, arrive on the show to share some laughs with Kapil.

episodesList.title: Legendary Musicians Take Over The Stage
episodesList.summary: Legendary singers Shankar Mahadevan, Akriti Kakar, Shaan, Nirmal Kakar, Sukriti Kakar, Prakriti Kakar, Shashwat Singh, Romy and Nikhita Gandhi grace The Kapil Sharma show and create a musical atmosphere on the stage.

episodesList.title: Stars From India And Beyond
episodesList.summary: Nigerian superstar Rema, the artist behind the hit song 'Calm Down', arrives on The Kapil Sharma Show. And later, the illustrious Kabir Bedi, Pooja Bedi and Alaya F grace the show with their presence.

episodesList.title: Hatke Bachke Night With Kapil
episodesList.summary: Vicky Kaushal and Sara Ali Khan take over the stage with Kapil and the team as they promote their film 'Zara Hatke Zara Bachke'.

episodesList.title: Laughter With The Legends
episodesList.summary: Cricketing legends Brett Lee and Chris Gayle sit down with Kapil for a night filled with loads of laughter and unlimited entertainment.

episodesList.title: Ek Shaam Rj's Ke Naam
episodesList.summary: RJ Anmol, RJ Anurag Pandey, RJ Naved, RJ Jeeturaaj and RJ Malishka join Kapil on the show and spend an evening of laughter with the team.

episodesList.title: Carry On Jatta 3 Ki Star Cast
episodesList.summary: Sonam Bajwa, Gippy Grewal and other stars from the upcoming film 'Carry On Jatta 3' arrive on the show to share some laughs and their hilarious stories with Kapil.

episodesList.title: OTT Stars Ki Mehfil
episodesList.summary: Sumeet Vyas, Rajesh Tailang, Amit Sial, Anchal Singh and Tridha Choudhury, the stars from the digital space have a fun conversation with Kapil and the team.

episodesList.title: Best Of The Best
episodesList.summary: Anand - Milind, Sameer Anjaan and Udit Narayan, legends of the musical world, who worked together on a beautiful song, ‘Dil Mein Badhi Halchal Hai’, spend a fun-filled evening on The Kapil Sharma Show along with four stars of Indian Idol.

episodesList.title: Satyaprem Ki Katha Ki Team Ke Saath Masti
episodesList.summary: Kiara Advani, Kartik Aaryan, Gajraj Rao and Supriya Pathak grace the stage of The Kapil Sharma Show as they promote their upcoming film 'Satyaprem Ki Katha'.

episodesList.title: Tribute To The Lyricists
episodesList.summary: It's an unforgettable gathering of poetic brilliance on The Kapil Sharma Show as the most celebrated lyricists of Indian cinema come together.

episodesList.title: 70's Ki Raunak
episodesList.summary: Superstars from the 70's, Reena Roy and Moushumi Chatterjee, join Kapil on the show for a night filled with unlimited laughter and entertainment.

episodesList.title: Hosts Take Over The Show
episodesList.summary: The hosts from the television world, Renuka Shahane, Mini Mathur, Rich Aniruddha, Deepti Bhatnagar and Parizad Kolah grace their presence on The Kapil Sharma Show to spend an evening of fun and laughter.

episodesList.title: Gadar 2 Ke Saath Masti Aur Dhamaal
episodesList.summary: The star cast of the much anticipated 'Gadar 2', Sunny Deol and Ameesha Patel join Kapil for a night filled with excitement and entertainment.

episodesList.title: Ek Rangeen Safar Ka Ant
episodesList.summary: Superstars Anil Kapoor, Aditya Roy Kapoor, Sobhita Dhulipala, Ravi Behl and Tillotama Shome grace the season finale episode of The Kapil Sharma Show and enjoy an evening with Kapil and his team.

episodesList.title: The Night Manager Of Entertainment
episodesList.summary: The star cast of the hit web series, Anil Kapoor, Aditya Roy Kapoor, Sobhita Dhulipala, Ravi Behl and Tillotama Shome, rejoin Kapil as they create many more moments of pure laughter and entertainment together.

plotHtml: The format is largely identical of Sharma's former show Comedy Nights with Kapil. The kapil sharma Show revolves around Kapil Sharma and his team of comedians, including Sumona Chakravarti, Kiku Sharda, Chandan Prabhakar, Krushna Abhishek, Bharti Singh and Rochelle Rao, who play residents of the Shantivan Non-cooperative Housing Society. Normally every episode unfolds in two parts with the first part being a comic skit enacted by the actors of the show and the second part being the celebrity interview where popular personalities from various fields indulge in a light-hearted interaction with karma. Navjot Singh Sidhu was the permanent guest of the show but was later replaced by Archana Puran Singh after 16 February 2019.
tagline: The format is largely identical of Sharma's former show Comedy Nights with Kapil.

title: Tamanna
summary: Tamanna (English: Dreams Come True) is an Indian Hindi television soap opera which aired on Star Plus from 1 February 2016 to 26 June 2016. It follows the journey of Dharaa who aspires to become a cricketer, breaking the norms of her family and society with her father's support.
plot:
The story revolves around Dharaa who wants to become a cricketer and the sacrifices she has to make in order to achieve her dream. Dharaa is supported by her father and soon convinces her grandmother about playing cricket. She continues playing well and a promising future seemed to lie ahead. But the sudden deterioration of her father's health convinces her to agree to marry Mihir soon, a guy with whom her alliance was going to be fixed. She is initially happy and continues playing cricket, but soon realises her husband's chauvinistic side. He treats Dharaa like a prisoner and controls her. He even went to the extent of doubting her character, and feels that Shubhangi, his and Dharaa's daughter, is not his but Diwakar's, his boss and their neighbour. Fed up of Mihir's possessive nature and insulting behaviour, Dharaa divorces Mihir.
After that M.N.Roy gives Dharaa a job as a cricket coach in a school in Merut. Seeing the bitterness between the Hindu and Muslim students she decides to first make one single team and she succeeds in it but because of a little war between the two players Sanjay and Salamat causes riots again in Bulandganj. She decides to resign but the students apologize to her and then she starts to coach them again. Mihir arrives in Bulandganj and is gathering evidences to portray Dharaa as an irresponsible mother to gain Shubhangi's custody. But Dharaa convinces the judge of her capability of single-parenting alongside her coaching. Mihir then realises his mistake and walks away. Bhanu Pratap and Khan conspire to make riots and assault Bashir and kill Gafur but later get arrested. During this Sanjay and Salamat become friends, and Mridula gives birth to a baby boy at the same time. Dharaa's team gets selected in the tournament and they slog hard and win the trophy. Mihir comes back to Dharaa but Dharaa turns him down and returns to Jamnagar.
reception:
In March 2016, Daily News and Analysis, in their list of 10 female characters of Indian television who stand out progressive, included the lead character Dhara among others stating her ambition as unique.
Hindustan Times stated the story as refreshing and criticised, "The narrative and pace of the show, which took a while to reach the crux of the story."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The series was launched on 21 January 2016 in Mumbai.
Before its premiere, initially titled as Badal Pe Paun Hai, later was renamed as Tamanna due to astrological reason.
The story is set in Jamnagar, Gujarat. The series was filmed in Gujarat and Mumbai. It was a planned finite series which was expected to end on May, but popular demand paved way for its extension till June.
The title track was composed by Suhail Zargar.

title: Tum Mere Kya Ho
summary:
Tum Mere Kya Ho (Urdu: تم میرے کیا ہو, lit. 'Who are you to me') is a 2015 Pakistani romantic drama television series directed by Siraj-ul-Haque and written by Mehrunisa Mustaqeem Khan. It was produced by Abdullah Kadwani and Asad Qureshi under the 7th Sky Entertainment banner, with Mikaal Zulfiqar serving as co-producer. The series stars Sajal Ali, Mikaal Zulfiqar, Kiran Haq and Umair Rana. It first aired on PTV Home on 14 October 2015 and concluded on 3 June 2016.
The series marked the fourth on-screen collaboration between Mikaal Zulfiqar and Kiran Haq.
plot:
When Ahmer (Mikaal Zulfiqar) loses his wife Sadia (Mehreen Raheel) in a fatal road accident, he becomes the sole caretaker of his young daughter Hira (Eshal). Meanwhile, his employee Anwar, whose daughter Hina (Sajal Ali) is due to be married, is unable to meet the financial demands of her prospective in-laws and is forced to cancel the wedding. The shock of this causes Anwar to suffer a fatal heart attack. Ahmer takes on responsibility for supporting Hina.
Ahmer's former friend Maheen (Kiran Haq) has meanwhile left her husband and son and re-enters his life. Unable to accept his growing closeness to Hina, Maheen schemes to remove her from Ahmer's life. When Hina becomes involved with her classmate Mustaqeem, Maheen sees an opportunity to establish herself permanently in Ahmer's household. Ahmer finds himself torn between Maheen's advances and his sense of responsibility towards Hina.
reception: A review in Dawn described Mikaal Zulfiqar's performance as visually compelling but noted the series relied on familiar plot conventions.

title: The Stage
summary: The Stage is an Indian talent television series, season 1 of which premiered on 10 October 2015 and broadcasts on Colors Infinity. The show airs on Saturday and Sunday nights. The series is produced by Kamna Nirula Menezes of SOL Productions. The series is India's first-ever homegrown English singing talent hunt show. All three seasons have been presented by Shibani Dandekar while Vishal Dadlani, Monica Dogra, Ehsaan Noorani, and Devraj Sanyal judge. Yatharth Ratnum was declared the winner of the first season. The second season was bagged by Sharvi Yadav. The third season was won by Siddhant Sharma.

title: Tashan-e-Ishq
summary:
Tashan-E-Ishq  (transl. Love with Attitude) is an Indian romantic drama television series created by Subhash Chandra under Essel Vision Productions  aired from 10 August 2015 to 16 September 2016.
The series starred Sidhant Gupta as Kunj Sarna, Jasmin Bhasin as Twinkle Taneja and Zain Imam as Yuvraj  "Yuvi" Luthra. Set in the backdrop of Punjab, it revolved around their lives and relationship of love, hatred, betrayal and obsession.
plot:
Twinkle Taneja and Yuvraj Luthra madly fall in love. Their respective mothers Leela Taneja and Anita Luthra, are rivals. During a fight between Leela and Anita, Leela challenges her that she will get a wedding alliance for Twinkle in 5 days. Twinkle is upset and meets Yuvraj, he suggests that they should elope. Leela wants Twinkle to marry another guy Kunj Sarna, so Manohar Sarna and Leela Taneja meet for their kid's alliance.
Twinkle packs her bag and has made her mind up to leave her home and run away with Yuvraj. She then realizes that she was being selfish, and if she had gone further with the plan it would hurt her mother, whom she loves, and she decides not to elope with Yuvi. Yuvraj is very angry with her decision and breaks up with her. Twinkle's alliance is fixed with Kunj Sarna. She decides to sort it out with Yuvi but they get into an argument.
Manohar meets Kunj and scolds him for not being at the home during the party. Manohar is a short-tempered person and a dominating husband he is also very religious. Kunj's mother dislikes Twinkle as they had a bad interaction the first time they met and got into a misunderstanding.
Yuvi is upset at seeing Kunj and Twinkle together at the party. Yuvi and Twinkle patch up. Kunj pretends to be a cheap and characterless boy so he drives Twinkle away as he is in love with Alisha. Twinkle tells her mother how Kunj is a creep but Leela refuses to believe her. Everyone proceeds with the Roka, this makes Yuvi angry.
Twinkle, Kunj, and Yuvraj have their plan to break the Roka but all of them fail in stopping the Roka. The next day Manohar scolds Usha(Kunj's mother) and Kunj for what happened on the Roka. Kunj drives his bike in anger and Yuvi follows him. They eventually get into a fight but Twinkle arrives disrupting the fight. Three of them reveal that none of them want this marriage.
They then decide to tell their families about their decision. They fail to express their feelings when their wedding date is being fixed. Yuvraj vows that he will not let Twinkle go and says that he will make Twinkle his no matter what.
Twinkle and Kunj make a deal that they will be together for 3 months and then they will go on their separate ways. Yuvi is on and off about this plan as he doesn't trust Kunj. Alisha is appointed as the wedding planner for Kunj-Twinkle's wedding. She initially denies having feelings for Kunj to Twinkle. She has an ulterior motive to have Kunj all to herself, which means that she wants him to leave his family because she doesn't want to share Kunj or his wealth with anyone.
As the engagement day comes, Twinkle, Kunj, and Yuvraj worry. Later, it is revealed that Yuvraj is faking love and wants to destroy Twinkle to take revenge on Leela for Anita. Twinkle is engaged with Kunj. Twinkle exposes Alisha to Kunj. Yuvraj plans to stop the wedding he crosses all the limits but fails each time. Twinkle marries Kunj. A guilty Twinkle decides to tell her mother the truth.
Leela is very upset to know about Twinkle's confession. Anita and Yuvraj brainwash Leela against Twinkle. When Twinkle confronts her mother, she faces her mother's rage. Kunj reaches the scene and tries to handle the situation but Leela asks Kunj to take Twinkle away.
Ishaan goes missing and Twinkle is blamed. Twinkle goes to Yuvraj to question him about the kidnapping. Twinkle and Kunj learn that it wasn't him who kidnapped Ishaan. The Sarnas learn that Ishaan was kidnapped because of the loan taken by Manohar. The Sarna's now face a financial crisis. Twinkle goes missing but is it later revealed that she fainted doing Parikrama and has dengue so she is admitted to the hospital.
Kunj cares for Twinkle which upsets Usha. Manohar's brother and mother come to live with them. Surjeet falls in love with Anita and decides to marry her even when everyone opposed this alliance. Kunj and Twinkle decide to stop this marriage but they fail. They are sent to Goa for their honeymoon, Yuvraj follows them and has an altercation with Kunj.
Yuvraj realizes he is really in love with Twinkle now. Yuvraj tries to create problems in Twinkle's life and kill Kunj. Twinkle and Kunj fall in love and want a happy life. But Yuvraj remains a threat to them and keeps interfering in their lives. Drawing strength from each other, Kunj and Twinkle fight Yuvraj's all intentions.
Things take a turn when Twinkle saves his life when he falls into his trap of killing her. Yuvraj changes the heart. Owing to hatred for Leela, Anita tries to ruin Twinkle's life by murdering Kunj. She gets him a shot. Kunj is missing and presumed dead. It is later revealed that he never died and was saved by a fisherman. Assuming Kunj is dead, Twinkle is shattered. After a few months, she finds out she is pregnant with Kunj's child. Her family gets her married to Yuvraj fakely as he has changed, but Twinkle continues to love Kunj.

articleSections.title: 5 years later
articleSections.text: Twinkle has suffered miscarriage and still lives with Yuvraj, unaware of his unconditional love for her. Kunj assumes the name Rocky Singh and is a successful boxer. Twinkle and Yuvraj suspect that Rocky might be Kunj. Kunj makes a fake MMS of Twinkle seducing him before she finally confronts him and narrates her sorrows after he presumably died. She tells him about her miscarriage, why she married Yuvraj, and their marriage is fake. Kunj breaks down and tries to win Twinkle's trust back. She is confused as she develops feelings for Yuvraj too and doesn’t want to leave him midway. She now spends some time alone, flees to Mussoorie, and meets a carefree Sonia. Kunj and Yuvraj follow Twinkle, individually trying to win her heart. She decides to study further and demands some space. Yuvraj protectively keeps an eye on Twinkle so that she doesn’t get into any problem. Kunj gets admission into the college as a coach. Yuvraj disguises himself as Jassi and befriends Twinkle to stay close to her as he fears losing her more than ever because this time, his love was pure and more selfless than the last time. As luck has it, Twinkle and Kunj get closer which Yuvraj and Pallavi are unlike. Out of jealousy and his immense love for twinkle, Yuvraj begins plotting against Kunj and tries to instigate Twinkle against him. She professes her belief in Kunj, upsetting Yuvraj further. After many difficulties, Kunj and Twinkle decide to remarry, upsetting Pallavi and Yuvraj. Pallavi pretends to commit suicide to stop the wedding but is killed by her servants for money. Twinkle and Kunj are blamed for the murder, but Yuvraj and a girl named Simple Singh work to prove the couple's innocence and fall in love. The show ends with Kunj-Twinkle and Yuvraj-Simple's marriage and thus ends the saga of Yuvraj and Twinkle’s Tashan-e-Ishq though they end up with different people.
