episodesList.summary: A hungry Jethalal is unable to have his favourite snack, as unexpected guests come over and finish up all the food. However, he calms down and plans on romancing with Daya. But Daya, on the other hand, decides to go to the mall What will Jethalal do now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Romances With Daya
episodesList.summary: While Daya is working in the kitchen, Jethalal comes and gets romantic with Daya. However, Daya has a plan to go shopping at a mall that has just opened up, along with all of her friends from Gokuldham.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Looks After The Kid
episodesList.summary: Daya has gone shopping with the other ladies while Jethalal has to look after the kid. However, Jethalal is not enjoying his time as the kid is extremely naughty and is creating a nuisance all over the house.

episodesList.title: Awkward Situation Between Jethalal And Babita
episodesList.summary: Babita comes to visit the kid in Jethalal's house. But the kid starts saying mean things about both of them, which makes Jethalal and Babita awkward. Meanwhile, Daya has found her purse and is returning home. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Dr. Hathi Arrives In Tempo
episodesList.summary: Dr Hathi is back to the Gokuldham Society after a break. He makes a heroic entry in a tempo, eating bananas. Everyone is happy to see him, however, Hathi is finding it difficult to get out of the situation he is in.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Seeks For Babita's Attention
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is praying from his balcony when he suddenly sees Babita. He starts trying hard and makes noises to gather her attention. Jethalal wants to know Babita's problem and wants to help her.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Misinterpreted The Situation
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets to know from somewhere that it is Babita's birthday. So he gets flowers for her and visits her house to give her birthday wishes. Babita tries to convey to him that it is not her birthday. But Jetha, in his excitement, does not understand.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Gets Panicky
episodesList.summary: Jethalal receives a call from Mehta and gets to know that it's Babita's birthday and there is a party with a western theme. Jethalal gets worried as he hears this and decides to learn western dance, and while practicing gets caught by his wife.

episodesList.title: Struggle Of Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Daya reacts unexpectedly after catching Jethalal dancing with a stranger, he explains that she is a dance instructor. Later on, they find out everybody received an invitation card except them.

episodesList.title: One Problem At A Time
episodesList.summary: A sorrowful Jethalal, after realizing the embarrassment of his family for not being invited, decides to go away. Suddenly, Babita shows up at his house and finds out about the issue. She clarifies everything and finally invites them. After all of this, a new problem arises.

episodesList.title: Finally Party Time
episodesList.summary: As it's a western-themed party, Daya tells Jethalal that she won't be comfortable wearing western clothes in front of Champaklal. After a while, Champaklal himself solves this problem for them by deciding not to attend the party at all. They at last leave for the party.

episodesList.title: Daya Astonishes Everyone
episodesList.summary: All of Gokuldham has arrived for the birthday bash with full spirit and excitement. Babita has a superb entry being the birthday girl and is looking stunning. Daya steals the limelight and astonishes everybody with her unseen attire and look.

episodesList.title: One Night, Two Different Plans
episodesList.summary: The women of Gokuldham have decided to keep a Jagran for the well-being of their husbands and ask them to stay awake at night. The men hesitate at first, but eventually, they all agree because they decide to have their plan of having a party while their wives are busy with the Jagran.

episodesList.title: Realization
episodesList.summary: All the women are decked up for the Jagran and are ready to leave for the clubhouse, whereas, the men are waiting for their chance to begin the party at Taarak's place. All of them finally reach Taarak's place without knowing that he has something else planned for them.

episodesList.title: Battle Of Antakshari
episodesList.summary: As Taarak made all the men of Gokuldham realize that what they were doing was wrong, everybody goes for the Jagran to accompany their wives. They also decide to play Antakshari the whole night. Jethalal begins the Antakshari round and everybody has a great time singing and dancing.

episodesList.title: Meeting At Sodhis
episodesList.summary: Daya loses in the Antakshari deliberately, so that everybody can sleep and makes Jethalal order food for everyone, as everybody seems hungry. This gesture of hers makes Champaklal and Jethalal proud. Later, all the residents gather at Sodi's house to plan for the anniversary of Gokuldham Society.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham's Anniversary Celebration Begins
episodesList.summary: Taarak invites his friend as the chief guest for the Gokuldham Society Anniversary function. They conducted a dance performance by the Gokuldam residents. The couples gave their debut in the rain dance performance.

episodesList.title: Raju Srivastav Visits Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Members of Gokuldham celebrate completing 200 episodes with Raju Srivastav. They have a few amazing dance performances lined up.

episodesList.title: The Gadas Plan On A Trip
episodesList.summary: As Krishna Janmashtami is approaching, Daya requests Jetha to plan a trip to visit her family. Will Jetha agree to this?

episodesList.title: Tapu's Essay
episodesList.summary: Tapu writes an essay on the first showers of the year. Will his parents be impressed with it?

episodesList.title: Jetha Lal's Trip To London
episodesList.summary: Jetha gets an opportunity to go on a trip to London. Nattu Kaka thinks that he's the cause for this trip. What will Jetha say to this?

episodesList.title: Raksha Bhandan At Gokuldham Society.
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is in turmoil & wonders how to tell his family that they were not going to London. He decides to tell his family after Raksha Bandhan event. Meanwhile, all the ladies come over to Jetha's house and give him a list of things to buy from London. What will Jetha do next?

episodesList.title: London Trip Canceled
episodesList.summary: Jethalal finally takes the courage to inform his family at the breakfast table that the London trip was canceled. Champaklal demands answers and asks if he was planning to go alone. But when Jetha explains the situation, his family decides to support him and let him go alone.

episodesList.title: Jethas Preparation For London
episodesList.summary: Jetha and his family are excited that he is going to London. Everyone is demanding gifts from Jetha, which is slowly upsetting him. Watch this episode and find out.

episodesList.title: Jetha's Send Off
episodesList.summary: The members of the society including Jetha's family send Jetha off to the airport. Will the family be happy about Jetha's trip or not?

episodesList.title: Jethas Digestive Pills
episodesList.summary: As Jethalal gets into the plane, Daya bhabhi runs behind him to give him his digestive pills. Will Daya get into trouble for loving her husband?

episodesList.title: Sundarlal Helps Tappu Sena
episodesList.summary: Sundarlal visits Jetha's place and decides to help Tappu Sena regarding a financial matter. What is this favor that makes Tappu Sena jump with joy?

episodesList.title: Dahi Handi Competition At Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: The members of Gokuldham Society celebrate Krishna Janmashtami together. They even arrange the famous Dahi Handi Competition for which, there is a huge prize. Will Tappu Sena win the game?

episodesList.title: Prevention Against Swine Flu
episodesList.summary: As the deadly disease, swine flu is spreading, Daya has her own way of protecting herself from the flu. What is Daya's way?

episodesList.title: Bhide The Philosopher
episodesList.summary: Jethalal and his family have arranged for a bhajan session and Sonu is excited to help them along with Tappu Sena. Meanwhile, Bhide gets deeply philosophical with his wife and starts explaining the purpose of life.

episodesList.title: Roshan Bhabi's Party
episodesList.summary: The ladies of Gokuldham get together to discuss Roshan's party. During the conversation, Daya is reminded of Jetha's absence.

episodesList.title: Preparations For Ganesh Chaturti
episodesList.summary: As Ganesh Chaturti is approaching, Bhide sends an invite to every house in the society. When Abdul gives the invitation to the Gadas, Champaklal sees the price everyone has to contribute and gets angry. What is the price fixed by Bhide?

episodesList.title: Jetha In London
episodesList.summary: The society celebrates Ganesh Chaturti together while Jetha is in London on his business trip. Will Jethalal get homesick?

episodesList.title: Daya Misses Jethalal
episodesList.summary: While Jetha is on a business trip in London, Daya misses him and remembers all the good times they had before he left.

episodesList.title: Ethnic Day Contest At Gokuldham Society
episodesList.summary: On the account of Ganesh Chaturti, Gokuldham Society arranges an ethnic day contest. The prize is given to the winner by Randeep Huda. Who is the winner?

episodesList.title: Garba At Gada Electronics
episodesList.summary: Daya comes to look after Jetha's shop to look after the business. She comes up with a sales pitch which becomes a big hit. What is this new scheme?

episodesList.title: Couples Shayari Time At Gokuldham Society
episodesList.summary: While celebrating Ganesh Chaturthi, Gokuldham Society members decide to have fun amongst themselves by playing a few games. One such game is the couple Shayari. what poems one loved one sings to another.

episodesList.title: Daya's Shayari On Jethalal
episodesList.summary: While playing the couple Sharyari game, Daya recites an emotional poem for her husband, saying that she misses him. Meanwhile, Jethalal calls her from London to give her a surprise. What is this surprise?

episodesList.title: Robbery At Gokuldham!
episodesList.summary: Tappu Sena returns from school to witness the donation box open. They all scream and alarm their parents about the robbery. How will the Gokuldham residents solve this problem?

episodesList.title: Remembering Funny Incidents From The Past
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham has a special guest at Ganesh Chaturthi puja and all the residents take a moment to remember everyone's funny incidents from the past. They also realize how these little incidents brought all the residents to become one big family.

episodesList.title: Daya Misses Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Jetha is still in London on business and Daya on the other hand, is unable to sleep as she's missing her husband.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Returns From London
episodesList.summary: As Daya starts the aarti, Jetha makes an entry back home. Everyone in the colony is excited to have him back.

episodesList.title: Gifts From London
episodesList.summary: Now that Jetha has come home, Tappu demands that he gets his gifts immediately. So, Jetha decides to unpack and distribute everyone's gifts to them.

episodesList.title: No Gift For Iyer
episodesList.summary: Daya and Jetha decide to visit their fellow residents and give them their gifts. Will everyone like their presents?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Back To His Lazy Practices
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is back to his lazy practices now that hes back from London. He uses the difference in timings as his excuse to sleep longer but, will that work?

episodesList.title: Jethalals New Look
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is back from London and has returned with a new look. What does everyone else think about his new look?

episodesList.title: Jethalal's New Friend From London
episodesList.summary: A lady visits the Gada family and asks Daya to pass on a gift to Jetha. Everyone in the society is surprised to have this visitor. But, what is Daya's opinion on this?

episodesList.title: Jethalals Intervention
episodesList.summary: Daya lets her friends know about the guest she had. Shocked to hear the news from Daya, the ladies tell their husbands about the new visitor who in turn decide to have an intervention for Jethalal.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Angry
episodesList.summary: Knowing that everyone has arranged an intervention for him for a wrong reason, Jethalal gets angry. Later, he talks to his wife and asks her to trust him. They make it up together and convey their love for each other.

episodesList.title: Goli Sees Jethalal Getting A Haircut
episodesList.summary: Jethalal finally decides to get a haircut and ends up at a street barber's shop. Goli sees Jetha on the road and demands to reveal it to others. Later, he loses his purse and gets caught with the police. How did all this happen?

episodesList.title: Karie Visits The Gadas
episodesList.summary: Jethalal's friend Karie decides to visit the Gada family. Daya gets excited to welcome her and decides to give her a grand welcome. Will Karie like the welcome?

episodesList.title: Karie Loves Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Karie visits everyone at Gokuldham Society and loves the hospitality provided by the society members.

episodesList.title: Navaratri At Gokuldham Society
episodesList.summary: It is the first day of Navaratri and everyone at Gokuldham is excited. The ladies have decided to go shopping for Navaratri outfits. Will Karie be included as well?

episodesList.title: Popatlal Has Fallen In Love
episodesList.summary: Navaratri is here and everyone at Gokuldham society is super excited to celebrate it together. Meanwhile, the ladies find out that Popatlal has a crush on Karie. Parallelly, Gada electronics comes up with a new Navaratri offer.

episodesList.title: Popatlal's Demand
episodesList.summary: The ladies go shopping for Dandiya costumes along with Sundar and Karie. They all are at Ahmedabad when Popatlal calls Daya. He demands for the same coloured and patterned dress as Karie's. Will he be satisfied?

episodesList.title: Navaratri At Ahmedabad
episodesList.summary: The ladies decide to stay back at Ahmedabad for one more day to celebrate Navaratri. They all dance and enjoy. Meanwhile, their husbands come all the way to Ahmedabad to bring them home.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Stuck In Ahmedabad
episodesList.summary: The members of the society return to Gokuldham Society return home from Ahmedabad. But, they realize that theyve left Popatlal behind on the way.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Unhappy About Popatlal's Crush
episodesList.summary: Hungover from the Navaratri celebrations, Jethalal wakes up to a shocking news. Daya informs him that she thinks Popatlal has a crush on Karie. Hearing this makes Jethalal furious. How will he react?

episodesList.title: Popatlal Gets A Makeover To Impress
episodesList.summary: Popatlal seeks help from the ladies in the society, with regards to his love for Karie. So they have a conversation with Karie to figure out the way for making her fall in love with Popatlal. Hence they give a makeover to Popatlal, on the assumption that Karie will love him for his handsomeness.

episodesList.title: Popatlal's Disastrous Date With Kerry
episodesList.summary: Popatlal and Kerry go to the park, he was struggling hard to keep up with his image in front of Kerry. But there were a lot of disturbances, and Kerry's handbag was snatched away by a petty thief. Popatlal tried to show his heroism but his efforts went in vain, though they got her bag back, Popatlal was beaten black and blue.

episodesList.title: Jethalal The Villain
episodesList.summary: Jethalal, on his way to work, sees Popatlal being comforted by Karie. Later, Karie shares her happiness with Daya and does the Garba with her out of happiness.

episodesList.title: Jethalal And Diwali Games
episodesList.summary: Champaklal is talking to his friend on the phone and explaining to him how much times have changed. Later, he blesses his family members to live a long and a prosperous life.

episodesList.title: Ajay Devgan Visits The Gadas
episodesList.summary: Jethalal and Daya have a miscommunication and forget to bring him home from Gada electronics. Ajay Devgn runs into Champaklal and drops him home.

episodesList.title: Diwali With Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: The members of Gokuldham are very excited to celebrate Diwali, the festival of lights. Watch this episode to see how Gokuldham society members celebrate Diwali.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Gets A Mobile For Babita
episodesList.summary: Babita is looking for a new phone to gift her brother. She approaches Jetha for the phone. Will Jetha be able to get the phone or not?

episodesList.title: Sundar Takes The Red Cherry Phone Away
episodesList.summary: Champaklal, while trying to look for his spectacles packs the phone in Sundar's bag. How will Iyer receive the new Red Cherry Phone?

episodesList.title: Jetha In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tries to contact Sundar with Taarak's help. Meanwhile, Iyer asks Jethalal about the phone which leads Jethalal to explode.

episodesList.title: Daya Vs Jetha
episodesList.summary: Daya is stern on to make Jetha believe that no matter what, Sundar can never steal the phone as he claims he has! Both of them get into a verbal fight. Watch to find out whether Sundar really stole a phone or no! Stay tuned!

episodesList.title: Jethalal And Daya At War
episodesList.summary: Sundar returns from Bangalore but forgets his bags in the taxi. Meanwhile, Daya and Jetha continue to fight. Will they make up for themselves?

episodesList.title: Daya Leaves Jethalal
episodesList.summary: After falsely accusing Daya's brother, Jethalal feels guilty about it. But, Daya decides to keep her word and leaves Jethalal with her brother. Will she come back?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Seeks For Taarak's Help
episodesList.summary: Not being sure whether Sundar has the mobile phone, Jetha seeks Taarak's help. Taarak comes up with a backup plan to help his friend out before Babita asks again.

episodesList.title: Too Many Mobile Phones
episodesList.summary: To save their relationships with one another, Sundar and Jethalal buy a new red cherry mobile each and hide them. Will they get into a bigger mess?

episodesList.title: Champaklal Solves The Problem
episodesList.summary: Jethalal finds the phone in Sundar's bag. Daya decides to leave the house but, Champaklal steps in and solves the chaos. Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Tappu Wins A Prize At The Camp
episodesList.summary: The kids return from the camp and narrate their stories to Champaklal. Later, Tapu says that he won the Best Boy prize in the camp.

episodesList.title: Taarak's Mind Block
episodesList.summary: Taarak Mehta is having a mind block and is finding new ways to write a new article. Later, Tapu creates a problem to drink milk while Jetha is on a business call. Will Jetha scold him?

episodesList.title: Tappu Sena's TV Ad
episodesList.summary: Rita visits Gokuldham Society and asks the parents if Tapu Sena can audition for a TV advertisement. How will the parents react?

episodesList.title: Audition Day
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena is excited about their auditions but, their parents are more excited about their auditions. Will the kids get through the auditions?

episodesList.title: Daya Admires Sodhi
episodesList.summary: After the auditions, the members of Gokuldham society return home. Daya observes Sodhi's excitement about the audition and love for his son and admires his fatherhood.

episodesList.title: Roshan Singh Sodhi Is Disappointed
episodesList.summary: Roshan Sodhi learns that all the kids have got selected for the ad shoot except for Gogi. He makes a scene about this issue and makes sure everyone knows that he is disappointed. Later, rest of the kids go for the shoot and become famous.

episodesList.title: Gogi Sodhi Is Angry
episodesList.summary: While the other kids from the Tapu Sena are at the ad shoot, Gogi is angry and throwing tantrums at his parents for not being selected. His parents, Mr. and Mrs. Roshan are trying their best to convince him. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Daya Is Excited For Tappu
episodesList.summary: Daya is very excited about her son's ad coming on TV. She is calling everyone she knows and informing them to watch the ad without fail. Later, she comes up with a brilliant plan to watch the ad together with the society members.

episodesList.title: Lights, Camera, Power Off!
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham society gathers to watch the ad in which their children have acted. But, just before the ad gets telecasted, the power goes off at Gokuldham society. How will the society members watch the ad now?

episodesList.title: Tappu Sena Is Famous
episodesList.summary: After Tapu Sena acts in an advertisement, people start recognizing them and take autographs. Gogi feels bad for not being a part of this and threatens to run away if he doesn't become famous.

episodesList.title: Tappu Has A Plan To Make Gogi Feel Special
episodesList.summary: Gogi forces Tapu to make him famous. Tapu soon comes up with a mysterious, secret plan to make Gogi appear on TV. But, clearly warns Tapu Sena to not tell this to anyone. Will Gogi become famous?

episodesList.title: Gogi Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena comes up with a plan to hide Gogi and spreads fake news that he's missing. How will this plan work? Will Tapu Sena get into trouble?

episodesList.title: Mr. And Mrs. Sodhi Are Worried
episodesList.summary: Now that Tapu Sena has established that Gogi is missing, the parents are freaking out. They look for Gogi in and around the society but, fail to find him. Where will they find Gogi?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Society Visit The Police Station
episodesList.summary: The members of Gokuldham Society decide to report a complaint to the police. Meanwhile, the Tapu Sena is waiting for Gogi's missing case to telecast on TV.

episodesList.title: Tappu Sena In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Seeing Gogi missing from the flat where Tappu Sena had hidden him in, they are petrified. Muddled, they go to Champaklal for help. Will Gogi be found?

episodesList.title: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah – The Police Create A Fuss
episodesList.summary: When the police learn that Gogi has been found within the society, they are furious. They later explain that it was their duty to inform the police about Gogi being found. Gogi is extremely happy as he gets selected to act in an advertisement.

episodesList.title: Taarak Is Sick Of Diet Food
episodesList.summary: Anjali again presents a plate of freshly cut salad in front of Taarak. She refuses when he asks her to add something to it for it to not taste bland. She later asks Taarak to join a gym, but he denies. Will Anjali make Taarak join the gym?

episodesList.title: Stubborn Champaklal
episodesList.summary: While Jethalal and Bhide argue with each other, Champaklal carries the LPG cylinder himself and leaves for his house. Seeing this, Jethalal runs behind him and takes the cylinder from him.

episodesList.title: Babita Decides To Join A Club
episodesList.summary: Jethalal finds that a rat has nibbled onto his shoes. Left without any option, he has to go out wearing Daya's footwear. Later, Babita gets an offer to become a swimming instructor at a club. Will she take the offer?

episodesList.title: Babita Influences The Ladies To Take Swimming Classes
episodesList.summary: Babita decides to be a swimming coach at the club. She calls the ladies to join the club and learn swimming from her. Will the ladies join the swimming class?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Also Wants To Learn Swimming
episodesList.summary: After learning that the ladies are planning to take swimming classes, Jethalal is eager to learn swimming from Babita. He seeks help from Taarak. Will Taarak help his friend out?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Asks Babita To Teach Him Swimming
episodesList.summary: Jethalal, eager to learn swimming, visits Babita's house and asks her if he can learn swimming. But is there a twist? Will Jethalal be disappointed?

episodesList.title: Ladies Have Fun At The Swimming Club
episodesList.summary: All the women from Gokuldham society gather at the Silver Club to learn swimming. Meanwhile, Jetha decides to learn swimming from Babita at any cost.

episodesList.title: Men Want To Swim Too

Meanwhile, Bhide is having a bad day. Find out why Bhide is upset in this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah.

episodesList.title: Komals Complaint Against Goli
episodesList.summary: Komal is worried about Goli. She takes him to Mehta's house so that he give Goli some knowledge about life and tell him about the importance of education. How will Mehta help?

episodesList.title: Tappu And Sonu's Result Day
episodesList.summary: The principal tells Champaklal that Tappu has failed and how he plays pranks on his teachers. Has Tappu really failed?

episodesList.title: Black Money
episodesList.summary: One of Jethalal's friends hands him 50 lakh rupees in cash in a steel box. Jethalal asks Daya to keep the box safe in her cupboard. Later, all the kids play Holi with atta. Will Daya be able to keep the box safe?

episodesList.title: Mehta Talks About Black Money
episodesList.summary: Mehta takes a day off from work to write an article on corruption. Meanwhile, Jethalal calls Mehta and tells him about the black money in his house. How will Mehta react?

episodesList.title: Mehta Needs A Lift
episodesList.summary: Mehta, with the box full of cash, asks Sodhi for a lift till Jethalal's shop. Due to some problems in his jeep, he asks Mehta to push the jeep for it to start. Now, what will happen?

episodesList.title: Where Is The Money?
episodesList.summary: When Mehta reaches Gada Electronics, Jethalal and his friend eagerly await to open the box with the money. As soon as they open the box, they find lentils instead of the cash. Where did the money go?

episodesList.title: Bhide Is The New Suspect
episodesList.summary: Daya, Jethalal, and his friend go to Bhide's house to get the box only to find out that Bhide has given all the boxes to Sodhi for grinding the lentils. When Madhavi and Bhide come to know that the box had so much cash, they are numb. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Bharat Threatens Jethalal
episodesList.summary: After Abdul is found missing, Bharat suspects Abdul to have stolen the money. He later threatens Jethalal to file a police complaint against him. Will Jethalal land into legal trouble?

episodesList.title: Tappu Sena Wastes Water
episodesList.summary: After playing in the garden, all the kids in Tappu Sena are dirty and covered in mud. When Bhide comes into the compound, he sees Tappu Sena play with water and shower with it.

episodesList.title: Water Conservation
episodesList.summary: Bhide informs all the women in the society that the water supply has been cut to half and that they will have to start saving water. How will everyone react to this?

episodesList.title: Water Problem Because Of Sodhi
episodesList.summary: Everyone is wondering why there's no water in Gokuldham society. Just then, Sodhi arrives and says that he doesn't remember turning the tap off. Did Sodhi cause water problems in Gokuldham society? Keep watching Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah and find out.

episodesList.title: Gadas Have Too Many Visitors
episodesList.summary: The Gadas have a few visitors early in the morning. When Jethalal gives Sundar permission to take bath, he assumes there will be only two people. But, to his surprise, Sundar brings his entire family. Jethalal is worried about creating a water issue again.

episodesList.title: The Water War
episodesList.summary: One of Daya's guests creates a scene and starts a fight with Bhide and other society members. The water issue now has crossed the line. How will the Gokuldham society find a solution to this? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Gadas Facing Trouble
episodesList.summary: Now that the Gadas have guests home, they're facing troubles with cleanliness. Jethalal finds gutkha packets in his room and a few stains on the bedsheets. How will Jethalal deal with this problem along with the water problem? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Daya Makes Everything Fun
episodesList.summary: Now that the water tanker is arriving, everyone at Gokuldham is waiting for the water desperately. But, Daya is excited to fill water in their buckets. How will the water problem get solved? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Popatlal The Water Thief
episodesList.summary: While Jethalal gets water for Babita, Popatlal slyly exchanges his buckets and takes the bucket with water. When Jethalal finds out, he gets into an argument with him. Will this argument turn ugly?

episodesList.title: Mehta Plans To Write An Article On Children
episodesList.summary: Mehta plans to write an article on children and their parent's tension after vacation. How going back to school after vacations can be tough and difficult to adjust with.

episodesList.title: It's GPL Time
episodesList.summary: It is time for Gokuldham Premier League. But, Bhide announces that there will be no GPL as the society has low funds. How will Tappu Sena react? How will Sundar's call help these kids in arranging GPL?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Against Gokuldam Premier League
episodesList.summary: Jethala is worried about Sundar taking initiatives to conduct the Gokuldam Premier League 2. But on the other hand, Nattu kaka is so excited about the match that he plans to advertise their company without informing Jethala. Hence there arises the problem in getting donations for conducting the GPL. What will Jetha do now?

episodesList.title: Pre Plans For GPL 2
episodesList.summary: Sundar calls in for two chief guests who will be playing as the captains for the two teams playing in the Gokulam Premier league. Jethalal and Daya are opposing each other for their teams. Who will win?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Teams Rigorous Training
episodesList.summary: Babita and Daya's teams get ready for the GPL 2. They start practicing for the match. While Babita's team finds a military coach who puts them in rigorous training, the other team goes casual.

episodesList.title: Long Awaited Moment Arrives
episodesList.summary: The Gokuldham Premier League begins, the ground is set ready and teams are ready to compete with each other. As this is going to go live on the shows, everyone is excited. On another hand, the rigorous training makes Babita's team tired. Will Babita's team lose?

episodesList.title: Blaster Babita Versus Daya Dandiya Devil
episodesList.summary: The match begins with the coin toss, Daya's team wins the toss; She chose Feilding. Hence, Mehta enters the field as the opening batsman, but eventually, he fails and Jethala enters the field. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Fun Packed GPL Match
episodesList.summary: The Gokuldam Premier League 2 is full of team spirit. Babita and Daya's teams are putting up their best to win the match, they enjoy while they play and make mistakes.

episodesList.title: Babita Does The Batting
episodesList.summary: Babita finally enters the field to do the batting. Daya's team is playing far better. Then when it is Jethalal's time to do the bating, it is Daya who is bowling for him. Will Jethalal lose?

episodesList.title: Roles Reverse In The Match
episodesList.summary: Now Daya's team is doing the bating and Babita's team is Feilding. As the roles are reversed, the match gets a little more interesting and it gets a lot funnier when Popatlal started bating.

episodesList.title: Parthiv Patel Reviews The GPL Match
episodesList.summary: A little break in GPL 2 match, where they conduct a Dandiya dance performance. Later, there's a nail-biting experience in the match where Daya's team has to move forward to get wickets to win the match. An international cricketer, Parthiv reviews the GPL match and he is taken aback.

episodesList.title: Captain Daya Enters The Feild For Bating
episodesList.summary: The GPL 2 match has entered the last phase, where Daya enters the field to do the bating but ends up getting mocked for her wig. The last ball decides the fate of the GPL 2 match. Which team will win the match?

episodesList.title: The Last Ball
episodesList.summary: The GPL 2 match has come to an end. The last ball is thrown! Did Daya score her wicket to win the match? This is the phase where there will be a lot of rewinds to give acute attention to the details of the last ball.

episodesList.title: Daya Dandiya Devil Team Wins The GPL 2 Match
episodesList.summary: The GPL 2 match concluded with Daya's team winning the match and Sodhi winning the title, Man of the Match. Both the teams conclude the match with a mutual understanding and all the issues that arose during the match are resolved peacefully.

episodesList.title: Silence After The Storm
episodesList.summary: Silence prevails after all the loud cheers for the Gokuldam Premier League 2 match. Everyone goes back to their normal lives, with the memories to savor from the match. But Bhide being the secretary, is aware of his responsibilities and looks over donations spent on the match. Will he find anything shocking?

episodesList.title: Tapu Learns A Life Lesson
episodesList.summary: Jethalal's mobile is stuck in the sofa. When his dad tries to take it, his hand gets stuck in the sofa. So they have to call Sodhi for help. Jethalal gets his mobile back, but the sofa needs to be repaired. On the other hand, Tapu who takes things for granted learns a life lesson from the boy who can't afford any luxuries due to poverty. Watch this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Champaklal Loses His Money Bag
episodesList.summary: Champaklal decides to help the boy who struggles to pay his school fees. So Tapu and his friends decide to help him along with his grandfather. But on the way to the school, Champaklal loses his money bag in the taxi. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Man Of The Match
episodesList.summary: Sodhi goes to Rita, the reporter, to get a copy of the GPL 2 match telecast in a CD. He is very excited to watch him and the others play. He is on cloud nine when he hears the other cricketer's comments about him when he wins the man of the match. He tries his best to get connected with them but ends in vain.

episodesList.title: Sodhi Leaves Without Informing
episodesList.summary: Sodhi has a dream about GPL 2 match and is so into meeting the actual cricketer that the next morning, Sodhi shows his gratitude to Daya for being his captain and leaves to meet the cricketer without informing his wife and son. They were worried without knowing his whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Sodhi's Dream Come True
episodesList.summary: Sodhi gets an opportunity to meet the cricket team. What will be the level of his excitement?

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Childhood Photos
episodesList.summary: Anjali appreciates Tappu and his friends for helping that student to pay his school tuition fees. Champaklal is busy fixing his old suitcase, where Tappu discovers few old photos of Jethalal. What will Tappu do with these photographs? Find out in this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Helps Babita
episodesList.summary: Babita seeks Jethalal's help to get her mobile phone fixed. But Jethalal gets a headache, where Daya helps him by giving him a massage. But that doesn't seem to work with the headache. Instead, he ends up having spiky hair. What will Jetha's reaction be to this?

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Weird Hairstyle
episodesList.summary: Jethalal's hair is in very bad shape after he applies the shampoo which Sunder has sent.  In the meantime, Iyer and Babita visit Jethalal, and Iyer wants to try the shampoo which Jethalal has used. Iyer is not aware of his upcoming trouble. Will Iyer find out before using the shampoo? Watch this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Will Jetha Go Bald?
episodesList.summary: Taarak gives Jetha two options and tells him that he can either stay with that hairstyle or go bald. He says that he had talked to some hairstylists and they are firm on the options. Jetha almost starts to cry after thinking of how he will look if he goes bald. Will Jetha really go bald?

episodesList.title: Daya's Trick
episodesList.summary: Sodhi comes to Jetha's house running. He sees that Jetha's hand on his chest and assumes that he's had a heart attack. After Bhide and Mehta join Sodhi, Daya tells her trick to everyone. What is Daya's trick? Watch this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Nattu Kaka's Love For Jetha
episodesList.summary: Nattu Kaka reminds Jetha of the time and tells him that he should go home. Meanwhile, Daya is worried and is patiently waiting for Jetha to return home. Nattu Kaka tells Jetha that it is raining outside and that he if he does not have an umbrella, he can borrow it from Nattu Kaka.

episodesList.title: Champakal Sees A Ghost
episodesList.summary: It is heavily raining outside as Champaklal is standing on the terrace of his house when he sees a ghost. He comes inside, scared for his life, and wakes everyone up. Did Champaklal really see a ghost? Watch this episode and find out.

episodesList.title: Daya's Plan
episodesList.summary: Madhavi tells Bhide about the ghost in the society. But he laughs it off. Daya asks Jethalal to get some items to get rid of the ghost, but she doesn't tell him the real reason. While Daya goes to execute the plan of getting rid of the ghost, Bhide sees her performing the task. Will Bhide believe Madhavi now?

episodesList.title: Bhide Is Scared
episodesList.summary: Madhavi finds Bhide lying in the Balcony. Bhide gets so scared that he gets a fever. Upon knowing this, the whole society gathers at Bhide's house and are shocked when they hear the story. Will everyone believe it? What will they do about it?

episodesList.title: Men To Guard The Society
episodesList.summary: All the ladies of the Gokuldham Society are scared of the ghost. But the men refuse to believe it. The men decide to guard society at night to prove that there is no ghost. Daya, according to her mother's advice, plans to send Jethalal to perform the task to get rid of the ghost.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Meets A Strange Person
episodesList.summary: Worried Daya, calls up Jethalal to ask whether he has left for home as it has become very dark. On his way back home, Jethalal encounters a strange man and he gets scared. Jethalal makes excuses as he doesn't want to guard the Gokuldham society at night.

episodesList.title: Iyer And Popatlal Encounter With The Ghost
episodesList.summary: Sodhi, Popatlal, and Iyer guard the society at night. But after some time, Sodhi goes to his home. After hearing Popatlal scream, the society members go down to find Popatlal and Iyer. Popatlal and Iyer tell the society members about their encounter with the ghost. What did they see? Watch this episode only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Black Magic For The Ghost
episodesList.summary: Everyone is scared at night to sleep in their houses. Sundar gives Daya the idea of calling a person who does black magic to get rid of the ghost. Will everyone support this idea of Sundar's? Only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Member's See The Ghost
episodesList.summary: Two men arrive at Gokuldham Society to get rid of the ghost. Suddenly, the ghost appears in front of the society members and scare everybody. The society members run into the clubhouse for protection. The parents start worrying as Tapusena is missing from the clubhouse. Where is Tapusena?

episodesList.title: Another Ghost In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena, along with Rita reporter, tells the society members about what they have discovered related to the ghost and make a plan. But, the twist in the story comes when the ghost meets another ghost in the society. How many ghosts are there in Gokuldham society? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Ghost Story Is Revealed
episodesList.summary: According to the plan, Daya dresses up as a ghost and tries to scare the lady ghost. But it turns out that the ghost is a lady who is trying to do something illegal in the society with her set of friends. Will society members be furious now? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Tapu Tells A Story
episodesList.summary: Tapu reveals to the society members as to how he found the truth behind the ghost story. He also tells that he took the help of Rita reporter, and together they made a plan. What was their plan?

episodesList.title: Parcel For Mehta
episodesList.summary: Mehta receives a parcel in which he gets a pen with I Love You written on the box. Jethalal and Anjali are suspicious of Mehta. Meanwhile, Anjali receives a call from a girl asking about Mehta. Why is Mehta being so fishy? Watch this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah to find out.

episodesList.title: Love Letter For Taarak
episodesList.summary: Anjali shares her doubt with her society friends who advise her to clear the matter soon. Daya suggests Popatlal and Rita get married to each other and they both start fighting. Anjali receives a flower bouquet, with which a love letter is written for Mehta.

episodesList.title: Anjali's Sister Koyal
episodesList.summary: Taarak receives a love message from an unknown number and Anjali gets upset with him. When the situation begins to worsen, Anjali's sister Koyal comes into the picture and tells that the prank was played by her. Meanwhile, Popatlal has fallen for Koyal. Will Koyal accept Popatlal? and what will be Anjali's reaction? Watch this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah to find out.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Dreams About Koyal
episodesList.summary: Popatlal tries impressing Koyal in every way possible and keeps dreaming about her. In his excitement, he even calls Bhide in the middle of the night to ask about his personality. Popatlal waits to see Koyal and talk to her the next day. Will he tell Koyal how he feels?

episodesList.title: Lunch At The Gada House
episodesList.summary: Daya invites the Mehta family for lunch at her place, and after sometime Popatlal lands at Mehta's house. Koyal plays many pranks on Popatlal to which he sweetly reacts. Upon knowing about the lunch program, Popatlal goes to Jethalal's house to meet Koyal.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Proposes Koyal
episodesList.summary: Mehta and Jethalal warn Popatlal to stay away from Koyal and forget her. Indirectly, they ask Koyal her opinion. Popatlal gets excited when her expectations match with his personality. Popatlal proposes Koyal. Will she say yes? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Throws A Party
episodesList.summary: After Mehta, Anjali and Koyal go to collect Koyal's visa. Popatlal announces to the society members about the function. The society members keep guessing the reason for the party. Mehta and Anjali get furious with Koyal for doing timepass with Popatlal. Is Koyal going to break Popatlal's heart?

episodesList.title: Chaos All Around
episodesList.summary: Popatlal comes to the hall and everyone starts asking him questions. He asks everyone to gather around so that he can tell everyone together, but people are unable to fit in that space, and chaos is created all around. How will everyone react when they find out what Popatlal wanted to tell them? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Takes The Poison
episodesList.summary: Everyone tries to stop Popatlal, but he does not listen and intakes the poison. Suddenly, the poison starts reacting and Popatlal falls on the ground. What will happen next? How will the people of Gokuldham Society help him?

episodesList.title: Goons In The Gokuldham Society
episodesList.summary: Some strange people come inside the Gokuldham society and demands money for the festivals. Daya, Komal, and Babita are buying vegetables and encounters them on the way. They start asking each and everyone a large sum of money as donations. How will Gokuldham society deal with these goons? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: A Surprise Treat For Abdul
episodesList.summary: Abdul is keeping a fast and eats his food alone in the evening. But this time he is surprised as everyone gets him delicious snacks and offers to open his fast with them. Abdul is deeply touched by the efforts made by everyone. Watch this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Competition In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: The society members gather to celebrate Krishna Jayanti and are excited about the competition. The ladies and gents of the society give equal competition to each other. Who will perform better?

episodesList.title: Daya Is In Danger
episodesList.summary: There is a lot of excitement among the society members as to who will win the competition. When the ladies start performing, Daya lands up in a dangerous situation. Will the competition stop for the sake of Daya? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Daya falls and gets injured during the task and she is rushed to the hospital. Daya's family and the society members pray for her speedy recovery. Watch this episode of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Daya Responds
episodesList.summary: The doctors try their best, but Daya is still unconscious. Tappusena prepares food for the society members who are in the hospital. Jethalal tries his best to bring Daya back into her consciousness. Will Daya recover?

episodesList.title: Daya Gains Consciousness
episodesList.summary: Jetha tries waking up Daya somehow and is worried for her life. After he chants God's name, Daya starts gaining consciousness. What does this mean? Daya is recovering? Keep watching Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah and find out.

episodesList.title: Champaklal Is Thankful To Daya
episodesList.summary: Sundar comes to see his sister. He decides to stay back until she is totally fit. Champaklal then says that he is thankful to Daya for being a strong woman and for taking care of the family.

episodesList.title: Jetha's Injury
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is sweeping and mopping in his house when he slips on the water. When he falls, Daya starts screaming. Babita, who happens to be there, comes and helps Jetha. What will be Jetha's reaction?

episodesList.title: Helpful Neighbours
episodesList.summary: All the ladies of Gokuldham society go to Daya's house to give her food as she won't able to cook. However, Daya refuses to take their food and tells everyone that Jethalal has prepared their lunch for the day. Introspecting, Jetha says everyone should be lucky enough to have neighbors like theirs.

episodesList.title: Ganpati Celebrations
episodesList.summary: All the members of the Gokuldham society have gathered to celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi. Jetha notices that Daya's hand is fine and she is able to move it again. This makes everyone in Gokuldham happy.

episodesList.title: The Inspiration
episodesList.summary: Jetha is visibly irritated as he cannot seem to find the perfect way to start his article. As Tappu Sena barges into heir house, Jetha tells them that they are the inspiration for his article about saving nature. Keep watching Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah and see what happens next.

episodesList.title: The Punishment
episodesList.summary: Tappu Sena gathers everyone around the society. He says that all of them have to go through punishment for not taking care of nature. As they see farming materials, they ask if the punishment is arduous. What will be the punishment? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Singing Competition
episodesList.summary: With the Ganpati celebrations going on, in one competition, Tappu calls Mehta to come and tell everyone about the rules of the competition. Keep watching Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah and see what happens next.

episodesList.title: Bhide Wins
episodesList.summary: As Bhide wins the singing competition, Sodhi lifts him up in celebration. Jethalal teases Madhavi and tells her that her training was useful to Bhide. The next person to sing is Abdul. How will Abdul do?

episodesList.title: Visitors Or Trespassers?
episodesList.summary: A group of people is tiptoeing in Gokuldham society. They talk amongst themselves and tell each other to be secretive and discreet about their presence in Gokuldham society. But who exactly are they? Why are they acting so suspicious?  Keep watching Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah and find out.

episodesList.title: Singing Competition In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: The Sangeet Samrat competition has reached its final round. And Tapu Sena has called none other than Anandji Virji Shah as the judge. How will the finalists perform?

episodesList.title: Winner Is Declared
episodesList.summary: The finale for the Sangeet Samrat competition continues as now it is time for Tarak Mehta and Jethalal to perform. Who will be crowned the Sangeet Samrat of Gokuldham Society? Stay tuned because Anand Ji will be announcing the winners of the competition at the end.

episodesList.title: Rishi And Neetu Kapoor Visit Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Navratri is approaching fast and all the society members have begun preparations. Daya has taken up the task to teach all the women some new 'Garbha' steps. Meanwhile, Rishi and Neetu Kapoor have arrived in Gokuldham. Find out more by watching the episode.

episodesList.title: Daya Teaches Garba To Rishi And Neetu
episodesList.summary: Rishi and Neetu Kapoor have come to Gokuldham to learn Garbha from Daya. They also tell the society members about their newest film, Do Duni Chaar and the characters they are playing.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Irritated
episodesList.summary: Jethalal goes to meet the hotel manager in regards to the large tender for TVs but doesn't get a positive response for him. Now Jethalal's mood is sour and he starts acting rude with everyone around. What will happen now? Keep watching the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Angry Young Man
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets in a fight with Popatlal and in the process, he ends up breaking Popatlal's favourite umbrella. Tarak goes to Jethalal's house to talk him out of his anger but is unsuccessful. Meanwhile, Popatlal is extremely upset and wants to teach Jethalal a lesson. Find out more in this episode.

episodesList.title: Daya Finds Out
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is still upset and also gets into a fight with Bhide in the morning. Meanwhile, Daya finds out the reason for his upset mood by calling up Nattu kaka at the shop. What will Daya do when she finds out about the hotel tender? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Daya's Vow To Not Play Garba
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena has made grand preparations in the society compound for the Garba night. However, Daya has taken a vow to not play Garba until Jethalal gets the tender from the hotel. All society members try their best to convince her but it is all in vain. What will happen to the celebrations now that Daya will not be a part of it?

episodesList.title: John Abraham In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Jethalal has figured out a way to get the hotel order for himself.  Meanwhile, John Abraham comes to Gokuldham society but no one seems to recognize him.

episodesList.title: Champaklal's Pride
episodesList.summary: It turns out that all the society members were playing a prank on John Abraham and were just pretending to not recognize him. After the reveal, all of them proceed to play Garbha together. Stay tuned to find out everything that happened.

episodesList.title: Iyer Plans A Surprise
episodesList.summary: Babita is trying hard to remind Iyer of their anniversary but Iyer is pretending to not remember anything. Even though he has planned a surprise for her, Babita is convinced that Iyer has forgotten about it. Will Iyer manage to surprise Babita? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Babita Is Unhappy
episodesList.summary: Iyer decides to get a second-hand car from Sodhi and gift it to Babita for their anniversary. He also tells Tarak and Sodhi that no one in the society should get to know about this. What will happen now? Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: A Rant Against Husbands
episodesList.summary: All the women of Gokuldham society gather around to buy some vegetables. But when Babita comes in, their gathering turns into an occasion to rant about their husbands. Meanwhile, a customer at Jethalal's shop wants to sell off his old car and Jethalal refers him to Sodhi. Keep watching the show to find out more.

episodesList.title: Where Is The Surprise?
episodesList.summary: Iyer finalizes the deal with Mr Yogi and gets the car from him. In the morning, he finally gives a huge flower bouquet to Babita that makes her really happy. Meanwhile, all society members have found out about the surprise and are eager to know what it is.

episodesList.title: Babaita's Sports Car
episodesList.summary: The surprise is finally here and Babita is elated to see the sports car. They decide to go on a drive to the temple and seek blessings from god. However, their happiness is about to take a sharp turn at the temple. What is going to happen? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Stolen Property
episodesList.summary: Iyer and Babita reach the Police station to register a complaint against the thief. However, the police reveals that the car is actually stolen property. In connection of buying this stolen car, the police ends up putting them behind bars. Can they convince the police of their innocence? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Will The Real Thief Be Caught?
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tries to find a way out of the trouble but is unsuccessful. Daya and others are worried as none of them have returned home. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka comes to the police station and reveals information about Peter Fernandes.

episodesList.title: Time Is Ticking
episodesList.summary: The police have given a time frame to Iyer and others to catch the thief. An ultimatum has been given that if they don't catch the thief in the prescribed time, they will be put behind bars yet again. Will they be successful in this mission? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Taarak Comes Up With An Idea
episodesList.summary: Taarak comes up with an idea to catch the thief. He narrates his plan to everybody. In the morning, Popatlal employs his journalistic tactics and sets the plan in motion.

episodesList.title: Sodhi Plays Smart
episodesList.summary: Peter Fernandes reaches Sodhi's garage. He convinces Sodhi to return the car and is ready to pay him a commission. It looks like the plan is finally coming along and everyone seems happy about it. Keep watching the episodes to find out more.

episodesList.title: Plan Successful
episodesList.summary: Sodhi and others are successful in handing over Peter to the police with the help of their efficient planning. Everyone gets in a festive mood and they celebrate Iyer and Babita's anniversary together.

episodesList.title: A Morning Walk?
episodesList.summary: Daya is worried for her brother when he doesn't answer her call. Meanwhile, Champaklal scolds Jethalal for waking up late in the morning and asks him to get up early to go to the park for a walk. Will Jethalal obey his father's orders?

episodesList.title: Sundar's Scheme
episodesList.summary: Sundar comes home to meet his sister Daya. Daya arranges a feast for her brother on the occasion of 'Bhai-Dooj'. Later, Sundar gets Jethalal interested in buying a plot of land in Ahemdabad. Keep watching the episodes on sony liv to catch all the excitement!

episodesList.title: Chanda Ramani's Flat
episodesList.summary: Jethalal rejects Sundar's offer to buy land. Consequently, Bhide gets a call from Chanda Ramani that he wishes to sell his flat. Stay tuned to find out more in this episode.

episodesList.title: Sodhi Gives The Token Amount
episodesList.summary: Bhide and Sodhi go for a ride when Bhide tells him about the flat. Sodhi is ready to buy the flat and gives the token amount. Meanwhile, Daya informs his brother, Sundar about the new flat that they are buying. What will Sundar do now?

episodesList.title: All The Gifts For Bhide
episodesList.summary: Bhide finds himself in a tough situation with Sodhi and Jethalal, both giving him the token amount for the flat. He tries to convince Jethalal to back out of the deal. Meanwhile, Madhavi takes the step to convince Sodhi. Will they succeed?

episodesList.title: Who Will Get The Flat?
episodesList.summary: Chanda Ramani's flat is on sale and Sodhi, as well as Jethalal, wants to buy it. They both have paid to token money to Bhide and Madhvi. Now the problem is none of them is wanting to back off and let go of the flat. Bhide is in great confusion and distress as to who should get the flat.

episodesList.title: Jethalal And Sodhi's Irrationality
episodesList.summary: Bhide is sandwiched between Jethalal and Sodhi's demands. Their irrational behaviour has led to big trouble for Bhide. Whereas the children and women of Gokuldham seem to be more sensible than the two fighting for the flat.

episodesList.title: Bhide Is No Longer The Middleman
episodesList.summary: Finally, Chanda Ramani calls Bhide back for the updates on his apartment. Bhide explains him everything and after listening, he decides to hold an auction, whoever bids the highest, gets the apartment. Bhide conveys this news to both of them and as an addition, Iyer claims even he would bid for it. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Auction Day At Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Chanda Ramami finally arrives at Gokuldham for the auction and meets everyone after a long time. In due course, the auction begins with Jethalal bidding first. It carries on for a while. The person who bids the highest astonishes everyone. Who is this person? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Popatlal's Withdrawal
episodesList.summary: As the bidding for the flat at Gokuldham continues, Tarak realises that the highest bid is by Popatlal at 60 Lakhs. He announces Popatlal to be the winner of the Auction and asks him to pay 11 Lakhs as an advance payment. After listening to the amount, Popatlal withdraws his bid.

episodesList.title: Goli Misses His Father
episodesList.summary: All the kids have gathered around to play with the gifts they received during Diwali. However, Goli gets upset because he did not receive any gifts from his father. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Komal Worries About Goli
episodesList.summary: Komal is worried about Goli and his mission to increase weight. Unsure of what to do next, She goes to Tarak Mehta for advice. Will Tarak be able to help Komal? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Gastric Problem
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is having gastric issues where he feels bloated and is unable to walk. Daya comes to his rescue and thinks of an idea in an attempt to help him out in his misery. Meanwhile, Bhide gets a cold from all the extra soda he drank and goes to the Hathi brothers for treatment.

episodesList.title: Jethalal And Taarak's Misery
episodesList.summary: The men of the society are disappointed with what their wives have offered them for breakfast. Taarak and Jetha are the main victims who feel despondent about the fact that one brings boring food on the table and one delays the breakfast. Keep watching the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Krishnaben Khakhrawala In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: The famous Krishnaben arrives in Gokuldham with her 'khakhras'. Daya gets excited after seeing her and everyone praises her for the taste of her khakras. Later, Taarak and Anjali have a little fight over a petty issue. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Suit
episodesList.summary: Jethalal's suit does not fit him but it's not the same with Daya. Champaklal hurts his feet while climbing the stairs and screams, listening to which everybody comes to his rescue. Seeing the Gada couple in that attire, all are stunned. All of them make fun of Jethalal and compliments Daya on looking pretty. The next day, Daya mistakenly pours tea over Jethalal's important cheque, he is furious.

episodesList.title: Daya Takes A Stand
episodesList.summary: Daya unintentionally spoils the important cheque by spilling some tea on it. In his anger, Jethalal throws some mean and harsh comments towards his wife. Daya gets upset but later takes a stand to be not looked down upon. Keep watching to find out more.

episodesList.title: It's Not That Easy
episodesList.summary: Jethalal called Daya several times but she did not pick up the call. He rushes home to ask for forgiveness but Daya is not going to open the door. Now Jethalal must look for other ways to make it up to his wife and get her to forgive him.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Struggles With Jethalal
episodesList.summary: In due course of time, all of Gokuldham suspects the weird behaviour of Jethalal and finally gets to know about the whole situation. Everybody decides to help him out and get Daya to open the door. Meanwhile, Taarak gets an idea to climb up a ladder and open the balcony door. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: A Sorry Solves Everything
episodesList.summary: The last option that remains now is to break the door and get inside. Sodhi decides to do the deed. He finally breaks in with all his power. Entering the house, they find Daya asleep as she had some cough syrup. Jethalal wakes her up and apologizes to her.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena Is Confused
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena is enjoying their vacation. While playing cricket in the compound, they encounter a lot of problems with the rest of the society members. Tapu Sena goes to Taarak to ask for his advice as they are confused as to what to do.

episodesList.title: Magic Show In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena informs Bhide about the magic show organized by Taarak. The kids along with the society members are excited about the magic show. Later, the famous magician Munnalal arrives at Gokuldham for his magical performance. Keep watching the show to find out more.

episodesList.title: The Magical Munnalal
episodesList.summary: The magician Munnalal starts showing off his talent and everyone is having a great time at his show. He involves some of the society members as well in his magic tricks. It seems Tapu Sena has finally found the change they were looking for.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena Wants To Learn Magic
episodesList.summary: The Magic show in Gokuldham society continues. Everyone is participating and are captivated by all the magical tricks. Tapu Sena is deeply influenced by the magician and wants to learn magic from him. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena's New Tricks
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena goes to learn magic from Munnalal and he teaches them some special tricks. Tapu Sena then presents the magic they learnt to all the society members, everybody is fascinated after seeing it. Keep watching to find out more.

episodesList.title: Madhavi's Money
episodesList.summary: In the process of showing off their magic to everybody, Tapu Sena by mistake misplaces Madhavi's money and she becomes mad at them. Bhide makes a big scene in the society regarding the money. Everyone is busy searching for the money and Champaklal has called the police to investigate.

episodesList.title: Dr. Hathi Is Back
episodesList.summary: Jethalal accuses Taarak and makes him the reason for Tapu Sena's mistake. Tapu is scared of the police and begs his parents that he will not repeat the mistake. Meanwhile, Dr Hathi returns from the Naturo Camp but he hasn't changed a bit in all this time.

episodesList.title: Champaklal Disciplines Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is trying to romance his wife but Champaklal's presence prevents him from doing so. He also tells Jethalal to take care of his health and scolds him about his lifestyle. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Tapu Bites Bhide's Hand
episodesList.summary: Tapu ruins Bhide's balcony while playing cricket. Furious Bhide goes down to teach Tapu a lesson. Tapu bites Bhide's hand and creates a scene. Jethalal defends Tapu and argues with Bhide.

episodesList.title: The Society Fund
episodesList.summary: Bhide conducts a meeting and informs everyone about the cost of the new paint quotation and tells them that the society doesn't have enough money in the fund to support the new paint job. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Credit Card
episodesList.summary: All the ladies go shopping with Babita and after coming home, Daya is mesmerized by the concept of a credit card. Babita tries explaining to all the ladies how a credit card works. Now all of them are pursuing their husbands for a credit card.

episodesList.title: Kutkutiya
episodesList.summary: After being rejected from one bank, Daya and the other housewives decide to get credit cards from Mr Kutkutiya. All of them are just too excited to finally get their credit cards.

episodesList.title: The Bill
episodesList.summary: After the women get their credit cards, they go shopping. Everyone shops to their heart's content. However, things take a sour turn when they receive the bill.

episodesList.title: The Bad People
episodesList.summary: After the women refuse to pay the money, Kutkutiya threatens to send people to hurt their husbands and their kids. As soon as they enter the society compound and see their kids playing, they all get worried and take them all home. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Right On Time
episodesList.summary: Kutkutiya comes to Gokuldham along with his men and takes the children as hostages. However, the police arrives on time and arrests the bad guys. All society members finally take a huge sigh of relief.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Gets A New Helper
episodesList.summary: Nattu Kaka has gone out of town and has left his nephew, Bagha to help out Jethalal at the shop. Jethalal later sends Bagha to collect payment from Lachhuram.

episodesList.title: Lachhuram's Helplessness
episodesList.summary: Lachhuram visits Jethalal's office and gives him buckets of paint, worth 2 lakh rupees. When enquired, Lacchuram tells him that he is helpless and has no other option to pay his debts. What is Jethalal going to do with all this paint? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Convinces Everyone
episodesList.summary: Jethalal wants to sell off all the paint buckets that he is stuck with. He tries talking to Bhide about it but he has already left the house. He decides to convince every society member he can see, to get the society buildings painted. Find out more by watching the episode.

episodesList.title: The Confusion Of Identity
episodesList.summary: Vishwajeet arrives at Gada Electronics but he only wants to buy 200 ml of paint. Jethalal gets furious and makes him leave the shop. Later, Jethalal goes to Taarak for advice regarding this paint problem.

episodesList.title: No New Year Party At Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena decides to ask Bhide regarding the New Year celebrations at Gokuldham society. However, Bhide says that the society has no funds left for a party as all of it is going to the painting job that is to be done. Meanwhile, Jethalal finds about his friend's vacant apartment, and he secretly plans a party with all the men of Gokuldham.

episodesList.title: Men's Secret Party
episodesList.summary: Jethalal has gotten his hands on some passes for a New Year party. He tells Tarak to arrive at the party location with all the other men, without letting their wives know about it. Can all the men keep this secret from their wives? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Champaklal Punishes The Men
episodesList.summary: Everyone catches the men red-handed when they are about to start their party. Champaklal reveals that he planned all this by getting in contact with Jethalal's cousin, in order to teach all the men a lesson.

episodesList.title: Colour Contractor
episodesList.summary: Bhide talks to Sakharam for the contract of painting the society and finalizes with him. Meanwhile, Daya and Jethalal are relieved that their paint problem has finally been solved.

episodesList.title: Painting The Society
episodesList.summary: The paint job has started in Gokuldham society. Meanwhile, the society has run out of funds and now Bhide asks Jethalal to provide financial aid, as he promised. Jethalal reveals that he is going to provide the society with paint, which rubs Sakharam the wrong way. What will Sakharam do now?

episodesList.title: Sakharam Cancels The Contract
episodesList.summary: After being denied the colour contract, Sakharam has decided to spoil the whole paint job. He is making excuses and delaying the work as much as he can. The society members are getting frustrated with the delays and decide to confront him.

episodesList.title: Champaklal Steps In
episodesList.summary: Sakharam has left his contract and Gokuldham society is finding it difficult to get a new contractor to finish the job. Everyone blames Jethalal for the mess they are in. However, Champaklal has an idea.

episodesList.title: Strength In Unity
episodesList.summary: After everyone banded together to paint the society, they were all extremely impressed by the end result. Even Sakharam saw the fault in his ways and apologized. Now all the society members have planned an event as a tribute to Jethalal and his efforts.

episodesList.title: Nattu Kaka Is Back
episodesList.summary: To commemorate the new paint job done in the society, everyone has decided to conduct a 'Satyanarayan Pooja'. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka returns after his leave from town.

episodesList.title: The Satyanarayan Pooja
episodesList.summary: The Satyanarayana Pooja was a huge success and now, everyone is eagerly waiting for the evening party. However, Champaklal has kept it a secret. Popatlal and Abdul manage to overhear him on a phone call and they have figured out what will happen in the party.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham's Musical Night
episodesList.summary: Instead of the usual dance party, Champaklal has decided that this time the celebrations would include 'Bhajans' to show their gratitude towards god. Everyone is apprehensive at first, but soon they realize that Champaklal made a thoughtful choice.

episodesList.title: Makar Sankranti
episodesList.summary: Iyer and Babita are getting ready for Pongal. Babita is dressed up in her South Indian outfit. Iyer and Jethalal can't take their eyes off her. Meanwhile, all the society members are having a great time, celebrating the festival of kites on the terrace.

episodesList.title: Papu Bhai Don
episodesList.summary: Everyone at Gokuldham is having a great time flying their kites in the sky. But the fun is about to come to a halt, as Papu Bhai Don has come there with a warning for all society members. What is this warning? Keep watching the show to find out.

episodesList.title: Kite Event Gone Wrong
episodesList.summary: Someone from Gokuldham severed the kite of Papu Bhai Don's son. They crash the event in search of the culprit but everybody hides to avoid Papu Bhai's wrath. What will happen now? Watch the show to find out.

episodesList.title: Finding A Bride For Popatlal
episodesList.summary: Popatlal is worried that he is single and not able to find a suitable bride. He goes to Taarak Mehta's house to tell him his woes. Taarak and Anjali console and reassure him that he'll soon find someone special. Keep watching the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Bagha Returns To Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Bagha returns to Jethalal's shop and tells him that he has lost his job. Nattu Kaka suggests that Bagha works at Jethalal's electronic shop. But Jethalal refuses and tells him that he is not required.

episodesList.title: Bagha's Onion Scheme
episodesList.summary: Bagha tries to sell onions on the road for a higher price but that doesn't work out for him. He is back at Gada Electronics, asking Jethalal for advice on his business but Jethalal shoots down his idea. What will Bagha do now?

episodesList.title: Bagha's Job Request
episodesList.summary: Out of compassion, Chamapklal and Daya request Jethalal to keep Bagha as a helper at his shop. Meanwhile, all the ladies of Gokuldham are getting ready to celebrate Republic day, but with a twist. Will Jethalal agree to this request? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Tapu Gets A Medal
episodesList.summary: Tapu finds a medal at school and hands it over to Daya. She gets overjoyed and informs Jethalal about their son's achievement. Jethala decides to celebrate this with sweets. However, things aren't what they seem to be.

episodesList.title: Returning The Medal
episodesList.summary: Jethalal, Bhide, Sodhi and Taarak decide to return the medal to its rightful owner. When they reach the house, they find out that the job won't be as easy as it seems. Find out more by watching this episode.

episodesList.title: Why Not Hindustan?
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of Republic Day, Gokuldham residents have organized a special show for the Colonel. The aim is to reignite his faith in the Indian people. However, the Colonel gets angry as soon as he arrives. What could be the cause of his anger? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Hindustani Society
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham Society performs its various cultural dances for the colonel. At first, the colonel is not impressed but in the end, he is moved to tears. Gokuldham proved itself to the colonel. Watch the episode to find out how.

episodesList.title: Champak Sena
episodesList.summary: Champaklal shares all of Jethalal's childhood memories and embarrasses Jethalal in front of Tapu. Meanwhile, Champaklal's friends visit their house and reveal his childhood memories. Tapu skips school to hang out with all of them.

episodesList.title: Tapu Misses Champaklal
episodesList.summary: Tapu is at home watching TV while Champaklal is out camping with his friends. Tapu and Jethalal, both are missing Champaklal very much. Tapu suggests they go visit Champaklal at the camp.

episodesList.title: Taarak Is Stressed
episodesList.summary: Taarak is stressed because of work so Anjali makes him his favourite tea. Meanwhile, Bagha comes up with another scheme for Jethalal's electronics shop. Taarak is trying to finish his article but people keep calling and disturbing him.

episodesList.title: Tapu's Great Decision
episodesList.summary: Tapu has decided to shave off his head and go bald. Daya is tensed and calls Jethalal home. He enters the society in a hurry which has everyone else wondering about what has happened. Will Tapu actually shave off his head? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: A Bald Situation
episodesList.summary: Tapu's decision affects all the kids in the society. Now all of them want to go bald as well. Their parents try to make their kids understand but the situation gets out of hand when the barber comes to cut Tapu's hair.

episodesList.title: A Bold Step
episodesList.summary: Tapu gets bald despite everyone in the society requesting him to not do so. He proudly flaunts his bald head and refuses to give any reason for taking the step. As per Anjali's plan, Anjali, Tarak, Jethalal and Daya follow Tapu the next day to school to find out why he went for such a drastic change.

episodesList.title: Tapu's Friend
episodesList.summary: Jethalal, Daya, Anjali and Taarak find out that Tapu got bald to support his friend who has leukemia which makes them feel extremely proud of him. Later, all the men of Gokuldham society decide to party at Popatlal's house in the evening.

episodesList.title: The Values Of Life And Friendship
episodesList.summary: The party gets cancelled as Champaklal suddenly returns from his pilgrimage which makes the men a bit sad. However, the men of Gokuldham society realize how much they value each other as friends. On the other hand, Champaklal is proud of Tapu's decision to go bald and imparts another valuable life lesson to his family.

episodesList.title: Tapu's Prank
episodesList.summary: Bhide, impressed by Tapu, decides to give him a gift but in return, gets pranked by him. Bhide informs everybody at the society to get ready for the upcoming census as two officers are scheduled to visit the society on the next day.

episodesList.title: The Census Operation
episodesList.summary: Bhide takes his former teachers, Mr Deshpande and Mr Pandey across the society for the Census Operation. Although the residents cooperate with the gentlemen, they force Mr Deshpande and Mr Pandey to have breakfast in all the houses which becomes quite painful for them.

episodesList.title: The Ugly Fight
episodesList.summary: Popatlal is worried about the huge bill payments. Soon Jethalal and Mr Iyer get into an ugly fight. Everyone in the society asks them to break it off or else, they won't be in talking terms with both of them. Later, Madhavi informs Daya about the fight.

episodesList.title: The Story Of Umbrella
episodesList.summary: Popatlal decides to switch his sim card and goes to meet Jethalal. Meanwhile, Jethalal asks him the reason for him carrying an umbrella in winters and he starts narrating why. Later Popatlal goes on to have south Indian breakfast where he reads his horoscope for the day and finds out that he would be meeting his ideal partner.

episodesList.title: The Misunderstanding And Missed Call Alerts
episodesList.summary: As Vaijayanti had instructed Popatlal to give her a missed call on a given number, later, it turns out Babita owns that number. He kept on giving missed calls thinking Babita to be Vaijayanti. Meanwhile, Babita and Mr Iyer decide to file FIR against the unknown number.

episodesList.title: A Ceremony For World Cup
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Gokuldham discusses on World cup that would start the next day. Tapu comes up with the idea of keeping a "Hawan" so that India wins the World cup this time. Everyone wears masks of the cricketers and come for the Hawan.

episodesList.title: Mr. Iyer In Doubt
episodesList.summary: Babita is still worried about the missed calls. Mr Iyer doubts Jethalal which is why he visits his house to get some proof only to find out that Jethalal was not the one doing it. Later, Mr Iyer gets to know he uses two mobile phones.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Has No Bad Intentions
episodesList.summary: Mr Iyer still doubts Jethalal's intentions. He follows Jethalal till his shop and is looking for a chance to know if he is the one who disturbs Babita throughout the night. Meanwhile, Taarak informs Jethalal about Iyer's speculation. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: The Missed Call
episodesList.summary: All the ladies of Gokuldham call on the unknown number and asks to meet. Here, Popatlal is all set to meet Vaijayanti. The whole society, Gokuldham, goes together to find out, just who that missed call guy is.

episodesList.title: Great Confusion
