episodesList.summary: Bhide celebrates when Jethalal brings the maintenance cheque on time. However, a silly mistake by Jethalal quickly spoils the celebration.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Ki Shaan
episodesList.summary: Bhide finds out that Tapu is about to return to Gokuldham. Meanwhile, Jethalal scolds Nattu Kaka about spoiling his maintenance cheque.

episodesList.title: Doctor Hathi Ki Dawa
episodesList.summary: Jethalal brings Bapuji to Dr Hathi's clinic to treat his stomach ache. Meanwhile, Gokuldham society members are worried about the moss build-up in the society compound.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Mein Bhookamp
episodesList.summary: Dr Hathi slips and falls in the society compound because of the moss build-up. Will the society members be able to lift him up?

episodesList.title: Sodhi Ka Idea
episodesList.summary: Sodhi comes up with a unique solution to lift Dr Hathi up from the ground. Will his plan work?

episodesList.title: Contractor Kaha Milega?
episodesList.summary: The members of Gokuldham society decide to repaint the colony but Bhide struggles to find a contractor who is ready to do the job before Diwali. Can a solution be found?

episodesList.title: Contractor Ki Khoj
episodesList.summary: The members of Gokuldham society interview multiple contractors and ask for their budget for repainting their colony. Will a suitable contractor be found on time?

episodesList.title: Patakho Ki Testing
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena helps Abdul test the new firecrackers at his shop. Meanwhile, the committee members gather at the clubhouse to finalize a contractor.

episodesList.title: Contractors Ki Meeting
episodesList.summary: Society members sit down for a meeting to select the best contractor out of the top four. Will they be able to make a sound decision?

episodesList.title: Contractors Ki Ladai
episodesList.summary: After interviewing all the contractors, the society members decide to shortlist one. Who will be the one to get the job?

episodesList.title: Painting Ka Kaam Shuru
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents decide to give the contract for painting the society to Raju Chamke. Will things go according to plan?

episodesList.title: Bhide Ka Sabse Bada Darr
episodesList.summary: The painting job in Gokuldham begins in full zest. However, Bhide is anxious about things going wrong. Will all of his worries come true?

episodesList.title: Diwali Ki Excitement
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents are excited to celebrate Diwali in the newly painted society. But will the contractor be able to complete the work on time?

episodesList.title: Bad News For Bhide
episodesList.summary: The contractor gives Bhide the bad news and tells him that the painting job won't get finished on time. What will Bhide do now?

episodesList.title: Saving Diwali
episodesList.summary: Bhide is ready to face everyone's anger when the painting job gets delayed. However, he gets a surprise once he steps out of his house.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Ki Diwali
episodesList.summary: After the painting job gets completed, all Gokuldham residents celebrate Diwali together. The next day, Huma Qureshi and Sonakshi Sinha arrive at Gokuldham to meet Dr Hathi.

episodesList.title: Bapuji Ki Treat
episodesList.summary: Bapuji treats Tapu Sena with pizzas to reward them for saving the Diwali celebrations. Meanwhile, Bhide decides to penalize Jethalal if he doesn't pay the maintenance cheque on time.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ki Penalty
episodesList.summary: Jethalal lies to Bapuji about giving the maintenance cheque. However, Bhide arrives at Jethalal's house and his lie comes out in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ke Cheques
episodesList.summary: Bagha and Nattu Kaka request Jethalal to sign some cheques. Later, Babita shows up at Jethalal's shop with some of her friends.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ka Sabak
episodesList.summary: Jethalal apologises to Bhide for not submitting the maintenance cheque on time. However, Bhide is adamant that if Jethalal doesn't pay the penalty, he will resign from the secretary post.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ki Tarkeeb
episodesList.summary: Bhide agrees to accompany Jethalal and Taarak to the medical store. But he is unaware that it was all a trick to give him the maintenance cheque. What will Bhide do when he finds out the truth?

episodesList.title: Cheque Ka Hungama
episodesList.summary: Madhavi tells Bhide that she accidentally washed the kurta that the cheque was in. What will happen when Jethalal finds out about this?

episodesList.title: Guru Nanak Jayanti Ki Badhaiya
episodesList.summary: Sodhi and his family celebrate Guru Nanak Jayanti with all Gokuldham residents. Meanwhile, Goli is scared as he spills chutney on Sakharam. What will Bhide do when he finds out?

episodesList.title: Guru Nanak Ji Ki Anmol Seekh
episodesList.summary: Sodhi and his family continue to celebrate Guru Nanak Jayanti and spread happiness among Gokuldham residents.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena's Dinner Plan
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena decides to take Bapuji out for dinner. Will their dinner plan be successful?

episodesList.title: Dinner With Bapuji
episodesList.summary: Bapuji wants to go out for dinner with Tapu Sena, but Jethalal is worried about this plan. How will things pan out?

episodesList.title: Restaurant Pahuchne Mein Deri
episodesList.summary: Problems keep piling up one after another, which causes a delay in the dinner plans. Can Tapu Sena and the others reach the restaurant in time?

episodesList.title: International Client
episodesList.summary: Jethalal scolds Bagha when a customer complains about him. Later, an important client from abroad contacts Jethalal about a big contract.

episodesList.title: Taarak's Important Task
episodesList.summary: Jethalal decides to bring Taarak along with him for the meeting with the international client. However, Taarak refuses as he gets assigned an important task by his boss. What will Jethalal do now?

episodesList.title: Office Se Chutti
episodesList.summary: Taarak decides to make an excuse to dodge office work and attend the meeting with Jethalal. Will this plan work?

episodesList.title: Taarak's Lie
episodesList.summary: Taarak decides to lie to his boss and help Jethalal instead of going to the office. Will Jethalal get into trouble because of this?

episodesList.title: International Client's Arrival
episodesList.summary: Taarak arrives at Jethalal's shop, and all of them await the international client's arrival. Will the business deal go as planned?

episodesList.title: Taarak In A Mess
episodesList.summary: Things get complicated for Taarak as his boss reaches Gada Electronics. Will his boss find out that Taarak lied to him about his injury?

episodesList.title: A Surprise For Taarak
episodesList.summary: Taarak finds out that his boss is headed to his home to surprise him. Taarak rushes back before his boss finds out that he lied about his injury.

episodesList.title: Bhide And Abdul's Plan
episodesList.summary: Bhide and Abdul try to think of excuses to stop Taarak's boss from entering the society. Meanwhile, Taarak and Jethalal encounter a lot of problems on their way home.

episodesList.title: Doctor Hathi To The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Doctor Hathi stalls Taarak's boss and takes him to his home. Meanwhile, Taarak encounters even more problems while on his way to Gokuldham. Will Taarak's boss find out about his lie?

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena's Distraction Plan
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena coaxes Taarak's boss to play cricket with them. Will they be able to buy Taarak enough time to return home?

episodesList.title: Efforts Gone In Vain?
episodesList.summary: Despite all the efforts from Gokuldham residents, Taarak's boss finally finds his way inside Taarak's house. What will happen when he finds out the truth?

episodesList.title: Sakharam Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Taarak tells everyone how he safely made it back home. Later, Bhide gets a shock as Sakharam goes missing from the society compound.

episodesList.title: Bhide's Search For Sakharam
episodesList.summary: Bhide takes Taarak's help to look for Sakharam. Bhide thinks that Jethalal has played a prank on him by taking Sakharam away. Will his hunch prove to be true?

episodesList.title: Late For Work
episodesList.summary: Jethalal's tension begins in the morning as Nattu Kaka and Bagha get late for work. However, the tension seemingly goes away as Jethalal receives an order for two hundred TVs.

episodesList.title: Gambhir Mudda
episodesList.summary: Jethalal has to go to Daman for an important meeting, and he gives Bhide the responsibility of taking care of Bapuji. Meanwhile, Popatlal gets a call from the marriage bureau about a potential match.

episodesList.title: Disheartened Popatlal
episodesList.summary: Popatlal gets disheartened when things don't work out for him at the marriage bureau. Later, he eavesdrops on Bhide talking to someone about looking for a potential groom. Will Popatlal finally get a match?

episodesList.title: The Suitable Groom
episodesList.summary: Popatlal overhears Bhide's conversation and finds out that his uncle is looking for a suitable groom for his daughter. Will this be the opportunity to get married Popatlal was waiting for?

episodesList.title: Finding Vidya's Address
episodesList.summary: Popatlal takes help from Gogi and Goli to find Vidya's address and meet her in person. Will Popatlal's plan work?

episodesList.title: Shiv Ganga Village
episodesList.summary: Popatlal, Gogi and Goli travel to Shiv Ganga village to meet Vidya and propose to her for marriage. Meanwhile, Bhide decides to apologise to Popatlal for his behaviour.

episodesList.title: Popatlal And Vidya
episodesList.summary: Popatlal decides to meet Vidya at the school where she works as a teacher. Meanwhile, Gogi and Goli's parents begin to grow suspicious about their activities.

episodesList.title: Angry Sudhakar
episodesList.summary: Sudhakar is fuming with anger and decides to confront Bhide about Popatlal's actions. What will happen when Popatlal returns to Gokuldham?

episodesList.title: Bhide's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Bhide is furious with Popatlal for his actions and chases him all around the colony. What will happen when Bhide finally gets his hands on him?

episodesList.title: Popatlal Hides
episodesList.summary: Popatlal sneaks into Iyer and Babita's house to escape Bhide's wrath. But how long will it be before Bhide catches him?

episodesList.title: Search For Popatlal
episodesList.summary: Popatlal hides inside Taarak's house when Iyer refuses to help him. Meanwhile, Bhide looks everywhere around the society in search of Popatlal. What will happen when Popatlal finally catches up to him?

episodesList.title: Popatlal's Escape
episodesList.summary: Taarak tries to lure Bhide away so that Popatlal can escape from the society. Will Popatlal find a safe place to hide?

episodesList.title: Bhide Suspects Everyone
episodesList.summary: Bhide starts doubting everyone and thinks that they are helping Popatlal hide. Will someone slip up and reveal the truth?

episodesList.title: Bhide Confronts
episodesList.summary: Bhide is unable to find Popatlal and his friends tell him to leave the matter for now and confront him when he returns. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Sudhakar Mama Warns Gokuldham Society
episodesList.summary: Sudhakar Mama arrives in Gokuldham society along with other people from his village to confront Bhide and Popatlal. Will Popatlal finally show his face?

episodesList.title: Bhide's Decision
episodesList.summary: Chalu Pandey agrees to find Popatlal on the condition that Bhide will not take the case back under any circumstance. What will Bhide do now?

episodesList.title: Police Complaint Against Popatlal
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents are shocked when they learn that Bhide has filed a police complaint against Popatlal. However, Popatlal is still nowhere to be found. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Finding Popatlal
episodesList.summary: Chalu Pandey reassures Bhide that they will find Popatlal in time. He thinks that Popatlal is hiding within the society compound and assigns a special agent to sniff him out.

episodesList.title: Truth Revealed
episodesList.summary: Everyone who helped Popatlal gets forced to reveal the truth in front of Bhide. Will Popatlal finally show his face?

episodesList.title: Will Popatlal be Caught?
episodesList.summary: Chalu Pandey and his canine look for Popatlal all over the colony. Can 009 find Popatlal's distinct smell and trace him?

episodesList.title: Inspector Pandey's Celebration
episodesList.summary: Inspector Pandey catches Popatlal and asks the rest of the members to back off. Will his celebration of catching the first criminal in Gokuldham Society last long?

episodesList.title: Sudhakar Mama Wants Popatlal
episodesList.summary: Sudhakar Mama arrives at Gokuldham along with a group of people from his village. Will Bhide and the others hand over Popatlal to them?

episodesList.title: The Eye Opener
episodesList.summary: The tables seem to have turned as Sudhakar and Vidya thank Popatlal for opening their eyes. Will Popatlal's wish of getting married finally be fulfilled?

episodesList.title: Unlucky Popatlal
episodesList.summary: Popatlal proves to be unlucky once again, as he finds out that Vidya loves someone else. Meanwhile, Chalu Pandey is adamant about arresting Bhide, as per their deal.

episodesList.title: Sonu Ke Special Guests
episodesList.summary: Sonu prepares breakfast for the special guests that are coming to her house. Bhide and Madhavi are puzzled by the change in her behaviour. Who will the special guests be?

episodesList.title: Year End Sale At Gada Electronics
episodesList.summary: Bhide tells Jethalal and Bapuji about the events that transpired between Popatlal and Sudhakar Mama. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka come up with an innovative offer for increasing sales before the New Year.

episodesList.title: New Year Ki Party Ka Rang
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena takes Bhide's help to plan a party for New Year's Eve. They decide to let everyone draw chits with a random colour that they would have to wear at the party.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Welcomes The New Year
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents come together to celebrate the New Year together. However, Taarak is worried that something might go wrong. Will Taarak's fears come true?

episodesList.title: Naye Saal Ka Naya Suvichar
episodesList.summary: Bhide kicks off the new year by writing the thought of the day in Sanskrit. However, many Gokuldham residents are puzzled by the meaning behind the thought. Who will be able to decipher its true meaning?

episodesList.title: Bharat Ki Pracheen Bhasha
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tries to decipher the meaning behind the thought written in Sanskrit. Meanwhile, Bagha brings good news for Jethalal in the morning.

episodesList.title: Naye Saal Ki Khushkhabri
episodesList.summary: Jethalal finds out that the profits of Gada Electronics have increased by fifty per cent over the past year. Meanwhile, Bagha rushes to meet Bawri, who has just returned from Kanpur.

episodesList.title: Bagha Ka Toota Dil
episodesList.summary: Bagha gets worried as Bawri gets late for their date. He goes to Bawri's house to check on her but finds that her house is locked.

episodesList.title: Bagha Ki Tragic Love Story
episodesList.summary: Bagha gets depressed when Bawri refuses to talk to him. Will Nattu Kaka and Jethalal be able to cheer up his mood?

episodesList.title: Badey Order Ki Tension
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is anxious as he receives a large order, but Bagha is in no condition to work. Meanwhile, Jethalal seeks Taarak's help to find a solution to this problem.

episodesList.title: Bagha Bhaag Gaya
episodesList.summary: Bagha runs away from home and is not picking up his phone. Meanwhile, Jethalal gets tensed about completing the order on time.

episodesList.title: Bagha Ho Gaya Seedha
episodesList.summary: Jethalal and the others find Bagha inside a bar, drinking away his sorrow. What will happen when Bagha drinks too much?

episodesList.title: Party Sharty Ka Nateeja
episodesList.summary: Bagha creates a ruckus in the society, and no one is able to handle him. What will Gokuldham residents do now?

episodesList.title: Bagha Ki Zidd
episodesList.summary: Taarak and Anjali come up with a plan to get Bagha to step down from the balcony. Will their plan work?

episodesList.title: Nashe Mein Bagha
episodesList.summary: Bagha's drunk antics become a problem for the entire colony. Can a solution be found?

episodesList.title: Bawri Vapas Aa Gayi
episodesList.summary: Bagha finally takes a sigh of relief when the real Bawri comes in front of him. However, Jethalal is still worried about completing the order on time.

episodesList.title: 50 TV Ki Delivery
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is worried that he has to deliver fifty TVs, but Bagha and Nattu Kaka are not picking up his calls. What will Jethalal do now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ki Angoothi
episodesList.summary: Jethalal loses his ring in the society compound. Will Bhide be able to help him find his ring?

episodesList.title: Bawri's Surprise
episodesList.summary: Madhavi tells Bhide that the neighbouring society has experienced some ghostly activities. Meanwhile, Bawri arrives at Gada Electronics to surprise Bagha.

episodesList.title: Employee Aur Boss Ka Rishta
episodesList.summary: Nattu Kaka and Bagha ask Jethalal to increase their salary. Meanwhile, Taarak gets in trouble with his boss for trying to skip work.

episodesList.title: Taarak Gives Anjali A Surprise
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets worried when Taarak does not answer his calls. Later, Taarak calls Anjali to give her a piece of good news.

episodesList.title: Taarak Ki Good News
episodesList.summary: Taarak calls Jethalal to his house to tell him some good news. What will the good news be?

episodesList.title: Yellow Shirt Ki Problem
episodesList.summary: Taarak burns his yellow shirt while ironing it. He asks his fellow Gokuldham society members for their help.

episodesList.title: Taarak Ki Akhri Ummeed
episodesList.summary: Taarak borrows Dr Hathi's yellow shirt, and Anjali helps him alter it. Will Taarak's problem finally get solved?

episodesList.title: Taarak Ka Luck
episodesList.summary: Iyer lends his yellow shirt to Taarak, which fits him perfectly. Gokuldham residents wish him luck for the meeting. Will things go in Taarak's favour?

episodesList.title: Taarak Phas Gaya
episodesList.summary: Taarak gets into an accident in the morning, which spoils his yellow shirt. Everyone blames Jethalal for putting Taarak in that situation. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Taarak's Green Shirt
episodesList.summary: Bapuji decides to go and talk to Taarak’s boss. Later, when Taarak and Bapuji arrive at the office, everyone is shocked to see Taarak’s green shirt.

episodesList.title: Badey Guru Ji Ke Darshan
episodesList.summary: Taarak arrives at the office, and his boss sees him in a green shirt. Will Bapuji's plan work out?

episodesList.title: Badey Guru Ji Ki Advice
episodesList.summary: Taarak gives the presentation in front of the clients. However, the clients are not satisfied with his presentation. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Bapuji Ki Jaadui Chhadi
episodesList.summary: Taarak shares the good news with all the Gokuldham residents and tells them about Bapuji's brilliant idea. Meanwhile, Anjali prepares for the Europe trip.

episodesList.title: Boss Ka Surprise
episodesList.summary: Taarak's boss decides to pay Taarak a surprise visit in the morning. What will Taarak do now?

episodesList.title: Surprise Gift For Taarak
episodesList.summary: Taarak's boss arrives at Gokuldham, and Taarak receives him at the society gate. Meanwhile, Jethalal and Sodhi look for him in the park.

episodesList.title: Bade Guruji
episodesList.summary: Taarak’s boss sees Champaklal and says he wants to meet Bade Guruji. Everyone tries to stop him, but he doesn’t listen.

episodesList.title: Jhoot Ka Jaal
episodesList.summary: Bapuji explains how he managed to hide from Taarak's boss. Later, Taarak unboxes the gift his boss gave him.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena's Request
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena requests Bhide to buy new games for the society clubhouse. Will Bhide approve their request?

episodesList.title: Bagha Ki Laparvahi
episodesList.summary: Bhide is curious about Tapu Sena's surprise gift. Meanwhile, Jethalal scolds Bagha for talking to Bawri during working hours.

episodesList.title: Bagha's Ghost Story
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets angry when Bawri shows up at the shop to meet Bagha. Later, Bagha scares Jethalal with a ghost story.

episodesList.title: Mystery Box In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents find mystery boxes outside their homes in the middle of the night. Who could be the one behind this prank?

episodesList.title: Prankster Of Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Rest of the Gokuldham residents open their mystery boxes and find that they all have been pranked. However, Bhide has figured out who is behind this mischief. Will his hunch be correct?

episodesList.title: Bhide Ka Shak
episodesList.summary: Bhide begins to think that Goli is the one behind the prank. Will Bhide prove to be right this time?

episodesList.title: Toofan Aa Gaya Hai
episodesList.summary: The prankster writes a cryptic message on the society notice board. Gokuldham residents are scared and they think that a ghost is behind all of this. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Bhoot Ka Hungama
episodesList.summary: Bhide, Popatlal and the others look for the ghost on the terrace. Meanwhile, Gokuldham residents find a speaker in the middle of the society compound.

episodesList.title: Prankster Ki Shart
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents are scared and confused as the lights go off in the clubhouse. Meanwhile, the prankster places a very strange condition in front of the society members.

episodesList.title: The Prankster Returns
episodesList.summary: The prankster appears before the society member and he turns out to be none other than a member of Gokuldham. Who could this prankster be?

episodesList.title: Tapu Ka Dhamakedar Surprise
episodesList.summary: Tapu surprises everyone by coming back. Champaklal and Abdul say they helped Tapu in surprising everyone. Later, Tapu apologizes to everyone for scaring them.

episodesList.title: Tapu Brings Gifts
episodesList.summary: Tapu brings special presents for all Gokuldham residents, and he decides to gift them in the middle of the night. Is Tapu planning another prank?

episodesList.title: Tapu Ka Style
episodesList.summary: Tapu makes everyone happy with his thoughtful gifts. In the morning, Sonu decides to prepare a special breakfast for Tapu.

episodesList.title: Tapu Ka Result
episodesList.summary: Tapu shows his disappointing exam results to Jethalal. Later, Tapu decides to talk to Jethalal about joining Gada Electronics.

episodesList.title: Gada Pariwaar Ki Nayi Bahu
episodesList.summary: Tapu's college friend comes to Gokuldham to meet him. Jethalal and Bapuji think this girl could be Tapu's future life partner. Will their assumption prove to be correct?

episodesList.title: Bhide Ka Sar Dard
episodesList.summary: Sonu bursts Bhide's bubble and tells him that Missa is not Tapu's girlfriend. Meanwhile, Tapu celebrates his return by playing cricket with his friends in the society compound.

episodesList.title: Tapu Aur Champaklal Ka Dance
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tells Baga and Nattu kaka that Tapu is back. Tapu and his friends tell Champaklal they want to dance with him.

episodesList.title: Babita Needs Help
episodesList.summary: Babita wants to gift her cousin a TV which is high in demand. She asks Jethalal for his help in acquiring this TV. Will Jethalal accept her request?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ki Pratigya
episodesList.summary: Jethalal vows to shave his head if he is unable to fulfil his promise to Babita. Meanwhile, Bagha and Nattu Kaka find a customer for the TV.

episodesList.title: Profit Ka Dukh
episodesList.summary: Bawri calls Bagha to fix her scooter. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka is excited as he secured a profitable deal for the TV. What will Jethalal do when he finds out?

episodesList.title: Search For The TV
episodesList.summary: Jethalal throws a tantrum when he finds out that the TV has been sold. How will Jethalal fulfil the promise he made to Babita now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ke Baal Khatre Mein Hai
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is unable to find the TV anywhere, and he feels hopeless. Meanwhile, Babita and Iyer arrive at Jethalal's shop, hoping to buy the TV from him. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ka Promise
episodesList.summary: Jethlalal is stressed about the promise he made to Iyer. Bawri comes to Jethalal’s rescue. Will Jethalal keep the promise he made to Iyer?

episodesList.title: Holi Ki Taiyyari
episodesList.summary: The kids of the colony are excited for Holi and begin their preparations for a memorable celebration. Will everything go according to plan?

episodesList.title: Holika Dahan In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena apologizes to Bhide for pranking him. Meanwhile, preparations for the Holi celebration continue in Gokuldham.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena Ke Holi Plans
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena tells everyone about their Holi plans. However, Gokuldham residents are worried that something might go wrong as usual. What troubles will be waiting for them?

episodesList.title: Hungame Vaali Holi
episodesList.summary: Members of the Tapu Sena cover Bhide with Holi colours and drench him with water. Later, Bhide finds out that Tapu mixed itching powder with the colour. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Tension Ke Rang
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents are waiting for Dr Hathi to arrive and treat Bhide. Meanwhile, Inspector Chalu Pandey pays them a surprise visit.

episodesList.title: Khujli Powder Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Inspector Pandey wants to arrest Tapu for throwing itching powder at Bhide. However, Dr Hathi arrives on time and decides to inspect the Holi colours. Will Dr Hathi prove Tapu's innocence?

episodesList.title: Aage Ki Soch
episodesList.summary: Babita and Iyer come to Jethalal's house with a problem, and Tapu gives them a solution. Later, Jethalal asks Tapu about his future plans.

episodesList.title: Baccho Ka Bhavishya
episodesList.summary: All the parents are worried that the kids are not focused on their life goals. Tapu comes up with an idea which will alleviate their tension and also ensure that the fun in their life never ends.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena's New Mission
episodesList.summary: Taarak talks to the kids about their career goals. Tapu promises that all of them will come up with a plan to make their families proud.

episodesList.title: Baccho Ka Secret Project
episodesList.summary: Jethalal and the others ask for Bapuji's help to find out what Tapu Sena is up to. Meanwhile, the kids decide to present their secret project in front of everyone the next day.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena Ka Nimantran
episodesList.summary: Everyone is wondering what could be Tapu Sena's secret project. Meanwhile, Tapu Sena invites all the residents of Gokuldham to the clubhouse, where they will present their idea.

episodesList.title: Bhide Hai Pareshan
episodesList.summary: Bhide is worried and wants to find out what is Tapu Sena going to do at 8:30 pm and comes up with an idea. Will he be able to find out about their plan?

episodesList.title: Program Ka Chief Guest
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents arrive at the clubhouse for the special program. All of them are curious about the secret chief guest for their program. Who could it be?

episodesList.title: Suspense Khatam Hua
episodesList.summary: The secret investor turns out to be none other than Asit Kumarr Modi, who helped Tapu Sena put their entire project together. Only one question remains now, what is this secret project that the kids have been working so hard for?

episodesList.title: Manoranjan Ka Khazana
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents praise Tapu Sena for their innovative ideas and hard work. Later, Gokuldham residents celebrate Gudi Padwa together.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena Ki Safalta
episodesList.summary: Popatlal confronts Asit Kumarr Modi about not finding a suitable bride for him. Meanwhile, everyone enjoys the rhymes and mobile games created by Tapu Sena.

episodesList.title: Rickshaw Kahan Hain?
episodesList.summary: Jethalal and Babita cannot find an auto that is ready to take them to their destination. He then faces a group of angry auto drivers. Will Jethalal reach his shop in time with the important meeting inching closer?

episodesList.title: Nayi Scheme
episodesList.summary: Rustom from Ramsang company decides to put Gada Electronics on the blacklist for Jethalal's unprofessional behaviour. Jethalal sees Rustom running from Gada Electronics and assumes he is a thief. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Gada Electronics Ki Scheme
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is excited about the new scheme that Gada Electronics has been selected for and wishes to see Babita benefit from it. Tapu is keen on marketing this scheme in the best possible way. Later, Jethalal tells the society members about the scheme at Gada Electronics.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Calls Out On The Scheme
episodesList.summary: Popatlal calls out schemes such as the one announced by Jethalal, to be fraudulent. All the society members look forward to making purchases to increase their probability of benefiting from the scheme.

episodesList.title: Scheme Ke Liye Excitement
episodesList.summary: The society members are excited and looking forward to making purchases under the scheme offered by Gada Electronics. Bagha and Natu Kaka have made all the necessary preparations for the big day of the sale. How will Jethalal react?

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena Ka Marketing Plan
episodesList.summary: Bagha and Nattu Kaka ask Bawri to hide before Jethalal reaches the store. Tapu Sena presents their marketing plan for the scheme before Jethalal. Later, a crowd assembles outside Jethalal's shop but doesn't enter the premises. What is the matter?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Gets Concerned
episodesList.summary: All the society members are impressed with the promotional video made by Tapu Sena, for the scheme offered by Gada Electronics. Jethalal shares his worries with Taarak about the probability of things not running smoothly. What will happen?

episodesList.title: Sale At Gada Electronics
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets anxious when he sees there are no customers at Gada electronics. Baga gets caps for the employees of Gada electronics. Will people turn up at Gada Electronics?

episodesList.title: The Day Of The Scheme
episodesList.summary: The society members assemble before setting out to make purchases under the scheme at Gada Electronics. Meanwhile, Jethalal's shop is packed with customers. Will the society members reach on time before the coupons run out?

episodesList.title: The Society Members Reach The Shop
episodesList.summary: Sunita reaches Jethalal's shop to make a purchase. While Jethalal and his team continue attending to various customers, the society members, except Babita, arrive at the shop. Will Babita reach in time?

episodesList.title: Chalu Panday Arrives At Gada Electronics
episodesList.summary: Inspector Panday arrives at Jethalal's shop to shop under the scheme followed by Babita. All the society members make their purchases under the scheme and return to the society.

episodesList.title: Fantasies About Winning The Lucky Draw
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is happy about the day that it has gone well. The society members decide to sit together at the clubhouse to watch the results of the lucky draw. They fantasize about what they'd do if they won the car.

episodesList.title: Kaash Mujhe Car Mil Jae
episodesList.summary: Bhide interrupts Tapu Sena's enthusiasm for creating a ruckus in the compound. Later, the society members pray to their respective gods, asking god to make them win the car.

episodesList.title: Lucky Draw Ka Din
episodesList.summary: All the society members gather together in the clubhouse for the lucky draw's announcement hoping to win a car under the Ramsang company's scheme. Who will win the car?

episodesList.title: Popatlal Wins The Honeymoon Coupon
episodesList.summary: All the society members gear up for the announcement of the last two coupon prizes. With Popatlal having won the honeymoon coupon, who will win the car?

episodesList.title: Khushi Bhet
episodesList.summary: Jethalal, Bagha and Nattu Kaka recount the events that transpired during the lucky draw viewing at the clubhouse, for Champaklal. Later, an excited Babita decides to attend driving lessons.

episodesList.title: Coupon Kahan Gaya?
episodesList.summary: Babita gets a nightmare and calls Jethalal in the middle of the night to make sure that the coupon is safe with Jethalal. The following morning, Jethalal leaves for his shop with Babita, Bhide and Popatlal coupons.

episodesList.title: Taarak Warns Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Taarak warns Jethalal, asking him to be careful with the coupons because of his streak of bad luck when it comes to handling others' responsibilities. Meanwhile, Babita registers for driving lessons and Jethalal tries to speed up the process of Babita receiving the car earlier than customary.

episodesList.title: Is The Coupon At Risk?
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is ecstatic to inform Babita about her being able to receive the car on her preferred day. Later, Jethalal calls Taarak in agony, asking for help on a situation with the coupon. What is it regarding?

episodesList.title: Car Coupon
episodesList.summary: Rustom from Ramsung congratulates Jethalal and gives him a certificate of appreciation. Jethalal tells Rustom he doesn’t have the car coupon. How will Rustom react?

episodesList.title: Babita Ka License
episodesList.summary: Bagha uses Bawri’s idea to prevent Rustom and Babita from learning the truth. Mahila Mandal is very excited because Babita is getting a car. How will everyone react when they get to know about Jethalal's lies?

episodesList.title: Sihayi Hatane Ka Idea
episodesList.summary: Bagha asks Dolly from Ramsung about Babita’s car colour. Bagha suggests they should make a duplicate car coupon. Later, Taarak gives an idea to Jethalal on how to get the ink off the car coupon. Will this idea work?

episodesList.title: Taarak Ka Tedha Idea
episodesList.summary: Rustom makes it clear to Jethalal that if he doesn’t receive the car coupon before 6 pm, he won’t give the car to Babita. Taarak has an idea that he believes could help Jethalal with his problem, but his boss won’t let him out of his sight. How will Taarak help Jethalal now?

episodesList.title: Car Coupon Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Jethalal decides to tell the truth to Rustom about the car coupon. How will Rustom react to the truth?

episodesList.title: Sachai Ki Raah
episodesList.summary: Taarak prepares Jethalal to tell the truth to Babita and Champaklal. Later, Babita along with Tapu Sena plans to surprise Iyer with the new car.

episodesList.title: Babita Ki Narazgi
episodesList.summary: Jethalal and Taarak arrive at Babita's house to tell her the truth about the car coupon. How will Babita react when she finds out what happened?

episodesList.title: Taarak And Jethalal Are Stressed
episodesList.summary: Taarak gets upset when Anjali asks him to welcome Babita’s new car with everyone. Popatlal calls Jethalal to Abdul’s soda shop, but Jethalal avoids his call.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Restless
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is not able to sleep because he is tense and decides to run away from home. Will he run away from the situation or face the situation and own his mistake?

episodesList.title: Dukh Dayak Samachar
episodesList.summary: Taarak acts irritable and asks Jethalal to talk to Babita. Babita asks Tapu to get a cake for Jethalal. Later, Jethalal writes a letter to Babita. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ka Khat
episodesList.summary: Jethalal asks Goli to give his letter to Babita. Babita loses the letter and calls Jethalal to ask about the letter. Will Jethalal tell her the truth?

episodesList.title: Iyer Ke Liye Surprise
episodesList.summary: Taarak asks Jethalal to tell Iyer the entire truth. Everyone is eagerly waiting for Babita’s car, and Tapu Sena prepares to surprise Iyer.

episodesList.title: Car Ka Golmol
episodesList.summary: Babita asks Jethalal to call Ramsung company and ask about the car. Jethalal tries to tell the truth to Babita in front of everyone when Bagha along with Rustom arrives in Gokuldham society. Will Babita finally learn the truth?

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Letter
episodesList.summary: The entire Gokuldham society cheers for Jethalal. Rustom asks Babita to send the car to his showroom for registration. Babita reads the letter Jethalal had written to her. What will be Babita’s reaction?

episodesList.title: Chamatkari Baba
episodesList.summary: Nattu Kaka and Bagha tell everyone that whoever took out the ink from the coupon has asked them not to reveal his identity. Who is this mystery man?

episodesList.title: Babita Ke Car Ka Sapna Hua Poora
episodesList.summary: Babita thanks everyone for making her dream come true. Jethalal asks Taarak to write a letter to Rustom. Later, Gada Electronic employees get sad when they don’t get a commission from Jethalal.

episodesList.title: Surprise Gift
episodesList.summary: Champaklal decides to give a surprise gift to Tapu. Later, Bhide stops Tapu Sena from playing cricket at night. What will Tapu Sena do now?

episodesList.title: Bhide Gets Protective
episodesList.summary: Bhide scolds Tapu for calling Sonu inappropriately. Later, Bhide reads Tapu's messages on Sonu's phone and gets furious.

episodesList.title: Jasoos Bhide
episodesList.summary: Bhide follows Tapu and Sonu and spies on them. What will he find after following them?

episodesList.title: Tapu Ka Proposal
episodesList.summary: Bhide gets scared when he finds out his friend's daughter ran away with someone. Later, Bhide sees Tapu planning a surprise for Sonu and proposing to her. How will Bhide react now?

episodesList.title: Bhide Ki Sharamnak News
episodesList.summary: Bhide tells Madhavi about Tapu and Sonu, but she doesn't believe him. Bhide calls Jethalal and says he has a piece of very shocking news for him. How will Jethalal react to Bhide's news?

episodesList.title: Problem Kya Hai?
episodesList.summary: Everyone tries to find out what happened between Bhide and Jethalal. Later, Everyone gathers in Jethalal's house and waits for Bhide to come. What will Bhide do now?

episodesList.title: Bhide Ko Laga Jhatka
episodesList.summary: Tapu gives a surprise to everyone and a return gift to Champaklal. Later, everyone asks Bhide what he wanted to talk to Jethalal about.

episodesList.title: Bhide Ki Asli Baat
episodesList.summary: Champaklal decides to give everyone a dinner treat. Jethalal is curious about what Bhide wanted to tell him and asks for Taarak's help. Will Bhide tell Jethalal the truth?

episodesList.title: Popatlal Ki Shaadi Ki Charcha
episodesList.summary: Anjali and Taarak talk about Popatlal's marriage. Later, the kids tell Champaklal about their new game.

episodesList.title: Hasi Khushi Se Raho
episodesList.summary: Madhavi gets extremely upset because she thinks Bhide doesn't like her food. Later, Gokuldham men meet at Abdul’s soda shop, and Taarak’s deep words impress everyone.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Is Hurt
episodesList.summary: Popatlal gets angry when Jethalal says girls refuse to get married to him. Later, someone plays the violin in the Gokuldham society, and everybody dances. Who is this talented person?

episodesList.title: Matchmaker Vinu Kaka
episodesList.summary: Popatlal finds out about Vinu Kaka and feels positive about his marriage. Later, Popatlal meets Vinu Kaka and asks him about his marriage. Will Popatlal get any good news?

episodesList.title: Kuch Pao Aur Kuch Kho
episodesList.summary: Popatlal says he needs some time to think about changing his name. Bhide gets worried when Viku Kaka sees Sonu’s hand and says she will get married to someone who lives nearby. Later, Popatlal goes to Jethalal and asks for his advice.

episodesList.title: Beheno Ka Decision
episodesList.summary: Bagha makes chits to solve Popatlal’s problem. Popatlal decides to let Mahila Mandal make the final decision about his name. Will Mahila Mandal solve Popatlal’s problem?

episodesList.title: P Se Naam
episodesList.summary: Everyone tries to find a new name for Popatlal. Later, Popatlal invites everyone to his party to celebrate his name-keeping ceremony.

episodesList.title: Name Voting
episodesList.summary: Everyone arrives at Popatlal’s name ceremony party except Jethalal and Champaklal. Later, Popatlal gives a speech to everyone.

episodesList.title: Choose One Name
episodesList.summary: Everyone from Gokuldham society votes for names that would suit Popatlal the most. Whose name will Popatlal choose?

episodesList.title: Unlucky Name
episodesList.summary: Jethalal suggests a few names from the letter P for Popatlal. Later, Popatlal finally finds the perfect name for himself but Iyer says it’s not the right name for him. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Alvida Popatlal
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena decides to give a gift to Popatlal. Popatlal’s relative’s ghost is angry because she doesn’t want him to change his name. What will he do now?

episodesList.title: Pyaarelal Ka Purse
episodesList.summary: A girl compliments Pyaarelal for his name and will marry someone with the same name. Pyaarelal’s editor is upset with him because he changed his name. Later, Pyaarelal gets into confusion with the police because of his name.

episodesList.title: Rishta Aa Gaya
episodesList.summary: Pyaarelal starts doubting his decision to change the name but Anjali informs him about a proposal that came for him. Later, Pyaarelal asks Taarak to take an off from the office and be with him, but his boss is in a bad mood. What will Taarak do now?

episodesList.title: Do Do Rishte
episodesList.summary: Taarak convinces his boss to give him leave from the office for half a day. Pyaarelal asks Anjali about Sapna. Later, Pyaarelal sets up a meeting with two different girls for marriage on the same day. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Ek Ghante Ki Meeting
episodesList.summary: Everyone gets ready to meet Sapna and Kalpana. Pyaarelal gets happy when he meets Sapna. Will this meeting change Pyaarelal’s life?

episodesList.title: Sapna Ka Jawab
episodesList.summary: Sapna’s father asks questions to Pyaarelal. Sapna and Pyaarelal talk in private to get to know each other better. Will Sapna say yes to Pyaarelal?

episodesList.title: Sapna Ya Kalpana?
episodesList.summary: Pyaarelal and Sapna talk it out in person and seem to like each other. However, Pyaarelal is concerned about meeting Kalpana first before giving his decision. Who will he pick?

episodesList.title: Hum Dono Ki Haan Hai
episodesList.summary: Pyaarelal and Kalpana talk in private. Later, Sapna and Kalpana both agree to marry Pyaarelal. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Pyaarelal's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Pyaarelal gets into trouble when he says yes to both Kalpana and Sapna for marriage. How will he get out of this problem?

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena Ka Idea
episodesList.summary: Champaklal asks Pyaarelal to refuse to marry either Sapna or Kalpana. Later, Pyaarelal tells Tapu Sena about his problem. Will Tapu Sena find a solution to his problem?

episodesList.title: Pyaarelal Under Pressure
episodesList.summary: Pyaarelal decides to meet Sapna and Kalpana once again. Later, Sapna’s family treats Pyaarelal like their son-in-law which makes the situation even more difficult for him.

episodesList.title: Pyaarelal Ke Bahane
episodesList.summary: Pyaarelal tells Sapna he has to leave to attend to a work emergency but instead goes to meet Kalpana. Will Sapna find out about this?

episodesList.title: Bohot Sara Khaana
episodesList.summary: Pyaarelal goes out with Sapna to get to know her better but soon leaves to meet Kalpana. Will Pyaarelal be able to choose one girl between Kalpana and Sapna?

episodesList.title: 6 Baje Wali Samasya
episodesList.summary: Kalpana and Sapna are head over heels in love with Pyaarelal. Pyaarelal is worried because he fixes a date with Kalpana and Sapna at the same time and same place. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Yellow Or Blue?
episodesList.summary: Kalpana gets a tatto for Pyaarelal. Pyaarelal goes to Sapna while he is on a date with Kalpana. Police find Pyaarelal's behaviour suspicious and keep an eye on him.

episodesList.title: Pyaarelal Ka Shagun
episodesList.summary: Pyaarelal tells his dream to everyone. Kalpana’s father fixes a meeting with Pyaarelal to give him Shagun, and Sapna’s family also decides to come with Shagun to Pyaarelal’s house.

episodesList.title: Pyaarelal Ke Khushi Ka Din
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham society members prepare for Pyaarelal and Kalpana’s Shagun ceremony. Later, Kalpana comes with her family to Pyaarelal’s house.

episodesList.title: Kalpana Ka Final Decision
episodesList.summary: Kalpana and her family find out the truth about Pyaarelal's name and Kalpana decides to break up with him. Later, Jethalal and Taarak give good news to Pyaarelal. What is it?

episodesList.title: Yellow Shagun Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Pyaarelal calls and invites Bagha, Nattu kaka and Bawri for his Shagun ceremony with Sapna. Later, everyone welcomes Sapna and her family to Gokuldham society.

episodesList.title: Sapna Ki Love Story
episodesList.summary: A man named Swapnil loves Sapna, and Pyaarelal brings him to his Shagun ceremony and helps them get together with each other. Later, Pyaarelal decides to change his name back to Popatlal.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena Ki Outstation Trip
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena visit Popatlal and helps cheer up his mood. Later, Tapu informs Jethalal that he is going outstation on a trip with all of his friends.

episodesList.title: Leave Ki Permission
episodesList.summary: Jethalal runs away to save himself from Anjali’s diet breakfast. Anjali reminds Taarak of their anniversary when they first met and asks him to take an off from the office. Will Taarak be able to convince his boss to take a leave for a day?

episodesList.title: Bagha Ka Idea
episodesList.summary: Taarak is worried because he doesn’t know how to take leave from his office and decides to ask Jethalal for advice. Taarak shares his problem with Bagha. Will Bagha be able to help Taarak with his problem?

episodesList.title: Boss Ki Permission
episodesList.summary: Taarak tries to find out his boss’s mood and asks Bagha to call him. Later, Bagha reminds Taarak of the promise he made.

episodesList.title: Taarak Ka Special Day
episodesList.summary: Jethalal finds out that his dream company wants to meet him tomorrow for a meeting. Jethalal asks Taarak to take a leave from his office and attend the meeting with him. How will Taarak manage to help Jethalal and also spend time with Anjali on their anniversary?

episodesList.title: Important Meeting Ki Tyaari
episodesList.summary: Taarak suggests Jethalal to take Bagha and Nattu Kaka for his dealership meeting. Later, Taarak asks Jethalal to stay quiet during the whole meeting and let Bagha and Nattu Kaka speak. Will Jethalal get this dealership?

episodesList.title: Bagha Is Well Prepared
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tells Taarak that Mike Gatting has become his company’s manager. Bagha impresses Jethalal with his presentation and English. Will he be able to get the dealership for Gada Electronics?

episodesList.title: Hum Meeting Ke Liye Taiyyar Hain
episodesList.summary: When the guests from the company arrive, they get a little confused seeing Jethalal with a 'Mon Vrat'. The dealership employees walk out as they only want to speak to Jethalal. Will Jethalal get the dealership?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ke Priya Mitra
episodesList.summary: Champaklal unknowingly exposes Jethalal and Taarak lying in front of the dealership employees. Later, Jethalal books a table for Anjali and Taarak at his friend’s restaurant.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ne Baati Mithaiyaan
episodesList.summary: Jethalal joyfully distributes sweets to all the members of society to commemorate the successful acquisition of a new dealership.

episodesList.title: Wakeel Ka Number
episodesList.summary: All the society members get ready for the monsoons as they run their chores. Meanwhile, Taarak gets called into his boss' cabin. Will he be in trouble?

episodesList.title: Bagha Bana Vakeel
episodesList.summary: Tarak's boss asks him to share his lawyer's number which makes him nervous. He confirms with Bagha and asks him to pretend to be a lawyer. Will he get caught?

episodesList.title: Mall Ke Daam
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena accidentally hurts Bhide. Later, Sunita sells vegetables to Mahila Mandal at a higher rate. What will Mahila Mandal do now?

episodesList.title: Daya Ki Yaad
episodesList.summary: Bhide asks Tapu Sena to stop playing video games. Later, everyone asks Jethalal when is Daya coming back and he starts missing her.

episodesList.title: Sundar In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets a call from the police station to inform him that they have arrested Sundar. How will Jethalal help him now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ko Mila Bhoot
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets a call from the police station. Sodhi gives a lawyer’s number to Jethalal. Later, Jethalal and his friends have an encounter with a ghost on their way to the police station.

episodesList.title: Bin Bulaye Mehman
episodesList.summary: Sundar tells Jethalal that he won a challenge because of him and Jethalal asks for his commission. Sundar tricks Jethalal into making tea for him and his friends.

episodesList.title: Ghost Show
episodesList.summary: Inspector Panday is furious with Jethalal for calling him to the police station in the middle of the night for no reason. Later, Sundar and his friends try to scare Inspector Panday by dressing up as ghosts.

episodesList.title: Sundar's Friend's Loan
episodesList.summary: Champaklal apologizes to Inspector Panday on behalf of Jethalal. Sundar tells Jethalal that he has a surprise for him. Later, Sundar wakes up Champaklal and Tapu in the middle of the night.

episodesList.title: Ek Bhayanak Sapna
episodesList.summary: Sundar tells his problem to Champaklal and asks him to come to Ahmedabad with him. Later, Sundar plans a surprise for Jethalal. What is the surprise?

episodesList.title: Surprise Ka Secret
episodesList.summary: Anjali forces Taarak to drink healthy juice. Jethalal wants to know what surprise Sundar is planning for him. Later, everyone gathers at the clubhouse to find out about Sundar’s surprise.

episodesList.title: Sundar Ka Start Up
episodesList.summary: Sundar asks Jethalal to do the inauguration of his stall. Everyone enjoys food from Sundar’s stall. Later, Sunday tells everyone that he has one more surprise for Jethalal.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Tries To Run
episodesList.summary: Bagha and Nattu Kaka try to convince Jethalal to take up Sundar’s offer to join his food business. Jethalal fears that he might have to pay for the lights and decorations. Later, Tapu tells Sundar about the games Tapu Sena has made.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ki Doosri Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Sundar leaves for Ahmedabad but Jethalal tries to stop him. Taarak asks Jethalal to get re-married. Later, Taarak tricks Sundar and forces him to return to Gokuldham society.

episodesList.title: Doosri Shaadi Ke Sapne
episodesList.summary: Taarak tells Sundar that Jethalal is thinking about getting married again. Later, Champaklal finds out about Jethalal’s intentions and gets angry at him. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Daya Ke Wapas Aane Ki News
episodesList.summary: Sundar says he knew that everyone was acting when they said Jethalal is getting married again. Later, Sundar decides to tell Jethalal when Daya is returning to Gokuldham society.

episodesList.title: Iyer Ki Good News
episodesList.summary: All the Gokuldham men are very happy to sit and have soda together. Iyer gets angry with Jethalal for pulling his leg. Later, Iyer says he has good news for everyone. What is it?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ka Worng Guess
episodesList.summary: Bhide’s morning quote triggers Popatlal. Later, Jethalal gets worried when he finds out that Iyer's good news is not what he was thinking about. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Bribes Goli
episodesList.summary: Taarak and Jethalal ask Goli to go to Iyer’s house and find out about his good news. Will Iyer tell the good news to Goli?

episodesList.title: Bazigar Iyer
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is afraid of losing while everyone waits for Iyer to come and give the good news. Later, Champaklal learns about Jethalal and Iyer’s bet. Who will win this bet?

episodesList.title: Car Ki Tamanna
episodesList.summary: Jethalal congratulates Babita on her new car. Everyone in Gokuldham society wishes they also had a car. Later, Iyer and Babita meet Bagha, Nattu Kaka and Bawri to give them sweets.

episodesList.title: Toofani Din
episodesList.summary: A big storm hits Mumbai, and Anjali asks Taarak not to go to the office. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka reach the shop and wait for Jethalal to come.

episodesList.title: Barsat Mein Pareshani
episodesList.summary: Everyone gets a day off from work because of the heavy rains. Bhide plans to spend a romantic day with Madhavi but one of his students shows up. How will Bhide's day go?

episodesList.title: Haso Hasao Divas
episodesList.summary: Iyer plans to watch a movie with Babita at home while Tapu Sena is getting bored and decide to make everyone laugh and entertain them. What will Tapu Sena do now?

episodesList.title: Bade Bhi Bane Bacche
episodesList.summary: Tapu calls the rest of the Gokuldham members outside in his unique style to have fun with them and celebrate the ‘Haso Hasao Divas’.

episodesList.title: Bhagwan Krishna Ki Gokul Nagri
episodesList.summary: Taarak’s boss scolds him for playing outside instead of working. Inspector Panday also celebrates ‘Haso Hasao Divas’ with Gokuldham members. Later, Lord Krishna gives his blessings to the Gokuldham society.

episodesList.title: Khushiyon Ke 15 Saal
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham Society celebrates 15 years of 'Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah' by reminiscing beautiful memories of the show.

episodesList.title: Champaklal Plays Pool
episodesList.summary: Goli and Tapu have a pool competition which Goli tries to win by cheating. Tapu Sena decides to teach Champaklal how to play pool. Later, Mahila Mandal plans a trip to enjoy the lovely weather.

episodesList.title: Mehenge Tamatar
episodesList.summary: Anjali tells Mahila Mandal that Taarak gave a polythene full of fresh tomatoes to the garbage man. Later, Sunita explains why she has increased the price of all the vegetables.

episodesList.title: Tamatar Ka Achar
episodesList.summary: Madhavi tells Bhide that she forgot to make Mr Nayar’s order of tomato pickles. Champkalal explains to Bhide the importance of respecting customers in business. Later, Bhide and Popatlal get into an accident.

episodesList.title: Tamatar Milna Hua Mushkil
episodesList.summary: Bhide struggles to find 40 kilos of tomatoes in one place. Bhide goes to Gada Electronics and sees a lot of tomatoes there. What will Bhide do now?

episodesList.title: Tempo Mein Tamatar
episodesList.summary: Bhide calls his uncle in Nashik who has a farm and asks him if he can give him tomatoes. Later, Taarak tells Bhide that a tempo full of tomatoes was looted on its way to Mumbai from Nashik. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Tamatar Ne Badhai Tension
episodesList.summary: Baliya is Bhide's last hope for getting his hands on tomatoes in time. Taarak explains why the price of tomatoes has increased drastically. Meanwhile, the Bhide family passes their time by playing a game of cards and watching a movie together.

episodesList.title: Tamatar Ki Chori
episodesList.summary: Bhide and Madhavi get very happy when they see tomatoes. They are not able to bring all the tomatoes to their flat so Bhide decides to stay down with the tomatoes. Later, the tomatoes get stolen.

episodesList.title: Kon Hai Tamatar Chor?
episodesList.summary: Bhide thinks Tapu Sena is messing with him by hiding the tomatoes while Iyer blames Jethalal. Gokuldham society members try to figure out who could’ve stolen the tomatoes while Bhide calls Inspector Panday for help.

episodesList.title: Nau Do Gyaara
episodesList.summary: Inspector Panday thinks someone from Gokuldham society has stolen Bhide’s tomatoes. Later, Inspector Panday sends his men to catch the rickshaw driver whom Abdul saw running away from the society.

episodesList.title: Padosi Ne Ki Padosi Ki Madad
episodesList.summary: Nobody is ready to believe that Popatlal is a thief, but Inspector Panday decides to arrest him. Later, Popatlal tells everyone what actually happened. Will Inspector Panday believe him?

episodesList.title: Gas Bich Mien Hui Khatam
episodesList.summary: Madhavi starts making tomato pickles for her customer while the gas cylinder at Bhide’s house gets over. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Independence Day Plans
episodesList.summary: Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell Jethalal there has been a robbery in their village and ask for their salary in advance. Later, Tapu Sena makes plans for going for an outing instead of celebrating Independence Day with everyone.

episodesList.title: Bhide Vs Tapu Sena
episodesList.summary: Bhide teaches his tuition kids about Independence Day. Later, Tapu Sena asks Bhide if they can go on a picnic to Khandala instead of celebrating Independence Day with everyone. Bhide asks Champaklal to teach the kids a lesson.

episodesList.title: Saare Bhartiya Bhai Bhai
episodesList.summary: Bhide thanks Champaklal for guiding him in the right direction while Taarak writes a poem for Independence Day. Later, everyone gathers to celebrate Independence Day.

episodesList.title: Long Drive Ke Sapne
episodesList.summary: Taarak, Bhide and Jethalal decide to go to the office together while Jethalal gets a chance to ride with Babita in her car.

episodesList.title: Chintamani
episodesList.summary: Dr Hathi’s patient, Chintamani, tells Dr Hathi that there is something wrong with him. Mahila Mandal meets for a kitty party while Goli gets ready to go to a medical camp.

episodesList.title: Namune Customers
episodesList.summary: All men from Gokuldham society gather to drink soda and talk about the kinds of customers they have to deal with.

episodesList.title: Champaklal Is Sick
episodesList.summary: Bhide writes a good message on the society board. Champaklal catches a cold while Tapu tells Jethalal about maps on the phone.

episodesList.title: All The Best Goli
episodesList.summary: Popatlal gets ready to go to somebody’s wedding, but Bhide drops green chutney on Popatlal’s new clothes. Tapu and Sony try to get the stain off his clothes. Will they be successful?

episodesList.title: Chintamani Piche Padh Gaya
episodesList.summary: Chintamani gets all his health tests done and shows his reports to Dr Hathi. Tapu takes Champaklal to Dr Hathi because he is not well. Will Champakal feel better after consulting Dr Hathi?

episodesList.title: Danger Bhai
episodesList.summary: Dr Hathi tells his friends that he is fed up with Chintamani. Dr Hathi gets to know that Chitamani has fainted and is admitted to a hospital. Later, a man named Danger bhai comes to Gokuldham and looks for Dr Hathi.

episodesList.title: Dr Hathi Ki Talaash
episodesList.summary: Sodhi gets into a fight with Danger Bhai. Danger Bhai asks Bhide about Dr Hathi’s house. Later, Danger Bhai decides to give an injection to Dr Hathi that would make him unconscious. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Khoj Jaari Hai
episodesList.summary: The goons look for Dr Hathi but are unable to find him but Danger Bhai is not ready to give up. Later, Danger Bhai’s men tell him that they couldn't search Champaklal’s house because he didn’t open the gate. Is Dr Hathi hiding there?

episodesList.title: Iyer Ne Saath Chodha
episodesList.summary: Champaklal tries to explain to Danger Bhai that Dr Hathi is a good doctor. Danger Bhai threatens all the men of Gokuldham society to get them to speak the truth. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Vs. Danger Bhai
episodesList.summary: Iyer locks up Danger Bhai and his men inside the clubhouse and they try to break down the door. Later, Champaklal asks everyone to get things from their house that can be used as weapons. Who will win this fight?

episodesList.title: Inspector Panday Stops Danger Bhai
episodesList.summary: Inspector Panday and his team arrive on time and save Champaklal from Danger Bhai’s injection. Later, Danger Bhai asks Inspector Panday to arrest Dr Hathi also for giving wrong medicine to his brother. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Galat Dawai Ki Kahani
episodesList.summary: Abdul tells everyone how he hid Dr Hathi from Danger Bhai and called Inspector Panday to save Dr Hathi. Later, Dr Hathi tells Inspector Panday what actually happened with Danger Bhai’s brother, Chintamani. Will Danger Bhai forgive Dr Hathi?

episodesList.title: Soch Acchi Rakho
episodesList.summary: Chintamani’s kids tell everyone that Chintamani is okay and get to know that Dr Hathi had nothing to do with Chintamani fainting. Later, all Gokuldham members talk to Chintamani and give him hope.

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ke Peeth Piche Hua Drama
episodesList.summary: Jethalal comes back to Gokuldham society and Bhide tells him what happened in the society when he was not there. Later, Chintamani comes to the Gokuldham society with another health problem. What will Dr Hathi do now?

episodesList.title: Bhagwat Geeta Ka Shlok
episodesList.summary: Sonu makes Bhide’s tension go away and asks him to write a shlok from Bhagwat Geeta on the society board. Bhide decides to test Tapu Sena. Later, Bhide and Tapu get into a fight.

episodesList.title: Tapu Ki Maafi
episodesList.summary: Bhide and Jethalal get into a fight when Bhide tells Jethalal that Tapu insulted him. Tapu apologises to Bhide for talking back to him and tells him that Tapu Sena won’t do Dahi Handi this year. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Iccha Purti Matki
episodesList.summary: A monk comes to Gokuldham society’s temple and gives Tapu Sena an Iccha Purti Matki and says whoever breaks it on Janmashtami his wishes will come true. Who will get to break this matki?

episodesList.title: Emergency Society Meeting
episodesList.summary: Madhavi tells Mahila Mandal about the Iccha Purti matki while Popatlal gets angry because no one told him about the society’s emergency meeting. Later, everyone gets excited about Iccha Purti matki.

episodesList.title: Matki Phodne Ka Decision
episodesList.summary: Champaklal tells Jethalal about Iccha Purti matki. Later, everyone gathers for the emergency meeting and waits for Bhide. What is taking Bhide so long?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Society Janmashtami Mahotsav
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham Society members unanimously agree to let Popatlal break the Iccha Purti matki on Janmashtami and wish for a happily married life. However, Popatlal decides to do something else with the matki. What is he planning?

episodesList.title: Iccha Purti Matki Ke Rules
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham society celebrates Janmashthami. Later, each family can put down only one name from their family for Iccha Purti matki. Who will get this golden chance?

episodesList.title: Ek Pareshaan Parivar
episodesList.summary: Everyone is excited to know who will break the Iccha Purti matki. Later, a couple comes to Gokuldham society and tells everyone that their son has only a few days left to live.

episodesList.title: Sabne Chintan Ko Chuna
episodesList.summary: Everyone asks Chintan to break the Iccha Purti matki. Tapu Sena helps him break the matki but he keeps falling down. Will he be able to break the matki?

episodesList.title: Sabka Bhala Socho
episodesList.summary: Chintan reveals that he didn’t pray for his good health while breaking the matki. Later, all the Gokuldham men sit and chat at the clubhouse, but Jethalal is missing. Where is he?

episodesList.title: B.K. Su
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham men talk about business. Jethalal tells Champakal that Tapu is still young to join the business. Later, Jethalal doesn’t agree with Bhide’s message on the society board. What does the message say?

episodesList.title: Paryushan Ki Shuruaat
episodesList.summary: Tapu tells Champaklal that he wants to take him to Palitana. On arriving at his shop, Jethalal is happy to see it full of customers but short-staffed. Later, Bagha makes a mistake while accepting a payment. How will Jethalal react?

episodesList.title: Imaandari
episodesList.summary: Bagha tells Bawri that Gada Electronis lost ten thousand rupees because of his mistake and Bawri decides to help them. Later, Nattu Kaka finds out something suspicious in the office account. What is it?

episodesList.title: Workload Se Pareshaan
episodesList.summary: Jethalal gets worried when he finds out that Dhanraj Seth has not given other people’s money either. Later, Taarak gives advice to Jethalal to keep a manager in his shop to divide the workload. How will Nattu Kaka and Bagha react to this?

episodesList.title: Manager Naam Ki Tension
episodesList.summary: Jethalal's friends urge him to keep a manager for the shop. Meanwhile, Nattu Kaka says that he will leave his job at Gada Electronics if Jethalal hires a new manager. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Badla Bartav
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is looking for a manager for his shop while Nattu Kaka’s behaviour changes towards Jethalal. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell Jethalal they will leave their jobs if he keeps a manager. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Bawri Ki Pariksha
episodesList.summary: Jethalal imagines what it would be like if he hired Bawri as a manager. Later, Jethalal asks Bawri to give a test so he can decide if she’s fit to become a manager or not. Will Bawri pass the test?

episodesList.title: Payment Mila Ya Nahi?
episodesList.summary: Bagha eagerly waits for Bawri to return with the payment. Later, Bawri tells everyone that she didn’t get the payment from Dhanraj Seth. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Freelancer Bawri
episodesList.summary: Bawri tells Jethalal she doesn’t want to work at Gada Electronics and that she can do freelancing whenever Gada Electronics needs her. Later, Bagha and Nattu Kaka apologise to Jethalal for their behaviour.

episodesList.title: Kharab Speaker
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tells Bagha and Nattu Kaka that he doesn’t like the mega bumper sale written outside Gada Electronics. Later, Tapu Sena takes Gokuldham’s speaker to Gada Electronics to get it repaired.

episodesList.title: Secret Decoration
episodesList.summary: Bhide scolds Tapu Sena for buying a new speaker without knowing that it’s a gift from Jethalal. Later, Tapu Sena helps set up the mandap for Ganesh Chaturthi.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Ganesh Ji
episodesList.summary: All Gokuldham members share their tea with Taarak. Later, they celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi in full swing.

episodesList.title: Sonu Ki Surprise Performance
episodesList.summary: Bhide wants Sonu to tell him about her Ganesh Chaturthi performance while everyone is excited about Sonu’s surprise performance. What is Sonu’s surprise?

episodesList.title: Mani Brothers Ki Surprise Visit
episodesList.summary: Sonu impresses everyone with her magnificent performance. Later, Danger Bhai and Chintamani visit Gokuldham society and give gifts to everyone.

episodesList.title: Bhagwan Ke Abhushan Ki Raksha
episodesList.summary: Sodhi, Abdul and Tapu Sena decide to stay near the pandal to protect the jewels while a family hides from them to go inside the mandap. Are they here to steal or do they have some other motive?

episodesList.title: Parivar Ke Bhes Mein Chor
episodesList.summary: Bhide has a very scary dream that all the precious jewels get stolen. Tapu Sena, Sodhi and Abdul find Bhakti’s parents near the mandap. What were they doing?

episodesList.title: Anghoti Mil Gayi
episodesList.summary: Bhakti doesn’t sleep at all in the night. Gokuldham members look for Bhakti’s father’s ring in the morning. Later, Tapu discloses that Anjali and Babita are going to do aarti nritya.

episodesList.title: Anjali And Babita's Dance
episodesList.summary: Bhakti’s parents try to find an excuse to go to Gokuldham society. Anjali and Babita are excited about their performance. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Ganpati Ki Param Bhakt
episodesList.summary: Dr Hathi checks Bhakti while Bhakti’s parents are worried about Gokuldham members finding out the truth. Later, Gokuldham members ask Bhakti’s parents why they don’t want to leave Gokuldham society. Will they tell the truth?

episodesList.title: Bhakti Ka Vachan
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham residents are unable to decide whether they should let Bhakti stay in the society or not. However, Bhakti is not willing to leave without playing Garba with Ganpati Bappa. Will her wish come true?

episodesList.title: Zidd Ya Bhakti?
episodesList.summary: Bawri asks Komal if she can sing Stuti Bhajan with her in the evening. Bhakti refuses to eat or drink anything. Later, Gokuldham members meet to find a solution for Bhakti.

episodesList.title: Bhakti's Wishes
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham members find a way to make Bhakti’s wishes come true. Later, Gokuldham members gather and wait for Bhakti to arrive. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Goli Ka Naya Roop
episodesList.summary: Bawri sings beautifully. Bhakti asks Gokuldham members to leave because she thinks Ganesh ji wants to dance only with her. Later, Goli dresses up as Ganesh ji.

episodesList.title: Bhakti Ka Sapna Hua Pura
episodesList.summary: Bhakti gets very happy and gets emotional when she sees her god with her own eyes. Later, Bhakti calls Gokuldham members to meet her god. Is this Goli in God's clothes or someone else?

episodesList.title: Goli Ka Confusion
episodesList.summary: Goli celebrates with Bhakti and dances with her. Goli gets stuck in traffic and gets confused when he finds out someone has replaced him during the celebration. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Is Blessed
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham members feel blessed by god and they all thank Bhakti for it. Later, everyone gets the same dream about a god. What is the dream?

episodesList.title: Babita Ki Dost
episodesList.summary: Jethalal bumps into Champaklal and Champaklal gets angry. Popatlal meets Babita’s friend and tries to impress her. Will she be impressed by Popatlal?

episodesList.title: Chai Ne Bigadi Deal
episodesList.summary: Jethalal orders tea and accidentally spills it on his client, Vicky, who gets angry and insults Jethalal. Later, Jethalal finds out that Vicky is Babita’s friend’s husband. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Babita Bani Mediator
episodesList.summary: Jethalal and Vicky start fighting in front of Babita and Nisha. Babita tries to resolve the issue between Jethalal and Vicky. Will she succeed in doing so?

episodesList.title: Vicky Ka Cheque
episodesList.summary: Jethalal brings sweets for Taarak and tells him about his big deal and how everything went smoothly. Later, Nattu Kaka tells Jethalal that there’s some issue with Vicky’s cheque that he gave Jethalal. What will Jethalal do now?

episodesList.title: Shiny Dandiya Sticks
episodesList.summary: Jethalal thinks there’s a ghost in his house. Tapu shows his glow in the dark dandiya sticks to Jethalal but Jethalal feels these sticks can be risky. Later, Jethalal scolds Bagha and Bawri when he overhears their conversation.

episodesList.title: Ziddi Box
episodesList.summary: Bhide protects his clothes from getting ruined as he’s meeting Amit for a new order. Later, Popatlal asks everyone to open a box, but no one is able to open it. What is in the box?

episodesList.title: Navratri Ke Liya Budget Nahi Hai
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham men open Popatlal’s box and end up spilling everything that was inside the box. Bhide tells Tapu Sena they don't have a budget to celebrate Navratri this year. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Sabse Pehele Aya Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Jethalal arrives at the meeting spot before everyone else and decides to hide and hear what Bhide says behind his back. Later, Bhide asks Jethalal to prove that he is the first one to arrive for the meeting.

episodesList.title: Bina Budget Ki Navratri
episodesList.summary: Bhide gets angry when Popatlal asks him what he does with the society's budget. Tapu Sena comes up with a solution to Navratri on zero budget. Later, Bhide wants to know about Tapu Sena’s surprise.

episodesList.title: Artists Kaha Hai?
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena welcomes all the Gokuldham members in their own unique style to Gokuldham’s Navratri function. Everyone is waiting for the artists to come and perform at the function. Will they reach the society on time?

episodesList.title: Cheque Pass Hoga Ya Nahi?
episodesList.summary: Taarak and Jethalal are worried about whether Jethalal will get his money from Babita’s friend on time or not. Later, Anjali gets angry when she finds unhealthy food in Taarak’s bag. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Payment Ki Tension
episodesList.summary: Babita's friend Vicky tears the cheque in front of Jethalal. Meanwhile, a phone call from Jethalal gets Taarak into trouble with his boss.

episodesList.title: Gift Ki Khoj
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is confused about what to gift Babita. Later, Jethalal gets a bouquet for Babita but Iyer is allergic to flowers. What will Jethalal gift Babita?

episodesList.title: The Perfect Gift
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is in distress as he struggles to find the right gift  and consults all his neighbours. Will he find the right gift?

episodesList.title: Babita Ka Mushkil Gift
episodesList.summary: Anjali gets upset with Taarak for not giving her gifts while Jethalal dreams about Babita’s gift. Later, Jethalal asks Sundar about Daya.

episodesList.title: Chand Par Zameen
episodesList.summary: Sundar tells Jethalal that he’s getting a piece of land on the moon at a very small price and asks Jethalal to give him the money for the same. What will Jethalal do now?

episodesList.title: NASA Se Call
episodesList.summary: Bagha and Nattu Kaka tell customers about their festive special offers. Later, Jethalal gets a call from NASA. What is this call about?

episodesList.title: Moon Residential Program
episodesList.summary: Bagha urges Jethalal to buy land on the moon as a good investment opportunity. Will this be a wise decision for Jethalal?

episodesList.title: Chand Par Padosi
episodesList.summary: Chand Bhai convinces Jethalal to buy three plots on the moon. How will Babita and Gokuldham members react when they find out about this?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ka Zabardast Surprise
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tells Babita he has a big surprise for her and asks everyone to come to the clubhouse in the evening. How will everyone react when they find out about Jethalal’s surprise?

episodesList.title: Babita Ke Liye Best Gift
episodesList.summary: Jethalal tells Babita about his surprise in a very special way. How will everyone react to this?

episodesList.title: Sapna Reh Gaya Sapna
episodesList.summary: Jethalal realises he had slept and he dreamt about buying land on the moon. Jethalal goes to the Moon Residential Program office. Will he buy land on the moon now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ka Sapna Toota
episodesList.summary: Jethalal asks Popatlal not to tell anyone that he wanted to buy land on the moon. Jethalal is upset because he couldn’t fulfil Babita’s wish. What will he do now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Surprise Gift
episodesList.summary: Jethalal finally brings a surprise gift for Babita with Taarak's help. Will Babita like the gift?

episodesList.title: Diwali Ki Tayariyan
episodesList.summary: Sodhi plays a prank on Bhide and steals society’s notice board. Gokuldham members want Daya to come back and make their Diwali even more special. When is Daya coming back?

episodesList.title: Diwali Ka Maahol
episodesList.summary: Bhide gets angry at Tapu for throwing water at him. Bhide goes to stop Tapu Sena from wasting water but falls down. Later, Taarak surprises Anjali with a present.

episodesList.title: Surprise Dham
episodesList.summary: Mahila Mandal goes to Jethalal’s house to find out when is Daya coming back while Champaklal’s friend pulls Champaklal’s leg. Will they find out the exact date when Daya is coming back?

episodesList.title: Sundar Ko Phone Lagao
episodesList.summary: Jethalal meets a customer who’s in a similar problem as him as his wife is also not coming home. Bagha, Nattu Kaka and Jethalal try to contact Sundar to ask about Daya. Will they get in touch with him?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Gets Impatient
episodesList.summary: Jethalal talks to Daya’s acquaintance and asks him to go to Daya’s house and make him talk to her. Later, Jethalal and Bagha try to call Sundar from an unknown number. Will he pick up the call now?

episodesList.title: Sundar Ka Vaada
episodesList.summary: Jethalal is worried that Sundar may not keep his promise. He makes plans to travel to Ahmedabad himself, along with Taarak, to bring Daya back.

episodesList.title: Apradhi Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Tapu books tickets for Jethalal and Taarak for Ahmedabad to bring Daya back home. Later, police arrive at the Gokuldham Society to arrest Jethalal. How will Jethalal go to Ahmedabad now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ne Kara Kya Hai?
episodesList.summary: Police come to arrest Jethalal while he talks in his sleep. Later, everyone wants to know what crime Jethalal has committed.

episodesList.title: Reason Kya Hai?
episodesList.summary: Inspector Panday is not telling anyone why he’s arresting Jethalal and Gokuldham members protest against it. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Humne Kisko Dhamkaya?
episodesList.summary: Mahila Mandal prays for Jethalal while Jethalal finds Bagha and Nattu Kaka in jail. Why are they in jail?

episodesList.title: ACP Ki Biwi Ko Di Dhamki
episodesList.summary: Inspector Panday informs Jethalal that he has been accused of threatening ACP Prithvi's wife, Jagruti, from Ahmedabad. Jethalal denies these allegations. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Ke Khilaaf Complaint
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham Society members arrive at the police station to convince Inspector Panday to let Jethalal go. Will Inspector Panday listen to them?

episodesList.title: Misunderstanding Clear Karo
episodesList.summary: Jethalal explains to ACP Prithvi that his messages were intended for Sundar, not Jagruti, and apologizes for any misunderstanding. Surprisingly, ACP Prithvi and his wife are revealed to be Daya's family friends. Will they withdraw their complaint against Jethalal?
