episodesList.summary: As Gokuldham residents urge Bawri to marry Balam, she revisits her cherished memories with Bagha. Will she be able to move on?

episodesList.title: Bawri And Balam's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Will Bawri say yes and get engaged to Balam, or will her heart choose a different path?

episodesList.title: Balam's Hidden Truth
episodesList.summary: As Bawri and Bagha end up in the same hospital, will Balam finally confess that he was the one who separated them?

episodesList.title: A Sweet Get-Together
episodesList.summary: With Abdul's shop closed, the Purush Mandali heads to Jethalal's house with ice cream, but Tapu and Babuji surprise them with a fun prank.

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Shop Gets Sealed
episodesList.summary: Jethalal arrives at the shop early, expecting a surprise from Natu Kaka and Bagha, but is left shocked to find the shop sealed. Who is behind it?

episodesList.title: Jethalal's Difficult Situation
episodesList.summary: As Iyer and Babita Ji bring their friend to the shop, Jethalal is left wondering how to manage the situation with the shop sealed.

episodesList.title: Taarak Mehta's Efforts to Help Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Taarak Mehta, Bagha, and Natu Kaka try to find the notice behind the shop sealing, but they discover that no notice was given. What will Jethalal do now?

episodesList.title: An Unexpected Twist For Jethalal
episodesList.summary: Even after Jethalal pays the fine, the municipal officials reveal they never sealed his shop. If not them, who put up the seal?

episodesList.title: Rita Reporter Reaches The Shop
episodesList.summary: After a customer informs Rita Reporter about Jethalal's sealed shop, she rushes to cover the story, but Natu Kaka and Bagha try to stop her.

episodesList.title: Jethalal In Deep Trouble
episodesList.summary: Clients are demanding payments, and rumors of Jethalal running away are spreading fast. How will he clear his name now?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Faces Babuji's Anger
episodesList.summary: After learning that Jethalal's shop has been sealed, Babuji loses his temper and tells him to leave the house. How will Jethalal handle this difficult situation?

episodesList.title: Pandey Ji On the Case
episodesList.summary: Jethalal turns to Inspector Pandey Ji for help. Will he uncover who was really behind sealing Jethalal's shop?

episodesList.title: Monika Visits Gada Electronics
episodesList.summary: Monika arrives at Gada Electronics, but Pandey Ji says the shop is sealed. How will Jethalal handle the situation, and will Monika still give him the agency?

episodesList.title: Jethalal Is Finally Proven Innocent
episodesList.summary: Pandey Ji informs Jethalal that he is innocent, as the tax was unpaid by another shop owner, and due to a mistake, Gada Electronics was wrongly sealed.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Searches For The Bhide Family
episodesList.summary: Bhide leaves overnight with his family. The next morning, Popatlal finds their house empty and their phones switched off, leaving the Gokuldham family wondering where the Bhide family has gone.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Waits For Bhide
episodesList.summary: Bhide stays at his uncle's house due to an unexpected dispute, while Madhvi and Sonu return to Gokuldham. As the renovation work remains pending, everyone in Gokuldham eagerly waits for Bhide to return.

episodesList.title: Bhide’s Important Meeting
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Mandal wonders what Bhide is going to say in the meeting, and even Madhvi has no idea. As all the Gokuldham members gather, everyone eagerly waits to see what happens in the meeting.

episodesList.title: Chachaji’s Special Selection
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Gokuldham is curious to know who Chachaji will choose for the Muh Dikhayi ceremony.

episodesList.title: Bhide’s Surprise For Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: The members of Gokuldham Society are excited about the Muh Dikhayi ceremony and eager to discover Bhide's surprise. What special surprise has Bhide planned?

episodesList.title: Veer & Bansari Take Center Stage
episodesList.summary: Champak Chacha entrusts Veer and Bansari with the honor of performing the Mukh Dikhayi ceremony, declaring that they represent the future of Gokuldham Society.

episodesList.title: One More Surprise From Bhide
episodesList.summary: The renovation work is finally complete, and everyone is happy to see the new Gokuldham Society. But Bhide has one more surprise waiting for everyone.

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Gets A Surprise Guest
episodesList.summary: As Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah celebrates 18 glorious years, everyone shares their heartfelt thoughts. Just then, Asit Modi announces a special guest, leaving everyone excited to find out who it is.

episodesList.title: Spider-Man In Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: The residents of Gokuldham Society warmly welcome Spider-Man. His presence fills everyone with joy as he interacts with each member.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Memories Together
episodesList.summary: Gokuldham relives some of the most memorable moments from Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah, bringing back old memories and special emotions.

episodesList.title: Bhide's Unexpected Problem
episodesList.summary: The Gokuldham men's group praises Bhide for the successful renovation, but he suddenly reveals that a new problem has arisen. What could it be?

episodesList.title: Bhide Gets A Surprise Gift
episodesList.summary: After the Purush Mandal praises Bhide for the society's renovation, the Mahila Mandal and Tapu Sena plan a special surprise for him at his house.

episodesList.title: Bhide In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Everyone praises Bhide's management, but new renovation charges leave him stressed. Will he protect his promise to society members?

episodesList.title: Bhide's Tough Decision
episodesList.summary: After learning he owes the contractor an extra ₹5 lakh for the society's renovation, Bhide tells Madhavi, who urges him to seek Taarak's help. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Bhide Gets Pranked
episodesList.summary: A prank on the society's renovation budget leaves Bhide stressed and confused as Gokuldham members enjoy his hilarious reactions.

episodesList.title: Madhavi's Pickle Order
episodesList.summary: Jethalal learns that his friend wants Madhavi Bhabhi's pickles. Soon, the Bhide family gets busy preparing and delivering the order.

episodesList.title: Bhide's Pickle Delivery Hassle
episodesList.summary: Bhide heads to the market for lemons and chillies, while Madhavi seeks Roopa's help. Can the Bhide family complete the order on time?

episodesList.title: Bhide Family's Big Win
episodesList.summary: The Bhide Family successfully delivers all pickle orders on time and receives great feedback, leaving Bhide delighted with their achievement.

episodesList.title: Madhavi's Pickle Trouble
episodesList.summary: Madhavi fears a piece of her bangle broke in the pickle. Tapu Sena panics as Bhide faces an FDA raid. Will it be found, or will FDA charges follow?

episodesList.title: Gokuldham Stands By The Bhide Family
episodesList.summary: Madhavi’s pickle licence is at risk, prompting Gokuldham Society members to unite and help the Bhide family overcome the crisis.

episodesList.title: Duplicate Pickle Scandal
episodesList.summary: A counterfeit of Madhavi's pickle product hits the market, leaving the Bhide family in trouble. Will the FDA uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Bhide & Family Win The Pickle Case
episodesList.summary: It's a relief for the Gokuldham society as the truth behind the duplicate pickle unfolds.

episodesList.title: Popatlal's Bride
episodesList.summary: Abdul sparks total confusion among Chachaji and the Mahila Mandal after spotting Popatlal carrying a bride in his arms.

episodesList.title: Popatlal Manifests His Bride
episodesList.summary: Popatlal manifests his future wife with a statue and asks the Purush Mandali to choose a photo to showcase.

episodesList.title: Bhide Becomes Popatlal’s Target
episodesList.summary: The Mahila Mandal helps Popatlal choose a photo and reveals Bhide’s role. Later, Popatlal playfully scares Bhide at the soda shop.

episodesList.title: Bapuji’s Chain Disappears
episodesList.summary: Madhavi’s earrings go missing, followed by Bapuji’s gold chain. The compound springs into action, but can the missing chain be found?

episodesList.title: Goli Finds A Surprise
episodesList.summary: The search for Madhvi’s earrings turns chaotic as Goli discovers money and sweets, but the earrings remain missing and the house becomes a mess!

episodesList.title: Gokuldham’s Mysterious Theft
episodesList.summary: As another theft shocks Gokuldham, the Purush Mandali gathers to investigate who's behind the incidents.

episodesList.title: Gold Vanishes From Gokuldham
episodesList.summary: Jethalal wakes up to find Bapuji’s gold chain missing, while Babita Ji’s gold bracelet also disappears, leaving everyone shocked.

episodesList.title: The Theft Investigation Begins
episodesList.summary: Bhide informs police about the theft, and Inspector Chalu Pandey arrives soon after to investigate the case and search for clues.

episodesList.title: Bhide Calls A Night Meeting
episodesList.summary: Inspector Chalu Pandey finds the same theft pattern and begins searching for the culprit. Later, Bhide calls a night meeting to plan precautions.

episodesList.title: Tapu Thinks Of A Clever Plan
episodesList.summary: Everyone is worried about the theft and comes up with different ideas, but Tapu suddenly gets a plan that could change everything.

episodesList.title: Jethalal’s One Thought Creates Panic
episodesList.summary: Everyone gathers for a meeting at the clubhouse, but when Jethalal points out the risk of a theft at home, everyone suddenly rushes back!

episodesList.title: Dr. Haathi’s Secret Gold Stash
episodesList.summary: During the meeting, Iyer suggests taking turns guarding the society in pairs for an hour each night. Afterward, everyone hurries home to secure their gold in secret hiding spots.

episodesList.title: Tapu Sena On Guard
episodesList.summary: Tapu Sena keeps a close watch on Gokuldham as everyone stays alert for the mysterious thief. Will they finally catch the culprit?

episodesList.title: Purush Mandali On Guard
episodesList.summary: The Purush Mandali asks Tapu Sena to rest and takes over the night watch to catch the thief and stop the thefts in Gokuldham Society. Will they succeed?

episodesList.title: Jethalal catches the thief
episodesList.summary: Taarak and Jethalal catch a masked man using itching powder and a blanket, but their victory turns awkward when they discover Inspector Chalu Pandey.

plotHtml:
The series is set in Mumbai and follows the lives of the residents of Gokuldham Co-operative Housing Society, a diverse community with people from different cultural and regional backgrounds.
Most storylines focus on an individual, a family, or sometimes the entire society as they encounter and resolve various problems. The characters frequently support one another and celebrate festivals together, highlighting their close-knit bond.
A recurring theme centers on Jethalal Champaklal Gada, who often finds himself in comical situations and troubles, with brief moments of relief before new challenges arise.
tagline: Problems Toh Hain Sabke Saath, Bas Nazariye Ki Hain Baat!

title: Tamil Pechu Engal Moochu
summary:
Tamil Pechu Engal Moochu (தமிழ் பேச்சு எங்க மூச்சு) is an Indian Tamil-language reality competition. The show is based on speaking Tamil letters, words, and sentences. The channel started taking auditions for this season through online audition registration. Then the offline auditions took place in Chennai, Madurai, Salem, Coimbatore, Trichy and Tirunelveli, and ended in 2022. 
The show's first season aired on Star Vijay in 2008. The new season scheduled to premiere on every Sunday at 11:30 from 16 April 2023. The show was hosted by Anitha Sampath. The show's final episode aired 15 August 2023 and ended with 19 episodes.

articleSections.title: Final
articleSections.text:
The final episode was aired on 15 August 2023 in Indian Independence Day. The show special third guest was Suki Sivam with special guest was Suba Veerapandian, Pa. Vijay, Bava Chelladurai, Selventhiran and Salma.

title: Thekkathi Ponnu
summary:
Thekkathi Ponnu is a 2008 Tamil soap opera that aired on Kalaignar TV. The show premiered on 14 April 2008 and aired Monday through Friday at 8:30PM IST. The show starred Napoleon, Ranjitha, Swarnamalya, Chandrasekhar and Bhuvaneswari.
The show was directed by Bharathiraja and it marked his television debut as director. It was produced by P. Jayaraj under Manoj Creations. It had been receiving the highest ratings of Tamil serials and received high praising from viewers. The show last aired on 20 September 2011 and ended with 750 episodes.
plot: The story of three villages, three families and three generations. And the generations-long conflict between the families of Napoleon and Chandrasekhar. Another aspect of the story is to portray village girls and how they possess gender equality without having to fight for it the way girls in towns and cities have to. The serial would like to show how, in work and relationships and family, women in villages seem to share more equally in villages.

title: Tujko Hai Salaam Zindgi
summary: Tujhko Hai Salaam Zindagi (transl. Life Salute to You) is an Indian daily television series which premiered on 10 December 2007 on Sony TV. It takes the audience through the journey of Manya, an effervescent, energetic, and fun-filled girl. The series is produced by Sphere Origins.
plot:
The show focuses on the life of the protagonist Manya, who has grown up with simple dreams...while at the moment she's just immersed herself in what her biggest passion - dance. The story takes a twist when Manya's biggest passion – dancing, clashes with the dreams of her grandfather, whose greatest loss was of his son who was a police inspector. Manya realizes her grandfather's dreams and leaves aside all her desires and firmly decides on becoming a successful police inspector. She makes a choice and faces all odds of the consequences of her actions.
To fulfill the dreams of her grandfather, Manya comes to the academy and is a complete underdog there. Her journey of gaining acceptance in the academy and ultimately going on to win the highest honour at the academy - the sword of honour and Manya finally becomes a cop, but her challenges are far from over...
In March 2008 three months into the show Sony cancelled the serial due to low TRPs (ratings).

title: Thirumathi Selvam
summary:
Thirumathi Selvam (transl. Mrs. Selvam) is a 2007 Tamil television soap opera directed by S. Kumaran and produced by Radhika Srinivasan & B. Srinivasan for Vikatan Televistas. It stars Sanjeev and Abitha in the lead roles with Rindhya, Gautami and Vadivukkarasi played supporting roles. It premiered on 5 November 2007 and initially aired weekday afternoons on Sun TV, before being moved to 8PM on 1 December 2008. The serial ended on 22 March 2013 with 1360 episodes. Thirumathi Selvam is currently re-airing on Kalaignar TV from 29 March 2021.
The story revolves around the lead character Selvam and showed how his good qualities, hard work, and love for his wife Archana and care for his best friend Nandhini and how that made him reach great heights. Then, it shows how money, fame, and power lead to his downfall.
The serial was remade in Hindi as Pavitra Rishta under Balaji Telefilms, which aired on Zee TV, in Telugu as Devatha, Kannada as Jokali and in Malayalam as Nilavilakku which aired from 2009 to 2013 on Surya TV.
plot: The story revolves around Selvam, an uneducated mechanic and Archana, and how their lives intertwine after an arranged marriage. Selvam hails from a lower-middle class family. His family consists of his father Poongavanam, his step-mother Bhagyam, younger half-siblings Vasu and Rani. Poongavanam is a useless man who spends his days drinking and Selvam is the sole-breadwinner. Bhagayam genuinely loves Selvam and they all live united. Periyavar is Poongavanam's older brother who lives in another house and is well-respected by the family. Nandini is a rich girl who is Selvam's childhood friend who secretly likes him but Selvam does not harbour any feelings for her. Meanwhile, Archana hails from a well-to-do middle class family. Her parents Sivaraman and Sivagami care about Archana, who had stopped her studies so that her younger siblings can study well. Her older brother Vinoth is married to Jayanthi, a cunning woman, and they have a daughter. Archana's younger sisters are Kaviya and Priya. Jayanthi wants her older brother, Dina to marry Archana by faking his credentials but he is found to be a drug smuggler and they marriage is halted, which causes friction for Jayanthi between Sivagami and Vinoth. Even, Jayanthi's mother Sinthamani hates Archana. To take revenge, Jayanthi and Sinthamani meet Selvam's family and try to reason with them to fake his studies and employment as a graduate and engineer to get Archana married. Selvam had seen Archana before and falls for her and thus, Periyavar too accepts to cheat the family for better. It is only after marriage Archana learns the truth. She stays with her mother but goes back to Selvam's house after Periyavar apologises and all. Sivagami hates Selvam and ill-treats him on many occasions. Archana slowly starts to settle and the two unite. Vasu runs away with Revathy who is the daughter of a high-profile man. Soon, Bhagyam is brainwashed by Sinthamani and she starts hating Selvam. Things take turn, and Selvam and Archana leave the house. Nandini and Selvam's friend help them and they start a car re-sale business which blooms and Selvam becomes wealthy. Everyone accepts all but Selvam's attitude starts changing. He starts suspecting Archana. All this is caused by Nandini, who feels insulted after Sivagami slaps her publicly for interfering in Selvam and Archana's lives. Many things occurs and Archana leaves Selvam and unites with a do-gooder Karunaikumar. Archana's parents and Bhagyam dies and Nandini dies too after Selvam kills her for cheating him and learning of all truths. Selvam gets arrested and loses his fortunes. He then returns to Archana a year later after his release and is alone. Archana rejects and berates him and even his father and siblings side with Archana. Selvam is left alone and even Siva and his wife don't care about him. Selvam sits under the same tree where he only had his tools to repair cars after he is kicked out of his house by Bhagyam, and this time around, Archana is not with him and he has nothing in his life.

title: Teen Bahuraaniyaan
summary: Teen Bahuraniyaan (International title: Three Daughters-in-Law) is a 2007 Indian television series depicting the story of three daughters-in-law of different cultural backgrounds living as a family in one house. The series was broadcast on Zee TV.
plot:
The married couples are Rohit and Bindiya; Sameer and Janki; Mahesh and Manjeet (Payal)
Teen Bahuraniyaan takes a major twist, when Mahesh marries Payal, after the death of Manjeet due to blood cancer. As Kajal (Payal's sister) was going to marry Mahesh, the report was out that she was pregnant with someone else's child. Mahesh ended up marrying Payal, Kajal's younger sister. Kajal was furious and commits suicide. However, her spirit comes back and start to make the Gheewala family and especially Bindiya and tries to make Payal's life as hell. She occupies Bindiya's body and she tortures her so much that Bindiya was scared to death and before her target was only the Gheewala family. As Kunjbala (her bhua) took Payal's side, she got even furious and tries to kill her as well but the thaaveez (a note added to a thread and that is blessed by God) saves her. After the incident, the family call Trikal Baba and, with his help, they trap Kajal's evil spirit. After all the havoc, the three couples decide to go on a holiday trip but are unaware that they are being followed by terrorists. A grand mask party takes place. All couples are dancing to the song "Darde disco". Sameer, Rohit, and Mahesh go to get some drinks when a huge bomb blast happens. Janki screams and sees two dead bodies wearing watches just like the one Sameer was wearing. She faints and is taken to the hospital. The whole family rushes to see her. There they find Payal, Bindiya, and Janki. Two of the sons are dead, but they don't know which ones.
The bodies of the sons are burnt by G kaka. The people who come for the prayers tell the Geewala family that the daughters-in-law should be here and they should from now on only wear white saris as they are widows. Janki, Payal, and Bindiya arrive wearing red saris and heavy jewelry. Everyone is shocked. The three say that they won't wear white saris until it is found out who is dead and who isn't. Indira, Kokila, and Bhavna support their daughters-in-law. The bahuraniyaans go to the 'mandir'. Janki gets into an accident and that is where they reveal Sameer is alive.
Sameer gets up; he has lost his memory. Janki is trying to explain that Sameer is alive, but no one wants to believe her. Janki has a sixth sense and can find out the future. She saves Bindiya from a falling chandelier. She sees a mandir and Sameer running. She also sees Payal in a white sari gagged and tied up. All of these come true. Later she sees a wedding and Bindiya getting married again. Bhavna and Kokila think Janki finally went crazy and try to set her straight. Sameer breaks into the Gheewala house not knowing it is his home. Janki tries to catch him, but Sameer runs away. She tells Bhavna, and Bhavna gets mad. Janki goes to Bindiya's room to persuade her to mary Jatin because then Sameer would return home. Bhavna brings people from the mental asylum to take Janki away; Bindiya stops them. Bindiya is ready to marry and everybody is shocked.
Jatin and Shaguna's real identity comes to face at the marriage venue and they run away from the police. Everyone is happy to see Sameer as he told the truth about Shaguna and Jatin. Sameer swears to bring Rohit and Mahesh back. Everyone is praying when all three sons return and a new life starts in Gheewala parrivar, but G kaka is dead. The family receives money in the mail. Bindiya tells everyone that she is thinking about buying a car with that money; the family is saying that they will need that money later. Their husbands are feeding them because they are pregnant. They all live happily ever after.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text:
Teen Bahuraniyaan is a tale of three bahus (daughters-in-law) — Manjeet (Payal), Bindiya, and Janki; who come from different backgrounds and now live under one roof with the Gheewala parivar (family). They are an upper-class Gujarati joint family living in Ahmedabad. Their lives pass through distinct ups and downs as they share different equations and are at different levels with their in-laws and other family members. Keeping alive their personal interests the bahuraniyaas tackle day-to-day affairs in their own way and manner. They manage to fight against what is wrong and prove themselves worthy of the Gheewala parivar. The daughters-in-law attempt to maintain peace in the family but face challenges from outside and within, particularly from their mother-in-law, whose selfish behavior threatens to destroy the unity and peace.
Within this seriousness, each episode usually features a great deal of comedy, making the show appealing to a wide range of audience.

title: Thodi Si Zameen Thoda Sa Aasmaan
wikiTitle: Thodi Si Zameen Thoda Sa Aasmaan
summary: Thodi Si Zameen Thoda Sa Aasmaan (transl. A Little bit of Land, A Little bit of Sky) is an Indian television show broadcast on STAR Plus. The series was produced by Smriti Irani along with Ekta Kapoor. It aired during weekends from 19 August 2006 to 2 September 2007.
plot:
A factory's workers have lost their job as the factory has shut down. Uma (Smriti Irani) has to work hard to run her family as her father and brother have lost their jobs.
Uma tries to motivate the people of her locality to work hard to conform various roles in the running of a mall, so they can all have jobs to run their families. Besides being a hard worker, Uma goes to school to fulfill her dreams even though that is not her parents’ priority.
reception: Business Standard stated, "The dialogues and their delivery are suited to the way the language is spoken in such places. And though the characters portray emotions, they do so within realistic parametres."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The series was produced by Smriti Irani with her own new production house Ugraya Entertainment partnering and co produced with Ekta Kapoor's Balaji Telefilms, based on the real life incidents and set in Mumbai Chawl. When the contract between them got over after 52 episodes, Kapoor and Balaji Telefilms moved out of the production of the series in February 2007.
This is the first series produced by Smriti Irani and also the first one in which Balaji Telefilms were co-producers.
On 4 November 2006, main lead Irani playing Uma could not be able to shoot for the series as she suffered from dengue and typhoid and was admitted in hospital. However, with the bank episodes available, the series was managed without her and she returned to shoot back after a week.
The series initially had an average ratings but on progressing it dropped which made the channel to end the series in September 2007.

title: Thodi Khushi Thode Gham
summary: Thodi Khushi Thode Gham (transl. Some happiness some sadness) is an Indian soap opera  about the battle of the two genders that aired five days a week on Sony TV from 24 April 2006 until 6 December 2007. The show was created by Vinta Nanda, Piyush Gupta and Jatin Sethi and was produced by their production company Diamond Pictures.
plot:
The story mainly focuses on Sneha, who is the youngest daughter-in-law of the Shah family; her battle is against her father-in-law Mansukh Lal Shah. Mansukh believes that men should be dominant over women at all times, whereas Sneha believes that both should have equal rights. Sneha is married to Pranav, who is very strong-minded and is a good son. Sneha is married in a joint family, which consists of a sweet, strong-minded but shy mother (Daya), a sweet and gentle natured daughter-in-law (Jyoti), a sweet smart gynecologist doctor turned housewife (Bhavna), a strong-minded son (Amar), a dedicated son (Manoj), a cool, modern son (Karan), a nosy aunt (Kanta Ben), an apprentice of an uncle (Bhagu Mamaji), two little children (Alisha and Bittu), a teenage daughter with big dreams (Hetal) together with loving but funny servants (Manjit and Santu). That is the Shah family, a Jain joint family living together in a male-dominated home; but with Sneha's arrival things start to go haywire.
After Sneha is married, her bhabhis (sisters-in-law) Jyoti, Bhavna, and Daya challenge Sneha to change her behavior and attitude in two months because their father-in-law is a very strict man with many rules which govern their lives. Sneha is determined to open the eyes of the other women of the household, but Mansukh is always two steps ahead of her. This show depicts how Sneha tries to change her in-laws, especially the father-in-law's behavior and thoughts about women in general. Sneha is successful after many ups and downs.
reception: Rediff.com stated, "A simple storyline and impressive performances get this serial a slot in the Top Ten New Serials list."

title: Time Bomb 9/11
summary:
Time Bomb 9/11 or just Time Bomb was a Hindi political thriller that aired on Zee TV from 20 June 2005 to 28 November 2005. It used to air every Monday at 10:00pm, and the show had a similar format to "24". The story focuses on Osama bin Laden and his terrorist group aiming to destroy the city of New Delhi on 11 September as well as assassinating the Indian Prime Minister who was played by Kay Kay Menon. A RAW group led by Field Officer Varun Awasthi (played by Rajeev Khandelwal) has to protect the Prime Minister and more importantly, the city.
It also starred Pankaj Tripathi as one of the RAW Officers. Umar Abbasi acted as a golfer turned rogue.

title: The Great Indian Laughter Challenge
summary:
The Great Indian Laughter Challenge is an Indian reality stand-up comedy series produced by Endemol India. The first four seasons aired on STAR One from 15 June 2005 to 26 September 2008.
The show's fifth season premiered on 30 September 2017 on STAR Plus and was judged by actor Akshay Kumar.
The show is based on a format where stand-up comedians perform and entertain judges and the studio audience with their comedy skills. The first three seasons of the show saw TV personality Shekhar Suman, and politician Navjot Singh Sidhu on the judging panel. The show's initial episodes were hosted by Parizaad Kolah Marshall and later she was replaced by Shonali Nagrani. The fifth season was hosted by Elli Avram. The set was designed by noted Bollywood production designer Nitin Chandrakant Desai. In the fourth season, Shatrughan Sinha replaced Navjot Singh Sidhu as judge as per season.

articleSections.title: Seasons
articleSections.text:
In the first season, Sunil Pal was the winner, while Ahsaan Qureshi finished as runner up and Raju Srivastava as second runner up. In the second season, contestants from Pakistan were present, and the winner Rauf Lala was from Pakistan. The third season was won by Kapil Sharma and the first runner up was Chandan Prabhakar both from Amritsar. Many other talented comedians like Siraj Khan, Sudesh Lehari, Rajiv Thakur, Bharti Singh, Navin Prabhakar, Jassi Kochar, Khayaali, Dipoo Srivastava, Ahsaan Qureshi have appeared in the show.
The first two seasons were followed by another show, The Great Indian Laughter Champions, which included top performers of the previous shows. Here also the judges were Sidhu and Shekar including some celebrity guests as well.
Recently, the first woman to participate was Aarti Kandpal. The fourth season's finalists were Rasbihari Gaur, Bharti Singh, Suresh Albela, and a duo Sikander Sanam-Wali Sheikh (veteran stage comedians from Pakistan). The winner for the fourth season after a tough laughter war was Suresh Albela.
The fifth season had 3 mentors, namely, Zakir Khan, Hussain Dalal and Mallika Dua, while the judges were replaced by Sajid Khan and Shreyas Talpade, the two of whom along with Akshay Kumar, selected 12 finalists who competed for the title.

episodesList.title: The semi-finalists
episodesList.summary: Parizaad Kolah announces the semi-finalists of the show. They are Parag Kansara, Ahsaan Qureshi, Syed Shahbuddin, Deepak Raja, Bhagwant Mann, Khader Shareef, Sunil Pal, Mir, Habeeb Qadeer, Naveen Prabhakar, Shreekant Rao and Raju Shrivastav. We then look back at the best moments of the show so far.

episodesList.title: Special guest: Jai Chaniyara
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman to the show, along with special guest Jai Chaniyara. After Ahsaan Qureshi, Habib Qadeer, Sayed Shabuddin, Deepak Raja, Bhagwant Mann and Raju Shrivastava’s acts, the judges announce the scores of the semi-finalists.

episodesList.title: The first semi-finalists
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman to the show. Shrikant Rao and Navin Prabhakar present their acts, followed by Parag Kansara, Mir, Sunil Pal and Dharsi Beradia. Shekhar Suman then announces the names of the first semi-finalists.

episodesList.title: Rajpal Yadav announces the score
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman to the show along with special guest Johnny Lever. After Navin Prabhakar, Bhagwant Mann, Raju Srivastava, Parag Kansara, Ahsaan Qureshi and Sunil Pal’s hilarious acts, Rajpal Yadav comes out to announce the score of the finalists.

episodesList.title: Shekhar announces the winner
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman to the show along with special guest Johnny Lever. Parag Kansara and Navin Prabhakar present their acts, followed by Bhagwant Mann, Raju Srivastava, Ahsaan Qureshi and Sunil Pal. Finally, Sunil Pal is declared the winner.

episodesList.title: A complete laugh riot
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekhar Suman on the show. Sunil Pal, Bhagwant Mann, Raju Srivastava, Pradeep Pallavi, Syed Shabbudin and Ahsaan Qureshi present some skits. Later, Sunil Pal, Bhagwant Mann, Raju Srivastava, Pradeep and Pallavi present their acts.

episodesList.title: Unadulterated entertainment
episodesList.summary: Kanwal Toor, the host, welcomes Sidhu and Shekhar Suman on the show. Parag Kansara starts the show with his opening act. Later, contestants Ahsaan Qureshi, Bhagwant Mann, Deepak Raja and Raju Shrivastav present their respective performances.

episodesList.title: Jay Chinyara is the hero
episodesList.summary: Host Parizaad welcomes Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman as the judges of the show in Indian Air force campus in Pune. Jay Chhaniyara, Bhagwant Mann, Ahsaan Qureshi and Parag Kansara present their funny acts. Shekhar Suman praises Jay Chinyara and declares him as a hero.

episodesList.title: Syed Shabuddin and Deepak Raja perform in the final round
episodesList.summary: Parizad Kolah welcomes Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman, judges of the show. Syed Shabuddin comes on the stage to perform. Next, Devender Babloo comes on the stage to perform. Next, Adarsh Tiwari comes on the stage to perform. Next, Deepak Raja comes on the stage to perform. Next, Arvind Shukla comes on the stage to perform. Devender Babloo gets eliminated. Syed Shabuddin, Adarsh Tiwari, Deepak Raja and Arvind Shukla perform in the second round. Adarsh Tiwari gets eliminated. Syed Shabuddin, Deepak Raja and Arvind Shukla perform in the third round. Syed Shabuddin and Deepak Raja perform in the final round

episodesList.title: Season 2 Opener
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu to The Great Indian Laughter Challenge: Season 2. There are five contestants: Khayali (Chandigarh), Amir Rambo (Karachi, Pakistan), Jitesh Chawla (Jaipur), Surendra Dubey (Jaipur) and Rasik Maharaj (Kutch). Khayali is declared the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Rajkumar and Kashif's victory
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu to the show. Rajkumar Javkar and Kashif Khan present their acts, followed by Sunil Borade, Kulvinder Singh and Yogendera Joshi. Based on the judges and audience score, Rajkumar and Kashif Khan are declared the winners of the episode.

episodesList.title: Wali Shaik's winning act
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu to the show. Albela Khatri and Wali Shaik present their acts, followed by Vinod Kumar, Rashid Khan and Kuldeep Dubey. Based on the judges and audience score, Wali Shaik is declared the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Special guest: Soha Ali Khan
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu, along with special guest Soha Ali Khan. Pratap Faujdar, Pradeep Pallavi, Rohit Pyare, Sunil Sawra and Gaurav Jha put on their hilarious performances. Later, the judges declare Pratap Faujdar as the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Special guest: Perizaad Zorabian
episodesList.summary: Parizaad Kolah welcomes judges Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu along with special guest, Perizaad Zorabian. Ekesh Parth, Tushar Shah, Abrar, Kamal Basid and Jagmeet Bal charm the audience with their funny acts. Later, Tushar Shah is declared the winner of the show.

episodesList.title: Rajeev Nigam's sensational act
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu to the show. Rajeev Nigam, Rajendra Malviya, Aslam Imran and Papa CJ put on wonderful performances. Later, the judges declare Rajeev Nigam as the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Ali Hasan and Irfan Malik's win
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman to the show. First up, Banwari Jhol and Kimti Anand present their acts. They are followed by Ali Hasan, Irfan Malik, Prakash Paplu, Sohail Pataka and Navneet Hullar. Ali Hasan and Irfan Malik are declared the winners of the episode.

episodesList.title: Gaurav Sharma is the king of fun
episodesList.summary: Host Parizaad Kolah Marshall welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman to the show. Gaurav Sharma, Rajan Srivastav, K.K Naicker, Subhani G., Hamid Kamal and Tariq Mahmood then present their rib-tickling acts. Parizaad then announces Gaurav Sharma as the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Uday Dahiya's winning act
episodesList.summary: Host Parizaad welcomes judges Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu to the show. Uday Dahiya, Faisal Masood, Vinod Bajaj and Bhotu Shah put on their sparkling acts. Based on the judges and the audience score, Uday Dahiya is declared the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Rauf Lala Brings The House Down
episodesList.summary: Host Parizaad welcomes judges Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu to the show along with special guest Koena Mitra. Ayaz Samoo, Nitin Bhandarkar, Rauf Lala, Rajesh Shah, Hasan Ali, Zakir Mastana and Jagdish Trivedi then put up their hilarious acts. In the end, Rauf Lala is declared the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Best of Season 2
episodesList.summary: Parizaad hosts the special episode featuring the best stand-up acts from previous episodes. Tune in to see the best performances of Rajkumar Javkar, Kashif Khan, Tushar Shah, Rajeev Nigam, Khayali, Wali Shaikh, Pratap Faujdar, Uday Dahiya, Irfan Malik, Ali Hasan and Gaurav Sharma.

episodesList.title: Runners-up episode
episodesList.summary: Host Parizaad welcomes judges Shekhar Suman and Najot Singh Sidhu to the show. Akesh Parth, Hamid Kamal, Subhani, Vinod Bajaj, Rajendra Malviya and Amir Rambo put on their lively performances. Finally, Amir Rambo is declared the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Special guest: Priyanka Chopra
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman to the show, along with special guest, Priyanka Chopra. Rasik Maharaj, Albela Khatri, Faisal Masood, Sunil Savara and Yogendra Joshi put up their humorous acts. The judges and the audience choose Faisal Masood as the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Chandan Prabhakar is the winner
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes the judges, Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman. Gaurav Sharma, Irfan Malik, Ali Hasan come to the stage and take the audience on a laughter ride. Later, Chandan Prabhakar and Jassi Kochar present their acts. Shonali announces Chandan as the winner.

episodesList.title: Special guest: Diya Mirza
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman to the show, along with special guest, Diya Mirza. Amir Rambo presents his hilarious act, followed by Pratap Fauzdar, Rauf Lala, Irfan Malik and Ali Hasan, who leave the audience in splits.

episodesList.title: Special guest: Hrithik Roshan
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman, along with special guest, Hrithik Roshan. Rajiv Nigam, Tushar Shah, Wali Shaik and Kashif Khan then present their highly entertaining acts.

episodesList.title: Special guest: Sunil Shetty
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman, along with special guest Sunil Shetty. Pratap Fauzdar, Rajkumar Javkar, Khayali, Tushar Shah, Rauf Lala, Rajeev Nigam, Irfan Malik and Ali Hasan then take the stage by storm with their witty humour.

episodesList.title: Rauf Lala wins the finals
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman for the mega finals, along with special guest, Bipasha Basu. Tushar Shah, Rauf Lala, Rajkumar Javkar, Rajiv Nigam, Pratap Fauzdar, Khayali, Irfan Malik and Ali Hasan then present wonderful acts. Shekhar declares Rauf Lala as the winner of the finals.

episodesList.title: Funniest Moments Of This Season
episodesList.summary: This episode brings all the funniest moments of this season. Parizaad starts the show with the performance of Rauf Lala. Later, Khayali, Wali Shaik, Gaurav Sharma, Rajiv Nigam, Irfan Malik, Ali Hasan, Tushar Shah and Rajkumar Javkar present their respective performances.

episodesList.title: Raju Shrivastav opens the show
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman on the show. Raju Shrivastav starts the contest by his funny act. Later, Khayali, Sunil Pal, Rauf Lala, Rajkumar, Naveen Prabhakar, Tushar Shah, Ahsan Qureshi, Pratap Fauzdar and Irfan- Ali Hasan present their respective performances.

episodesList.title: Kapil's best laughter moment
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu to the show. While N D Sharma is voted out in the first round, Uzair is voted out in the rapid fire round. In the final round, Kapil Sharma and Harvinder Pal Sicha come out as the winners. The best laughter moment is chosen from Kapil Sharma’s act.

episodesList.title: Kapil enters the semi-finals
episodesList.summary: Host Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman. Rauf Lala, Dr. Tushar Shah, Raju Shrivastava, Harvinder Pal Sicha and Kapil Sharma then take to the stage with their comedy acts. Finally, Kapil Sharma moves on to the semi-finals.

episodesList.title: Rajiv and Faisal win the episode
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu. After the first round, Hari Om is voted out. Sharif Bharti is then voted out in the rapid fire round. The remaining contestants compete in the third round and Rajiv Thakur and Faisal Masood are declared as winners.

episodesList.title: Faisal & Rajiv's winning ways
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu to the show. Gaurav Sharma. Raju Shrivastava and two of the finalists, Faisal Masood and Rajiv Thakur then present their hilarious acts. Both Faisal Masood and Rajiv Thakur are eventually declared the winners.

episodesList.title: Kuldeep, Pankaj voted out
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu to the show. Kuldeep Lalkaar is voted out after a tight first round. Pankaj Johari is the next to go out from the rapid fire round. After a thoroughly entertaining third round, Aarti Khandpal and Hanif Raja are declared winners.

episodesList.title: Kapil goes to the semis
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman. Rauf Lala, Gurpreet Guggi, Ali Hasan, Irfan Malik, Aarti Kandpal and Hanif Raja then grab the attention with their funny acts. Kapil Sharma moves on to the semi-finals.

episodesList.title: Sudesh, Rasbihari in next round
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes the audience and judges Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu. While Amit Hawaldar gets disqualified in the first round, Liaqat Soldier gets voted out in the rapid fire round. Priyesh Sinha is eliminated in the last round. Sudesh Lehri and Rasbihari Gaur reach the next round.

episodesList.title: Cricket and Karan Johar flicks
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekhar to Season 3 of The Great Indian Laughter Challenge. After Irfan Malik and Ali Hasan’s funny act, Gaurav Sharma cracks jokes on Indian cricket and Karan Johar movies. But Rasbihari Gaur and Sudesh Lehri’s jokes on music impress the judges most.

episodesList.title: Acts of comedy
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekhar and Sidhu before Ashok Sundarani makes cracks on Indian TV shows. Ajeet Shrivastav, Rahul, Savitri Kochar and Amanulla Khan then present their acts. Finally, the judgement pick Ashok and Amanulla as winners to compete for the finals.

episodesList.title: Amanullah goes to the semis
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Shekhar and Sidhu. Bhagwant Mann, Rasik Maharaj, Amanullah Khan then present their funny acts. While Ashok Sundrani gets eliminated from the show, Amanullah Khan reaches the semi-finals.

episodesList.title: Ram Sarin and Parvez Siddiqui win
episodesList.summary: Parizaad starts the show by welcoming Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu. Ram Sarin from Mathura starts the show followed by Rajeev Kumar, Moshai Sabir Khan, O.P. Dwivedi and Parvez Siddiqui. Parizaad announces Ram Sarin and Parvez Siddiqui as the winners.

episodesList.title: Parvez Siddiqui wins the show
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani starts the show by welcoming Shekhar Suman and Navjot Singh Sidhu on the show. Bhagwant Maan starts the show followed by Rajeev Nigam, Irfan Malik, Ali Hasan, Ram Sarin and Parvez Siddiqui. Shonali announces Parvez Siddiqui as the winner of the show.

episodesList.title: A complete comedy show
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes Navjot Singh Sidhu, Shekhar Suman and guest judge Himesh Reshammiya. Chandan Prabhakar, Shailu Choukade, Somnath Karmakar, Jassi Kochar and Abrar Lucknavi present their acts. Parizaad announces Chandan Prabhakar and Jassi Kochar as winners.

episodesList.title: Champions from the past
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekhar to this special episode, featuring champions of the previous seasons. Gaurav Sharma, Irfan Mallick and Ali Hassan amuse the judges with their comedy acts. Jassi Kochar from Jalandhar and Chandan Prabhakar also put up memorable performances.

episodesList.title: Get ready for great laughter
episodesList.summary: Parizaad starts the show by welcoming the judges, Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman. Aiyaz Saimoo, Dinesh Bawra and Kuldeep Dubey give some stunning performances. Rehman Khan amuses the viewers with his pranks.

episodesList.title: Laugh your way to glory
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani hosts the show and introduces Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekhar Suman. Raju Shrivastav mimics Dilip Kumar and Amitabh Bachchan. Dinesh Bawra, Rehman Khan and Kuldeep Dubey entertain the audiences with their hilarious acts. Kuldeep Dubey wins the show.

episodesList.title: Vinod and Saleem's winning acts
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Shekhar and Sidhu to the show. Jagbir Rathee, Vinod Kumar, Ramanpreet Singh, Mohammad Athar, Salim Afridi then enthral the audience with their funny acts. Vinod Kumar and Salim Afridi are declared the two final winners of the day.

episodesList.title: Saleem Afridi is the winner
episodesList.summary: Host Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekhar to the show. Gaurav Sharma, Rajiv Nigam, Vinod Kumar, Saleem Afridi then present their hilarious acts. After a tough final round with Vinod Kumar, Saleem Afridi is chosen as the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Sharendu & Seema are eliminated
episodesList.summary: Host Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekhar on the show. While Shardendu Shukla is eliminated in the first round, Seema Motwani is goes out in the second round. Khawer Hassan and Amir Rambo are declared the winners of the episode for their rib-tickling acts.

episodesList.title: Rambo's ramblings
episodesList.summary: Host Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekhar to the show. Guggi and Raju are first up, followed by Ali and Irfan’s entertaining acts. Khawer Hassan and Amir Rambo are the last ones to present. Based on the judges and the audience scores, Amir Rambo is declared the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Tie between Ashok and Shambhu
episodesList.summary: Host Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekhar, who are floored by Ras Bihari Gaur and Shambhu Shikhar’s funny acts. Harvinder Sicha, Ram Sarin and Ashok Subdrani then put up their hilarious performances. The show ends in a tie between Ashok Subdrani and Shambhu Shikhar.

episodesList.title: Shambhu Shikhar on top
episodesList.summary: Host Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekhar to the show. Rauf Lala, Rajiv Nigam, Bhagwant Maan, Ashok Subdrani and Shambhu Shikhar put on a series of wonderful acts. The judges and audience choose Shambhu Shikhar as the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Vinod & Rehman are the winners
episodesList.summary: Host Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekhar to the show. Jassi Kochar, Rehman, Mukesh Gautam and Vinod Kumar put on some eye-catching performances. In the end, Vinod Kumar and Rehman are declared the winners of the episode.

episodesList.title: Rehman is eliminated
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shekar Suman. Following Irfan Malik, Ali Hasan, Guggi Paji and Rehman’s acts, Vinod Kumar entertains the floor with his hilarious performance. The judges finally decide to eliminate Rehman.

episodesList.title: Wild card runner-up contest
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar to the the show. After Kapil, Aarti, Hanis Raja and Sudesh Lehri’s acts, Kuldeep and Rehman fight for their place in the semi-final. Aman comes next and Salim Afridi and Vinod Kumar present their individual acts at the end.

episodesList.title: Independence Day Special
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar, who express their feelings about Indian independence. Indian and Pakistani contestants celebrate the sixtieth year of Indian independence. After Gaurav Sharma, Rajiv Nigam, Raju Srivastav’s funny acts Shekar Suman praises all the semi-finalists.

episodesList.title: Aarti and Shambu eliminated
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar to the show. Sudesh Lehri’s opening act is followed by Pervez Siddiqui, Shambu Shikhar, Aarti and Rajiv Thakur’s entertaining performances. The judges eventually eliminate Aarti and Shambu Shikar.

episodesList.title: Semi-finals
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar to the show. Rajiv Nigam opens the show with his funny act, followed by Rajiv Thakur, Pervez Siddique and Sudesh Lehri. Due to a tie between Rajiv Thakur and Pervez Siddique, both of them qualify for the finals along with Sudesh Lehri.

episodesList.title: Second Semi-final
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar to the show. Vinod Kumar, Chandar Prabhakar, Salim Afridi, Amir Rambho and Kuldeep Dube presents their entertaining acts. Vinod Kumar and Amir Rambho are eliminated as they secure the lowest points tally.

episodesList.title: Om Puri and Anupam Kher special
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar to the show, along with special guests, Om Puri and Anupam Kher. After Raju Srivastav and Salim Afridi’s act, Kuldeep Dube presents his impression of Om Puri. After Chandan Prabhakar’s final act, the judges eliminate Salim Afridi.

episodesList.title: Kapil comes first
episodesList.summary: The charming Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar. After Kapil Sharma and Rehman Khan’s acts, Faisal Masood cracks jokes on celebrities. Following Amanullah Khan’s final gig, the scores are announced. Kapil Sharma comes first, followed by Amanullah Khan in second position.

episodesList.title: Kapil Sharma Steals The Show
episodesList.summary: Host Sonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar. Rauf Lala, Faisal Masood, Kapil Sharma and Amanullah Khan then look to impress the judges with their funny acts. Kapil Sharma comes first, with Amanullah Khan in second position, while Faisal Masood is out of the competition.

episodesList.title: Special guest: Umar Sheriff
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar to the final episode of the season. Umar Sheriff, Parvez Siddiqui, Rajiv Thakur and Sudesh Lehri put on their fabulous performances. Parvez Siddiqui gets the highest number of points.

episodesList.title: Laugh along and feel happy
episodesList.summary: Shonali Nagrani starts the show by welcoming the judges Navjot Singh Sidhu, Shekhar Suman and Umar Sharif. Kapil Sharma, Chandan Prabhakar, Kuldeep Dubey and Amanullah Khan present their respective acts. Shonali Nagrani announces the scores of the contestants.

episodesList.title: Sudesh Lehri gets emotional
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes judges Sidhu and Shekar to the grand finale, whith Umar Sheriff as a special guest. Parvez Siddiqui, Rajiv Thakur, Kuldeep Dube and Sudesh Lehri then present their hilarious acts. Sudesh Lehri gets emotional when Umar Sheriff praises him.

episodesList.title: Kapil creates a laughter riot
episodesList.summary: Sonali Nagrani welcomes judges Sidhu, Shekar and Umar Sherrif to the grand finale of The Great Indian Laughter Challenge. Chandan Parbhakar, Kapil Sharma, Amanullah Khan then present their acts. Kapil Sharma breaks down when he is declared the winner. Chandan Prabhakar and Sudesh Lehri 2nd and 3rd respectively.

episodesList.title: Unlimited entertainment
episodesList.summary: Shenaz welcomes Sidhu and Shatrughan Sinha on the show. Singer Hard Kaur gives a special performance. Ehsaan and Bablu Baral start the contest by his opening act. Later, Sourav Chakraborty, Yashwant Singh, Sunil Pal, Rajbeer, Kapil Sharma, Chandan Prabhakar and Kader Sharif present their acts.

episodesList.title: Time to tickle your funny bone
episodesList.summary: Shenaz welcomes Sidhu, Shatrughan Sinha and Rajpal Yadav on the show. Chandan Prabhakar and Kapil Sharma start the contest with their hilarious acts. Siddhesh Bhosle, Sikandar Sanam, Walli Sheikh, Gaurav Sharma, Bharti Singh and others present their acts.

episodesList.title: Tickling the funny bone
episodesList.summary: Host Shenaz welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shatrughan Sinha. Contestants Kapil Sharma and Chandan Prabhakar start the show with a hilarious act. Later, Anirudh Madesia, Bharti Singh and Amit Sharma showcase their talent in front of the judges.

episodesList.title: Non-stop laughter just for you
episodesList.summary: Shenaz welcomes Sidhu and Shatrughan Sinha on the show. Chandan Prabhakar, accompanied by Kapil Sharma, starts the contest. Later, Yashwant, Naveen, Jeetendar, Abdal Khan, Amil Khan, Yashwant, Naveen, Sourav are selected for the second round. Yashwant and Sourav get equal scores.

episodesList.title: Rajbir Kaur is the winner
episodesList.summary: Host Shenaz welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shatrughan Sinha to the show and announces the audience score. Kapil Sharma, Chandan Prabhakar, Rajbir Kaur, Sanjay Pandey Bharat, Vishwa Chauhan, Ajay Atpattu and Manoj Kumar Bobby then present their acts. Rajbir Kaur is declared the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Complete comedy show for family
episodesList.summary: Host Shenaz welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu and Shatrughan Sinha. Kapil Sharma, Chandan Prabhakar, Jaffer Hussain, Mukesh Chhotu, Suresh Albela, Pushpinder Jeera perform in the first round. Later, Mukesh Chhotu, Pushpinder Jeera and Suresh Albela present their acts.

episodesList.title: Sugandha Mishra's winning act
episodesList.summary: Host Shenaz welcomes judges Sidhu and Shatrughan Sinha to the show. Kapil Sharma, Chandan Prabhakar, Dinesh Bawra, Sugandha Mishra, Sunil Borade, Shakil Shah, Zakir Mastana and Kashif Prince then present their acts. In the end, Sugandha Mishra is declared the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Ras Bihari Gaur's win
episodesList.summary: Host Shenaz welcomes judges Sidhu and Shatrughan Sinha to the show Kapil Sharma, Chandan Prabhakar, Govind Pathak, Balraj Syal, Ras Bihari Gaur, Manish Jangara and Liyaqat Soldier then present their acts. Finally, the judges declare Ras Bihari Gaur as the winner of the episode.

episodesList.title: Rihan moves to the next round
episodesList.summary: Shenaz Treasurywala welcomes judges Sidhu and Shatrughan Sinha on the show. Kapil, Chandan, Harvinder Shicha, Mithilesh Tiwary, Mintu, Rihan and Arvind Pratihar entertain the floor with their splendid performances. Eventually, Rihan gets qualified for the next round after second innings.

episodesList.title: Some hilarious performances
episodesList.summary: The host welcomes judges Navjot Singh Sidhu, Shatrughan Sinha, Manoj Bajpai and Hansini. Albela takes everyone on a laughter ride with his hilarious comedy and funny acts.

episodesList.title: Babbu Baral qualifies
episodesList.summary: Shenaz Treasurywala welcomes judges Sidhu and Shatrughan Sinha on the show. Babbu Baral, Prakash Nagori, Deepak Sharma, Brajesh Dubey and Anil Shukle then present their acts. Finally, Babbu Baral gets qualified for the next round after second innings.

episodesList.title: Wild Card entry round
episodesList.summary: Parizaad welcomes special judges Shatrughan Sinha and Shakti Kapoor on the show. In the Wild Card round, Anirudh Madesia, Navin Sarathi, Manoj Kumar Bobby, Sunil Thakkar and Shafdar Khan present their acts. Sunil Thakkar, Navin Sarathi and Anirudh Madesia then qualify for the next round.

episodesList.title: The first round of eliminations

title: Tumhari Disha
summary: Tumhari Disha is an Indian drama television series produced by Filmfarm India that premiered on 22 August 2004 on Zee TV. It is based on the life of a girl named Disha and the moments that changed her life forever.
plot:
Vijayendra and Suhasini Bhosle have raised their two daughters Disha and Rano as equals - well almost equals. However, a dark secret from the past threatens to create a rift between the two sisters. When Suhasini realizes that Rano is in love with Inder, while Inder is keen to marry Disha, she lets the cat out of the bag. She discloses that Disha is not their biological child but their servant's child.
Dushyant Sehgal aka DK, a powerful diamond merchant, asks Disha to pose in the nude for his jewellery advertisement. Disha refuses the proposal. However destiny has something else in store for Disha. Vijayendra Bhosle meets with an accident and dies, leaving the family in dire straits. Disha is left with no choice but to accept DK's proposal; however, she poses the condition that DK will have to marry her.
The relationship, which had started on a sour note, takes a turn when DK realizes that he loves Disha. Jealousy and possessiveness adds spice to the growing relationship between Disha and Dk. Gargi, DK's step mother, is a cunning and shrewd lady who wants to grab DK's business empire for herself.
Disha and Dk manage to survive through all the odds. However, DK meets with an accident, which leaves him paralyzed waist down. DK is so devastated that he wants Disha to move on in her life. He encourages disha to marry someone else; however Disha chooses to be DK's for all her life. She ends her life before she can be forced to marry someone else. Before dying, Disha makes DK promise to get on with life.
DK gets well and does as promised. He marries a simpleton named Kamna and has three children—Dhan, Veer and Dhruvi. Dk still lives with the memories of his first wife Disha. He pampers his children and completely ignores Kamna. When the children grow up, Dhan gets engaged to Surily, who is a very shrewd and cunning person. DK starts receiving threats to stop the wedding, but keeps ignoring them. The day of the wedding arrives.DK gets kidnapped before the wedding...

title: Tum Bin Jaaoon Kahaan
summary: Tum Bin Jaaoon Kahaan is a Hindi television serial that aired on Zee TV and starred Vikas Bhalla and Jividha Sharma in the main leads. It aired from 12 October 2003 to 3 March 2005.
plot:
Muskaan lives in Delhi with her parents and younger sister. They go to Mumbai to visit relatives and Muskaan ends up staying there to go to Medical School. She meets Aryan and they fall in love. Aryan has a friend Monty, who does dark arts and knows how to talk to spirits. Aryan and Muskaan want to get married. Aryan has to attend to his ailing father and leaves. Due to a misunderstanding Muskaan agrees to marry someone else. On the day of her wedding Aryan convinces her to elope with him but on their way they meet with an accident. Aryan is injured but Muskaan loses her life.
A depressed Aryan convinces Monty to make him talk to Muskaan's spirit. The spirit tells him to move on but tells him that Muskaan will be reborn after 13 months in the town of Omkareshwar and throws yellow flowers on Aryan. Using the clue, Aryan finds a house in the town with yellow flowers. Though he doesn't find a newborn there, that very night after he leaves a couple visits the homeowners looking for a place where the woman can give birth. Thus, Khushi is born.

articleSections.title: 3 years later
articleSections.text: Khushi lives in Omkareshwar at her grandparents house with her mother and grandfather. Aryan falls into depression after Muskaan's demise. Aryan's parents get him engaged to Shweta. When a toddler Khushi finds out about Aryan's fiance Shweta, she kills her in a car accident. Aryan is shattered and starts to think that marriage is not for him. He spends all his time working in the hospital.

articleSections.title: 3 years later
articleSections.text:
Three years later Aryan is still unable to forget Muskaan and blames himself for her death. Khushi's mother, Vrinda, shifts the family to Mumbai where they live with Vrinda's brother, Vishwanath and his wife. Vishwanath and Aryan's families know each other professionally.
Aryan's childhood friend Durga comes to Mumbai and helps him move on. Aryan eventually falls in love with her, and they decide to get married. Khushi tries to make use of her stronger senses to kill Durga. Noticing these mishaps, Sumitra takes advice from Guruma who advises her to ask Durga to keep herself away from Aryan for 40 days. This causes a rift in their marriage but they go for a vacation. Meanwhile, noticing Khushi's odd behaviour, her grandfather's friend Parikshit, takes her to Guruma and asks for help. Guruma realises Khushi has a power within her and wants it for herself but is unable to get it.
Failing to kill Durga, Khushi seeks help of Guruji. They talk about her past life but Parikshit overhears the conversation. As he is about to inform her grandfather, she makes him fall off a roof leading him to be completely paralyzed. He writes about her truth in a diary which is lost. Meanwhile, Durga decides to disobey Sumitra. On her way to reconcile with Aryan, she meets with an accident and is killed by Khushi. Aryan is devastated.

articleSections.title: 3 years later
articleSections.text:
Khushi, now 8 years old, is very attached to Neelu and Shalini. Khushi has developed better senses, and is now able to predict what will happen the next moment. However, she now sees Aryan in a very blurry vision. She doesn't know why she keeps having nightmares. Khushi goes to Aryan's house for a party, and encounters Akash who is Devika's (Guruji's granddaughter) fiancé. Khushi sees him committing a murder but is unable to prevent it from happening.Akash realises Khushi's power and wants to kill her. Mysteriously, Durga reappears and she and Aryan discover she is pregnant.
Khushi is still confused about her visions of Muskaan. It is revealed that Akash, in fact, killed Muskaan because she left him on the day of their wedding. Akash is confined to a mental asylum. Looking for answers, Khushi goes back to the temple as Guruji looks on.
10 years later Now 18, Khushi has been living in Australia with her parents but decides to go to India for an internship. Khushi visits her grandfather in Omkareshwar before heading to Mumbai. She joins an architectural firm where she hears about an upcoming project - the Kali Ma temple Khushi visited with Aryan. Khushi vaguely remembers the temple.
Meanwhile, Aryan and Durga are happily living with their daughter Shraddha. Khushi is sick of the games her mind keeps playing on her and one day, she goes back to the temple and asks God to reveal her purpose on earth. Khushi suddenly gets flashbacks of Aryan and her, and fully remembers her past. She then realizes that she is Muskaan who was brought back to earth to reunite with Aryan. Khushi catches Aryan when he is alone and tries to make him believe that she is Muskaan. Aryan gets a shock and does not trust her at first, until she talks about how they were about to get married, and met with an accident. Khushi is crazy about Aryan and refuses to leave him. Aryan explains to her that he has moved on in life and cannot leave Durga.
Eventually, everyone in the family finds out that Khushi is Muskaan. After being paralytic for years, Parikshit dies in the hospital. Khushi professes her love to Aryan and tells him that she will wait at the same temple as a bride to marry him but Aryan explains to Khushi that he cannot marry her as he loves Durga. This breaks Khushi’s heart.
Khushi falls into depression. At a park Khushi is bitten by a snake after which she is consumed by a negative force which turns her into a completely evil and heartless person. She vows to destroy Durga’s life. Durga eventually finds out that Khushi is Muskaan, and tries to keep her away from Aryan but in vain. Khushi creates misunderstandings between the couple and finally when Durga decides to go on holiday with Aryan and Shraddha, Khushi leads her to be involved in an accident where a man dies. Pretending to help Durga, Khushi helps cover up the incident but turns on Durga during the court hearing. Durga is sentenced to life imprisonment and the entire family is left in shock.
Khushi begs Aryan to marry her and divorce Durga. He gets compelled to break his relationship with Durga and marry Khushi. This shatters Durga. Aryan develops hatred for Khushi and tells her that he will never be able to love her the way he loves Durga. A heartbroken Durga meets Guruma in prison. Guruma helps Durga escape from prison using black magic and everyone believes Durga is dead. Aryan and Khushi consummate their marriage and Khushi believes that Aryan loves her once again.
Durga tries to expose Khushi and succeeds. Aryan and his family finally realize that Khushi was the mastermind behind Durga’s jail sentence and Aryan decides to sever all ties with Khushi. Aryan and Durga get back together. During the ceremony where they are remarrying, Khushi meets Aryan and tells him that she is pregnant with his child. Coincidentally, Durga also becomes pregnant the same time as Khushi. Khushi decides to kill Durga. She sets a car on fire, but ends up killing Aryan instead. Devastated, she vows to bring up Aryan’s child with pride and dignity when he is born. During both Durga and Khushi’s delivery, Guruma swaps the newborns.
The evil newborn is named Timir by Durga. As Timir transitions from a newborn to a little boy, he kills three people. Timir is under Guruma’s shadow. Meanwhile, Guruji’s men look for Timir because they know he is a demonic spirit disguised as a child. Maahir and Timir study in the same school and hate each other. Timir tries to torture Aryan’s mother when she finds out that he is evil spirited.
Shraddha’s doctor, Ritvik, tries to win over Durga’s heart and confesses his love to her. Khushi's friend Dhruv proposes to her. Ritvik and Dhruv tell Durga and Khushi to marry them respectively. Both women agree for the sake of their children’s happiness. Maahir warns Durga about Ritvik but she fails to understand his gestures. Ritvik turns out to be appointed by Guruma to assist in killing Durga. On their wedding day Durga exposes Ritvik, and he leaves. During an architectural project Dhruv discovers a mummy at the construction site, which turns out to be Timir! Timir kills Dhruv and dumps his dead body somewhere untraceable.
It is revealed that Aryan survived the car accident and was abducted by Guruma who kept him with her in a den for 7 years. She takes advantage of his memory loss by turning him against Durga and making it seem like Durga was the reason for the accident. A lost Aryan believes her, and starts plotting against Durga. Durga and Khushi discover Aryan is still alive. Meanwhile, Aryan is unable to bring himself to kill Durga. Affected by Maahir, he chooses to live with Khushi and Maahir breaking Durga's heart. Khushi remains unconvinced that Aryan loves her.
Guruma finds a dangerous convict who is Aryan's lookalike. She gets him to pretend being Aryan and live with Durga. The lookalike tries killing Durga but fails each time. He slowly starts getting attracted to Durga and sympathizes with her situation. On the day of Karva Chauth it is revealed that the man Durga was living with is not the actual Aryan. In an accident both Aryans are badly injured and one of them dies. At the hospital, the surviving 'Aryan' decides to keep Guruma in the dark.
During the final battle, Maahir and Timir vow to destroy each other. Just before Timir finally dies, Khushi and Durga realize that they had been under the wing of each other’s children. A few months pass. Guruma is now helpless, powerless, and completely disheveled from her endless battle.
Khushi requests Durga to let Maahir stay with her. Durga agrees, while Aryan, Durga and Shraddha reunite. As Aryan meets Khushi one last time, Maahir senses that Durga’s life is in danger. He tells Khushi to 'help him save his mother.' Khushi decides to do a good deed. A mentally ill Guruma attempts to put Durga in danger by causing an accident. Aryan tries to save Durga on his motorbike, while Khushi sits behind as a pillion rider. She recalls the first time they sat on the bike which was when they eloped. She smiles to herself and thinks how lucky she had been to be with Aryan. Aryan manages to save Durga and as the rocks tumble down, Khushi tries to save Aryan. In doing so, she gets buried under a heavy rock. Khushi dies in Aryan's arms as she whispers Tum Bin Jaoon Kahaan (Where do I go without you) under her breath and dies with the ending credits showing flashbacks of Muskaan reincarnating as Khushi.

title: Thief of Baghdad
summary: Thief of Baghdad is an Indian fantasy adventure TV series that first originally aired on Zee TV between 2000–2001. The show was loosely based on the Arabian Nights story. It was originally intended to run for 48 episodes but it went off-air in June 2001 abruptly due to a conflict between the production house and Zee TV. It was directed by Vijay Pandey, who has earlier directed shows like Sword of Tipu Sultan, Great Maratha, Arth, Des Mein Nikla Hoga Chand and Saat Phere. It was also syndicated on sister channels Zee Next and Zee Smile and Zee Anmol.
plot:
Set in the Middle East during an era of marvellous adventures and magical folk tales as narrated in the Arabian Nights, 'Thief of Baghdad' tells the story of Jafar, a ruthless warlord serving under the command of the evil genie 'Shah Jinn' and his obsession with conquering the entire world to become its undisputed king.
Shortly after invading the city of Baghdad with his army and brutally vanquishing a secret rebellion led by Mukhtar, a spiritual leader and revolutionary, Jafar is informed by Shah Jinn and his sorceress aide Badi about a prospect which can greatly assist him in achieving his seemingly overwhelming objective. Jafar must convince a princess belonging to a peaceful kingdom of fairies to marry him of her own volition in order to gain complete authority and control over the inhabitants of both realms. Immediately, he decides to interrupt the birthday celebration of the beautiful princess Yasmeen and take her away from her kingdom to imprison her in his palace full of grim spells preventing her from escaping back to her home. As the princess begins to develop feelings of despair and anguish, hope appears in the form of a notorious thief known only throughout the city as the 'Thief of Baghdad', a sly and artful hero who steals from the rich to help the poor and oppressed.
One night during an intrusion into Jafar's palace to retrieve a collection of magical items stolen from three visiting merchants, the Thief coincidentally encounters the captive princess and they both recall their romance with each other prior to the events which unfolded with the appearance of Jafar. Realising the severity of the situation and its impact on every inhabitant in both realms, the Thief decides to do whatever he can to stop the tyranny of Jafar and rescue the Princess from his vile grasp.
As the series progresses the Thief and several allies he forms relationships with all have to endure and overcome the dangerous obstacles and ghastly traps Jafar has set to secure his position as the ultimate king of kings.

summary:
Tu Tu Main Main (transl. Squabble) is an Indian television sitcom which originally aired on DD Metro and later StarPlus directed by Sachin Pilgaonkar. title: The Great Maratha
summary: The Great Maratha is an Indian historical drama television series directed by Sanjay Khan and produced by Numero Uno International Limited.  The drama aired on DD National. The series is based on the life of Mahadaji Shinde. The show comprised 47 episodes. The music was composed by Mohammed Zahur Khayyam.
plot: The series starts with the events of 1759 in Delhi, during the declining Mughal empire under emperor Shah Alam II. Weakness of the Mughal empire leads to the invasion of Ahmad Shah Durrani and his army faces the Maratha army on 14 January 1761. The cataclysmic defeat of the Marathas in this Third Battle of Panipat lead to the death of 50000 Marathas and many more. Witnessing this defeat, the Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao dies of mental depression. Then the show follows the life of Mahadji Shinde who was gravely wounded in the battle. But soon Maratha Empire, with his help, recovered Maratha power in North India, restoring Mughal emperor's moral authority as Mughal empire came under Maratha protection. He was awarded the title of grand visier by the Mughal emperor. There is a romance between Mahadji and princess Jumna, blossoming into marriage. Mahadji and Indore's queen Ahilya Bai Holkar develop attraction and have a sublime relationship where they help each other. The British are kept in check due to his efforts.The series ends with a fictional account of Mahadji suddenly falling ill, possibly by poisoning, while eating food with other Maratha officers in Pune, and he dies soon.

title: Talaash
summary:
Talaash (English: "The Search") is an Indian drama series that aired in 1992 on Doordarshan. Directed by Hrishikesh Mukherjee, the film is based on the novel Sonar Kathi Rupor Kathi by Ashutosh Mukherjee. The title song sung by Suresh Wadekar and lyrics by Yogesh was a cover of the song "Tum Pukar Lo". Episode 9 has a song sung by Sonu Nigam with music by Usha Khanna.
The cast of the series includes Moushumi Chatterjee.
plot: As the name suggests this is a story of search of old lost family friend of the lead character. Shankarlal Shrivastava Alok Nath is an author who is returning from a function by train. On the way back he is passing from a village "Sarsavan", the name of which strikes him prominently but he cannot remember the relation. Once he gets down the train and goes in that village he realizes the link. The last letter from Sudhir (Vijayendra Ghatge), Shankarlal's close family friend was sent from this village. Sudhir is the son of Shankarlal's mother's closest friend who consider themselves as sisters. The two families are very close to each other. On insistence of his mother Sudhir takes a job and leaves the family. Shankarlal takes care of Sudhir's mother in her last days. However, after some days there is no contact from Sudhir and all ties are lost. The last and very faint tie is the place from where Sudhir had sent his last letter which is from village 'Sarsavan'. It is then the story of Shankarlal's quest to find his long lost friend and to know the reason and consequences why he disappeared.

title: The Sword of Tipu Sultan
summary:
The Sword of Tipu Sultan is a fictional semi historical drama that was first broadcast on the DD National in  February 1990. Based on a novel by Bhagwan Gidwani, this drama is a fictional portrayal of the life and times of Tipu Sultan, the 18th century ruler of Mysore. 
While the series was widely praised for its casting and grandeur, it also attracted wide criticism for whitewashing the history and misrepresenting Tipu Sultan as a benevolent and tolerant ruler.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The television drama was produced by the company Numero Uno International owned by movie director and producer Sanjay Khan. Akbar Khan, Sanjay Khan's brother, directed the first 20 episodes over a span of 18 months. The remaining episodes were directed by Sanjay Khan, and he also played the leading role of Tipu Sultan. A total of 52 episodes were shot, some of them in the Premier Studios in Mysore, Karnataka. Whereas, the music was composed by legendary Naushad and was photographed by Basheer Ali.
The series is based on a novel of the same name, written by the Montreal-based author Bhagwan S Gidwani. The novel was a best-seller, having sold about 200,000 copies, translated into many languages and reprinted in 44 editions. Gidwani also wrote the screenplay and script for the 60 episodes. The last few episodes were shot after the fire accident, a few years later.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text:
The drama was first telecast in Hindi on the Doordarshan channel in February 1990. It was dubbed into Telugu and broadcast on ETV in 1996. In 2001, it was also telecast on Star Plus. The episodes were dubbed in Bengali and broadcast on BTV in the early 1990s and into Tamil and broadcast on the DD Podhigai channel in 2006. In the BTV broadcast, portions of dialogue were censored. Outside the subcontinent, the drama was shown on Channel 4 in the United Kingdom during the early 1990s. Other countries included Iran, Indonesia and Mauritius. An original pack of 12 DVDs was later released.
as Tipu Sultan (right) with Kanwaljeet Singh

articleSections.title: Fire accident
articleSections.text: A major fire accident took place on 8 February 1989, in the Premier Studios of Mysore where the drama was being shot. Unavailability of firefighting equipment and ignorance of fire safety standards have been quoted as the major reasons. Loose wiring and absence of ventilators were further causes for the fire to spread. Instead of fire-proofing material, the walls had gunny bags and the temperature rose to around 120°C (248°F) because of huge lights being used for the shooting. All these factors contributed to the massive fire; the final death toll was 62. Sanjay Khan himself suffered major burns and had to spend 13 months in hospital and undergo 72 surgeries. An ex-gratia amount of Rs.5000 was paid to the victims.

articleSections.title: Awards
articleSections.text: For his work on this drama, Sanjay Khan received the Gem of India Award.
